[1]
oṃ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ |
caturvargacintāmaṇau pariśeṣakhaṇḍe kālanirṇaye
saṃvatsarāyaṇamāsaviśeṣāṇāṃ kāryaviśeṣopayoganirūpaṇam |
prathamo’dhyāyaḥ |
kalyāṇāni dadātu vo gaṇapatir yaminn atuṣṭe sati
kṣodīyasy api karmaṇi prabhavituṃ brahmāpi jihmāyate |
jāte taccaraṇapraṇāmasulabhe saubhāgyabhāgyodaye
raṅkasyāṅkam anaṅkuśā niviśate devendralakṣmīr api || 1 ||
śaśvatpuṇyahiraṇyagarbharasanāsiṃhāsanādhyāsinī
seyaṃ vāgadhidevatā vitaratu śreyāṃsi bhūyāṃsi vaḥ |
yatpādāmalakomalāṅgulinakhajyotsnābhir udvelitaḥ
śabdabrahmasudhāmbudhirbudhamanasyucchṛṅkhalaṃ khelati || 2 ||
namas tasmai viśvodayavilayarakṣāprakṛtaye
śivāya kleśaughacchidurapadapadmapraṇataye |
amandasvacchandaprathitapṛthulīlātanubhṛte
trivedīvācām apy apathanijatattvasthitikṛte || 3 ||
[2]        rāgaḥ kṛṣṇa navastavaśrutir iyaṃ cetaścamatkāriṇī
mugdhe vettha yathā mayāśu bharate vaidagdhyam āviṣkṛtam |
jānīte dayitaiva sāśubharate yad yad vidhatte bhavān
ity uko madhubhinniruttaramukhaḥ śliṣyan priyāṃ pātu vaḥ || 4 ||
te devasya gabhastayo dinapater āpannakhedacchido-
niṣkṛntantu kṛtāntapattanapathaprasthānadausthyāni vaḥ |
yaiḥ sauvarṇam ivākhilaṃ karuṇayā nirmātum abhyudyataiḥ
kīrṇavarṇaparāgarāgaghaṭitaṃ dikcakram ālakṣyate || 5 ||
rājā rājīvacakṣur vijayati jagati sphītaśītāṃśuvaṃśa-
prādurbhūtaḥ kṣitīśaḥ kṣitipatitilakaḥ saṃghaṇaḥ siṃhaśaktiḥ |
tatputro jaitrapālaḥ samabhavad avanīmaṇḍalākhaṇḍalaśrīr
asmād vismāpakānāṃ samajani yaśasāṃ bhājanaṃ kṛṣṇabhūpaḥ || 6 ||
asti pahvakṣamābhṛd bhaṭamukuṭataṭaprāṃśuratnāṃśudaṇḍa-
śreṇīveṇṇīvirājatpadayugalagaladgarvanirvairavīraḥ |
tāduṅgiḥ somasomādbhuta caritaśatārambhadambhāhmāśā-
bhittinyastapraśastis tadanujatanujaḥ śrīmahādevabhūpaḥ || 7 ||
ā kailāsād vilāsālasagaṇataruṇīgītagaurīśakīrteḥ
ā ca preṅkholapāthonidhijalalaharīkhedavelāt suvelāt |
ā pūrvasmāt parasmād api dharaṇibhṛtaḥ kampamānā yadīyām
ājñāṃ rājñāṃ adhīśāḥ karamukulamilanmaulayaḥ pālayati || 8 ||
saṃgrāmeṣv adhamarṇatām upagatā vīrāḥ paraṅkoṭayaḥ
sevāprītyupapādanena vividhānādhīnirasya kṣaṇāt |
[3]        asmād ādadate niratyayasukhaṃ tatraitadīyaṃ yaśo-
dikapālān iva sākṣitāṃ gamayituṃ diṅmaṇḍalīm añcati || 9 ||
helāsāditalakṣamārgaṇagaṇaṃ śrutvaitadīyaṃ guṇaṃ
yeṣāṃ śreṇir anusmaranty aharahas tuṣṭāvadānādbhutam |
teṣām eva mahāhaveṣu milatāṃ pratyarthinām arthinām
apy āsādya bhujaṃ vrajanti vilayaṃ sainyāni dainyāni ca || 10 ||
asyoccair bhīmabhūmīruhagahanaguhāgarttagarjan mṛgendra-
trāsavyāsaprasaṅgoccalanakulakulavyākulavyālamālām |
vāraṃ vāraṃ smṛtaitadbhujabhujagayugaiḥ sphītabhītajvaraughāṃ
mūrcchām ṛcchanti hanta kṣitidharadharaṇīṃ laṅghayantodviṣantaḥ || 11 ||
anena cintāmaṇikāmadhenu-
kalpadrumānarthijanāya dattān |
vilokya śaṅke kim amuṣya sarva-
gīrvāṇanātho ’pi karaprado ’bhūt || 12 ||
tasyāsti nāma hemādriḥ sarvaśrīkaraṇaprabhuḥ |
nijodāratayā yaś ca sarvaśrīkaraṇaprabhuḥ || 13||
tasmād akutsitacaritrapavitrakīrter
vaṃśe himāṃśuviśadadyutir āvir āsīt |
līlāvatāram akarod iha vāsudevas
tasmād dvijātir udajṛmbhata kāmadevaḥ || 94 ||
hemādrir ity akhilabhūtalagītakīrttis
tasyātha sūnur ajaniṣṭa variṣṭhamūrttiḥ |
[4]        nāmnā samo ’pi vijitaś caritena yena
ślāghām upaiti na hi kāñcana kāñcanādriḥ ||15||
tasya śrīkaraṇeśasya kāpi lekhanacāturī |
yaśaḥ praśastibhis tūrṇaṃ yena digbhittayo bhṛtāḥ || 13 ||
lipiṃ vidhātrā likhitāṃ janasya
bhāle vibhūtyā parimṛjya duṣṭām |
kalyāṇinīmeṣa likhatyathainām
citraṃ pramāṇīkurute vidhiś ca ||17||
saṃcinya saṃcintya tad etadīyaṃ
dhatte manovismayam asmadīyam |
prāgjanmavidyāsmaraṇakṣamo ’yam
kṣaṇena yad vismṛtim eti dattvā || 18 ||
manye tatkṛtadānavārilaharīpūrṇāyamāno ’mbudhiḥ
kalpānte ’pi na śoṣadoṣaviṣamāṃ dhatte kadācid daśām |
kiṃ caivaṃ jaladhisthitipratibhuvaṃ niścitya daityāriṇā
niścintena bhujaṅgapuṅgavatanūtalpeṣu saṃsupyate || 18 ||
citraṃ tatkṛtadānavṛṣṭipayasas tattvasya kiṃ brūmahe
yasminn anyavadānyakīrttir atulā dhatte tṛṇaśreṇitām |
yad bahūmau patitaṃ grasiṣṇu janatāpaṅkāni yac cārthinām
nyastaṃ hastataleṣu bhālaphalake pāpāṃ lipiṃ lumpati ||20||
tattarpito devagaṇaḥ sa nūnam
arocakī candramasaḥ sudhāyāḥ |
[5]        kṣayantu candrasya tadīyakīrtti-
sparddhāsamṛddhāni phalanty aghāni || 21 ||
śūrāṇām avadhir nidhiś ca yaśasām ekāśrayaḥ sampadām
dātṝṇāṃ prathamaḥ kalākulagṛhaṃ vaidagdhyabhāvāṃ guruḥ |
dhaureyaś ca vipaścitāṃ sukṛtinām advaitavādāspadam
naivāsīn na ca varttate na bhavitā hemādrisūreḥ paraḥ || 22 ||
vibhartti nūnaṃ dvijaveṣam eṣa
sa eva hemādrir iti pratītaḥ |
udārasantānavato yad asya
kalpadrumaṃ dakṣiṇabāhum āhuḥ ||23||
athāmunā dharmakathādaridram
trailokyam ālokya kaler balena |
tasyopakāre dadhatānucintām
cintāmaṇiḥ prādur akāri cāru ||24||
tatra ca |
khaṇḍaiś caturbhir vratadānatīrtha-
mokṣābhidhair vargacatuṣkam uktvā |
viracyate tatpariśiṣṭavastu-
vyāvarṇanārthaṃ pariśeṣakhaṇḍam || 25||
tatrādau devatākāṇḍaṃ tataḥ kālavinirṇayaḥ |
vipākaḥ karmaṇāṃ paścāl lakṣaṇānāṃ samuccayaḥ |
mahāprakaraṇānīha catvāry etāny anukramāt ||26||
[6]        tatroktavratadānādikarmajātopayoginam |
kurute karaṇādhyakṣo hemādriḥ kālanirṇayam ||27||
tatra kālasvarūpaṃ kūrmapurāṇe darśitam |
anādir eṣa bhagavān kālo ’nanto ’jaro ’maraḥ |
sarvagatvāt svatantratvāt sarvātmatvān maheśvaraḥ ||
brahmāṇo bahavo rudrā hy anye nārāyaṇādayaḥ |
eko hi bhagavān īśaḥ kālaḥ kavir iti smṛtaḥ ||
kālenaiva ca sṛjyante sa eva grasate punaḥ |
brahmanārāyaṇeśānāṃ trayāṇāṃ prākṛto layaḥ ||
procyate kālayogena punar eva ca saṃbhavaḥ |
paraṃ brahma ca bhūtāni vāsudevo ’pi śaṅkaraḥ |
tasmāt kālātmakaṃ viśvaṃ sa eva parameśvaraḥ ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
anādinidhanaḥ kālo rudraḥ saṅkarṣaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ |
kalanāt sarvabhūtānāṃ sa kālaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||
anādinidhanatvena sa mahān parameśvaraḥ |
nimeṣād api sūkṣmatvāt sūkṣmāt sūkṣmataro hy ati ||
tasya sūkṣmātisūkṣmasya kālasya parameṣṭhinaḥ |
durvibhāvyā mahābhāga yoginām api sūkṣmatā ||
padmapatrasahasraṃ tu sūcyā vai bhidyate yadā |
samakālaṃ tu tad bhinnam abudho manyate janaḥ |
kālakrameṇa tadbhinnaṃ sā tasya dvija sūkṣmatā ||
[7]        evaṃvidhasyānādinidhanasyāpi sūkṣmasya yady apy aparicchinnatā tathāpy ādyantavatībhiḥ sūryādigrahakriyābhiḥ paricchinnatopapadyate tāsāṃ kriyāṇāṃ santānasya bījāṅkurasantānavadanādyanantatvād anādinidhanasyāpi kālasya paricchedaḥ saṃbhavati |
tathā ca viṣṇudharmottare |
tasya sūkṣmātisūkṣmasya tathāpi mahato dvijāḥ |
mānasaṅkhyā budhair jñeyā grahagatyanusārataḥ ||
tathāsmadādipratyakṣanimeṣādikriyādvāreṇa paricchedaḥ kālasya tatraivābhihitaḥ |
laghvakṣarasamā mātrā nimeṣaḥ parikīrtitaḥ |
ataḥ sūkṣmataraḥ kālo nopalabhyo bhṛgūttama ||
nopalabhyaṃ yathā dravyaṃ susūkṣmaṃ paramāṇutaḥ |
dvau nimeṣau truṭir jñeyā prāṇo daśatruṭiḥ smṛtaḥ ||
trināḍikās (?) tu ṣaṭprāṇās tatṣaṣṭyā nāḍikāḥ smṛtāḥ |
ahorātraṃ tu tatṣaṣṭyā nityam eva prakīrtitam ||
triṃśanmuhūrtāś ca tathā ahorātreṇa kīrtitāḥ |
te ’tra pañcadaśa proktā rāma nityaṃ divācarāḥ ||
uttarāṃ tu yadā kāṣṭhāṃ kramād ākramate raviḥ |
tathā tathā bhaved vṛddhir divasasya mahābhuja ||
divasaś ca yathā rāma vṛddhiṃ samadhigacchati |
tadāśritamuhūrtānāṃ tathā vṛddhiḥ prakīrtitā ||
dinavṛddhir yathā rāma doṣāhānis tathā tathā |
[8]        tadāśritamuhūrtānāṃ hānir jñeyā tathā tathā ||
dakṣiṇāṃ ca yadā kāṣṭhāṃ kramād ākramate raviḥ |
divasasya tathā hānir jñātavyā tāvad eva tu ||
kṣīyante tasya hānau tu tanmuhūrtās tathaiva ca |
rātryāśritāś ca vardhante rātrivṛddhis tathā tathā ||
yadā meṣaṃ sahasrāṃśus tulāṃ caiva prapadyate |
samarātriṃ divaṃ kālo viṣuvacchabdavācakaḥ ||
evaṃ ca nimeṣādikriyākāladvāreṇāvacchinnā yā sūryakriyā tādṛśyau dve kriye yasyāḥ kriyāyāḥ avayavau tatkriyayā avacchinnaḥ kālas truṭir iti vyavahārasya viṣayo bhavati | evam anye ’pi prāṇavināḍikādayo vyavahārā jñeyāḥ, evaṃ truṭyādyavayavadvāreṇāhorātraṃ niṣpadyate | tac ca trividhaṃ darśitaṃ brahmasiddhānte |
sāvanaṃ syād ahorātram udayād odayād raveḥ |
raves triṃśas tu rāśyaṃśas tithisaṃbhogam aindavam ||
viṣṇudharmottare tv ahorātraṃ ca caturdhā darśitam |
tithinaikena divasaś cāndramāne prakīrtitaḥ |
ahorātreṇa caikena sāvano divasaḥ smṛtaḥ |
ādityabhāgabhogena sauro divasa ucyate |
candranakṣatrabhogena nākṣatro divasaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
tithibhāgayor lakṣaṇaṃ tatraiva darśitam |
candrārkagatyā kālasya parichedo yadā bhavet |
tadā tayoḥ pravakṣyāmi gatim āśritya bhārgava ||
[9]        bhagaṇena samagreṇa jñeyā dvādaśa rāśayaḥ |
triṃśāṃśaś ca tadā rāśer bhāga ity abhidhīyate ||
ādityād viprakṛṣṭaṃ tu bhāgaṃ dvādaśakaṃ yadā |
candramāḥ syāt tadā rāma tithir ity abhidhīyate ||
skandapurāṇe prabhāsakhaṇḍe ’pi |
amāṣoḍaśabhāgena devi proktā mahākalā |
saṃsthitā paramā māyā dehināṃ dehadhāriṇī ||
amādipaurṇamāsyantā yā eva śaśinaḥ kalāḥ |
tithayas tāḥ samākhyātāḥ ṣoḍaśaiva varānane ||
evaṃ māso ’pi pitāmahena trividho darśitaḥ |
darśād darśaś cāndras triṃśaddivasas tu sāvano māsaḥ |
ravisaṃkrāntivicihnaḥ sauro ’pi nigadyate tajjñaiḥ ||
'darśād' iti slyablope pañcamī darśāt parataḥ śuklapratipadam ārabhya amāvāsyānta ity arthaḥ |
tathā ca brahmasiddhānte ’bhihitam |
candraḥ śuklādidarśāntaḥ sāvanas triṃśatā dinaiḥ |
ekarāśau ravir yāvat tāvat kālaṃ sabhāskaraḥ ||
jyotiḥsiddhānte tu māsaś caturvidho darśitaḥ |
prathamaḥ sāvano māso dvitīyaś cāndra ucyate |
nākṣatras tu tṛtīyaḥ syāt sauro māsaś caturthakaḥ ||
[10]        viṣṇudharmottare ’pi māsasya cāturvidhyam āveditam |
candramāḥ paurṇamāsyante bhāskarād atiricyate |
rāśiṣaṭkaṃ tathā rāma māsārdhena na saṃśayaḥ ||
bhāgadvādaśakenaiva tithyāṃ tithyāṃ krameṇa tu |
candramāḥ kṛṣṇapakṣānte sūryeṇa saha yujyate ||
sannikarṣād athārabhya sannikarṣād athāparam |
candrārkayor budhair māsaś cāndra ity abhidhīyate ||
sāvane tu tathā māsi triṃśat sūryodayāḥ smṛtāḥ |
ādityarāśibhogena sauro māsaḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
sarvarkṣaparivartais tu nākṣatro māsa ucyate ||
cādras tu deśavyavasthayā trikāṇḍamaṇḍanena nibandhakṛtā dvidhā darśitaḥ | cāndro ’pi śuklapakṣādiḥ kṛṣṇādir veti ca dvidhā |
kṛṣṇapakṣādikaṃ māsaṃ nāṅgīkurvanti kecana |
ye ’pīcchanti na teṣām apīṣṭo vindhyasya dakṣiṇe ||
tathā ca taitirīyake śrūyate |
amāvāsyayā māsān saṃpādyāhar utsṛjanty amāvāsyayā hi māsān saṃpatsyanti paurṇamāsyayā māsān saṃpādyāhar utsṛjanti paurṇamāsyayā hi māsān saṃpatsyantīti |
tathā paurṇamāsādakṣiṇantyasmin mahāvārtike pūrṇamāso ’sminn iti śabdavidbhir uktatvāt,
aśvayuk kṛṣṇapakṣe ca śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ dine dine |
iti nidarśanāc ca |
ata eva dvividhacāndramāsagrahārthaṃ,
yasmin māse dine yasmin vipattir [11] upajāyate |
parvāntaḥ sa tu vijñeyo māso naimittikaṃ prati ||
iti jyotirgārgyeṇāpi parvānta iti sāmānyenoktam | naimittikaṃ ca pratisāṃvatsarikam ucyate, sāṃvatsarike ca cāndramāsa eva viniyuktaḥ,
ābdike pitṛkārye ca cāndro māsaḥ praśasyate |
iti vacanāt |
mānabhedena māsadinasaṃkhyā viṣṇudharmottare darśitā |
māne māsas tu nākṣatraḥ saptaviṃśatibhir dinaiḥ |
pariśeṣeṣu māseṣu māsas triṃśaddinaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
māsaśabdo yathoditānāṃ caturṇām api māsānām anekārthagavādiśabdavad vācako draṣṭavya iti kecit | apare tv āhuḥ māsaśabdaś cāndramāsaviśeṣavacanaḥ “trayodaśamāsāḥ saṃvatsaraḥ asti trayodaśe māsaḥ ardhamāse devā ijyante māsi māsi pitṛbhyaḥ kriyanta" ityādivaidikaprayogasya cāndraviṣayatvāt tena yavavarāhādiśabdavan na sarvatra mukhyatvam, "pakṣau pūrvottarau śuklakṛṣṇau māsas tu tāv ubhāv" ity amarasiṃhenābhidhānāt | itarathā cāndramāsa ity abhidadhyāt | evam anyeṣv abhidhāneṣu cāndra eva māsaśabda iti nirūpitam | "māsaḥ pakṣadvayam" iti purāṇādyabhidhānāc ca | na ca caturṣu māseṣv anugataṃ māsatvasāmānyam anubhūyate upapadyate vā, māsāntare prayogas tu prakārāntareṇāpy upapadyata ity anekārthaśaktikalpanābhayāc cāndra eva mukhyo māsaśabda iti | atra kecid āhuḥ caitraveśākhādiśabdāś citraviśākhādyanurādhādinakṣatrāṇām ekataranakṣatrayuktapaurṇamāsīyuktamāsavacanāḥ pāṇiner anuśāsanād iti yathoktaṃ “nakṣatreṇa yuktaḥ kālaḥ sāsmin paurṇamāsīti saṃjñāyām" iti ‘nakṣatreṇa’viśākhādyanyatareṇa, yuktā paurṇamāsī vaiśākhādivyapadeśabhāk [12] nakṣatrayogaś ca na kārtsnena kiṃ tv ekadeśenāpi vyapadeśe hetuḥ |
tathā ca śaṅkaragītā |
ādipādārdhamātreṇa nakṣatrasyānvaye hy asau |
tithir ardhe ’pi saṃyuktā viparītā na sā punaḥ || iti ||
sā paurṇamāsī yasmin māse sa vaiśākhādipadābhidheyaḥ, 'saṃjñāyām' iti rūḍhiśabdatāṃ puraskaroti |
tathā ca cyavanaḥ |
antyopāntyau tribhau jñeyau phālgunaś ca tribho mataḥ |
śeṣā māsā dvibhā jñeyāḥ kṛttikādivyavasthayā || iti |
saṃkarṣaṇakāṇḍe ’pi |
dve dve citrāditārāṇāṃ paripūrṇendusaṃgate |
māsāś caitrādayo jñeyās trikaiḥ ṣaṣṭhāntasaptamāḥ ||
tena viśākhādiyogād vaiśākhāditvam iti nakṣatrayogaḥ cādaraṇīyaḥ | tathā ca viṣṇuḥ |
māghī cen maghāyuktā syād vaiśākhī ced viśākhāyuktā syāt || iti|
yat tu vṛttikāreṇa puṣyayogāt pauṣītyādy udāhṛtaṃ tac chiṣyāṇāṃ sukhabodhārthaṃ nāyam aśvakarṇādivat saṃbandhī luptāvayavārthaḥ kiṃ tūdbhidādivad yathā kathaṃcid avāptapravṛttinimitta iti tasyābhiprāyaḥ, prakṛtipratyayānvākhyānam api gośabdasyeva gamerḍo gacchatīti gaur itivad avaseyam | tataś ca vaiśākhaśabdena paurṇamāsī vā nakṣatraṃ vā tadyogo vā tadyuktā vā paurṇamāsī nakṣatraṃ vā tadyuktaṃ paurṇamāsīyukto vā tadyoga ityādikalpanāvatāraḥ | āgamaprasiddhiprābalyād aśvakarṇadiśabdatulyatvānupapatteḥ | tasmād vaiśākhyādiśabdāḥ [13] yathoditanakṣatrayuktapaurṇamāsī lakṣaṇakālavacanāḥ, vaiśākhādiśabdāś ca tattannakṣatrānvitapaurṇamāsīmadhyaśuklapratipadādidarśanta-cāndramāsavacanā iti sthitam | kathaṃ tarhi sauramāse vaiśākhādipadapravṛttiḥ tatrāpi prasiddhiprābalyam asti |
tatra kecid āhuḥ: anekaśaktikalpanādoṣād gauṇīti | cāndre hi māse vaiśākhādiśabdaprasiddhiḥ abhiyuktānāṃ śāstrasthā, saure tu māse na śāstrasthā, śāstrasthā ca prasiddhir balīyasī na laukikī, tathā gauṇatvenāpy upapatteḥ | tathā cāhuḥ “śāstrasthā tannimittatvāt pratipatter balīyasī | laukikī pratipattis tu gauṇatvenāpi nīyate” iti ||
tad asat prasiddhyor aviśeṣāt | tathā ca jyotirgārgyaḥ |
sauro māso vivāhādau yajñādau sāvanaḥ smṛtaḥ |
ābdike pitṛkārye ca cāndro māsaḥ praśasyate ||
bṛhaspatiḥ |
vivāhe sauramāse adhikām arthasiddhiṃ prāha varāhamihiraḥ |
caitraṃ prāha parāśaraḥ kathayate pauṣañ ca daurbhāgyadam |
āṣāḍhādicatuṣṭayaṃ na śubhadaṃ kaiścit pradiṣṭaṃ dvijair ityādi ||
baudhāyanayaś ca |
karkaṭe tu harau supte śakradhvajakriyāśvine iti |
tulāyāṃ bodhayed devīṃ vṛścike tu janārdanam |
dvirāṣāḍhaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ śete ca śrāvaṇe ’cyuta iti ||
tena baudhāyanādayaḥ sauramāse śrāvaṇādipadāni prayuñjate tenobhayāpi (?) prasiddhiḥ śāstrasthā na viśeṣeṇa sauramāsagatā gauṇyā vṛttyā [14] samādhīyate prasiddhiprābalyāc cānekaśaktikalpanā akṣādiśabdavan na virudhyate, āgopālāṅganājanapuraskṛtā sauramāse vaiśākhādipadaprasiddhiḥ, keṣāṃcid eva tu cāndre | tasmāt sauracāndramāsavacanā eva mukhyayā vṛttyā vaiśākhādiśabdā iti siddham iti |
tad ayukaṃ ubhayor api prasiddhyoḥ śāstrasthatvāviśeṣe ’pi cāndramāse vaiśākhādipadaprasiddhiḥ sārvatrikī prabalā saure tu na tathā, yat tūktaṃ āgopālāṅganājanapuraskṛtā ca saure māse vaiśākhādipadaprasiddhiḥ keṣāṃcid eva tu cāndra iti, tad api mithyaiva viparītasyaiva darśanāt | tathā ca pāṇiniḥ "nakṣatreṇa yuktaḥ kālaḥ sāsmin paurṇamāsīti saṃjñāyām" iti | na ca saurasāvanayor evaṃvadhāsti saṃjñā, tasmāc cāndramāsavacanā eva caitravaiśākhādiśabdāḥ | ṛtavas tu sauracāndramānenaiva māsadvayātmakāḥ | tatra sauramānena viṣṇudharmottare |
sauramāsadayaṃ rāma ṛtur ity abhidhīyate |
cāndramānenāpi trikāṇḍamaṇḍane |
śrautasmārtakriyāḥ sarvāḥ kuryāc cāndramāsartuṣu |
tadabhāve tu saurartuṣv iti jyotirvidāṃ matam ||
ṛtau cāndranimittatvaṃ mantravarṇāt pratīyate |
ṛtūn anyovidadhaj jāyate punar ity ataḥ ||
punaḥ punar yo jāyate sa eva vidadhad ṛtūn |
candraḥ punaḥ punar janmā tasmāc candravaśād ṛtuḥ ||
hotṛprakaraṇe candraṃ prakṛtya prāha tittiriḥ |
sa ṛtūn kalpayatīti cāndro ’yam ṛtukalpakaḥ ||
[15]        te ca ṣaṭ hemantaśiśirayoḥ samāsena pañca ṣaḍ vā ṛtavaḥ pañcartavaḥ hemantaśiśirayoḥ samāseneti ca śruteḥ, te ca vasantopakramāḥ mukhaṃ vā etad ṛtūnāṃ yad vasanta iti śruteḥ, te ca pratyekaṃ caitrādimāsadvayātmakāḥ, madhuś ca mādhavaś ca vāsantikāv ṛtū, śukraś ca śuciś ca graiśmāv ṛtū, nabhaś ca  nabhasyaś ca  vārṣikāv ṛtū, iṣaś corjaś ca śāradāv ṛtū, sahaś ca sahasyaś ca haimantikāv ṛtū, tapaś ca tapasyaś ca śaiśirāv ṛtū ity ādhvaryavādiśruteḥ |
madhumādhavādiśabdāś caitravaiśākhādiṣu granthāntare prayuktāḥ |
caitro māso madhuḥ prokto vaiśākho mādhavo bhavet |
jyaiṣṭhamāsaś ca śukraḥ syād āṣāḍhaḥ śucir ucyate ||
nabho māsaḥ śrāvaṇaḥ syān nabhasyo bhādra iṣyate |
iṣa āśvayujo māsaḥ kārttikaś corjasaṃjñakaḥ ||
saho māso mārgaśiraḥ sahasyaḥ pauṣanāmakaḥ |
māghamāsas tapaḥ proktas tapasyaḥ phālgunaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
baudhāyanena punar mīnameṣayor meṣavṛṣayor vā vasanta ity abhidhānāt mīnāditvaṃ meṣāditvaṃ ca vaikalpikaṃ vasantasyāṅgīkṛtaṃ, yadā tv adhikamāso bhavati tadā cāndramānena māsatrayātmako ’pi kaścid ṛtuḥ saṃpadyate |
tathā ca trikāṇḍamaṇḍanenoktam |
cāndre mīnaṃ yadā caitramāsādir malinas tadā |
śuddhe ’pi maline caitre vaiśākhe ’pi vasantatā ||
nanu saiveyam āyātā māsatrayavasantatā |
satyaṃ gatyantarābhāvāt saivātrābhyupagamyate |
nanv atrāpi vikalpaḥ kiṃ tadvan nābhyupagamyate ||
[16]        māsās trayo vasantasthāḥ tyaktvādyam atha vāntimam |
atrocyate vikalpo hi sauramāseṣu yujyate ||
ma tu cāndreṣu yukto ’sau malamāsānuvartiṣu |
dvādaśaiva hi te māsāḥ sūryasaṃkrāntisaṃmitāḥ ||
dvau dvau māsāv ihaikaikam ṛtuṃ kṛtvā tu gaṇyate |
ṛtavas tatra mīnādyā meṣādyā vā ṣaḍ eva hi ||
cāndras tu maline māse prāpte māsās trayodaśa |
vikalpante ’ca yat kiṃcin māsam ārabhya yugmataḥ ||
ṛtuṣu kriyamāṇeṣu māsa eko ’tiricyate |
kim asāv anṛtur māsaḥ kiṃ cartuḥ saptamo bhavet ||
prakṛtartuṣu vā kvāpi praviśatv iti cinyate |
ṛtuśūnyo na kālo ’sti nāpy ṛtuḥ saptamaḥ śrutau ||
tatrartur ṛetunā ’yujyamāna ity ṛtuśūnyatā |
ṣaḍ vā ṛtava ity eṣā śrutiḥ saptamavārikā ||
ataḥ śruteḥ smṛtir bādhyā dvau māsāv ṛtur ity asau |
tasmād adhikamāsaḥ syāt teṣv evartuṣu kutracit ||
yatraiṣo ’ntarbhaven māsaḥ sa ṛtuḥ syāt trimāsikaḥ |
yad vā ṣaṣṭidinair māsa eka evobhayātmakaḥ |
ato ’trāpi vasantatvaṃ syād dvayor eva māsayoḥ ||
ayanaṃ ca sauram ṛtutrayeṇa tathā ca sauramānam (?) adhikṛtya viṣṇudharmottare "ṛtutrayaṃ cāyanaṃ syād" iti | tathā ca saṃvatsaro ’pi cāndrair māsaiś cāndraḥ sāvanaiḥ sāvanaḥ sauraiḥ saura iti trividhaḥ | tathā cokaṃ brahmasiddhānte |
[17]        cāndrasāvanasaurāṇāṃ māsānāṃ tu prabhedataḥ |
cāndrasāvanasaurākhyās trayaḥ saṃvatsarā api ||
te ca dvādaśamāsātmakāḥ "dvādaśa māsāḥ saṃvatsara" iti śruteḥ | cāndras tu saṃvatsaraḥ kadācit trayodaśamāsātmako bhavati, "asti trayodaśo māsa ity āhur" iti śruteḥ, cāndramāna eva trayodaśamāsasya saṃbhavāt |
tathā ca viṣṇudharmottare |
saurasaṃvatsarasyānte mānena śaśino yadā |
ekādaśātiricyante dināni bhṛgunandana |
samādvaye sāṣṭamāse tasmān māso ’tiricyate ||
cāndrasaṃvatsarasya caitraśuklapratipady upakramaḥ |
tathā brahmapurāṇe saṃvatsarārambhavidhikrame |
caitre māsi sṛjan brahmā sasarja prathame ’hani |
śuklapakṣe samagraṃ tu tathā sūryodaye sati ||
pravartayāmāsa tathā kālasya gaṇanām iha |
grahān nāgān ṛtūn māsān vatsarān vasarādhipān ||
brahmasiddhānte |
caitrasitāder udayāt bhānor dinamāsavarṣayugakalpāḥ sṛṣṭyādau laṅkāyāṃ samaṃ pravṛttā dine ’rkasya sauraḥ saṃvatsaraḥ, punar mīnādir meṣādir vā vasantasya vikalpena mīnāditvasya meṣāditvasya coktatvād vasantasya ca ṛtumukhyatvāt saṃvatsaramukhasyaiva ṛtumukhatvopapatteḥ |
yat tu viṣṇudharmottare,
māghaśuklasamārambhe candrārkau vāsavarkṣagau |
[18]        jīvayuktau yadā syātāṃ ṣaṣṭyābdādis tadā smṛtaḥ ||
iti māghaśuklapratipadupakramatvaṃ saṃvatsarāṇāṃ, taj jyotiḥśāstraprasiddhaśubhāśubhaphalapratipādanārthaṃ na tu dharmānuṣṭhānārtham iti mantavyam | prabhavādiṣaṣṭisaṃvatsarāṇāṃ āditaḥ pañcānāṃ pañcānāṃ yugasaṃjñakānāṃ yathāsaṃkhyaṃ saṃvatsaraparivatsaredāvatsarānuvatsarodvatsarākhyāḥ |
tathā brahmavaivarte |
saṃvatsaras tu prathamo dvitīyaḥ parivatsaraḥ |
idāvatsaras tṛtīyas tu caturthaś cānuvatsaraḥ |
udvatsaraḥ pañcamas tu kālas tu yugasaṃjita iti ||
tathā ca kālasya yathoktaprakāreṇāvacchedasaṃbhavād anādinidhanasyāpi yathāyathaṃ vratādidharmānuṣṭhānāṅgatvam upapadyata iti nirṇayaḥ kriyate | tatra saṃvatsarādeḥ kālasya saṃvatsaravratādau yathāyatham upayogo draṣṭavyaḥ |
ayanasya tu sa evāha |
devatārāmavāpyādipratiṣṭhodaṅmukhe ravau |
dakṣiṇāśāmukhe kurvan na tatphalam avāpnuyāt ||
saurasāvanacāndranākṣatrāṇāṃ māsānāṃ punaḥ kutra kasyopayoga ity apekṣāyām uktaṃ viṣṇudharmottare |
evaṃ kālasya sūkṣmasya proktaṃ māṣacatuṣṭayam |
yena yena ca māsena yac ca kāryaṃ nibodhata ||
athāyanartugrahacārakarma
saureya mānena sahādhyavasyat |
satrāṇy apāsyāny atha sāvanena
[19]                laukyaṃ ca yasmāt vyavahārakarma ||
syāt pūrvakālakṣayapūraṇābhyām
cāndreṇa mānena yugaṃ ca rāhoḥ |
nakṣatrasatrāṇy ayanāni cendvor (?)
manena kuryād bhagaṇātmakena ||
ṛṣyaśṛṅgaḥ |
vivāhavratayajñeṣu sauraṃ mānaṃ praśasyate |
pārvaṇe ’nvaṣṭakāśrāddhe cāndram iṣṭaṃ tathābdike ||
jyotirgārgye |
vivāhotsavayajñeṣu sauraṃ mānaṃ praśasyate |
tathā smṛtyantare |
ekoddiṣṭavivāhādau ṛṇādau saurasāvanau |
sadaiva pitṛkṛtyādau māsāś cāndramasaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
tathā ca jotirgārgye |
sauramāso vivāhādau yajñādau sāvanaḥ smṛtaḥ |
ābdike pitṛkārye ca cāndro māsaḥ praśasyate ||
'ābdike' sāṃvatsarikamṛtāhaśrāddhe | 'ptṛkārye' ṣāṇmāsikaśrāddhādau, caśabdān māsasaṃvatsarasādhye yajñavyatirikre sarvasmin devakārye cāndro māsaḥ praśasyata ity ukam |
uktaṃ ca pitāmahena |
daive karmaṇi pitrye ca māsaś cāndramasaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
brahmasiddhānte |
[20]        pratisaṃvatsaraśrāddhe māsaś cāndramasaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
bṛhaspatiḥ |
raver abhyudaye mānaṃ candrasya pitṛkarmaṇi |
yajñe sāvanam ity āhur ārkṣaṃ sarvavratādiṣu ||
jyotirgārgyaḥ |
āyurdāyavibhāgaś ca prāyaścittakriyā tathā |
sāvanenaiva kartavyā śatrūrṇāṃ vāpy upāsanā ||
yathā pāṇḍavaiḥ kauravāṇāṃ brahmasiddhāntāt |
amāvāsyāparicchinno māsaḥ syād brāhmaṇasya tu |
saṃkrāntipaurṇamāsābhyāṃ tathaiva nṛpavaiśyayoḥ ||
atrādiśabdārthaḥ śrīdhareṇa darśitaḥ |
vivāhopanayanacūḍāvrataniyamapratiṣṭhāgṛhakaraṇakṣaurayātrāmahāṣaṣṭhī– mahāsaptamīvijayadaśamīdaśaharāyugādimahājyeṣṭhāprabhṛtyādiśabdenopādīyate, yajñādāv ity ādiśabdena yāgadānahomagarbhādhānasīmantonnayanajātakarma-ṛṇakraya-vikrayavyavahāragrahaṇaṃ | tathā – “sadaiva pitṛkṛtyādau māsāś cāndramasaḥ smṛtaḥ” ity atra pitṛkṛtyādāv ity ādiśabdena vṛddhyabhiṣekasaṃvatsaraśrāddhapārvaṇāṣṭakā-devśayanacūḍāvrtaniyamapratiṣṭhāgṛhakaraṇakṣaurayātrāśakrotsavādigrahaṇam | tathā ca prathamarāśitaḥ prabhṛtigocarāṣṭavargānusaraṇakrameṇa tattadrāśibhogasaṃbandheṇa śubhāśubhopabhogāt |
maṅgaleṣu vivāheṣu kanyāsaṃvaraṇeṣu ca |
daśa māsāḥ praśastante caitrapauṣavivarjitā iti ||
[21]        māsopadeśe sauramāsāśrayaṇaṃ sāvanasya ca māsasya niyatatriṃśadivasatvān niṣekadivasāt prabhṛtiṣu ṣaṣṭhāṣṭamāseṣu puṃsavanāder vidhānāt "māsam agnihotraṃ juhoti" iti "cāturmāsyena yajeta" ityādiṣv aniyatadivasamāsaparigrahānupapatter niyatapadena sāvanagrahaṇam | tathā "māsi māsi piṇḍapitṛyajñena caranti" iti | “nabhasyasthāpare pakṣe tithiṣoḍaṣakaṃ ca yat" ityāditithisaṃbandhena vihitapitṛkāryasitāsitavidhiniyamam antareṇa sāṃvatsarikaṃ prati niyamānupapatteḥ sarvatra tithibhoge cāndramāsāśrayaṇam iti | atra paṇḍitaparitoṣakṛtoktaṃ ādiśabdena vyavasitāḥ yathā parigaṇitā vivāhādayo gṛhītavyā iti kuto ’vagataṃ avyavasthitagrahaṇabādhakapramāṇābhāvāt tathā hi sauro devaśayanādiṣu vihitaś cāndramāsāśrayaṇaṃ ca dvādaśyāditithivaśena śayanādiṣu kriyāyāṃ dṛśyate, yad āha gārgyaḥ |
dvirāṣāḍhā kriyā tāvad yāvad viṣṇoḥ prabodhanam |
prabuddhe tu harau kāryā sūryanatyaiva sā kriyā ||
atha ca "viṣṇuḥ svapiti karkaṭa iti" dvirāṣāḍhe ’pi rāśibhogapuraskāro dṛśyate, na copanayanānnaprāśanādiṣu sauramāsa ity aikāntikagarbhādisaṅkhyā varṣāṇāṃ "garbhāṣṭame brāhmaṇam upanayīteti, “ṣaṣṭhe ’nnaprāśanaṃ māsi” “aṣṭavarṣā bhaved gaurī navavarṣā tu rohiṇī” ityādigautamavacanaiḥ sāvanamāsapuraskārān na ca sāvane māsi sitāsitapakṣapariharaṇam asti | sati ca tithiparigrahe cāndramāsāśrayaṇam api śakyate vaktum | kiṃ ca “yāsau vaiśākhyam āvāsyā rauriṇyā saṃpadyate tasyām ādadīteti cāndre māsy ādhānavidhānād yajñādau sāvanavidhir anaikāntikaḥ |
vivāhavratayajñeṣu sauramānaṃ praśasyate || iti |
yajñeṣv api sauraṃ mānaṃ darśayati |
[22]        anena vidhinā śrāddhaṃ tripaitram iha nirvapet |
kanyākumbhavṛṣasthe ’rke kṛṣṇapakṣeṣu sarvadā ||
kanyāyogāt savitari pitṛyajñānuśāsanāt |
tāvat pitṛpurī śūnyā yāvad vṛścikadarśanam || iti |
sauramānenāpi pitṛkāryopadeśāt na ca sāṃvatsaraśrāddhe cāndra ity ekāntikam |
yasmin rāśau gate sūrye vipattiṃ yānti mānavāḥ |
teṣāṃ tatraiva kartavyāḥ piṇḍadānodakakriyāḥ ||
iti vyāghravacanaṃ hi sauramānaṃ darśayati |
pracetāḥ punar āha |
pretamāsasya yaḥ pakṣas tatithau prativatsaram |
yāvat smarati pautro ’pi teṣāṃ tatraiva dāpayet || iti |
na ca vrataniyamādikaṃ saure kriyate ity ekāntikaṃ, cāturmāsyavratānāṃ hariśayanavaśenārambhasamāptyupadeśāt māsopavāsasya cāśvinapakṣaśuklaikādaśyām upakrāntasya tathāvidhaikādaśyantam upavāsāt sāvanacāndrayor ekatamam api niyataṃ, na ca devaśayanaśakrotsavādi cāndramāse vihitam apy aikāntikaṃ, viṣṇuḥ svapiti karkaṭe |
tulāyāṃ bodhayed devīṃ vṛścike tu janārdanam |
kanyāyām ambikāṃ devīṃ siṃhe caiva purandaram ||
tasmin supte yadā viṣṇus tālāyām api vṛścike |
[23]        ityādibaudhāyanavacanavaśena hi sauraṃ pratīyate |
yad api paṭhanti,
daśaharāsu notkarṣaś caturṣv api yugādiṣu |
upākarma tathā ṣaṣṭhyāṃ hy etad iṣṭaṃ vṛṣādita iti ||
tad apy anaikāntikaṃ prauṣṭhapadyāṃ hastenopākaraṇaṃ śrāvaṇyāṃ prauṣṭhapadyāṃ
vāpy upākṛtya yathāvidhītyādigobhilādivacanāc cāndramāsāvagateḥ |
yad api pitāmahavacanam,
kārtikasya tu yat snānaṃ māghe māsi viśeṣataḥ |
kṛcchrādiniyamānāṃ ca cāndramānaṃ pramāṇataḥ ||
iti, tad anaikāntikaṃ,
tulāmakarameṣeṣu prātaḥsnānaṃ vidhīyate |
iti padmapurāṇavacanāt | na kṛcchrādiniyame cāndramānam anaikāntikam | tathā hi cāndrāyaṇaṃ prakramya manuḥ |
yathā kathaṃcit piṇḍānāṃ tisro’śītisamāhitaḥ |
māsenāśnan haviṣyasya candrasyaiti salokatām ||
iti vadan sāvanamāsaṃ puraskaroti | "tithivṛddhyā caret piṇḍān" iti yājñavalkyaś cāndrāyaṇaṃ darśayati | tathā,
patitena tu saṃparkī māsaṃ māsārdham eva vā |
gomūtrayāvakāhāro māsārdhena viśudhyati ||
iti sāvanaṃ māsaṃ darśayati | anyathā tu katipayadinādhike māsasaṃsarganimittaprāyaścittakalpanāmūlamāsānusāreṇa sauracāndrayor aniyatadivasatayā kalpanānupapatter niyatadinasāvanamāsāśrayo yujyate | evaṃ varṣamite ’pi prāyaścitte sāvanamāsagrahaṇam | tasmāt sauro māso [24] vivāhādāv iti | vivāhaśabdena yathāparigaṇitena vivāhādayo gṛhyanta ity anyathā varṇanīyam | tathā hi yatra meṣādirāśibhogavyapadeśena karmavidhiḥ tatra sauramāsāśrayaṇena karmāṇy anuṣṭheyāni, bhādrapadādivyapadeśena yadi tāny eva yathā "dvādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣe ca māsi bhādrapade" iti |
tathā "śakram upasthāpayed rājā" iti, tathā "siṃhe śakradhvajakriyā" iti | tatra siṃhabhādrapadayoḥ sāmānyaviśeṣanyāyenāvirodhād ubhayasamāveśaḥ sukaraḥ | yatra sāmānyena "daśa māsāḥ praśasyante caitrapauṣavivarjitāḥ" iti śrūyate tatra caitrādiśabdānāṃ sauracāndrasādhāraṇatvāt saṃdehe vivāhe saurarāśir gamyate | tadrāśivaśena hi śubhāśubhaphalaṃ śrūyate | "sauro māso vivāhādau" iti vacanāt saura eva yujyate | saure ca vaiśākhe gṛhyamāṇe yadi tatra citrāyuktapaurṇamāsīsaṃbandho dṛśyate tadā caitravyapadeśorhatvān na niṣedhaviṣayatvaṃ saurasthāgamabalīyastvena niṣedhasya ca paurṇamāsasaṃbandhenāpy upapatteḥ | sad api caitratvam asatkalpam eva tathā "garbhādisaṃkhyā varṣāṇām" iti yady api sāvanaparigrahaḥ tathāpy upanayanādiṣu rāśibhogajanyaśubhāśubhaphalānusāreṇa lagnādyupapādanavaśāt sauragraho virodhād upapadyata ity abhipretyoktam, “sauramāso vivāhādau" iti na punar anyasya māsasya vivāhādau nirākaraṇam avagamyate | tathā ca varāhamihiraḥ: “bṛhaspatau śobhanagocarasthe vivāham ichanti hi dākṣiṇyātyāḥ” iti | bṛhaspateḥ śuddhiṃ vacāṃś cāndramāsaṃ puraskaroti "saṃvatsaraṃ guras tiṣṭhati" "paṇatrayaṃ bhūmijaḥ” iti ca sāvanacāndramānaṃ saṃbhavaty evaṃ niyatadivasakramamāsadvādaśāvacchinatvāt [25] sāvanavarṣasya bṛhaspatirāśigatabhogasya ca niyatadivasakramamāsadvādaśāvacchinnatvād aṅgārakaśuddher api cāpekṣitatvāt tadrāśibhoge ’pi cāndramāsagrahaṇam eva tathā "saṃsṛṣṭe bhṛgutanaye kanyā kriyate" iti, "bṛhaspatau puruṣa" ityādivacanaṃ kvacit sāvanaṃ kvacic cāndramānaṃ puraskaroti | evaṃ yajñāder api sāvanamāsāder aniyama iti darśitaṃ tasmān na tadvacanavaśena sarveṣv eva karmasu sarveṣām eva cāndrādimāsānāṃ saṃbhavaḥ kiṃ tu kvacit kvacit praśastaṃ taduktaṃ praśasyate iti | yatra tu ekasmin viṣaye cāndrapraśaṃsā tatraiva ca saurasya yathā kārttikasnāne, tatroditānuditahomanindāpraśaṃsānyāyena vyavasthitaśākhāvikalpavad anuṣṭhānaṃ tasmād ādiśabdena vyavasthitā vivāhādayo gṛhyanta iti vacanam aśobhanaṃ yathoktām eva sādhīya iti | vayaṃ tu brūmaḥ – yasmin kriyāntare vacanāntareṇa saurādimāsā viniyuktās tat kāryam ādiśabdenopādīyate | yatra tu māsaviśeṣagrahaṇe kāraṇaṃ na vidyate tatra cāndra eva grāhyaḥ | caitravaiśākhādipadānāṃ cāndra eva mukhyatvād iti |
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevīyasakalaśrīkaraṇādhīśvarasakalavidyāviśārada-śrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau pariśeṣakhaṇḍe kālanirṇaye saṃvatsarāyaṇamāsaviśeṣāṇāṃ kāryaviśeṣopayoganirūpaṇaṃ nāma prathamo ’dhyāyaḥ ||
[26]
atha dvitīyo ’dhyāyaḥ |
atha malamāsanirṇayaḥ |
tatra malamāsārūpaṃ laghuhārītena darśitam |
indrāgnī yatra hūyete māsādiḥ sa prakīrtitaḥ |
agnīṣomau smṛtau madhye samāptau pitṛsomakau |
tam atikramya tu yadā ravir gacchet kadācana |
ādyo malimlutto jñeyo dvitīyaḥ prākṛtaḥ smṛtaḥ || iti |
'indrāgnī yatra hūyete' iti śuklapratipadupalakṣaṇaṃ, 'agnīṣomau; iti kṛṣṇapratipadaḥ, 'pitṛsomakau' iti darśasya | etena cāndramāsa upalakṣitaḥ taṃ māsam atikramyānyasmin māse yadā sūryo rāśyantaraṃ gacchet tadā pūrvo malimlucaḥ uttaraḥ prākṛtaḥ |
tathā ca brahmasiddhānte |
cāndro māso ’py asaṃkrānto malamāsaḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
nandipurāṇe |
amāvāsyām ahorātre yadā saṃkramate raviḥ |
va tu māsaḥ pavitraḥ syād atīte hy adhiko bhavet ||
amāvāsyāṃ prāpya yadāhani vā rācau vā raviḥ saṃkrāmati tadā cāndro māsaḥ pavitraḥ syāt | yadā punar amāvāsyāvyāpte ahorātre vyatīte sati pratipadi saṃkrāmati tadā cāndro māso ’dhimāsaḥ syāt |
jyotiḥśāstre |
amāvāsyādvayaṃ yatra ravisaṃkrāntivarjitam |
[27]        malimlucaḥ sa vijñeya uttaras tūttamābhidhaḥ ||
raviṇā laṅghito māsaś cāndraḥ khyāto malimlucaḥ ||
varuṇaḥ sūryo bhānus tapanaś caṇḍo ravir gabhastiś ca
aryamā hirṇyaretā divākaro mitraviṣṇū ca |
ete dvādaśanāmānaḥ sūryā māghādiṣūdayanti māseṣu
niḥsūryo ’dhikamāso malimlucākhyas tataḥ pāpaḥ ||
māseṣu dvādaśādityās tapante hi yathākramam |
napuṃsake ’dhike māsi maṇḍalaṃ tapate raviḥ ||
saṃkrānto hi yo māsaḥ kadācit tithivṛddhitaḥ |
kālāntarāt samāyāti sa napuṃsaka ucyate ||
sa tu kadā bhavatīty apekṣāyāṃ vaśiṣṭhasiddhānte uktam |
dvātriṃśadbhir gatamāsair dinaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhis tathā |
ghaṭikānāṃ catuṣkeṇa pataty adhikamāsakaḥ ||
atītādhikamāsād ārabhya dvātriṃśanmāsād upari ṣoḍaśadineṣu ghaṭikācatuṣṭayādhikeṣu gateṣv adhikamāso bhavatīty arthaḥ |
yat tu viṣṇudharmottare ’bhihitam,
saureṇābdas tu mānena yadā bhavati bhārgava |
sāvane tu tadā māne dinaṣaṭkaṃ prapūryate ||
ūnarāvāś ca te rāma proktāḥ saṃvatsareṇa ṣaṭ |
saurasaṃvatsarasyānte mānena śaśijena tu ||
ekādaśātiricyante dināni bhṛgunandana |
samādvaye sāṣṭamāse tasmān māso ’tiricate |
[28]        sa cādhimāsakaḥ proktaḥ kāmyakarmasu garhitaḥ ||
tathā kāṭhakagṛhye "māse triṃśattame bhaved" iti |
mahābhārate |
pañcame pañcame varṣe dvau māsāv upajāyate |
teṣāṃ kālātirekeṇa grahāṇām aticārataḥ || iti |
tad etat sarvam arvāṅ malamāso na saṃbhavaty evaṃ param |
nanu ekasmin vatsare saṃkrāntirahitaṃ māsadvayaṃ jyotiḥsiddhāne ’bhihitam: "asaṃkrāntamāso ’dhimāsaḥ sphuṭaḥ syāt dvisaṃkrāntimāsaḥ kadācit kṣayākhyaḥ | kṣayaḥ kārtikāditraye nānyataḥ syāt tadā varṣamadhye ’pi māsadvayaṃ ceti" tat katham ucyate dvātriṃśanmāsād arvāṅmalamāso na saṃbhavatīti |
ucyate | yady apy ekasmin vatsare saṃkrāntirahitaṃ māsadvayaṃ bhavatīti tathāpi tayor eka eva malamāsaḥ dvātriṃśanmāsād ūrdhvaṃ yaḥ saṃpadyate, aparaḥ saṃkrāntirahito ’pi na malamāsaḥ akālādhikyāt kālādhikyasyaiva malatvāt |
tathā ca gṛhyapariśiṣṭe |
malaṃ vadanti kālasya māsaṃ kālavido ’dhikam || iti |
tathā ca viṣṇudharmottare |
sa cādhimāsakaḥ proktaḥ kāmyakarmasu garhitaḥ || iti |
adhiśabdenāvayavenādhikyalākṣaṇayādhikyāpratīteḥ yathorukam iti kaśabdena māṃsavācakakāsaśabdalakṣaṇayā māṃsasya tataś ca māsaśuddhatulya evāsau |
tathā ca jābāliḥ |
ekasmin api varṣe ca dvau māsāv adhimāsakau |
pūrvo māsaḥ praśastaḥ syād aparas tv adhimāsakaḥ ||
[29]        māsadvaye ’bdamadhye tu saṃkrāntir na yadā bhavet |
prākṛtas tatra pūrvaḥ syād adhimāsas tathottaraḥ ||
ityādipūrvādhikamāsād ārabhya dvātriṃśanmāsād ūrdhvaṃ pūrvaṃ yo ’saṃkrāntaḥ sa prākṛtaḥ śuddha ity arthaḥ, yas tataḥ paraḥ so ’dhimāso malamāsa ity arthaḥ | tathā ca dvātriṃśanmāsādūrdhvaṃ (?) yo ’saṃkrānto māsaḥ so ’dhimāsaḥ, tato ’rvāg yo 'saṃkrānto māsaḥ sa prākṛto nādhimāsa ity arthaḥ, na tv atra māsapaurvāparyaṃ vivakṣitaṃ vakṣyamāṇa-vacanavirodhāt | yat tu tadā varṣamadhye adhimāsadvayaṃ cety abhidhānaṃ tad asaṃkrāntatvād asaṃkrānto māsaḥ "raviṇā sahito māsa" ityādivacanāt na tu karmānarhatvād iti | yadā tv ekasmin vatsare āśvinādiṣaṭkamadhye saṃkrāntiśūnya eko māsaḥ caitrādiṣaṭkamadhye tv aparaḥ, tadā dvātriṃśanmāsād ūrdhvam api bhavet pūrvo māso nādhiko māsaḥ paratas tu bhavati |
tathā ca brahmasiddhānte |
caitrād arvāṅ nādhimāsaḥ parastād adhiko bhavet |
dṛṣṭā hi sarvaśāstreṣu tasmin mūrtis trayodaśī ||
tasminn uttarasminn eva māse trayodaśī mūrtiḥ na tu pūrvasminn api virodhād iti bhāvaḥ | "caitrād arvāg"ity atrāśvinād ārabhyeti draṣṭavyam | uktaṃ hi jyotiḥsiddhānte |
ghaṭakanyāgate sūrye vṛścike vātha dhanvini |
makare vātha kumbhe vā nādhimāso vidhīyate || iti |
yadi tu sāmānyato ’dhimāsamātraniṣedhaparaṃ vacanadavaṃ tadā,
māsaḥ (?) kanyāgate bhānāv asaṃkrānto bhaved yadi |
daivaṃ pitryaṃ tadā karma tulāsthe kartur akṣayam || [30]
iti jyotiḥpitāmahasmaraṇaṃ virudhyeta bahubādhaś ca syāt, tasmād yathoktaviṣayam eveti | yadā tv ekasminn āśvinādiṣaṭke saṃkrāntirahitamāsadvayaṃ bhavati tadā,
prākṛtas tatra pūrvaḥ syād adhimāsas tathottaraḥ |
ity etad eva draṣṭavyaṃ caitrādiṣaṭke tv adhikamāsadvayaṃ na bhavaty eva tasya kṣayamāsobhayapūrvapārśvavṛttitvāt kṣayasya ca kārtikyāditrayaniyatatvasyoktatvād iti | tathā dvisaṃkrānto ’pi kṣayākhyo malamāsaḥ |
tathā ca kāṭhakagṛhye |
yasmin māse na saṃkrāntiḥ saṃkrāntidvayam eva vā |
malamāsaḥ sa vijñeyo māse triṃśattame bhavet || iti |
atra kecin māsasaṅkhyāpi lakṣaṇāntargatety āhuḥ |  tan na, sa vijñeya iti lakṣaṇavākye samāpte triṃśattama ity abhidhānāt pūrvodāhṛtavacanāc ca | api ca yat kiṃcid apekṣya triṃśattamatvam atra lakṣaṇaṃ malamāsāpekṣayā vā nādyaḥ ativyāpteḥ, na dvitīyaḥ ātmāśrayāt sṛṣṭyādimāse vyāpakatvāc ca tasya triṃśattamatvābhāvād amalamāsatvāc ca taduttaraḥ sarvo na malamāsaḥ syād iti lakṣaṇavyāghātān na lakṣaṇaṃ, yatraikasmin vatsare ’saṃkrāntaṃ māsadvayaṃ saṃkrāntidvayayuto māsaś ca tatra yāvasaṃkrāntadvisaṃkrāntau tau saṃsarpāṃhaspatisaṃjñau anyaś cādhimāsaḥ |
tathā bārhaspatyajyotirgranthe |
yasmin māse na saṃkrāntiḥ saṃkrāntidayam eva ca |
saṃsarpāṃhaspatī māsāvadhimāsaś ca ninditaḥ ||
śrutir api "saṃsarpo 'syaṃhaspataye tvetyāha asti trayodaśomāsa [31] ityāhus tam eva tat prīṇātīti | atra jyotiḥśāstre prasiddhavivāhādikarmasu trayo ’pi ninditāḥ kṣayādhikamāsau tu śrautasmārtakāmyakarmasv api ninditau kṣayasyāṃhaspatitvena kālamalarūpatvād ahaṃsaś ca malatvāt adhikamāsasya kālādhikyenāpavitratvāt |
tathā ca smṛtyantare |
amāvākhāmahorātre yadā saṃkramate raviḥ |
sa tu māsaḥ pavitraḥ syād atīte hy adhiko bhavet ||
atra kecid āhuḥ | viśvaprakāśamatadūṣaṇāyopanyasyed adhimāsas tāvac caitrādisaṃjñāṃ labhate | nanu caitrādimāsasaṃjñānāṃ meṣādisaṃkrāntinibandhanatvād adhimāsasya saṃkrāntirahitatvāc caitro 'dhimāso vaiśākho ’dhimāsa ityādivyavahāro na syāt | tathāhi caitrādirūpajātyā tāvac caitrādiśabdapravṛttāv anugataḥ kaścid upādhiḥ svīkāryaḥ | yaugikatve ’pi citrālakṣitapaurṇamāsīyukte caitrapadaprayogārtham upādhyāśravaṇaṃ tulyam | na ca meṣādisaṃkrāntiyogātirikta upādhir dṛśyate, na ca phālgunottaratvaṃ upādhiḥ, vaiśākhapūrvatvasyāpi prasaṅgād aviśeṣāt dvayopādhikatvavaiyarthyāt vikalpenopādhitve anekārthatvāpātāt phālgunānantaram adhimāse ca taduttarasya caitratvaṃ syāt | kiṃ ca caitravat phālgunasya māghottaratvaṃ tasya puṣyottaratvam iti krameṇa caitrottaratvaṃ vaiśākhasyeti cakrakadoṣaḥ ato meṣādisaṃkrāntiyoga evopādhiḥ | kiṃ ca vede madhuś ceti dvādaśamāsāḥ saṃvatsara iti dvādaśa saṃjñā anukramya saṃsarpohīti saṃjñāntaratvam arthāntaraviyuktaṃ trayodaśamāsāḥ saṃvatsara iti saṃkhyā pṛthaktve yuktā tena caitrādyādhikyān na tatsaṃjña iti, ucyate [32] yadi hy adhikamāsaḥ śuddhāt pṛthagbhūtaḥ syāt syād evaṃ, na tv evam asti,
kiṃ tv asau śuddhāntarbhūta eva |
tad ukaṃ |
ṣaṣṭyā tu divasair māsaḥ kathito bādarāyaṇaiḥ || iti |
evaṃ ṣaṣṭidino māsas tadarddhaṃ ca malimluca || iti ca |
na ca vācyaṃ atra māsaśabdaḥ ekaśeṣavṛttiḥ yat dvivacanābhāve ’pi māsadvitvāvagater ekavacanam eva saṃkrāntiyogopādhiḥ tenādhimāso na caitrādir iti | sakalalokasiddhacaitrādivyavahārasyābhāvaprasaṅgāt saṃsarpaśabdasyaikadeśavacanasyārthāntaraviṣayatvam asya tatpakṣe ’pi vidyata eva | śrutiś ca triṃśaddinatanmāsavivakṣayeti | ato yadā yadā yadantarbhūto ’sau tadā tatsaṃjñayā vyapadiśyata iti na doṣaḥ | nanv evam adhimāsasya śuddhamāsadvayamadhyapātitvāt kim asau pūrvasyottarārddhaṃ kiṃ vottarasya pūrvārdham iti nirdhāraṇakāraṇābhāvāt saṃjñānirddhāro durghaṭaḥ | ucyate adhimāsasyottaramāsapūrvārddhatvād uttaramāsasaṃjñā |
tad uktam |
ādyo malimnuco jñeyo dvitīyaḥ prākṛtaḥ smṛtaḥ |
ṣaṣṭidinātmakamāsasya ‘ādyaḥ' pūrvabhāgaḥ, 'malimlucaḥ' aśuddhaḥ karmānarho jñeyaḥ, 'dvitīyaḥ' uttaro bhāgaḥ, 'prākṛtaḥ śuddha ity arthaḥ |
jyotiḥśāstre pitāmaho ’pi |
ṣaṣṭyā tu divasair māsaḥ kathito bādarāyaṇaiḥ |
pūrvam ardhaṃ parityajya uttarārdhaṃ praśasyate ||
evaṃ sarvatrādhimāsasyottaramāsapūrvārdhatve prāpte kvacid apavādam āha |
[33]        māsadvaye ’bdamadhye tu saṃkrāntir na yadā bhavet |
prākṛtas tatra pūrvaḥ syād uttaras tu malimlucaḥ ||
ekasmin varṣe yadā dvau māsāv asaṃkrāntau bhavatas tadā vaiparītyaṃ, ṣaṣṭidinātmakasya māsasya pūrvo bhāgaḥ 'prākṛtaḥ' śuddhaḥ, uttaro bhāgo malimluca ity arthaḥ | ekābdamadhyavartinau dvāv adhimāsau pūrvamāsottarārdhatvāt pūrvamāsasaṃjñāv ity abhiprāyaḥ | yuktaṃ caitat adhimāsasya pūrvabhāgaḥ prākṛtaḥ uttaro bhāgo malimlucaḥ tasya vṛddhitvād vṛddheś ca pūrvaniṣṭhatvaniyamāt | anyathā tithivṛddher apy uttaratithisaṃjñatvāpateḥ ekādhimāsasya tu "indrāgnī yatra hūyete" ityādinyāyād balīyasā vacanenottaramāsasaṃjñatvam abhihitam | ata evoktam |
ekatra māsadvitayaṃ yadi syāt
varṣe ’dhikaṃ tatra paro ’dhimāsaḥ |
nanv ekasmin saṃvatsare caturdaśa māsāḥ syur ity ata āha,
trayodaśaṃ tu śrutir āha māsaṃ caturdaśaḥ kvāpi na caiva dṛṣṭaḥ |
ekasmin varṣe ’dhimāsadvaye ’pi māsās trayodaśaiva "yadvarṣamadhye ’dhikamāsayugmaṃ tat kārtikāditritaye kṣayākhya iti vacanād ity abhiprāyaḥ | kaiścit "māsadvaye ’bdamadhye tv" ityādivacanānām evaṃ vyākhyānaṃ kṛtaṃ yadaikasmin varṣe dvau māsāv asaṃkrāntau bhavatas tatra tayor asaṃkrāntayor madhye yaḥ pūrvo ’saṃkrāntaḥ sa prākṛtaḥ śuddhaḥ karmārhaḥ, uttaras tv asaṃkrānto malimlucaḥ karmānarhaḥ, durgendrasthāpanotthāne na ca vajriṇaḥ,
pūrvavat pratiṣiddhāni parato na ca daivikam |
iti, tad uktaṃ "ekatra māsadvitayam" ityādineti tad ayuktaṃ anekavacanavirodhāt | tathā hi,
[34]        yasmin māse na saṃkrāntiḥ saṃkrāntidayam eva vā |
malamāsaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtaḥ ||
sinīvālīm atikramya yadā saṃkramate raviḥ |
bhānunā laṅghito māso hy anarhaḥ sarvakarmasu ||
yasmin varṣe dvisaṃkrānto ’dhikamāsadayaṃ tadā |
tad dhi māsatrayaṃ duṣṭaṃ sarveṣu śubhakarmasu ||
saṃsarpāṃhaspatī māsāv adhimāsaś ca ninditāḥ |
yad varṣamadhye ’dhikamāsayugmaṃ
tat kārttikāditritaye kṣayākhye |
māsatrayaṃ tyājyam idaṃ prayatnād
vivāhayajñotsavamaṅgaleṣu ||
saptamyām udite sūrye parataś cāṣṭamī bhavet |
tatra durgotsavaṃ kuryān na kuryād apare ’hani ||
iti nirṇayāmṛtavacanam ityādi | tasmāt pūrvā vyākhyā jyāyasī |
yat tu vacanam |
caitrād arvāṅ nādhimāsaḥ paratas tv adhiko bhavet |
dṛṣṭā hi sarvaśāstreṣu tasmin mūrtis trayodaśī ||
yad api |
ghaṭakanyāgate sūrye vṛścike vātha dhanvini |
makare vātha kumbhe vā nādhimāso vidhīyate ||
iti tadubhayam apy āśvinādīnāṃ phālgunāntānāṃ pūrvabhāgā adhimāsā na bhavantīty evaṃparaṃ, na tu sarvathaivādhimāsā na bhavantīty evaṃparaṃ [35] "daśānāṃ phālguṇādīnāṃ prāyomāghasya tu kvacit napuṃsakatvaṃ bhavatīti" vacanavirodhād iti, tad ayuktaṃ viśvaprakāśamataṃ dūṣayati vākyānārjavatvāt pūrvottaraśabdābhyām upāttabhāgaparityāgenānupāttabhāgagrahavasyāyuktatvāt | yat tūktaṃ “caitrād arvāṅ nādhimāsa" iti “ghaṭakanyāgate sūrye" iti vacanadvayam āśvinādīnāṃ phālgunāntānāṃ pūrvabhāgā adhimāsā na bhavantīty evaṃparam iti,  tan na, lakṣaṇādhyāhārādiprasaṅgāt "daśānāṃ phālgunādīnām" iti vacanavirodhasyāsmatpakṣe ’py abhāvāc ca samarūpato ’dhimāsaniṣedhasyānaṅgīkārāt | yat tv asmatpakṣe dūṣaṇam abhihitaṃ tad ayukaṃ asaṃkrāntamāsaniṣedhasya sāmānyaśāstrasya viśeṣaśāstreṇa bādhasya yuktatvād asa doṣasya bhavatpakṣe ’pi samānatvāt sāmānyaśāstraprāptottaramāsapūrvārdhatvāpavādāṅgīkārān māsatrayasya duṣṭatvapratipādakavacanasya jyotiḥśāstraprasiddhavivāhādiśubhakarmaviṣayatvāt, tathā ca tatraivoktaṃ “vivāhayajñotsavamaṅgaleṣv" ityādi, tasmāt pūrvaiva vyākhyā jyāvasī |
saṃkrāntidvayasaṃyuktaḥ sa māso ’ṃhaspatiḥ smṛtaḥ |
caitrādisaptamāseṣu na kadācid bhaved ayam ||
ūrjādipañcamāseṣu kadācana bhaved yadā |
tadā dvāv adhikau syātāṃ tasminn arcādipañcake ||
iti malamāsārūpanirṇayaḥ |
[36]
atha malamāse kāryākāryanirṇayaḥ |
tatra śātātapaḥ |
vatsarāntargataḥ pāpo yajñānāṃ phalanāśakṛt |
nairṛtyayātudhānādyaiḥ samākrānto ’dhimāsakaḥ ||
malimlucaiḥ samākrāntiṃ sūryasaṃkrāntivarjitām |
malimlucaṃ vijānīyād garhitaṃ sarvakarmasu ||
satyavrataḥ |
malimlucas tu yo māsaḥ sa māsaḥ pāpasaṃjñakaḥ |
varjitaḥ pitṛdevānāṃ sarvakarmasu taṃ tyajet ||
paiṭhīnasiḥ |
śrautasmārtakriyāḥ sarvā dvādaśe parikīrtitāḥ |
trayodaśe tu sarvās tā niṣphalā iti saṃjñitāḥ ||
tasmāt trayodaśe māsi kuryāt tā na kathaṃcana |
kurvann anartham evā kuryād ātmavināśanam ||
bhṛguḥ |
ekarāśisthite sūrye yadā darśadvayaṃ bhavet |
havyakavyakriyāhantā tadā jñeyo ’dhimāsakaḥ || iti
bhaviṣyottare ’pi |
asaṃkrāntaṃ tathā māsaṃ daive pitrye ca karmaṇi |
malīmasam aśaucaṃ tu varjayen mātimān naraḥ ||
sumantuḥ |
[37]        na kuryād adhike māsi kāmyaṃ karma kadācana |
malaṃ vadanti kālasya māsaṃ kālavido ’dhikam || iti |
gṛhyapariśiṣṭe ’pi |
malimlucas tu māso vai malinaḥ pāpasaṃbhavaḥ |
garhitaḥ pitṛdevebhyaḥ sarvakarmasu taṃ tyajet ||
brahmasiddhānte |
yadā śaśī yāti gabhastimaṇḍalaṃ
divākaraḥ saṃkramaṇaṃ karoty anu |
tadādhimāsaḥ kathito viriñcinā
vivāhayātrotsavayajñadoṣakṛt ||
jyotiḥśāstrāntare |
savitṛmaṇḍalam eti yadā śaśī
tadanusaṃkramaṇaṃ kurate raviḥ |
makhamahotsavanāśakaras tadā
munivaraiḥ kathito ’dhikamāsakaḥ ||
tathā |
sinīvālīm atikramya yadā saṃkramate raviḥ |
bhānunā laṅghito māso hy anarthaḥ sarvakarmasu ||
evaṃ sāmānyataḥ sakalakarmaniṣedhaprāptau viśeṣo vakṣyāte | tatra śaṅkhaḥ |
na kuryād adhike māse karmākarma kathaṃcana |
muktvā naimittikaṃ karma tad dhi tatraiva kīrtitam ||
[38]        karmākarmetiśabdena kāmyakarmocyate | tad dhi phalakāmaiḥ kriyamāṇatvāt karma, aphalakāmair akriyamāṇatvād akarma, karma ca tad akarma ceti karmadhārayaḥ | tathaivāha prajāpatiḥ |
na kuryād adhike māsi kāmyakarma kadācana |
muktvā naimittikaṃ śrāddhaṃ tad dhi tatraiva kīrtitam ||
atra kecid āhuḥ kāmyasya karmaṇo ’dhimāse prārambhaḥ samāptiś ca niṣidhyate | ārabdhe tu kāmye karmaṇi samāptikālād arvāk madhyapatite ’dhimāse ’pi kāmyaṃ karma kāryam | tathā cāturmāsyavratānām āṣāḍhe ’dhimāse nārambhaḥ kārttike cādhimāse na samāptiḥ | antarāpatite tv adhimāse ’py anuṣṭhānaṃ | ata evāntarādhimāsapāte ’pi saṃkrāntiyuktāṣāḍhaśuklaikādaśyāṃ cāturmāsyavratānām ārambho ’bhihitaḥ saṃkrāntiyuktakārttikaśuklaikādaśyāṃ samāptir uktā | yathoktam |
ekādaśyāṃ tu gṛhṇīyāt saṃkrāntau karkaṭasya ca |
āṣāḍhādau naro bhaktyā cāturmāsyavratakriyām ||
tato vibudhyate devaḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ |
kārttike śuklapakṣasya ekādaśyāṃ samāhitaḥ ||
mantreṇa caiva rājendra devam utthāpayed dvijaḥ |
adhimāse ca patite eṣa eva vidhikramaḥ ||
adhimāsanipāte ’pi kramād indrāmbikāharīn |
kanyātulāvṛścikeṣu nṛpa utthāpayed dhruvam ||
na caivaṃ sati māsapañcakaṃ vratānuṣṭhānaprāptau cāturmāsyavratam iti samākhyāvirodhaḥ |
[39]        vārṣikāṃś caturo māsān madyaṃ māṃsaṃ parityajet |
svarṇado harim uddiśya va bhaved vedavid dvijaḥ ||
yaḥ kṣipet kṛcchrapādena āṣāḍhādiṛtudvayam |
viṣṇupūjanakṛn martyaḥ sa bhavet tanniketanaḥ ||
maitrādipāde svapitīha viṣṇur
vaiṣṇavyamadhye parivartate ca |
pauṣṇāvasāne ca surārihantā
prabudhyate māsacatuṣṭayena ||
ityādivacanavirodhaś ceti vācyam,
ṣaṣṭyā tu divasair māsaḥ kathito bādarāyaṇaiḥ |
iti vacanān māsacatuṣṭayopapatteḥ |
brahmasiddhānte |
prārabdhaṃ karma yat kiṃcin na tu kāryaṃ malimluce |
asūryā nāma ye māsā na teṣu mama saṃmatāḥ |
vratānāṃ caiva yajñānām ārambhāś ca samāptayaḥ ||
ity ārambhasamāpyor evādhimāse pratiṣiddhatvāc ca cakārāt sarvakāmyakarmagrahaṇam iti tad ayuktam |
pravṛttaṃ malamāsāt prāg yat kāmyam asamāpitam |
āgate masamāse ’pi tat samāpyam asaṃśayam ||
iti kāṭhakagṛhyapariśiṣṭavacanena kāmyakarmasamāpter api malamāse ’pi vidhānāt tasmād evaṃ viṣayavyavasthā, "asūryā nāma ye māsā" iti vacanena kāmyavratayajñānām ārambhaḥ samāptiś ca pratiṣidhyate na tu [40] nityavratayajñānāṃ, “nitvanaimittike kuryāt prayataḥ san malimluce” ityādivakṣyamāṇanityanaimintikavidhāyakabahuvacanasaṃkocaprasaṅgāt | tasmād asyaivekasya kāmyavratayajñaviṣayatayāsasaṃkoco yuktaḥ |
nanu kim atra malamāsāt prāg ārambhasya samāptiḥ pratiṣidhate, utātraivārabdhasya, na prathamaḥ “pravṛttaṃ malamāsāt prāg" iti vacanavirodhāt, na dvitīyaḥ ārambhaniṣedhād eva ca samāpter aprasakter niṣedhāyogād iti |
ucyate | malamāsaprārabdhasyaiva samāptis tatra niṣidhyate yo hy ajñānān malamāse ’pi kāmyaṃ karma prārabhate tena tatra samāptau kṛtāyāṃ doṣādhikyaṃ sthād ity etadartham idaṃ vākyam iti na doṣaḥ |
vṛddhamanu-bṛhaspati- paiṭhīnasi-jyotiḥparāśarāḥ |
agnyādheyaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ ca yajñadānavratāni ca |
vedavratavṛṣotsargacūḍākaraṇamekhalāḥ |
māṅgalyam abhiṣekaṃ ca malamāse vivarjayet ||
kvacid 'yajñadānapratigrahān' iti pāṭhaḥ |
asyāpavādaḥ |
candrasūryagrahe caiva maraṇe putrajanmani |
malamāse ’pi deyaṃ syād dattam akṣayakārakam || iti |
bālye vā yadi vā vṛddhe śukre vāstam upāgate |
malamāsa ivaitāni varjayed devadarśanaṃ || iti |
“agnyādheyaṃ pratiṭhāṃ" cety āvaśyakatve satīti śeṣo draṣṭavyaḥ tena malase ’pi prāyaścittabhūtam agnyādheyam agnyanugatyanantaraṃ kartavyaṃ na pratiṣidhyate | evaṃ pratimādisaṃskāranāśe punaḥ pratiṣṭhā na pratiṣidhyate | [41] yajñāḥ kāmyā nityā api vasantādisaṃbandhena vidhīyamānā uttare sasaṃkrānte ’pi kriyamāṇā ye svakāle eva kṛtā bhavanti | 'dānāmi' mahādānāni | kecid vratānām api mahatām eva pratiṣedham āhuḥ | vṛṣotsargasa ca naikādaśāhikasya ca pratiṣedhaḥ ṣoḍaśaśrāddhādivat tasyāpi pretopakāritvāc chukrāstamayād ādāv api anāvaśyakatve sati agnyādheyādi prati-
vidhyate " malamāsa ivetyabhidhānāt | 'devadarśanaṃ' prasiddhyate malamāsa ivety abhidhānāt | 'devadarśanaṃ' prasiddhasvayaṃbhūdevatādarśanam |
tathā ca prathamaṃ vivakṣitaṃ, “anādidevatā dṛṣṭā na śubhaṃ naṣṭabhārgave” iti skandapurāṇavacanāt malimluce 'py anāvṛttatīrthasthānaṃ vivarjayet |
atra kecid āhuḥ | mala iveti siddhavad dṛṣṭāntīkaraṇāny athānupapattyā malamāse prathamadevatādarśananiṣedhaḥ siddhaḥ | apare tu malamāsa ivety agnyādheyādiṣv eva yojayanti | yathā malamāse candrasūryagrahādikālavyatirekeṇaiteṣāṃ niṣedhas tathaiva bālyādiṣv api yathā syād iti, tasmin pakṣe malamāse devatādarśanasya na pratiṣedhaḥ |
vāpīkūpataḍāgādipratiṣṭhāṃ yajñakarma ca |
na kuryān malamāse tu mahādānavratāni ca ||
mahādānāni matsyapurāṇe darśitāni |
manur uvāca |
mahādānāni yānīha pavitrāṇi śubhāni ca |
rahasyāni pradeyāni tāni me kathayācyuta ||
matsya uvāca |
[42]        noktāni yāni guhyāni mahādānāni ṣoḍaśa |
tāni te saṃpravakṣyāmi yathāvad anupūrvaśaḥ ||
ādyaṃ tu sarvadānānāṃ tulāpuruṣasaṃjñitam |
hiraṇyagarbhadānaṃ ca brahmāṇḍaṃ tadanantaram ||
kalpapādapadānaṃ ca gosahasraṃ ca pañcamam |
hiraṇyakāmadhenuś ca hiraṇyāśvas tathaiva ca ||
hiraṇyāśvarathas tadvat hemahastirathas tathā |
pañcalāṅgalakaṃ tadvad dārādānaṃ tathaiva ca ||
dvādaśaṃ viśvacakraṃ ca tataḥ kalpalatātmakam |
saptasāgaradānaṃ ca ratnadhenus tathaiva ca |
mahābhūtaghaṭas tadvac choḍaśaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||
kūrmapurāṇe tv anyāny api daśa mahādānāni darśitāni |
kanakāś ca tilā nāgā dāsīrathamahīgṛhāḥ |
kanyā ca kapilā dhenur mahādānāni vai daśa ||
kāṭhakagṛhye |
cūḍāṃ mauñjībandhanaṃ ca agnyādheyaṃ mahālayaṃ |
rājābhiṣekaṃ kāmyaṃ ca na kuryād bhānulaṅghite ||
kauthumiḥ |
adhimāse na kartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ sāṃvatsarādikam |
varṣavṛddhyabhiṣekādi kartavyam adhike na tu ||
hārītaḥ |
adhimāse na kartavyaṃ śrāddham abhyudayaṃ tathā |
[43]        tathaiva kāmyaṃ yat karma vatsarāt prathamād ṛte ||
sapiṇḍīkaraṇād ūrdhvaṃ yat kiṃcit śrāddhikaṃ bhavet |
iṣṭaṃ vāpy atha vā pūrtaṃ tatra kuryāt malimluce ||
ābhyudayikaṃ śrāddhaṃ ādyavatsarāntargatajātakarmādinimittavyatirikam | anye tv evaṃ vyācakṣate 'vatsarāt prathamād ṛta' iti prathamaṃ vatsaraṃ vihāya ābhyudayikaṃ śrāddhaṃ malamāse na kartavyaṃ prathame tu saṃvatsare malamāse prāpte sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ vihitaṃ taduttaradine yad ābhyudayikaṃ vihitaṃ tan malamāse ’pi kartavyam | yathoktam |
bhrātā vā bhrātṛputro vā sapiṇḍaḥ śivya eva ca |
sapiṇḍakakriyāṃ kṛtvā kuryād ābhyudayaṃ tataḥ ||
ity atra vacane ābhyudayaśabdena ābhyudayikaṃ śrāddhaṃ vibhāgaprakaraṇe viśvarūpācāryeṇa vyākhyātam | anye tu uttaraśeṣatvenaivaṃ vyācakṣate sapiṇḍīkaraṇād ūrddhaṃ yat prathame saṃvatsare pratimāsaṃ punaḥ kriyamāṇaṃ caipuruṣikaṃ māsikaṃ śrāddhaṃ tan malimluce ’dhimāse kāryam iti vaktuṃ 'vatsarāt prathamād ṛta' ity ukaṃ etac copariṣṭād vakṣyate | asaṃkrāntaṃ prakṛtya jyotiḥśāstre |
tatra dattam adattaṃ syād dhutaṃ cāhutam eva ca |
suprajaptam ajaptaṃ syān nopavāsaḥ kṛto bhavet ||
na yātrāṃ na vivāhaṃ ca na ca vāstuniveśanam |
na pratiṣṭhāṃ ca devānāṃ prāsādagrāmabhūruhām |
na hiraṇyaṃ suvāsāṃsi kārayed iti niścayaḥ ||
parāśaraḥ |
raviṇā laṅghito māsaś cāndraḥ khyāto malimlucaḥ |
[44]        tatra yad vihitaṃ karma uttare māsi kārayet ||
prajāpatiḥ |
upākarma ca havyaṃ ca kavyaṃ parvotsavaṃ tathā |
uttare niyataḥ kuryāt pūrve tan niṣphalaṃ bhavet ||
parāśaraḥ |
pakṣadvaye ’rkasaṃkrāntiryadā na syāt sitāsite |
tadā tanmāsikaṃ kāryam uttare māsi kārayet ||
evaṃ ṣaṣṭidino māsas tadardhaṃ ca malimlucaḥ |
tyaktvā taduttare kāryāḥ pitṛdevādikāḥ kriyāḥ ||
satyavrataḥ |
māsi saṃvatsare caiva tithidvaidhaṃ yadā bhavet |
tatrottarottamā jñeyā pūrvā tu syān malinulaḥ ||
tatrādhimāse yat kartavyaṃ tad āha śātātapaḥ |
ekasaṃjñau yadā māsau syātāṃ saṃvatsare kvacit |
tatrādye pitṛkāryāṇi devakāryāṇi cottare ||
aṅgirāḥ |
dvau māsāv ekanāmānāv ekasmin vatsare yadi |
pūrvasmin pitṛkāryāṇi devakāryāṇi cottare ||
jyotiḥśāstre |
ṣaṣṭibhir divasair māsaḥ kathito bādarāyaṇaiḥ |
devakāryāṇi pūrvasmin pitṛkāryāṇi cobhayoḥ ||
evamādīni malamāse devakāryapitṛkāryapratipādakāni vacanāny [45] āvaśyakadevakārya-pitṛkāryaviṣayāṇi draṣṭavyāni |
bṛhaspatiḥ |
nityanaimittike kuryāt prayataḥ san malimluce |
tīrthaśrāddhaṃ gajacchāyāṃ pretaśrāddhaṃ tathaiva ca ||
nityam āvaśyakaṃ yan māsaviśeṣanāmanirapekṣam eva vihitaṃ yasyākaraṇe kālātyayanimittaṃ prāyaścittam āmnāyate tad yathā "agnaye pathikṛte puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet yo darśapūrṇamāsayājī sa amāvāsyāṃ vā paurṇamāsīṃ nirvaped" iti | tathābhūtasya nityasya grahaṇaṃ na tu nityamātrasya | tena darśapūrṇamāsāgnihotrapañcamahāyajñāder anuṣṭhānaṃ malimluce kartavyaṃ svakālātikrame prāyacittāmnānāt | evaṃ ca nityāpi somayāgakriyā malimluce māsi na kāryā malimlucamāsātikrame ’pi vasantādikālasya somayāgāṅgabhūtasthānatikrāntatvenātra prāyaścittaprāpter asaṃ bhavāt | evaṃ yasya naimittakasya gṛhadāheṣṭyāder nimittānantarakāle kartavyasya na māsāntare vihitakālalābhaḥ tathābhūtāvaśyakriyāviṣayam, evaṃ "malimluce māsi kuryād" iti vidhānaṃ jāteṣṭyāder naimittikasyāpi śiśurakṣaṇārthaṃ nimittānantarakālam apahāya kālāntare kartavyasya yathā daśarātrādisūtakakālasya madhye ’nuṣṭhānam anyānyyaṃ tathā malimlucakālamadhye ’pi sati ca malimluce ’nuṣṭhānaṃ, evaṃ ca nityatvaṃ naimittikatvaṃ cāvivakṣitaṃ yasyātikrame prāyaścittaprāptir yasya ca māsāntare vihitakālālābhenāvaśyakaṃ malimluce’nuṣṭhānaṃ tat sarvaṃ malimluce kuryād iti bārhaspatyavacanatātparyarthaḥ pretavyaḥ |
tathā ca smṛtyantare |
[46]        ananyagati yan nityaṃ kuryān naimittikaṃ tatheti |
yasya nityasya mukhyakālātikrame jaghanyasya kālāntarasyānabhyanujñātatvād atyantalope prāyaścittaṃ prasajyate tatkarmānanyagatitvān malamāse ’pi kāryam |
gṛhyapariśiṣṭam api |
malaṃ vadanti kālasya māsakālavido ’dhikam |
mehetātra viśeṣejyām anyatrāvaśyakād vidheḥ ||
āvaśyakād darśapūrṇamāsādividher anyatra viśeṣejyaṃ malamāse 'neheta' mācaret, yasyāṃ śuddhe māsi kriyamāṇāyāṃ nāsti vidhilopaḥ sā vidhiviśeṣejyā yathā "vasante vasante jyotiṣā yajeteti," vasante vihitasya jyotiṣṭomasya malamāsavaiśākhaparityāgena śuddhavaiśākhe kriyamāṇasya vasanta evaṃ kṛtatvān nāsti vidhilopaḥ anenāvaśyako vidhir adhikamāse ’nuṣṭheya ity arthād uktam |
uktaṃ ca sākṣād api tatraiva |
avaṣaṭkārahomāś ca parva cāgrayaṇaṃ tathā |
malamāse tu kartavyaṃ kāmyā iṣṭīr vivarjayet ||
'avaṣaṭkārahomāḥ' agnihotropāsanavaiśvadevādayaḥ, 'parva' darśapaurṇamāsau pārvaṇasthālīpākaś ca, 'āgrayaṇaṃ' āgrayaṇeṣṭiḥ, yady apy āgrayaṇaṃ varṣāṣu śyāmākair yajeteti māsadvayātmakavarṣākhyakālavihitaṃ malimlucamāse ’pi svakālasaṃbhavād ananyagatikaṃ na bhavati tathāpi durbhikṣeṇa śyāmākavyatiriktadhānyāsaṃbhave jīvanārthaṃ śyāmākānnabhojanam akṛtvāgrayaṇenāvaśyakartavyam ity āgrayaṇānuṣṭhānaṃ jīvanārtham āvaśyakam iti yuktam uktam [47] āgrayaṇaṃ tatheti, yadā tu durbhikṣābhāvād anāvaśyakaṃ tadādhimāse śyāmākāgrayaṇaṃ na kartavyam |
anenaivābhiprāyeṇa paiṭhīnasinā,
saṃkrāntirahite māsi kuryād āgrayaṇaṃ na vā |
iti vikalpa uktaḥ |
kāṭhakagṛhyapariśiṣṭe |
male ’nanyagatiṃ vityāṃ (?) kuryān naimittikīṃ kriyām |
somayāgādikarmāṇi nityāny api malimluce ||
puṣṭīṣṭyāgrayaṇādhānacāturmāsyādikāny api |
mahālayāṣṭakāśrāddhopākarmādy api karma yat |
spaṣṭaṃ māsaviśeṣākhyāvihitaṃ varjayen male ||
‘mahālayaḥ’ bhādrapadasyāparapakṣaḥ |
pretamālyādim ārabhya śrāddhapiṇḍodakakriyāḥ |
sapiṇḍīkaraṇāntāś ca yathākālam upasthitāḥ ||
yavavrīhitilair homo jātakarmādikāḥ kriyāḥ |
maghātrayodaśaīśrāddhaṃ pratyupasthitihetukam |
ananyagatikatvena kartavyaṃ syān malimluce ||
bhṛgusmṛtāv api |
vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ tathā somam agnyādheyaṃ mahālayam |
rājābhiṣekaṃ kāmyaṃ ca na kuryād bhānulaṅghite ||
jyotiḥpitāmaho ’pi |
māsaḥ kanyāgate bhānāv asaṃkrānto bhaved yadi |
[48]        daivaṃ pitryaṃ tadā karma tulāsthe kartur akṣayam ||
jyotiḥparāśaro ’pi |
yātudhānapriyo māsaḥ kanyāke jāyate yadā |
devaṃ pitryaṃ tathā karma uttare māsi budhyate ||
devalaḥ |
arke nabhasyakanyāsthe śrāddhapakṣaḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
sinīvālīm atikramya yadā kanyāṃ vrajed raviḥ |
tadā kālasya vṛddhatvād atītaiva pitṛkriyā ||
'atītā' pañcamaṃ pakṣam atikrāntā, evaṃ ca yat kaiścid uktaṃ kanyāsaṃkrāntinimittānāṃ śrāddhānāṃ ṣoḍaśasu divaseṣu naimikatvān naimittikasya ca śrāddhasa malamāse pratiṣedhābhāvāt tāni kāryāṇi tad ukaṃ prajāpatinā "muktvā naimittikaṃ śrāddham" iti |
brahmasiddhānte |
sūryeṇa sahito māso na karmaṇaḥ smṛto budhaiḥ |
tasmāt tatra na kurvīta śrāddhaṃ naimittikād ṛte ||
nimittatvaṃ ca śrāddhaṃ prati kanyāsaṃkrānteḥ purāṇoktam ||
kanyāgate savitari yāny ahāni tu ṣoḍaśa |
ṛtubhis tāni tulyāni pitṝṇāṃ dattam akṣayam ||
iti tan nirastam | yathā ca śāṭyāyaniḥ |
nabhasyasyāpare pakṣe tithiṣoḍaśakas tu yaḥ |
kanyāgatānvitaś cet syāt sa kālaḥ śrāddhakarmaṇi ||
tathā ca nāgarakhaṇḍe ’pi pitṝn prati brahmavacaṇam |
[49]        āṣāḍyāḥ pañcane pakṣe kanyāsaṃsthe divākare |
yo vai śrāddhaṃ naraḥ kuryād ekasminn api vāsare ||
tasya saṃvatsaraṃ yāvat tṛptāḥ syuḥ pitaro dhruvam |
nabho vātha nabhastho vā malamāso yadā bhavet |
saptamaḥ pitṛpakṣaḥ syād anyathaiva tu pañcamaḥ ||
yat tu jātūkarṇavacanam,
āṣāḍhīm avadhiṃ kṛtvā yaḥ syāt pakṣas tu pañcamaḥ |
śrāddhaṃ tatra prakurvīta kanyāṃ gacchatu vā na vā ||
tat pūrvapradarśitavākyanicayaparyālocanayā pakṣopakramābhiprāyam |
tathā ca kārṣṇājiniḥ |
ante vā yadi vā madhye yatra kanyāṃ ravir vrajet |
pakṣas tu pañcamaḥ pūjyaḥ śrāddhaṣoḍaśakaṃ prati ||
bṛhanmanur api |
madhye vā yadi vāpy ante yatra kanyāṃ ravir vrajet |
sa pakṣḥ sakalaḥ pūrṇaḥ śrāddhaṃ tatra vidhīyate ||
tena "kanyāgate savitari" ityādi purāṇavacanaṃ pakṣamadhye yasmin kasmiṃścid ahani kanyāsaṃkramaṇe sati pratipadādiṣoḍaśāpy ahāny upādeyānīty evaṃ vyākhyeyaṃ na tu saṃkramaṇāt pūrvāṇi heyānīty evaṃ, pañcamapakṣasya prādhānyārthaṃ vā tad vacanaṃ, tīrthaśrāddhaṃ gajacchāyāśrāddhaṃ tad ubhayaṃ na nityaṃ akaraṇe pratyavāyābhāvān nāpi naimittikaṃ tīrthasaṃbandhasya gajacchāyāsaṃbandhasya ca nimittasya puruṣaprayatnasādhyatvād atas tayoḥ pṛthaggrahaṇam | gajacchāyātra gajasyaiva chāyā yā pūrvasyāṃ diśi vartate yā mukhyā grāhyā viśvāmitroktā |
[50]        paramānnaṃ tu yo dadyāt pitṝṇāṃ madhunā saha |
chāyāyāṃ tu gajendrasya pūrvasyāṃ dakṣiṇamukhaḥ ||
yadenduḥ pitṛdaivatye haṃsaś caiva kare sthitaḥ |
yānyā tithir bhavet sāpi gayacchāyā prakīrttitā ||
iti yā paribhāṣitā gajacchāyā sā amukhyā asaṃbhāvinī ca "malamāse haṃsaś caiva kare sthita" iti vacanāt | 'haṃsaḥ' sūryaḥ, 'kare' haste, 'sthita" iti kanyāsaṃkrānter vartamānatvāt malamāsatvābhāvāt, pretaśrāddhanityatvena malamāse ’pi prāpte yat tat punar vidhīyate tat saṃvatsaramadhyapatite malimluce ekaṃ māsikaṃ kṛtvā dvitīye māsi śuddhe ’pi anyad adhikaṃ kuryād ity etadartham |
yad āha vaśiṣṭaḥ |
saṃvatsaramadhye yady adhimāso bhaven māsikārthaṃ dinam
ekaṃ vṛddhiṃ nayet |
vṛddhavaśiṣṭhaḥ |
śrāddhīye ’hani saṃprāpte adhimāso bhaved yadi |
śrāddhadvayaṃ prakurvīta evaṃ kurvan na muhyati ||
kauthumiḥ |
abdam ambughaṭaṃ dadyād annaṃ vāpi susaṃcitam |
saṃvatsare vivṛddhe ’pi pratimāsaṃ ca māsikam ||
gabhastiḥ |
na kuryān malamāse ’pi kāmyaṃ karma kadācana |
muktvā naimittikaṃ śrāddhaṃ tad dhi tatraiva kīrtitam ||
ekoddiṣṭaṃ tu yac chrāddhaṃ tan naimittikam ucyate |
[51]        tat kāryaṃ pūrvamāse ’pi kālādhikye ’pi dharmataḥ ||
viṣṇuḥ |
māsikārdhe ced adhimāṣapāto māsikārthaṃ dinam ekaṃ vardhayet |
kaścid etad vacanam evaṃ vyācaṣṭe 'vardhayet' khaṇḍayed iti, tat prāg udāhṛtavacanād (?) darśananibandhanam ity upekṣaṇīyam | smṛtyantare ’pi "saṃvatsaravivṛddhe ’pi pratimāsaṃ ca māsikaṃ" etat sapiṇḍīkaraṇāt prāktanamāsikaviṣayaṃ, ekoddiṣṭamāsikaviṣayatvādciti kecit, tad ayukaṃ sapiṇḍīkaraṇottaramāsikānām api vaikalpikaikoddiṣṭatvavidhānāt |
yad āha kātyāyanaḥ |
sapiṇḍīkaraṇād ūrdhvaṃ na dadyāt pratimāsikam |
ekoddiṣṭavidhānena dadyād ity āha śaunakaḥ ||
atra ca sapiṇḍīkaraṇottaram ekoddiṣṭavidhānena "na dadyāt pratimāsikam" ity ekaḥ pakṣaḥ, dadyād ity aparaḥ, na tu sapiṇḍīkaraṇottarakālamāsikaṃ na dadyād ity ekaḥ, ekoddiṣṭavidhānena dadyād ity aparaḥ |
tathā ca jātūkarṇaḥ |
pituḥ pitṛgaṇasthasya kuryāt pārvaṇavat sutaḥ |
pratyabdaṃ pratimāsaṃ ca vidhir jñeyaḥ sanātanaḥ |
'pitṛgaṇasthaḥ' sapiṇḍīkṛtaḥ |
ṛṣyaśṛṅgaḥ |
saṃvatsarātireko vai māsaṃ caiva trayodaśaḥ |
asurāṇāṃ tu māso ’sau tasmād eva vigarhitaḥ |
tasmāt trayodaśe śrāddhaṃ na kuryān nopatiṣṭhati ||
[52]        yasmāt trayodaśo māso asurasaṃbandhena garhitas tasmāt trayodaśe malamāse śrāddhaṃ na kuryāt kṛtam api yato nopatiṣṭhate | kecit trayodaśaṃ śrāddhaṃ na kuryād iti paṭhitvā trayodaśaṃ ṣaṇmāsikaṃ malamāse prāptaṃ tatra kāryam iti vyācakṣate, tad ayukaṃ saṃvatsaramadhye yady adhikamāso bhaved ityādiprāgudāhṛtavacanavirodhāt | apare tu "tasmāt trayodaśe śrāddhaṃ na kuryād indusaṃkṣaye" iti paṭhanti, tad apy ayuktam |
jātakarmaṇi yac chrāddhaṃ darśaśrāddhaṃ tathaiva ca |
malamāse ’pi tat kāryaṃ vyāsasya vacanaṃ yathā ||
iti vyāsavacanavirodhāt, piṇḍapitṛyajñavat tadanantaram avaśyānuṣṭheyasyāmāvāsyāśrāddhasya pratiṣedhānarhasya pratiṣedhaprasaṅgāc ca | “tasmāt trayodaśe śrāddhaṃ na kuryān nopatiṣṭhate" ity eva bahugranthadṛṣṭaḥ kāśmīralikhitaś ca pāṭho jyāyān | tathā ca hariharādigranthe ’py ayam eva pāṭho gṛhyate |
māṇḍavyaḥ |
garbhe vārdhuṣike pretaśrāddhe bhṛtye tu māsike |
prathame cābdike caiva nādhimāso vidhīyate || iti ||
yamaḥ |
garbhe vārdhuṣike bhṛtye śrāddhakarmaṇi māsike |
sapiṇḍīkaraṇe nitye nādhimāsaṃ vivarjayet ||
tīrthasnānaṃ japo homo yavavrīhitilādibhiḥ |
jātakarmāntyakarmaṇi navaśrāddhaṃ tathaiva ca ||
maghātrayodaśīśrāddhaṃ śrāddhāny api ca ṣoḍaśa |
candrasūryagrahe snānaṃ śrāddhadānajapādikam |
kāryāṇi malamāse ’pi nityaṃ naimittikaṃ tathā || iti |
[53]        'garbhe' garbhamāsaprayuktyā vihitapuṃsavanādau, 'vārdhuṣike' aśītibhāgetyādivihite vṛddhau, 'bhṛtye' saṃvatsarādiparyatakālakṛte, 'māsike' iti dvādaśamāsikaviṣayatvena kecid vyācakṣate | tad ayukaṃ śrāddhāny api ca ṣoḍaśety anenaiva tasya śrāddhasya malamāse ’pi vidhānāt tasya śoḍaśaśrāddheṣu gaṇanāt |
jātūkarṇaḥ |
dvādaśapratimāsyāni ādyaṃ ṣāṇmāsike tathā |
sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ caiva ity etac chrāddhaṣoḍaśam ||
'ṣāṇmāsikābdika' ity anena vihitayoḥ śrāddhayoḥ nirūpaṇārtham āha,
ekenāhnā tu ṣaṇmāsā yadā syur api vā tribhiḥ |
nyūnāḥ saṃvatsaraś caiva syātāṃ ṣāṇmāsike tadā ||
ekenāhnā tribhir vā yadā ṣaṇmāsāḥ nyūnāḥ syuḥ saṃvatsaraś ca tadā ṣāṇmāsikābdike śrāddhe kārye it yarthaḥ |
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
asthisaṃcayanaśrāddhe tripakṣe māsikāni ca |
riktayoś ca tathā tithyoḥ pretaśrāddhāni ṣoḍaśa ||
riktayos tithyor ity ekaikenāhnā nyūne ṣaṣṭhe dvādaśe ca māsa ity arthaḥ |
brahmapurāṇe |
nṛṇāṃ tu tyaktadehānāṃ śrāddhāḥ ṣoḍaśa sarvadā |
caturthe pañcame caiva navamaikādaśe tathā ||
tato dvādaśabhir māsaiḥ śrāddhā dvādaśasaṅkhyayā |
[54]        kartavyāḥ śrutitas teṣāṃ tatra viprāṃs tu tarpayet ||
tena ‘māsike śrāddhakarmaṇi' amāvāsyāśrāddhakarmaṇīty arthaḥ, 'nitye' nityadāne, 'homaḥ' atropāsanahomaḥ, yavavrīhitilādibhis tatra hotavyadravyopādānāt, 'antyakarmāṇi' dahanodakapiṇḍadānāsthisaṃcayanādīni | jātakarmavaj jātaśrāddham api kartavyam |
śrāddhajātakanāmāni ye ca saṃskārasavratāḥ |
malimluce’pi kartavyāḥ kāmyā iṣṭīś ca varjayet ||
'saṃskārāḥ' annaprāśananiṣkramaṇādayaḥ, janārdanaśayanād ārabhya yāvad utthānaṃ dhāraṇapāraṇādikaṃ kariṣyāmīty evaṃ saṃkalpasahitāḥ savratāḥ kāmyā api, iṣṭigrahaṇaṃ kāmyapaśubandhādidharmopalakṣaṇārthaṃ sarveṣām api kāmyānām anāvaśyakatvena varjanīyatvāt | ata eva smṛtyantaraṃ
iṣṭyādikarma kāmyaṃ tu malamāse vivarjayet |
hārīto ’pi |
adhimāse na kartavyaṃ śrāddham abhyudayaṃ tathā |
"tathaiva kāmyaṃ yat karmeti" yat kāmyaṃ karma iṣṭyādikaṃ tan malamāse na kartavyam ity arthaḥ |
yat tu jyotiḥpārāśareṇoktam |
upākarma tathotsargaḥ prasavāhotsavāṣṭakāḥ |
māsavṛddhau parāḥ kāryā varjayitvā tu paitṛkam ||
'parāḥ kāryāḥ' uttare māsi kāryā ity arthaḥ | tatra prasavāhotsavaśabdena jāteṣṭir evāvagṛhyate na punar ābhyudayikaṃ śrāddhaṃ jātakarma ca, tayor api grahaṇe “śrāddhajātakanāmānītyādismṛtivirodhāpatteḥ [55] paitṛkagrahaṇam āvaśyakaviṣayaṃ, na tu kevalasāṃvatsarikaviṣayaṃ amāvāsyādiśrāddhasyāpi malamāse vidhānāt |
matsyapurāṇe |
candrasūryagrahe caiva maraṇe putrajanmani |
malamāse ’pi deyaṃ syād dattam akṣayakārakaṃ ||
kvacic chrāddham akṣayam iti pāṭhaḥ |
śātātapasmṛtau |
pratisāṃvatsare śrāddhe nādhimāsaṃ vivarjayet |
paiṭhīnasiḥ |
malamāse ’pi kartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ yat prativatsaram |
sāṃvatsaraṃ na vardheta śrāddhaṃ tatra mṛtāhani ||
jātakarmaṇi yac chrāddhaṃ darśaśrāddhaṃ tathaiva ca |
pratisaṃvatsaraṃ yac ca pūrvabhāge prakīrtitaṃ ||
'pūrvabhāge' adhimāse |
māsas trayodaśo yatra tatra śrāddhaṃ kathaṃ bhavet |
pūrvaparāvadhau tatra kathaṃ kuryād vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
yasmin rāśau gate sūrye vipattiḥ syād dvijanmanaḥ |
tadrāśāv eva kartavyaṃ pitṛkāryaṃ mṛtāhanīti ||
etāni malamāsamṛtaviṣayāṇi |
yad āha paiṭhīnasiḥ |
malamāse mṛtānāṃ tu śrāddhaṃ yat prativatsaraṃ |
malamāse ’pi kartavyaṃ nānyeṣāṃ tu kadācaneti ||
[56]        bhṛgur api |
malamāse mṛtānāṃ tu yac chrāddhaṃ prativasaram |
malamāse tu kartavyaṃ nānyeṣāṃ tu kadācaneti ||
vyāsaḥ |
malimluce tu saṃprāpte brāhmaṇo mriyate yadi |
ūnābhidheyo māso nu kathaṃ kuryād athābdikam ||
yasmin rāśau gate sūrye vipattiḥ syād dvijanmanaḥ |
tasminn eva prakurvīta piṇḍadānodakakriyāḥ ||
adhimāse mṛtānāṃ tu sauraṃ mānaṃ samāśrayet |
sa eva tasya māso ’pi śrāddhapiṇḍakriyādiṣu ||
smṛtyantare tūttarārdham anyathā paṭhyate,
sa eva divasas tasya śrāddhapiṇḍodakādiṣu |
anye tu |
māsapakṣatithispṛṣṭe yo yasmin mriyate ’hani |
pratyabdaṃ tu tathābhūte kṣayāhaṃ tasya taṃ viduḥ ||
ityādivacanaparyālocanayā śātātapādivacanāni malamāsamṛtaviṣayāṇīty āhuḥ | malamāsamṛtasya malamāsasaṃbhave sati malamāsaspṛṣṭa eva mṛtāhas tathābhūto na tu śuddhamāsaspṛṣṭa iti | malamāsagatakṣayāha evābdikaṃ śrāddhaṃ kartavyaṃ, na tu śuddhamāsagatakṣayāhe, atathābhūtatvāt malamāsasaṃbhave tadguṇalopanyāyān malamāsaspṛṣṭe ’pi kṣayāhe mṛtāhaśrāddhaṃ kartavyam ity avagantavyam | prathamābdikaṃ malamāse kāryam |
[57]        tathā ca vṛddhavaśiṣṭhaḥ |
asaṃkrānte ’pi kartavyam ābdikaṃ prathamaṃ dvijaiḥ |
tathaiva māsikaṃ śrāddhaṃ sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ tathā ||
kecid evaṃ vyācakṣate ābdikaṃ prathamaṃ nyūnābdikaṃ tadābdikaṃ mṛtāhāt pūrvadine kriyate māsikaṃ tu mṛtāhany eva, yadābdikasaṃjñaṃ kriyata iti pūrvam eva dvādaśāhādau sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ kṛtaṃ, yadā tu pūrṇe saṃvatsare tat kriyate tadā pṛthagābdikaṃ nāsti sapiṇḍīkaraṇenaiva tasyāpi siddhes tad uktam |
pūrṇe saṃvatsare piṇḍaḥ ṣoḍaśaḥ parikīrtitaḥ |
tenaiva ca sapiṇḍatvaṃ tenaivābdikam iṣyate ||
piṇḍaśabdena śrāddhaṃ pūrṇe saṃvatsare lakṣyate ‘ṣoḍaśaḥ piṇḍaḥ' ṣoḍaśaśrāddham ity arthaḥ | tad ayuktaṃ 'ābdikaṃ prathamam' ity anena nyūnābdikagrahaṇe māsikaśabdenābdikagrahaṇe pramāṇābhāvāt dvādaśamāsikasya ca dvādaśamāsopakrama eva kartavyatvāc ca | etac ca ṣoḍaśaśrāddhakālanirṇayaprastāve darśayiṣyate | yat tu satyavratenoktam,
varṣe varṣe ca yac chrāddhaṃ mātāpitror mṛte 'hani |
malamāse na kartavyaṃ vyāghrasya vacanaṃ yathā ||
tadadhimāsād anyatra mṛtasya prathamābdikānyaśrāddhaviṣayam | atra malamāsaśabdenādhimāso grāhyaḥ |
eka eva yadā māsaḥ saṃkrāntidvayasaṃyutaḥ |
māsadayagataṃ śrāddhaṃ malamāse ’pi śasyata iti ||
śuddhamāsamṛtasyāpi pratisaṃvatsaraśrāddhasya kṣayamāse vidhānāt | [58] evaṃ ca kṣayamāsāt pūrvabhāvyasaṃkrāntaśrāddhaṃ "prākṛtas tatra pūrvaḥ syād" iti śuddhatvāt pūrvāsaṃkrānte, "eka eva yadā māsa" iti vacanāt tatra kṣayamāse ca kāryaṃ, tena malamāsamṛtasya yadā maraṇamāso malamāso bhavati tadā pratisaṃvatsaraśrāddhaṃ malamāsa eva kāryaṃ na śuddhe nāpy ubhayoḥ, śuddhamāsamṛtasya tu yadā maraṇamāso malamāso bhavati tadā prathamābdikaṃ cen malamāse eva kāryaṃ na śuddhe nāpy ubhayoḥ, dvitīyābdikaṃ cet śuddhe eva kāryaṃ na malamāse nāpy ubhayoḥ |
tasmiṃs tu prākṛte māse kuryāc chrāddhaṃ yathoditam |
tathaivābhyudayaṃ sarvaṃ nityam ekaṃ hi sarvadā ||
'prākṛte' śuddhe, sarvaṃ śrāddhaṃ nityaṃ niyamenaikam eva kuryāt na dvitīyaṃ malamāse ’pīty arthaḥ | tathā
sāṃvatsaraṃ na vardheta śrāddhaṃ tatra mṛtāhani |
iti vacanād api na sāṃvatsarikam ubhayatrānuṣṭheyam |
atra kecid āhuḥ | malamāse sāṃvatsarikaṃ śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā tad uttaramāse punas tad evāvartanīyam | tathā ca yamaḥ |
ābdikaṃ prathamaṃ yat syān na kurvīta malimluce |
trayodaśe tu saṃprāpte kurvīta punar ābdikam ||
trayodaśe tu saṃpūrṇe sati caturdaśamāsapraveśadine punar apy ābdikaṃ kurvītety arthaḥ | 'sāṃvatsaraṃ na vardhatety asyāyam arthaḥ, 'na vardheta' na vicchidyeteti | tenaitad api māsadvaye śrāddham anuṣṭheyam iti pratipādayatīti | tad ayuktaṃ ubhayatra śrāddhānuṣṭhāne pramāṇābhāvāt | yamavacanasya tv ayam arthaḥ prathamābdikaṃ malimluce kurvīta, 'punar ābdikaṃ' dvitīyābdikaṃ, tat tu [59] trayodaśe māsi saṃpūrṇe sati caturdaśamāsapraveśadine kurvīteti, 'ābdikaṃ prathamam' iti 'sāṃvatsaraṃ na vardhateti' vacanadvayasyāsmadukto’rtho vacanāntarasaṃvādī tathā ca tanmūlabhūtayā śrutyopapatter na mūlāntarakalpanā, bhavaduktas tv artho na tatheti mūlabhūtasmṛtyantarakalpanāprasaṅgaḥ | kiṃ ca bhavatpakṣe tu 'trayodaśe tu samprāpte' ity atrābdikaśabdavaiyarthyaṃ prasajyate | trayodaśe tu saṃpūrṇe punaḥ kurvītety ukte ’pi prakṛtatvena prathamābdikasyānvayāt dvitīyādyābdikaviṣayatve tu nāyaṃ doṣaḥ | tena 'śrāddhīyāhani samprāpte' iti vaśiṣṭhavacanaṃ māsikaviṣayam iti jñeyam | kiṃ ca sāṃvatsarikaviṣayatve ’pi kiṃ malamāsamṛtasāṃvatsarikaviṣayaṃ amalamāsamṛtaprathamābdikaviṣayaṃ vā | na prathamaḥ, "tadrāśāv eva kartavyaṃ” "tasminne va prakurvīta" "sa eva tasya māso ’pi sa eva divasas tasyeti" prāgudāhṛtasādhāraṇabahuvākyavirodhāt | 'malamāse ’pi kartavyam' iti paiṭhīnasivacanagato 'pi śabdas tv evam apy upapadyate yadā śuddhas trayodaśo bhavati tadā tatra sāṃvatsarikaṃ kāryaṃ yadā malamāsas trayodaśo bhavati tadā tatrāpīti | yadā prāgudāhṛtabahuvacanavirodhād apiśabda evakārārthe bhaviṣyati ekasminn evāhani śrāddhadvayaprasaṅgāc ca | atha vā vacanāntaraparyālocanayaikaṃ malamāse aparaṃ tu śuddha ity ucyate tarhi tatparyālocanayaiva māsikaviṣayatā prasajyeta | nāpi dvitīyaḥ, uktād eva hetoḥ 'pratyabdaṃ dvādaśe māsīti' vakṣyamāṇāl laghuhārītavacanāc ca, athāsaṃkrānte ’pi kartavyam ity apiśabdād ubhayatrāpi kartavyaṃ śrāddham ity ucyate tarhi malamāse ekam ābdikaṃ kṛtvā punaḥ śuddhe kriyamāṇaṃ na prathamābdikaṃ syāt | yadā śuddhas trayodaśo bhavati tadā [60] tatra prathamābdikaṃ kāryam | yadā mṛtamāsaḥ asaṃkrāntatrayodaśo bhavati tadā tatrāpīty evam apiśabdopapatteś ca |
anye tu “ābdikaṃ prathamaṃ yasmān na kurvīta malimluce" iti pāṭham udāhṛtya malamāsamṛtaviṣayatvenaivaṃ vyācakṣate, malimlucamṛtasya yat prathamābdikaṃ tan malimluce na kurvīta tasya prathamābdikasamaye malimlucāsaṃbhavāt | tṛtīye hi varṣe pūrvasmān malamāsād anyo malamāso bhavati tasmān malamṛtasya prathamādikaṃ malamāse kadācid api na prāproti, ataḥ pūrvārdhaṃ nityānuvādaḥ | yadā gacchatā kālena yadi malamāsamṛtasya punar ābdike prāpte sa eva malamāso bhavati tadā tasminn eva malamṛtasya punar ābdikaṃ pratisaṃvatsaraṃ vihitaṃ śrāddhaṃ kurvītety arthaḥ |
malamāse 'pi kartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ yat prativatsaram |
sāṃvatsaraṃ na vardheta śrāddhaṃ tatra mṛtāhani ||
asyāpi pūrvārdhaṃ malimlucamṛtaviṣayaṃ, 'sāṃvatsaraṃ' prathamābdikaṃ, 'na vardheta' na vicchidyeta, śuddhe ’pi māse ity etāvān anuvādaḥ |
tad ayuktam, niṣprayojananityānuvādasyāyuktatvāt ślokavaiyarthyaprasaṅgāt | tasmāt “ābdikaṃ prathamaṃ yat syāt tat kurvīta milimluce" ity evaṃ bahugranthadṛṣṭaḥ pāṭho yuktaḥ | "malamāse na kartavyam" iti vacanasya cāsmdukta evārtho yuktaḥ, tasmān malamāsamṛtasāṃvatsarikaṃ malamāsasaṃbhave tatraiva kāryaṃ amalamāsamṛtasya prathamābdikaṃ ceti siddham | idaṃ tv iha vicāryate, kimantarādhimāsanipāte ’pi prathamābdikaṃ trayodaśe māsi kāryaṃ, uta yadā adhimāsas trayodaśo bhavati |
tatra kecid āhuḥ | antarā tv adhimāsanipāte trayodaśe māsi prathamābdikaṃ kāryam ity evaṃparatvenaitad vākyam iti |
[61]        yad āha hārītaḥ |
pratyabdaṃ dvādaśe māsi kāryā piṇḍakriyā sutaiḥ |
kvacit trayodaśe 'pi syād ādyaṃ muktvā tu vatsaram ||
'piṇḍakriyā' mṛtāhaśrāddhakriyā, dvādaśe māsi paripūrṇe sati trayodaśe māsīti yāvat kvacid adhimāsayuktasaṃvatsare trayodaśe māsi paripūrṇe sati caturdaśe māsīti yāvat ādyam ābdikaṃ tv adhikamāsavaty api saṃvatsare dvādaśe māsi paripūrṇe sati kāryaṃ trayodaśe māsi kāryam ity arthaḥ |
tad ayuktam, yadi hi kvacid ity asyādhimāsavati saṃvatsara ity arthaḥ syāt tadāntarādhimāse sati kārtikamṛtaprathamābdikasyāśvine māsi prāptau,
māsapakṣatithispṛṣṭe yo yasmin mriyate 'hani |
pratyabdaṃ tu tathābhūtaṃ kṣayāhaṃ tasya taṃ viduḥ ||
iti vyāsavacanaṃ bādhyeta | yadi tu kvacid ity asya trayodaśādhimāsa ity arthaḥ syāt tadā nāsya vākyasya saṃkocalakṣaṇo bādha ity ayam evārtho yuktaḥ | kiṃ ca "pratyabdaṃ dvādaśe māsi" ity asya vākyasyāsmaduktārthasvīkāre
saṃkrānte ’pi kartavyam ābdikaṃ prathamaṃ dvijaiḥ |
ity etanmūlatayaiva śrutyupapatter na mūlāntarakalpanā, bhavatpakṣe tu sāpy āpadyeta | evaṃ tāvat kvacic chabdenaitasyārthasya siddhatvāt, "pratyabdaṃ dvādaśe māsi" ity asya vākyasyāsmatpakṣe saṃkoco nāstīty uktam idānīm aṅgīkṛtyocyate, kārtikamṛtasyāntarādhimāse sati āśvine māsi śrāddhe kriyamāṇe "māsapakṣatithispṛṣṭe" iti vacanasaṃkocaḥ | adhimāse śuddhamāse ca māsikasya vidhānād adhimāsavati saṃvatsare trayodaśamāsikāni jātāni, tataś ca trayodaśamāsapraveśadine māsikaṃ sāṃvatsarikaṃ ca prāpnoti tac cāyuktam, [62] "naikaḥ śrāddhadvayaṃ kuryāt samāne ’hani kutracid iti vacanād asyānyaviṣayatve ca bhavatpakṣe vākyadvayasaṃkocaḥ, asmatpakṣe tu trayodaśapadasyādhimāsaviṣayatvena saṃkoca iti viśeṣaḥ | kiṃ ca śrāddhadvavaṃ yugapad anuṣṭhīyate krameṇa vā | na tāvad yugapat karmamadhye karmāntarānuṣṭhānaniṣedhād asyānyaviṣayatve ca bhavatpakṣe vākyatrayasaṃkocaḥ, asmatpakṣe ev ekadyeti sa eva yuktaḥ | dvitīye ’pi kim ādau māsikaṃ sāṃvatsarikaṃ vā na tāvanmāsikaṃ ekasya vihitakālabādhaprasaṅgāt | tasyānyaviṣayatve tu ukta eva parihāraḥ | nāpi sāṃvatsarikaṃ uktād eva hetoḥ | kiṃ ca māsikottarakālam ābdikavidhānāt tadbādho ’pi prasajyate | tasyānyaviṣayatve ca bhavatpakṣe vākyacatuṣṭayasaṃkocaḥ, asmatpakṣe tv ekasyeti mahān viśeṣaḥ |
nanu
saṃvatsaravivṛddhau ca yadi syād adhimāsakaḥ |
tadā dvādaśake māsi kāryaṃ taddhikaṃ bhavet ||
iti satyavratavacanena trayodaśamāsikaṃ dvādaśe māsi vihitaṃ ato nāyaṃ doṣaḥ iti cet,
ucyate
saṃvatsāravivṛddhau ca pratimāyaṃ ca māsikam |
ityādivacanena pratimāsaṃ māsikavidhānād vikalpaḥ, tataś ca trayodaśamāseṣu pratimāsaṃ māsikānuṣṭhānapakṣe prāgukto doṣa ity avadheyam | kiṃ ca "pratyabdaṃ dvādaśe māsk" ity atra dvādaśe māsi adhike ity ayam arthaḥ "māsapakṣatithispṛṣṭa iti vākyaparyālocanayā varṇanīyaḥ | tataś copajīvyābādhenāpy asya vākyasyopapattau nopajīvyabādhā yukteti | kiṃ ca
yasmin māse dine yasmin vipattir upajāyate |
parvāntaḥ sa tu vijñeyo māso naimittikaṃ prati |
iti jyotirgārgyādivacanasaṃkoco ’pi prasajyate | kiṃ cāsmatpakṣe malamāsakāryākāryanirūpaṇaprasaṅgasya prakṛtatvāt prakṛtasaṅgatam [63] idaṃ vākyaṃ bhavet, bhavatpakṣe tv adhimāsavati saṃvatsare ’pi māsāntaragatakāryanirūpaṇān na tathā saṅgatam ity aparo viśeṣaḥ | kiṃ ca caitre mṛtasya jyeṣṭhādāv adhimāse phālgune śrāddhaṃ syāt tatra pratisaṃvatsaram iti bādhyeta saṃvatsarabhedābhāvāt | dvitīye cābhāvāt pratisaṃvatsaram iti vyāptibādhaḥ |
anye tu pūrvoktadūṣaṇabhiyaivaṃ vyācakṣate na tu dvādaśamāsād arvāg api,
mṛte ’hani tu kartavyaṃ pratimāsaṃ tu vatsaram |
iti vidhānam asti tatrāhādyam iti dvitīyādisaṃvatsare tv ayaṃ niyama ity arthaḥ | evaṃ hi sarvaśāstrāvirodhaḥ | anyathāpy anyathāsiddhena mṛtāhaviśeṣeṇa māsabādhaprasaṅgād ādyaśabdaś ca dvitīyaparaḥ syād iti, tasmād yadādhimāsas trayodaśo bhavati tadaiva trayodaśe māsi prathamābdikaṃ na tv antarādhimāsanipāte ’pīti jñeyam |
anye tu,
ābdikaṃ prathamaṃ yat syān na kurvīta malimluce |
iti yamavacanapāṭham udāhṛtya antarā patite ’py adhimāse trayodaśe māsi prathamābdikaṃ kāryam ity evamparatvenaitad vākyaṃ vyācakṣate | antarā malimluce saty ābdikaṃ yat yatra kasmin māse pakṣatithispṛṣṭe mṛtāhani vidhānavaśāt syāt tatra punar ābdikaṃ dvitīyādyābdikaṃ kurvīta na prathamaṃ, prathamaṃ tu dvādaśe māsy atīte trayodaśe māsi samprāpte praveśadine kurvītety arthaḥ |
tad ayuktaṃ anekādhyāhārādidoṣaprasaṅgāt asya vākyasya vacanāntarād apratīter asminn arthe adhyāhārādyaṅgīkāreṇa tātparyakalpane pramāṇābhāvāc ca | tasmād asya vākyasa         ābdikaṃ prathamaṃ yat syāt tat kurvīta malimluce |
ity ayam eva bahugranthadṛṣṭaḥ pāṭho yuktaḥ, tasmād yadā malamāsas trayodaśo bhavati tadaiva trayodaśe māsi prathamābdikaṃ na tv antarādhimāsanipāte ’pīti siddham |
[64]        paiṭhīnasiḥ |
praśastāny adhimāse tu na kāryāṇi mahātmabhiḥ |
apraśastaṃ na kartavyam ātmanaḥ śreya icchatā ||
yady apy atra kāmyavratādīni malamāsamātre pratiṣidhyante tathāpy adhimāse teṣām ārambhasamāptau pratiṣidhyete | kṣayamāse tu prathamārambha eva, anyathā kārttikasya kṣayamāsāntaḥpāte prāpte prārambhānāṃ cāturmāsyavratānām asamāptiḥ prasajyeta pauṣasya ca kṣayamāsāntaḥpāte pūrvasmin pakṣe prārambhasya māghasnānavratasya punarārambhaḥ prasajyeta | kṣayamāsāt pūrvasminn uttarasmin vā māse tatsamāptau tadārambhe ca kārttike samāptividhānaṃ puṣye cārambhavidhānaṃ virudhyata | prārabdhakarmaṇaś cāsamāptāv anekavarṣasādhyasya ca māsavratasyārambhasyānyasmin varṣe punar ārambhasaṅkalpavirodhaḥ, "ārambhān niyamo doṣaś cāsamāptau syād" iti kātyāyanavacanavirodhaś ca | adhimāse tu śrāddhe śuddhamāsāntarasadbhāvād ārambhasamāptos tatropapatter adhimāse tayoḥ pratiṣedhe na kaścid virodhaḥ | prathamārambho ’pi kṣayamāse ’pi śuddhamāsāntarābhāvāt kasmān na syādi ti cet, na,
na kuryān malamāse tu mahādānavratāni ca |
iti vacanavirodhāt | asya prathamārambhavyatiriktasamāpyādiniṣedhaparatve saṃkalpādivirodhaś coktaḥ syāt kāmyavratādīnāṃ kṣayamāse prārambhaniṣedhaparatve saṃkalpādivirodhasyokatvāt kāmyavratādīnāṃ kṣayamāse prathamārambhaniṣedhaparatve virodhābhāvāc ceti |
nanv evaṃ sati yadā kārttiko ’dhimāso bhavati tadā kārttikavratānāṃ śuddhāśvina evārambhāc chuddhakārttike ca saṃprāpte māsopavāsavratasyāpi māsadvayam anuṣṭhānaṃ prāpnoti tac cāśakyam |
ucyate | yadi hi māsopavāsavratasyāśvine prārambhavidhānaṃ śuddhakārttike ca samāptividhānaṃ syāt syād evaṃ na tv evam asti, kiṃ tv asyāśvinaśukladvādaśyām ārambham abhidhāyoparitanaśukladvādasyāṃ samāptir viṣṇurahasye ’bhihitā |
āśvinasyāmale pakṣe ekādaśyām upoṣitaḥ |
vratam etat tu gṛhṇīyāt yāvat triṃśaddināni tu ||
anyūnādhikam evaṃ tu vrataṃ triṃśaddinair idam |
kṛtvā māsopavāsaṃ tu saṃyatātmā jitendriyaḥ ||
tato ’rcayeta vai puṇyaṃ dvādaśyāṃ garuḍadhvajam |
pūjayet puṣpamālābhir gandhapuṣpavilepanaiḥ ||
vastradānādibhiś caiva bhojayeta dvijottamān |
dadyāc ca dakṣiṇāntebhyaḥ praṇipatya samāpayet || iti |
tataḥ śuddhāśvinaśukladvādaśyām etad vratam ārabhyoparitanaśukladvādaśyāṃ samāpanīyaṃ na māsadvayam anuṣṭheyaṃ māsopavāsavratasya ca kāmyatvāt kāmyasya ca malamāsāt prāgārabdhasya malamāse ’pi samāptividhānān na kaścid doṣaḥ |
nanu kṣayamāsamṛtānām utpannānāṃ ca dvitīyāś cābdikaṃ varddhāpanaṃ ca kasmin māse kāryam ity apekṣāyāṃ tannirṇayārthaṃ kṣayamāsāntargatamāsadvayavivekam āha |
tithyardhe prathame pūrvo dvitīye ’rddhe taduttaraḥ |
māsāv iti budhaiś cintyau kṣayamāsasya madhyagau ||
prathame tithyarddhe pūrvo māsaḥ dvitīye tithyarddhe taduttaro māsa ity eva kṣayamāsasya madhyagatau māsau budhaiś cintanīyāv ity arthaḥ | ataḥ prathame [66] tithyarddhe mṛtasyābdikaṃ tatrotpannasya ca vardhāpanaṃ ca pūrve māsi kāryaṃ dvitīye tithyardhe mṛtasyābdikaṃ tatrotpannasya vardhāpanam uttare māsi kāryam iti vivekaḥ |
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevīyasakalaśrīkaraṇādhīśvara-
sakalavidyāviśāradaśrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau
pariśeṣakhaṇḍe kālanirṇaye malamāsanirṇayaḥ samāptaḥ |
[67]
atha tṛtīyo ’dhyāyaḥ |
atha sāmānyataḥ sarvatithinirṇayaḥ |
tithiś ca dviḥprakārā saṃpūrṇā khaṇḍā ca | tatra saṃpūrṇā skandapurāṇe darśitā |
pratipatprabhṛtayaḥ sarvā udadyād udayād raveḥ |
sampūrṇā iti vikhyātā harivāsaravarjitāḥ ||
harivāsarasya saṃpūrṇatvam ekādaśīnirṇaye vakṣyate | asaṃpūrṇā dinadvayasaṃbandhinī khaṇḍā, tasyāṃ dinadvayasaṃbandhinyāṃ satyāṃ vratādyanuṣṭhāne pūrvā parā vopādeyeti saṃdehe nirṇayaḥ kriyate | tatra nigamaḥ |
yugmāgniyugabhūtānaṃ ṣaṇmunyor vasurandhrayoḥ |
rudreṇa dvādaśī yuktā caturdaśyā tu pūrṇimā ||
pratipady apy amāvāsyā tithyor yugmaṃ mahāphalam |
etadvyastaṃ mahādoṣaṃ hanti puṇyaṃ purākṛtam || iti |
‘yugmaṃ' dvitīyā, ‘agniḥ’ tṛtīyā, 'yugaṃ' caturthī, bhūtaṃ' pañcamī, 'ṣaṭ' ṣaṣṭhī, 'muniḥ' saptamī, 'vasuḥ' aṣṭamī, 'randhraṃ' navamī, 'rudraḥ' ekādaśī, tithyor yugmam ity abhidhānāt dvitīyādipratipadantāsu tithiṣu krameṇa dvayor dvayos tithyoḥ parasparam eva yugmaṃ mahāphalaṃ na punar vyastaṃ tithyantarayugmam ity arthaḥ, anenoktayugmasaptake pūrvā tithir uttaraviddhā kāryā uttarā tu pūrvaviddhety uktaṃ bhavati |
[68]        bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
dvādaśīkalpe tu “yugmāsu kṛtarāmāsv" iti paṭhyate, 'kṛtaṃ' caturthī, 'rāmaḥ' tṛtīyā, tatraiva "yugmāni kṛtapuṇyāni" iti pāṭhāntaraṃ, tathā 'kṛtabhūtāni' iti ca |
atra kecid āhuḥ | śukrapratipadamāvāsyāyutā grāhyā "pratipady apy amāvāsyeti" vacanāt | yat tu "pratipat sadvitīyā syād dvitīyā pratipadyutety" āpastamba-bhaviyatpurāṇadvādaśīkalpayor vacanaṃ tat kṛṣṇapratipadviṣayaṃ “pratipady apy amāvāsyā tithyor yugmaṃ mahāphalam iti śuklapratipadaḥ pūrvayutāyā eva pratipādanāt |
apare tv āhuḥ | atra pratipadamāvāsyā yutā grāhyā “pratipady apy amāvāsyeti" vacanāt,
pañcamī saptamī caiva daśamī ca trayodaśī |
pratipannavamī caiva kartavyā saṃmukhā tithiḥ ||
iti paiṭhīnasivacanāc ca |
atra kecit saṃmukhā sāyāhnavyāpinīti vyācakṣate “saṃmukhā nāma sāyāhnavyāpinī dṛśyate yadīti" skandapurāṇavacanāt |
tad ayuktaṃ vakṣyamāṇavacanavirodhāt skandapurāṇavacanasyānyaviṣayatvopapatteś ca | tasmād atra saṃmukhā pūrvaviddhā vivakṣitā sāpi cāparāhṇavyāpiny eva “pratipat saṃmukhā kāryā yā bhaved āparāhṇikīti" skandapurāṇavacanāt | anyā śuklā kṛṣṇā vā dvitīyāyutaiva grāhyā pratipat sadvitīyā syād dvitīyā pratipadyutety āpastambavacanāt, na tu śuklapratipatpūrvā grāhyety uktam | tatraivācaṃ viśeṣaḥ kasmān na bhavati
pratipatsaṃmukhā kāryā yā bhaved āparāhṇikī |
[69]        pratipat sadvitīyā syād |
