iti tu kṛṣṇapakṣaviṣayam eva | tatra ca nāparāhṇikatvaniyamaḥ, paiṭhīnasivacanam api śuklapratipadviṣayam ity ucyate | evaṃ sati "pañcamo saptamo ceti," "pratipatsaṃmukhā kāryeti" vacanadvayasya kevalaśuklapratipadviṣayatvena saṃkocaḥ prasajyeta | "pratipat sadvitīyā syād" iti vākyasaṃkocas tu pakṣadvaye ’py aviśiṣṭaḥ bhavatā yugmāgnivākyaviṣayaparityāgāśravaṇāt asmābhiḥ "pratipatsaṃmukhā kāryeti vākyaviṣayaparityāgāśrayaṇāt |
nanu "pañcamī saptamī caiva" iti vacanasaṃkoco na doṣāya sāmānyaśāstrasya viśeṣaśāstreṇopasaṃhārasya yuktatvāt saṃkocabhayād anupasaṃhāre sarvatropasaṃhārocchedāpatteḥ |
satyam evaṃ "pratipatsaṃmukhā kāryā" iti vacanasaṃkoce tāvat kāraṇaṃ na vidyate tenaitad ubhayatrāpi pravartate, evaṃ ca "pañcamī saptamī caiveti" vākyasaṃkoco ’py asmatpakṣe na bhaviṣyati, "pratipatsaṃmukhā kāryetivacanasaṃkocaḥ so ’py āpadyata iti nāsya saṃkoco yukta ity ucyate |
nanu kṛṣṇapratipadaḥ pūrvaviddhatvam aprāptaṃ ataś ca sā pūrvaviddhā grāhyā sā cāparāhṇikīty arthadvayavidhānāt gauravaṃ syāt, śuklapratipadas tu pūrvaviddhatvaṃ prāptam iti tadviṣayatvena gauravam iti cet, ucyate, āparāhṇikī tāvat pratipatsvarūpato vidyate tataś ca sāparāhṇikī pratipatsaṇmukhā kāryeti vidhīyata iti na gauravaṃ, ataś cobhayapatipadviṣayam idaṃ tenāparāhṇikī pratipat pūrvaviddhā anyā tūttaraviddheti vyavasthā siddhā |
tad etad ayuktaṃ pratipadaḥ saṃmukhāyāḥ kartum aśakyatvāt | tataś ca saṃmukhāyāṃ pratipadi karma kāryaṃ tathāparāhṇavyāpinyām iti vidhāne gauravaṃ śuklapratipadviṣayatve tu nāyaṃ doṣaḥ | evaṃ ca "pañcamī saptamī caiveti" vākyasaṃkoco ’pi balād āpatito na doṣāya tasmāt śuklapratipat [70] pūrvā grāhyā yathāparāhṇikī kṛṣṇā pratipat sarvottaraiveti vyavasthā | tena yat kaiścid uktaṃ "pratipat sadvitīyā syād" iti vacanaṃ tilakāśokakaravīravrataviṣayaṃ teṣāṃ pūrvāhṇa eva vidhānād iti tan nirastaṃ karmāntarasyāpi pūrvāhṇa eva vidhānāt kevalatadviṣayatvena saṃkoce kāraṇābhāvāc ca | atha pūrvāhṇavihitasakalakarmaviṣayam ucyate, tad ayukam,
yasmin kāle tu yat karma tat kālavyāpinī tithiḥ |
iti sāmānyavacanenaivārthasya siddhatvāt | kiṃ caivaṃ sati "pratipat saṃmukhā kāryeti" vacanam aparāhṇavihitakarmaviṣayaṃ prasajyeta | tataś cāsyāpi vaiyarthyaṃ syāt sāmānyavacanenaiva siddheḥ | kiṃ caivaṃ pūrvaviddhaparaviddhagrahaṇapratipādaka-sarvavākyavaiyarthyaṃ prasajyeta | prātisvikapūrvāhṇādividhāyakavākyebhyaḥ pradarśitasāmānyavacanāc cāsyārthasya siddhatvāt dinadvaye ’pi karmakālavyāpitithyabhāve pūrvaviddhaparaviddhagrahaṇapratipādakavākyapravṛtter vakṣyamāṇatvāc ca tasmād asmaduktaiva vyavasthā yuktā |
apare tv evam āhuḥ |
ekādaśī tathā ṣaṣṭhī amāvāsyā caturthikā |
upoṣyāḥ parasaṃyuktāḥ parāḥ pūrveṇa saṃyutāḥ ||
iti vacanāt pratipadaḥ pūrvaviddhatvam upavāsaviṣayaṃ "pratipat sadvitīyā syād" iti tu tadvyātiriktaviṣayam iti |
nanv evaṃ sati "pratipady apy amāvāsyeti," "pañcamī caiveti," “pratipatsaṃmukhā kāryeti" vacanasaṃkocaḥ prasajyeta asmatpakṣe tu "pratipat sadvitīyā syād" ity asyaiva saṃkoca iti viśeṣo vidyate, ataḥ katham iyaṃ viṣayavyavatheti cet, ucyate, bahuvākyasaṃkoco’pi svīkriyate sāmānyaśāstrasya viśeṣaśāstreṇopasaṃhārasya yuktatvāt | na cātra saṃkoco ’pi vidyate, yugmādivacanena hi pratipadaḥ [71] pūrvaviddhatvam abhihitaṃ "pratipat sadvitīyā syād" ity anena pratipadaḥ paraviddhatvaṃ evaṃ virodhe sati karmaviśeṣānupādānāt, kasyātra karmaṇo grahaṇam ity apekṣāyām upavāse pratipadaḥ pūrvaviddhatvābhidhānāt, yugmavākye sa eva gṛhyate "pratipat sadvitīyā syād" iti vacane tūpavāsavyatiriktakarmagrahaṇam iti kutaḥ saṃkocaḥ |
tad ayuktaṃ "pratipat sadvitīyā syāt dvitīyā pratipadyutety atrottarapāde pratipatditīye kṛṣṇe eveti vakṣyate | tena pūrvapāde ’pi te eva prakṛte grāhye |
dvitīyā pañcamī caiva daśamī ca trayodaśī |
caturdaśī copavāse hanyuḥ pūrvāpare tithī ||
iti vacanena pratipanmātrasya pūrvaviddhasyopoṣyatvābhidhānād yugmavākyasyopavāsaviṣayatve kevalaśuklapratipadaḥ pūrvaviddhatvābhidhānam anupapannaṃ syāt | atha tad api śuklapratipadviṣayaṃ, tarhi "dvitīyā pañcamībedhād" ity atra dvitīyātṛtīye api śukle eva grāhye tena śuklatṛtīyā parayutopoṣyety arthaḥ syāt, tataś ca |
rambhākhyāṃ varjayitvā tu tṛtīyāṃ dvijasattama |
anyeṣu sarvakāryeṣu gaṇayuktā praśasyate ||
iti vacanena rambhākhyavratavyatiriktasarvakāryeṣu tṛtīyāmātrasya parayutatvavidhānaṃ na syāt pūrvaviddhapratipatpratipādakabahuvākyebhyaḥ sāmānyataḥ pūrvaviddhatvaṃ pratīyamānaṃ "dvitīyā pañcamībedhād" iti vacane dvitīyādiśabdānāṃ sādhāraṇatvaṃ pratīyamānaṃ vinā kāraṇena bādhitaṃ syād iti tasmād asmaduktaiva vyavasthā yuktā, dvitīyāṃ kecid āhuḥ śukladvitīyā parānvitā "yugmāgnīti" vacanāt, asya ca śuklapakṣaviṣayatvaṃ [72] pakṣānte caturdaśīpūrṇimāyugmena sāhacaryād avagantavyam | yat tu brahmavaivartavacanaṃ "dvitīyā pratipadyuteti" tat kṛṣṇadvitīyāviṣayam | anye tv āhuḥ | śukladvitīyā parayutā grāhyā kṛṣṇadvitīyā pūrvā,
śuklapakṣe tithir grāhyā yasyām abhyudito raviḥ |
kṛṣṇapakṣe tithir grāhyā yasyām astamito raviḥ ||
iti mārkaṇḍeyavacanāt | yatra hy ekaikatithir ekena vacanena pūrvaviddhā grāhyety |
ucyate apareṇāparayuteti tatrānena vākyena vyavasthā kriyate evaṃ saty apekṣitārthapratipādanaṃ bhavati na tu śuklakṛṣṇavyavasthayā vyavasthitacaturdaśyāditithiviṣayatvam | yat tu keṣāṃcid vyākhyānaṃ yugādiviṣayam etad vacanam,
dve śukle dve tathā kṛṣṇe yugādī kavayo viduḥ |
śukle pūrvāhṇikagrāhye kṛṣṇe caivāparāhṇike ||
iti vacanād iti tad api nirastam | uktaprakāreṇākāṅkṣitasamarpaṇenārthavatve saṃbhavati kevalayugādiviṣayatvena saṃkoce kāraṇābhāvāt | yat tu vyākhyānaṃ śuklapakṣaśabdena devakāryam upalakṣyate tasya prāyeṇa śuklapakṣe vihitatvāt kṛṣṇapakṣaśabdena ca pitṛkāryaṃ tasya prāyeṇa kṛṣṇapakṣe vidhānāt |
devakārye tithir jñeyā yasyām abhyudito raviḥ |
pitṛkārye tithir jñeyā yasyām astamito raviḥ ||
iti vṛddhayājñavalkyavacanāt |
pūrvaviddhā pitṛbhyas tu tṛptidā kīrtitā tithiḥ |
na śastā vibudhebhyas tu muktvaikāṃ bhāskarapriyām ||
[73]        vacanāc ca, tad apy ayuktaṃ vinā kāraṇaṃ lakṣaṇāprasaṅgāt | vākyāntarasyāpy artho ’nenaiva yathāśrutopapadyamānena pratipādyata iti vacanaṃ prāmāṇikaṃ, tasmāt kṛṣṇadvitīyā pūrvāhṇavyāpinī śukladvitīyā tūttareti vyavastheti |
apare ev evam āhuḥ | dvitīyā tu sarvā tṛtīyāyutā grāhyā "yugmāgnīti" vacanāt |
yat tu brahmavaivarte |
pratipatsaṃmukhā kāryā dvitīyā dijasattameti |
āpastambena "dvitīyā pratipadyuteti," tat pūrvadinapūrvāhṇavyāpinīdvitīyāviṣayam |
tathā ca skandapurāṇe |
pratipatsaṃmukhā kāryā yā bhaved āparāhṇikī |
pūrvāhṇiko ca kartavyā dvitīyā tādṛśī vibho ||
'tādṛśī' saṃmukhā pūrvaviddhety arthaḥ | nanu kṛṣṇadvitīyā pūrvā grāhyā, tatraivāyaṃ viśeṣaḥ "pūrvāhṇikī ca kartavyeti" | śukladvitīyā tūttaraiva na tatra pūrvāhṇikatvaniyama iti vyavasthā kiṃ na syāt | ucyate evaṃ sati "pūrvāhṇikī ca kartavyeti" vākyasaṃkocaḥ prasajyeta, “pratipatsaṃmukhā kāryā dvitīyeti," "dvitīyā pratipadyuteti" vacanadvayasaṃkocas tu pakṣadvaye ’py aviśiṣṭaḥ, bhavatā "yugmāgnīty" asya śukladvitīyāviṣayatvam aṅgīkṛtya tadviṣayatvaparityāgāśravaṇāt | asmābhis tu "pūrvāhṇikī kartavyety" etadviṣayaparityāgāśravaṇāt | svarūpataś ca pūrvāhṇikī dvitīyā vidyate tasyāḥ pūrvaviddhatvaṃ vidhīyata iti pūrvavad gauravaparihāraḥ "śuklapakṣe tithir jñeyeti" tu vacanaṃ sākāṅkṣatithyantaraviṣayam | tasmāt pūrvāhṇikī dvitīyā pūrvaviddhā [74] anyā tūttaraviddheti vyavasthā, tad etad ayuktaṃ pūrvavad eva gauravasya parihartum aśakyatvāt tasmāt kṛṣṇadvitīyā pūrvā grāhyā yadi pūrvāhṇikī, śukladvitīyā tu sarvāpy uttareti vyavasthā | etena yat kaiścid uktaṃ dvitīyāyāḥ pratipadyuktatvaṃ tat yamadvitīyāviṣayaṃ tasyāṃ hi bhaginībhir bhrātaro bhojyante, naikabhaktāyācitanaktaviṣayaṃ, teṣāṃ svakālavyāpinyāṃ nivatatvāt | nāpy upavāsaviṣayaṃ tasyāpi paraviddhāyām eva vihitatvād iti tan nirastham | pūrvāhṇikyā dvitīyāyāḥ pūrvaviddhāyā upādeyatvam uktaṃ tac caikabhaktādicatuṣṭayavyatiriktakarmāntaraviṣayam apy upapadyata iti yamadvitīyāviṣayatvena niṣprāmāṇikasaṃkocāśrayaṇasyāyuktatvāt | tasmād asmaduktaiva vyavasthiteti |
anye tv evaṃ vyavasthām āhuḥ
ekādaśy aṣṭamī ṣaṣṭhī dvitīyā ca catudaśī |
amāvāsyā tṛtīyā ca upoṣyāḥ syuḥ parānvitāḥ ||
iti viṣṇudharmottara-śivagītāvacanaṃ "yugmāgnīti" vacanam upavāsaviṣayaṃ, “dvitīyā pratipadyutetyādi pūrvaviddhadvitīyāpratipādakam upavāsavyatiriktaviṣayam | tatra cāyaṃ viśeṣaḥ "pūrvāhṇikī ca kartavyeti," pūrvavyavasthāyāṃ tu "pratipatsaṃmukhā kāryā" "dvitīyā pratipadyuteti vacanadvayasyopavāsayatiriktakarmaviṣayatvena śuklapakṣe ’py upapadyamānasya kāraṇaṃ vinā saṃkocaḥ prasajyeta |
nanu yugmāgnivākyasyopavāsavyatiriktaviṣavatvenāpi śuklapakṣa evopapadyamānasya bhavanmate ’pi saṃkocaḥ prasajyeta |
ucyate | etadvākyasaṃkocas tu tvatpakṣe 'pi vidyate kṛṣṇadvitīyopavāsaviṣayatvenāpy upapadyamānasyāsya kevalaśukladvitīyāviṣayatāśravaṇāt |
nanu pakṣadvaye saṃkocāviśeṣe ’pi bhavatpakṣe śukladvitīyopavāsavyatiriktabahu-karmatyāgād asmatpakṣe tu kṛṣṇadvitīyopavāsamātratyāgāt bahvalpakṛto [75] viśeṣo vidyate |
satyam evaṃ, kiṃ tu bhavatpakṣe pradarśitavākyadvayasaṃkocaḥ, asmatpakṣe tu yugmāgnivākyasyaiveti viśeṣaḥ | kiṃ cātra saṃkoco ’pi na vidyate | tathā hi "yugmāgnivākyena dvitīyā paraviddhā grāhyety uktaṃ, "dvitīyā pratipadyutetyādinā ca pūrvaviddhatvam | na cātra karmaviśeṣa upāttaḥ, ataś cātra kasya karmaṇo grahaṇam ity apekṣāyām upavāse dvitīyāyāḥ paraviddhatvābhidhānāc ca | evaṃ yugmavākye gṛhyate "dvitīyā pratipadyutetyādivacanair upavāsavyatiriktakarmagrahaṇam iti kutaḥ saṃkoca iti tad ayukaṃ pratipadyutāyā api dvitīyāyā upoṣyatvasyopavāsatithinirṇaye darśitatvāt | tasmāt pūrvoktaiva vyavasthā svīkāryeti | tṛtīyā tu dvitīyāyutā grāhyā "yugmāgnītivacanāt sāpi ca rambhātṛtīyaiva |
tathā ca brahmavaivarte |
rambhākhyāṃ varjayitvā tu tṛtīyāṃ dvijasattama |
anyeṣu sarvakāryeṣu gaṇayuktā praśasyate ||
'gaṇaḥ' caturthī |
skandapurāṇe |
dvitīyayā tu yā viddhā tṛtīyā na kadācana |
kartavyā vratibhis tāta dharmakāmārthatatparaiḥ ||
vihāyaikāṃ tu rambhākhyāṃ tṛtīyāṃ puṇyavardhanīm |
tathā ca ṛṣibhiḥ proktaṃ vacanaṃ kṛttikāsuta ||
bṛhattapā tathā rambhā sāvitrī vaṭapaitṛkī |
kṛṇāṣṭamī ca bhūtā ca kartavyā ṣaṃmukhā tithiḥ ||
tathā |
[76]        kṛṣṇāṣṭamī tathā rambhā tṛtīyā baṭapaitṛkī |
bṛhattapā tathā brahman kartavyā saṃmukhā tithiḥ |
nānyeṣu saṃmukhā kāryā tṛtīyā cāṣṭamī dvija ||
anyā sarvā tṛtīyā ca caturthīyutaiva |
tathā ca brahmavaivarte |
caturthīsaṃyutā yā ca sā tṛtīyā phalapradā ||
āpastambaḥ |
caturthīsaṃmukhā vā ca sā tṛtīyā phalapradā |
avaidhavyakarī strīṇāṃ putrapautrapradāyinī ||
brahmavaivarte |
tṛtīyā tu na kartavyā dvitīyopahatā vibho |
dvitīyayā yutāṃ tāṃ tu yaḥ karoti narādhamaḥ |
saṃvatsarakṛteneha maro dharmeṇa mucyate ||
tathā |
dvitīyāśeṣasaṃyuktāṃ tṛtīyāṃ kurute nṛpa |
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ kālasūtraṃ bhavyaṃkaram ||
dvitīyāṃ śeṣasaṃyuktāṃ yā karoti vimohitā |
yā vaidhavyam avāpnoti pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ ||
skandapurāṇe |
tṛtīyā tu na kartavyā dvitīyāsaṃyutā tithiḥ |
yā karoti vimūḍhā strī puruṣo vā śikhidhvaja ||
[77]        dvitīyāsaṃyutāṃ tāta pūrvadharmā vilupyate |
vidhavātvaṃ durbhagatvaṃ bhaven naivātra saṃśayaḥ ||
kalākāṣṭhāpi yā caiva dvitīyā saṃpradṛśyate |
sā tṛtīyā na kartavyā kartavyā gaṇasaṃyutā |
ya icchet paramaṃ guhyaṃ vratakartā śikhidhvaja ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe dvādaśīkaṣpe |
kāryā dvitīyayā sārdhaṃ na tṛtīyā kadācana ||
nanu dvitīyāyutaṭṛtīyāyāḥ vidhiḥ śukatṛtīyāviṣayaḥ niṣedhas tu kṛṣṇatṛtīyāviṣaya iti vyavasthā kiṃ na sthāt | na ca vācyaṃ, evaṃ sati rambhāvākyānarthakyaṃ prasajyate sarveṣām api vratānāṃ tatra prāpteḥ pūrvaviddhatṛtīyāvākyasya kṛṣṇapace bādhaḥ dvitīyāviddhaniṣedhavākyasya śuklapakṣe ity aparaṃ dūṣaṇadayam iti | upavāse tu tṛtīyāyāḥ parayutāyāḥ śuklapakṣe ’pi grahaṇāt tadapavādakatayā rakbhāvākyasyārthavatvopapatteḥ | na cāpavāde ’py utsargasya bādhād asty eva dūṣaṇam iti vaktavyaṃ, yato bhavatpakṣe ’pi sarvavrataviṣayatayā caturthīyutātṛtīyāgrahaṇe prāpte tadapavādakarambhāvākyam |
ucyate | bhavatpakṣe vacanadvayagatapākṣikabādha ekasminn api vacane vidyata eva tathā hi "yugmāgniyugabhūtānām" iti vākyaṃ śuklakṛṣṇapakṣasādhāraṇaṃ sat kevalaśuklapakṣaviṣayaṃ, tatrāpi vratamātrasādhāraṇaṃ sad rambhaikavrataviṣayam ucyate iti tulyo bādhaḥ | kiṃ cātra "amāvāsyā tṛtīyā ca tā upoṣyāḥ parānvitā" ity upavāsapadm avivakṣitaṃ syāt vratāntare ’pi caturthīviddhatṛtīyāgrahaṇe, tasmād dvitīyāyutatṛtrīyāvidhiniṣedhau śuklakṛṣṇadvitīyāviṣayāv iti tad etad apeśalam | evaṃ hi sati [78] dvitīyāyutatṛtīyāniṣedhaprāgudāhṛtabahuvākyasaṃkocaḥ prasajyeta, “caturthīsaṃyutā ca" ity āpastamba-brahmavaivartavacanasya “kartavyā gaṇasaṃyuteti" skandapurāṇavacanasya saṃkocaḥ prasajyeta | asmatpakṣe tu na tathā saṃkocaḥ rambhātrataparityāgena dvitīyāviddhatṛtīyāniṣedhānāṃ caturthīyutatṛtīyāvidhīnāṃ ca śuklapakṣe ’pi pravṛtter āśrayaṇāt | "anyeṣu sarvakāryesu" iti "vihāyaikāṃ tu rambhāṃ vā" iti vacanabādho ’pi bhavatpakṣe prasajyeta | asmatpakṣe tu yugāgnīty asyaiva rambhāvrataviṣayatvena saṃkoca iti mahān viśeṣaḥ | "amāvāsyā tṛtīyā ca" iti vacanaṃ tithiviśeṣāṇām upavāse paraviddhatvapratipādakaṃ na tu kāryāntare paraviddhatvaniṣedhakam | etenaitan nirastaṃ dvitīyāniṣedhāc caturthīyutatṛtīyāvidhayaś copavāsaviṣayāḥ "amāvāsyā tṛtīyā ca tā upoṣyāḥ parānvitā" iti vacanāt dvitīyāviddhatṛtīyāvidhis tu tadvyatirikraviṣaya iti, "anyeṣu sarvakāryeṣu gaṇayuktā praśasyate" ityādivacanenopavāsavyatiriktakārye ’pi paraviddhatvābhidhānāt |
nanu yugmavākyasya rambhātṛtīyāviṣayatve vairūpyaṃ prasajyeta śukladvitīyāntarasyāpi tṛtīyāyuktatvāṅgīkārāt tadartham agniśabdena tṛtīyāntarasyāpi grāhyatvāt anyathā rambhāratīyāyā eva paraviddhatvaṃ prasajyeta |
tad ayukaṃ atra karmaviśeṣānupādānāc chuklatṛtīyā rambhāvrate pūrvaviddhāpi grāhyā śukladvitīyā tu sarvasminn api kārye parayutety asminn ārthe vacanāntaraparyālocanayā svīkriyamāṇe doṣābhāvāt | tasmād asmaduktaiva vyavasthā yuktā | caturthī tu pañcamīyutā grāhyā "yugabhūtānām" iti vacanāt |
yad bhaviṣyatpurāṇa-brahmavaivartayor vacanam |
[79]        caturthīsaṃyutā kāryā tṛtīyā ca caturthikā |
tṛtrīyayā yutā naiva pañcamyā kārayet kvacit ||
tathā skandapurāṇe |

caturthyās tṛtīyāyuktatvavacanaṃ, tad vināyakavrataviṣayam |

atra ca gaṇanāthaṃ sutarāṃ toṣayatīti gaṇanāthasutoṣiṇīti caturthīviśeṣaṇasāmarthyād vināyakavrataviṣayatvaṃ pratīyate |
anye tu sutarāṃ śabdaparyālocanayā varacaturthīviṣayatvam āhus tatra bhādrapadaśuklacaturthyaṅgārakacaturthyādīnām api sutarāṃ toṣakatvād bhavatpakṣe codāhṛtatṛtīyāyutacaturthīvidhidvayasya pañcamīyutacaturthīniṣedhasya ca caturthīmātraviṣayatvena bādhe gauravam | asmatpakṣe tu yugabhūtānām ity asyaiva saṃkoca iti viśeṣaḥ |
somadattas tv āha | bhaktiśraddhātiśayavaśena sarvā api sutarāṃ toṣikāḥ tadrāhitye tu na varacaturthyākhyā māṣaśuklacaturthy apīti sarvavināyakacaturthīviṣayataiva yukteti, tasmāt tṛtīyāyutacaturthī sutoṣiṇī na pañcamīyutety arthaḥ |
anye tv evam āhuḥ | śuklacaturthī parayutā, kṛṣṇacaturthī pūvayutā “śuklapakṣe tithir jñeyā ity udāhṛtavacanād iti |

jayā ca yadi sampūrṇā caturthī hrasate punaḥ |
sā jayā caiva kartavyā nāgaviddhāṃ na kārayet ||

padmapurāṇa-bhavivyatpurāṇa-dvādaśīkalpayoḥ |

iti vacanenaivopavāse pañcamyāś caturthīyuktatvasyābhidhānāt | kiṃ ca pūrvavyavasthāyāṃ “pañcamī tu prakartavyā" iti vākyasyopavāsavyatiriktaviṣayatvena kṛṣṇapakṣe ’py upapadyamānasya kāraṇaṃ vinā saṃkocaḥ prasajyeta | na ca yugmādivākyānām upavāvaviṣayatvena saṃkoco doṣāya, sāmānyaśāstrasya viśeṣaśāstreṇopasaṃhārasya yuktatvāt | bhavanmate ’pi kevalakṛṣṇapakṣaviṣayatvena saṃkocasyāviśiṣṭatvāt | na caivaṃvidhe viṣaye saṃkoco vidyate ity uktaṃ prāk |

nigamaḥ |

navamyā yaha kāryā syād aṣṭamī nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
etac ca śuklāṣṭamīviṣayam |
tathā ca nigamaḥ |
śuklapakṣe ’ṣṭamī caiva śuklapakṣe caturdaśī |
pūrvaviddhā na kartavyā kartavyā parasaṃyutā |

tathā ca padmapurāṇe |

navamī tv aṣṭamīyutaiva grāhyā | tathā ca yugmavākye “vasurandhrayor" iti |

skandapuraṇa-bhaviṣyatpurāṇa-dvādaśīkalpayoḥ |

tathā ca nigamavākyam |
ṣaṣṭyaṣṭamī tv amāvāsyā kṛṣṇapakṣe trayodaśī |
etāḥ parayutāḥ pūjyāḥ parāḥ pūrvayutās tathā ||
yadā tu nottaredyuḥ kṛṣṇatrayodaśī kiṃ tu pūrvedyur niṣiddhatithividdhaiva tatrāha vṛddhavaśiṣṭaḥ, “ekādaśī tṛtīyā ceti", tena śuklatrayodaśy api pūrvedyuḥ saṃbhavantī na pūrvā grāhyeti | anye tūbhayatrayodaśīviṣayam etad vākyam ity āhuḥ | tad ubhayam apy ayuktaṃ yadi trayodaśī paredyuḥ saṃbhavetāṃ tadā na pūrvayute grāhye | tathā nigamavākye “kṛṣṇapakṣe trayodaśī” atra kṛṣṇapakṣa iti viśeṣaṇavaiyarthyaṃ prasajyeta | kiṃ ca kṛṣṇatrayodaśīviṣayam idam uta śuklatrayodaśīviṣayam iti saṃdehe kṛṣṇatrayodaśyāḥ parayutāyāḥ grahaṇābhidhānāt śukla[86]trayodaśyāś ca pūrvayutāyā grahaṇād ekādaśyādīnāṃ tu paraviddhānām upādānāt tatsāhacaryāt trayodaśīgrahaṇam api paraviddhaviṣayaṃ satkṛṣṇatrayodaśīviṣayaṃ jñāyate | tasmāt pūrvoktaiva vyavasthā jyāyasī |

āsu kriyāṃ na kurvīta pūrvaviddhāsu mānava iti ||

'maheśvaraḥ' aṣṭamī |

iti vacanāt |

ucyate |

dvitīyādiṣu yugmānāṃ pūjyatā niyamādiṣu |
ekoddiṣṭādivṛddhyādau hrāsavṛddhyādicodanā ||
niyamādiṣv ity ādiśabdena pitṛkarmavyatiriktavratopavāsādisakalakarmaṇāṃ grahaṇaṃ, ekoddiṣṭādīty ādiśabdena vivāhādimaṅgalāṅgabhūtaśrāddhavyatiriktaśrāddhasya, vṛddhyādāv ity ādiśabdena māṅgalikaśrāddhasya | evaṃ ca pitṛkārye hrāsavṛddhyādicodanetyuktaṃ bhavati |
asyāpavādaḥ skānde |
yasmin kāle tu yat karma tatkālavyāpinī tithiḥ |
yo yasya vihitaḥ kālas tatkālavyāpinī tithiḥ ||
vṛddhayājñavalkyaḥ |
karmaṇo yasya yaḥ kālas tatkālavyāpinī tithiḥ |
tathā karmāṇi kurvīta hrāsavṛddhī na kāraṇam ||
pūrvāhṇikās tu tithayo devakārye phalapradāḥ |
aparāhṇikās tathā jñeyāḥ pitrarthe tu śubhāvahāḥ ||
[92]        ityetan nigama-brahmavaivartavacanam api "karmayo yasya yaḥ kāla"
ity anena samānaviṣayam |
nanu yadā ayugmadine karmakālavyāpinī yugmadine tu viparītā tadā kā grāhyā |
atra kecid āhuḥ | yugma tithir eva grāhyā tithyor yugmaṃ mahāphalam ity abhidhānāt,
etadvyastaṃ mahādoṣaṃ hanti puṇyaṃ purākṛtam |
iti yugmātikrame doṣaśravaṇāc ca ghaṭikādiparimitāyā api sampūrṇatvābhidhānāc ca | udāhṛtakarmakālavyāptiśāstrasya yugmavākyaviṣayaparihāreṇaivopapatteś ca śiṣṭācārānugaṇyāc ca yugmādara eva yuktaḥ |
tad ayukaṃ, yady api karmakālavyāptiśāstraṃ yugmavākyaviṣayaparihāreṇāpy upapadyate yugmavākyaṃ ca karmakālavyāptiśāstraviṣayaparityāgena, tathāpi yugmavākyasyaiva karmakālavyāptiśāstraviṣayaparityāgo yuktaḥ anyathā prātisvikapratipadādividhīnām api bādhaprasaṅgāt | keṣucid vrateṣūtpattivākya eva pratipadāditithiśrutes tadbādho ’py utpannaśiṣṭaguṇāvarodhena prasajyeta, saṃpūrṇatvābhidhānenāropitakarmakālīnatithigrahaṇasya mukhyakarmakālīnatithisaṃbhave anyāyyāśrayaṇāc ca | śiṣṭācāraś cātra niyato na vidyate ubhayathā ācaraṇāt | kiṃ ca yadā bhādrapadaśuklaṣaṣṭhī dinamātraparyāptā dvitīyadine ca saptamī trimuhūrtonā (?) tadā amuktābharaṇasaptamī dvitīyaiva "ahaḥsu tithayaḥ puṇyā" iti vakṣyamāṇavacanāt bhavatpakṣe dūrvāṣṭamīvratam api tatraiva kāryaṃ asyāḥ pūrvaviddhāyā abhidhānāt | tataś ca virodhaḥ prasajyeta amuktābharaṇasaptamyām agnipakvaviśeṣasyaiva bhojyatābhidhānāt dūrvāṣṭamyāṃ cāgnipakvabhojanāvidhānāt | tataś ca [93] svīkṛtobhayavratānāṃ virodhaḥ syāt | asmatpakṣe tu nāyaṃ doṣaḥ karmakālavyāptiśāstraparyālocanayā dvitīye ’hni dūrvāṣṭamīvratacaraṇād (?) daive karmaṇi pūrvāhṇavidhānāt | evam anyāsv api tithiṣu virodha udbhāvanīyaḥ | tasmāt prātisvikapratipadādyavasthitapūrvāhṇādikālasya karmaṇām āvaśyakatvād yugmānādareṇa karmakālavyāpinī tithir grāhyeti | tathā caivaṃ vyavasthā yadā dinadvaye ’pi niyamādikarmakālavyāpinyās tither asambhavaḥ sambhavo vā tadviṣayaṃ yugmādivākyaṃ ekoddiṣṭādikarmakālavyāpinyās (?) titheḥ sambhave asaṃbhave vā hrāsavṛddhyādivākyam | yadā tv ekasmin dine vratādyekoddiṣṭādikarmakālavyāpinī tithiḥ parasmin nāsti tadā "karmaṇo yasya yaḥ kāla" ityādivacanāt karmakālavyāpinī tithir grāhyeti |
śuklapakṣe tithir grāhyā yasyām abhyudito raviḥ |
kṛṣṇapakṣe tithir grāhyā yasyām astamito raviḥ ||
iti mārkaṇḍeyavacanam api |
yatraikaiva tithir ekena vacanena pūrvā grāhyety ucyate apareṇāparayuteti tatra virodhe sati vyavasthāpakaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ | tathā ca tatra darśitaṃ vyākhyānāntaraṃ ca pūrvam eva nirākṛtam |
yat tu viṣṇudharmottaravacanam,
vardhamānendupakṣasya udaye pūjyate tithiḥ |
yadā candraḥ kṣayaṃ yāti tadā syād āparāhṇikīti ||
kṛṣṇapakṣe tithir jñeyā yasyām astamito raviḥ |
tayā karmāṇi kurvīta hrāsavṛddhī na kārayam || iti |
[94]        tad ubhayam api pūrvavad vyākhyeyam |
yat tu baudhāyanavacanam,
yā tithis tac ca nakṣatraṃ yasyām abhyudito raviḥ |
vardhamānasya pakṣasya hānau tv astamayaṃ (?) prati ||
yac ca vṛddhavaśiṣṭhasya |
vardhamānasya pakṣasya udaye pūjyate tithiḥ |
yadā pakṣaḥ kṣayaṃ yāti tadā syād āparāhṇikī ||
tat sarvaṃ darpavacanena samānaviṣayam |
anye tu "śuklapakṣe tithir jñeyā" iti vacanasamānaviṣayam iti vadanti |
tad ayuktaṃ, candrakṣayavṛddhyoḥ pakṣe upacāraprasaṅgāt |
yat tu vyākhyānaṃ yadā pakṣo vardhate ṣoḍaśadinātmako bhavati yadā pakṣaḥ kṣīyate caturdaśadinātmako bhavati tadā pūrvaiveti |
tad apy ayuktaṃ, ubhayathā vākyasyopapattau vacanāntarasaṃvādiny arthe tātparyakalpanāyuktatvād evaṃ mūlabhūtaśrutyantarakalpanāpi na bhaviṣyati, bhavatpakṣe ’pi sā syāt | tasmāt pūrvaiva vyākhyā yuktā |
anye tv evaṃ vyavasthām āhuḥ, pratipadādiviśeṣeṇa pūrvāhṇādiviśeṣeṇa ca vihite dharme pūrvāhṇādivyāpinī tithir grāhyā “karmaṇo yasya yaḥ kāla" ityādivacanāt | nanu kāladvayavidhivākyābhyām eva prāpto ’yam arthaḥ |
satyaṃ, kiṃ tu hrāsavṛddhyādivākyair bādhitaḥ | ata evokaṃ "hrāsavṛddhī na kāraṇam" iti, kutra tarhi te kāraṇam iti | ucyate, yadā dve tithī tatkālasthe bhavatas tadā tithikṣaye pūrvā grāhyā vṛddhau parā yājñā "kharvodarpas tathā hiṃsā" itivacanāt | tithisāmye tu śuklapakṣe parā kṛṣṇapakṣe [95] pūrvā "śuklapakṣe tithir" iti mārkaṇḍeyavacanāt |
nanu trayāṇām aviśeṣeṇa bādhe prāpte kimiti kharva eva bādhyate |
atra brūmaḥ, prathamapratītatvād bādhalāghavāt “hrāsavṛddhī na kāraṇam" iti hrāsavṛddhyoḥ sarvatithiviṣayatvānuvādāc ca | kas tarhi kharvasyāvakāśaḥ, amāvāsyā |
tathā ca pracetāḥ |
tithikṣaye sinīvālī tithivṛddhau kuhūr matā |
sāmye ’pi ca kuhūr jñeyā vedavedāṅgavedibhiḥ ||
yadā tu dve api tithī tatkālasthe na bhavatas tadā yugmavākyaparyālocanayā nirṇaya iti, tad ayukaṃ, "dvitīyādiṣu yugmānām" iti vyāsa-nigamavacanavirodhāt "śuklapakṣe tithir jñeyā" iti vacanāsya cāsmaduktaprakāreṇopapatteḥ sarvabādhakatve pramāṇābhāvāc ca, kharvadarpakṣayeṣv ekavakyenopatteṣu kṣayadarpau sarvatithiviṣayau, sarvas tv amāvāsyāviṣaya iti vaiṣamyāśrayaṇasyoktaprakāreṇa vākyasyopapattau anucittatvāt | tasmāt pūrvaiva vyavasthā jyāyasī | yadā tv ekasmin dine alpakarmakālaṃ spṛśati tithir anyasmin dine nālpam api tadā "karmaṇo yasya yaḥ kāla" ityanena karmakālasaṃbandhiny eva grāhyā | yadā tu dinadvaye ’py alpakarmakālasaṃbandhinī tadā hrāsavṛddhivākyair yugmādivākyaiś ca yathāyathaṃ pūrvā parā yā grāhyā |
ekasmiṃś ca pakṣadvaye saṃpūrṇakarmakālavyāpivihitatithisaṃsparśamātreṇāpy anuṣṭhitaṃ karma saguṇaṃ bhavatīti darśayitum āha devalaḥ |
yāṃ tithiṃ samanuprāpya udayaṃ yāti bhāskaraḥ |
yā tithiḥ sakalā jñeyā snānadānajapādiṣu ||
[96]        paṇḍitaparitoṣe tu "snānadānavratādiṣv iti paṭhitaṃ, viṣṇudhamottare "snānadānādikarmasv" iti pāṭhaḥ |
vyāsaḥ |
udayann eva savitā yāṃ tithiṃ pratipadyate |
sā tithiḥ sakalā jñeyā dānādhyayanakarmasu ||
devalaḥ |
yāṃ tithiṃ samanuprāpya astaṃ yāti divākaraḥ |
sā tithiḥ sakalā jñeyā dānādhyayanakarmasu ||
paṇḍitaparitoṣe tu "snānadānādikarmasu" iti paṭhitam |
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe ’pi |
vratopavāsaniyame ghaṭikaikā yadā bhavet |
yā tithiḥ sakalā jñeyā pitrarthe cāparāhṇikī |
viṣṇudharmottare |
yā tithis tad ahorātraṃ yasyām astamito raviḥ |
tathā karmāṇi kurvīta hrāsavṛddhī na kāraṇam |
padmapurāṇe ’pi |
vrate snāne tathā nakte pitṛkārye viśeṣataḥ |
yasyām astaṃ gato bhānuḥ yā tithiḥ puṇyabhāg bhavet ||
vratopavāsaniyame ghaṭikaikā yadā bhavet |
udaye sā tithis tatra viparītā tu paitṛke ||
'viparītā' astamayasaṃbandhinī |
viṣṇudharmottare |
[97]        vratopavāsasnānādau ghaṭikaikā yadā bhavet |
udaye sā tithir grāhyā śrāddhādāv astagāminī ||
vyāsaḥ |
vratopavāsasnānādau ghaṭikaikā yadā bhavet |
tām eva tithim āśritya kuryāt karmasv atadritaḥ ||
baudhāyano ’pi |
ādityodayavelāyāṃ yā stokāpi tithir bhavet |
pūrṇā sā tv avagantavyā prabhūtā nodayaṃ vinā ||
atrāstamayakālīnatitheḥ saṃpūrṇatvābhidhānaṃ pūrvaviddhopādeyatithiviṣayaṃ, udayakālīnatithisaṃpūrṇatvābhidhānaṃ ca paraviddhopādeyatithiviṣayam iti jñeyam |
atrāpi viśeṣaḥ skānde ’pi |
yāṃ tithiṃ samanuprāpya yāty astaṃ padminīpatiḥ |
sā tithis taddine proktā trimuhūrtāpi yā bhavet ||
śivarahasya-saurapurāṇayoḥ |
yāṃ prāpyāstam upaity arkaḥ sā cet syāt trimuhūrtikā |
dharmakṛtyeṣu sarveṣu sampūrṇāṃ tāṃ vidur budhāḥ ||
kṣaye pūrvā tu kartavyā vṛddhau kāryā sadottarā |
tithes tasyās trikṣaṇāyāḥ kṣayavṛddhī tv akāraṇam ||
'trikṣaṇāyāḥ' trimuhūrtāyāḥ | skandapurāṇe tu "tasyās tu trimuhūrtāyā" iti tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ paṭhitaḥ |
[98]        vṛddhavaśiṣṭhaḥ |
yasyāṃ tithāv astam iyāt sūryas tu trimuhūrtake |
yāgadānajapādibhyas tām evopakramet tithim ||
asyāpavādam āha vaśiṣṭhaḥ |
trimuhūrtā na kartavyā yā tithiḥ kṣayagāminī |
trimuhūrtāpi kartavyā yā tithir vṛddhigāminī ||
atra trimuhūrtatithigrahaṇaparityāge vṛddhihrāsayoḥ kāraṇatvaṃ vaśiṣṭhavacanenoktaṃ śivarahasya-saurapurāṇavacanena ca pratiṣiddhaṃ tatraivaṃ vyavasthā pitṛkārye vṛddhihrāsayoḥ kāraṇatvaṃ na niyamādiṣu, "dvitīyādiṣu yugmānām" iti vyāsa-nigamavacanāt | viṣṇudharmottare baudhāyanaprokte ca |
udite daivataṃ bhānau pitryaṃ cātamite ravau |
dvimuhūrtaṃ trirahnaś ca tithir havyakavyayoḥ || iti ||
asyārthaḥ | bhānāv udite saty uttarakāle ahno muhūrtadvayaṃ 'daivataṃ' devadaivatyaṃ, tasmiṃś cāstamite tatpūrvakālīnam ahno muhūrtatrayaṃ 'pitryaṃ' pitṛdaivatyaṃ, atas tāvatkālavyāpinī yā tithir bhavati saiva kramāt havyakavyayor grāhyeti |
atra kecid āhuḥ | dvimuhūrtam ity anukalpaḥ,
trimuhūrtā na kartavyā yā tithiḥ kṣayagāminī |
dvimuhūrtā na kartayā yā tithir vṛddhigāminī |
iti dakṣavacanāt |
[99]        etac codayasaṃbandhitithiviṣayaṃ astamayasaṃbandhinyās trimuhūrtāyā eva grāhyatvābhidhānāt, anukalpayaś cāvaśyakakarmārthaḥ, yadā tu yugmadine 'stamayasaṃbandhinī ayugmadine tu udayāstamayasaṃbandhinī tatrobhayasaṃbandhinyoḥ prāśasthyāt saiva grāhyā yugmadinasaṃbandhinyāḥ kriyānarhāyāḥ asatkalpatvāt | yadā tu yugmadine astamayāt prāk na dṛṣyate ayumadine ’stamayāt prāg eva samāpyate tatroktaṃ jābāli-vṛddhagautamābhyāṃ |
ahaḥsu tithayaḥ puṇyāḥ karmānuṣṭhānato divā |
naktādivratayogeṣu rātriyogo viśiṣyate ||
ahorātrasādhyaṃ vratam ubhayayoginyām eva kāryaṃ na tu yugmatvāt tatrādaraḥ |
tathā ca vṛddhayājñavalkyaprokta-padmapurāṇayoḥ |
divārātrau vrataṃ yac ca ekam ekatithau gatam |
tasyām ubhayayoginyām ācaret tadvrataṃ vratī ||
nanv evaṃ sati ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyādiyugme saptamīvratasaṃkalpaḥ kadā, na tāvat saptamyādikāle,“prātaḥ saṃkalpayed vidvān upavāsavratādikam" iti tasya prātaḥkālavidhānāt | na ca prātaḥ,
śuklapakṣe ravidine pravṛtte cottarāyaṇe |
punnāmadheyanakṣatre gṛhṇīyāt saptamīvratam ||
ityādivacanaiḥ saptamyādikāle saṃkalpaśravaṇāt | na cāyugmadine, yugmapuṇyatvābhidhānāt tadatikrame doṣaśravaṇāc ca |
atra kecid āhuḥ | yugmadine eva prātaḥ saṃkalpaḥ karaṇīyaḥ yugmapuṇyatvābhidhānāt pūrvāparayor api tithyoḥ sākalyavidhāyakavacanānām agre darśayiṣyamāṇatvāt [100] svīyasvīyakāryakaraṇārhatvātiriktasākalyābhāvāt tena ṣaṣṭhyādikāle saptamyādikāryam ity avagamyate | na ca prātaḥ saṃkalpagrahaṇam iti niyamaḥ, bhīmadvādaśyādivrateṣu sāyaṃ tadupadeśāt, tasmād yugmatithāv eva saṃkalpaḥ sa ca prātar eva, na ca saptamyāditithikāla iti jñeyam |
apare tv evam āhuḥ | yadā ekasmin dine karmopakramakālasambandhinī tithir naparasmin dine tadā karmopakramakālasaṃbandhiny eva grāhyā |
tathā ca baudhāyanaḥ |
yo yasya vihitaḥ kālaḥ karmaṇas tadupakrame |
vidyamāno bhaved aṅgaṃ nojjhitopakrameṇa tu ||
iti yugmapuṇyatvābhidhānaṃ sākalyābhidhānaṃ ca baudhāyanādivacanaviṣayaparityāgenāpy upapadyate |
anye tv āhuḥ | yadaikasmin dine karmopakramakālasaṃbandhinī aparasmin dine ca karmasamāptikālasambandhinī tadiṣayam eva baudhāyanādivacanam iti | evaṃ yugmādivākyais trimuhūrtāyā lābhe ayugmatithiyogino vedhayogadoṣād agrāhyety arthād uktam | doṣaś ca nāradīyapurāṇe darśitaḥ |
dānavā ūcuḥ |
asmākaṃ vasatir brahman kasmin sthāne bhaviṣyati |
nirādhārāḥ sthitāḥ sarve kva nu bhokṣyāma bhojanaṃ ||
brahmovāca |
dvitīyānte sthitir hy ekā nāgānte tu dvitīyakā |
aṣṭamyādau tṛtīyā tu daśamyante caturthikā ||
[101]        pratipadāditaḥ kṛtvā pañcamī bhavatāṃ sthitiḥ |
ṣaṣṭhī trayodaśīprānte ādau kṛtvā caturdaśīm ||
eṣo ’pi bhavatāṃ vāsaḥ sudṛḍhaḥ parikīrtitaḥ |
evaṃ prokrās tu tithayaḥ pradattā brahmaṇā purā ||
teṣāṃ saṃmiśritā dattāḥ pitṛbhyas tās tathaiva hi |
śeṣo hi vividhaḥ kālaḥ kīrtitaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ ||
saptamyādau mahīpāla pūrṇādau śreyasaḥ sthitaḥ |
viparīto ’surebhyas tu pradatto brahmaṇā purā || iti |
vedhayogau brahmavaivarte darśitau |
kīdṛśas tu bhaved yogo vedho viprendra kīdṛśaḥ |
yogavedhau samācakṣva yābhyāṃ duṣṭam upoṣaṇam ||
iti pṛṣṭe |
yā tithiḥ spṛśate rājan prātar vaktāvalokinī |
sā vedha iti vijñeyo yogaḥ sūryodayo mataḥ ||
iti kathitaṃ |
yat tu brahmavaivarte,
vyāsa uvāca |
catasro ghaṭikā bhūpa aruṇodayaniścayaḥ |
catuṣṭayavibhāgo ’tra vedhādīnāṃ kiloditaḥ ||
aruṇodaṣavedhaḥ syāt sārddhaṃ tu ghaṭikātrayaṃ |
ativedho dvighaṭikaḥ prabhāsaṃ darśanād raveḥ ||
mahāvedho ’pi tatraiva dṛṣyate ’rko na dṛśyate |
turīyas tatra vihito yogaḥ sūryodaye budhaiḥ ||
[102]        tat prakaraṇād ekādaśīvrataviṣayam |
yat tu,
nāgo dvādaśanāḍībhir dikpañcadaśabhis tathā |
bhūto ’ṣṭādaśanāḍībhir dūṣayaty uttarāṃ tithim || iti |
tad dinadvaye ’pi karmakālavyāpitithisaṃbhave draṣṭavyaṃ, upavāsaviṣayatā tu na yuktā,
aviddhāni niṣiddhaiś cen na labhyante dināni tu |
muhūrtaiḥ pañcabhir viddhā grāhyaivaikādaśī tithiḥ ||
tadarddhaviddhāny anyāni dināny upavasen naraḥ |
aviddhānām alābhe tu payodadhiphalāni vā |
sakṛd evālpam aśnīyād upavāsas tv asau bhavet ||
iti ṛṣyaśṛṅgavacanāt |
upavāse ca ghaṭikāmātravedho ’pi "dūṣayaty uttarāṃ tithim" iti vacanāntarasiddhaḥ | na caitan naktaikabhaktāyācitaviṣayaṃ, teṣāṃ pradoṣadinavyāpinyāṃ tithau niyamena kartavyatābhidhānāt dvitīye ’hani ca tadasaṃbhavāt tallopaḥ prasajyeta |
yat tu ṣaṭtriṃśanmatavacanaṃ,
ghaṭikārdhaṃ tribhāgaṃ vā svalpaṃ vā dūṣayet tithim |
pañcagavyaghaṭe pūrṇe surāyā binduko yathā ||
iti, tad uktād eva hetor upavāsaviṣayam |
etena yat kaiścid uktaṃ " 'ghaṭikārdhaṃ tribhāgaṃ veti' vacanaṃ vedanindārthavādatayā avadheyaṃ anyathā 'nāgo dvādaśanāḍībhir' ity anarthakaṃ syād" iti, tan nirastam | uktaprakāreṇa vākyopapatau lakṣaṇayā arthavādatvakalpanāyā anyāyyatvāt |
anye tv evam āhuḥ | ekādaśī tāvad dindvaye ’pi karmakālavyāpitve [103] kṣaye pūrvā prāptā ṣaṣṭhīpūrṇime tu yugmavākyair api tatra sāhacaryād ekādaśīprāptir eva tatra niṣidhyata iti,         tad ayuktaṃ dinadvaye ’pi karmakālavyāpitve ’pi yugmādivākyapravṛtter uktatvāt yugmavākyakṣayavṛddhisāmyavākyakarmakālavyāptivākyaviṣayavyavasthāyās taduktāyānirākṛtatvāc ca tasmād dinadvaye ’pi karmakālavyāpitithisaṃbhave idaṃ draṣṭavyam |
anye tu dinadvaye ’pi karmakālavyāptyabhāva idaṃ vacanam ity āhuḥ |
anye tūbhayaviṣayam aṅgīkurvanti |
tasmād yāsāṃ tithīnāṃ kevalānāṃ puṇyatvaṃ tāsām eva vedhavyavasthā yāsāṃ tithīnāṃ vāranakṣatrayogena puṇyatvaṃ tāmāṃ vedhadoṣo na bhavati, tatra vedhadoṣe ’ṅgīkriyamāṇe dvitīye ’hani vārādiyuktatither abhāvāt karmaiva lupyeta |
uktaṃ ca caturthīṃ prakṛtya brahmavaivarte |
aṅgārakayutā yā tu sā tathaiva phalapradā | iti |
'tathaiva' yugmaguṇanirapekṣavārādiguṇena |
liṅgapurāṇe |
daśamy ekādaśī yatra sā nopoṣyā bhavet tithiḥ |
śravaṇena ca saṃyuktā sā śubhā sarvakāmadā ||
gobhilaḥ |
yā tithir ṛkṣasaṃyutā yā ca yogena nārada |
muhūrtadvayamātrāpi sāpi sarvā praśasyate ||
sarvāpi duṣṭayugmasthāpīti prāpte na kevalaṃ tithiviṣaya eva vedhadoṣaḥ tasmān niṣiddhatithividdhā parityājyā anyā tūdayasaṃbandhinyasta[104]mayasambandhinau vā "sā tithiḥ sakalā jñeyā" iti vacanād upādeyeti siddham |
asyāpavādam āha nāradīyapurāṇe vaśiṣṭhaḥ |
pāraṇe maraṇe nṝṇāṃ tithis tātkāliko smṛtā |
pitrye ’stamayavelāyāḥ spṛṣṭā pūrṇā nigadyate || iti |
pāraṇe maraṇe vā tātkāliky eva tithir na punaḥ sā tithiḥ sakalā jñeyety etad bhavatīty arthaḥ |
skandapurāṇe |
abhyaṅge codadhisnāne dantadhāvanamaithune |
jāte ca nidhane caiva tatkālavyāpinī tithiḥ ||
manvādau ca yugādau ca grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ |
vyatīpāte ca vaidhṛtyāṃ tatkālavyāpinī kriyā ||
manvādau yā snānadānaśrāddhādikā kriyā sā manvādikālavyāpinī kāryā na kālāntara ity arthaḥ | evaṃ yugādau cetyādi vyākhyeyaṃ,
naktavrate ca samprāpte tatkālavyāpinī tithiḥ || iti |
tasya naktavratasya yaḥ kālaḥ pradoṣākhyaḥ tadvyāpinī tithir grāhyety arthaḥ |
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevīyasakalaśrīkaraṇādhīśvarasakalavidyāviśārada-śrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau pariśeṣakhaḍe kālanirṇaye tithisāmānyanirṇayaḥ samāptaḥ |
[105]
caturtho ’dhyāyaḥ |
atha vrataviśeṣeṇa tithiviśeṣanirṇayaḥ |
atha brahmavaivarte |
kṛṣṇāṣṭamī tathā rambhātṛtīyā vaṭapaitṛkī |
bṛhattapā tathā brahman kartavyā saṃmukhā tithiḥ ||
nānyeṣu saṃmukhā kāryā tṛtīyā cāṣṭamī dvija |
ṣaṣṭhī caikādaśī brahmann ity evaṃ śāstranirṇayaḥ ||
'saṃmukhā' pūrvaviddhā, 'kṛṣṇāṣṭamī' kṛṣṇāṣṭamīvratasaṃbandhiny aṣṭamī |
kecit tu kṛṣṇāṣṭamī janmāṣṭamīti vyācakṣate, asyāpi pūrvadina eva rohiṇīyuktāyāḥ pūrvaviddhāyāḥ upoṣyatvāt | 'rambhātṛtīyā' rambhāvratasaṃbandhinī tṛtīyā | 'bṛhattapā' bṛhatapavratasaṃbandhinī tithiḥ, tac ca vrataṃ śivarahasye pratipāditam |
bharataṃ prati utaṅka uvāca |
śṛṇuṣvaikaṃ mahārāja bṛhattapa iti vratam |
kṛtena yena viśvātmā śivaḥ śīghraṃ prasīdati |
bṛhattapovratam idaṃ brahmahatyādiśoṣaṇam ||
ityādinā |
kecid etad vratam apaśyanto bṛhattalpam iti pāṭham utprekṣyāśūnyaśayanaṃ dvitīyāvratārthatvena vyācakṣate |
tat kvacid api śrutismṛtītihāsapurāṇatannibandhanādiṣv adṛśyamānatvān na pramāṇapadavīm upāroḍhum arhati |
saṃvartaḥ |
[106]        kṛṣṇāṣṭamī bṛhattapā sāvitrī vaṭapaitṛkī |
anaṅgatrayodaśī rambhā kartavyā pūrvasaṃyutā ||
'anaṅgatrayodaśī' kāmavratasaṃbandhinī trayodaśī |
bṛhattapā tathā rambhā sāvitrī vaṭapaitṛkī |
kṛṣṇāṣṭamī ca bhūtā ca kartavyā saṃmukhā tithiḥ ||
brahmavaivarte |
caturthī tu tṛtīyāyāṃ mahāpuṇyaphalapradā |
kartavyā vratibhir vatsa gaṇanāthasutoṣiṇī ||
'caturthī' vināyakavratasaṃbandhinī caturthī |
paiṭhīnasiḥ |
kṛṣṇāṣṭamī skandaṣaṣthī śivarātriś caturdaśī |
etāḥ pūrvayutāḥ kāryās tithyante pāraṇaṃ bhavet ||
'skandaṣaṣṭhī' skandavratasambandhinī ṣaṣṭhī |
skandapurāṇe |
janmāṣṭamī rohiṇī ca śivarātris tathaiva ca |
pūrvaviddhaiva kartavyā tithibhānte ca pāraṇam ||
vṛddhayamaḥ |
śrāvaṇī durganavamī dūrvā caiva hutāśanī |
pūrvaviddhā tu kartavyā śivarātrir baler dinam ||
'śrāvaṇī' śrāvaṇapūrṇimā | 'durganavamī' durgavratādisaṃbandhinī navamī | 'dūrvā' durvāṣṭamī | 'hutāśanī' holikā pūrṇimā, vahnivratasaṃbandhinī tithiś ca, 'baler dinaṃ' balipratipat |
[107]        padmapurāṇe |
śrāvaṇī durganavamī tathā durvāṣṭamī ca yā |
pūrvaviddhā tu kartavyā śivarātrir baler dinaṃ ||
skandapurāṇe prabhāsakhaṇḍe |
aśvayukśuklapakṣe yā aṣṭamī mūlasaṃyutā |
yā mahānavamī proktā trailokye tu sudurlabhā ||
kanyāgate savitari śuklapakṣe ’ṣṭamīyutā |
mūlanakṣatrasaṃyuktā sā mahānavamī smṛtā ||
aṣṭamyāṃ ca navamyāṃ ca jaganmātaram ambikām |
pūjayitvāśvine māsi viśoko jāyate hi saḥ ||
dūrvāṣṭamī ca siṃhasthe sūrye bhādrapadaśuklāṣṭamī bhavati | yadi cāṣṭamyāḥ pūrvam agastir udeti tadā prāg bahule pakṣe kāryā |
tathā ca laugākṣiḥ |
udyānikā śivapavitrakameghapūjā
dūrvāṣṭamī phalavirūḍhakajāgarāpi |
strīṇāṃ vratāni nikhilāny api vārṣikāṇi
kuryād agatsya udite na śubhāni lipsuḥ ||
iti vrataviśeṣeṇa tithiviśeṣanirṇayaḥ |
athaikabhaktatithikālanirṇayaḥ |
tatraikabhaktalakṣaṇaṃ skandapurāṇe |
[108]        dinārdhasamaye ’tīte bhujyate niyamena yat |
ekabhaktam iti proktam atas tat syād divaiva hi ||
devalaḥ |
dinārdhasamaye ’tīte bhujyate niyamena yat |
ekabhaktam iti proktam ūnaṃ grāsatrayeṇa tu ||
tac ca madhyāhnavyāpinyāṃ kāryam |
tathā ca padmapurāṇe |
madhyāhnavyāpinī grāhyā ekabhakte sadā tithiḥ |
baudhāyanaḥ |
udaye tūpavāsasya naktasyāstamaye tithiḥ |
madhyāhnavyāpinī grāhyā ekabhaktavrate tithiḥ ||
atra ca tridhā vibhaktasyāhno madhyamo bhāgo madhyāhnaḥ | nanu caturdhā vibhaktasyāhno dvitīyabhāge ’pi madhyāhnaśabdaḥ prayuktaḥ,
pūrvāhnaḥ praharaṃ sārddhaṃ madhyāhnaḥ praharaṃ tathā |
ā tṛtīyād aparāhṇaḥ sāyāhnaś ca tataḥ param ||
iti gobhilavacanāt | tathā pañcadhā vibhaktasya tṛtīyabhāge ’pi |
lekhāprabhūtāv āditye trimuhūrte gate ravau |
prātas tu sa smṛtaḥ kālo bhāgaś cāhnas tu madhyamaḥ ||
saṅgavas trimuhūrtas tu madhyāhnas tatsamaḥ smṛtaḥ |
tatas trayo muhūrtās tu aparāhṇo vidhīyate ||
pañcamo dinabhāgo yaḥ sa sāyāhna iti smṛtaḥ |
yad yad eteṣu vihitaṃ tat tu kāryaṃ vijānatā ||
[109]        iti parāśaravacanāt | tat kathaṃ nirṇayaḥ |
ucyate | svarasatas tāvan madhyāhnaśabdaḥ pūrvottarabhāgadvayāpekṣo madhyamabhāge vartate, bhāgāntarāpekṣayā caturdhā vibhaktadvitīyabhāge pañcadhā vibhaktatṛtīyabhāge ca vilambitapratītir iyaṃ tena tridhā vibhaktasya tṛtīyabhāge madhyāhnaśabdo ’yaṃ, tathā ca śatapathaśrutiḥ: "tasmai ha sma pūrvāhne devā aśanam abhiharanti madhyandine manuṣyāḥ aparāhṇe pitaraḥ" iti |
ataḥ pūrvoktavacanaparyālocanayā dinārdhād uparitano madhāhno mukhyaḥ kālaḥ, tadūrdhvamastamānāvadhir gauṇaḥ "dinārdhasamaye ’tīte" iti vacanāt, “divaivety" abhidhānāc ca || madhyāhnavyāpitvaṃ ca "karmaṇo yasya yaḥ kāla" ityādivacanaparyālocanayaikadeśa-lakṣaṇayā dinārdhād uparitanamadhyāhnavyāpitvaṃ vivakṣitaṃ paṭo dagdha itivat, yadā tu dve mukhyakālaikadeśaṃ samaṃ vyāpnutaḥ ekā gauṇam api tadobhayavyāpinī grāhyā |
nanu tithihrāse bhavatv evaṃ na tu sāmye vṛddhau vā
kharvo darpas tathā hiṃsā trividhaṃ tithilakṣaṇam |
kharvadarpau parau pūrvyau hiṃsā syāt pūrvakālikī ||
iti vyāghravacanāditi cet,
ucyate | yathā samagrakarmakālavyāpinyāḥ pūrvāyāḥ “karmaṇo yasya" ityādivacanabalena grahaṇena “kharvadarpau" itivacanavirodhas tathā dvividhakarmakālaikadeśavyāpinyāḥ pūrvāyā grahaṇe ’pīti | kiṃ ca vrataviṣaye yugmavākyam eva pravartate na karvadarpavākyam iti sāmānyatithinirṇayaprastāve darśitam | yadā tūttarādhikamukhyakarmakālaikadeśaṃ vyāpnoti pūrvā tu tato nyūnaṃ vyāpam api gauṇam api tadottaraiva grāhyā bahumukhyakarmakālavyāpakatvāt,
[110]        yo yasya vihitaḥ kālaḥ karmaṇas tadupakrame |
vidyamāno bhaved aṅgaṃ nojjhitopakrameṇa ca ||
iti vacanānurodhāc ca | kharvadarpavacanavirodhaparihāranyāyenātra "hiṃsā pūrvakālikīti" vacanavirodhaḥ pariharaṇīyaḥ | yadā tūbhe api mukhyakālaikadeśam api na vyāpnutaḥ pūrvā gauṇaikadeśaṃ vyāpnoti tadā pūrvaiva grāhyā mukhyakālaikadeśāsparśe ’pi gauṇakarmakālasparśāt |
atra kecid āhuḥ | gauṇakāla evaikabhaktaṃ kāryaṃ tathā saty ubhayor anugraho bhaviṣyati, ekabhaktatither gauṇakālasya ca madhyāhne tv ekabhakte kriyamāṇe utpannaśiṣṭamadhyāhnalakṣaṇaguṇānurodhenotpattiśiṣṭas tithiviśeṣo bādhito bhavati | tac cāyuktaṃ mukhyāsaṃbhave ca sarvatra gauṇakālagrahaṇam āśritaṃ tasmād gauyakāla evaikabhaktaṃ kāryam iti |
tad ayuktaṃ |
tithyādiṣu bhaved yāvān hrāso vṛddhiḥ pare ’hani |
tāvān grāhyas tu pūrvedyur adṛṣṭo ’pi svakarmaṇi ||
iti vacanād yasyāṃ tithau yad vihitaṃ karma tat tasyāḥ svakarma tena madhyāhnakāle ’pi tattithilābhāt tatraivaikabhaktaṃ kāryam iti |
yadā tu dinadvaye ’pi karmakālavyāpinī tadā yugmādivacanān nirṇayaḥ | ayaṃ ca kālaḥ svatantraikabhaktaviṣayaḥ, yat tv anyavratāṅgam ekabhaktaṃ tat svayamaṅgatvena durbalād aṅgaguṇavirodhanyāyena na pradhānakālaṃ bādhate | upavāsasthānīyaṃ tv ekabhaktam  upavāsatithāv eva kāryam |
nanu svatantraikabhaktavrate madhyāhnavyāpinyāṃ gṛhyamāṇāyāṃ niṣiddhatithiyuktāpi prasajyeta, niṣiddhatithityāge tu madhyāhnavyāpinī na labhyate tatra kiṃ kriyatāṃ madhyāhnaśāstrasya bādho niṣedhasya veti |
ucyate | tatra niṣedhabādha eva [111] yuktaḥ "nāgaviddhā tu yā ṣaṣṭhītyādiniṣedhe vrataviśeṣānupādānān mādhyāhnaśāstrasya vrataviśeṣavato balīyastād iti |
nanu nivedhabādhe yugmavākyasyāpi bādhād gauravam iti cet |
na | tulyaśāstrāṇāṃ bādhagaurave gauravakṛto niṣedho bhavati na sāmānyaviśeṣaśāstrayoḥ, viśeṣaśāstrasyaiva balīyastvādviti |
nanu,
upavāsavratādīnāṃ ghaṭikaikāpi vā bhavet |
udaye sā tithis tatra viparītā tu paitṛke |
ityādiviśeṣaśāstrasya niṣedhayugmavākyābhyāṃ bādho yathā evam ihāpy astu |
ucyate |
upoṣyāḥ parasaṃyuktāḥ parāḥ pūrveṇa saṃyutāḥ |
ityādivacanāntaravirodhād atra yugmavākyāto vyavastheti vaiṣamyam |
nāgo dvādaśanāḍībhir dikpañcadaśabhis tathā |
bhūto ’ṣṭādaśanāḍībhir dūṣayaty uttarāṃ tithim ||
iti vacanāt dvitīye ’hani madhyāhnābhāve ’py ekabhaktaṃ kāryam iti kecit |
tad ayukaṃ karmakālavyāpinyāṃ labhyamānāyām anyasyā anāśrayaṇāt |
yasmin kāle tu yat karma tat kālavyāpinī tithiḥ |
karmaṇo yasya yaḥ kālas tatkālavyāpinī tithiḥ |
madhyahnavyāpinī grāhyā ekabhakte sadā tithiḥ ||
iti vacanāt | tasmād asmaduktaiva vyavasthā yukteti |
ity ekabhaktakālatithinirṇayaḥ |
[112]
atha naktakālanirṇayaḥ |
tatra dakṣaḥ |
naktavarate ca saṃprāpte tatkālavyāpinī tithiḥ |
pradoṣavyāpinī grāhyā tithir naktavrate sadā || |
ekādaśīṃ vinā sarvāḥ śuklakṛṣṇasamāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
ekādaśī tu nakte na pradoṣavyāpinī grāhyā tatropavāsāsāmarthyena naktavidhānād ata upavāsadina eva tat kāryam ity arthaḥ |
pradoṣaparimāṇaṃ tu skandapurāṇe uktam |
udayāt prāktanī sandhyā ghaṭikātrayam ucyate |
sāyaṃ sandhyā trighaṭikā astād upari bhānutaḥ |
trimuhūrtaḥ pradoṣaḥ syād ravāstaṃ gate sati || iti |
yat tv amarasiṃhenoktaṃ "pradoṣo rajanīmukham" iti tac ca rajanīmukhaśabdena muhūrtatrayam ucyate pūrvavākyānusārāt anekārthatvasyānyāyyatvāc ca |
viśvādarśe tu |
pradoṣo 'stamayād ūrdhvaṃ ghaṭikātrayam ucyate |
ityuktam |
atra kecid āhuḥ, pradoṣādau pūrvaghaṭikātrayaṃ saṃdhyāśabdavācyaṃ tatra ca bhojanaṃ niṣiddhaṃ,
catvārīmāni karmāṇi saṃdhyāyāṃ parivarjayet |
āhāraṃ maithunaṃ nidrāṃ svādhyāyaṃ ca caturthakam ||
ityādinā, ataḥ pradoṣottaraghaṭhikātraye bhojanaṃ kartavyam iti |
[113]        tad ayukaṃ mukhyasaṃdhyāśabdārthaparityāge kāraṇābhāvāt tatraiva niṣedhapravṛtteḥ | tathā hi ādityāstamayāditārakodayāntaḥ sarvajanaprasiddho mukhyaḥ saṃdhyākālaḥ kiṃcid ālakṣyatārakākālāt sūryadarśanāvadhiś ca tasmiṃś ca kāle bhojanaṃ niṣiddhaṃ |
tathā ca samṛtyantaram |
udayāt prāktanī saṃdhyā ghaṭikātrayam ucyate |
sāyaṃ saṃdhyā trighaṭikā asmād uparikalpanā ||
vidhiś ca |
nakṣatradarśanāt saṃdhyā sāyaṃ tatparataḥ sthitam |
tatparā rajanī jñeyā tatra dharmān vivarjayet ||
astu vā ghaṭikātrayaṃ saṃdhyāśabdārthaḥ tathāpi na tatra niṣedhaḥ tasya rāgaprāptabhojanaviṣayatvāt | yadā tu dinadvaye ’pi pradoṣavyāpinī na bhavati tadāpi skandapurāṇoktam |
pradoṣavyāpinī na syād divānaktaṃ vidhīyate |
ātmano dviguṇacchāye mandī bhavati bhāskare ||
tan naktaṃ naktam ity āhur na niśi bhojanam |
evaṃ jñātvā tato vidvān sāyāhne tu bhujikriyām |
kurvan naktavratī naktaṃ phalaṃ bhavati niścitam ||
atha kecid āhuḥ | 'pradoṣavyāpinī na syād" ity upalakṣaṇaṃ ādityavārādau rātribhojananiṣedhāt tena tatrāpi divānaktaṃ kāryam iti |
tad ayuktaṃ niṣedhasya rānaprāptabhojanaviṣayatvāt vidhiprāptaniṣedhāvāgayā taisyābhyaṅgakālanirṇayaprastāve darśitatvāt lakṣaṇāprasaṅgāc ca | tasmād [114] ādityavārādau rātrāv eva na kāryam iti |
sauradharme tu |
yadā tu dviguṇāñ chāyāṃ kurvaṃs tapati bhāskaraḥ |
tatra naktaṃ vijānīyān na naktaṃ niśi bhojanam ||
etad api pūrveṇa samānaviṣayam |
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
muhūrtonaṃ dinaṃ naktaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ |
nakṣatradarśanān naktam ahaṃ manye gaṇādhipa |
nakṣatradarśanād ūrdhvaṃ naktasya mukhyaḥ kālaḥ "ahaṃ manya" iti vacanāt, itaro gauṇaḥ paramatatvenopadeśāt, etadvacanaparyālocanayā yāvan nakṣatradarśanoparitanapradoṣavyāpitvaṃ naktavākye vivakṣitam |
atra kecit prathamātikrame kāraṇābhāvād gauṇanaktakālasaṃnidhānāc ca nakṣatradarśanāt pūrvaṃ "naktam ahaṃ manye" iti vyācakṣate |
tatrocyate kim atra naktaśabdena kālo vivakṣitaḥ bhojanaṃ vā, na tāvat kālaḥ nakṣatradarśanāt pūrvakālasya sandhyātvāt tasyāś ca "na divānakram" iti vede naktakālaśabdavācyatvaniṣedhāt | nāpi bhojanaṃ "naktavrate ca saṃprāpte tatkālavyāpinī tithiḥ” iti nakṣatravacanāt naktakālasaṃyogāc ca bhojane na naktaśabdaḥ pravartate | tatrāsmin kāle kriyamāṇaṃ na naktaṃ syāt tasmān nakṣatradarśanād ūrdhvaṃ bhojanaṃ manya ity evārthaḥ, śiṣṭasamācāraś ca tathaiva dṛśyate tasmān nakṣatradarśane sati naktam |
devalaḥ |
nakṣatradarśanān naktaṃ gṛhasthasya budhaiḥ smṛtam |
[115]        yater dināṣṭame bhāge tasya rātrau niṣidhyate ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
nakṣatradarśane naktaṃ prāg yāmābhyantarāśanam |
śeṣam ekabhaktakālanirṇayavad avaseyam ||
iti naktakālanirṇayaḥ |
athopavāsatithinirṇayaḥ |
tatra vṛddhavaśiṣṭhaḥ |
dvitīyā pañcamī vedhād daśamī ca trayodaśī |
caturdaśī copavāse hanyuḥ pūrvāpare tithī |
upavāse saptamī tu vedhād dhanty uttaraṃ dinam || iti |
dvitīyādyās tithayo vedhād upavāse svapūrvottare tithī hanyuḥ saptamī cottarām evety arthaḥ | anena pratipattṛtīyā ca dvitīyāviddhā nāpoṣyā ity ukaṃ bhavati evaṃ pañcamyādyāsv api draṣṭavam |
nāradīyapurāṇe tu "dvitīyā pañcamī vedhād" iti ślokaṃ paṭhitvaivaṃ paṭhyate |
tṛtīyaikādaśī ṣaṣṭhī tathā caivāṣṭamī tithiḥ |
vedhād adhastād dhanyus tā upavāse tithīs tv imāḥ ||
upavāse saptamī tu vedhād dhanty uttaraṃ dinam |
pakṣayor ubhayor eva upavāsavidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ||
dvitīyādyās tu tithayas tṛtīyādiyutā nopoṣyā ity arthaḥ | atra [116] tṛtīyāyutāyāṃ dvitīyāyām upavāso niṣiddhaḥ bhṛgusmṛti-viṣṇudharmayos tu vihitaḥ |
ekādaśy aṣṭamī ṣaṣṭhī dvitīyā ca caturdaśī |
amāvāsyā tṛtīyā ca tā upoṣyāḥ parānvitāḥ ||
viṣṇudharmottare śaṅkarīgītāsv api |
ekādaśy aṣṭamī ṣaṣṭhī dvitīyā ca caturdaśī |
trayodaśī amāvāsyā upoṣyāḥ syuḥ parānvitā || iti |
atraivaṃ vyavasthā śukladvitīyā parayutopoṣyā kṛṣṇadvitīyā tu pūrvayutā,
śuklapakṣe tithir jñeyā yasyām abhyudito raviḥ |
kṛṣṇapakṣe tithir jñeyā yasyām astamito rāviḥ ||
iti viṣṇudharmottaravacanāt | atra ditīyāviddhatṛtīyāniṣedho rambhāvratavyatiriktaviṣayaḥ |
tathā ca nigamaḥ |
kṛṣṇāṣṭamī bṛhattapā sāvitrī vaṭapaitṛkī |
anaṅgatrayodaśī rambhā upoṣyāḥ pūrvasaṃyutā || iti |
rambhāto ’nyatra tṛtīyā caturthīyutaiva |
tathā ca gārgyaḥ |
ekādaśī tathā ṣaṣṭhī amāvāsyā caturthikā |
upoṣyāḥ parasaṃyuktāḥ parāḥ pūrveṇa saṃyutāḥ ||
'parāḥ' anantarāḥ | atra pañcamītyutāyāṃ caturthyām upavāsaḥ “dvitīyā pañcamī vedhād " iti vacanena niṣiddhaḥ gārgyavacanena tu vihitaḥ |
[117]        atra kecid āhuḥ | śuklacaturthī parayutopoṣyā kṛṣṇacaturthī pūrvayutā “śuklapakṣe tithir jñeyā" iti vacanād iti tu |
tad ayuktam,
caturthī tu tṛtīyāyāṃ mahāpuṇyaphalapradā |
kartavyā vratibhir vatsa gaṇanātha sutoṣiṇī ||
iti brahmavaivartavacanāt pañcamīyutāyāṃ caturthyām upavāsaniṣedhenārthāt tṛtīyāyutāyām upavāsavidhānasya vināyakavrataviṣayatvapratīteḥ anyavrataviṣayatve hi "gaṇanātha sutoṣiṇīty asaṅgataṃ syāt | sarve ca śiṣṭās tṛtīyāyutāyāṃ caturthyāṃ vināyakavratam ācaranti "śuklapakṣe tithir jñeyā" iti vacanasya viṣayaḥ sāmānyatithinirṇayaprastāve darśitaḥ | tasmād vināyakavratacaturthī pūrvayutopoṣyā anyā tu parayuteti vyavasthā | pañcami tu caturthīyutopoṣyā "ekādaśy aṣṭamī ṣaṣṭhī" iti gārgyavacanāt "tṛtīyaikādaśī ṣaṣṭhī" iti nāradīyapurānavacanena ṣaṣṭhīyutāyām upavāsaniṣedhāc ca | ṣaṣṭhī tu parayutopoṣyā "dvitīyā pañcamī" ityādivacanāt |
tathā śivarahasya-saurapurāṇayoḥ |
nāgaviddhā tu yā ṣaṣṭhī śivaviddhā tu saptamī |
daśamy ekādaśīviddhā nopoṣyā syāt kathaṃcana ||
jñātvaivaṃ sūryacandrābhyāṃ tithiṃ sphuṭatarāṃ vratī |
ekādaśīṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ ca ṣaṣṭhīṃ copavaset sadā ||
atra pañcamīyutāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ upavāsaniṣedhaḥ skandaṣaṣṭhīvyatiriktaviṣayaḥ saptamīyutāyām upavāsavidhiś ca |
tathā ca padmapurāṇe |
kṛṣṇāṣṭamī skandaṣaṣṭhī śivarātriś caturdaśī |
[118]        etāḥ pūrvayutāḥ kāryās tithyante pāraṇaṃ bhavet ||
saptamī tu ṣaṣṭhīyutopoṣyā "ekādaśy aṣṭamī ṣaṣṭhī" iti gārgyavacanāt, "nāgaviddhā tu yā ṣaṣṭhī" iti śivarahasya-saurapurāṇayor aṣṭamīyutāyām upavāsaniṣedhāc ca,
ṣathy ekādaśy amāvāsyā pūrvaviddhā tathāṣṭamī |
saptamī paraviddhā ca nopoṣyaṃ tithipañcakam ||
iti skandapurāṇe nivedhāc ca | aṣṭamī tu pakṣadvaye ’pi parayutaiva "pakṣayor ubhayor" ity abhidhānāt |
kṛṣṇapakṣe ’ṣṭamī caiva śuklapakṣe caturdaśī |
pūrvaviddhā tu kartavyā paraviddhā na kasyacit |
upavāsādikāryeṣu hy eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ||
iti vacanaṃ rudravrataviṣayam |
rudravrateṣu sarveṣu kartavyā saṃmukhā tithiḥ |
anyeṣu vratakalpeṣu yathoddiṣṭām upāvaset ||
iti vacanāt | navamī tu pūrvayutaiva "dvitīyā pañcamī vedhād" iti vacanāt | daśamy api pūrvayutaiva "tṛtīyaikādaśī ṣaṣṭhī" iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇavacanāt | ekādaśī tu parayutā "dvitīyā pañcamī vedhād" ityādinā daśamīviddhāyām upavāsaniṣedhāt "ekādaśī aṣṭamī" iti bhṛgvādivacanaiḥ parayutāyām upavāsavidhānāc ca | śeṣam ekādaśīnirṇayaprastāve vakṣyate | dvādaśī tu pūrvayutaiva "ekādaśī tathā ṣaṣṭhī" iti gārgyavacanāt |
atra kecid āhuḥ | śuklatrayodaśī pūrvayutā kṛṣṇatrayodaśī parayuteti sāmānyatithinirṇayaprastāve darśitaṃ tathaivopavāse ’pi jñeyam |
[119]        nanu "ekādaśy aṣṭamī ṣaṣṭhī" iti viṣṇudharmottara-śaṅkaragītāvacanāt śuklatrayodaśyupavāsaviṣaye dvitīyā kasmān na gṛhyate |
ucyate | “dvitīyā pañcamī vedhād" iti caturdaśīyuktāyāṃ trayodaśyām upavāsapratiṣedhād avaśyambhāvini dvādaśīyuktāyāṃ tasyām upavāse
ṣaṣthy aṣṭamī tv amāvāsyā kṛṣṇapakṣe trayodaśī |
etāḥ parayutāḥ pūjyāḥ ||
iti nigamavacanāt kṛṣṇatrayodaśyupavāse parānvitā śuklatrayodaśī tu pūrvānviteti vratāntaravad eṣā vyavasthā svīkriyate |
apare tv āhuḥ | atra caturdaśīyutāyāṃ trayodaśyāṃ upavāsaniṣedho 'naṅgatrayodaśīviṣayaḥ, caturdaśīyutāyāṃ trayodaśyām upavāsavidhānam anaṅgatrayodaśīvyatiriktaviṣayaṃ "kṛṣṇāṣṭamī bṛhattapeti" nigamavacanāt, etadavacanaparyālocanayā pūrvavyavasthā nāśrayaṇīyā trayodaśīyutacaturdaśīniṣedhas tu pakṣadvaye 'pi | tad āha vṛddhavaśiṣṭhaḥ |
ekādaśy aṣṭamī ṣaṣṭhī ubhe pakṣe caturdaśī |
amāvāsyā tṛtīyā ca tā upoṣyāḥ parānvitāḥ ||
nigama-brahmapurāṇayoḥ |
ekādaśy aṣṭamī ṣaṣṭhī amāvāsyā caturdaśī |
tṛtīyā pūrvaviddhā ca tā upoṣyāḥ pare ’hani || iti |
ekādaśyādayaḥ parayutā upoṣyāḥ, tṛtīyā pūrvaviddhā ca, tatrāpi vyavasthā rambhātṛtīyā pūrvaviddhā anyā tūttaraviddheti | caturdaśīyutayoḥ paurṇamāsyamāvāsyayor upavāsaniṣedhaḥ sāvitrīvratavyatiriktaviṣayaḥ, pratipadyutayor upavāsavidhiś ca “kṛṣṇāṣṭamī vṛhattapeti" nigamavacanāt | yat tu padmapurāṇe,
[120]        śaṣṭhy ekādaśy amāvāsyā pūrvaviddhā tathāṣṭamī |
pūrṇimā paraviddhā ca nopoṣyaṃ caiva pañcakam ||
iti, tat sāvitrīvrataviṣayam |
skandapurāṇe ’pi |
bhūtaviddhā sinīvālī na tu tatra vrataṃ caret |
varjayitvā tu sāvitrīvrataṃ tu śikhivāhana ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
ekādasy aṣṭamī ṣaṣṭhī paurṇamāsī caturdaśī |
amāvāsyā tṛtīyā ca tā upoṣyāḥ parānvitāḥ |
anyāś ca tithayaḥ varṣā upoṣyāḥ pūrvasaṃyutāḥ ||
“anyāś ca tithayaḥ kāryāḥ” iti vacanāntaravihitaparaviddhopoṣyatithivyatiriktaviṣayaṃ asya sāmānyaśāstratvena viśeṣaśāstrāvaruddhe viṣaye pravṛttyanupapatteḥ | na tv idaṃ yuktaṃ sarvaśabdavaiyyarthyaprasaṅgāt "anyāś ca tithayaḥ sarvāḥ" ity anena vacanāntaravihitaparaviddhopoṣyatithivyatiriktatithyalābhāt | yadi tu vacanāntaravihitaparaviddhopoṣyatithīnām api vikalpena pūrvaviddhānām upoṣyatvārthaṃ sarvaśabdaḥ tadā saprayojanaḥ, tenaitad api viśeṣaśāstram ity ekādaśyāditithisaptakavyatiriktās tithayo vikalpena pūrvayutāḥ parayutā vopoṣyāḥ tathā ca jāghanyādhikaraṇasiddhānte jāghanyājyayor vikalpe vārttikakṛtokte bhavadevenoktaṃ idaṃ tv iha vaktavyaṃ kathaṃ sāmānyavihitenājyena viśeyavihitajāghanyavikalpaḥ sarvatra sāmānyaviśeṣaśāstrayor bādhyabādhakabhāvocchedaprasaṅgāt, naitad dvayor api viśeṣaśāstratvāt | tathā hi yadi khalv ājyavidhau yajñāyety etāvanmātraṃ [121] śrūyate, anyatra ca patnaīaṃyājarūpo viśeṣas tathā bhavaty eva sāmānyaviśeṣanyāyaḥ, kiṃ tu "sarvasmai vā etad yajñāya gṛhyate yad dhruvāyām ājyam iti, yajñāyeti sāmānyam abhidhāyāpi punas tatsamānādhikaraṇasarvaśabdoccāraṇaṃ, tenaitat jñāyate yad utpattiśiṣṭadravyānavaruddhaprakṛtasakalayāgaviṣayatvam evādhyayanavidhyabhimataṃ yajñaśabdasyeti tena dvayor api viśeṣaviṣayatvād vikalpa iti |
tad ayukaṃ | yadi hi vacanāntaravihitaparopoṣyatithiṣv etad vākyaṃ pravartate tadaikatra śāstrāntarabādhasāpekṣo niṣedhaḥ anyatra nirapekṣa iti vidhivaiṣamyaṃ prasajyeta | kiṃ ca pūrvopoṣyatithiṣu nityavad vidhiḥ paropoṣyatithiṣu ca vikalpenety api vaiṣamyaṃ syāt | "sarvasmai vā etad yajñāya gṛhyate yad bruvāyām ājyaṃ" ity atrāpy avihitadravyake yāge ājyavidhānam uktād eva hetoḥ | kiṃ ca yāgoddeśenājyavidhau avihitadravyakayāgalābhārthaṃ "sarvasmai” iti viśeṣaṇe viśiṣṭānuvādād vākyabhedaḥ prasajyeta | tasmāt sarvaśabdo yathāprāptānuvādārthas tasya ca sarvayajñasambandhapratipādanadvārā ājyastutiḥ prayojanam |
kathaṃ tarhi jāghanyājyayor vikalpa uktaḥ |
ucyate | “yad ājyena prayājā ijyante ājyena patnīsaṃyājā" iti taittirīyavacanāt patnīsaṃyājeṣv ājyaprāpteḥ |
athocyeta ṛganuvacanavidhiśeṣo ’yam arthavādaḥ na tu patnīsaṃyājeṣv ājyavidhiḥ | evaṃ hi śrūyate "jāmi vā etad yajñasya kriyate yad ājyena prayājā ijyante ājyena patnīsaṃyājā ṛcam anūcyā patnīsaṃyājānām ṛcā yajaty ajāmitvāyeti |
tad ayuktaṃ siddhavadanuvādāny athānupapattyātra vidher āśrayaṇāt upari hi devebhyo (?) dhārayatītivat | tantravārttikanibandhakārās tu “ājyena patnīsaṃyājān yajatīti śrutyantarād ājyaprāptiṃ manyante tena [122] yuktaṃ tatra vikalpābhidhānam |
nanu bhavatu tatraivaṃ sarvaśabdasya stutyarthatvena saprayojanatvāt, atra tu na tatheti katham etad iti cet,
ucyate | sarvaśabdo yathāprāptānuvādaḥ "yasyobhayaṃ havir ārttim ārcet” ity atrobhayapadavat | atha tatra prathamaṃ vā niyamyetety āśgneyahavirārttivad bhramāpanodārtham ubhayagrahaṇaṃ tarhy atrāpi bahuvacanasya triṣv eva caritārthatvāt | pratipadāditithitrayagrahaṇam iti bhramāpanodārthaṃ sarvaṃ grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati | athātra bhramāpanodanārthasya prakārāntareṇāpi siddher na prayojanatā | tarhy ubhayapadasyāpi na seti tulyaś cārthaḥ | yad vā kim anena prayojanagaveṣaṇena ubhayapade yā gatiḥ saivehāpīty alam atiprasaṅgena | yad api vṛddhagārgyavacanaṃ tithyupoṣaṇe pūrvāparapakṣayoḥ pūrvā pareṇa parā pūrveṇopoṣyā, tad api vacanāntaraviruddhaviṣayaṃ veditavyam | athedaṃ vicāryate yadodayād ārabhyodayāntaraṃ vyāpyānantaraṃ tithir vardhate sā ca paropoṣyā, trayodaśyādir bhavati tadā kiṃ pūrvopoṣyā uta pareti | tatra kecid āhuḥ paraivopoṣyā yugmādivacanāt |
nanu,
divārātrau vrataṃ yac ca ekam ekatithau gatam |
tasyān ubhayayoge ’nyām ācaret tad vrataṃ vratī ||
iti vacanāt yugmatithiparityāgena pūrvedyur eva vratānuṣṭhānaṃ yuktam | mukhyakālasyāsaṃbhave hy ahorātrādisādhyavratādeḥ khaṇḍatithau kartum aśakyatvena tatpratyāsannāniyatatithyantaragrahaṇe prāpte "yugmāgniyugabhūtānām" ityādivākyais tithiviśeṣā niyamyante tat katham ucyate saṃpūrṇatithiparityāgena yugmavākyabalāt khaṇḍatither api grahaṇam iti |
ucyate |
[123]        tithyādiṣu bhaved yāvān hrāso vṛddhiḥ pare ’hani |
tāvān grāhyas tu pūrvedyur adṛṣṭo ’pi svakarmaṇi ||
iti vacanaparyālocanayottaredyur yāvatī tithir vardhate tāvatī pūrvedyur apītarā tithir vidyata eva | tataś ca pūrvatither api khaṇḍatvāt parityāgena yugmavākyānugrahāya paredyur evānuṣṭhānaṃ yuktam |
tad uktaṃ viṣṇudharmottare |
tithiḥ saśalyā parivarjanīyā
dharmārthakāmeṣu budhair manuṣyaiḥ |
vihīnaśalyāpi vivarjanīyā
yadāgrato vṛddhim upaiti pakṣa iti ||
smṛtyantaram api |
yathā malimlucaḥ pūrvo māso daivas tathottaraḥ |
tyājyā tithis tathā pūrvā vṛddhau kāryā sadottarā iti ||
madayuktaṃ (?) upavāso hy ahorātrasampādyas tena pūrvasyāṃ va kāryaḥ tasyāḥ vakalakarmavyāpitvāt (?) | "yasmin kāle tu yat karma tatkālavyāpinī tithiḥ” iti vacanāt | yat tūktaṃ pūrvāpi khaṇḍatithir eva “"tithyādau tu bhaved yāvān" iti vacanād yāvatī pare’hṇi vṛddhiḥ tāvatyāḥ pūrvatither udayād ūrdhvaprāpter iti, tad apy ayuktaṃ tatra hi svakarmaṇīty uktaṃ yasyāṃ ca tithau yad vihitaṃ karma tat tasyāḥ svakarma tena trayodaśyāṃ vihitam upavāsavrataṃ tasyā eva karma na dvādaśyās tena svakarmavihitahrāsavṛddhigrahaṇaṃ trayodaśīvrate dvādaśyāṃ niṣpramāṇakaṃ "divārātrau vrataṃ
yac ca" iti vacanasyopavāsavyatiriktaviṣayatve saṃkocakāraṇābhāvāc ca [124] yugmādivākyaparyālocanayā saṃkocas tūpavāsavyatireke ’pi bhavet |
athocyate,
prātaḥ saṃkalpayed vidvān upavāsavratādikam |
iti vacanāt saṃkalpaḥ prātar eva karaṇīyaḥ | evaṃ ca dvitīyadine saṃkalpayogyāyā api tither alābhe pūrvatithigrahaṇaṃ, lābhe tu sarvasminn apy ahorātravyāpake karmaṇi dvitīyāyā eveti |
tad apy ayuktaṃ “divārātrau" iti viśeṣaṇānarthakyaprasaṅgāt tathā sarvavratānāṃ pūrvedyur evācaraṇāt |
karmaṇo yasya yaḥ kālas tatkālavyāpinī tithiḥ |
tathā karmāṇi kurvīta kṣayavṛddhī na kāraṇam || iti |
karmakālavyāpinyāṃ labhyamānāyāṃ hrāsavṛddhyoḥ titheḥ pūrvatvaparatve prati kāraṇatvanirākaraṇāc ca avidyamānahrāsavṛddhigrahaṇaprayojanasya sarvatithisāmānyanirṇayaprastāve darśitasyātrāsambhavāc ca | "tithiḥ saśalyetivacanaṃ tv ekādaśīviṣayam | 'samalyā' daśamīviddhā, 'vihīnaśalyā' saṃpūrṇaikādaśī, sā dvividhāpi tyājyā | yadottaredyur ekādaśi kiṃcid vardhate tena "saṃpūrṇaikādaśī yatra prabhāte punar eva setyādivacanena samānaviṣayam idam iti jñeyam | evaṃ ca vacanāntaravirodhaḥ parihṛto bhavati, mūlabhūtaśrutyantarakalpanā ca na bhaviṣyati, sarvatithiviṣayatve tu sāpy āpadyate,"yathā malimlucaḥ pūrva" iti vacanaṃ "sarvadarpau parau pūjyau" ity anena samānaviṣayaṃ na saṃpūrṇatithibādhanāya prabhavati | tasmād evaṃvidhe viṣaye pūrvaiva grāhyeti siddham | yadā tu parā upoṣyāḥ dvitīye ’hani ghaṭikāmātrāḥ vidyante tadā tā evopoṣyā na tu svalpatithiniṣiddhatithiividdhāḥ |
[125]        tathā ca bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
vratopavāsaniyame ghaṭikaikā yadā bhavet |
yā tithiḥ sakalā jñeyā pitrarthe cāparāhnikī ||
ṣaṭtriṃśanmate ’pi |
ghaṭikārdhaṃ tribhāgaṃ vā svalpaṃ vā dūṣayet tithim |
pañcagavyaghaṭaṃ pūrṇaṃ surāyā vinduko yathā || iti |
yadā tu nottare dyur udayavyāpinī kiṃ tu pūrve dyur niṣiddhatithividdhaiva |
tad āha ṛṣyaśṛṅgaḥ |
aviddhāni niṣiddhaiś cen na labhyante dināni tu |
mūhūrtaiḥ pañcabhir viddhā grāhyaivaikādaśī tithiḥ |
tadardhaviddhāny anyāni dināny upavasen naraḥ || iti |
niṣiddhair dinair aviddhāni dināni yadi na labhyante tadoktalakṣaṇāni grāhyāṇīty arthaḥ | “muhūrtaiḥ pañcabhir viddhā" iti aruṇodayaghaṭikācatuṣṭayāntarbhāveṇa | asmād adhikavedho yadā bhavati dināntare ca śuddhatithyabhāvaḥ tadāpi sa evāha |
aviddhānām alābhe tu payo dadhi phalāni ca |
sakṛd evālpam aśnīyāt upavāsas tato bhavet || iti |
kecid āhuḥ | ayam ekādaśīvarjam upavāsapratyāmnāyo veditavyaḥ ekādaśyāṃ tv ambupānam evopavāsapratyāmnāyaḥ bhojanasya niṣedhāt ambupānam api upavāsapratyāmnāyatvena darśitam |
vāyuprokte |
upavāsaniṣedheṣu bhakṣyaṃ kiṃcit prakalpayet |
[126]        na duṣyaty upavāse tadupavāsaphaṃ  labhet ||
naktaṃ haviṣyānnam anodanaṃ vā
tilāḥ kathaṃ kṣīram athāmbupānam |
yat pañcagavyaṃ yadi vātha vāyuḥ
praśastam atrottaram uttaraṃ yat || iti |
tad ayuktaṃ, rāgaprāptalābhe vidhiprāpte niṣedhāpravṛtteḥ |
ity upavāsatithinirṇayaḥ ||
aba nakṣatropavāsādikālanirṇayaḥ |
viṣṇudharmottare |
rāma uvāca |
nayanaṃ devadeveśa tithir vāpi vinirgatā |
dṛṣṭvā kathaṃ tu kartavyam iti me saṃśayaṃ hara ||
devadeva uvāca |
upoṣitavyaṃ nakṣatraṃ yenāstaṃ yāti bhāskaraḥ |
yatra vā yujyate rāma niśīthaḥ śaśinā saha ||
kvacit anyathā pāṭhaḥ |
upoṣitayaṃ nakṣatraṃ yasminn astam iyād raviḥ |
yeṇa vā yujyate rāma niśīthaḥ śaśinā saha || iti |
yatra vā niśītho ’rdharātraṃ śaśinā nakṣatreṇa saṃyujyate tad vā nakṣatram upoṣitavyam ity arthaḥ |
tathā ca sumantuḥ |
yatrārdharātrād arvāk tu nakṣatraṃ prāpyate tithau |
[127]        tan nakṣatravrataṃ kuryād atīte pāraṇaṃ bhavet ||
'prāpyate' prārabhyate ity arthaḥ | atīte tasmin nakṣatre iti śeṣaḥ |
bṛhatpracetāḥ |
nakṣatrāṇi samastāni pūrayitvā tu pāraṇam |
atra kecid āhuḥ | pāraṇam atra vratasya samāptir na tu bhojanam tasya puraṣadharmatvāt tasya ca pāratīrakarmasamāptāv ity asya dhātoḥ rūpaṃ pāraṇam iti | tasya ca dāmahomadevapūjātmakatvād eṣāṃ ca rāhudarśanād vinā rātrau kartavyatāyāḥ pratiṣiddhatvād ato nakṣatram upoṣitavam iti | etac ca nakṣatropoṣaṇa eva nakṣatrapuruṣādau draṣṭayam | yadā nakṣatracchedo divā na kathaṃcanāpi prāpyate tadā prāṅ nakṣatratruṭer devapūjādikaṃ vidhāya nakṣatravicchede bhojanaṃ kartavyam ity eva yujyate iti |
tad ayuktam,
rāhudarśanasaṃkrāntivivāhātyayavṛddiṣu |
snānadānādikaṃ kuryur niśi kāmyavrateṣu ca ||
ityādinā vacanena rātrāv api kāmyavrāteṣu dānādividhānān nakṣatrapuruṣavratādīnāṃ ca kāmyatvāt | yad apy uktaṃ yadā nakṣatracchedo divā kathaṃcanāpi prāpyate ityādi, tad apy ayuktaṃ evaṃvidhe viṣaye bhavanmatena dvitīyadinasaṃbandhinakṣatragrahaṇays yuktatvāt | tasmād evaṃ vyavasthā yadā pūrvasminn eva dine astamayasaṃbandhinakṣatraṃ tadā tad evopoṣyaṃ | yadā tu dinadvaye ’pi nāstamayasambandhi tadāpi tathaiva, yadā tu pūrvedyur ardharātrasaṃbandhi dvitīyadine cāstamayasambandhi tadā dvitīyadinasaṃbandhi,
yo yasya vihitaḥ kālaḥ karmaṇas tad upakrame |
vidyamāno bhaved aṅgaṃ nonmitopakrameṇa tu ||
iti vacanāt |
[128]        yat tu viṣṇudharmottare vacanam,
yā tithis tac ca nakṣatraṃ yasyām abhyudito raviḥ |
tayā karmāṇi kurvīta hrāsavṛddhī na kāraṇam ||
tad upavāsavyatiriktavrataviṣayam |
yad api baudhāyanavacanam,
yā tithis tac ca nakṣatraṃ yasyām abhyudito raviḥ |
vardhamānasya pakṣasya hānau tv astamayaṃ prati ||
tat pitṛkāryaviṣayam iti jñeyam | viṣṇudharmottara-baudhāyanavacanayor ekaviṣayatve virodhaprasaṅgāt ekatra hrāsavṛddhyoḥ kāraṇatvābhyanujñānāt anyatra ca tanniṣedhāt | na ca vaiparītyaṃ, tithisāhacaryeṇa tadvad eva nakṣatranirṇayasya yuktatvāt | tithinirṇayaś caiva pitṛkṛtye hrāsavṛddhicodanā nānyatreti, nāpy ubhayam upavāsaviṣayam tasya ca viśeṣaśāstrāvaruddhatvāt | tasmād asmaduktaiva vyavasthā yuktā |
iti nakṣatropavāsādikālanirṇayaḥ |
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevīyasamastakaraṇādhīśvara-
sakalavidyāviśāradaśrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau
pariśeṣakhaṇḍe kālanirṇaye caturtho ’dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ |
[129]
pañcamo ’dhyāyaḥ |
atha janmāṣṭamīnirṇayaḥ |
sā ca yā rohiṇīyuktā pūrvāparā vā saivopoṣyā |
tathā ca viṣṇurahasye |
prājāpatyarkṣasaṃyutā kṛṣṇā nabhasi cāṣṭamī |
muhūrtam api labhyeta sopoṣyā sā mahāphalā ||
muhūrtam apy ahorātre yasmin yuktaṃ hi labhyate |
aṣṭamyāṃ rohiṇīṛkṣaṃ tāṃ supuṇyām upāvaset ||
kiṃ ca yā rohiṇīyukrā sā copavāsādau mahāphalā iti saiva grāhyā |
tathā ca viṣṇudharmottare |
rohiṇyṛkṣaṃ yadā kṛṣṇe pakṣe ’ṣṭamyāṃ dijottama |
jayantī nāma sā proktā sarvapāpaharā tithiḥ ||
yad bālye yac ca kaumāre yauvane vārddhake tathā |
bahujanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ hanti sopoṣitā tithiḥ ||
sanatkumārasaṃhitāyām |
śṛṇuṣvāvahito rājan kathyamānaṃ mayā tava |
śrāvaṇasya tu māsasya kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ narādhipa |
rohiṇī yadi labhyeta jayantī nāma yā tithiḥ ||
[130]        skandapurāṇe |
prājāpatyena saṃyuktā aṣṭamī tu yadā bhavet |
śrāvaṇe bahule sā tu sarvapāpapraṇāśinī |
jayaṃ puṇyaṃ ca kurute jayantī tena tāṃ viduḥ ||
viṣṇurahasye |
aṣṭamī kṛṣṇapakṣasya rohiṇīṛkṣasaṃyutā |
bhavet prauṣṭhapade māsi jayantī nāma yā tithiḥ ||
'prauḍapada' iti kṛṣṇapratipadādimāsavivakṣayā, 'śrāvaṇa' iti ca śuklapratipadādimāsavivakṣayā, evaṃ saty aṣṭamī ekaiva pratipāditā bhavati |
bhaviṣyad-viṣṇudharmayoḥ |
jayantyām upavāsaś ca mahāpātakanāśanaḥ |
sarvaiḥ kāryo mahābhaktyā pūjanīyaś ca keśavaḥ ||
vahnipurāṇe |
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ bhaved yatra kalaikā rohiṇī smṛtā |
jayantī nāma yā jñeyā upoṣyā sā prayatnataḥ ||
saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ rājan yat trividhaṃ nṛṇām |
tat kṣālayati govindas tithau tasyāṃ subhāvitaḥ ||
upavāsaś ca tatrokto mahāpātakanāśanaḥ |
jayantyāṃ jagatīpāla vidhinātra na saṃśayaḥ ||
tretāyāṃ dvāpare caiva rājan kṛtayuge purā |
rohiṇīsaṃyutā ceyaṃ vidvadbhiḥ samupoṣitā ||
[131]        tathā |
rohiṇī tu kalāpy ekā kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ jayantikā |
yadobhayatrārddharātraṃ vihāya rohiṇīyogaḥ tadottaraivopoṣyā,
saṛkṣāpi na kartavyā saptamīsaṃyutāṣṭamī |
iti vacanāt | yadā tu pūrvasyām ardharātre rohiṇīyogaḥ uttarasyāṃ tv ardharātraṃ vihāya tadā pūrvaivopoṣyā |
tathā ca bhaviṣyad-viṣṇudharmayoḥ |
rohiṇyām ardharātre ca yadā kṛṣṇāṣṭamī bhavet |
tasyām abhyarcanaṃ śaurer hanti pāpaṃ trijanmajam ||
prājāpatyarkṣasaṃyuktā kṛṣṇā nabhasi cāṣṭamī |
sopavāso hareḥ pūjāṃ tatra kṛtvā na sīdati ||
ardharātre tu yogo ’yaṃ tārāpatyudaye tathā |
rohiṇīsahitā kṛṣṇā māsi bhādrapade ’ṣṭamī ||
ardharātrād adhaś cordhvaṃ kalayāpi yadā bhavet |
tatra jāto jagannāthaḥ kaustubhī harir īśvaraḥ ||
vahnipurāṇe |
saptamīsaṃyutāṣṭamyāṃ niśīthe rohiṇī yadi |
bhavitā sāṣṭamī puṇyā yāvac candradivākarau ||
tathā |
samāyoge tu rohiṇyā niśīthe rājasattama |
samajāyata govindo bālarūpī caturbhujaḥ |
tasmāt taṃ pūjayet tatra yathāvittānusārataḥ ||
[132]        bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
māsi bhādrapade ’ṣṭamyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe ’rddharātrake |
śaśāṅke vṛṣarāśisthe ṛkṣe rohiṇīsaṃjñite ||
yoge ’smin vasudevād dhi devakī mām ajījanat |
tasmān māṃ pūjayet tatra śuciḥ samyag upoṣitaḥ ||
agnipurāṇe ’pi |
tasmāt kṛṣṇāṣṭamī pūjyā saptamyā nṛpasattama |
rohiyīsaṃyutopoṣyā sarvāghaughavināśinī ||
tathā |
ardharātrād adhaś cordhvaṃ kalayā vā yadā bhavet |
jayantī nāma sā prokrā sarvapāpapraṇāśinī ||
padmapurāṇe ’pi |
kāryā viddhā ca saptamyā rohiṇīsahitāṣṭamī |
tatropavāsaṃ kurvīta tithibhānte ca pāraṇam ||
viṣṇudharme ca |
jayantī śivarātriś ca kārye bhadrājayānvite |
kṛtvopavāsaṃ tithyante tadā kuryāt tu pāraṇam ||
bhṛgur api |
janmāṣṭamī rohiṇī ca śivarātris tathaiva ca |
pūrvaviddhaiva kartavyā tithibhānte pāraṇam ||
yadārdharātrād ūrdhvaṃ kalām apy atikramya aṣṭamī pravṛttā, rohiṇī ca
dvitīye 'hni muhūrtārdhaṃ muhūrtaṃ vā tadā dvitīyaiva grāhyā |
[133]        tathā ca skandapurāṇe |
saptamīsaṃyutāṣṭamyāṃ bhūtvā ṛkṣaṃ dvijottama |
prājāpatyaṃ dvitīye 'hni muhūrtārdhaṃ bhaved yadi |
tadāṣṭayāmikaṃ jñeyaṃ prokaṃ vyāsādibhiḥ purā || iti |
pādme ’pi |
muhūrtenāpi saṃyuktā saṃpūrṇā sāṣṭamī bhavet |
kiṃ punar navamīyuktā kulakoṭyās tu muktidā ||
yadā tithinakṣatravṛddhyā dinadvaye ’rddharātre rohiṇyaṣṭamīyogaḥ tadā paradine jayantīvratam |
tathā ca brahmavaivarte |
varjanīyā prayatnena saptamīsaṃyutāṣṭamī |
saṛkṣāpi na kartavyā saptamīsaṃyutāṣṭamī ||
yadā tu dvitīyadivasa eva rohiṇyaṣṭamīyogaḥ tadā tatraiva jantīvratam ity uktam | tatraiva budhavārādiyoge prāśastyātiśayaḥ |
tathā ca skandapurāṇe |
udaye cāṣṭamī kiṃcin navamī sakalā yadi |
bhavet tu budhasaṃyuktā prājāpatyarkṣasaṃyutā |
api varṣaśatenāpi labhyate vātha vā na vā ||
padmapurāṇe ’pi |
pretayonigatānāṃ tu pretatvaṃ nāśitaṃ naraiḥ |
yaiḥ kṛtā śrāvaṇe māsi aṣtamī rohiṇīyutā ||
kiṃ punar budhavāreṇa somenāpi viśeṣataḥ |
[134]        kiṃ punar navamīyuktā kulakoṭyāḥ sumuktidā |
anye tv evam āhuḥ | yadā pūrvārdharātre rohiṇīyuktā nottarā sā ced budhavāre somavāre vā bhavati tadottaraivopoṣyā na pūrvā "udaye cāṣṭamī kiṃcid" iti skandapurāṇavacanāt "pretayonigatānām" iti padmapurāṇavacanāc ca | "saptamīsaṃyutāṣṭamyām" iti "muhūrtenāpi saṃyukā" iti vacanadvayaṃ ca budhasomavāravyatiriktaviṣayam iti |
tad ayukaṃ | yady api "ardharātre tu rohiṇyām" ityādivākyaṃ budhasomavārayuktāṣṭamīvyatiriktaviṣayatvena sāvakāśaṃ budhasomavāravākyaṃ ca dvitīya eva rohiṇīyoge, tathāpi budhasomavāravākyasaṃkoce karmakālavyāpitithisaṃbhavād ardharātravākyasaṃkoce tadbādhaprasaṅgāt budhasomavāravākyasyaiva saṃkocaḥ nārdharātravākyasya ubhayaviṣayatvena "saptamīsaṃyutāṣṭamyām" iti "muhūrtenāpi saṃyuktā" ity etadvacanadvayasyopapatteḥ, budhasomavāraviṣayatvena saṃkoce pramāṇābhāvāt |
yat tu kaiścid uktam, etadvacanadvayaṃ nopavāsaviṣayam upavāsaśabdāśravaṇāt saṃpūrṇatvamātrābhidhānāt, kiṃ tu "ardharātrād adaś cordhvam" itivākyaparyālocanayā pūrvasmin dine upavāse kṛte dvitīye dine yat tu brāhmaṇabhojanadakṣiṇādi vihitaṃ tad atikramyāpi kriyamāṇāṃ sakalatvābhidhānena aṣṭamīrohiṇyor eva kṛtaṃ bhavati iti mahāphalatvam upavāsasya jñāpayatīti |
tad ayuktaṃ saṃpūrṇatvābhidhānasyopavāsaviṣayatvenāpy upapatteḥ, "ardharātrād adhaś cordhvam" iti vacanavirodhasya parihatatvāt | tasmād uktaiva viṣayavyavasthā yuktā |
atra kecid āhuḥ | alpakālarohiṇīyoge jayantī nāmāṣṭamī ardharātrayoge rohiṇyaṣṭamīti |
tad asat, jayantīśabdasyārdharātrayoge [135] ’pi pravṛtteḥ "ardharātrād adhaś cordhvaṃ kalayā vā yadā bhavet | jayantī nāma sā proktā" ity udāhṛtavacanāt |
yat tu jayantīṃ prakṛtyoktaṃ 'muhrttam api labhyeta" iti, tad ardharātrayoge ’py upapadyate jayantīśabdasya cālpakālarohiṇīyuktāṣṭamīvacanatve pramāṇābhāvāt prāgudāhṛtasakalavākyaparyālocanayā rohiṇīsahitakṛṣṇāṣṭamīvacanatvapratīteḥ | yadā janārdanajanmopalakṣitarātriviśeṣavacano jayantīśabdaḥ,
abhijinnāma nakṣatraṃ jayantīnāma śarvarī |
muhūrto vijayo nāma yatra jāto janārdanaḥ ||
iti brahmāṇḍapurāṇavacanāt | yadā tu na rohiṇyaṣṭamīyuktā tadā,
kṛṣṇapakṣe’ ṣṭamī caiva kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśī |
pūrvaviddhā tu kartavyā paraviddhā na kasyacit ||
ityādivacanebhyaḥ pūrvaviddhaiva grāhyā |
atra kecit sūkṣmānayanena vaktavyāḥ, tāś ca sthūlānayanena siddhakṛttikottarārdhamadhyavarttinyas tadābhipretāḥ | na ca tāsāṃ rohiṇītvaaṃ mukhyaṃ saṃbhavati, na hy anyad anyad bhavati, virodhāt | yathā dinārdhaṃ dinam eva na rātris tasmāt kṛttikardhasya sūkṣmānayanāt yad rohiṇītvaṃ tad gauṇarohiṇīphalasaṃbandhena rohiṇītulyatvād devadattasya siṃhatvam eva | evaṃ ca sati mukhyayā saṃbhavantyā rohiṇyā rohiṇīsahitatvam aṣṭamyā grāhyaṃ mukhyasaṃbhave gauṇāśravaṇasyānyāyyatvāt | kiṃ ca prathamapratītatvena sthūlamārgasiddhasya tithinakṣatrāder grahaṇaṃ yuktam | jyotiḥśāstram api sūkṣmānayanena mukhyakālam evānayati na mukhyasvarūpatvam |
[136]        yad āha |
sthūlaṃ kṛtaṃ bhānayanaṃ tad etaj
jyotirvidāṃ saṃvyavahārahetoḥ |
sūkṣmaṃ pravakṣye ’tha munipraṇītam
vivāhayātrādi phalaprasiddhyai || iti |
kiṃ ca sthūlād anyena prakāreṇādṛṣṭārtheṣu vidhiniṣedheṣu nakṣatragrahaṇe vyavasthā syād vāranakṣatrādiviśeṣavihitasya pratiṣiddhasya sūkṣmānayanasiddheḥ, tadaṃśeṣu prasaṅgāt avigītaśiṣṭācāraviruddhāṃ caitat | tasmāt sthūlānayanam evāśrayaṇīyam ||
iti janmāṣṭamīnirṇayaḥ |
atha jayantīpāraṇakālanirṇayaḥ |
་
tac ca tithibhānte ca kartavyaṃ prāgudāhṛtavacanāt | yadā tu pāraṇadine ardharātrād upari bhāntas tithyanto vā bhavati tadārdharātre pāraṇaṃ (?) kāryam |
tithyarkṣayor yadā chedo nakṣatrāntam avāpya vā |
ardharātre ’tha vā kuryāt pāraṇaṃ tv apare ’hani ||
iti vacanāt |
atra kecid āhuḥ | "nakṣatrāntam avāpya veti pakṣo jayantīśravaṇadvādaśīvyatirekeṇa,
yāḥ kāścit tithayaḥ proktāḥ puṇyā nakṣatrasaṃyutāḥ |
ṛkṣānte pāraṇaṃ kuryād vinā śravaṇarohiṇīm ||
iti vacanāt |
[137]        brahmavaivarte ’pi |
aṣṭamyām atha rohiṇyāṃ na kuryāt pāraṇaṃ kvacit |
hanyāt purākṛtaṃ karma upavāsārjitaṃ phalam ||
tithir aṣṭaguṇaṃ hanti nakṣatraṃ ca caturguṇam |
tasmāt prayatnataḥ kāryaṃ tithibhānte ca pāraṇam || iti |
tad ayukaṃ kevalatithyante bhānte vā jayantīvrataprakaraṇa eva vahnipurāṇe pāraṇavidhānāt,
bhānte kuryāt tither vāpi śastaṃ bhārata pāraṇam || iti |
tathā |
rohiṇīsaṃyutā ceyaṃ vidvadbhiḥ samupoṣitā |
viyoge pāraṇaṃ cakrur munayo brahmavādinaḥ ||
sāṃyogike prate prāpte yatraikāpi viyujyate |
tatra pāraṇakaṃ kuryād evaṃ vedavido viduḥ ||
tasmāt kevalatithyante bhānte ca pāraṇavidhānam asamarthaviṣayaṃ itaraṃ tu samarthaviṣayam iti jñeyam |
iti jayantīpāraṇakālanirṇayaḥ |
atha prasaṅgāj jayantīvratanityatvanirṇayaḥ |
prājāpatyarkṣamaṃyuktā śrāvaṇasyāsitāṣṭamī |
varṣe varṣe tu kartavyā tuṣṭyarthaṃ cakrapāṇinaḥ ||
ity etad vacanāt "vasante vasante jyotiṣā yajetetivat vīpsāyuktatvāt nityatvam avagamyate, tena jyotiṣṭomādivad ekasya tūbhayatve [138] saṃyogapṛthaktvam iti nyāyena nityatvam api svīkriyate |
yac coktaṃ kaiścit naitat tena tulyam | tatra hi vākyāntareṇa phale vihite jyotiṣṭomādiphalarahitam eva vīpsayā yuktaṃ vasantakāle vidhīyate, tena tasya vākyasya nityatvāvabodha eva phalam | idaṃ tu "tuṣṭyarthaṃ cakrapāṇinaḥ” iti tuṣṭilakṣaṇe phala eva vrataṃ vidhatte, tena kāmyasya sato na śaknoti nityatāṃ bodhayituṃ ubhayaparatve vākyabhedaprasaṅgāt | tasmāt "varṣe varṣe” iti vīpsā phalabhūyastvārthā na nityatvārthā, anyathārthasaṅgatyabhāvāt prājāpatyarkṣasaṃyuktāṣṭamī varṣe varṣe yato na saṃbhavatīti |
tad yuktaṃ vīpsāśruter ānarthakyaprasaṅgāt | na ca phalabhūyastvārthā seti vācyaṃ | phale tadvidhānaṃ tadbhūyastve ca tadāvṛttividhānam iti bhavanmate ’pi vākyabhedaprasaṅgāt | atha phale vratavidhir eva na vratāvṛttau, phalabhūyastvasiddher na tatparatā vīpsāśruter iti manyase | tathā saty ānarthakyaṃ duṣpariharaṃ phalabhūyastvārthatve ca prativarṣam avaśyakartavyatārūpasya mukhyārthasya hāniprasaṅgāt | na ca taddhānau kāraṇam asti, yato ’sya vākyasthāyam arthaḥ, yacchrāvaṇasyāsitāṣṭamyāṃ prājāpatyarkṣasaṃyuktāyāṃ  cakrapāṇinas tuṣṭyārthaṃ vrataṃ vākyāntareṇa vihitaṃ tad varṣe varṣe kartavyam iti | na ca mukhyārthaparityāgenāṣṭamīśabdena lakṣaṇayā vratābhidhānam ayuktam iti vācyam | anuvādasya prāptyanurūpatvāt bhavato ’pi samānatvāc ca phale vratavidhānāṅgīkārāt |  iyāṃs tu viśeṣaḥ tava vidhau lakṣaṇā mamānuvāde, uktaṃ ca bhāṣyakāreṇa “vidhau hi na paraḥ śabdārthaḥ pratīyate" iti | ato ’nyathārthasaṅgatyabhāvādi tyādy uktaṃ tat parihṛtaṃ nityasyāpi tuṣṭiphalatvopapatteś ca |
varṇāśramācāravatā puruṣeṇa paraḥ pumān |
[139]        viṣṇur ārādhyate panthā nānyas tatropakārakaḥ ||
iti viṣṇupurāṇavacanāt | kiṃ ca kim upāttaduritakṣayaphalaṃ nityam utākaraṇanimittapratyavāyaparihārārthaṃ, tatrādye pakṣe nityatvam asyāpy avaśiṣṭam |
ardharātre tu rohiṇyāṃ yadā kṛṣṇāṣṭamī bhavet |
tasyām abhyarcanaṃ śaurer hanti pāpaṃ trijanmajam ||
iti vacanāt | dvitīye pakṣe ’pi nityatvama viruddham |
tuṣṭyarthaṃ devakīsunor jayantīsaṃbhavaṃ vratam |
kartavyaṃ vittamānena bhaktyā bhaktajanair api |
akurvan yāti nirayaṃ yāvad indrāś caturdaśa ||
ity akaraṇe mahādoṣaśravaṇāt |
yat tv atroktaṃ kaiścit naitan nityatvam avabodhayitum alaṃ anyathaivopapatteḥ, tathā hi |
ardharātre tu rohiṇyāṃ yadā kṛṣṇāṣṭamī bhavet |
tasyām abhyarcanaṃ śaurer hanti pāpaṃ trijanmajam ||
ityādi | anena trijanmasaṃcitapāpakṣayaphalatvam uktaṃ prāyaścittavat vratasya tasyākaraṇe pāpakṣayābhāve tasmād eva trijanmasaṃcitāt pāpān narakaṃ yātīty arthaḥ |
yathā yājñavalkyavākye |
prāyaścittam akurvāṇāḥ pāpeṣu niratā narāḥ |
apaścāttāpinaḥ kaṣṭān narakān yānti dāruṇān ||
ity atra prāyaścittākaraṇajanitāt pāpān na narakapātaḥ, kiṃ tu tadakaraṇe pāpakṣayakaraṇābhāvena vidyamānāt pāpāt evam ihāpīti |
[140]        tad yuktaṃ vīpsāvākyena nityatvāvadhāraṇāt | vratasyākaraṇe pratyavāyasiddhau tadakaraṇe doṣavidhāyakavacanasya mukhyārthatvasaṃbhavāt | tatparityāgenārthāntarakalpanāyāṃ pramāṇābhāvāt | yadi caitaj jayantīvratam ekam eva pāpakṣayakaraṃ syāt tadaivaṃ bhaven nāma, yadā tv anyāny api prāyaścittādīni pāpakṣayakārīṇi santi tadā tasyaivākaraṇe kathaṃ nirayapātaḥ | evaṃ prāyaścitte ’pi prāyaścittaṃ caritavyam ato nityam iti,
kṛte niḥsaṃśaye pāpe na bhuñjītānupasthitaḥ |
bhuñjāno vardhayet pāpaṃ yāvannākhyāti parṣadi ||
ityādivākyair āvaśyakatvāvagamād akaraṇe pratyavāyasiddhau tadakaraṇe doṣābhidhāyakasya "prāyaścittam akurvāṇāḥ" ityādivākyasya mukhyārthatvasaṃbhavāt tatparityāgenārthāntarakalpane pramāṇābhāvāt |
yad apy uktaṃ yadi vratasya nityatvenākaraṇe nirayapātaḥ tarhi tadvyudāsārthaṃ prāyaścittam api śrūyate, yathā vrātyatānāhitāgnitayoḥ | tathā ca nityaikādaśīvratasyākaraṇe |
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ divā bhuktvaindavaṃ caret |
ekādaśyāṃ divā rātrau naktaṃ caiva tu parvaṇi || iti |
tad apy ayuktaṃ sarvatraupadeśikaprāyaścittābhāvāt, tathā sati,
prāyaścittaṃ prakalpyaṃ syāt yatra coktā na niṣkṛtiḥ |
prāṇāyāmaśataṃ kāryaṃ sarvapāpāpanuttaye |
upapātakajātānām anādiṣṭasya caiva hi ||
ityādivacanānarthakyaprasaṅgāt |
yac cānyad uktaṃ kaiścit yady akaraṇe pratyavāyo ’bhaviṣyat anukalpo ’pi vyadhāsyata |
yathā |
eṣām asambhave kuryād iṣṭiṃ vaiśvānarīṃ dvijaḥ |
[141]        tathaikādaśīvrate nitye |
ekabhaktena naktena kṣīṇavṛddhāturaḥ kṣipet |
ity asamarthaṃ pratyanukalpo vidhīyate na tathātrāstīty uktam |
tad apy ayuktaṃ anukalpavidhānābhāve ’pi nityākaraṇe pratyavāyasyāvaśyaṃbhāvitvāt |
purāṇāntare sādhāraṇo ’nukalpo darśitaḥ |
upavāsāsamarthaś ced ekaṃ vipraṃ tu bhojayet |
tāvaddhanādi vā dadyād bhuktaś ced dviguṇaṃ tathā ||
sahasrasaṃmitāṃ devīṃ japed vā prāṇasaṃyamāt |
kuryād dvādaśasaṃkhyākān yathāśakty āturo naraḥ || iti |
tasmān nirayagamanavacanasya nityatāvabodhaḥ phalam iti siddham |
skandapurāṇe anācaraṇe doṣabāhulyapratipādanena nityatvam eva spaṣṭīkṛtaṃ | tathā hi |
śūdrānnena tu yat pāpaṃ śavahastasthabhojane |
tat pāpaṃ labhyate puṃbhir jayantyāṃ bhojane kṛte ||
gṛdhramāṃsaṃ kharaṃ kākaṃ śyenaṃ ca munisattama |
māṃsaṃ vā dvipadāṃ bhuktaṃ kṛṣṇajanmāṣṭamībhave ||
kṛṣṇāṣṭamīdine prāpte yena bhuktaṃ dijottama |
trailokyasaṃbhavaṃ pāpaṃ bhuktaṃ tena na saṃśayaḥ ||
brahmaghnaś ca surāpaś ca govadhaḥ strīvadho ’pi vā |
na loko suniśārdūla jayantīvimukhasya ca ||
ye na kurvanti jānantaḥ kṛṣṇajanmāṣṭamīvratam |
te bhavanti mahāprājña vyālāḥ syus te hi kānane ||
[142]        śrāvaṇe bahule pakṣe kṛṣṇajanmāṣṭamīvratam |
na karoti naro yas tu bhavati krūrarākṣasaḥ ||
śrāvaṇe bahule pakṣe na karoti yadāṣṭamīṃ |
krūrāyudhāḥ kūramukhā hiṃsanti yamakiṅkarāḥ ||
na karoti yadā viṣṇor jayantīsaṃbhavaṃ vratam |
yamasya vaśam āpannaḥ sahate nārakīṃ vyathām ||
jayantīvāsare prāpte karoty udarapūraṇam |
pīḍyate tilamātraṃ tu yamadūtaiḥ kalevaram ||
yo bhuñjīta vimūḍhātmā jayantīvāsare nṛpa |
narakottāro na tasyāsti dvādaśīṃ tu prakurvataḥ ||
yadā saha jayantyā tu karoti dvādaśīvratam |
tasya śauripure vāso yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam ||
raṭantīha purāṇāni bhūyo bhūyo mahāmune |
atītānāgataṃ tena kulam ekottaraṃ śatam |
pātitaṃ narake ghore bhuñjatā kṛṣṇavāsare || iti |
yat punar uktaṃ bhojanavākyaṃ tat tv etad bhojanapratiṣedhaḥ "na hiṃsyāt sarvā bhūtānī" itivat, tena jayantyāṃ kathaṃ nityatā tanmāhātmye ca kathaṃ tasya pāṭhaḥ tayor asaṃbandhāt | atha jayantīprakaraṇapāṭhāt tadarthatvaṃ pratiṣedhasyeṣyate | tathāpi tena na jayantyā nityatā śakyate boddhuṃ, na hi khalu “nānṛtaṃ vaded" ity anena kratvarthapratiṣedhena krator nityatvaṃ siddhyati | kiṃ ca upavāso nāma setikartavyatāko ’bhojanasaṃkalpaḥ tannirvāhārtham eva bhojananivṛttau siddhāyāṃ ko ’rthaḥ pratiṣedheneti, tat pratiṣedhānabhyupagamenaiva [143] parihṛtaṃ, tasmāt “na pṛthivyām agniś cetavyo nāntarikṣe na divi" itivat prāptyabhāvāt yathā nityānuvādatvenāsya hiraṇyanidhānastutyarthatābhūt evam ihāpi bhojanapratiṣedhasya nityajanmāṣṭamīvratastutyarthatā veditavyā akaraṇe doṣābhidhāyakatvena kāmyavratavidhistutyarthatānupapatteḥ, bhojananindāvākyānāṃ tu nityavidhivrataśeṣatvaṃ spaṣṭam eva, phalasaṃbandhavacanāt kāmyatvam apy etadvratasyāvagamyate |
tad yathā viṣṇurahasye |
prājāpatyarkṣasaṃyuktā kṛṣṇā nabhasi cāṣṭamī |
muhūrtam api labhyeta sopoṣyā sā mahāphalā ||
skandapurāṇe |
vratenārādhya taṃ devaṃ devakīsahitaṃ harim |
tyaktvā yamapathaṃ ghoraṃ yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam ||
janmāṣṭamīvrataṃ ye vai prakurvanti narottamāḥ |
kārayanti ca viprendra lakṣmīs teṣāṃ sadā sthirā ||
smaraṇaṃ vāsudevasya mṛtyukāle bhaven mune |
sidhyanti sarvakāryāṇi kṛte kṛṣṇāṣṭamīvrate ||
dharmam arthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca mokṣaṃ ca munipuṅgava |
dadāti vāñchitān kāmān ye cānye cātidurlabhāḥ ||
tathā |
mamājñayā kuruṣva tvaṃ jayantīṃ muktaye 'nagha |
bhaviṣyottare |
prativarṣaṃ vidhānena madbhakto dharmanandana |
[144]        naro vā yadi vā nārī yathoktaphalam āpnuyāt ||
putrasantānam ārogyaṃ saubhāgyam atulaṃ bhavet |
iti dharmaratir bhūtvā mṛto vaikuṇṭham āpnuyāt ||
tatra divyena mānena varṣalakṣaṃ yudhiṣṭhira |
bhogān nānāvidhān bhuktvā puṇyaśeṣād ihāgataḥ ||
sarvakāmasamṛddhe tu sarvāsukhavivarjite |
sarvadharmayute pārtha sarvagokulasaṃkule ||
kule nṛpavariṣṭhānāṃ jāyate hṛcchayopamaḥ |
yasmin sadaiva deśe tu likhitaṃ vā ghaṭārpitam ||
mama janmadinaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvālaṅkāraśobhitam |
pūjyate pāṇḍavaśreṣṭha janair utsavasaṃyutaiḥ ||
paracakrabhayaṃ tatra na kadācid bhavaty uta |
parjanyaḥ kāmavarṣī syād ditibhyo na bhayaṃ bhavet ||
gṛhe vā pūjyate yasmin devakyāś caritaṃ mama |
tatra sarvasamṛddhiḥ syān nopasargādikaṃ bhayam ||
paśuto nakulād vyālāt pāparogāc ca pātakāt |
rājataś corato vāpi na kadācid bhayaṃ bhavet ||
tasmād etad vrataṃ nityaṃ kāmyaṃ ceti siddham |
iti jayantīvratanityatvanirṇayaḥ |
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevīyasamastakaraṇādhīśvara-
sakalavidyāviśāradaśrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau pariśeṣakhaṇḍe kālanirṇaye janmāṣṭamīnirṇayo nāma pañcamo ’dhyāyaḥ ||
[145]
atha ṣaṣṭho ’dhyāyaḥ |
athaikādaśīnirṇayaḥ |
tatraikādaśīmahimā tattvasāgare |
māteva sarvabālānāṃ auṣadhaṃ roginām iva |
rakṣārthaṃ sarvalokānāṃ nirmitaikādaśī tithiḥ ||
tathā |
ekādaśyupavāsī yaḥ sa dhanyaḥ sa ca buddhimān |
tathā |
ekādaśīṃ parityajya yo ’nyad vratam upāsate |
sa karasthaṃ mahāratnaṃ tyaktvā loṣṭaṃ hi yācate ||
tathā |
ekām ekādaśīṃ vāpi samupoṣya janārdanam |
kāmenāpi samabhyarcya saṃsārān muktim āpnuyāt ||
purāṇāntare tu toyenāpi samabhyarcyeti pāṭhaḥ |
prasaṅgād vātha vā dambhāl lobhād vā tridaśādhipam |
ekādaśyāṃ namaskṛtya sarvaduḥkhād vimucyate ||
saṃsārākhyamahāghorād duḥkhināṃ sarvadehināṃ |
ekādaśyupavāso ’yaṃ nirmitaṃ paramauṣadham ||
saṃsārarogadaṣṭānāṃ narāṇāṃ pāpakarmanām |
[146]        ekādaśyupavāsena sadya eva sukhaṃ bhavet ||
nāradīyapurāṇe vaśiṣṭhaḥ |
ekādaśīsamutthena vahninā pātakendhanam |
bhasmatāṃ yāti rājendra api janmaśatodbhavam ||
nedṛśaṃ pāvanaṃ kiṃcin narāṇāṃ bhūpa vidyate |
yādṛśaṃ padmanābhasya dinaṃ pātakahānidam ||
tāvat pāpāni dehe ’smiṃs tiṣṭhanti manujādhipa |
yāvan nopavasej jantuḥ padmanābhadinaṃ śubham ||
aśvamedhasahasrāṇi vājapeyaśatāni ca |
ekādaśyupavāsasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ||
ekādaśendriyaiḥ pāpaṃ yat kṛtaṃ bhavati prabho |
ekādaśyupavāsena tat sarvaṃ vilayaṃ vrajet ||
ekādaśīṣamaṃ kiṃcit paritrāṇaṃ na vidyate |
svargamokṣapradā hy eṣā rājyaputraprasādhinī |
sukalatrapradā hy eṣā śarīrārogyadāyinī ||
na gaṅgā na gayā bhūpa na kāśī na ca puṣkaram |
na cāpi kauravaṃ kṣetraṃ na revā na ca devikā |
yamunā candrabhānā ca tulyā bhūpa harer dināt ||
