vyājenāpi kṛtā rājan na darśayati sāntakam |
anāyāsena rājendra prāpyate vaiṣṇavaṃ padam ||
cintāmaṇisamā hy eṣātha vākṣayanidheḥ samā |
saṃkalpapādapaprakhyā vedavedopamā tathā ||
[147]        brahmavaivarte |
sarvaprāyaścittam idaṃ saṃsārottārakārakam |
ekādaśīvrataṃ vipra kurvan muktim avāpnuyāt ||
naro dinair yad daśabhiś caturbhiś ca karoty ayam |
upoṣya pañcadaśamaṃ dinaṃ viṣṇor hi mucyate ||
iti sarvapurāṇeṣu munīnāṃ niścitaṃ matam |
upoṣyaikādaśīṃ pāpān mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
kalāv asminn anagnīnām ahiṃsāpāvitātmanām |
ekādaśīṃ vinā vipra na saṃsārād vimokṣaṇam ||
padmapurāṇāt |
upoṣyaikādaśīm ekāṃ prasaṅgenāpi mānavaḥ |
na yāti yātanāṃ yāmīm iti no yamataḥ śrutam
tathā |
ekādaśendriyaiḥ pāpaṃ yat kṛtaṃ vaiśya mānavaiḥ |
ekādaśyupavāsena tat sarvaṃ vilayaṃ vrajet ||
ekādaśīsamaṃ kiṃcit puṇyaṃ loke na vidyate |
vyājenāpi kṛtā yais te vaśaṃ yānti na bhāskareḥ |
skandapurāṇe |
vinā hi ṛkṣasaṃyogāt sadaivaikādaśī nṛṇām |
vinihantīha enāṃsi kunṛpo viṣayaṃ yathā ||
kuputras tu kulaṃ yadvat kunārī ca patiṃ yathā |
adharmeṇa yathā dharmaḥ kudharmeṇa yathā nṛpaḥ (?) ||
[148]        kujñānena yathā jñānaṃ kuśauce śucitā yathā |
asadvāde yathā vādaḥ satyaṃ caivānṛtena hi ||
yathoṣṇena himaṃ subhru anarthenārthasaṃcayaḥ |
yathā prakīrtanād dānaṃ tapo vismayakāraṇāt ||
aśiṣṭo hi yathā putro gāvo dūragamād yathā |
saṃketena yathā śrāddhaṃ yathā vittam avardhanāt ||
yathā samīhanāj jñānaṃ phalānāṃ varavarṇini |
tathā duṣkṛtasaṅghānāṃ prokteyaṃ dvādaśī śubhe ||
brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ steyaṃ gurvaṅganāgamaḥ |
abhāvaṃ samupeṣyanti na tathā vai tripuṣkaram ||
na cāpi naimiṣaṃ kṣetraṃ na ca kauravasaṃjñitam |
prabhāsaṃ na gayā devi na revā na sarasvatī ||
kālindī yamunā caiva devikā na ca kāñcanī |
tathānyas tīrthasāṃghato naiva tulyo harer dināt ||
na dānaṃ na japaḥ snānaṃ na cānyat sukṛtaṃ kvacit |
muktaye hy abhavat subhru muktvaikaṃ harivāsaram ||
sakṛc copoṣaṇe cāsyā naśyante pāparāśayaḥ |
ekataḥ pṛthivīdānam ekato harivāsaraḥ |
na samaḥ kavibhiḥ prokto vāsaro hy adhiko mataḥ ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
upavāsīṃ hariṃ yas tu bhaktyā dhyāyati mānavaḥ |
tajjapyajāpī tatkarmaratas tadgatamānasaḥ |
[149]        niṣkāmo ’dvaitavad brahma padam āpnoty asaṃśayam |
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
ekādaśī mahāpuṇyā sarvapāpavināśanī |
bhaktes tūddīpanī viṣṇoḥ paramārthagatipradā |
yām upoṣya naro bhaktyā na saṃsāre bhaviṣyati ||
ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāro yo bhuṅkte dvādaśīdine |
na sa durgatim āpnoti narakāṇāṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
kṛtvā pāpasahasrāṇi ekādaśyām upoṣitaḥ |
dvādaśyām arcayed viṣṇuṃ na sa durgatim āpnuyāt ||
eṣā tithiḥ parā puṇyā viṣṇor īśasya tuṣṭidā |
tasyāṃ caiva jagannāthaḥ amūrtto mūrttimān sthitaḥ |
tena sā sarvapāpaghnī sarvaduḥkhavināśanī ||
yā sā viṣṇumayī śaktir anantā hy akṣayā sthitā |
sā tena tithirūpeṇa draṣṭavyaikādaśī satī |
sanatkumāraprokte |
kṛtvā pāpasahasrāṇi brahmahatyāśatāni vai |
ekām ekādaśīṃ bhaktyā samupoṣya śucir bhavet ||
ekādaśīvratād anyad yad vrataṃ kriyate naraiḥ |
niṣphalaṃ tad vijānīyād ūṣarodbhūtam aṅkuram ||
nāradīyapurāṇe |
saṃprāpya vāsaraṃ viṣṇor yo naraḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ |
upavāsaparo bhūtvā pūjayen madhusūdanam |
[150]        sa hanti sarvapāpāni kiṃ tapobhiḥ kim adhvaraiḥ ||
ekādaśīṃ prapannā ye narā naravarottamāḥ |
tadvac ca bahavo bhūtā nāgārikṛtaketanāḥ |
agryeṇa pītavastrā hi prayānti harimandiram ||
eṣa prabhāvo hi mayā dvādaśyāḥ parikīrttitaḥ |
pāpendhanasya ghorasya pāvakākhyo mahīpata iti ||
devīrahasya-skandapurāṇayoḥ |
pāpaṃ ca vividhaṃ proktaṃ pātakaṃ cātipātakam |
upapātakasaṃjñaṃ ca mahāpātakam eva ca ||
prakīrṇakaṃ ca tat sarvam ekādaśyām upoṣaṇāt |
vilayaṃ yāti toyasthaṃ yathā mṛṇmayabhājanam ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe vaiṣṇave mahātantre |
ekādaśyupavāsī yaḥ kiṃ tasthānyena karmaṇā |
naikādaśyupavāsī yaḥ kiṃ tasyānyena karmaṇā ||
sauradharmeṣu |
ekatāś cāgnihotrādi dvādaśīm ekataḥ prabhuḥ |
tulayātolayat tatra dvādaśī ca viśiṣyate ||
devīrahasye |
gāyatrīha yathā sarvapāpapañjarabhedinī |
ekādaśī tathā sarvapāpapaścarabhedinī ||
skandapurāṇe ’pi |
abhojyabhojanāj jātaṃ agamyāgamanāc ca yat |
[151]        ayājyayājanād yac ca abhakṣyāṇāṃ ca bhakṣaṇāt ||
aspṛśyasparśanād yac ca pareṣāṃ nindanāc ca yat |
ātmasaṃstavanād yaś ca pāradāryāt kṛtaṃ ca yat ||
vihitākaraṇād yac ca paravittāpahārataḥ |
jñānājñānakṛtaṃ yac ca pātakaṃ copapātakam |
tat sarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti ekādaśyām upoṣaṇāt ||
vaiṣṇavatantre |
ekādaśī mahāpuṇyā viṣṇor īśasya vallabhā |
tasyām upoṣito yas tu dvādaśyāṃ pūjayed dharim ||
tasya pāpāni naśyanti viṣṇor bhaktiś ca jāyate |
jñānaṃ ca śāśvataṃ yena saṃsārād vindate naraḥ ||
skanda-bhaviṣyatpurāṇayoḥ |
ye dvādaśīm upavasanty anilāmbubhakṣāḥ
ye vā lavaṅgakusumair harim arcayanti |
te dhautapāṇḍurapayonidhirājahaṃsāḥ
saṃsārasāgarajalasya taranti pāram ||
vāyupurāṇe |
ekādaśīvrataṃ yas tu bhaktimān kurute naraḥ |
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sa viṣṇor yāti mandiram ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
ekādaśyupavāsaṃ yaḥ śraddhayā kurute naraḥ |
sa sarvapātakādibhyas tvacevāhir vimucyate ||
[152]        na paśyaty āpadaṃ nāpi narakaṃ na ca yātanām |
sa namasyaḥ sa pūjyaś ca vāsudevapriyo hi saḥ ||
garuḍapurāṇe |
ekādaśīvrataṃ bhaktyā yaḥ karoti naraḥ sadā |
sa viṣṇulokaṃ vrajati yāti viṣṇoḥ sarūpatām ||
āgneyapurāṇe |
ekādaśyām upavāsaṃ yaḥ sadā kurute naraḥ |
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo hariḥ sthitaḥ ||
rudrapurāṇe |
yaḥ karoti naro bhaktyā ekādaśyām upoṣaṇam |
sa yāti viṣṇusālokyaṃ yāti viṣṇoḥ sarūpatām ||
viṣṇupurāṇe |
oṃkāraḥ sarvavedānāṃ yathaivādyaḥ prapūjitaḥ |
tathā sarvavratānāṃ tu dvādaśīvratam uttamam ||
ity ekādaśīmahimā |
athaikādaśīviṣaye vratavākyaniṣedhanirṇayaḥ |
tatraikādaśyāṃ kānicid vākyāni bhojananiṣedhaparāṇi, kānicid vratavidhiparāṇi | tatra bhojananiṣedhaparāṇi tāvad udāhriyante |
tatra devalaḥ |
na śaṅkhena pibet toyaṃ na khādet kūrmaśūkarau |
ekādaśyāṃ na bhuñjīta pakṣakṣor ubhayor api ||
nāradīyapurāṇe |
yāni kāni ca pāpāni brahmahatyāsamāni ca |
annam āśritya tiṣṭhanti saṃprāpte harivāsare ||
tāni pāpāny avāpnoti bhuñjāno harivāsare |
raṭantīha purāṇāni bhūyo bhūyo varānane ||
na bhoktavyaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ saṃprāpte harivāsare |
skandapurāṇe |
mātṛhā pitṛhā caiva bhrātṛhā guruhā tathā |
ekādaśyāṃ tu bhuñjāno viṣṇulokāc cyuto bhavet ||
nāradīyapurāṇāt |
aṣṭavarṣādhiko martyo aśītir na hi pūryate |
yo bhuṅkte māmake rāṣṭre viṣṇor ahani pāpabhāk |
sa me daṇḍyaś ca vadhyaś ca nirvāsyo deśataḥ sa me |
viṣṇusmṛtāv api |
ekādaśyāṃ na bhuñjīta kadācid api mānavaḥ |
brahmavaivarte |
sa kevalam aghaṃ bhuṅkte yo bhuṅkte harivāsare|
dine tu sarvapāpāni bhavanty annasthitāni tu |
tāni mohena yo ’śnāti na sa pāpair vimucyate ||
vidhavāyās tv ekādamyāṃ doṣaviśeṣaḥ pradarśitaḥ kātyāyanena |
vidhavā yā bhaven nārī bhuñjītaikādaśīdine |
tasyās tu sukṛtaṃ naśyet bhrūṇahatyā dine dine |
[154]        atra ca "na khādet kūrmaśūkarau" ityādiniścitaniṣedhasamabhivyāhatatayā "ekādaśyāṃ na bhuñjīta pakṣayor ubhayor apītyāder niṣedhaparataivādhyavasīyate | na caiteṣu vākyeṣu paryudāsakāraṇaṃ vrataśabdasāmānādhikaraṇyādi śrūyate, ato bhojananiṣedhā ime |
atra kecid āhuḥ | etāny api vacanāny upavāsaparāṇy eva kvacid upakrame kvacid upasaṃhāre kvacid upakramopasaṃhārayor upavāsasya pratipādanāt nañarthavidhau tu mūlabhūtavedāntarakalpanāprasaṅgāc ca | ekamūlatvāya lakṣaṇāpi smṛtitantraprasiddhaiva | yac ca "ekādaśyām upavased" ity abhidhāya "ekādāśyāṃ na bhuñjīta" iti vacanaṃ devalādismṛtiṣu tadupasaṃhārārthaṃ guṇavidhānārthaṃ vā, tathā copavāsaprakaraṇapaṭhanam apy ucitaṃ bhavati | tena svatantranañārthavidhiparam evamādivacanam iti matam apāstam iti |
apare tv āhuḥ | naitad yuktam | mukhyārthasaṃbhave lakṣaṇāśrayaṇasyānucitatvāt | na ca mūlabhūtavedāntarakalpanāprasaṅgāl lakṣaṇāśrayaṇam ucitam iti vācyam | sarvavidhiniṣedhānām ekārthatvāpatteḥ | na ceha vratādiśabdasāmānādhikaraṇaṃ paryudāsāśrayṇakāraṇam asti |
nanu |
ekādaśyāṃ na bhuñjīta pakṣayor ubhayor api |
vanasthayatidharmo ’yaṃ śuklām eva sadā gṛhī ||
iti paryudāso ’yam abhojanasaṃkalpam upavāsākhyaṃ vrataṃ vidhatte "vanasthayatidharmo ’yam" iti dharmaśabdasāmānādhikaraṇyāt | na hi niṣiddhānāṃ brahmahatyādīnāṃ parityāge kaścid dharmo jāyate | brahmahatyādyanuṣṭhānād adharmo bhavati ananuṣṭhānād adharmaparihāramātraṃ na punar dharmasaṃbhavaḥ, grāhakaniṣedho [155] gṛhīto dharmo bhaved api na punaḥ svatantro niṣedhas tathā bhavati | tasmād dharmaśabdasāmānādhikaraṇyād avagamyate bhāvarūpaṃ kiṃcid vidheyam astīti, prajāpativrateṣv iva nañarthasya vrataśabdasamānādhikaraṇyād ataḥ sarveṣv ekādaśībhojananiṣedhavākyeṣu sarvaśākhānyāyena "vanasthayatidharmo ’yam" ity asyopasaṃhārād dharmaśabdasāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ paryudāsāśrayaṇakāraṇaṃ bhaviṣyatīti |
ucyate | satyam | yatraitadākyavihitaṃ nityam ekādaśyupavāsavrataṃ smṛtyantare mukhyayā vṛttyā mukhyāsaṃbhavād vā lakṣaṇayā vidhīyate | yathā kātyāyana-devalasmṛtyoḥ |
ekādaśyām upavaset pakṣayor ubhayor api |
viṣṇurahasya-skandapurāṇayoḥ |
upoṣyaikādaśīṃ nityaṃ pakṣayor ubhayor api |
ityādiṣu |
yathā ca bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
ekādaśyāṃ na bhuñjīta pakṣayor ubhayor api |
brahmacārī ca nārī ca śuklām eva sadā gṛhī ||
agnipurāṇe |
gṛhastho brahmacārī ca āhitāgnis tathaiva ca |
ekādaśyāṃ na bhuñjīta pakṣayor ubhayor api ||
|
ityādivacanam | tatraitatsmṛtigatasya ca "vanasthayatidharmo ’yam" iti viśeṣasya tatsmṛtigatasya ca "brahmacārī ca nārī ca" iti "gṛhastho brahmacārī ca āhitāgnis tathaiva ca" iti viśeṣasyātra karmaikyād upasaṃhāro yujyate | yatra tu mukhyārthasaṃbhāvena niṣedhaniścayād upavāsavratavidhānaṃ nāsti [156] tatra kathaṃ vratagatasyopasaṃhāraḥ, na hy agnihotragato viśeṣaḥ | śākhāntare ’nyakarmaṇy upasaṃhriyate, upasaṃhārād eva vratavidhānaṃ bhaviṣyatīti cet | na | upasaṃhāre sati vratavidhānaṃ vratavidhāne ca sati karmaikyād upasaṃhāra iti duruttaretaretarāśrayaprasaṅgāt | sarvatropasaṃhāre ca devalāsmṛtau vratavidhāyakavākyāntarasadbhāvāt paunaruktaprasaṅgaḥ | na caikaṃ vratavidhānaṃ dvitīyaṃ tadupasaṃhārārthaṃ guṇavidhānārthaṃ ceti vācyam | "na śaṅkhena pivet toyam" ityādiniṣedhavyavadhānenābuddhisthasyopasaṃhārānupapatter bhinnārthatve saṃbhavaty upasaṃhārārthatvasyānucitatvāc ca | nāpi guṇavidhiḥ, prāptārthaviṣayatvena vidhitvasyaivānupapatteḥ "na śaṅkhena pibet toyam" ityādibhiḥ saṃpratipannaniṣedhaiḥ sāhacaryeṇa paṭhitatvāc ca | etena kvacid upakrame kvacid upasaṃhāre upavāsapratipādanād ity api nirastaṃ | ekatithisaṃbandhāc copavāsaprakaraṇapaṭhanam apy ucitam | tasmāt svatantranañarthavidhiparam evamādivacanam iti mataṃ samīcīnam | kathaṃ brahmacāryādivākyeṣu mukhyārthāsaṃbhavāt lakṣaṇayopavāsavratavidhānam iti cet, ucyate mukhyārthaparigrahe hy eṣāṃ vākyānām ayam artho bhavet | gṛhasthabrahmacāryāhitāgninārīṇāṃ pakṣadvaye ’py ekādaśyāṃ bhojananiṣedhas tarhy atiriktānāṃ bhojane pratyavāyābhāvaḥ | gṛhasthasya tu śuklāyām eva bhojananiṣedhaḥ kṛṣṇāyāṃ bhojane pratyavāyābhāvaḥ ity āpadyeta viśeṣaniṣedhasya śeṣābhyanujñāviṣayatvāt | tathā ca sati,
ekādaśyāṃ na bhuñjīta kadācid api mānavaḥ |
ityādivacanavirodhaḥ | na ca sāmānyasya niṣedhasya viśeṣaniṣedhenopasaṃhāraḥ yathā "puroḍāśaṃ caturdhā karoti" iti sāmānyavidhiḥ "āgneyaṃ caturdhā karoti" iti viśeṣavidhinā bhaviṣyatīti vācyam | [157] niṣedhasya nivṛttiphalatvena viśeṣānapekṣatvād upasaṃhārānupapatteḥ | evam apy upasaṃhāre "na hiṃsyāt sarvā bhūtāni" iti sāmānyaniṣedhasya “brāhmaṇo ma hantavyaḥ" iti viśeṣaniṣedhenopasaṃhāropapattau kṣatriyādivadhe prāyaścittopadeśānarthakyaprasaṅgāt | "brāhmaṇo na hantavyaḥ" iti ca pāpagauravakhyāpanārthaṃ viśeṣaniṣedha iti cet | na | tad abhāvāt | na hi vanasthayatīnām ekādaśyāṃ bhojane nyūnaḥ pratyavāyo gṛhasthādīnām adhikaḥ, gṛhasthasya ca kṛṣṇāyāṃ bhojane nyūnaḥ śuklāyām adhika iti saṃbhavati, prāyaścittādhikyānabhidhānāt | praty uta gṛhasthādyapekṣayā vanasthādīnāṃ "śaucavac chodhanaṃ prokram" iti prāyaścittādhikyaṃ cābhihitam | prāyacittopadeśād eva nopasaṃhāra iti cet | na | anupadiṣṭe prāyaścitte prasaṅgāt | sāmānyato vihitaṃ prāyaścittaṃ sarvatrāstīti cet | na | bhavanmate pratyakṣaniṣedhasadbhāve ’pi kalpanāprasaṅgāt | śrutasyaivopasaṃhārābhāvamātraṃ tasmād bhaviṣyatīti cet | na | upasaṃhāranivāraṇārthatvābhāve mānavapadavaiyarthyāt śāstrasya manuṣyādhikāratvenaiva tatsiddheḥ | yat tūktaṃ paryudāsapakṣe "gṛhastho brahmacārī ca" ity atra vākye pakṣadvaye ’py upavāsaprasakter gṛhasthagrahaṇam anupapannaṃ syāt, “śuklām eva sadā gṛhī" ityādivakṣyamāṇavirodhād iti, tad ayuktaṃ avirodhasyānupadam evopapāyiṣyamāṇatvāt |
apare tv āhuḥ | yāni vratādiśabdasāmānādhikaraṇyarahitāni vākyāni tāni niṣedhaparāṇy eva | nanu paryudāsapakṣe ’pi lakṣaṇā nāsty eva “nañabhāve ca sādṛśye tadviruddhatadanyayor api" iti smaraṇād ataś ca vākyāntaraparyālocanayā bhojanaviddham abhojanasaṃkalpam abhidadhad upavāsaparaḥ syāt, anyathā "nānuyājeṣu ye yajāmahaṃ karotīty atrāpi lakṣaṇābhidhā [158] paryudāso na syāt | niṣedhapakṣe aṣṭadoṣaduṣṭavikalpaprasaṅgāt lakṣaṇāpi svīkriyata iti cet | na | evaṃ sati “yavair yajeta" ity atrāpi vrīhilakṣaṇāprasaṅgāt | na ca “vrīhibhir yajeta" ity atra yavalakṣaṇā, vrīhibhir ity asya bahuṣu vākyeṣu paṭhyamānatvāt aṣṭadoṣaduṣṭavikalpāc ca, varaṃ vākyadvayavihitam abhyudayakāri bhavatīti kalpanā | anekasaṃskāravākyagatayavalakṣaṇāto varam ekasmin yavavākye vrīhilakṣaṇā yuktā, tasmād vikalpabhayāl lakṣaṇāṅgīkāre avyavasthā prasaṅgāt na paryudāsapakṣe naño lakṣaṇā mukhyataiva | tena paryudāsa eva bhavatv iti cet, ucyate, paryudāsapakṣe lakṣaṇābhāve ’pi niṣedhā evaite, sarvaṃ hi pradhānenaiva sati saṃbhave saṃbadhyate, tena pradhānākhyātayogena niṣedhataiva, nāmadhātvārthayoge ca paryudāso bhavati, na tu niṣedhaḥ | sa tv ākhyātayoge, tad uktaṃ "nāmadhātvarthayogāc ca na nañ pratiṣedhakaḥ" iti | tasmān niṣedho ’yam aṅgīkiyate pratīyamānapradhānākhyātasaṃbandhe bādhakābhāvāt, na tu lacaṇāprasaṅgabhiyā | yac ca vikalpabhayāt lakṣaṇāsvīkāre yavavākaye sā prasajyate ity ukam |
tad ayukaṃ vrīhivākye yavavākye vā sā svīkāryeti vinigame hetor abhāvāt | na ca vrīhiśabdasya bahuvākyapāṭho niyāmakaḥ, saṃskāravākyagatavrīhiśabdasya yavalakṣaṇatvābhāvāt, pradeyaprakṛtimātralakṣaṇayopapatteḥ gṛhastho brahmacārī ceti vacanam api niṣedhaparam eva, na tu "ekādaśyāṃ na bhuñjīta kadācid api mānavaḥ" iti vacanavirodhaḥ upasaṃhārābhāvāt | na ca viśeṣagrahaṇavaiyarthyaṃ |
āhitāgnir anaḍvāṃś ca brahmacārī ca te trayaḥ |
aśnanta eva sidhyanti naiṣāṃ siddhir anaśnatām ||
[159]        yo gṛhastho na bhuñjīta āhitāgnis tathaiva ca |
prāṇāgnihotralopena avakīrṇī bhavet tu saḥ ||
ity evamādivacanaparyālocanayā mānavapadasaṃkocaparihārārthatvāt | na ca “ekādaśyāṃ na bhuñjīta" itivacanāny ekādaśīvyatiriktaviṣayāṇi, gṛhasthādiviṣayabhojananiṣedhaparyālocanayā "ekādaśyāṃ na bhuñjīta" ityasyāpi tadvyatiriktaviṣayatāprasaṅgāt | tenaitadbhramāpanodanārthaṃ "gṛhastho brahmacārī ca" iti vacanam iti na doṣaḥ | yāni punar vākyāni vrataśabdavanti dṛśyante tāni na niṣedhaparāṇi "nodyantam ādityam īkṣeta" itivat |
matsya-bhaviṣatpurāṇoḥ |
ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāro yo bhuṅkte dvādaśītithau |
śukle vā yadi vā kṛṣṇe tad vrataṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ mahat ||
āgneyapurāṇe |
ekādāśyāṃ na bhuñjīta vratam etad dhi vaiṣṇavam |
evam anyāny api vākyāni vratavidhiparāṇi jñeyāni | yāny upavāsaśabdavanti yāni ca phalaśabdavanti vākyāni vakṣyamāṇāni tāny api vratavidhiparāṇy eva niṣedhaparatve phalasaṃbandhānupapatteḥ | vratavidhiparāṇy api vākyāni dvividhāni nityavratavidhiparāṇi kāmyavratavidhiparāṇi ca | nityavratavidhiparāṇi tāvad udāhriyante |
tatra nāradaḥ |
nityaṃ bhaktisamāyuktair narair viṣṇuparāyaṇaiḥ |
pakṣe pakṣe tu kartavyam ekādaśyām upoṣaṇam ||
atropoṣaṇaṃ nityaṃ kartavyam ity anvayaḥ |
[160]        gāruḍapurāṇe 'pi |
upoṣyaikādaśīṃ nityaṃ pakṣayor ubhayor api |
sanatkumāraprokte 'pi |
ekādaśī sadopoṣyā pakṣayoḥ śuklakṛṣṇayoḥ |
tathā |
ekādaśyām upavasen na kadācid atikramet |
tathā |
ma karoti hi yo mūḍha ekādaśyām upoṣaṇam |
sa naro narakaṃ yāti rauravaṃ tamasāvṛtam ||
eṣu vākyeṣu sadā nityaṃ nātikramed iti śravaṇāt pakṣe pakṣe iti vīpsāśravaṇād akaraṇe doṣasaṃkīrtanāc ca ekādaśīvrataṃ nityam iti gamyate |
tathā ca viṣṇurahasye |
dvādaśī na prabhoktavyā yāvad āyuḥ suvṛttibhiḥ |
āgneyapurāṇe |
upoṣyaikādaśī rājan yāvad āyuḥ suvṛttibhiḥ || iti |
yatividhavayor ekādaśyupavāsātikrame doṣaviśeṣaḥ pradarśito nāradīyapurāṇe |
ekādaśyāṃ vinā raṇḍā yatiś ca sumahāmune |
pacyate hy andhatāmisre yāvad ābhūtasaṃplavam ||
ekādaśyāṃ na bhuñjīta pakṣayor ubhayor api |
vanasthayatidharmo ’yaṃ śuklām eva sadā gṛhī ||
[161]        iti gobhilavacanād api nityatvam avagamyate sadāśabdānvayāt, 'sadā' sarvakālam, “ekādaśyāṃ na bhuñjīta" iti pratīteḥ na tu gṛhiṇaiva sadāśabdānvayaḥ | evam itareṣv api upavāsaviṣayatvasya nityakāmyaprakāraviśeṣaḥ, na hy avasāyaparihārārtham, saṃnihitasadāśabdenānvayatvāt | -
trikāṇḍamaṇḍanas tv āha |
sa brahmahā surāpaḥ saḥ sa steyī gurutalpagaḥ |
vicārayati yo mohād ekādaśyau sitāsite ||
iti vacanaṃ nityatvapratipādakam | idaṃ ca yady apy arthavādamātraṃ tathāpi svatantrārthavādatvād vidhim antareṇa tadanupapatter vidhiṃ kalpayati "auḍumbaro yūpo bhavatītivat | tathāpi doṣaśravaṇād doṣasya cāvaśyakaśāstrātikramanimittatvād āvaśyakavidhiṃ kalpayati, tadatikrame doṣaśravaṇam upapadyate, na punaḥ kāmyaṃ kalpayati | tac cāvaśyakatvaṃ kiṃviṣayam ity apekṣāyam anyad vastu kalpayitvā tasyāṃ cotpattividhiṃ prakalpya tadviṣayāvaśyakatvavidhānād varaṃ vākyāntarāvagatasyaikādaśyupavāsasya nityakāmyaprakāraviśeṣākāṅkṣasyehāpi vākye ekādaśīśabdaśravaṇād buddhisthasya śabdāpekṣiṇa āvaśyakatvavidhānena saṃbandhaḥ kalpanālāghavāt |
nanu nindāśravaṇān niṣedhaḥ kimiti na kalpyate |
ucyate, niṣedhyaniṣedhobhayakalpanāgauravāpatteḥ |
nanu "vicārayati yo mohād" iti vicāro niṣedhyo ’vagamyate kiṃviṣayo vicāraḥ saṃnidhānād ekādaśīviṣaya iti brūmaḥ |
maivam, avicāritasyānuṣṭhātum aśakyatvena vicāraniṣedhāsaṃbhavāt, tad uktaṃ "avicārya kiṃcid evopādadāno vyāhanyeteti, tasmād upavāsarucyarthaṃ [162] vicāranindā kimarthaṃ vicāryate vicāritaprāyam evaitat tasmān nirvicāram ekādaśyām upavasanīyaṃ anyathā brahmahatyādidoṣāpattir iti vākyārthaḥ |
athaikādaśīvidhiparāṇi vākyāni |
tatra viṣṇurahasye |
ya icched viṣṇunā vāsaṃ śrutaṃ sampadam ātmanaḥ |
kvacit tu śrutapadasthāne putrapadaṃ paṭhyate |
kūrmapurāṇe |
ya icched viṣṇusāyujyaṃ śriyaṃ sampattim ātmanaḥ |
kātyāyanaḥ |
saṃsārasāgarottāram icchan viṣṇuparāyaṇaḥ |
aiśvaryaṃ santatiṃ svargaṃ muktiṃ vā yad yad icchati ||
eteṣām uttarārddham
ekādaśyāṃ na bhuñjīta pakṣayor ubhayor api || iti |
skandapurāṇe |
yadīcched vipulān bhogān muktiṃ cātyantadurlabhām |
ekādaśyām upavaset pakṣayor ubhayor api ||
nāradīyapurāṇe |
ārādhayati govindam ekādaśyām upoṣitaḥ |
yaḥ sa yāsyati nirvāṇaṃ dāhapralayavarjitam ||
viṣṇuḥ |
mārgaśīrṣe śuklaikādaśyām upoṣito bhagavantaṃ vāsudevam abhyarcayet | pūjyadhūpādyanulepanadīpanaivedyair vahnibrāhmaṇatarpaṇaiś ca vratam etat sampūrṇaṃ [163] kṛtvā pāpebhyaḥ pūto bhavati yāvajjīvaṃ kṛtvā śvetadvīpam evāpnoti ubhayato dvādaśīty evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ svargaṃ lokaṃ prāpnoti yāvajjīvaṃ viṣṇulokam ityādi |
nāradīyapurāṇe |
svargamokṣapradā hy eṣā śarīrārogyadāyinī |
sukalatrapradā hy eṣā rājyaputrapradāyinī ||
na hy apāpaślokaśravaṇādivat parārthatvād iyaṃ phalaśrutir arthavādo ’yam ucyate, parārthatā nāma pāpakṣayārthatā abhipretā, sāpi ca na spaṣṭaṃ vidhyuddeśe ’vagamyate kiṃ tv arthavādamātraśaraṇaiva, sa cārthavādaḥ svargādiṣv apy aviśiṣṭa iti tāny eva phalāny aṅgīkriyante yathā jāteṣṭer  avaśyakarttavyāyā apy ārthavādikaphalasambandho ’ṅgīkṛtaḥ | atra ca "tam etaṃ vedānuvacanena brāhmaṇā vividiṣanti yajñena dānena tapasā anāśakena" iti tapaso vidyāṅgatvāvagamāt pāramparyeṇa mokṣārthatvam astīti manyamānenoktaṃ mokṣapradeti |
ityekādaśauviṣayaniṣedhavākyanirṇayaḥ |
athāsmin vrate ’dhikārī nirūpyate |
tatra kāmyatvapakṣe tattatphalakāma eva | nityatvapakṣe trikāṇḍamaṇḍanaḥ prāha | nityatvānukūlatvāj jīvanavān adhikārī kalpyate, tathāpi traivarṇikādhikāratvād dharmaśāstrāṇāṃ atraivarṇikavyudāsaḥ |
nanu "vanasthayatidharmo ’yam" iti smaraṇād gṛhasthādivyudāso ’pi kasmān na bhavati |
ucyate | vanasthayatyor ākhyātapadānvayāsaṃbhavāt | na hi dharmaśabdopasarjanībhūtayor ekādaśyāṃ na bhuñjītety anenānvayaḥ saṃbhavati | evaṃ tu saṃbhavati vanasthayatidharmo ’yam ekādaśyāṃ na bhuñjīteti, kiṃ tv artho 'sau [164] nopapadyate dharmasyācetanasyopavāsakartṛtvāsaṃbhavāt | na hi "vanasthayatidharmo ’yam" iti bhuṅkte yena tasya nivāryate, tasmād yādṛśo ’nvayas tādṛśo ’rtho nāsti yādṛśo ’rthaḥ saṃbhavati tādṛśavācakaśabdo nāsti tasmāt stutyarthaṃ vanasthādipadaṃ yasmād vanasthayatyor uttamāśramiṇor apy ayaṃ dharmaḥ kim utetareṣām iti | yathā "devā vai satram āsate kim uta netare" iti |
nanv evam api vākyaśeṣād vanasthayatinirṇayaḥ kasmān na bhavati |
saṃdehābhāvāt yatra hi ghṛtatailayor upādāne saṃdehas tatra "tejo vai ghṛtam" iti vākyaśeṣān nirṇaya uktaḥ, iha tūpavāse jīvanmātrādhikāraniścayān na vākyaśeṣāpekṣā |
nanu "jīvann upavased" iti na śrūyate |
satyaṃ tac cāpi kalpyate |
nanv adhikārakalpanāto vākyaśeṣāt tadāśrayaṇaṃ laghīyorātrisatravat |
ucyate | kalpanāgauravabhayād vākyaśeṣagatayor vanasthayatyor adhikāriṇor ā*īyamāṇayos [broken letter] tato 'dhikataro doṣo vākyabhedaḥ prāpnoti, tathā hi vanasthayatyor ekatra puruṣe yugapatsamāveśāsaṃbhavāt na saṃhatayor adhikāriviśeṣaṇatvaṃ pratyekam adhikāriviśeṣaṇe gṛhyamāṇe vanastha upavaset yatir upavased iti vākyabhedaḥ spaṣṭa eva |
nanu pratyuddeśaṃ vākyaparisamāptau ko vākyabhedaḥ yathā "grahaṃ saṃmārṣṭi" iti aindravāyavādiṣu pratyekaṃ sammārgavidhānenāpi vākyabhedaḥ |
satyaṃ, tatraikasmin śabdatātparyae śraute paryavasite saty ārthiko vyāpāraḥ pratyekaṃ graheṣu bhidyamāno ’pi na vākyaṃ bhinatti, iha tu na kasyacid ekasya śabdasya śrauto vyāpāro vanasthayatisādhāraṇaḥ saṃbhavati vanasthaśabdena yater anabhidhānād yatiśabdena vanasthasya ato vākyabhedaḥ |
nanu rājapurohitayor iva vanasthayatyor bhinnaśabdopāttayor apy adhikārasambandhaḥ |
maivaṃ | tatra hi sāyujyamākanā nāmaikam adhikāraviśeṣaṇaṃ [165] sambhavati, iha tu vanasthatvayatitvābhyām anyad ubhayānusyūtam ekam adhikāriviśeṣaṇaṃ na paśyāmaḥ | kiṃ ca rājapurohitatulyanyāyāśrayaṇāt saṃhatayor adhikāraḥ prāpnoti, tatra vanasthayatī ekādaśyāṃ na bhuñjīyātām iti syān na punar ekādaśyāṃ na bhuñjīteti |
nanv anuṣaṅgeṇobhayatra sambandhān na dvirvacane nirdeśyābhāvo doṣaḥ |
ucyate | yatra bhinnavākyatvaṃ niścitaṃ tatra sampūrṇād vākyāt kiṃcid anuṣajyate nyūnavākyaṃ prati yathā “vasantāya kapiñjalān ālabhata" iti | iha ca samāsapadagatayor vanasthayatyoḥ pratyekam ākhyātasambandhāyogyatvenānuṣaṅgābhāvaḥ | tasmād vanasthayatiśabdasya kathaṃcid apy adhikārisamarpakatvābhāvād gṛhasthāder apy adhikāra iti siddham |
nanv evaṃ satīdaṃ vākyaṃ virudhyate
gṛahastho brahmacārī vā yo ’naśnaṃś ca tapaś caran |
prāṇāgnihotralopena avakīrṇī bhavet tu saḥ ||
iti |
ucyate | kim anena vākyena tapaḥ pratiṣidhyate kiṃ vā prāṇāgnihotrasyāvaśyakatvaṃ vidhīyata iti | na tāvat prāṇāgnihotravidhānaṃ tasya hetuvannigadābhihitasya vidhitvāsambhavāt tena hy annaṃ kriyata itivat | yady api hetuvannigaditārtho vidhīyate, tathāpi na prāṇāgnihotravidhānalābhaḥ kiṃ tu tadīyo lopa eva hetutvena nirdiṣṭa iti taddhānāpattyā agnihotralopa eva prasajyetety aniṣṭāpattiḥ | kiṃ cāgnihotranāmadheyaśravaṇān naiyamikāgnihotravidhyantaprāptyā tadīyadravyeṣu kṣīrādiṣu atidiṣṭeṣu teṣāṃ madhye ’vādidravyeṇopavāsāvirodhināpi prāṇānihotrasiddher naivopavāsabādhakatvaṃ prāṇāgnihotraniyamasya | athārthavādagatasya nāmno ’tideśakatvābhāvān naiyamikāgnihotradraveṣv aprāpteṣu prāṇāgnihotrasya mukhe hūyamānatayā buddhis tena bhojanārthena dravyeṇa prāṇāgnihotraṃ [166] kartavyam iti vidhīyate, tataś ca tatsiddhyārthaṃ bhojanākṣepād upavāsavirodhaḥ |
ucyate | yadi bhojanārthena dravyeṇa prāṇāgnihotraṃ kartavyaṃ tarhi tatprayuktadravyopajīvitvān na svayam ākṣepakatvaṃ "puroḍāśakapālena tuṣān āvapatītivat | nirūpitaś cāyam arthaḥ śārīrake "tad yad bhaktaṃ prathamam āgacchet taddhomīyaṃ svayaṃ prathamām āhutiṃ juhuyāt prāṇāya svāhety atrodāharaṇāt | tasmān na prāṇāgnihotrasyāvaśyakatvavidhāyakam idaṃ vākyaṃ "gṛhastho brahmacārī" iti | nāpi gṛhasthāder upavāsapratiṣedhakaṃ “pūrvām upavased gṛhī”,"śuklām eva sadā gṛhī" ityādivirodhāt | tathādityavārādikālaviśeṣopayuktopavāsaparyudāsād upavāsāntarābhyanujñā gamyate | ataś ca pare ’pi vākye gṛhasthasya tathānuvādo dṛśyate "prajāpatir akāmayata prajāḥ sṛjeya" iti, “sa tapo ’tapyata" iti prājāpatyādinādhikṛtatvād gṛhasthasya satas tapo’nuvādād gṛhasthāntarasyāpi tapo yukram iti tu gamyate | tathā ca vaśiṣṭhādayaḥ ṛṣayo gṛhasthā eva santo ’py ugrāṇi tapāṃsi cakira iti purāṇeṣu śrūyate | tathā viṣṇudharma-bhaviṣyottara-matsyapurāṇādiṣūpavāsapracurāṇi vratāni gṛhasthānāṃ vidhīyante | tathā dharmaśāstreṣu upavāsabahulāni prāyaścittāni gṛhasthānāṃ smaryante | adyatve ’pi kecana gṛhasthā mahātmānas tūpavāsaparāyaṇā dṛśyante sadācārād api gṛhasthānāṃ śreyo’rthināṃ tatrādhikāro gamyate | evaṃ ca sati yāni sādhāraṇāni tapovacanāni tāni gṛhasthe saṃkocalakṣaṇaṃ bādhaṃ na pratipadyante ity aparo lābhaḥ | tathā hi tapa iti tapo nānaśanāt paraṃ, yad dhi parantapas durādharṣaṃ, tasmāt tapasi ramanta iti | iha hi prakaraṇe yatrāśramaviśeṣavivakṣā tatra tadāśramagrahaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tasmāt tatsādhāraṇaṃ gamyate | [167] tathā "tapasā devā devatām agram āyan tapasarṣayaḥ suratvam avindan tapasā sapatnān praṇudāmarātīs tapasi sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ tasmāt tapaḥ paramaṃ vadantīti, “tapasā ye anādhṛṣyās tapasā ye svargatās tapo ye cakrire mahattāṃś ca devo ’pi gacchatād iti,
tapasaiva ca yuktasya brāhmaṇasya divaukasaḥ |
pūjāṃ tu pratigṛhṇantii kāmān saṃvardhayanti ca || iti |
yāni tu mohinīvacanāni "aho rājan rukmāṅgada bhavato gṛhasthasya sato nopavāsādhikāro ’sti viśeṣeṇa kṣatriyasya kiṃ tu yatīnāṃ vidhavānām evāyaṃ dharmo yad upavāsādi tad ekādaṣyāṃ tvayā bhoktavyaṃ bhoktavyam" ity arthapratipādakāni bhūyo bhūyaḥ kathitāni tāni vidhisarūpāṇi paramārthato na vidhāyakāni, kiṃ tu svaviparītārthasya vidher upavāsānuṣṭhānaparasya rukmāṅgadakīrtitasyārthavādabhūtāni, kutaḥ "mā maivaṃ vada kalyāṇi kiṃ tu tvayy upapadyate" ityādinā tad uktārthapratiṣedhapūrvakam upavāsavidhānāt | yathā “jartilayavāgvā vā juhuyāt gavīdhukayavāgvā veti," payasāgnihotraṃ juhotīty asvārthavādaḥ "anāhutir vai jarttilāś ca gavīdhukāś ceti jarttilagavīdhukapratiṣedhapūrvakaṃ payovidhānāt | kiṃ ca yadi mohinīpakṣa eva siddhāntaḥ syāt kiṃ tarhi taduktaviparītakāriṇaṃ rukmāṅgadaṃ hastenākṛṣya bhagavān vāsudeva ātmasāyujyenaivepsitavān | kiṃ ca yasyopakārārthe manuṣyān narakaṃ prāpayitum eva mohinyāḥ pravṛttir iti upavāsād api narakaprāptiphalāny eva mohinīvacanāni nānuṣṭheyārthāni | tasmād gṛhastho ’py upavāsādāv adhikata iti siddham | etena brahmacārī vyākhyātaḥ
tapoviśeṣair vividhair vrataiś ca vidhicoditaiḥ |
vedaḥ kṛtsno ’bhigantavyaḥ sarahasyo dvijanmanā ||
ityādivacanais tasyāpi tapaḥsaṃbandhāvagamāt |
nanv evaṃ tarhi "brahmacārī [168] veti vacanasya ko viṣayaḥ, prāṇāntikataponiṣedhaparatvaṃ brūmaḥ | tathā hi prāṇāgnihotralopeneti dvandvagarbhas tatpuruṣaḥ, itthaṃbhūtalakṣaṇā ca tṛtīya, vihitakarmopalakṣaṇārthaś cāgnihotraśabdaḥ, tathā cāyam artho bhavati yo gṛhastho brahmacārī prāṇabādhayā vihitakarmabādhayā vā tapaś carati so ’vakīrṇidoṣaṃ pratipadyeteti | evaṃ ca yojanā prāṇāś cāgnihotraṃ ca prāṇāgnihotre tayor lopeneti | etad uktaṃ bhavati vānaprasthādeḥ prāṇāgnihotrādyuparodhenāpi tapaḥ kurvāṇasya nātīva doṣaḥ, gṛhasthādes tu yadi prāṇo vāgnihotrādikaṃ vā uparudhyeta tadā doṣa iti,
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ prāṇāḥ saṃsthitihetavaḥ |
tān nighnatā kiṃ na hataṃ rakṣatā kiṃ na rakṣitaṃ ||
iti,
kurvann eveha karmāṇi jijīviṣec chataṃ samāḥ |
iti vacanābhyāṃ prāṇakarmaṇām abādhanīyatvapratipādanāt | yady apy ucyate,
śarīraṃ pīḍyate yena śubhenāpi ca karmaṇā |
atyantaṃ tan na kartavyam anāyāsaḥ sa ucyate ||
iti tad atyantapīḍānivārakaṃ na tu pīḍāmātrasya | tasmād gṛhasthabrahmacāriṇor upavāsādyadhikāro ’stīti siddham |
nanv astu nāmānyeṣāṃ gṛhasthānāṃ āhitāgneś ca nāsti,
āhitāgnir anaḍvāṃś ca brahmacārī ca te trayaḥ |
aśnanta eva suddhyanti naiṣāṃ siddhir anaśnatām |
iti smaraṇāt |
ucyate | kim anena vacanenāhitāgner aśanaṃ vidhīyate kiṃ vopavāsaḥ pratiṣidhyata iti yadāpy aśanaṃ vidhīyate tadāpi kiṃ sarvadā bhoktāvyam ity ucyate, kiṃ vā bhojanecchāyāṃ satyāṃ pratibandhe cāsati labhyamāne ca bhojane bhoktavyaṃ, āho svic chāstrāntarānanujñāte ’pi bhojanapratiprasavo vidhīyata iti, tatra sarvadāśanavidhānam aśakyatvād eva neṣṭam | nāpi bhojanec chāyāṃ pratibandhe cāsati labhyamāne bhojane vidhir yuktaḥ rāgataḥ [169] prāptatvāt | tad uktaṃ nyāyamañjarīkāreṇa "na hi bubhukṣito ’śnīyāt malinaḥ snāyād iti vidhānam upayujyata" iti | na ca pratibandhe ’pi bhoktavyam iti vācyam, aśakyatvāt | nāpi śāstrāntarānanujñātadeśakālāvasthādāv aśanaṃ pratiprasūyate, tathā ca sati sagrahādāv api kāle śmāśānādāv api deśe vā śucināpy āhitāgninā paryuṣitādikam apy annaṃ bhoktavyam ity āpadyate | bhavatv iti cet, hā kaṣṭam idaṃ śrutaṃ aho mahaty apy aśanalolupā yena samastaśiṣṭajanaprasiddhiviparītaṃ saṅgrahādiṣv api bhojanam ucyate, virudhyante ca bahūni śāstrāṇi tattadviṣayaniṣedhakāni "candrasūryagrahe nādyād" ityādīni |
nanu tāni sāmānyaśāstratvād anāhitāgniviṣayāṇi |
ucyate, idaṃ vā niṣiddhavyatiriktaviṣayaṃ kimiti neṣyate, yathā niṣedhaśāstrāṇy āhitāgnyanāhitāgnisādhāraṇatvāt sāmānyaśāstrāṇīty ucyante tathāśanaśāstram api niṣiddhāniṣiddhaviṣayasādhāraṇatvāt sāmānyaśāstraṃ, evaṃ tarhi vikalpo ’sthv iti cet, tan na, viṣamaśiṣṭatvāt | tathā "aśnanta eva sidhyanti" iti vartamānāpadeśatvāt kalpyo vidhiḥ "candrasūryagrahe nādyād" ityādiṣu pratyakṣaḥ, ato na vikalpaḥ |
nanv asthāne kliśyate āyuṣmatā yāvatā saṅgrahādiṣv āhitāgner aśanaṃ nocyate kiṃ tv ekādaśyādāv aśitavyam iti |
ucyate, kas tatra pakṣapātaḥ, yathā hi "candrasūryagrahe nādyād" iti spaṣṭaḥ śāstravirodhaḥ tathaiva "rātrāv apy ekādādaśyāṃ na bhuñjīta" iti śāstraṃ vidyata eva | tasmāt virodhaḥ, śāstrāntarāvaruddhe viṣaye nāśanavidhānam etat, “aśnanta eva sidhyanti" iti viṣayāntare vidhāyakatvaṃ pūrvam eva nirākṛtaṃ, tasmān na kvacid anenāśanaṃ vidhīyate |
nanu ca,
[170]        sāyaṃprātar dvijātīnām aśanaṃ śruticoditam |
nāntarā bhojanaṃ kuryād agnihotrasamo vidhiḥ ||
ity etad aśanavidhānaṃ, tarhi pūrvavad vikalpya dūṣayituṃ śakyate, ko bhrūte tad aśanavidhānam iti rāgataḥ prāptasya bhojanasya sāryaṃprātaḥ kālāntare pratiṣedhamātram iha kriyate sarvam anyad anūdyate, evam alpavidhiparatve saṃbhavati kālaviśiṣṭabhojanavidhānasyāyuktatvāt kāladvayaniyame vākyabhedāt sāyaṃprātar evāśanaṃ nāntarāle ity etāvatāgnihotrasāmyastutyupapatter nāvaśyakatayā samānatvaṃ kalpyaṃ, dhātvarthānuvādenānyaparā evaiṣa vidhayo ’ṅgīkriyate yathā "prāṅmukho ’nnāni bhuñjīta" ityevamādayaḥ |
nanu dīkṣitavratasya sāyaṃprātarāvaśyakatā kathaṃ |
ucyate tatrāpi śarīradhāraṇārtham eva vratasya parigraho na punas tannirapekṣasyāvaśyakatayā vidhānam |
anye tv āhuḥ, āvaśyakam eva vratam iti | tathā hi "madhyandine madhyarātre ca vrataṃ vratayatīti vrataṃ vidhāya punar āha "na tv evaṃ na vratayed" iti pūrvavacanenaiva vratasya madhyandinamadhyarātrakālasaṃbandhasidder ayaṃ vratābhāvapratiṣedho ’narthako bhavatu, nūnaṃ vratitatvam evety avagamayati |
yat tūcyate rāgaprāptatvād vidhānam anarthakam iti |
tan na, kṣudhādyabhāve ’py avaśyaṃ kiyanmātraṃ prāśanīyam iti vidhānāt śeṣabhakṣo ’pi pratipādyadravyaprayuktatvād rāgādyabhāve ’py āvaśyaka eva, "sāyaṃprātar dvijātīnām" iti vākyasya tv antarālapratiṣedhamātravidhānenāpi gatir uktā āhitāgnivākyasyāpi vakṣyate | tasmāt nedam aśanavidhāyakam |
nanu mā bhūd vidhāyakam abhyanujñāṃ tu karoty eva |
ucyate, tathāpi pūrvavad vikalpanīyam | na tāvad upavāsādiśāstrāvaruddhe viṣaye ’bhyanujñā [171] kriyate tacchāstravirodhād eva | nāpi śāsthānavaruddhe viṣaye abhyanujñānaṃ, vaiyarthyāt | yadi bhokum iṣyate labhyate ca vidhivirodhaś ca nāsti tadācamanam antareṇāpi bhujyata eva kim abhyanujñānavacanaṃ kariṣyati | upavāsapratiṣedhapakṣaḥ punar api pāpiṣṭhaḥ | tathā hi yatra śāstrīyā hy upavāsaprāptir aśanavidhānam āśrityāpi na nivārayituṃ śakyate ity ukaṃ | tat kathaṃ nāma pratiṣedhena vāryate prāptiparatantratvāt pratiṣedhasya tatra hi ṣoḍaśigrahaṇāgrahaṇavat vikalpo vā syāt "āhitāgnir upavasen na vā" iti, "nānuyājeṣu ye yajāmahaṃ karotītivad vā paryudāsaḥ, "āhitāgnivarjitā upavaseyur" iti ubhayathā na saṃbhavati vikalpasyāṣṭadoṣatvāt paryudāse lakṣaṇāprasaṅgāt pradhānākhyāte saṃbandhābhāvaprasaṅgāc ca |
nanu yāny āvaśyakāny upavāsādīni tāni bhavanty āhitāgner apīti, yāni tu śreyo’rthitayā kriyante tāni tasya nivāryante idaṃ tu subhāṣitaṃ, tathā hi nityo ’py upavāso nivāravituṃ na śakyate anena kathaṃ nāma kāmyo nivāryate, kim etan na śrutavān asi "kāmyo hi nityāid balīyān" iti, vākyasya tarhi kā gatir yadā kṣīṇaśakter āhitāgner upavāsādyanuṣṭhānenāhitāgnikṛtyavirodho bhavati tathāvidhasyāhitāgnes tābhir eva codanābhiḥ smārtam upavāsādyanuṣṭhānaṃ nivāryate, tatpratipādanārtham etad vākyaṃ “āhitāgnir anaḍvāṃś ca" iti |
nanv idam anuvādakaṃ vākyaṃ prāpnoti |
kim adyāpi na jānāsi smṛtivākyāny anuvādakānīti, evaṃ dharmāntarasāmarthyānurodhena vyākhyāyamāne prastutānusāro bhaviṣyati, tathā hi “tathā cātmano ’nuparodhaṃ kuryād yathā karmasu samarthaḥ syād" iti prastutya āpastambenoktaṃ “āhitāgnir anaḍvāṃś ca" iti | tasmād āhitāgnināpy [172] agnihotrādyapabādhenopavasituṃ śakyate ced ekādaśyām upavasanīyam eveti siddhaṃ | tathā cāgnipurāṇe ’pi gṛhasthādīnām upavāso vihitaḥ |
gṛhastho brahmacārī ca āhitāgnis tathaiva ca |
ekādaśyāṃ na bhuñjīta pakṣayor ubhayor api || iti |
kātyāyanaḥ |
aṣṭavarṣadhiko martyaś cāpūrṇaśītivatsaraḥ |
ekādaśyām upavaset pakṣayor ubhayor api || iti |
“upanayanādiniyame” iti ca sarvaniyamānām upanayanottarakālatvasmaraṇād aṣṭavarṣaparyantam upanītasyāpy anadhikāro ’ṣṭavarṣādhikaśabdenoktaḥ |
nāradīyapurāṇe |
aṣṭavarṣādhiko martyaś cāśītir na hi pūryate |
yo bhuṅkte māmake rāṣṭre viṣṇor ahani pāpabhāk |
sa me vadhyaś ca daṇḍyaś ca nirvāsyo deśataḥ sa me ||
etasmāt kāraṇād vipra ekādaśyām upoṣaṇam |
kuryān naro vā nārī vā pakṣayor ubhayor api ||
idam ekādaśīvrataṃ māheśvarair apy anuṣṭheyam |
tathā ca viṣṇudharmottare |
liṅgārcanaṃ rudrajapo vrataṃ śivadinatraye |
vārāṇasyāṃ ca maraṇaṃ mutir eṣā caturvidhā ||
ity uktvoktam |
ekādaśy aṣṭamī caiva pakṣayoś ca caturdaśī |
śivasya tithayaḥ proktā munibhiḥ śaunakādibhiḥ |
[173]        tāsām ādyām upavased divā nādyāt tathāntyayoḥ || iti ||
tathā |
vaiṣṇavo vātha vā śaivo kuryād ekādaśīvratam |
ekādaśyām upoṣaṇaṃ saurair apy anuṣṭheyaṃ saurapurāṇe tathābhidhānāt |
vaiṣṇavo vātha śaivo vā sauro ’py etat samācaret || iti |
tena traivarṇikasya gṛhasthāder upavāsa iti siddham iti |
apare tv āhuḥ nātra traivarṇikavyudāsaḥ,
varṇāśrametarāṇāṃ no brūhi dharmān aśeṣataḥ |
iti vākyaparyālocanayā sarveṣām adhikārād viśeṣataś cātra martyagrahaṇāt sarveṣām adhikāraḥ | yat tu pratigrāsam iti vacanena dvijagrahaṇaṃ, tat teṣāṃ doṣaviśeṣasya darśanārtham |
anye tu brahmacāryader apy adhikārapratipādanān manuṣyamātropalakṣaṇārtham ity āhuḥ |
tan na, lakṣaṇāprasaṅgāt, atrānāyāsavrata evādhikāro jñātayaḥ |
tathā ca brahmavaivarte |
ekādaśīṃ vinā vipra na saṃsārād vimokṣaṇam |
tathāpy ayaṃ viśeṣo ’sti kāryā śaktimatātra vā ||
na tu dehaṃ viduḥ prājñāḥ pīḍanīyam ihāgrahāt |
śarīraṃ pīḍyate yena suśubhenāpi karmaṇā ||
atyantaṃ tan na kurvīta anāyāsaḥ sa ucyate |
dharmasādhanam ādyaṃ yat śarīraṃ bahupuṇyakṛt ||
yathā kathaṃcin maurkhān na tat kṣayed ekahelayā |
mūlagrāheṇātmano yat pīḍayā kurate tapaḥ |
[174]        na sa sukham avāpnoti na siddhiṃ na parāṃ gatim ||
adhikāriṇo ’sāmarthye pratinidhir ukto vārāhapurāṇe |
asāmarthye śarīrasya vrate tu samupasthite |
kārayed dharmapatnīṃ vā putraṃ vā vinayānvitam |
bhaginīṃ bhrātaraṃ vāpi vratam asya na lupyate ||
kātyāyanaḥ |
rājñaś ca kṣatriyārthe ca ekādaśyām upoṣitaḥ |
purodhās tu kṣatriyo vā dvayoḥ samam itīritam |
upavāsaphalaṃ tābhyāṃ samayaṃ samavāpyate ||
śṛṇu yaś cānyam uddiśya ekādaśyām upoṣitaḥ |
yam uddiśya kṛtaṃ viprās tasya pūrṇaṃ phalaṃ bhavet |
kartā daśaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ prāpnoty atra na saṃśayaḥ ||
annābhāve yadā vipra ekādaśyām upoṣitaḥ |
upavāsaphalaṃ tasya samagraṃ samavāpyate ||
rājaroṣād yadā vipra ekādamyām upoṣitaḥ |
upavāsaphalaṃ tasya samyak bhavati niścitam ||
etasmāt kāraṇād vipra ekādaśyām upoṣaṇam |
kuryān naro vā nārī vā pakṣayor ubhayor api ||
vāyupurāṇe |
upavāse tv aśaktas tu āhitāgnir athāpi vā |
putrād vā kārayed ādyād brāhmaṇāpi kārayet ||
atha vā vipramukhyebho dānaṃ dadyāt svaśaktitaḥ |
[175]        upavāsaphalaṃ tathā samagraṃ samavāpyate |
tatra bhojanadoṣo ’pi tatkṣaṇād eva naśyati ||
kātyāyano ’pi |
pitṛbhrātṛmātur arthe ācāryāthe viśeṣataḥ |
upavāsaṃ prakurvāṇaḥ puṇyaṃ śataguṇaṃ labhet ||
yam uddiśya kṛtaḥ so ’pi sampūrṇaṃ labhate phalam |
nārī svapatim uddiśya ekādaśyām upoṣitā ||
puṇyaṃ śataguṇaṃ prāhur munayaḥ pāradarśinaḥ |
upavāsaphalaṃ tasyāḥ patiḥ prāpnoty asaṃśayam ||
tathā |
svayaṃ kartum aśaktaś cet kārayīta purodhasā |
hiraṇyaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt svaśaktyā cānurūpataḥ ||
kātyāyanaḥ |
evaṃ karoti yaḥ kaścit ekādaśyām upoṣaṇam |
pitṛmātṛbhrātur arthe gurvarthe ca viśeṣataḥ ||
upavāsaṃ prakurvāṇaḥ puṇyaṃ śataguṇaṃ labhet |
dakṣiṇā nātra dātavyā śuśrūṣā vihitā sadā ||
dravyasampattipattau vā ekādaśyām upoṣitaḥ |
dravyadātopavāsasya phalaṃ prāpnoty asaṃśayam |
kartā naktam avāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
manunoktam |
ghṛṇayā vānyam uddiśya ekādaśyām upoṣitaḥ |
[176]        yam uddiśya kṛtaṃ viprās tasya pūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet |
kartā daśaguṇaṃ puṇaṃ prāpnoty atra na saṃśayaḥ ||
yat tu manunoktam,
nāsti strīṇāṃ pṛthag yajño na vrataṃ nāpy upoṣaṇam |
viṣṇunāpi,
patyau jīvati yā nārī upavāsavrataṃ caret |
āyuḥ saṃharate bhartur narakaṃ caiva gacchati ||
tad bhartrādyananumatopavāsaviṣayaṃ kartṛstrīviṣayaṃ ca |
yathā cāhatuḥ śaṅkha-likhitau |
kāmaṃ bhartur anujñayā vratopavāsādīn ārabheta |
mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
nārī khalv ananujñātā pitrā bhartrā sutena ca |
niṣphalaṃ tu bhavet tasyā yat karoti vratādikam || iti |
nityaikādaśyupavāsāsamarthena ekabhaktādikaṃ kartavyam |
tathā ca mārkaṇḍeyaḥ |
ekabhana naktena tathaivāyācitena ca |
upavāsena dānena na nirdvādaśiko bhavet ||
ekabhaktena naktena bālavṛddhāturaḥ kṣipet |
payomūlaphalair vāpi na nirdvādaśiko bhavet ||
baudhāyano ’pi |
upavāse tv aśaktānām aśīter ūrdhvajīvinām |
ekabhaktādikaṃ kāryam āha baudhāyano muniḥ ||
[177]        bhaviṣyatpurāṇe dvādaśīkalpe |
ekādaśyāṃ prabhuṃ viṣṇuṃ samabhyarcya kadācana |
upoṣitena naktena tathaivāyācitena vā ||
ekabhaktena vā tāta na nirdvadaśiko bhavet |
tadekaniyamī nityaṃ na sīdati bhavārṇave ||
kāyaśaktibalād eva na balād dharmam ācaret |
upoṣito vā nakī vāyācity ekāśano ’pi vā ||
dvirdinaṃ pūjayet tāta hariṃ saṃsārapāradam |
ekāhārapradānena ekāśanaphalaṃ smṛtam ||
athācitaphalaṃ viddhi dakṣiṇādviguṇena ca ||
naktasya ca caturguṇyaṃ caturguṇam upoṣaṇāt |
sadakṣiṇaṃ phalaṃ dānād vratabhaṅge ’pi labhyate ||
ekādaśyupavāsī yaḥ pakṣayor ubhayor api |
durācāro ’pi ca jñeyaḥ snātaḥ sa svayam acyutaḥ ||
naktaṃ tṛtīyam apy uktaṃ vrataṃ dvāpararūpiṇam |
nakṣatradarśane puṇyaṃ prāg yāmābhyantarāśanam ||
vyāsaḥ |
haviṣyabhojanaṃ snānaṃ satyam āhāralāghavam |
agnikāryam adhaḥśayyāṃ naktabhogī ṣaḍ ācaret ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe dvādaśīkalpe |
satāmbūlam atāmbūlaṃ sabhojanam abhojanaṃ |
sāhāraṃ ca nirāhāraṃ caturvidham upoṣaṇam ||
[178]        yāvat kṛtāhniko na syād yāvan nārcayate harim |
gṛhī tāmbūlahīnaḥ syāt tat satāmbūlam ucyate ||
pūjayitvācyutaṃ pūrvaṃ pūrṇābhuktyāṃ bhunakti yaḥ |
bhadrābhuktyāṃ punar bhuṅkte tat sabhojanam ucyate ||
tṛṇadhānyāśanaṃ mūlaṃ payasājyena vā phalaiḥ |
harer ahny upavāsaś ca tat sāhārau udāhṛtam ||
yady etair ahitaṃ śuddham upāyaiḥ samupoṣaṇam |
atāmbūlam anāhāram abhojanam ato hitam ||
baudhāyano ’pi |
vyādhibhiḥ paribhūtānāṃ pittādhikaśarīriṇām |
triṃśadvarṣādhikānāṃ ca naktādiparikalpanā ||
'triṃśadvarṣāṇām' ity api kvacit pāṭhaḥ | tatra navativarṣāṇām ity arthaḥ |
kūrmapurāṇe |
ekabhaktena naktena bālavṛddhāturaḥ kṣipet |
nātikramet dvādaśīṃ ca upavāsavratena ca ||
etac ca vrataṃ pakṣayor ubhayor apy anuṣṭheyam |
tathā viṣṇurahasye skanda-kūrma-nāradīyapurāṇeṣu ca |
yathā śuklā tathā kṛṣṇā viśeṣo nāsti kaścana || iti ||
sanatkumāraprokte ’pi |
pathā śuklā tathā kṛṣṇā yathā kṛṣṇā tathetarā | iti |
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
śuklā vā yadi vā kṛṣṇā viśeṣo nāsti kaścana | iti |
[179]        sauradharmeṣu |
ekādaśī sadopoṣyā śuklā kṛṣṇā tathaiva ca | iti |
viṣṇurahasya-saurapurāṇayoḥ |
yathā supūjito gauraḥ kṛṣṇo vā vedavid dvijaḥ |
santārayati dātāraṃ dvādaśyau ca tathā smṛte ||
viṣṇurahasye skandapurāṇe ca |
tailaṃ śukletarāṇāṃ vai tilānāṃ sadṛśaṃ yathā |
kṛṣṇāyāś ca sitāyāś ca goḥ kṣīraṃ sadṛśaṃ yathā |
dvādaśyoḥ sadṛśaṃ tadvat puṇyaṃ śuklāsitobhayoḥ ||
darśaś ca pūrṇamāsī ca puṇyatas tu yathā same |
tathā sitāsite puṇye dvādaśyau munibhiḥ smṛte || iti |
skandapurāṇe |
yathottare dakṣiṇe ca ayane veai prakīrtite |
tulyaṃ puṇyam avāpnoti dvādaśyos tu tathobhayoḥ ||
tathā |
somasūryagrahau puṇyau yathaiva munibhiḥ smṛtau |
tathā sitāsite puṇye dvādaśyau viṣnutuṣṭide ||
sāyaṃ prātar yathā sandhyā sāyaṃ prātar yathāhutī ||
tathā sitāsite puṇye dvādaśyau dharmataḥ same
tathā |
yathā viṣṇuḥ śivaś caiva saṃpūjyau munibhiḥ smṛtau |
tathā pūjyatame prokte dvādaśyau śuklakṛṣṇake ||
[180]        varāhapurāṇe |
ekādaśyām upavaset pakṣayor ubhayor api |
dvādaśyāṃ yo ’rcayed viṣṇuṃ sa muktiphalabhāg bhavet ||
viṣṇurahasye 'pi |
dustārāṇi tvayoktāni narakāṇi sahasraśaḥ |
yamasya sadane ghore yātanā yamakiṃkaraiḥ |
yat kiṃcit tadvighātārthaṃ yamamārgasya tad vada ||
brahmovāca |
manasāpi cikīrṣanti dvādaśīṃ ye narottamāḥ |
te ’pi ghoraṃ na paśyanti saṃsāraṃ duḥkhasāgaram ||
sukle vā yadi vā kṛṣṇe viṣṇupūjanatatparaḥ |
ekādaśyāṃ na bhuñjīta pakṣayor ubhayor api ||
yathā sampūjito gauraḥ kṛṣṇo vā vedavid dvijaḥ |
saṃtārayati dātāraṃ dvādaśyau phalatas tathā ||
sarvapāpapraṇāśāya viṣṇoḥ santoṣaṇāya ca |
upoṣyā dvādaśī puṇyā sevetobhayapakṣayoḥ ||
śuklakṛṣṇaviveke pāpadoṣaśravaṇāc ca |
tathā ca kūrmapurāṇe viṣṇudharmottare ca |
sa brahmahā surāpaḥ syāt kṛtaghno gurutalpagaḥ | |
skandapurāṇe |
sa brahmahā sa goghnaś ca surāpo gurutalpagaḥ |
[181]        kālikāpurāṇe |
sarveṣām iha pāpānām āśrayaḥ sa tu kīrtitaḥ |
ity eteṣāṃ uttarārdham |
vivecayati yo mohād ekādaśyau sitāsite |
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
evaṃ jñātvā sadopoṣyā dvādaśī śuklakṛṣṇayā |
tayor bhedaṃ na kurvīta bhedanān narakaṃ vrajet ||
garuḍapurāṇe |
śuklā vā yadi vā kṛṣṇā viśeṣo nāsti kaścana |
viśeṣaṃ kurute yas tu pitṛhā sa tu kīrtitaḥ ||
tattvasāgarāt |
yathā śuklā tathā kṛṣṇā yathā kṛṣṇā tathetarā |
tulye te manute yas tu sa vai vaiṣṇava ucyate ||
hrāsavṛddhyenduraśmīnāṃ śuklatā kṛṣṇata tathā |
ekādaśyāḥ svarūpaṃ tu saṃkhyāyāḥ saiva kevalam ||
ataḥ kṛṣṇasitatvādi śaśino guṇa ucyate |
ekādaśyāṃ na tenāsti dūṣaṇaṃ yena dṛśyate ||
yadi vāsyā guṇo ’pi syāt tat tathāpi na dūṣaṇam |
tathā hi tilaviprādau kṛṣṇatvaṃ naiva dūṣaṇam |
sanatkumāraprokte |
ekādaśyor dvayor yas tu viśeṣaṃ krute nṛpaḥ 1
tasyoddhāraṃ na paśyāmi yāvad ābhūtasaṃplavam ||
[182] tena śuklakṛṣṇapakṣayor upavāsaḥ kārya iti siddham |
athādityavārādau kṛṣṇaikādaśyāṃ copavāsaniṣedhaḥ |
tatra vṛddhavaśiṣṭhaḥ |
kṛṣṇapakṣe ca saṃkrāntyāṃ grahaṇe cāpi putravān |
upavāsaṃ na kurvīta sutabandhudhanakṣayāt ||
matsyapurāṇe |
dinakṣaye tu saṃkrāntyāṃ grahaṇe cāpi putravān |
upavāsaṃ na kurvīta sutabandhudhanakṣayāt ||
matsyapurāṇe |
dinakṣaye tu saṃkrāntyāṃ grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ |
upavāso na kartavyaḥ putrapautrasamanvitaiḥ ||
saṃkrāntyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe ca raviśukradine tathā |
ekādaśyāṃ na kurvīta upavāsaṃ ca pāraṇam ||
kūrmapurāṇe |
dvau tithyantāv ekavāre yasmin saḥ syād dinakṣayaḥ |
tasmin snānaṃ japo homo nopavāso gṛhāśrame ||
sṛtimīmāṃsāyāṃ jaiminiḥ |
āditye ’hani saṃkrāntyāṃ grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ |
upavāso na kartavyo gṛhiṇā putriṇā tathā ||
kātyāyanaḥ |
ekādaśīṣu kṛṣṇāsu ravisaṃkramaṇe tathā |
candrasūryoparāge ca na kuryāt putavān gṛhī |
[183]        upavāsam iti śeṣaḥ |
gautamaḥ |
āditye ’hani saṃkrāntyām asitaikādaśīṣu ca |
vyatīpāte kṛte śrāddhe putrī nopavased gṛhī ||
ādityavāre saṃkrāntau vyatīpāte dinakṣaye |
pāraṇaṃ copavāsaṃ ca na kuryāt putravān gṛhī ||
nārado ’pi |
saṃkrātyām upavāsaṃ tu kṛṣṇaikādaśivāsare |
candrasūryagrahe caiva na kuryāt putravān gṛhī ||
ekādaśyāṃ ca kṛṣṇāyāṃ saṃkrāntyāṃ ca ravau tathā |
pāraṇaṃ copavāsaṃ ca na kuryāt putravān gṛhī ||
vṛddhavasiṣṭho ’pi |
ādityavāre saṃkrāntāv asitaikādaśīdine |
vyatīpāte kṛte śrāddhe putrī nopavased gṛhī ||
skandapurāṇe |
saṃkrānyām upavāsena pāraṇena yudhiṣṭhira |
ekādaśyāṃ ca kṛṣṇāyāṃ jyeṣṭhaḥ putro vinaśyati ||
tatraiteṣu vākyeṣv ādityavārādāv upavāsaniṣedhās tāvad ādityavārādiprayuktopavāsanivedhaparāḥ | na tv ekādaśīvrataprayuktopavāsaniṣedhaparāḥ |
tathā ca jaiminiḥ |
āditye ’hani saṃkrāntau grahane candrasūryayoḥ |
pāraṇaṃ copavāsaṃ ca na kuryāt putravān gṛhī ||
[184]        tannimittopavāsasya niṣedho ’yam udāhṛtaḥ |
nānuṣaṅgakṛto grāhyo yato nityam upoṣaṇam ||
'tannimittasya' ādityavārādinimittasya, ayaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ na punar ekādaśyām ādityavārādyanvayanibandhanopavāsapratiṣedhaḥ, yata ekādaśyāṃ nityam upoṣaṇam ity arthaḥ |
kātyāyano ’pi |
tatprayuktopavāsasya niṣedho ’yam udāhṛtaḥ |
prayuktyantarayuktasya na vidhir na nivedhanam ||
kecid asyaikādaśīprakaraṇapāṭhāt tacchabdasya prakaraṇasaṃnihitaikādaśīparatvād anuṣaṅgataḥ prāptopavāsaparatvābhāvāt putravataḥ saṃkrāntyādiyuktāyām ekādaśyāṃ upavāsaniṣedhaparam etad iti varṇayanti |
tan mandaṃ, vākyasaṃnidheḥ śīghrabhāvitvāt | yutaṃ caitat, ekādaśyāṃ rāhudarśanāsaṃbhavena kathaṃ tacchabdopapattiḥ, tatra rāhudarśanaparatvaṃ tarhi sakṛduccaritasyārthadvayaparatvam iti vairūpyaṃ syāt | ataḥ pūrvoktaiva vyākhyā jyāyasī | na ca saṃkrāntyādīnāṃ ekādaśīviśeṣaṇatvaṃ candrasūryagrahaṇasāhacaryādy uktaṃ samānavibhaktinirdeśāt saṃkrāntyādau satyām ekādaśyām upavāsavidhānāc ca |
tathā sanatkumāraprokte |
bhānuvāreṇa saṃyuktā tathā saṃkrāntisaṃyutā ||
ekādaśī sahopoṣyā sarvasaṃpatkarā tithiḥ ||
kātyāyanasmrtau |
saṃkrāāntī ravivāro vā ekādaśyāṃ yadā bhavet |
[185]        upoṣyā sā mahāpuṇyā sarvapāpaharā tithiḥ ||
tathā |
vyatīpāto vaidhṛtir vā ekādaśyāṃ yadā bhavet |
upoṣyā sā mahāpuṇyā putrasaṃpadvivardhanī ||
nāradaḥ |
bhānuvāreṇa saṃyuktā tathā saṃkrāntisaṃyutā |
ekādaśī sahopoṣyā putrasaṃpadvivardhanī ||
skandapurā ’pi |
ekādaśyāṃ yadā vatsa ādityasya dinaṃ bhavet |
tadopoṣyā prayatnena putrapautrapravardhanī ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
ekādaśyāṃ yadā rāma vāras tu savitur bhavet |
upoṣyā sā mahāpuṇyā putrapautravivardhanī ||
na caitāni putravadgṛhasthavyatiriktaviṣayāṇi, “putrapautrapravardhanītyādivākyaśeṣāt |
yasmāt saṃkāntyādinimittaś copavāsaḥ saṃvartenoktaḥ |
amāvāsyā dvādaśī ca saṃkrāntiś ca viśeṣataḥ |
etāḥ praśastās tithayo bhānuvāras tathaiva ca ||
atra snānaṃ japo homo devatānāṃ ca pūjanam |
upavāsas tathā dānam ekaikaṃ pāvanaṃ smṛtam ||
kṛṣṇaikādaśyupavāsaniṣedhas tu putravadgṛhiviṣayaḥ | tathā ca [186] kṛṣṇaikādaśyupavāsaniṣedhapareṣu vākyeṣu “putravān gṛhī” “jyeṣṭhaḥ putro vinaśyati" ityādiviśeṣaṇaṃ, nindā ca śrūyate "sutabandhudhanakṣayād" iti vā |
gobhilaḥ |
ekādaśyāṃ na bhūjīta pakṣayor ubhayor api |
vanasthayatidharmo ’yaṃ śuklām eva sadā gṛhī || iti |
evaṃ brahmacāryāder api draṣṭavyam | ata eva smṛtyantaram |
ekādaśyāṃ na bhuñjīta pakṣayor ubhayor api |
brahmacārī ca nārī ca śuklām eva sadā gṛhī | iti ||
bhaviṣyottare ubhayadvādaśīprārambhe yudhiṣṭhiravacanam |
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇā na me khyātā dvādaśī kena hetunā |
kiṃ sā na te priyā deva kiṃ vā khyātuṃ na yujyate ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca |
yathā śuklā tathā kṛṣṇā dvādaśī me sadā priyā |
śuklā gṛhasthaiḥ kartavyā bhogasantānavardhanī |
mumukṣubhis tathā kṛṣṇā tena tenopadeśitā |
tasmāt putravato gṛhasthasya śuklāyām evopavāso na kṛṣṇāyāṃ, kvacit punar naimittikaḥ kṛṣṇāyām ekādaśyām upavāso ’sti |
tad uktaṃ bhaviṣyottare |
nityā śuklā tadā khyātā kṛṣṇā naimittikī bhavet |
śuklā pārtha sadā kāryā na tyājyā saṅkaṭeṣv api |
śuklāyāṃ vastu vai bhuṅkte sa bhuṅkte kilbiṣaṃ naraḥ ||
'kṛṣṇā', 'naimittikī' nimitte bhavā naimittikī, nimittaṃ śayanībodhanīmadhyavarttitvam |
[187]        śayanībodhanīmadhye yā kṛṣṇaikādaśī bhavet |
saivopoṣyā gṛhasthena nānyā kṛṣṇā kadācana ||
kecit putrābhāvo nimittam iti vyācakṣate, tad evaṃ śāstrārthaḥ saṃpadyate, sarveṣāṃ sarvadā pakṣadvaye ’pi bhojanamātravarjanaṃ niṣedhapratipālanārthaṃ, putravadgṛhasthavyatiriktānāṃ pakṣadvaye ’py upavāsavratam anuṣṭheyaṃ, gṛhasthasya śuklāyām eva vrataṃ śayanībodhanīmadhye kṛṣṇāyām api, tad api putrarahitasya |
nanu putravataḥ kim iti na bhavati putravadgṛhasthasya kṛṣṇaikādaśyupavāsaniṣedhānāṃ śayanībodhanivākyavihitopavāsavyatiriktaviṣayatopapatteḥ |
ucyate | “śuklām eva sadā gṛhī" itivacanaparyālocanayā sakalakṛṣṇaikādaśīṣūpavāsābhāvaprāptau śayanībodhanīmadhyavartitvaṃ kṛṣṇaikādaśūṣūpavāsaniyamād anyatra tatprāptyabhāvād yasyāṃ kṛṣṇaikādaśyāṃ gṛhasthopavāsas tasyām eva viśeṣaniṣedhasyopapadyamānatvāt |
etad evākṣepapūrvakam anyair uktaṃ | imāni vacanāni putravato gṛhasthasya upavāsaṃ pratiṣedhanti tat katham etad upapadyate, na hi kṛṣṇaikādaśyāṃ upavāso vacanato vā rāgato vā prāptaḥ prāptipūrvakaś ca pratiṣedhaḥ, anyavidhiśeṣatvābhāve prāptyabhāvena nityānuvādāt pratiṣedhavacanānām ānarthakyaṃ prasajyate |
ucyate | “śayanībodhanīmadhye” ityādinā gṛhasthamātrasaṃbandhena kṛṣṇaikādaśyupavāsaprāptir asti, tām apekṣya putravato gṛhasthasya kṛṣṇaikādaśyupavāsapratiṣedhāḥ pravṛttāḥ |
hanta tarhi vihitapratiṣiddhatvāc choḍaśigrahaṇāgrahaṇavad vikalpaḥ prāpnoti |
maivaṃ bhinnaviṣayatvād vidhipratiṣedhayoḥ sāmānyaṃ viśeṣavidhir viśeṣaviṣayo vā niṣedho bādhate | yau punar ekaviṣayau vidhipratiṣedhau tāv eva ṣoḍaśigrahaṇāgrahaṇavad vikalpete iti | tad ayuktaṃ [188] pratiṣedhapradeśenārabhya vidhānena prāptapratiṣedhatvād vikalpaḥ syād ity adhikaraṇavirodhāt | vayaṃ tu paryudāsāśrayayena parihāram upariṣṭāt vakṣyāmaḥ putravadgṛhasthaviṣayakṛṣṇaikādaśyupavāsaniṣedhānāṃ bhūyasām bhavanmate śayanīvākyavihitopavāsāsu kṛṣṇaikādaśīṣu saṃkocaḥ prasajyeta | asmanmate tu śayanīvākyasyaiva putraviṣayatayā samkocaḥ |
pitāmahaḥ |
teṣām apīha pitaraḥ pitṝṇāṃ pitaras tathā |
teṣāṃ mātāmahānāṃ ca yeṣāṃ ye janakās tathā ||
teṣām api janetāro janitrīṇāṃ ca pūrvajāḥ |
prayānti vaiṣṇavaṃ lokam upoṣya harivāsaram ||
evaṃ daṇḍapaṭo hy eṣa tava padbhyāṃ niyojitaḥ |
lokapālatvam atulam arjitaṃ yena bhūbhujā ||
tam ekaṃ vadatāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ saṃprāpte harivāsare |
yadi cālayase dhairyat tato ’haṃ tava kiṃkaraḥ || iti |
tatrāpi harivāsaragrahaṇaṃ rukmāṅgadavihitaikādaśīparam ity avagantavyam | ato gṛhiṇaḥ putravataḥ śuklaikādaśyām upavāsa itareṣāṃ tūbhayor iti siddham |
anye tv āhuḥ | kṛṣṇaikaśyupavāsaniṣedhāḥ kāmyavratopavāsaviṣayā na tu nityavrataviṣayāḥ |
na hi tadviṣayā niṣedhāḥ kalpyante, vikalpāpatteḥ | na ca sāmānyaśāstravihitopavāsabādha iti vācyam | pratiṣedhavidheḥ prāptisāpekṣatvād atyantatadbādhakatvānupapatteḥ | tenāyuktam [189] etat putravadgṛhasthavyatiriktasyobhayaikādaśyupavāsa iti |
anye tu vaiṣṇavānām eva upavāsam ity āhuḥ | tathāpi gṛhiṇaḥ putravataḥ śuklaikādaśyām upavāso na kṛṣṇaikādaśyām ity āhuḥ | tathā ca gautamaḥ |
ekādaśyāṃ na bhuñjīta pakṣayor ubhayor api |
vanasthayatidharmo ’yaṃ śuklām eva sadā gṛhī || iti |
tan mandaṃ vaiṣṇavānām evopavāsa ity atra pramāṇābhāvāt | na ca ta vrataṃ vaiṣṇavam iti pramāṇaṃ, tasya viṣṇusaṃbandhakīrtanamukhenaikādaśyupavāsapraśaṃsārthatvāt,
vaiṣṇavo vātha vā śaivo kuryād ekādaśīvratam ||
iti matsyapurāṇavacanavirodhāt, vaiṣṇavasya gṛhiṇaḥ putriṇor unmāṅgādeḥ kṛṣṇaikādaśyām upavāsaśravaṇāc ca |
“śuklām eva sadā gṛhī" iti na kāmyam ity arthaḥ, anyathā vihitapratiṣedhe vikalpaprasaṅgāt tena sarveṣām ubhayaikādaśyāṃ nityavratopavāsādhikāra iti uktam iti |
tad ayuktaṃ |
putravāṃś ca sabhāryaś ca bandhuyuktas tathaiva ca |
ubhayoḥ pakṣayoḥ kāmyaṃ vrataṃ kuryāt tu vaiṣṇavam || iti |
putravato gṛhasthasya niṣiddhakṛṣṇaikādaśyupavāsasya kāmyavratapratiprasavasmarayāt, bhaviṣyottare kṛṣṇena putravato gṛhasthasya yudhiṣṭhirasya kāmyobhayadvādaśīvratopadeśāc ca kāmyatve ’pi vihitatvena vikalpaprasaṅgasya tadavasthatvāc ca | tasmād vikalpabhayāt paryudāsa evāyaṃ “nānuyājeṣu ye yajāmahaṃ karotītivat | na ca paryudāse lakṣaṇeti nirūpitaṃ, na ca niṣedho ’yam udāhṛta iti vacanasya paryudāsatvanirākaraṇārthatvaṃ, [190] tannimittopavāsasyety atra tātparyāt | tenāyam anuvādaḥ san nañarthatvasāmyāt paryudāsaviṣayaḥ, gṛhiṇaḥ putravato rukmāṅgadasyobhayaikādaśyupavāsasmaraṇam uktavākyaparyālocanayā kāmyaviṣayam iti jñeyam | tasmāt putravato gṛhasthasya kāmyakṛṣṇaikādaśyupavāsaviṣayo niṣedhaḥ kiṃ tu nityaikādaśyupavāsaviṣaya iti siddham |
athaikādaśyāṃ śrāddhaprāptāv upavāsakartavyatocyate |
tatra,
vyatīpāte kṛte śrāddhe putrī nopavaset gṛhī |
iti, tathā,
śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā tu yo vipro na bhuṅkte pitṛsevitam |
havir devā na gṛhṇanti kavyāni pitaras tathā ||
ityādinā | yas tu śrāddhadine upavāsaniṣedhaḥ sa ekādaśyupavāsavyatiriktaviṣayaḥ |
tathā ca vṛddhayājñavalkyaḥ |
upavāso yadā nityaḥ śrāddhaṃ naimittikaṃ bhavet |
upavāsaṃ tadā kuryād āghrāya pitṛsevitam ||
mātāpitroḥ kṣaye prāpte bhaved ekādaśī yadi |
abhyarcya pitṛdevāṃś ca ājighret pitṛsevitam ||
brahmavaivarte |
upavāsadinaṃ prāpya yadā bhavati nārada |
pitṛśrāddham athānyad vā tadā kāryaṃ ca tac chṛṇu ||
vratabhaṅge mahāpāpaṃ bhuktaśeṣaṃ tu bhojayet |
[191]        śeṣam annaṃ kuleṣṭebhyo bhoktavyaṃ tu sahaiva tu ||
tatra yat tu prakartavyaṃ tac chruṇuṣva mayeritam |
sarvam annaṃ samuddhṛtya dakṣiṇena kareṇa tu ||
prāṇāghrāṇaṃ tu kartavyaṃ vratabhaṅgo 'nyathā bhavet |
akṛtena muniśreṣṭha prāṇāghrāṇena nārada ||
śrāddhalopaḥ kṛtas tena mātṛhā pitṛhā bhavet |
evaṃ jñātvā tu vidvadbhir upāyaś cintito dvijaiḥ ||
skandapurāṇe |
yasmin dine pituḥ śrāddhaṃ mātur vātha bhaved guha |
tasminn eva dine tāta bhaved ekādaśīvratam ||
anyatrāpi vrataṃ skanda tadā kāryaṃ ca tac chṛṇu |
na lupyate tathā śrāddham upavāso 'tha vā guha ||
iti vipratipanne 'rthe upāyaḥ paramo mataḥ |
iṣṭo hitārthaṃ sarveṣāṃ narāṇāṃ śikhivāhana ||
śrāddhadinaṃ samāsādya upavāso yadā bhavet |
tadā kṛtvā tu vai śrāddhaṃ bhuktaśeṣaṃ tu yad bhavet ||
tat sarvaṃ dakṣiṇe pāṇau gṛhītvānnaṃ śikhidhvaja |
avajighraty anenārthaḥ tena śrāddhaṃ śikhidhvaja |
pitṝṇāṃ tṛptidaṃ tāta vratabhaṅgo na vidyate ||
śrāddhe janmadine caiva saṃkrāntyāṃ rāhusūtake |
upavāsaṃ na kurvīta yadīcchec chreya ātmanaḥ ||
tatra śrāddhagrahaṇaṃ pūrvavākyaparyālocanayā ekādaśīvyatiriktaviṣayaṃ [192] draṣṭavyam | 'saṃkrāntyām iti tatprayuktopavāsaniṣedhaḥ, 'janmadina' ity api sāhacaryāt ekādaśīvyatiriktaviṣayaḥ |
apare tu rāgaprāptopavāsaviṣayatām āhuḥ |
vṛddhiṃ kṛtvā tu ṣaṇmāsān nopavāso vidhīyate |
ity etad gṛhītavrataviṣayam iti prāñcaḥ |
agṛhītam apy āvaśyakaṃ kāryam ity apare |
anye tu rāgaprāptopavāsaviṣayam iti vadanti |
tan na “nopavāso vidhīyate” iti vākyānanuguṇatvāt |
athāsya vratasya sūtakādāv api kartavyatocyate |
tatra viṣṇurahasye |
paramāpadam āpanne harṣe vā samupasthite |
sūtake mṛtake caiva na tyājyaṃ dvādaśīvratam || iti ||
atra vārāhapurāṇoktaviśeṣaḥ |
sūtake tu naraḥ snātvā praṇamya manasā harim |
ekādaśyāṃ na bhuñjīta vratam evaṃ na lupyate ||
ekādaśyāṃ tato bhuktvā sūtakānte janārdanam|
pūjayitvā vidhānena pūjayec ca dvijottamān ||
mṛtake tu na bhuñjīta ekādaśyāṃ sadā naraḥ |
dvādaśyāṃ tu samaśnīyāt snātvā viṣṇuṃ praṇamya ca || iti ||
pūrvasaṃkalpitaṃ yat tu vrataṃ suniyatavrataiḥ |
tat kartavyaṃ naraiḥ śrāddhadānārcanavivarjitam ||
atha daśamīniyamāḥ skandapurāṇe |
[193]        kāṃsyaṃ māṃsaṃ masūraṃ ca kṣaudraṃ vānṛtabhāṣaṇam |
punarbhojanam abhyāsaṃ daśamyāṃ parivarjayet ||
kūrmapurāṇe |
kāṃśyaṃ maṃsaṃ masūraṃ ca caṇakān koradūṣakān |
śākaṃ madhu parānnaṃ ca tyajed upavasan striyam ||
'upavasan' upavākṣaṃ kariṣyann ity arthaḥ | tataś ca daśamyām eva niyamaḥ kāryaḥ | tathā |
kāṃsyaṃ māṃsaṃ masūraṃ ca punarbhojanamaithune |
dyūtam atyambupānaṃ ca daśamyāṃ saptamaṃ tyajet ||
kvacid dyūtapadasthāne ghṛtapadaṃ ca padyate ||
devalaḥ |
daśamyām ekabhaktaṃ ca māṃsamaithunavarjitam |
ekādaśyām upavaśet pakṣayor ubhayor api ||
matsyapurāṇe |
kāṃsyaṃ māṃsaṃ surāṃ kṣaudraṃ tailaṃ vitathabhāṣaṇam |
vyāyāmaṃ ca pravāsaṃ ca divāsvāpaṃ tathārjanam |
tilapiṣṭaṃ masūraṃ ca dvādaśaitāni saṃtyajet ||
smṛtāv api |
daśamyām ekabhaktaṃ tu kurvīta niyatendriyaḥ |
ācamya dantakāṣṭhaṃ tu khādayet tadanantaram ||
tataś cānantaraṃ vipra brahmacārī jitendriyaḥ |
rātriṃ nayet tataḥ paścāt prātaḥsnāyī samāhitaḥ |
[194]        upavāsaṃ tu saṃkalpya mantrapūtaṃ jalaṃ pibet ||
athopavāsadinaniyamāḥ |
tatropavāsasvarūpaṃ vṛddhavasiṣṭha-kātyāyana-viṣṇudharmottareṣu |
upāvṛtasya pāpebhvo yas tu vāsoguṇaiḥ saha |
upavāsaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ sarvabhogavivarjitaḥ || iti |
'pāpebhyaḥ' parivarjanīyebhyaḥ | 'upāvṛtasya' nivṛttasyety arthaḥ |
tatra varjanīyāny āha sumantuḥ |
vihitasyānanuṣṭhānam indriyāṇām anigrahaḥ |
niṣiddhasevaṇaṃ nityaṃ varjanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ ||
hārītaḥ |
patitapāṣaṇḍanāstikādisaṃbhāṣaṇānṛtādikam upavāsadine varjanīyam || iti | ādigrahaṇena hiṃsendriyacāpalādi gṛhyate |
guṇāḥ viṣṇudharmottare uktāḥ |
tajjapyatajjapadhyānatatkathāśravaṇādikam |
tadarcanaṃ ca tannāmakīrtanaśravaṇādayaḥ |
upavāsakṛtā hy ete guṇāḥ proktā manīṣibhiḥ ||
viṣṇudharmeṣu |
upavāsī hariṃ yas tu bhaktyā dhyāyati mānavaḥ |
tajjāpyajāpī tatkarmaratas tadgatamānasaḥ |

[197]        saṃpūjya devadeveśaṃ bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ |
ahorātraṃ kṣiped dhīmān upavāsaphalāptaye ||

ekabhaktena yo mārtya upavāsavrataṃ caret |

upoṣya naktena vibho catvāraḥ kujasaṃyutāḥ |

[199]        tad uktaṃ viṣṇudharmeṣu |
pāṣaṇḍibhir asaṃsparśaṃ samambhāṣaṇam eva ca |
viṣṇor ārādhanaparair naiva kāryam upoṣitaiḥ ||
viṣṇupurāṇe ca |
tasmāt pāṣaṇḍibhiḥ pāpair ālāpasparśane tyajet |

vedabāhyāgamavihitakāriṇaḥ pāṣaṇḍinaḥ teṣāṃ darśane prāyaścittam uktam |
viṣṇupurāṇe |
tasyāvalokanāt sūryaṃ paśyeta matimān naraḥ |
saṃsprśe prāyaścittam uktaṃ viṣṇudharmeṣu |
saṃsparśe tu budhaḥ snātvā śucir ādityadarśanāt |
sambhāṣaṇe ca prāyaścittam uktaṃ tatraiva 1
saṃbhāṣya tān śucipadaṃ cintayed acyutaṃ budhaḥ |
idaṃ codāharet samyak kṛtvā tatpravaṇaṃ manaḥ ||
śārīram antaḥkaraṇopaghātaṃ
vācaṃ ca viṣṇur bhagavān aśeṣam |
śaman nayatvā mameha sarvaṃ

[200]        śamaṃ nayatv anantātmā viṣṇuś cetasi saṃsthitaḥ ||
etat sambhāṣya japtavyaṃ pāṣaṇḍibhir upoṣitaiḥ |
namaḥ śucipadety uktvā sūryaṃ paśyeta dīkṣitaḥ || iti |
kecit kāyikavācikamānasikaniyamalope prāyaścittam idaṃ viduḥ |
tan mandaṃ pramāṇābhāvāt | na ca mantraliṅgaṃ pramāṇaṃ, tasya vākyād durbalatvena vākyavirodhe saty apramāṇatvāt viruddhaṃ ca vākyaṃ "etat saṃbhāṣya japtavyam" ityādi | vācikalope prāyaścittam idam āha yājñavalkyaḥ |
yadi vākyasya lopaḥ syāt snānadānajapādiṣu |

tathā ca kātyāyanaḥ |
brahmacaryasamāyuktam upavāsaṃ caren naraḥ |
'upavāsakś ca vrataṃ | vrate brahmacaryādicatuṣṭayaṃ kāryam |
tathā ca devalaḥ |

upavāsadūṣakāni sa evāha |

iti, tat puṇyake strīviṣayam iti |
atha dvādaśīniyamāḥ |
tatrāha kātyāyanaḥ |

[202]        snānārcanakriyā kāryā dānahomādisaṃyutā ||

bṛhaspatir api |

[204]        kṣaudraṃ māṃsaṃ surāṃ tailaṃ vyāyāmaṃ krodhamaithune |
parānnaṃ kāṃsyatāmbūle lobhaṃ nirmāyalaṅghanam |
dvādaśyāṃ dvādaśaitāni vaiṣṇavaḥ parivarjayet ||
eṣu vākyeṣu kvacit "kāmitaṃ sidhyati" iti, kvacit "upavāsaphalaprepsuḥ" iti, kvacit “upavāsaphalaṃ hanyur" iti phalasaṃbandhaḥ śrūyate teneti gamyate kāmādhikāraviṣayāṇīmāni vacanānīti, yatra punar daśamīniyamavākyeṣu na śrūyate phasasaṃbandhaḥ teṣv apy avagamyate kāmyaviṣayasāhacaryeṇa pāṭhāt, tasmāt sarvaṃ kāmyaviṣayam avasīyate |
sāyam ādyaṃ tathor ahnoḥ sāyaṃ prātas tu madhyame |
upavāsaphalaprepsur jahyād bhaktacatuṣṭayam || iti |
tatra kecid āhuḥ | anena vacanena kāmyopavāsāṅgabhaktacatuṣṭayahānir vidhīyate nityāṅge prepsugrahaṇānupapatteḥ, na hi nityeṣu phalasaṃbandham anuṣṭhānam iti |
tad anupapannaṃ aṅgatve pramāṇābhāvāt | iha hi vākyaprakaraṇe saṃbhāvyete, pramāṇāntaraṃ tu śaṅkāspadam api na bhavati, na tāvat prakaraṇenāṅgatvaṃ, tathā hi phalavatsaṃnidhāv aphalaṃ tadaṅgaṃ bhavati | na ca bhaktacatuṣṭayahānasya phalepsuśabdena phalakāmaśabdaparyāyeṇa saṃbadhyamānasyāphalatvaṃ śakyate vaktuṃ | tasmān na prakaraṇenāṅgatvam | nāpi vākyena, vākyaṃ hy upavāsaphalena saṃbandham āha na punar upavāsena kāmyamānārthatayaiva kriyamāṇaṃ, svarasavṛttyā saṃbandhāvagamāt | atas tasyopavāsaphalenaiva sambandhaḥ | tad api na, putrapaśvādyaviśeṣitasya phalasāmānyasyānapekṣitatvena tatsandhāyogāt | athopavāsaphalaprepsur ity upavāsaviśeṣaṇasāmarthyād evopavāsasya yaḥ phalaviśeṣas [205] tena sambhraṃsyata ityucyate |
tan na | upavāsaviśeṣitena cet phalaviśeṣeṇa sambaamtsyata ity ucyate | tan na | upavāsaviśeṣitena cet phalaviśeṣeṇa saṃbandhas tarhi tasyopavāsaphasasambandhavidhāyakavākyapramitipūrvakatvāt tadvirodhitayopavāsasādhanake phale sādhanāntaraṃ vidhātuṃ na śakyate, svayaṃ tadadhīnatvena tena saha vikalpasamuccayayor asaṃbhavāt | astu tarhi guṇaphalasaṃbandhakalpanam upavāsasya, yādṛśaḥ phalaviśeṣas tādṛśaphalaprepsur jahyād bhaktacatuṣṭayam iti, tad api na phalaśabdasya tādṛśaphalalakṣaṇāprasaṅgāt, tasmād guṇaphalasaṃbandha evetthaṃ vaktavyaḥ | upavāsasādhyam eva phalaṃ yadā prakṛṣṭataram iṣyate tadā jahyād bhaktacatuṣṭayam iti | yathā jyotiṣṭomasādhyaphalātiśayārthinām udgīthādyupāsanaṃ vidhīyate tadvad atrāpi | evaṃ sati phalaprepsur iti praśabdo ’pi prakarṣavācakatayārthavān bhavati |
nanu bhaktahānasya svayaṃ kriyātmakatvāt kriyāntaram asādhayataḥ kathaṃ phalāya vidhānam | yathā vāravantīyasāmno gītikriyātmakasya prakṛtaṃ yāgam asādhayataḥ phalasaṃbandhāyogāt viśiṣṭavidhānam āśritaṃ |
ucyate, siddharūpasya kārakasya kriyām asādhayataḥ phalaprayojakatvāyogāt prakṛtakriyāniṣpaytir dvārabhūtāpekṣyeta yathā godohanasya, kriyāyāṃ tu svayam eva kriyātmakatvāt na kriyāntaraniṣpādanāpekṣā, kiṃ tu tadupajīvanena vinā phalasādhakatvāyogāt tadāśrayavyapadeśaṃ labhate |
nanu kāmasaṃyogam antareṇāpi daśamyām ekabhaktaṃ praiṣarūpeṇa vacanena vidhīyate, tad yathā |
prātar haridinaṃ lokās tiṣṭhadhvaṃ vaikabhojanā iti |
ucyate kārttikaśuklaikādaśīviṣayaṃ tat naikādaśīmātraviṣayaṃ tatprakaraṇapāṭhāt, yena tatraivam āha |

athaikādaśīnirṇayaḥ |

[207]        prakārāntareṇa saṃpūrṇatvam upariṣṭād vakṣyāmaḥ | sampūrṇaikādaśī ca viddhā dvādaśyām asatī satī ca, tatrādyā sarvair upoṣyā trayodaśyāṃ dvādaśyabhāve satīti nirvivādam | trayodaśyāṃ dvādaśīsadbhāve kecid āhuḥ ekādaśyām upavāso na dvādaśyāṃ ekādaśīlakṣaṇasya mukhyakālasya dvādaśyām abhāvāt, ekādaśīkāryakaratayā hi na dvādaśī grāhyā mukhyakālasaṃbhave hi tatkāryakaratvaṃ kālāntarasya nopapadyate |
yat tu vacanam,
ekādaśī tv ahorātraṃ dvādaśī ca kalādhikā |
trayodaśyāṃ yadā prātar upoṣyā dvādaśī tadā ||

viddhāpy aviddhā vijñeyā parato dvādaśī na cet |
aviddhāpi tathā viddhā parato dvādaśī yadi ||
iti padmapurāṇavacanāt |
tathā ca viṣṇupurāṇe |

atha vaikādaśī nāsti daśamyā vātha saṃyutā ||
kalātha kāṣṭhā dvādaśyā yadi syād apare ’hani |

[208]        tad uktaṃ viṣṇurahasye “pāraṇānaṃ vrataṃ jñeyam” iti, tena śuddhadvādaśyām upavāso ’vasīyate, na cotpattiśiṣṭaikādaśyuparodhadoṣaḥ, mukhāntareṇa tatra dvādaśīpraveśābhidhānāt | ye uparitanaikādaśīviṣayam evedaṃ vacanam ūcire te prakaraṇānabhijñāḥ | “atha vaikādaśī nāstīty api hy atra prakṛtam | ye ca daśamīviddhaikādaśīviṣayam eveti te 'pi tathā, “daśamyā cātha saṃyuteti tatra prakṛtatvāt dvitīyaikādaśyupavāse viddhaikādaśyupavāsena śūddhadvādaśyupavāse ca parato dvādaśīsadbhāvasyāprayojakatāyā vakṣyamāṇatvāc ca | yathoktaviṣayam idaṃ vacanam |
skandapurāṇe |

tadā hy ekādaśīṃ tyaktvā dvādaśīṃ samupoṣayet ||

'uttarā' dvādaśī, 'sadṛśī ' saśeṣā, trayodaśyām api syād ity arthaḥ, 'pūrvā' ekādaśī, 'pūrvavat' daśamīvad anupoṣyety arthaḥ |

ityādivacanāni |
upoṣyā dvādaśī śuddhā dvādaśyām eva pāraṇam |
[210]        nirgatā cet trayodaśyāṃ kalā vā dvikalāpi vā ||
dvikalāyāṃ tu dvādaśyāṃ pāraṇaṃ yaḥ karoti hi |
tām upoṣya mahīpāla ma garbhe viśate naraḥ ||
saṃpūrṇaikādaśī yatra dvādaśī cāpare ’hani |
tatropoṣyā dvādaśī syād dvādaśyām eva pāraṇam |
na garbhe viśate jantur ity āha bhagavān hariḥ ||
ityādivacanaparyālocanayā mumukṣuviṣayāṇi | gṛhimumukṣuvyatiriktānāṃ kutropavāsa iti saṃdehe |
bahuvākyavirodhena saṃdeho jāyate yadā |
dvādaśī tu tadā grāhyā trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam ||
iti smṛter dvādaśyām upavāsaḥ | ekādaśyāṃ tu vedhābhāve (?) sati dvādaśyāṃ vā abhāve dvādaśyās trayodaśyām abhāve dvādaśyupavāsanimittābhāvena saṃdehābhāvāt |
dvikasyāyāṃ tu dvādaśyāṃ pāraṇaṃ yaḥ karoti hi |
iti ca kalādvayaparyāptadvādaśīsadbhāve dvādaśīmadhyapāraṇavidhānād asaṃpūrṇakalādvayadvādaśīsadbhāve trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam ity upapatter aviddhaikādaśyā dvādaśyām abhāve dvādaśyās tu trayodaśyāṃ sadbhāve gṛhimumukṣuvyatiriktānāṃ tatraivopavāse gṛhiyativad ekādaśyām upavāse niścayahetvabhāvāt “na garbhe viśate jantur" itivac ca dvādaśyupavāsaniścayahetvabhāvāt saṃdehe sati ekādaśyām upavāse “atha vaikādaśī nāstīti bahuvākyavirodhāpatteḥ dvādaśī grāhyety arthaḥ | bahuvākyavirodhasyāpi [211] viṣayavyavasthayā parihārasaṃbhave vyavasthāniścayena saṃdehābhāvād asaṃbhave tv atulyabalavattve balavadanusāreṇa niścayopapatteḥ saṃdehābhāvāt tulyabalavattve vikalpaniścayena saṃdehābhāvād viṣayavyavasthādyanālocanāt kathaṃcit saṃdehotpattāvasthāpy adṛṣṭārthasmṛtitvāviśeṣeṇaikatarapakṣaniścayāyogād bahuvākyakṛtasaṃdehāpanayanārthatvenaitadvākyavyākhyā na yuktā |
bahuvākyavirodhena brāhmaṇeṣu vivādiṣu |
ekādaśīṃ parityajya dvādaśīṃ samupoṣayet ||
ity eṣā smṛtir gṛhimumukṣuvyatiriktavidhavādīnāṃ vyavasthā, ekavākyatvābhāvena vivādiṣu viparītavādiṣv ekādaśyām upavāsavādiṣu brāhmaṇeṣu bahuvākyavirodhāpatter vidhavādir ekādaśīṃ parityajya dvādaśīm upavased ity arthaḥ | bahuvākyavirodho yeṣāṃ te bahuvākyavirodhā iti bahuvrīhiḥ
saṃdigdheṣu ca vākyeṣu dvādaśīṃ samupoṣayet |
ity api vacanaṃ yasmin vidhavādiviṣaye "atha vaikādaśī nāstītyādi vākyāni saṃdigdhāni sa vidhavādir dvādaśīṃ samupoṣayed iti vyākhyeyaṃ |
tad ayukaṃ, “udayāt prāg yadā vipretivacanaparyālocanayā gṛhivyatiriktānām uttaratropavāsapratīteḥ | yad api " bahuvākyavirodhenetyādivacanavyākhyānaṃ tad api vacanānārjavādayuktaṃ tithipramāṇe jyotiḥśāstravipratipatteḥ daśamīvedhasaṃdehaviṣayatvenārjavopapatteś ca | yad api mārkaṇḍeya-pradyumna-
saṃvādavacanam |

[212]        iti, tad apy uktavedhaviṣayatvena vyākhyeyam | yad vā yo viṣayavyavasthāṃ niścetuṃ na śaknoti tadviṣayāṇi, tathā “saṃdigdheṣu ca vākyeṣu” ity uktam, aviddhaikādaśyupavāsamātreṇa mokṣāṣiddheḥ “na garbhe viśate jantur" ity asyārthavādatvāt | sattvaśuddhidvāreṇopayogitā gṛhasthādiṣv aviśiṣṭeti na phalaparatve ’pi bādhaḥ, tasmād yathoktam eva sādhīyaḥ | dvitīyāpi trayodaśyām avidyamānadvādaśikā vidyamānadvādaśikā vā, tatrādyāyām vyavasthā |
tathā ca kūrmapurāṇe |

punaḥ prabhātasamaye ghaṭikaikā yadā bhavet |
atropavāso vihitaś caturthāśramavāsinām |
vidhavāpi ca tatraiva parato dvādaśī na cet ||
atra caśabdena vanasthādigrahaṇam |
pracetāḥ |
ekādaśī vivṛddhā cec chuklapakṣe viśeṣataḥ |

[213]        lupyate dvādaśī tasminn upavāsaḥ kathaṃ bhavet |
upoṣye dve tithī tatra viṣṇuprīṇanatatparaiḥ ||
tasmiṃs trayodaśe tv ahni yadā dvādaśī nāsti tadā pūrvoktagṛhasthāśramicaturthāśramyadhikārabhedena dve tithī upoṣye na tv ekaivety arthaḥ |
apare tu tithidvayopavāsaparatvenaiva vyācakṣate | anyathāpy adhikāribhedakalpanāprasaṅgāt itaretarayogavihitadvandvāpavādaikaśeṣadarśanād itaretarayuktatithidvayasyopoṣyatvapratīteś ca viṣṇuprītikāmasyādhikāriṇo ’pi śruteś ca | na ca tithidvayayuktaṃ dinam ekam upoṣyam iti vyākhyā yuktā, tithiśabdasya tadekadeśe lakṣaṇāprasaṅgāt |
skandapurāṇe ’pi |
prathame ’hni saṃpūrṇā vyāpyāhorātram āsthitā |
dvādaśyāṃ ca tathā tāta dṛśyate punar eva ca ||
ghaṭikā ca pradṛśyeta dvādaśyāṃ śikhivāhana |
pūrvā kāryā gṛhasthais tu yatibhiś ca tathā vibho |
dvādaśīsaṃyutā kāryā sadā vai mokṣakāṅkṣibhiḥ ||
etadvacanaparyālocanayā "punaḥ prabhātasamaye" iti vacane ahorātravyāpinyāṃ saṃpūrṇāyāṃ dvitīyadinavidyamānaikaghaṭikāyāṃ ityādivyavasthokteti pratīyate, na tv aruṇodayād ārabhyāruṇodayaṃ yāvad avasthitodayāt prāg iti vākye saṃpūrṇā vivakṣitā | “punaḥ prabhātasamaya" iti cāruṇodaye vidyamānaikaghaṭikāyām ityādivyavasthoktā | yadi sūryodaya uttarāvadhiḥ tadā aruṇodayavācī prabhātaśabdo nopapadyate, tathā hi “pratyūṣoharmukhaṃ kalyam uṣaḥpratyūṣasī api prabhātaṃ cetyādinā amarahiṃhādibhiḥ [214] prabhātaśabdo ’bhihitaḥ, sa cāruṇodayavācī pratyūṣaparyāyaḥ, alpāyām atheti dvādaśīniyamadarśanāvasarapaṭhitanāradīyavākaye ca aruṇodayasnānam ity abhidhāya pratyūṣe “snānam ācared" ity upasaṃhārāt | tathā yadā bhavatīti tatraiva paṭhite pādmavacane uṣaḥkāle snānādi kāryam ity abhihitam | “alpāyām atheti" bhaviṣyatpurāṇavākye aruṇodaye, tenāruṇodayavācyuṣaḥśabdaparyyāyaḥ prabhātaśabdas tadvacanas tathā | “parato dvādaśī na ced" iti nopapadyate paramavṛddher anantaradine ṣaḍghaṭikāntakṣayasya jyotiḥśāstraprasiddhatvād ity ucyate yathā “punaḥ prabhātasamaya iti vākyaṃ “prathame’ hni tu saṃpūrṇety etadvacanasamānārthaṃ saṃbhavet tadaitanmūlabhūtayaiva śrutyopapatter na mūlāntarakalpanā | anyathā sā syād bhavatpakṣe ca samayaśabdavaiyarthyam, asmatpakṣe ca prabhātasamaya iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāśrayaṇān na kaścid doṣaḥ | ata eva “prabhāte punar eva seti vacanāni tatsamānāni, prabhāta iti ca saptamī, prabhātasamaya iti karmadhārayapakṣe "sarvā hy etāś ca saṃpūrṇā" ityādivākaye uktottarāvadhityāge kāraṇābhāvāc ca | na ca harivāsaravarjitā iti kāraṇaṃ vācyaṃ, gauravaprasaṅgāt anyathāpy upapatteś ca saṃpūrṇatithiṣu ṣaṣṭighaṭikātmakatvavat sūryodayarūpottarāvadher api darśanāc ca | na ca "ādityodayavelāyām' iti vacanaṃ pratipāditaṃ ṣaṣṭighaṭikātmakatvam eva bādhitam avasthitaṃ vācyam | ubhayāvadhitve saṃpūrṇaśabdasyānekārthatvāpātāt ṣaṣṭighaṭikātmakatvāvabodhe ca pūrvoktadoṣaprasaṅgāt ākāṅkṣitavācyaviśeṣanirṇayārthatvena "udayāt prāg" iti "ādityodayavelāyām" iti vacanadvayasya dinadvaye ’py udayāt prācīnamuhūrttadvaye vidyamānā saṃpūrṇety etadarthaparatvena vyākhyānopapatteś ca | tena dvividhaikādaśī [215] saṃpūrṇā ahorātrayāpinī aruṇodayād ārabhya dvitīyasūryodayaparyantam avasthitā ca | tatrāpi sarvatithisādhāraṇaḥ pūrvasyāṃ saṃpūrṇaśabdo mukhyaḥ na dvitīyāyāṃ anekārthatvāpātāt | udayāt prāg ghaṭikācatuṣṭaye ’pi vidyamānāyāḥ saṃpūrṇety abhidhānaṃ ca aruṇodayavedhanirākaraṇārthaṃ, harivāsaravarjitā iti ca |
apare tv āhuḥ | pūrvāvadhiyutaiva saṃpūrṇety abhidhīyate na dvitīyāvadhiniyamāgrahaḥ | asminn api pakṣe vyākhyā pūrvaiva pūrvanayāt |
anye tv evaṃ vyācakṣate | udayāt prāg yadi muhūrttadvayaṃ sā cāhorātravyāpinī ca bhavati tatra “pratipatprabhṛtayaḥ pūrvā" ity anena sarvatithisādhāraṇasaṃpūrṇatvaniṣedhe prakārāntareṇa saṃpūrṇatvabubhutsāyāṃ ākākṣitapratipādanenaiva vākyasyopapatteḥ |
tathā ca mārkaṇḍeyaḥ |

nanu yatipadaṃ niyatipadayogena vartamānaṃ vanasthādikam api vadaty eva, tathā cottarasyām asyopavāsa iti cet |
na, gṛhiṇām api niyatānāṃ uttaratropavāsaprasaṅgāt | tathā ca “pūrvām upavased gṛhī" iti vacanānāñjasyaṃ syāt |
nanu gṛhivyatiriktopalacakṣaṃ yatipadam iti vanasyāder uttaratropavāsa iti cet,
maivam, anupasañjātavirodhitayā yatipadasyopalakṣakatvānupapatteḥ, pratyutopasaṃhāragatatvena gṛhipadasya yativyatiriktopalakṣakatvaṃ syāt, tathā ca “punaḥ prabhātasamaya" ityādivacanavirodhaḥ syāt |
atha gṛhī pūrvām evopavased yatir uttarām eveti vidhānaṃ tathā ca vanasthāder anyatropavāsa iti cet,
maivaṃ, “pūrvām upavased gṛhī" iti vacanasya viphalatvāpatteḥ, parato dvādaśīsadbhāvanimitto hi paradinopavāsaḥ “parato dvādaśī yadi" iti vacanāt, parato dvādaśyabhāvāt pūrvasyām ekādaśyām upavāsaḥ sarveṣāṃ prāpta iti “pūrvām upavased gṛhī" iti vacanaṃ viphalam eva syāt |
nanu vanasthādeḥ tithidvayopavāsaḥ kim iti na bhavet so ’py asminn eva viṣaye vihitaḥ |

ity upakramya |

karoti tasya naśyanti dvādaśyo dvādaśaiva tu ||
