pāraṇaṃ tu trayodaśyāṃ yaḥ karoti nṛpottama |
dvādaśa dvādaśīṃ hanti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || iti |
maivaṃ sakāmaviṣayatvāt trayodaśīpāraṇaniṣedhavacanānāṃ, tathā yasyām ekādaśyām upavāse trayodaśīpāraṇaṃ prasajyate tāṃ sakāmo nopavased iti | uktaniṣedhavacanānāṃ niṣkāmaviṣayatve trayodaśīpāraṇavidhānānāṃ nirviṣayatvāpatteḥ tena niṣkāmaviṣayās trayodaśīpāraṇavidhayaḥ |
[219]        tathā gāruḍapurāṇe |
pāraṇaṃ tu trayodaśyāṃ kartavyam aphalārthibhiḥ |
skandapurāṇe ’pi |
pāraṇaṃ tu trayodaśyāṃ niṣkāmāṇāṃ vimuktidam | iti |
tasmād gṛhiyatipade na yathāśrute |
brahmapurāṇe |
śuddhā caikādaśī yatra tathā viddhā tu dvādaśī |
svargado poṣitā pūrvā uttarā svargamoksadā ||
trayodaśyāṃ vidyamānā dvādaśī kācid uttaraiva sarvair upoṣyā |
tathā ca bhṛguḥ |
saṃpūrṇaikādaśī yatra prabhāte punar eva sā |
uttarāṃ tu yatiḥ kuryāt uttarā svargamokṣadā ||
trayodaśyāṃ vidyamānā dvādaśī kācid uttaraiva sarvair upoṣyā |
tathā ca bhṛguḥ |
saṃpūrṇaikādaśī yatra prabhāte punar eva sā |
uttarāṃ tu yatiḥ kuryāt pūrvām upavaset gṛhī ||
ity ekaṃ vākyam |
saṃpūrṇaikādaśī yatra prabhāte punar eva sā |
tatropoṣyā dvitiyā tu parato dvādaśī yadi ||
ity aparam |
tatra kecid evaṃ vyācakṣate pūrvaśloke vidhidvayaṃ tatraivekena vidhinā gṛhasthasya viśeṣeṇa pūrvaikādaśī niyamyate, apareṇottaraikādaśī [220] yater niyamyate | evaṃ gṛhasthasya viśeṣavihitāṃ prathamaikādaśīṃ upoṣya tṛtīyadinadvādaśīsadbhāvaviṣayaikādaśī vidhīyata iti |
tad anupapannam | tathā hi dvādaśadādaśīvākye gṛhasthapadaṃ tāvan na śrūyate |
tatra kena viśeśeṇa tad gṛhassthaviṣayaṃ gṛhyate viṣayāntarābhāvād iti cet |
yativiṣayaṃ kasmān na bhavati | atha yativiṣayaikādaśyā vacanāntaravihitatvena punar dvādaśīvākyam apy uttaraikādaśīvidhānārtham eva sad anarthakaṃ prāpnoti tādrūpyaparicinnatvena pramitiprajananāśakter iti |
ucyate gṛhasthe ’pi tarhi pūrvaikādaśyavirodhād uttaraikādaśī vidhātuṃ na śakyate tadviparyayaparicchinnatvena virodhāt | pramitijananānupapatter ānarthakyasya tadavasthatvāt | atha virodhe ’pi dvādaśīvacanasya viśeṣavidhitvena bādhakatvāt sārthakyam ucyate, tatra viśeṣavidhitvam eva tāvan nāstīti vakṣyāmi, astu vā viśeṣavidhitvaṃ, tathāpi na tāvat punaruktatayā gamayituṃ śakayata eva viśeṣavidhitvenaiva sāmānyaprāptottarekādaśyupasaṃhāratayā sārthakatvasaṃbhavāt | tathā hi yat yater uttaraikādaśīvidhānaṃ tad uparidvādaśīsadbhāvaviṣaya eva nānyatreti |
nanūpasaṃhāre upasaṃhriyamāṇasaṃkocāpatter asāmañjasyaṃ |
hantāpavāde ’py apavādyamānasyāsāmañjasyam eva |
nanu "dvādaśī na ced" iti tasya nirviṣayatvāpatter gṛhivākyasyāsāmañjasye ’py apavādo ’ṅgīkriyate |
hanta tata eva hetor yatiśāstrasyopasaṃhāraḥ |
nanv apavādapakṣe tūtsargāpavādābhyāṃ mahān vivayo vyāpyate upasaṃhāre tv alpaviṣayatā prāpnoti |
satyam alpaviṣayatā nāma ko ’yaṃ doṣaḥ pratyutākṣepalāghavād guṇa eva | yas tu saṃkocāpattyā bādha ity ucyate sa upavāsapakṣe 'py aviśiṣṭa ity uktam eva |
nanūpasaṃhāro nāma sāmānyapravṛttasya śāstrasya [221] tadantarvārtanā (?) viśeṣaśāstreṇa kriyate, yathā nārabhyādhītaṃ sāptadaśyaṃ sarvaprakṛtīṣṭisādhāraṇam adhvarakalpādiviśeṣaviṣayeṇa sāptadaśyaśāstreṇopasaṃhriyate | dvādaśīvākyaṃ tu na yatiśāstrāvāntaro viśeṣaḥ yatyayatisādhāraṇatvena pratīteḥ, tatra katham upasaṃhāraḥ, evaṃ tarhy apavādo ’pi sāmānyaviśeṣeṇa bhavati | yathā yad āhāhavanīye juhotīty asyāpsu juhoti ityanena, dādaśīvākyaṃ tu na gṛhasthaśāstrāvāntaro viśeṣaḥ gṛhasthāgṛhasthasādhāraṇatvāt, viśeṣo nāma sa bhavati yaḥ sāmānyaviṣayād bahir ivarttate, tasmān nāpavādakatvam | atha gatyabhāvād dvādaśīvākyasya gṛhasthaśastrāvāntaraviṣayatvaṃ kalpayitvāpavādaḥ kriyate, hanta yatiśāstrāvāntāraviyatāṃ kalpayitvopasaṃhāraḥ kathaṃ nāma neṣyate |
nanv apavādapakṣe utsargāpavādayor viṣayadvayasadbhāvād vākyadvayaṃ sārthakaṃ, upasaṃhārapakṣe upasasaṃhṛtaikaviṣayatvād vākyadayam anarthakaṃ prāpnoti |
satyaṃ viṣaṣadayābhāve ’pi vidhidvayasadbhāvāt sārthakataiva | tathāpi upasaṃhriyamāṇaṃ svarūpam ekena vidhīyate tad upasaṃhārasvarūpareṇa |
nanu “brāhmaṇebhyo dadhi dīyatām" ity asya śāstrasya “gargebhyo dīyatām" ity upasaṃhārakaṃ, tatra gargaśāstramātre sati yāvadanuṣṭhānaṃ tāvad eva brāhmaṇaśāstre ’pi sati tathāpi gargaviṣaya evopanimajjanāt gargadadhidānānuṣṭhānānatirekāt | tasmād brāhmaṇaśāstraṃ mandaprayojanam | apavādapakṣe tu na viśeṣaśāstreṇa brāhmaṇebhyo dadhi sidhyati | nāpi sāmānyaśāstramātreṇa kauṇḍinyāya takraṃ prāpyate tasmāc chāstradvayaṃ saprayojanam iti |
ucyate upasaṃhārapakṣe śāstradvayam arthavat ekena dadhi vidhīyate gargasaṃbandho ’pareṇa, sāptadaśyādāv avaśyānārabhyādhītena vākyena sāptadāśyasya dvārabhūtasāmidhenīsaṃbandhaḥ kathyate, [222] ataḥ śāstradvayam arthavat | yat tu viśeṣaśāstre sati yāvadanuṣṭhānaṃ tāvad evobhayasminn api satīty ānarthakyam ucyate, na dadhnā juhotītyādāv api śakyaṃ vaktum | tathā hi agnihotraṃ juhotīty utpattividhim aṅgīkṛtya dadhnā juhotīty asmin viśiṣṭavidhāv āśrīyamāṇe yāvadanuṣṭhānaṃ tāvad evotpattiḥ viniyogabhedenobhayaminn āśrīyamāṇe ’pīty utpattividhir anarthakaḥ prāpnoti | tasmād ekaikavidhānenānekaśātropapattau naikamastake bahubhāraḥ āropaṇīya iti, pratyutānuṣṭhānabhedam ākṣipatoḥ śāstayor vā saprayojanatvaṃ labhyate, tad eva tarhi sāmyaṃ tasmād apavādopasaṃhārayor anyatarānavadhāraṇād ubhayaparatve vākyabhedaprasaṅgāt na dvādaśīvākyasyaitadviṣayatm iti sarvadaiva gṛhasthasya pūrvaikādaśī yater uttaraiveti siddham |
dvādaśīvākyasya tarhi ko viṣayaḥ atra brūmaḥ tathā hi vānaprasthādayaḥ kiṃ pūrvām upavaseyuḥ utottarāṃ athobhayām iti saṃdehe vyavasthāpyate parato dvādaśīsadbhāve uttarām upavaseyur anyathā pūrvam iti | evam apekṣitārthavidhānād vākyasya kṛtārthatā bhavati itarasyāpi vākyasya saṃkocaḥ pariitobhavati | tade tat trikāṇḍamaṇḍanamatam |
saṃpūrṇaikādaśī yatra prabhāte punar eva sā |
sarvair evottarā kāryā parato dvādaśī yadi ||
iti nāradavacanādarśananibandhanam ity upekṣaṇīyam |
ekādaśī viṣṇunā ced dvādaśī parataḥ sthitā |
upoṣyā dvādaśī tatra yadīcchet paramaṃ padam ||
'viṣṇuḥ' dvādaśī, sahārthe tṛtīyā dvādaśīyuktety arthaḥ |
brahmapurāṇe ’pi |
[223]        syād yadaikādaśī pūrṃā dvādaśātha tathā saha |
pare ’hani tathā kurvād dvādaśyām arcanādikam ||
asaṃpūrṇā daśamīviddhaikādaśī trividhā rātriśeṣe dvādaśīyuktā paredyur dvādaśyāṃ varttamānā ca tatrādyā sarvair upoṣyā |
tathā ca nāradaḥ |
daśamīśeṣasaṃyuktā nopoṣyā dvādaśī tithiḥ |
ekādaśyāṃ rātriśeṣe dvādaśī cen na dṛśyate ||
yadi daivāt tu saṃsidhyed ekādaśyāṃ tithitrayam |
tatra kratuśataṃ puṇyaṃ dvādaśīpāraṇe bhavet ||
kūrmapurāṇe ’pi |
dvispṛg ekādaśī yatra tatra saṃnihito hariḥ |
tām evopavaset kāmam akāmo viṣṇutatparaḥ ||
daśamīṃ dvādaśīṃ ca yā spṛśati saikādaśī 'dvispṛk' |
padmapurāṇe ’pi |
ekādaśī daśāviddhā parato na ca vardhate |
yatibhir gṛhibhiś caiva saivopośyā kṣaye tithiḥ ||
dinakṣaye ’pi śuddhadvādaśyupavāsavidhānaṃ mumukṣuviṣayam |
tathā ca sumantu-satyavratau |
dinakṣaye ’pi śuddhaiva dvādaśī mokṣakāṅkṣibhiḥ |
upoṣyā daśamīviddhā nopoṣyaikādaśī sadā ||
śāradāpurāṇe |
upoṣyā dvādaśī śuddhā ekādaśyāṃ dinakṣaye |
[224]        mumukṣubhir daśāviddhā nopoṣyaikādaśī tithiḥ ||
yat tu vacanaṃ bhaviṣatpurāṇe,
dinatrayavatī jātā tithir ekādaśī yadi |
prathamā tatra nopoṣyā upoṣyā cottarā bhavet ||
tat pūrvavākyaparyālocanayā mumukṣuviṣayam |
dinakṣaye tu saṃprāpte saṃpūrṇā vāsaradvaye |
viśūddhā dvādaśī rājan samupoṣyā bhavet sadā ||
iti viṣṇupurāṇe vacanam api tadviṣayam |
skandapurāṇe |
ekādaśyāṃ pradṛśyeta daśamī ghaṭikā api |
dvitīye ’hni na cāpnoti yadā caikādaśī tithiḥ ||
udayena sahasrāṃśos tadā kāryā ca yā tithiḥ |
tadā kāryā ca vidvadbhir daśamīsaṃyutā tithiḥ ||
tithikṣaye tu senāni na vṛddhau tu kathaṃcana |
vṛddhau parā tu kartavyā kṣaye pūrvaṃ tu kārayet ||
padmapurāṇe ’pi |
dinakṣaye mṛte devi nopoṣyā daśamīyutā |
saivopoṣyā tadā puṇyā ṣaṣṭhy ekādaśy athāṣṭamī ||
dvādaśyāṃ yadi trayodaśīty arthaḥ |
nigame ’pi |
pūrvaviddhā na kartavyā pachayekādaśacāhamau |
ekādaśīṃ tu kurvīta kṣīyate dvādaśī yadi |
[225]        apare tu pare ’hani cec chuddhā trayodaśī na dvādaśī kiṃcid asti tadā dinakṣayābhāvād dinakṣaye ’pi daśamīyutopoṣyeti sadāśabdavato vacanasyārtha ity āhuḥ | yadā tv asminn eva viṣaye dvādaśyāṃ trayodaśī nāsti kiṃ tu dvādaśyudayaparyantā tadāpi daśamīviddhaikādaśy upoṣyā | tathā ca skandapurāṇe |
ekādaśī yadā viddhā sakalā dvādaśī bhavet |
ṛṣyaśṛṅgaḥ |
ekādaśī na labhyeta sakalā dvādaśī bhavet |
anayor uttarārdham |
upoṣyā daśamīviddhā ṛṣir uddālako ’bravīt |
aviddhāni niṣiddhaiś cen na labhyante dināni tu ||
muhūrtaiḥ pañcabhir viddhā grāhyā vaikādaśī tithiḥ |
tadardhaviddhāny anyāni dināny upavased budhaḥ ||
kecid evaṃ vyācakṣate | niṣiddhair muhūrtair aviddhāni dināni (?) yadi na labhyante tadaikādaśī tribhir dvābhyāṃ vā muhūrtābhyāṃ viddhā grāhyaiva vyastayor api saṃkayor lāghavārthaṃ pañcaśabdenābhidhānaṃ, na tv etad upapadyate evaṃvidhe viṣaye dvādaśyām ekādaśīlābhāt | na ca tasyāṃ labhyamānāyām api daśamīviddhā grāhyeti kvacit kāle iti |
tad ayukaṃ daśamyām araṇodayavedhāntarbhāvena muhūrtapañcavedhaṣaḍghaṭikātmake ca kṣaye dvādaśyām ekādaśyabhāvena trayodaṣyāṃ ca dvādaśyabhāvenoktavakṣyamāṇavākyaparyālocanayā daśamīyutāyā api grahaṇopapatteḥ | tasmān na kliṣṭavyākhyāśrayaṇīyeti |
[226]        tathā |
pāraṇāhe na labhyeta dvādaśī kalayāpi cet |
tadānīṃ daśamīviddhāpy upoṣyaikādaśī tithiḥ ||
hārīto ’pi |
trayodaśyāṃ yadā na syād dvādaśī ghaṭikādvayam |
daśamy ekādaśīviddhā saivopoṣyā sadā tithiḥ ||
viṣṇurahasye |
daśamīśeṣasaṃyuktā upoṣyaikādaśī tadā |
yadā na syāt trayodaśyāṃ muhūrtaṃ titiḥ ||
smṛtyantare |
pūrvaviddhā na kartavyā ṣaṣṭhī caikādaśī tathā |
viddhāpy kādaśī kāryā parato dvādaśī na cet ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
daśamyā saha saṃyuktā upoṣyaikādaśī tadā |
yadā na syāt trayodaśyāṃ dvādaśī ghaṭikātrayam ||
purāṇāntare |
trayodaśyāṃ na labhyeta dvādaśī yadi kiṃcana |
upoṣyaikādaśī tatra daśamīmiśritāpi vā ||
smṛtyantare |
upoṣyā daśamī tatra dvādaśīṃ na labhed yadi |
daśamyāpi hi miśraiva ekādaśy eva dharmakṛt ||
dvādaśī svalpam alpāpi yadi na syāt pare ’hani |
[227]        daśamyā miśritā kāryā na doṣo ’sīti vedhasaḥ ||
vacanam iti śeṣaḥ |
viṣṇurahasye |
muhūrtaṃ dvādaśī na syāt trayodaśyāṃ yadā mune |
upoṣyā daśamīmiśrā sadaivaikādaśī tithiḥ ||
tathā |
yadi na syāt trayodaśyāṃ muhūrtaṃ dvādaśī tithiḥ |
daśamy ekādaśīyuktā samupoṣyā bhavet tadā ||
vṛddhavaśiṣṭho ’pi |
dvādaśī svalpam alpāpi yadi na syāt pare ’hani |
daśamīmiśritā kāryā mahāpātakanāśinī ||
yadārkodayamātrāpi dvādaśī hy apare ’hani |
trayodaśyāṃ tadā karyā daśamīśeṣasaṃyutā ||
ekādaśī dvādaśī ca kṣaye yadi dinatrayam |
na dvādaśī pare caiva kartavyā daśamīyutā ||
purāṇāt |
miśritāpi na kartavyā daśamy ekādaśī yadā |
miśritāpi hi kartavyā na vinded dvādaśīṃ yadi ||
upoṣyā pāraṇe prāpte na vinded dvādaśīṃ yadi |
daśamyāpi hi viddhā syād ekādaśy eva puṇyabhāk ||
viddhāpy ekādaśī vatra dvādaśī cen na labhyate |
dvādaśadvādaśīr hanti trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇe |
[228]        atra ca muhūrtadvayaghaṭikāgrahaṇam avivakṣitaṃ “kalayāpi cet” "svalpam alpāpi ced" iti vacanāntare ’bhidhānād iti kecit |
apare tv āhuḥ "kalayāpi ced" iti vākyaṃ mumukṣuviṣayam,
dvikalāyāṃ tu dvādaśyāṃ pāraṇaṃ yaḥ karoti hi |
tām upoṣya mahīpāla na garbhe viśate naraḥ ||
iti liṅgāt | sarvaviṣayatve ca,
trayodaśyāṃ yadā rājan dvādaśyās tu kalā bhavet |
sā tithiḥ sakalā ceti vasiṣṭhaḥ prāha dharmavit ||
iti sākalyoktyānarthakyāpattiḥ, muhūrtādigrahaṇaṃ ca vivakṣitaṃ syāt |
anye tu,
divābhāgadvayād ūrdhvam ā niśīyāt tu cen niśi |
dvijabhojanakālo ’yaṃ bālavṛddhāturaṃ vinā ||
iti ca muhūrtadvayāt prāg divābhojananiṣedhasya nityasya dvādaśīmadhyapāraṇaniyamena kāmyatvaṃ vinā mokṣakāmaikādaśyupavāsaviṣaye sāvakāśena bādhāyogān mumukṣumātraviṣayam etat, na sarvatrayodaśīviṣayatvam iti varṇayanti |
etac ca putravadgṛhivyatiriktaviṣayaṃ putravadgṛhiṇas tv ekādaśīdinakṣaye pratiṣiddha upavāsaḥ | tathā ca |
ekādaśīdinakṣaye upavāsaṃ karoti yaḥ |
tasya putrā vinaśyanti maghāyāṃ piṇḍado yathā ||
na ca dinakṣayanimittopavāsasyāyaṃ niṣedha iti vācyam, ekādaśīśabdavaiyarthyaprasaṅgāt |
na cāyaṃ doṣādhikyapradarśanārtham iti vācyam, doṣādhikyānabhidhānāt dinakṣayasya jaiminivacanena [229] kātyāyanavacanena vā prākṛtatvena sarvanāmnā parāmarśānupapatteḥ |
tathā hi jaimininoktam |
āditye ’hani saṃkrāntau grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ |
pāraṇaṃ copavāsaṃ ca na kuryāt putravān gṛhī || iti |
tannimittopavāsasya niṣedho ’yam udāhṛtaḥ |
nānuṣaṅgakṛto grāhyo yato nityam upoṣaṇam ||
kātyāyanenāpi |
ekādaśīṣu kṛṣṇāsu ravisaṃkramaṇe tathā |
candrasūryoparāge ca na kuryāt putravān gṛhī || iti |
tatprayuktopavāsasya niṣedho ’yam udāhṛtaḥ |
prayuktetarayuktasya na vidhir na niṣedhanam ||
pitāmaho ’pi |
ekādaśīdinakṣaye upavāsaṃ karoti yaḥ |
tasya putrā vinaśyanti maghāyāṃ piṇḍado yathā ||
dinakṣaye tu samprāpte nopoṣyā daśamīyutā |
yadīcchet putrapautrāṇāṃ ṛddhisaṃpadam ātmanaḥ ||
evaṃ putravadgṛhiṇaḥ pūrvedyuḥ pratiṣiddhe sati upavāse vratālopārthaṃ śuddhadvādaśyām evopavāsaḥ |
vyāso ’pi |
ekādaśīdinakṣaye upavāsī tu ced gṛhī |
annābhāve ’varuddhe vā saṃkalpād vā viśeṣataḥ ||
[230]        dharmahāniś ca bhavati santatir naśyati dhruvam |
tasyāyuḥ kṣīṣate nityaṃ saṃvatsaram iti śruteḥ ||
tathā |
ekādaśīṣu kṛṣṇāsu ravisaṃkramaṇe tathā |
pāraṇaṃ copavāsaṃ ca na kuryāt putravān gṛhī ||
tathā ca gobhilaḥ |
ekādaśyāṃ yadā brahman dinakṣaye tithir bhavet |
tadā hy ekādaśīṃ tyaktvā dvādaśīṃ samupoṣayet |
tatra kratuśataṃ puṇyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam ||
pitāmaho ’pi |
ekādaśyāṃ yadā vatsa dinakṣaye tithir bhavet |
tatropoṣyā dvādaśī syāt trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam ||
nāradīyapurāṇe |
kṣaye vāpy atha vā vṛddhau saṃprāpte ca dinakṣaye |
upoṣyā dvādaśī puṇyā trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam ||
kūrmapurāṇe ’pi |
dinakṣaye tu saṃprāpte upoṣyā dvādaśī bhavet |
daśamīśeṣasaṃyuktāṃ na kurvīta kadācana ||
tathā |
tithivṛddhau tathā hrāse saṃprāpte vā dinakṣaye |
saṃdigdheṣu ca vākyeṣu dvādaśīṃ samupoṣayet || iti |
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
[231]        dinakṣaye tu saṃprāpte nopoṣyā daśamīyutā |
upoṣyā dvādaśī śuddhā trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam ||
brahmapurāṇe |
tithichede tu saṃprāpte dvādaśyāṃ samupoṣaṇam |
pāraṇaṃ tu trayodaśyāṃ yadīcchet śreyam ātmanaḥ ||
ekādaśī vinaṣṭā ced dvādaśyām apy upoṣaṇam |
upoṣya cārcayed viṣṇum ubhayor api pakṣayoḥ ||
jape home tathā dāne brāhmaṇānāṃ ca tarpaṇe |
pāraṇe cāpi rājendra praśastā ca trayodaśī |
kūrma-nāradīya- mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇeṣu ca |
kalārdhenāpi viddhā syād daśamy ekādaśī yadā |
tadā hy ekādaśīṃ tyaktvā dvādaśīṃ samupoṣayet |
dvādaśyām upavāso ’tra trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam ||
skandapurāṇe ’pi |
ūrdhvaṃ haridinaṃ na syāt dvādaśīṃ grāhayet tataḥ |
dvādaśyām upavāso ’tra trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam ||
evaṃ kurvan naro bhaktyā viṣṇusāyujyam āpnuyāt |
anyathā kurute yas tu sa yāti narakaṃ dhruvam ||
ekādaśī yadā viddhā parato ’pi na vartate |
upoṣyā dvādaśī tatra trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam ||
tathā |
[232]        ekādaśī ṛṣīṇāṃ tu dvādaśī cakrapāṇinaḥ |
ekādaśī yadā na syād upoṣyā dvādaśī tadā ||
tathā |
dvādaśyām upavāso ’tra trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam |
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
pūrvaviddhām upāste konandāṃ vedabalād api |
ko vedavacanāt tāta gosave gāṃ nihanti vai ||
daśamīśeṣasaṃyuktam āśrayet ko vrataṃ vratī |
tasmād ekādaśī tyājyā daśamīśeṣasaṃyutā |
upoṣyā dvādaśī śuddhā trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam ||
yadā tv asminn eva viṣaye dvādaśyāṃ trayodaśy asti tadā dvādaśyām evopavāsaḥ |
tathā ca vyāsaḥ |
ekādaśī yadā luptā parato dvādaśī bhavet |
upoṣyā dvādaśī tatra yadīcchet paramāṃ gatim ||
'luptā' kṣayaṃ gatā | 'parataḥ' trayodaśyām ity arthaḥ | yadā daśamīviddhaikādaśī udayamātraṃ prāptā dvādaśī nāsti dvādaśī tu trayodaśyāṃ vidyate tadā śuddhadvādaśyām evopavāsaḥ |
tathā ca nāradīyapurāṇe |
śuddhā tu dvādaśī rājan samupoṣyā sadā tithiḥ |
[233]        daśamy ekādaśīmiśrā na kartayā kadācana ||
padmapurāṇe ’pi |
daśamīgarbhitā pūrvā lupyetaikādaśī parā |
upoṣyā dvādaśī tatra na daśamyā kathaṃcana ||
palārddhenāpi viddhā ca daśamyaikādaśī yadā |
tadā hy ekādaśīṃ tyaktvā dvādaśaīṃ samupoṣayet || iti |
nāradīyapurāṇe ’pi |
yadā na prāpyate viddhā dvādaśyāṃ pūrvasaṃbhavā |
tadopavāso hi kathaṃ kartavyo mānavair vada ||
upavāsadinaṃ viddhaṃ yadā bhavati pūrvayā |
dvitīye ’hni yadā na syāt svalpāpy ekādaśī tithiḥ |
tatropavāso vihitaḥ kathaṃ tad vada sūtaja ||
sūta uvāca |
yadā na prāpyate viprā dvādaśyāṃ pūrvavāsaraḥ |
ravicakrārdhamātro ’pi tadopoṣyaṃ paraṃ dinam ||
upoṣyā dvādaśī śuddhā dvādaśyām eva pārayet |
nirgatā cet trayodaśyāṃ kalā vā dvikalāpi vā ||
brahmavaivarte |
ekādaśī dvādaśī ca tatra saṃnihito hariḥ |
tena śuddhāpi kartavyā dvādaśīphalakāṅkṣibhiḥ ||
ekādaśī yadā luptā parato dvādaśī bhavet |
upoṣyā dvādaśī tatra yadīcchet paramaṃ padam ||
[234]        atra yadītyarthavādamātram udāhṛtavacananicayaparyālocanayā sarveṣāṃ dvādaśyupavāsāvagamāt | yadā tu daśamīviddhaikādaśī udayamātraparyantā dvādaśī ca samā nyūnā vā tadā gṛhiṇām pūrvopavāsaḥ |
skandapurāṇe |
pāraṇāhe na labhyeta dvādaśī yadi kiṃcana |
ṛṣyaśṛṅgaḥ |
pāraṇāhe na labhyeta dvādaśī kalayāpi cet |
anayor uttarārdham |
tadānīṃ daśamīviddhā upoṣyaikādaśī tithiḥ |
padmapurāṇe |
viddhāpy ekādaśī grāhyā parato dvādaśī na cet |
dvādaśa dvādaśīr hanti trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam ||
viddhāpy aviddhā vijñeyā parato dvādaśī na cet |
aviddhāpi tathā viddhā parato dvādaśi yadi ||
hārīto ’pi |
trayodaśyāṃ yadā na syāt dvādaśī ghaṭikādvayam |
daśamy ekādaśīmiśrā saivopoṣyā tadā tithiḥ ||
tattvasāgarasaṃhitāyām api |
daśamy ekādaśī yatra nopoṣyā sā kulāpahā |
saivopoṣyā kalāmātrā dvādaśyāṃ cen na vidyate ||
bhaviṣye |
ekādaśī kalāpy ekā parato na vardhate |
[235]        gṛhibhiḥ putravadbhiś ca saivopoṣyā tadā tithiḥ ||
asminn eva viṣaye yatyāder mumukṣor uttaratraivopavāsaḥ |
tathā ca viṣṇurahasye |
daśamīmiśritā pūrvā lupyetaikādaśī parā |
ekādaśyāṃ mahāprājña upavāsaḥ kathaṃ bhavet ||
śuddhaiva dvādaśī rājann upoṣyā mokṣakāṅkṣibhiḥ |
pāraṇaṃ ca tryodaśyāṃ tatra kratuśataṃ bhavet ||
yadaiva daśamīviddhaṃ bhavaty ekādaśīdinam |
upoṣyā tu tadā śuddhā dvādaśī mokṣakāṅkṣibhiḥ |
pāraṇaṃ tu trayodaśyāṃ tatrākṣayaphalaṃ bhavet ||
yāny etāni vacanāni kūrma-padmapurāṇayoḥ |
ekādaśī daśāviddhā parato dvādaśī na hi |
upoṣyā dvādaśī tatra trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam ||
skandapurāṇe |
ekādaśī daśāviddhā dvādaśī na ca vardhate |
tadopoṣyā dvādaśī syāt trayodaśāṃ tu pāraṇam || iti |
tāny udāhṛtavākyaparyālocanayā mumukṣuviṣayāṇi | yadā tu daśamīviddhaikādaśī dvādaśyāṃ vidyate dvādaśī codayaparyantā vidyate ca tadā dvitīyaivopoṣyā nityā kāmyā ca |
tathā ca nāradaḥ |
dvādaśyaikādaśī yatra saṃgatā tridaśādhipa |
tām upoṣya tataḥ kuryāt trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam ||
[236]        skandapurāṇo ’pi |
ekādaśīkalā yatra parato dvādaśī na cet |
tatra kratuśataṃ puṇyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam ||
skandapurāṇe ca |
ekā liptyā samāyuktā yāti vṛddhiṃ parā tithiḥ |
dvādaśī pāraṇārthā ca nopoṣyaṃ pūrvavāsaram ||
baudhāyano 'pi |
kalāpy ekādaśī yatra parato dvādaśī na cet |
tatra kratuśataṃ puṇyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam ||
padmapurāṇe ’pi |
dvādaśīmiśritā kāryā sarvatraikādaśī tithiḥ |
dvādaśī ca trayodaśyāṃ vidyate yadi vā na vā ||
tathā |
sarvatraikādaśī kāryā dvādaśīmiśritā naraiḥ |
prātar bhavatu vā mā vā yato nityam upoṣaṇam ||
tattvasāgarasaṃhitāyām api |
dvādaśyekādaśī yatra saṃgatā tridaśādhipa |
tām upoṣya tataḥ kuryāt trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam ||
nāradaḥ |
dādaśyaikādaśī yatra dvādaśī parato ’pi ca |
dvādaśyāṃ pāraṇaṃ kuryāt kratukoṭiphalaṃ labhet ||
brahmapurāṇe ’pi |
[237]        dvādaśyaikādaśī yatra tatra saṃnihito hariḥ |
tatra kratuśataṃ puṇyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam ||
padmapurāṇe ’pi |
ekādaśīkalāyuktā yena dvādaśy upoṣitā |
kiṃ tatra bahubhir yajñair aśvamedhādibhir nṛpa ||
ekādaśī dvādaśī ca tatra saṃnihito hariḥ |
upoṣya rajanīm ekāṃ brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati |
tattvasāgarasaṃhitāyām |
dvādaśyekādaśī yatra saṃgatā tridaśādhipa |
tām upoṣya tataḥ kuryāt trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam ||
dvādasy ekādaśī ca parato na trayodaśī |
upoṣyā dvādaśī bhaktyā dvādaśyāṃ caiva pāraṇam ||
kiṇ caivaṃ vividhaviṣaye dvitīyaiva grāhyā daśamīviddhāyā niṣedhāt |
tathā ca skandapurāṇe |
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena pūrvaviddhāṃ vivarjayet |
nāradīyapurāṇe |
pūrvaviddhā na kartavyā tṛtīyā ṣaṣṭhy api dvija |
aṣṭamy ekādaśībhūtā dharmakāmārthamokṣibhiḥ ||
atraikādaśyādayaḥ paraviddhā upoṣyāḥ pratīyante viśeṣaniṣedhasya śeṣābhyanujñāviṣayatvāt, anyathā nopoṣyā iti vācyaṃ, na tu pūrvaviddhā nopoṣyeti paraviddhaikādaśy upoṣyeti vacanāc ca |
[238]        tathā ca sumantu-sanatkumārau |
tṛtīyaikādaśī ṣaṣṭhī caturthī caturdaśī |
amāvāsyāṣṭamī caiva tā upoṣyāḥ parānvitāḥ ||
śāradāpurāṇe |
ekādaśy aṣṭamī ṣaṣṭhī pūrṇamāsī caturdaśī |
tṛtīyā ca caturthī ca amāvāsyāṣṭamī tathā |
upoṣyāḥ parasaṃyuktā nopoṣyāḥ pūrvasaṃyutāḥ ||
paiṭhīnasiḥ |
ekādaśī tathā ṣaṣṭhī śuklapakṣe caturdaśī |
tṛtīyā ca caturthī ca tā upoṣyāḥ parānvitāḥ ||
yadā ca daśamīviddhaikādaśī dvādaśyāṃ ca kiyanmātra vidyate rātriśeṣe ca trayodaśī tadā gṛhasthavyatiriktānāṃ tatropavāsaḥ |
tathā ca padmapurāṇe |
dvādaśīsaṃyutā tatra bhavaty ekādaśī kalā |
dinakṣaye ’pi yā puṇyā daśamyā na kathaṃcana ||
trispṛg ekādaśī yatra tatra saṃnihito hariḥ |
puṇyaṃ kratuśatasyoktaṃ trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam ||
nāradīyapurāṇādau |
ekādaśī dvādaśī ca rātriśeṣe trayodaśī |
upavāsaḥ praśasto ’sau yady evaṃ pūjyate tithiḥ ||
ekādaśī dvādaśī ca viśeṣeṇa trayodaśī |
[239]        trispṛśā nāma sā proktā brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati ||
ekādaśī dvādaśī ca viśeṣeṇa trayodaśī |
ya upāste sadā bhaktyā sa naro divi modate ||
ekādaśīkalāyuktām upoṣya dvādaśīṃ naraḥ |
trayodaśyāṃ tu yo bhuṅkkte tasya viṣṇuḥ prasīdati ||
ekādaśī dvādaśī ca viśeveṇa trayodaśī |
tatra kratuśataṃ puṇyaṃ trayodaśāṃ tu pāraṇe ||
kūrmapurāṇe |
ekādaśī dvādaśī ca rātriśeṣe trayodaśī |
tribhir miśrā tithiḥ proktā sarvapāpaharā smṛtā |
upavāsaḥ kṛtas tasyāṃ sarvapātakanāśanaḥ |
ekādaśī dvādaśī ca viśeṣeṇa trayodaśī || iti |
purāṇat |
ekādaśī dvādaśī ca taccheṣe ca trayodaśī |
dinakṣaye ’pi yā pūjyā divasasyāpare ’hani ||
skānde ’pi |
dvādaśīsaṃyutā yatra bhavaty ekādaśī tithiḥ |
dinakṣaye ’pi sā pūjyā na daśamyā kathaṃcana ||
ekādaśī dvādaśī ca rātriśeṣe trayodaśī |
sopoṣyā ca prayatnena mahāpuṇyavivarddhanī ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
ekādaśī kalāpy ekā dvādaśī sakalaṃ dinam |
[240]        trayodaśī uṣaḥkāle vaiṣṇavaṃ tad dinatrayam |
sarvapāpaharaṃ proktaṃ tad upoṣyam iti smṛtiḥ ||
skandapurāṇe |
ekādaśī kalāyuktā dvādaśī kṣīyate yadā |
upoṣyā ca mahāpuṇyā sarvapāpaharā tithiḥ ||
sumantuḥ |
ekādaśī kalāyuktā dvādaśī lupyate yadā |
ekādaśī tadopoṣyā dvitīyā mokṣakāṅkṣibhiḥ ||
asmin viṣaye putravato gṛhasthasya upavāso niṣiddhaḥ |
tathā padmapurāṇe |
ekādaśī dvādaśī ca rātriśeṣe trayodaśī |
tattryahaspṛg ahotrātraṃ nopoṣyaṃ tat sutārthibhiḥ ||
kūrmapurāṇe |
ekādaśī dvādaśī ca viśeṣeṇa trayodaśī |
upavāsaṃ prakurvīta putrapautrasamanvitaḥ ||
ekādaśī dvādaśī ca rātriśeṣe trayodaśī |
dvādaśa dvādaśīr hanti trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam ||
ity api tadviṣayam | tasyaivopavāsaniṣedhe sati tasminn eva dine upavāsapratyāmnāyatvena naktaṃ vihitaṃ vṛddhaśātātapena |
daśamy ekādaśīviddhā dvādaśī ca kṣayaṃ gatā |
kṣīṇā sā dvādaśī jñeyā naktaṃ tatra vidhīyate || iti |
pracetāḥ |
[241]        ekādaśī dvādaśī ca taccheṣe ca trayodaśī |
tatra snānaṃ japaṃ homaṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇavācanam |
nirvartya dvādaśīkarma tato naktena vartayet || iti |
viṣṇudharmottare |
ekādaśī yadā viddhā dvādaśī ca kṣayaṃ gatā |
kṣīṇā sā dvādaśī jñeyā naktaṃ tatra vidhīyate ||
skandapurāṇe |
ekādaśīkalā yatra dvādaśī ca kṣayaṃ gatā |
tatra naktaṃ prakurvīta nopavāso gṛhāśrame ||
padmapurāṇe |
ekādaśīkalāyuktā dvādaśī kṣīyate yadā |
kṣīṇā sā dvādaśī jñeyā naktaṃ tatra vidhīyate ||
nanu “nopoṣyaṃ tat sutārthibhir" iti sutārthināṃ putrakāmānāṃ upavāsapratiṣedho ’yaṃ na niṣkāmāṇāṃ gṛhasthānāṃ kāmāntarayuktānāṃ vā |
tad asat | nāyaṃ putrakāmapratiṣedhaḥ kiṃ tu,
trispṛgekādaśī yatra tatra saṃnihito hariḥ |
ityādivacanair aviśeṣeṇa sarveṣāṃ tatropavāse prāpte "nopoṣyaṃ tat sutārthibhir" ityanena nivāryate puruṣaviśeṣamātrasya, tatrāpi sutārthiśabdena grahasthamātram abhidhīyate, tasya sutārthitvaṃ saṃbhavatīti na sarūpeṇa sutārthitā yatra vidyate,
dinakṣaye ’pi yā puṇyā yatīnām uttamā tithiḥ |
iti yater eva tādṛṣyā uttamatvābhidhānāt | tatra yatiśabdaḥ [242] kiṃ sutārthitārahitaparaḥ sutārthiśabdo vā sutārthitvasaṃbhāvanāpara iti saṃdehe sutārthiśabda eva saṃbhāvanāparo grāhyaḥ |
uttarāṃ tu yatiḥ kuryāt pūrvām upavased gṛhī |
iti gṛhasthamātrasya |
upavāsaṃ na kurvīta putrapautrasamanvitaḥ |
ity anayor vākyayor ekārthatvāya putrasaṃbandhimātraparataiva yuktā, putrasaṃbandhitvaṃ ca gṛhasthād vinā na sambhavatīti tadāpekṣaḥ, etāvataivāsya caritārthatve kim iti na vidhyanapekṣito vākyabhedāpādako viśeṣo 'ṅgīkartavyaḥ,
dvau tithyantāv ekavāre yasmin sa syād dinakṣayaḥ |
tasmin snānaṃ japo homo nopavāso gṛhāśrame ||
iti gṛhasthamātrasya dinakṣaye niṣedhadarśanāt |
anye tv āhuḥ |
ekādaśī dvādaśī ca rātriśeṣe trayodaśī |
upavāsaṃ na kurvīta putrapautrasamanvitaḥ ||
iti vacanāt, sutārthibhir iti sāmānyasutārthitvaṃ putrapautrasamanvita iti viśeṣa upasaṃhriyate, putravatāpi trispṛśāyāṃ naktaṃ vā kāryaṃ bhakṣaṃ vā kiṃcid bhakṣayitvopavāsaḥ kartavyaḥ |
upavāsaniṣedhe tu bhakṣaṃ kiṃcit prakalpayet |
na duṣyaty upavāse sa upavāsaphalaṃ bhavet ||
ityādivacanānurodhāt |
apare tv āhuḥ | atropasaṃhāram anumanyāmahe na tu bhakṣaprakalpanaṃ [243] “upavāsaniṣedhe tu bhakṣam" ity asya sāmānyaśāstrasyaikādaśīdinakṣayanaktavidhāyaka-viśeṣaśāstreṇa bādhāt | tena bhakṣaprakalpanam anyatra veditavyaṃ tac cānekaprakāram |
naktaṃ haviṣyānnam anodanaṃ vā
phalaṃ tilāḥ kṣīram athāmbu cājyam |
yat pañcagavyaṃ yadi vāpi vāyuḥ
praśastam atrottaram uttaraṃ ceti ||
anye tv āhuḥ | yad atra naktavidhānaṃ tat sakāmaviṣayaṃ “nopavāso gṛhāśrama" iti kāmyupavāsaḥ pratiṣidhyate,
ekādaśīkalā yatra dvādaśyanugatā bhavet |
lupyate dvādaśī tatra nopavāsaḥ phalārthinām ||
iti vacanāt, nityopavāsaniṣedhād, vikalpaprasaṅgāc ca | tathā putravadgṛhiviṣaye niṣedham apekṣya pākṣikavidhānaṃ taditaraviṣaye nityavad vidhānam iti vairūpam | kāmyaṃ tu phalaṃ rāgād eva pravṛtter niṣedho ghaṭata iti vikalpo nāsti vidhivyāpāravairūpyaṃ, paryudāse ca saṃbhave yukte sati upavāse ca niṣiddhe sakāmaḥ kiṃ kuryād ity apekṣitena naktaṃ vidhātuṃ ucitaṃ bhavati |
evaṃ ca |
ekādaśīkalāpy ekā dvādaśī yatra lupyate |
tatropavāsaṃ kurvīta niṣkāmo viṣṇutatparaḥ ||
iti vacanam upapanaṃ bhavatīti |
tad ayuktaṃ | pāpaparihārakāmaviṣṇuṣāyujyakāmamumukṣūṇam apy upavāsavidhānāt |
[244]        ekādaśī dvādaśī ca rātriśeṣe trayodaśī |
tribhir miśrā tithiḥ proktā sarvapāpaharā smṛtā |
upavāsaḥ kṛtas tasyāṃ mahāpātakanāśanaḥ ||
dvādaśyāṃ tu yadā bhūpa dinakṣayatithir bhavet |
tadopavāsaḥ kartavyo viṣṇusāyujyam āpnuyāt || iti |
sāyujyam icchateti kvacit pāṭhaḥ |
ekādaśī dvādaśī ca rātryante ca trayodaśī |
upavāsaḥ kṛtas tatra mokṣam eva prayacchati || iti |
tathā |
dinakṣaye tu kartavya upavāso mumukṣubhiḥ |
iti kāmyasyāpi vihitatvena vikalpasya tadavasthatvāt tathā hi vidheḥ pravṛttilakṣaṇā parihṛteti, tasmād yathoktam eva jyāyaḥ |
anye tv āhuḥ | yad atra naktavidhānaṃ tad asāmarthyaviṣayam | na ca viddhāviddhayor aśaktes tulyatvād yad etad viddhāyā naimittikaviśeṣavidhānaṃ tad asamarthaviṣaye asamañjasaṃ syād iti vaktavyam | viddhāyāṃ hy ekabhaktādirūpopavāsapratyāmnāyo durghaṭa eva pratīyate rātrāv upavāsasaṃkalpavidhānāt |
vidhopavāse ’naśnaṃs tu dinaṃ tyaktvā samāhitaḥ |
rātrau saṃpūjayed devaṃ saṃkalpaṃ ca tadācaret ||
tatpratyāmnāyanasyāpi sa eva kālo yuktaḥ ekabhaktakālas tv asau na bhavati |
dinārdhasamaye ’tīte bhujyate niyamena yat |
ekabhaktam iti proktam atas tasmād divaiva hi ||
[245]        iti tasya divaiva vihitatvān naktam eva tadānīṃ bhavatīti samyag uktam asamarthaviṣayam idam iti yuktaṃ sāmānyato dinakṣaye ’smin dinakṣayaviśeṣe ca putravato gṛhasthasyopavāsaniṣedhād aniyamena bhakṣakalpanāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ niyamavidhānārthatvenākāṅkṣitasamarpaṇenārjavenaiva vākyasyopapatteḥ tena yathoktam eva sādhu | etenaitan nirastam |
ekādaśyāṃ tathā naktaṃ dvijaḥ kuryād yathāvidhi |
mārgaśīrṣaśuklapakṣād ārabhyābdaṃ vidhīyate ||
iti vārāhapurāṇoktaviṣayaṃ dvādaśīkṣaye naktavidhānam ekādaśī cety udāhṛtavacane pūrvopavāsavidhāyakavirodhād iti sāmānyaśāstrasya viśeṣaśāstreṇa bādhāt upavāsaniṣedhe cākāṅkṣitasamarpaṇena vākyasyopapatteḥ utpattiśiṣṭaikādaśībādhaprasaṅgāc ca |
kalāpy ekādaśī yatra dvādaśyanugatā bhavet |
dinakṣaye ’pi sā puṇyā yatīnām uttamā tithiḥ ||
atra ca yatigrahaṇaṃ netarasyāvṛttyartham | tathā sati putravato gṛhasthasya prāptyabhāvena niṣedhānupapatteḥ | tena yatīnāṃ vaiśiṣṭyamātrapratipādanaparam etat |
tad ayukaṃ 'uttameti' dinakṣaye ’pīty apiśabdena dinakṣayam antareṇāpi yatīnāṃ dvitīyā cottameti darśitaṃ |
yat tu ṛṣyaśṛṅgavacanam,
pūrvaviddhā na kartavyā ṣaṣṭyekādaśy athāṣṭamī |
ekādaśīṃ tu kurvīta kṣīyate dvādaśī yadi || iti |
tac chuddhikāmaviṣṇusāyujyakāmamumukṣuvyatiriktaviṣayaṃ udāhṛtavākyānurodhāt |
[246]        aviddhāni niṣiddhaiś cen na labhyate dināni tu |
muhūrtaiḥ pañcabhir viddhā grāhyaivaikādaśī tithiḥ |
tadardhaviddhāny anyāni dināny upavased budhaḥ ||
'niṣiddhaiḥ' daśamyādibhiḥ, aviddhāny ekādaśyādidināni |
ekādaśī dvādaśī ca rātriśeṣe trayodaśī |
upavāsaṃ na kurvīta putrapautrasamanvitaḥ ||
ekādaśī dvādaśī ca rātriśeṣe trayodaśī |
tryahaspṛg ahorātraṃ nopoṣyaṃ tat sutārthibhiḥ ||
ityādivacanād upoṣyatvena na labhyante na svarūpeṇa cety arthaḥ | yat tu kaiścit dvādaśīdinakṣaye daśamīviddhāṃ nityām ekādaśīṃ gṛhasthaḥ kurvīteti vacanavyākhyānaṃ kṛtaṃ tad evaṃvidhasaṃkoce kāraṇābhāvād ayuktaṃ | viddhaikādaśyupavāsapratiṣedha-vacanāny udāhariṣyante |
tatra vāsiṣṭhasaṃhitāyāṃ |
daśamy ekādaśī yatra tatra nopavased budhaḥ |
apatyāni vinaśyanti svargalokaṃ na gacchati ||
brahmapurāṇe vratakhaṇḍe |
upoṣyaikādaśīṃ mohād daśamīśeṣasaṃyutām |
na naraḥ sukham ādhatte iha loke paratra ca ||
dhṛtarāṣṭreṇa maitreyaḥ pṛṣṭaḥ prāha narādhipam |
[247]        yad arthayante viyogo ’bhūt putrāṇāṃ bhāryayā saha ||
pūrvaṃ tvayā sabhāryeṇa daśamīśeṣasaṃyutā |
kṛtā vaikādaśī rājaṃs tasyedaṃ kāraṇaṃ matam ||
tasmād ekādaśī yuktā daśamyā narasattama |
na kartavyā prayatnena niṣphalā dvādaśī yadi ||
yathā caikādaśī rājan dvādaśī ca tathā nṛṇām |
samānā tatphalā proktā vrate ’smiṃś cakrapāṇinaḥ ||
na cāhaṃ svairiṇī bhāryā na cāham apativratā |
na ceha kaluṣaṃ yena kiṃ pāpaṃ tv anyajanmani ||
rāmapatnyā vacaḥ śrutvā vālmīkir munipuṅgavaḥ |
ciraṃ dhyātvā mahārāja tām uvācedṛśaṃ vacaḥ ||
daśamyekādaśīṃ pūrvāṃ samupoṣya janārdanaḥ |
abhyarcitas tvayā devi tasyedaṃ karmaṇaḥ phalam ||
upoṣyaikādaśī śuddhā nopoṣyā daśamīyutā |
tatra kratuśataṃ puṇyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam ||
vaśiṣṭhaḥ samuvācedaṃ pṛṣṭo māndhātṛbhāryayā |
daśamyekādaśī devi purā copoṣitā tvayā ||
tena te karmaṇā ceha sabhartṛsutabāndhavaiḥ |
viyogaṃ samanuprāptā satyaṃ viddhi pativrate ||
yāni kānīha pāpāni trailokye saṃbhavanti vai |
teṣāṃ snānaṃ daśamyā vai sahaivaikādaśī matā ||
saptajanmakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ naśyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
[248]        daśamyanugatā yatra tithir ekādaśī bhavet |
tatrāpatyavināśaś ca pare tu narakaṃ vrajet ||
nopoṣyā daśamīviddhā sadā caikādaśī tithiḥ |
tām upoṣya naro jahyāt puṇyaṃ varṣaśatodbhavam ||
tathā |
daśamyāṃ caiva viddhāyām ekādaśyām upoṣitaḥ |
tasyāyuḥ kṣīyate nityaṃ nārado ’haṃ bravīmy adaḥ ||
satyaṃ satyaṃ vinaśyeta santatis tu na cānyathā |
daśamyanugatā yatra tithir ekādaśī bhavet |
tatrāpatyavināśaḥ syāt pare tu narakaṃ bhavet ||
tathā |
muhūrtenāpi saṃyuktā daśamyekādaśī tathā |
tām upoṣya naro mohāt sukhād dharmāc ca hīyate ||
kūrma-nāradīyapurāṇayoḥ viṣṇurahasye ca |
daśamīśeṣasaṃyuktām upoṣyaikādaśīṃ kila |
saṃvatsarakṛteneha naro dharmeṇa mucyate ||
daśamīśeṣasaṃyuktā gāndhārya samupoṣitā |
tasyāḥ putraśataṃ naṣṭaṃ tasmāt tāṃ parivarjayet ||
brahmavaivarte 'pi |
daśamīśeṣasaṃyuktāṃ yaḥ karoti vimūḍhadhīḥ |
ekādaśīphalaṃ tasya naśyed dvādaśavārṣikam || iti |
yaiḥ kṛtā daśamīviddhā vidyāmohena mānavaiḥ |
[249]        te gatā narakaṃ ghoraṃ yugāny ekonaviṃśati ||
sauradharmottare |
ekādaśīm upoṣyaitad dvādaśīm atha vā punaḥ |
vimiśrāṃ vāpi kūrvīta na daśamyā yutāṃ kvacit |
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
pūrvāviddhāṃ palārdhena nandāṃ pūrṇām api tyajet |
yadīcched ātmasantānaṃ caturṣu niyameṣv api ||
nopoṣitaṃ ca naktaṃ ca naikabhaktam ayācitaṃ |
nandāyāṃ pūrvaviddhāyāṃ kuryād aiśvaryam īhate ||
brahmavaivarte ’pi |
daśamyā yatra śeṣaś ca ekādaśyāṃ bhaved yadi |
sā tithiḥ sakalā jñeyā daśamīkālamiśritā ||
gaṅgodakasya sampūrṇaṃ yathā tv ājyaghaṭaṃ bhavet |
surābindusamāyukaṃ tat sarvaṃ madyatāṃ vrajet ||
halāhalaṃ viṣaṃ raudraṃ kaḥ piven mūḍhadhīr naraḥ |
daśamīśeṣasaṃyuktaṃ ka upoṣyati sadvratī ||
evaṃ jñātvā muniśreṣṭha daśamīśeṣasaṃyutā |
varjitā munibhiḥ sarvair vāsudevam abhīpsubhiḥ ||
nāradīyapurāṇe |
lavavedhe ’pi viprendra daśamyekādaśī yadā |
surāyā bindunā spaṣṭaṃ gaṅgāmbha iva saṃtyajet ||
[250]        śvadṛtau pañcagavyaṃ ca daśamyā dūṣitān tyajet |
tathā |
ekādaśīm upoṣya syād aprajo daśamīyutām |
daśamīmiśritā hanti phalam ekādaśīkṛtam ||
kauśikaḥ |
daśamyekādaśīviddhā suraiśvaryavināśikā |
paiṭhīnasiḥ |
nāgaviddhā tu yā ṣaṣṭhī śivaviddhā tu saptamī |
daśamyekādaśīviddhā tatra nopavased budhaḥ ||
vārṣāyaṇiḥ |
bhūtaviddhā tv amāvāsyā daśamyekādaśīyutā |
daśāviddhā tu sāmagraṃ hanti puṇyaṃ purākṛtam ||
gāruḍapurāṇe ’pi |
viddhām ekādaśīṃ viprās tyajanty etāṃ manīṣiṇaḥ |
tasyām upoṣito yāti dāridryaṃ duḥkham eva ca ||
skandapurāṇe |
dvāparānte tu gāndhārī kuruvaṃśavivardhinī |
kariṣyati ca senānīr mūḍhabhāvāc chikhidhvaja |
tena putraśataṃ tasyā nāśam eṣyaty asaṃśayam ||
evaṃ nandā na kartavyā daśamīsaṃyutā vibho |
kalā kāṣṭhāpi yā caiva dṛśyate daśamī vibho |
ekādaśyāṃ tu senānīḥ kartavyā na kathaṃcana ||
[251]        etāni vākyāni viddhaikādaśyanujñāvyatiriktaviṣayāṇi |
kautso ’pi |
aruṇodayavelāyāṃ viddhā kācid upoṣitā |
tasyāḥ putraśataṃ naṣṭaṃ tasmāt tāṃ parivarjayet ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe ’pi |
aruṇodayakāle tu daśamī yadi dṛśyate |
na tatraikādaśī kāryā dharmakāmārthanāśinī ||
tathā |
aruṇodayakāle tu daśamī yadi dṛśyate |
pāpamūlaṃ sadākhyeyam ekādaśyām upoṣaṇam ||
tathā |
aruṇodaye daśamī gandhamātraṃ bhaved yadi |
draṣṭavyaṃ tat prayatnena varjanīyaṃ narādhipa |
nāradīyapurāṇe mohinīvākyam |
mohinyuvāca |
daśamyāḥ prāntam ādāya yadodeti divākaraḥ |
tena spṛṣṭaṃ haridinaṃ taddattam asurāya vai ||
sūryodayavihīnaṃ hi dṛṣyaṃ dṛśyaṃ ca lāghavam |
daśamyantaṃ prayacchanti spṛṣṭaṃ haridinena hi ||
agner vihārakāle tu vadhvopasthānake tathā |
prātaḥ sandohakaraṇe pakṣisaṃvedane tathā ||
virāme sarvadevānāṃ mārjanīgrahaṇaṃ (?) tathā |
[252]        dvārodghāṭanavelāyāṃ snānakāla upasthite ||
yatīnāṃ dīkṣitānāṃ ca vāditraninade kṛte |
yatrākrāntā daśamy atra ekādaśīsamanvitā |
pradīyatāṃ nivāsārthaṃ yady asti mayi ced dayā ||
na yāce nodayaṃ devā na yāce tad dinaṃ hareḥ |
vainateyodayaṃ mahyaṃ dīyatāṃ surasattamāḥ ||
dagdhā yā muninā devāḥ kṣīṇā yā hy arthasaṃcayaiḥ |
viśramārthaṃ ca tuṣṭyartham etatprāntaṃ pradīyatāṃ ||
vaśiṣṭha uvāca |
tan mohinyā vacaḥ śrutvā surāḥ sarve mahīpate |
sumantrya suciraṃ kālaṃ digambarapurogamāḥ ||
yamasaṃsthāpanāyaiva vaikuṇṭhadhvaṃsanāya ca |
pāṣaṇḍināṃ hi vṛṣṭyarthaṃ pāpasaṃjananāya vai ||
udayāt prāk trighaṭikāvyāpiny ekādaśī yadā |
puraskṛtya ca tatrendraṃ tathānyāṃś ca surān nṛpa |
ūcus te mohinīṃ devā lokasambhāvanāya vai ||
dattaṃ mohini te sthānaṃ pratyūṣasamayāntikam |
duṣṭaṃ haridinopetaṃ daśamyāṃ prāntam eva hi ||
tena jambhena juṣṭaṃ tu naitad devair na mānavaiḥ ||
aruṇodayavelāyāṃ parityajed iti bhāvaḥ | aruṇodayo ’pi purāṇe darśitaḥ |
[253]        catasro ghaṭikā prātar aruṇodaya ucyate |
yatīnāṃ snānakālas tu gaṅgāmbhaḥsadṛśaḥ smṛtaḥ || iti ||
yatīnāṃ snānakāla ityanenodayād avag api ghaṭikācatuṣṭayam aruṇodaya ity uktaṃ bhavati | etāny araṇodayaniṣedhavākyāny api yadā dvādaśyāṃ kiyanmātrāpy ekādaśī dṛśyate trayodaśyāṃ ca kiyanmātrā dvādaśī tadā parityājyety evaṃparāṇi draṣṭavyāni, kāmyaikādaśīvrataviṣayāṇi vā |
gāruḍapurāṇe |
saṃdigdhaikādaśī nāma varjayed dharmakāṅkṣitaḥ |
putrarājyasamṛddhyārthaṃ dvādaśyām upavāsayet |
tatra kratuśataṃ puṇyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇe ||
udayāt prāṅ muhūrtena vyāpiny ekādaśī yadā |
saṃyuktaikādaśī nāma varjayed dharmavṛddhaye ||
putrapautravṛddhyarthaṃ dvādaśyām upavāsayet |
tatra kratuśataṃ puṇyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇe ||
ādityodayavelāyām ārabhya ṣaṣṭināḍikā |
saṃpurṇaikādaśī nāma tyājyā dharmaphalesubhiḥ ||
putrapautrasamṛddhyarthaṃ dvādaśyām upavāsayet |
tatra kratuśataṃ puṇyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇe ||
kāṇvo ’pi |
aruṇodayavelāyāṃ daśamī yadi saṃgatā |
atropoṣyā dvādaśī syāt trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam ||
[254]        purāṇe ’pi |
aruṇodayavelāyāṃ daśamī yadi saṃgatā |
ravicakrārdhamātrāpi dvādaśīm upavāsayet |
tatra kratuśataṃ puṇyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam ||
gobhilaḥ |
aruṇodayavelāyāṃ daśamī yadi saṃgatā |
saṃyukaikādaśīṃ tāṃ tu mohinyā dattavān vibhuḥ ||
viṣṇuḥ |
udayād uparividdhā daśamy ekādaśī yadā |
dānavebhyaḥ prīṇanārthaṃ dattavān pākaśāsanaḥ ||
tasmāt sarvapratnena saṃpūrṇaikādaśīṃ tyajet |
dvādaśyām upavāso ’tra trayodayśāṃ tu pāraṇam ||
nāradīyapurāṇe ’pi |
bahuvākyavirodhena saṃdeho jāyate yadā |
dvādaśī tu tadā grāhyā trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam ||
dinakṣaye ca saṃprāpte upoṣyā dvādaśī bhavet |
daśamīśeṣasaṃyuktāṃ na kurvanti kadācana ||
etāni kāmyaikādaśīviṣayāṇy eva | tathā ca teṣu teṣu vākyeṣu dharmakāṅkṣitvaputra-pautrasamṛddhyartham ity evamādīni phalāni śrūyante | yad vā aruṇodayaviddhopavāsaniṣedhavākyāni vaiṣṇavaviṣayāṇi, śaivādīnāṃ tv ekādaśyupavāvādhikāre tatropavāse nāsti doṣaḥ |
tathā ca bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
[255]        daśamīśeṣasaṃyukto yadi syād aruṇodayaḥ |
vaiṣṇavena na kartavyaṃ taddinaikādaśīvratam ||
kāmyaikādaśīnirṇayaḥ brahmavaivarte ekādaśīprakaraṇe aruṇodayavedhanindāyāṃ |
śaunaka uvāca |
vratam ekādaśīṃ sūta viśeṣeṇa prakīrtaya |
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ kṛte yasmin bhaven nṛṇām ||
kīdṛśy ekādaśī kāryā kathaṃ kāryā kathaṃ hariḥ |
pūjanīyaḥ phalaṃ kiṃ ca bhavet tat sūta kīrtaya ||
udyāpanavidhānaṃ ca kāryaṃ vrataphalāptaye |
tat tathā sūta sarvaṃ hi vada saṃprati śṛṇvataḥ ||
sūta uvāca |
idam arthaṃ purā śūro vasudevapitā munim |
kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ vyāsaṃ papraccha tava yan matam ||
śūra uvāca |
kathitā vaiṣṇavā dharmā vyāsa muktikarā ṇṛṇām |
pradhānaṃ tatra sarveṣāṃ tvayoktaṃ dvādaśīvratam ||
kīdṛśī sā kathaṃ kāryā kiṃphalā kasya pūjanam |
vidheyam etan no brūhi sarvaśas tvaṃ hi me matiḥ ||
sūta uvāca |
ity uktaḥ pratyuvācāmum uttaraṃ yadukulodbhavam |
vyāso yathāvat tad ahaṃ vacmi tac chṛṇu śaunaka ||
[256]                vyāsa uvāca |
supuṇyaikāśī śūra yadi śalyavivarjitā |
kartur nirayapātāya saśalyā sāpy upoṣitā ||
aruṇodayavelāyāṃ yā stokāpi tithir bhavet |
pūrṇā ity eva mantayā prabhūtā nodayaṃ vinā ||
tatra ced daśamīvedho ’tivedho vāpi jāyate |
mahāvedhāya vā yogo rakṣasāṃ saphalaṃ bhavet ||
tad etad daśamīśalyaṃ saṃtyājyaṃ dvādaśīdine |
ṣaḍ ahaṃ śodhayitvā tu samyak candrārkakovidaiḥ ||
tataḥ saśalyā parivarjanīyā
dharmārtha-kāmais tu budhair manuṣyaiḥ |
vihīnaśalyāpi vivarjanīyā
yadāgrato vṛddhim upaiti pakṣaḥ ||
śalyaṃ vedha iti prokaṃ purāṇārthavicakṣaṇaiḥ |
tat tyājyaṃ dūrato gāṅgaṃ surābinduyutaṃ yathā ||
catasro ghaṭikāḥ prātar aruṇodaya ucyate |
yatīnāṃ snānakālo ’yaṃ gaṅgāmbhaḥsadṛśaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
triyāmāṃ rajanīṃ prāhus tyaktvādyantacatuṣṭayam | |
nāḍīnāṃ tad ubhe saṃdhye dinasyādyantasaṃjñite ||
tadādivedharahitām upoṣyām āhur āsurīm |
viparītaṃ parityājyam āsuraṃ ca dinatrayam ||
nandā prātar bhaved bhadrā madhye prānte bhavej jayā |
[257]        daivaṃ dine trayaṃ pūrṇā nandā bhadreti cāsuraṃ |
trayodaśīdine prāpte dvādaśī labhyate yadā |
dvādaśadvādaśīr hanti trayodaśāṃ tu pāraṇe ||
trayodaśā dine prāpte dvādaśī kalayā bhavet |
tatra kratuśataṃ puṇyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇe ||
vinopavāsaniyamair dvādaśī laṅghitā nṛṇām |
karoti dharmaharaṇam asnāte ca sarasvatī ||
nandāpūrvāṃ jayāprāptāṃ tasmād bhadrām upāvaset |
pūrṇadine ca bhadrāntāṃ nandāṃ sūra kathaṃcana ||
ye tu mithyābhidhānena mohayanti narā bhuvi |
vimūḍhā pāpinas teṣāṃ rauravaṃ śaraṇaṃ ciram ||
adhyāpayanty avijñāya paṇḍitaṃ anyabuddhayaḥ (?) |
kārayanty abudhā loke dvādaśīṃ daśamīyutām ||
ye kārayanti kurvanti dvādaśīṃ daśamīyutām |
śuddhaye tanmukhaṃ vīkṣya sūryadarśanam ācaret |
namo nārāyaṇāyeti japed vā dvādaśākṣaram ||
kṛte pāpe tu tāpo vai yasya puṃsaḥ prajāyate |
prāyaścittaṃ tu tasyaikaṃ harisaṃsmaraṇaṃ param ||
varākā kim u jānanti praṇināṃ kāryacintanam |
dhigvimūḍhadhiyaḥ pāpān dharmaviplavakāriṇaḥ ||
hiṃsito bhagavān tena dvādaśī daśamīyutā |
kṛtā yena dvijaśreṣṭha samyag uktaṃ mayā tava ||
[258]        saṃsthito bhagavān kṛṣṇo dvādaśīrūpadhṛg yataḥ |
tasmād asaṃśayaṃ tyājyā dvādaśī daśamīyutā ||
nandā śarīraṃ devasya bhadrā hy ātmā hy ajo ’vyayaḥ |
tasmāt sarogaṃ tyaktvāṅgam ātmānaṃ tūpavāsayet ||
dvayor vivadatoḥ śrutvā dvādaśīṃ samupoṣayet |
pāraṇaṃ tu trayodaśyām eṣa śāstravinirṇayaḥ ||
dvādaśī daśamīyuktā yatra śāstre pratiṣṭhitā |
na tacchrāstram ahaṃ manye yadi brahmā svayaṃ vadet ||
kurvatām iha pāpāni dharṣṭhyaṃ paśyata yādṛśam |
kārayantītarān mūḍhān varākān prāṇinaḥ katham ||
dvādaśī daśamīviddhā gāndhāryā samupoṣitā |
tasyāḥ putraśataṃ naṣṭaṃ tasmāt tāṃ parivarjayet ||
ardharātre 'pi keṣāṃcid daśamyā vedha iṣyate |
aruṇodayavelāyāṃ nāvakāśo vicāraṇe ||
kapālavedha ity āhur ācāryā ye haripriyāḥ |
na tan mama mataṃ yasmāt triyāmā rātrir iṣyate ||
tat prātar eva vadanaṃ daivikaṃ dharmasādhanaṃ |
mukhyam āhur atas tyāgas tatra vedhaś ca niścitaḥ |
sūra uvāca |
kīdṛśaś ca bhaved vedho yogo viprendra kīdṛśaḥ |
vedhayogau samācakṣva tayor duṣṭam upoṣaṇam ||
śrīvyāsa uvāca |
[259]        catasro ghaṭikāḥ sūra aruṇodayaniścayaḥ  |
catuṣṭayavibhāgo ’tra vedhādīnāṃ kiloditaḥ ||
arayodayavedhaḥ syāt sārdhaṃ tu ghaṭikātrayam |
ativedho dvighaṭikaḥ prabhāṣandarśanād raveḥ ||
mahāvedho ’pi tatraiva dṛṣyate ’rko na dṛśyate |
turīyas tara vihito yogaḥ sūryodaye budheḥ ||
yātudhānavrataṃ yoge mahāvedhaṃ tu bāṣkale |
jambhāsurasyātivedhe mohinī vedhaleśinī ||
daśamyāḥ prāntaviddhaṃ hi yad yad duṣṭaṃ harer dinam |
tat purā vibudhair dattaṃ mohinyai tadviparyayāt ||
varam ekādaśītyāgo na kāryā daśamīyutā |
sūra me niścayaḥ so ’yaṃ na kṛtā dvādaśī śubhā |
daśamīśeṣasaṃyuktā kiṃ punar bahubhāṣiteḥ ||
itthaṃ vicārya nipuṇaiḥ saha viddhaikādaṣyā dvādaśyām abhāve dvādaśyāś ca trayodaśyām abhāve ’pi,
ekādaśīṃ daśāviddhāṃ pakṣavṛddhau vivarjayet |
pakṣahānau sthite some kurvīta daśamīyutāṃ ||
iti śruter amāvāsyāyāḥ paurṇamāsyā vā pratipadi sadbhāve ’pi śuddhā dvādaśy eva,
tithihānau prayoktavyā saśalyaikādaśī yadi |
upoṣyā dvādaś śuddhā trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam ||
ity anusārād upoṣyā, vihīnaśalyāpi vivarjanīyā, “yady agrato vṛddhim upaiti pakṣaḥ” iti tu yady api smārtaṃ tathāpi ekādaśīṃ daśāviddhām ity asya “saśalyaikādaśī yadi" ity asya viśeṣaṇasyānyathānupapatteḥ vihīnaśabdasya cātyantāśalyavācitvenāpy [260] upapatteḥ
aviddhāni niṣiddhaiś cen na labhyante dināni tu |
muhūrtaiḥ pañcabhir viddhā grāhyaivaikādaśītithiḥ ||
ity aviddhālābhanimittaviddhānujñāsmṛtyuktaghaṭikādaśakāpekṣayābhyadhikaviddhāpi tithir varjanīyety evaṃ vyākhyeyam |
eṣaiva ca |
darśaś ca pūrṇamāsaś ca sampūrṇā vardhate yadi |
dvitīye ’hni nṛpaśreṣṭha sā bhavet pakṣavardhanī |
ity ākhyāyate |
athonmīlinyādyaṣṭabhedanirūpaṇam |
brahmavaivarte |
ekādaśīvrataṃ sarvavratānāṃ pravaraṃ smṛtam |
tad ahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi tvam ākarṇaya sāṃpratam ||
viśodhanam idaṃ puṃsāṃ śuṣkārdrasyāṃhasaḥ param |
tatsvarūpaṃ śrutaṃ tīrthasnānād apy adhikaṃ viduḥ ||
eta sāram idaṃ tattvam idaṃ satyam idaṃ vratam |
prāyaścittam idaṃ samyag yad ekādaśyupoṣaṇam ||
viśeṣas tatra vijñeyo dvādaśīṣu dvijottama |
bhavanty aṣṭau parikhyātās tāḥ śṛṇuṣva yathoditāḥ ||
unmīlanī vañculī ca trispṛśā pakṣavardhanī |
jayā ca vijayā caiva jayantī pāpanāśinī |
dvādaśyo ’ṣṭau mahāpuṇyāḥ sarvapāpaharā dvija |
tithiyogena jāyante catasraś cāparās tathā |
[261]        nakṣatrayogāt prbalaṃ pāpaṃ praśamayanti tāḥ ||
ekādaśī tu saṃpūrṇā vardhate punar eva sā |
unmīlanī bhṛguśreṣṭha kathitā pāpanāśinī ||
dvādaśyām upavāsas tu dvādaśyām eva pāraṇam |
vañculī nāma sā proktā hatyāyutavināśinī ||
aruṇodaya ādyā syāt dvādaśī sakalaṃ dinam |
ante trayodaśī prātas trispṛśā sā hareḥ priyā ||
kuhūrāke yadā vṛddhiṃ prayāte pakṣavardhinī |
vihāyaikādaśīṃ tatra dvādaśīṃ samupoṣayet ||
puṣyaśravaṇapuṣyādyarohiṇīsaṃyutāḥ kṛtāḥ |
upoṣitāḥ samaphalā dvādaśyo ’ṣṭau pṛthak pṛthak ||
brahmaghnam api sā pūrvā viśodhayati bhārgava |
vañculīti dvitīyā sā hatyāyutavināśinī ||
mahāpāpāni catvāri śoṣayet trispṛśā kṛtā |
kurute ’śeṣakaluṣavicchedaṃ pakṣavardhanī ||
jayā jayantu vijayā pretamokṣaṃ tathāparā |
jayantī narakaccedam api duṣkṛtakāriṇām |
aṣṭamī tu bhṛguśreṣṭha mahāpātakanāśinī ||
tāvāt pāpāni deheṣu duḥsahā yamayātanāḥ |
kurvanti prāṇināṃ yāvan naitad unmīlanīvratam ||
yad atra dīyate dānaṃ hūyate cātra yad dhaviḥ |
sarvaṃ tad akṣayaṃ prāhur unmīlinyāṃ maharṣayaḥ ||
[262]        vañculī vāsare yatra saṃprāpte garuḍadhvajaḥ |
svasthānād vasudhām etya kurute vāñchitaṃ viśām ||
vañculīvimukhaṃ mārtyam ālokya ravinandanaḥ |
kurute saṃvidaṃ sākaṃ citraguptena harṣitaḥ ||
ayam eṣyati mandātmā viṣṇuvratabahiṣkṛtaḥ |
vaśaṃ mameti tat puṇyaṃ mārjayādya purākṛtam ||
śirortir nitarām eṣāṃ māse ’traiva pradhāvate |
yānti viṣṇuparāḥ svargam api duṣkṛtakāriṇaḥ ||
dvādaśyo 'ṣṭau samākhyātā yāḥ purāṇavicakṣaṇaiḥ |
tāsām ekāpi vihitā hanti pāpaṃ purākṛtam |
tad eva viparītena hanti puṇyaṃ purākṛtam ||
āyāti mahatā puṇyaprasāreṇa harer dinam |
śuklapakṣe kuruśreṣṭha viśeṣavratasaṃyutam ||
tadāyātam api tyaktaṃ yadi puṇyabahiṣkṛtaiḥ |
tad etad amṛtaṃ prāptaṃ karād vigalitaṃ kṣaṇāt ||
ekādaśīsvarūpeṇa dharmaḥ sākṣāj janārdanaḥ |
tac charīrasamaṃ prāhur vañculyunmīlinīvratam ||
vihāya vañculīṃ pāpāḥ kariṣyanti parāṃ tithim |
na ca rājan vijānanti prāṇinaḥ sauracakṣuṣaḥ ||
svayaṃvinirṇayān dhik tān nīcān paṇḍitamāninaḥ |
ye gartāyatanaṃ sarvaprāṇināṃ kārayanty uta ||
ye kārayanty avibudhāḥ śāstram ullaṅghya haitukāḥ |
[263]        prāṇinas tat kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ teṣāṃ gacchaty asaṃśayam ||
teṣāṃ nirabhimānais tu bhūtvā śāstrānugāmibhiḥ |
yathāvad upadeṣṭayaṃ na bhāvyaṃ kaluṣāśayaiḥ ||
sarvavratānāṃ caraṇaṃ sarvatīrthābhiṣecanam |
sarvadānapradānaṃ ca samaṃ syād vañculīvrataṃ ||
tatrānnadānaṃ viprāya vidhāya śraddhayānvitaḥ |
prāpnoti bahuśo vipro 'kalmaṣaḥ kṛṣṇasaṃnidhim ||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ sauvarṇaṃ tatra pūjayet |
yathāśakty annadānaṃ ca datvā vaikuṇṭham āpnuyāt ||
hanti tripauruṣaṃ pāpaṃ vañculī bhaktitaḥ kṛtā |
sa eva sarvaśāstrārthaḥ sarvabuddhimatāṃ satāṃ ||
hitaṃ sarvaṃ samīcīnaṃ yad vañculyām upoṣaṇam |
upavāsaṃ yathāśaktyā dānaṃ brāhmaṇapūjanam |
vidhāya vañculīṃ caiva puruṣo yāti sadgatim ||
evam unmīlinyādyaṣṭaikāśīmāhātmyaṃ vistāreṇa nirūpyopasaṃhṛtam |
evaṃ samastavaradharmaguṇāśritaṃ vai
caikādaśīvratam idaṃ kila hetuyuktam |
śāstrānvito harinas tu haripriyaṃ yaḥ
śuddhaṃ punaḥ prakurate labhate sa muktim ||
ity unmīlinyādyaṣṭanirūpaṇam |
apare tv āhuḥ | parato dvādaśīsadbhāve sati sarveṣāṃ śuddhadvādaśyām upavāsas tadabhāve tu viddhaikādaśyām iti |
[264]        tathā ca śrutiḥ |
ekādaśīṃ daśāviddhāṃ pakṣavṛddhau vivarjayet |
pakṣahānau sthite some laṅghayed daśamīyutām |
‘laṅghayet’ upavased ity arthaḥ |
vāyupurāṇe |
ekādaśī daśāviddhā dvādaśī ca pare ’hani |
dvādaśī tu tadopoṣyā dharmakāmārthasādhanī || iti ||
tad ayukaṃ, parato dvādaśyabhāve ’pi śuddhadvādaśyām upavāsavidhānāt |
tathā ca kūrma-padmapurāṇayoḥ |
ekādaśī daśāviddhā parato dvādaśī na cet |
tatropoṣyā dvādaśī tu trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam ||
anyāny apy evaṃviṣayāṇi vacanāni prāgdarśitāni | na ca parayuktaikādaśīviṣayam idaṃ vacanajātaṃ, “tadopoṣyā dvādaśī" iti vacanāt | tathā hi dvitīyaikādaśī grāhyeti vaktum ucitaṃ na tu dvādaśīti |
kecit tu sannyāsiviṣayam idaṃ vacanajātam ity āhuḥ |
tan mandaṃ pramāṇābhāvāt | na ca
śuddhaiva dvādaśī rājann upoṣyā mokṣakāṅkṣibhiḥ |
pāraṇaṃ tu trayodaśyām |
iti vacanaṃ pramāṇaṃ | na hy etena vacanena śuddhadvādaśyupavāsaḥ sannyāsināṃ vidhīyate, kiṃ tu mumukṣūṇām | na ca sannyāsinām eva mumukṣateti niyamaḥ | kiṃ ca kṣatriyāder api śuddhadvādaśyupavāso vidhīyate
kṣatriyair vaiśyais tathā śuddhaiḥ kim anyac chrotum arhasi |
iti vacanena, tatra na śūdrādeḥ sannyāsaḥ saṃbhavati | kiṃ ca yatīnām api viddhaikādaśyupavāso vidhīyate |
[265]        ekādaśī daśāviddhā parato ’pi na vardhate |
gṛhibhir yatibhiś caiva saivopoṣyā sadā tithiḥ ||
iti matsyapurāṇavacanena |
anye tv aruṇodayaviddhaikādaśyupavāsaviṣayaḥ, tadūrdhvaviddhaviṣaśās tanniṣedhāḥ, śuddhadvādaśyupavāsavidhayaś cety āhuḥ |
tan mandaṃ | aruṇodayaviddhaikādaśyupavāsaniṣedhānāṃ prāg udāhṛtatvāt |
anye tu yadā vidddhaikādaśīdvādaśyāṃ ca śravaṇam ṛkṣaṃ bhavati tadā viddhaikādaśyupavāsaniṣedhāḥ śuddhadvādaśyupavāsavidhayaś ca, viddhaikādaśyupavāsavidhayas tu ekādaśyantaraviṣayā ity āhuḥ | ekādaśyām aviddhāyāṃ śravaṇe prāpte śuddhadvādaśyupavāsavidhānāt | tathā ca nāradīyapurāṇe |
ekādaśyām aviddhāyāṃ saṃprāpte śravaṇe tathā |
upoṣyā dvādaśī puṇyā ubhayor daivataṃ hariḥ ||
skandapurāṇe |
śāstravāde ’py upasthite |
iti caturthaḥ pādaḥ padyate |
kūrmapurāṇe |
ekādaśī daśāviddhā śravaṇaṃ ca bhavet tathā |
upoṣyā dvādaśī tatra trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam ||
kiṃ caivaṃvidhaikādaśyupavāsaprakaraṇapāṭho ’narthakaḥ syāt |
apare tu viddhaikādaśyupavāso dinakṣayaviṣayaḥ anyatra śuddhadvādaśyupavāso dinakṣayaviṣayaḥ | anyatra śuddhadvādaśyāṃ dinakṣayam ṛte devenopoṣyā “daśamīyuteti" vacanād ity āhuḥ |
tad apy ayuktaṃ ekādaśīdinakṣaye ’pi śuddhadvādaśyām upavāsavidhānasya darśitatvāt |
[266]        anye tu “viddhāpy ekādaśītyādivacanajātaṃ parato dvādāśyabhāve sati śuddhaikādaśīpraśaṃsārtham | parato dvādaśī na ced viddhāpi grāhyā kim utāviddhāpi | tathā ca mūlāntarakalpanābhāve ’pi viddhaikādaśyupavāsaniṣedhavacasām asaṅkocaś ca bhavet viṣṇurahasyādyupakramopasaṃhāraparyalocanayā cāyam evārthaḥ pratīyata ity āhuḥ |
tatra “dinakṣayam ṭṛe devīti vacanaṃ katham iti cintyam |
kecit tu parato dvādaśīsadbhāve sati dvitīyaikādaśyupavāsaḥ sarveṣāṃ nānyathety āhuḥ |
tathā ca bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
tṛtīye ’hani saṃprāpte dvādaśī yadi dṛṣyate |
dvitīyaikādaśīṃ kuryāt prathamāṃ tu vivarjayet ||
dvādaśyekādaśī yuktā dvādaśī parato yadi |
dvādaśīmiśritopoṣyā tithir ekādaśī tadā ||
dvādaśyekādaśī yatra dvādaśī parato bhavet |
tatropoṣyā dvitīyā tu dvādaśyāṃ caiva pārayam || iti ||
tad ayuktam parato dvādaśyābhāve dvitīyaikādaśyupavāsavidhānāt |
tathā ca brahma-vārāha-skandapurāṇeṣu |
daśamīśeṣasaṃyuktā yadi vṛddhimatī bhavet |
tadopoṣyā dvitīyā syāt trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam ||
skandapurāṇe |
dvādaśyekādaśī yatra saṃyutā munisattama |
[267]        tām upoṣya naraḥ kuryāt trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam ||
kūrmapurāṇe |
ekādaśī kalāpy ekā parato dvādaśī na cet |
tatra kratuśataṃ puṇyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam || iti ||
na ca parato dvādaśīsadbhāvaviṣayāṇy etāni vacanāni "trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam" iti vacanāt, tadā dvādaśyāṃ pāraṇam iti vācyaṃ na tu trayodaśyām iti |
kecit sannyāsiviṣayam idaṃ vacanajātam |
yadā tu daśamīviddhā dvādaśīm api saṃspṛśet |
ekādaśī tadopoṣyā dvitīyā mokṣakāṅkṣibhiḥ ||
ekādaśī daśāviddhā parato ’pi bhaved yadi |
tadopoṣyā dvitīyā tu viṣṇusāyujyam icchatā ||
iti vacanād ity āhuḥ |
tan mandaṃ, na hīdaṃ vacanadvayaṃ sanyāsināṃ dvitīyaikādaśyupavāsam āha, kiṃ tu mumukṣūṇām | na ca sannyāsinām eva mumukṣā, gṛhasthāder api tatsaṃbhavāt |
nanu ca yāni trayodaśīpāraṇaparāṇi teṣv eva "tatra kratuśataṃ puṇyaṃ" ityādiphalaśravaṇaṃ, tāni kāmyopavāsābhiprāyāṇi, viddhopavāsavidhiparāṇi tu nityopavāsaviṣayāṇīti vyavasthā kiṃ na syāt |
maivaṃ |
yadi daivāt tu saṃsidhyed ekādaśyāṃ tithitrayam |
tatra kratuśataṃ puṇyaṃ dvādaśīpāraṇaṃ bhavet ||
dvādaśyekādaśī yatra dvādaśī parato ’pi vā |
dvādaśīpāraṇaṃ kuryāt kratukoṭiphalaṃ labhet ||
[268]        iti dvādaśīpāraṇe ’pi phalaśravaṇāviśeṣāt |
kiṃ ca |
sarvatraikādaśī kāryā dvādaśīmiśritā naraiḥ |
prātar bhavatu vā mā vā yato nityaṃ hi paraṇam |
pāraṇaṃ tu trayodaśyāṃ niṣkāmāṇāṃ vimuktidam ||
ityādiṣu trayodaśīpāraṇasyāpi nityatāśravaṇāc ca | ato neyaṃ phalaśrutiḥ, api tv arthavāda iti mamayaṃ |
apare tv āhuḥ viddhaikādaśyā nirṇayaṃ vaktuṃ kīdṛgvedha iti tāvad vaktavyam |
ardharātrāt parā yatra ekādaśyāṃ tu labhyate |
tatropavāsanaṃ kartuṃ na cecched daśamīkalā ||
iti smṛtyālocanayārdharātrād ūrdhvaṃ daśamīsparśasya vedhatvāvagamāt |
ādityodayavelāyāṃ prāṅmuhūrtadvayānvitā |
ekādaśī tu saṃpūrṇā viddhānyā parikīrtitā ||
iti smṛteḥ sūryodayāt prāg ghaṭikācatuṣṭaye daśamīsparśasya vedhatvāvagamāt,
sūryodayaspṛśā hy eṣā daśamyā garhitā sadā |
ity smṛtyālocanayā ca sūryodaye daśamīsparśasya vedhatvāvagamāt, sūryodayāt prāg daśamīsparśasya vedhatve tadūrdhvakālīnasya sutarāṃ vedhatvasiddheḥ “sūryodayaspṛśā śeṣeti" vākyānarthakyaprasaṅgād avedhakatve vā tadvedhakatvābhidhāyakavākyavirodhaprasaṅgāt |
aruṇodayavedhaḥ syāt sārdhaṃ tu ghaṭikācayaṃ |
ativedho dvighaṭikaḥ prabhāsaṃ darśanād raveḥ |
[269]        mahāvedho ’pi tatraiva dṛśyate ’ko na dṛṣāte ||
yā tithiḥ spṛśate rājan prātar vaktrāvalokinī |
sa vedha iti vijñeyo yogaḥ sūryodaye smṛtaḥ ||
iti cāturvidhyasmṛtyālocanāc ca viṣayatāratamyād doṣatāratamyam ābhāti |
tad ayukaṃ karmāṅgakāladoṣasya puruṣe doṣānāpādakatvāt karmaṇaś ca svasādhyaphalasādhakatvātiriktadoṣābhāvād alpavedhe ’pi ca karmavaiguṇyāt phalāsiddheḥ karmadoṣatāratamyāyogāt |
daśamīśeṣasaṃyuktāṃ na tu kuryāt kathaṃcana |
jambhasyeyaṃ purā dattā daśamyāḥ śeṣasaṃyutā ||
upoṣitā pramādena prāyaścitaṃ caret dvijaḥ |
prāyaścittam akurvāṇas tatphalena vināśitaḥ |
sa gacchaty andhatāmisraṃ narakaṃ bhṛśadāruṇam ||
ajñānāt yadi vā mohāt kurvann ekādaśīṃ naraḥ |
daśamīśeṣasaṃyuktāṃ prāyaścittam idaṃ bhavet ||
tatra kṛcchraṃ naraś cīrtvā gām ca dadyāt savatsikām |
suvarṇasyārdhakaṃ deyaṃ tiladroṇasamanvitam ||
iti vihitena prāyaścittena parihṛte vaiguṇye bahuvidhe ’pi yamagraphalasiddheḥ |
yātudhānavrataṃ yoge mahāvedhaṃ tu bāṣkale |
jambhāsurasyātivedhe mohinī śilavedhanī ||
iti jambhāsurabhāgitayā ninditātivedhamātraviṣayatvenāsya prāyaścittasya vedhamahāvedhādau tadanusāreṇa prāyaścittālpatvamahatvasyakalpyatvāt [270] prāyaścittavaiṣamyeṇa vaiguṇyākhyakarmadoṣavaiṣamyāvagates tāratamyaṃ yukram iti cet | na |
daśamīśeṣasaṃyuktā na tu kāryā kathaṃcana |
iti sāmānyaviṣayaniṣedhānusārāt "jambhasyeyaṃ purā datteti" nindārthavādasya jambhagrahaṇasyopalakṣaṇatvāvagame prāyaścittaviṣayavyavasthāpanāśakteḥ |
prāyaścittaṃ tu kartavyaṃ śuddhyarthaṃ tu vratasya vai |
niśchidraṃ jāyate hy etad dharmasantānam eva ca ||
brāhmaṇān bhojayet triṃśad gāṃ ca dadyāt savatsikām |
suvarṇasyārdhakaṃ deyaṃ tiladroṇam athāpi vā ||
iti smṛtyantare ca viṣayaviśeṣāpratīteḥ smṛtasya ca prāyaścittasya viśiṣṭaviṣayakalpane ’pi viṣayāntare ’pi tad eva prāyaścittam anyad veti niścetum aśakyatvāt vaiguṇyavaiṣamyakalpanayā prāyaścittavaiṣamyakalpanā prāyaścittavaiṣamyakalpanayā ca vaiguṇyavaiṣamyakalpanety anyonyāśrayatāpatter na prāyaścittatāratamyād doṣatāratamyakalpanaṃ yuktam | vedhātivedhamahāvedhayogākhyacāturvidhyasmṛteś ca | “etāni vai daśa yajñāyudhāni" iti yajñāyudhavyapadeśasya “sa eṣa yajñāyudhīyaṃ yajamāno 'ñjasā svargalokaṃ yātīty arthavādaupayikatvavat "yātudhānavrataṃ yoga ityādinindārthavādaupayikatvasaṃbhavān na tadbalād api doṣatāratamyakalpamā yuktā, tasmāt sarvavākyopapattyartham evaṃ vaktavyam, "sūryodayaspṛśā hy evety atra sadeti śravaṇāt sūryodaye daśamīsparśasya nitye kāmye vaikādaśīvrate garhitatvapratīteḥ “daśamīśeṣasaṃyuktety saṃyuktaśabdaśravaṇāt "yogaḥ sūryodaye smṛta [271] iti yogavyapadeśasya sūryodaye daśamīsparśasya niṣedhapratīteḥ (?) |
daśamyāḥ prāntam ādāya yadodeti divākaraḥ |
tena spṛṣṭaṃ haridinaṃ dattaṃ jambāsurasya tu ||
iti smṛtyantare ca sūryodaye daśamīsparśasya jambhāsurabhāgitvena nindanāt “jambhasyeyaṃ purā datteti nindāyā api tadviṣayatvāpatteḥ sūryodaye daśamīsparśasyaiva niṣiddhatvād vedho ’vasīyate | tataḥ prācīnānāṃ tu sparśānāṃ madhye |
aruṇodayakāle tu daśamī yadi dṛśyate |
pāpamūlaṃ sadā jñeyaṃ ekādaśyupavāsinām ||
iti nindāśravaṇe ’py aruṇodaye tu daśamīsparśasya |
aruṇodaye tu daśamīgandhamātraṃ bhaved yadi |
draṣṭavyaṃ tat prayatnena varjanīyaṃ narādhipa |
iti niṣedhaśravaṇe ’pi ca |
daśamīśeṣasaṃyukto yadi syād araṇodayaḥ |
vaiṣṇavena tu kartavyaṃ taddinaikādaśīvratam ||
iti smṛter niṣedhasya viṣṇusāyujyakāmāsya vaiṣṇavaviṣayatvāvagamāt |
udayāt prāk trighaṭikāvyāpiny ekādaśī yadā |
saṃdigdhaikādaśī nāma varjayed dharmakāṅkṣibhiḥ ||
iti ca |
vīraḥ śaktimatāṃ śreṣṭho dharmī dharmavid uttamaḥ |
iti dharmaśabdasya “viṣṇunāmasupāṭhād yajñena yajñam ayajanta devās tāni dharmāṇi prathamāny āsann" iti mantraliṅgād dharmaśabdavācyatayāvagatena yajñena [272] “viṣṇur vai yajña" iti viṣṇoḥ saṃstavād dharmaśabdavācyatvāvagateḥ dharmakāṅkṣiśabdasya viṣṇusāyujyakāmayācitvāvagamena sūryodayāt prāk ghaṭikātrayavyāpyekādaśyupavāsavarjanaṃ viṣṇusāyujyakāmaviṣayam evāvasīyate | "catasro ghaṭikāḥ prātar aruṇodaya ucyata iti ghaṭikācatuṣṭayasya “aruṇodayavedhaḥ syāt sārddhaṃ ca ghaṭikātrayam" iti ca sārddhaghaṭikātrayasyāruṇodayakālatvasmaraṇe’pi |
niśiprānta tu yāmārddhe devavāditravādane |
sārasvatān adhyayane cāruṇodaya ucyate ||
iti rātryantyāṣṭamabhāge cāruṇodayakālasya smṛter makarasaṅkraṅgāntau saptaviṃśatighaṭikāmātratvād rātres tadaṣṭamabhāgena sārddhaghaṭikātrayasyāpi vyāptyaśakteḥ kiṃcidadhikaghaṭikātrayavyāpinyā api caikādaśyāḥ trighaṭikāvyāpinītvavyapadeśāvirodhāt ghaṭikātrayavyāptyuktyāraṇodayakālīnadaśamīsparśalakṣaṇopapattiḥ, sārddhaghaṭikātrayoktiḥ aṣṭāviṃśatighaṭikāmātrarātriviṣayā mahattarās tu rātrīr viṣayīkṛtya catasro ghaṭikā ity uktam | yad vā catasṛṣv api ghaṭikāsv aruṇodaye sārdhaghaṭikātrayāt prāgdaśamīsparśasya vedhakatvābhāvoktyarthaṃ sārdhaghaṭikātrayoktiḥ | sūryodayāt prāk ghaṭikādvaye daśamīsparśavarjanaṃ tu |
udayāt prāṅmuhūrttena vyāpiny ekādaśī yadā |
saṃyuktaikādaśī nāma varjayed dharmavṛddhaye ||
iti dharmavṛddhiśabdena śuddhyaupayikyāḥ satvaśuddheḥ,
yadīcched vipulān bhogān muktiś cātyantadurlabhā |
itiśabdalakṣitāyā dharmātiśayātmakatayā vivakṣitatvāt kāmaviṣayam |
[273]        ādityodayavelāyām ārabhya ṣaṣṭināḍikāḥ |
saṃpūṇaikādaśī nāma tyājyā dharmaphalepsubhiḥ ||
ity etat “mahāvedho ’pi tatraiva dṛṣyate ’rko dūśyate" iti smṛtyantarālocanayā,
ravicakrārddhamātrāpi daśamī śrūyate yadi |
tadāpi dvādaśī grāhyā trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam ||
iti smṛtyantarālocanayāpy ardhādityodaye daśamīsparśavarjanoktyarthaṃ "paśvādīni ca dharmasya phalāni" iti vyavasthitam iti mīmāṃsāvārttikābhidhānāt dharmaphalaśabdasya “yadīcched vipulān bhogān" ity ekādaśyupavāsākhyadharmaphalatayā smṛtibhogavācitvāvagateḥ tattatkāmaviṣayaṃ, dharmakāṅkṣidharmavṛddhidharmaphalaśabdānāṃ sammugdhalokaprasiddhārthatvābhyupagame aruṇodayavedhaprārabdhadharmāsamāptighaṭikādvayavedhe samāptasyāpi dharmasyātiśayasiddhiruddhasūryodayavedhe ’tiśayitasyāpi dharmasya pratibandhādivaśāt phalānavāptir ityāpatter viparītavedhatāratamyaprasaṅgāt prathamo vedho dvitīyo ’tivedhaḥ tṛtīyo mahāvedha iti vyapadeśā nirālambanāḥ syuḥ, samāptasyāpi karmaṇaḥ śreyaskaratvākhyadharmatvāsiddhāv api dharmakāṅkṣiśabdena vivakṣitāyāṃ dharmaphalāvāptiśabdenāpi tasyā eva vivakṣāpratīter mahāvedhavyavasthā nirālambanā syād ato ’smatkṛtaiva dharmakāṅkṣidharmavṛddhidharmaphalāptiśabdavyākhyā yuktā sūryodayottarakāladaśamīsparśaniṣedhavat tatkāladhaśamīsparśaniṣedhānām api sarvaviṣayatvābhyupagame tu dharmakāṅkṣādiśabdānarthakyāpatiḥ | “saṃdigdhaikādaśī nāma varjyā syād dharmakāṅkṣibhir" ity etad uttarasya “putrarājyasamṛddhyarthaṃ dvādaśyām upavāsayed" ity asya [274]  saṃyuktaikāsaśīṃ nāma varjayed dharmavṛddhaya ity etaduttarasya ca “putrapautrasamṛddhyarthaṃ dvādaśyām upavāsayed ity asya “saṃkīrṇaikādaśī nāma tyājyā dharmaphalepsubhir" ity etaduttarasya ca “putrapautrasamṛddhyarthaṃ dvādaśyām upavāsayed" ityasyāruṇodayādividdhaikādaśīviṣaye phalāntarakāmasya dvādaśyupavāsavidhānārthatvāt na tadvaśenāruṇodayādividdhaikādaśīniṣedhānāṃ phalāntarakāmaviṣayatvaṃ śaṅkanīyam | “pāpamūlaṃ sadā jñeyam" ity asyā nindāmātratvāt sacchabdavācyasya viṣṇor iyam āśety api ca vyākhyātuṃ śakyatvāt sadāśravaṇamātreṇāruṇodayakāle daśamīsparśaniṣedhasya sarvaviṣayatvāpattiḥ | “aruṇodayavelāyāṃ viddhā kācid upoṣitā | tasyāḥ putraśataṃ naṣṭaṃ tasmāt tāṃ parivarjayed ity api nindāmātram | “sūryodayaspṛśā hy eṣā daśamī garhitā sadety asya tu niṣedhārthatvāt,
aviddhāni niṣiddhaiś cet na labhyante dināni tu |
muhūrttaiḥ pañcabhir viddhā grāhyaivaikādaśī tithiḥ |
ityādivirodhāpatter ekādaśyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ parato vā sattve cety evaṃ sadāśabdavyākhyanayogāt sarvanityakāmyaikādaśyupavāsaviṣayatvavyākhyānayogāt sarvanityakāmyaikādaśyupavāsaviṣayatvavyākhyaiva yuktā,
udayād ūrdhvaviddhā tu daśamyekādaśī yadā |
dānavebhyaḥ prīṇanārthaṃ dattavān pākaśāsana ||
iti smṛtyantaradarśanāt sūryodayottarakālasparśinī sūryodayaspṛśāśabdenokteti gamyate | tasmāt sūryodayottarakāladaśamīsparśa eva sarvaviṣayovedhaḥ, aruṇodayaghaṭikādvayārddhasūryodayakālās tu daśamīsparśā yathākramaṃ viṣṇusāyujyamuktikāmaikādaśyupāyaviṣayā eveti siddham | ardharātrāt parā daśamīkalā labhyate tatropavāsaṃ nārabhetety evaṃ prathamārambhaviṣayatayā vyākhyeyaṃ |
tad etad ayukaṃ | tatra yat tāvad uktaṃ karmāṅgakāladoṣasya puruṣadoṣānāpādakatvād iti tad ayuktam | [275] karmāṅgakālaniṣiddhakāle karmānuṣṭhāne sarvavākyeṣv api puruṣadoṣasyaivābhidhānāt bādhakābhāvāc ca tattyāgānupapatteḥ | yad api vaiṣṇavaśabdena viṣṇusāyujyakāmo ’bhidhīyata ity uktaṃ tad api na viṣṇuprītikāmaviṣṇubhaktānām ekādaśyupavāsinām apy abhidhānāt | dharmakāṅkṣidharmavṛddhidharmaphalaśabdānāṃ lokaprasiddhārthahānam apy ayuktam, vedhatāratamyaṃ ca puruṣadoṣatāratamyād upapadyate, aruṇodayaviddhaikādaśīniṣedhānāṃ phalāntarakāmaviṣayatvam apy ekavākyatāvaśād avagamyate, "pāpamūlaṃ sadā jñeyam" ity atra sadāśabdasya “sūryodayaspṛśā hy eṣā daśamī garhitā sadeti ca viddhānugrahavyatiriktaviṣayatvopapatteḥ na sacchabdasya viṣṇuparatvena kliṣṭakalpanayā vyākhyānaṃ yuktaṃ tasmād yathoktam eva sādhīyaḥ |
athaikādaśīdvādaśyupavāsakālanirṇayaḥ |
yadaikādaśīmiśrāyāṃ dvādaśyām ekādaśīvrataṃ prāpnoti dvādaśīvrataṃ ca tadaikenopavāsenaikādaśyupavāso dvādaśyupavāsaś ca suddhyati | yadā tv ekādaśyāṃ pṛthag upavāsaḥ saṃpūrṇatvena prāpnoti dvādaśyāṃ ca pṛthak tadopavāsadvayaṃ kartavyaṃ “ ekādaśīm upoṣyaiva dvādaśīm apy upoṣayet | na cātra vidhilopaḥ syād ubhayor daivataṃ hariḥ iti vidhānāt | “asamāpte vrate pūrve naiva kuryād vratāntaram iti samāptiś ca pāraṇena | tadabhāve upavāsadvaye ’pi kriyamāṇe pūrvavratasyāsamāpter vidhilopaḥ prāpnoti | so ’py ekadevatātvena parihṛto bhavaty eva |
evam ekādaśīṃ tyaktvā dvādaśīṃ samupoṣayet |
pūrvavāsarajaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvaṃ prāpnoty asaṃśayaṃ ||
etad upavāsadvayāsamarthaṃ praty ucyate | yadaikasminn apy upavāse asamarthasyaikabhakādi vihitaṃ tadopavāsadvayāsamarthaṃ prati kiṃ u vaktavyam | ekādaśyupavāsavrataṃ nityaṃ sarveṣāṃ sarvadā hitaṃ tathā [276] dvādaśyupavāsavrataṃ kāmyam anyad eva sarveṣāṃ sarvadā vihitaṃ, mārkaṇḍeya-pradyumnasaṃvāde mārkaṇḍeyena pūrvam ekādaśyām upavāso dvādaśyāṃ pāraṇam ity uktvānantaraṃ dvādaśyām upavāsaḥ trayodaśyāṃ pāraṇam ity uktam | tadviruddhaṃ vacanadvayaṃ śrutvendraprayumna uvāca |
nopoṣyā dvādaśī rājan purāṇe parikīrtitā |
tvayāpi muniśārdūla prāg uktaṃ tac chṛṇuṣva me ||
pāraṇe vyāhatā brahman dvādaśī keśavapriyā |
upoṣyā vyāhṛtā brahman tvayā hy ekādaśī śubhā ||
dvādaśyāṃ pāraṇaṃ kāryam ekādaśyāṃ hi laṅghanam |
purāṇavihite mārge niṣiddhaṃ carase katham ||
iti pṛṣṭo mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
śṛṇu bhūpāla sakalaṃ yat pṛṣṭaṃ sādhunā tvayā |
jagad vināśitaṃ duṣṭair hetuvādakathānvitaiḥ ||
dvādaśyā nirṇaye bhūpa mūḍham atra jagattrayam |
atha mūḍhā mahīpāla prāyaśo ye narāḥ purā ||
te naṣṭās teṣu na sthairyaṃ rahasyaṃ yāti bhūmipa |
samaleṣv atra deheṣu pītaṃ caivauṣadhaṃ yathā ||
ye śuddhās teṣu tad yāti sthiratvaṃ dharmasaṃgrahāt |
triphalā riktadehānāṃ auṣadhaṃ sthiratāṃ vrajet ||
caturdaśīm upoṣanti śivabhaktyā narādhipa |
na teṣāṃ gamanaṃ bhūpa narake dṛṣyate kvacit ||
[277]        apare gopatau kecid bhakiṃ kurvanti ye narāḥ |
saptamīṃ samupoṣanti bhaktiyuktās tathaiva ca |
na cāpi kutsitaṃ teṣāṃ mayā dṛṣṭaṃ narādhipa ||
paurṇamāsyupavāsena brahmalokaṃ gatā nṛpa |
apare tv aṣṭamīṃ santaḥ śivabhaktisamāśrayāḥ ||
kalipaṅkaṃ parityajya narāś caiva narottama |
ekādamī ṛṣīṇāṃ tu dvādaśī cakrapāṇinaḥ |
tat kathaṃ dvādaśī bhūpa nopoṣyā kriyate janaiḥ ||
eṣā niḥśreyasī bhūpa phālabhogavivarjitā |
mokṣātmikā purā proktā dvādaśī pravarā tithiḥ ||
ekādaśī śarīraṃ tu puruṣo dvādaśī smṛtā |
dvādaśyām upavāsena siddhā bhūpa sahasraśaḥ ||
cakravartitvam atulaṃ saṃprāptā avanīśvarāḥ |
caturdaśaite saṃjātā balinaś cakravartinaḥ ||
viṣṇvaṃśās te mahāvīryā duṣṭadaityanivarhaṇāḥ |
dvādaśyām upavāsena siddhā bhūpa sahasraśaḥ |
cakravartitvam atulaṃ saṃprāptā acalāṃ śriyam ||
upoṣya dvādaśīṃ śuddhāṃ yāvajjīvavratānvitāḥ |
cakravartitvam āpannā bhuktvā bhogān sukhāni te ||
kuvalāśvo bhavān gādhir hariścando nalaḥ pṛthuḥ |
maruto bharataś caiva kārttavīryaś ca haihayaḥ ||
māndhātā sagaro rāmaḥ kakutstho nahuṣas tathā |
[278]        upoṣya dvādaśīṃ puṇyāṃ aparāṃ ca vivarjya ca |
bhuktvā svargasukhāny ete cakravartitvam āgatāḥ ||
janakānāṃ mahīpāla dvādaśyāṃ samupoṣaṇe |
saptabhiḥ saptabhir yuktāḥ saṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ gatāḥ ||
purukutso mahīpālo dvādaśyāṃ samupoṣaṇe |
siddhiṃ gataḥ parityajya karmabandhaṃ durāsadam ||
māndhātā yauvanāśvaś ca dvādaśyāṃ samupoṣaṇe |
saṃgrāme nidhanaṃ prāpya saṃprāptaḥ paramaṃ padam ||
śākuntalo mahīpāla dauṣyantir aparājitaḥ |
dvādaśyām upavāsena gatas tad vaiṣṇavaṃ padam ||
vainyaḥ purūravā bhūpa pālayitvā dharātalam |
dharaṇīdharam abhyarcya dvādaśīṣu sadā punaḥ |
gatas tu vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ dāhapralayavarjitam ||
ete rājarṣayo bhūpa dvādaśyāṃ samupoṣaṇe |
siddhiṃ paramikāṃ prāptā ye dvijās tān śṛṇuṣva me ||
yājñavalkyas tu raibhyas tu māṇḍavyaḥ kauśiko muniḥ |
bharadvājas tathā kaṇvaḥ kumbhayonis taponidhiḥ ||
aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇāṃ ṛṣīṇām ūrdhvaretasām |

mayā saha gatā bhūpa kathante saṃśayo bhavet ||

anye tv āhuḥ |

athaikādaśīvrate naktādikālanirṇayaḥ |

yadīched ātmasantānaṃ caturṣu niyameṣv api ||
[280]        nopoṣitaṃ na naktaṃ ca naikabhaktam ayācitam |
mandāyāṃ pūrvaviddhāyāṃ kriyetaiśvaryam īhatā ||
ekādaśīyutā śastā dvādaśyāḥ samupoṣaṇe |
nakte vāyācite nityam ekabhakte tathārcane ||

viṣṇurahasye |

daśamyanugatā hanti dvādaśadvādaśīphalam |

skandapurāṇe ’pi |

sarvayajñādhikaṃ vāpi naraḥ prāpnoty asaṃśayam ||
