karoti dharmaharaṇaṃ asnāteva sarasvatī ||
kūrmapurāṇe |
kalādvayaṃ trayaṃ vāpi dvādaśīṃ na tv atikramet |
atikrāntā dvādaśī tu hanti puṇyaṃ purākṛtam ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
yo dvādaśīm atikramya pāraṇaṃ kurute naraḥ |
dvādaśābdavrataṃ tasya tatkṣaṇād eva naśyati ||
skandapurāṇe |
dvādaśīṃ yas tv atikramya trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam |
karoti tasya naśyanti dvādaśyo dvādaśaiva tu ||
devīrahasye |
dvādaśīṃ samatikramya pāraṇaṃ yaḥ karoti hi |
snānadānādikaṃ sarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ tasya jāyate ||
na ca |
[282]        yāṃ tithiṃ samanuprāpya udayaṃ yāti bhāskaraḥ |
sā tithiḥ sakalā jñeyā snānadānajapādiṣu ||
iti devalavacanāt dvādaśyatikrame na doṣa iti śaṅkanīyam | yata āha nāradapurāṇe vasiṣṭhaḥ |
pāraṇe maraṇe nṝṇāṃ tithis tātkālikī smṛtā | iti |
yasmin kāle pāraṇaṃ maraṇaṃ vā tatra tātkālikyeva tithiḥ na punaḥ sā tithiḥ sakalā jñeyety etad bhavatīty arthaḥ | yatra punas trayodaśyāṃ pāraṇakālaparyāptā kiyanmātraiva dvādaśī tatra padmapurāṇoktam |
trayodaśyāṃ yadā rājan dvādaśyās tu kalā bhavet |
yā tithiḥ sakalā ceti vaśiṣṭhaḥ prāha dharmavit ||
skandapurāṇe |
kalādvayaṃ trayaṃ vāpi dvādaśyāḥ samatikramet |
ekādaśīm upoṣitvā tatra dharmaphalaṃ vrajet ||
tathā |
dvādaśītithiśeṣaḥ syāt parataś ca trayodaśī |
tatra kratuśataṃ puṇyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇe ||
etad api pāraṇaparyāpītadvādaśīviṣayam | evaṃ ca yāni trayodaśīpāraṇe niṣedhaparāṇi dvādaśīpāraṇaniyamavidhiparāṇi vā tāni sarvaṇi trayodaśyāṃ dvādaśīsaṃbhavaviṣayāṇi |
tathā ca padmapurāṇe |
yadi kiṃcit trayodaśyāṃ dvādaśī copalabhyate |
dvādaśyāṃ pāraṇe yatra varjyajitvā trayodaśīm ||
[283]        mahāhānikarā hy eṣā dvādaśī laṅghitā naraiḥ |
karoti dharmaharaṇam asnāteva sarasvatī ||
atha vā dvādaśī na syāt svalpāpi ravisaṃyutā |
pāritavyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ mahāpuṇyavivṛddhaye ||
anyāsu gaṅgādyāsu saritsūtīrya parasmin tīre snātayaṃ sarasvatyāṃ tu prathamaṃ snātvā paraṃ pāraṃ gantavyaṃ, 'asnātā' kṛtaṃ snānaṃ yasyāṃ sā snātā kto’dhikaraṇe, na snātā 'asnātā' sarasvatī laṅghyamānā yathā dharmaharaṇaṃ karoti evaṃ pāraṇalaṅghitā atikrāmitā dvādaśī dharmaharaṇaṃ karoti |
purāṇāt |
ekādaśī dvādaśī ca tatropoṣyā kṛtaṃ phalam |
muhūrtaṃ dvādaśīṃ prāpya trayodaśyāṃ na pāraṇam ||
yāni punaḥ |
kalākāṣṭhāmurtaṃ tu yadi cen na pare ’hani |
dvādaśa dvādaśīr hanti trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam ||
iti trayodaśyāṃ dvādaśyasaṃbhavam anūdya pāraṇaniṣedhaparāṇi tāni |
viddhāpy ekādaśī grāhyā parato dvādaśī na cet |
dvādaśa dvādaśīr hanti trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇaṃ ||
ityādibhiḥ samānārthānīty anavadyam |
anye tv evaṃ trayodaśīpāraṇanindāpraśaṃsayor vyavasthām āhuḥ, gṛhasthānāṃ trayodaśīpāraṇaniṣedhaḥ tasyaiva ca dvādaśīphalahānilakṣaṇo nindārthavādaḥ, trayodaśīpāraṇaṃ tu yatīnāṃ, tathā hi dvādaśīkṣaye [284] gṛhiṇāṃ phalārthināṃ yujyate, yatayas tu phalanirapekṣāḥ kartavyam iti karmācaranti | kratuśataprāptipuṇyalakṣaṇapraśaṃsā yatīnām eva, na hi nānāvidhāni krtuśataphalāni trayodaśīpāraṇād bhavantīty arthaḥ pramāṇaṃ, tasmāt praśaṃsāmātram etad iti |
tad asat tathā hi dvādaśa dvādaśyo naśyānti gṛhiṇām ity asya ko ’rthaḥ, na khalu kṛtaṃ vinā karmabhogena kṣīyate, tena dvādaśyaḥ svarūpeṇa phalato vā nasyantīti na saṃbhavaḥ kiṃ tu pratyavāyaphalavibhīṣikeyaṃ | tathā hi na girā gireti brūyāt tadātmānam eva tad udgātodgired iti, na khalūdgātrātmagiraṇaṃ pratyakṣādibhir upalabhyate, kiṃ tu girāpadaprayoganindeyam iti sthitam | tathā dvādaśīkṣayanindā yatigṛhiṇor yater api hi nityanaimittikakāmyānuṣṭhānopāttaduritakṣayākaraṇanimittapratyavāyaparihāraprayojanaṃ tasmāt dvādaśīkṣaye saty upāttaduritakṣayābhāvād akaraṇanimittapratyavāyāpatteḥ trayodaśīpāraṇam anucitam eva yatīnām |
tathā cāha |
nityanaimittikair eva kurvāṇo duritakṣayam |
jñānaṃ ca vimalīkurvann abhyāsena ca pācayet |
vairāgyakṣepavijñānāt kaivalyaṃ labhate nara iti ||
yad apy uktam “viṣṇusāyujyam ṛcchatīti" yatīnām evocitaṃ na gṛhiṇām iti |
tad adpy asat | gṛhasthasyāpi yathocitakarmānuṣṭhānāt mokṣaśrutes tatra gṛhasthamumukṣoḥ karmāṇy upadiśyante, śrūyate ca "sa evaṃ vartayan yāvadāyuṣaṃ brahmalokam abhisampadyate na sa punar āvarttate" iti |
yājñavalkyaś ca |
[285]        nyāyāgatadhanas tattvajñānaniṣṭho ’tithipriyaḥ |
śrāddhakṛt satyavādī ca gṛhastho ’pi vimucyate|| iti ||
kratuśatapuṇyaprāptilakṣaṇā ca praśaṃsā yatigṛhiṇoḥ sādhāraṇaiva | tasmāt trayodaśīpāraṇavidhiniṣedhayor uktaiva vyavasthāśrayaṇīyā | athaikādaśyādidharmasaṃdehe sati yeṣāṃ vacanam upādeyaṃ yeṣāṃ cānupādeyaṃ te pradṛśyante viṣṇurahasye |
brahmovāca |
arcayanti sadā viṣṇuṃ manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ 1
teṣāṃ hi vacanaṃ grāhyaṃ te hi viṣṇusamā matāḥ ||
kūrmapurāṇe |
bhagavān uvāca |
saṃspṛṣṭvā vaiṣṇavān viprān viṣṇuśāstraviśāradān |
cīrṇavratān sadācārān taduktaṃ yatnavac caret ||
skandapurāṇe |
maheśvara uvāca |
ye purāṇāni jānanti setihāsāni tattvataḥ |
sadācāraparāḥ śāntās teṣāṃ vacanam auṣadham ||
pulastya-satyavratau |
dharmeṣu niyatā ye ca dharmaśāstrārthacintakāḥ |
vedaśāstravido ye vai teṣāṃ vacanam auṣadham ||
bhagavān vedavyāsaḥ |
vedavedārthatattvajñā dharmaśāstrārthacintakāḥ |
sadācāraparā ye vai teṣāṃ vacanam auṣadham ||
devīpurāṇe |
[286]        ye ca nyāyavidaḥ śāntā dharmaśāstrārthavedinaḥ |
svakarmaniratā dāntās teṣāṃ vacanam auṣadham ||
auṣadham ivopādeyam ity arthaḥ |
āpastambaḥ |
yaṃ śiṣṭā brāhmaṇā brūyuḥ sa dharmo mānuṣaḥ smṛtaḥ |
ārṣe dharmopadeśaṃ ca vedaśāstrāvirodhinā |
yas tarkeṇānusaṃdhatte sa dharmaṃ vetti tattvataḥ ||
tena tadacanam upādeyam ity arthaḥ |
śāradāpurāṇe |
purāṇanyāyamīmāṃsādharmaśāstrārthacintakāḥ |
sadācāraparā ye vai taduktaṃ yatnataś caret ||
padmapurāṇe |
setihāsapurāṇajñāḥ smṛtisiddhāntavedinaḥ |
vāsudevapriyā ye ca taduktaṃ vaidikaṃ bhavet ||
uktebhyaś ca ye 'nye teṣāṃ vacanaṃ varjanīyam ity arthaḥ | siddham uktaṃ ca viṣṇurahasye kūrmapurāṇe |
yeṣāṃ na kāraṇaṃ vedā na viprā na janārdanaḥ |
tantrāṇi dharmaśāstrāṇi pramāṇaṃ kāraṇaṃ mune |
skandapurāṇe |
vedādhigamahīnā ye śaucācāravivarjitāḥ |
nāstikāḥ paṇḍitaṃmanyās teṣāṃ vākyaṃ vivarjayet ||
vaiśvadevavihīnā ye japayajñavivarjitāḥ |
[287]        devatāvimukhā ye ca teṣāṃ vākyaṃ vivarjayet ||
ādityapurāṇe |
devatāvimukhā ye ca japahomavivarjitāḥ |
viṣṇubhaktivihīnāś ca teṣāṃ vākyaṃ vivarjayet ||
yeṣām araṇyakaṃ nāsti ratiḥ svādhyāya eva ca |
parame dhāmni sūrye ca teṣāṃ vākyaṃ vivarjayet ||
vaiṣṇavatantre |
yeṣāṃ gurau ca japye ca viṣṇau ca paramātmani |
nāti bhaktiḥ (?) sadā teṣāṃ vacanaṃ parivarjayet ||
vāyupurāṇe |
nagnānagnāḥ smṛtā ye vai haitukā bakavṛttayaḥ |
devatānindakā ye vai teṣāṃ vākyaṃ vivarjayet ||
kālikāpurāṇe |
vede ca devatāyāṃ ca karmaṇy api ca vaidike |
śraddhā nāsti ca yeṣāṃ vai teṣāṃ vākyaṃ vivarjayet ||
padmapurāṇe |
vācaṃ vyākurute naiva mīmāṃsāṃ na tathādhvaram |
śuṣkatarkaratā ye vai teṣāṃ vākyaṃ vivarjayet ||
skandapurāṇe |
yeṣāṃ viśveśvare viṣṇau śive bhaktir na vidyate |
na teṣāṃ vacanaṃ grāhyaṃ dharmanirṇayasiddhaye ||
tathā |
[288]        paścāśat tu purāṇāni setihāsāni mānavāḥ |
ye vinighnanti teṣāṃ ve vacanaṃ parivarjayet ||
tathā ca yogayājñavalkyaḥ |
purāṇaṃ pañcarātraṃ ca vedāḥ pāśupataṃ tathā |
atipramāṇāny etāni na hantavyāni hetubhiḥ ||
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevīyasamastakaraṇādhīśvarasakala-vidyāviśāradaśrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau pariśeṣakhaṇḍe
kālanirṇaye ekādaśīnirṇayaḥ ṣaḍo ’dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ |
[289]
atha saptamo’dhyāyaḥ |
dādaśīmiryayaprakaraṇam |
atha śravaṇadvādaśaunirṇayaḥ |
viṣṇudharmottare |
śrīrāma uvāca |
upavāsāsamarthānāṃ kiṃ syād ekam upoṣitam |
mahāphalaṃ mahādeva tan mam ācakṣva pṛcchataḥ |
śaṅkara uvāca |
yā rāma śravaṇopetā dvādaśī mahatī tu yā |
tasyām upoṣitaḥ snātaḥ pūjayitvā janārdanam ||
prāpnoty ayatnād dharmajña dvādaśadvādaśīphalam |
bhaviṣyottare |
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca |
upavāsāsamarthānāṃ sadaiva puruṣottama |
eṣā yā dvādaśī puṇyā tāṃ vadasva mamānagha ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
māsi bhādrapade śuklā dvādaśī śravaṇānvitā |
sarvakāmaphalā puṇyā upavāse mahāphalā ||
saṃgame saritāṃ snātvā svādaśyaṃ samupoṣitaḥ |
samagraṃ samavāpnoti dvādaśadvāśīphalam ||
[290]        tathā |
dvādaśī śravaṇopetā yadā bhavati bhārata |
saṃgame saritāṃ snātvā gaṅgādisnānajaṃ phalam |
sopavāsaḥ samāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
yamaḥ |
yadā ca śukladvādaśyāṃ nakṣatraṃ śravaṇaṃ bhavet |
nāmnā tu sā mahāpuṇyā dvādaśī vijayā smṛtā |
viṣṇurahasye |
śravaṇena samāyuktā māsi bhādrapade hi sā |
dvādaśī sā mahāpuṇyā nāmnā tu vijayā hi sā ||
tasyāṃ snāto vidhānena sarvatīrthaphalaṃ labhet |
arcayitvā ’cyutaṃ bhaktyā labhet puṇyaṃ daśābdikam ||
skandapurāṇe |
māsi bhādrapade śuklā dvādaśī śravaṇānvitā |
mahatī dvādaśī jñeyā upavāse mahāphalā ||
saṃgame saritāṃ puṇye dvādaśīṃ tām upoṣitaḥ |
aplavād eva cāpnoti dvādaśadvādaśīphalam ||
budhaśravaṇasaṃyuktā saiva ced dvādaśī bhavet |
atyantamahatī tasyāṃ dattaṃ bhavati cākṣayam iti ||
arcayitvācyutaṃ bhaktyā labhet puṇyaṃ daśābdikam |
phalaṃ dattakṛtānāṃ ca tasyāṃ lakṣaguṇaṃ bhavet ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
[291]        śravaṇadvādaśīyoge budhavāro bhaved yadi |
atyantamahatī nāma dvādaśī sā prakīrtitā ||
snānaṃ japyaṃ tathā dānaṃ homaśrāddhaṃ surārcanam |
sarvam akṣayam āpnoti tasyāṃ bhṛgukulodvaha ||
tasmin dine tathā snāto yatra kvacana saṃgame |
sa gaṅgāsnānajaṃ rāma phalaṃ prāpnoty asaṃśayam ||
śravaṇe saṃgamāḥ sarve paripuṣṭipradāḥ sadāḥ (?) |
viśeṣād dvādaśīyukte vratayukte viśeṣataḥ ||
budhaśravaṇasaṃyuktā saiva ced dvādaśī bhavet |
atīva mahato tasyāṃ sarvaṃ dattam ihākṣayam ||
śravaṇadvādaśīyoge pūjayitvā janārdanam |
dānaṃ dattvā ca viprebhvaḥ sopavāso jitendriyaḥ ||
mahānadīsaṃgameṣu prativarṣaṃ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ |
cakāra vidhivad dānaṃ tato diṣṭāntam āgataḥ ||
avyayaṃ paramaṃ sthānaṃ durlabhaṃ sarvamānavaiḥ |
yatra kāmaphalā vṛkṣāḥ nadyāḥ pāyasakardamāḥ |
sadaivāmalapānīyāḥ puṣkariṇyo manoramāḥ ||
taṃ deśam āsādya vaṇiṅ mahātmā
sumṛṣṭajāmbūnadabhūṣitāṅgaḥ |
kalpaṃ samagraṃ surasundarībhiḥ
sākaṃ sa reme muditaḥ sadaiva ||
budhaśravaṇasaṃyuktā dvādaśī saṃgamodakam |
[292]        dānaṃ dadhyodanaṃ śastam upavāsaparo vidhiḥ ||
sagareṇa kakutsthena dhundhumāreṇa gādhinā |
etaiś cānyaiś ca rājendra kāmadā dvādaśī kṛtā ||
yā dvādaśī budhayutaśravaṇena sārdhaṃ
sā vai jayeti kathitā munibhir namasyaiḥ |
tām ādareṇa samupoṣya naro hi samyak
prāpnoti siddhimaṇim ādiguṇopapannām ||
pauṣkare pañcarātre ca |
sarvakāmaplave viṣṇur budhaśravaṇavāsare |
dvādaśyāṃ prīṇanīyaḥ syān nimnagāsaṃgame kvacit ||
tathā ca śravaṇadvādaśīṃ prakṛtyoktaṃ nāradīyapurāṇe viṣṇurahasye ca |
dvādaśyām upavāso 'tra trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam |
niṣiddham api kartavyam ity ājñā pārameśvarī ||
tathā ca mārkaṇḍeyaḥ |
śravaṇarkasamāyuktā dvādaśī yadi labhyate |
upoṣya dvādaśīṃ tatra trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam || iti ||
iyaṃ ca dvādaśīśravaṇayogamātreṇa kṛtsnāpi puṇyā bhavati yathā rohiṇīyogenāṣṭamī |
tathā ca matsyapurāṇe |
dvādaśī śravaṇāyuktā kṛtsnā puṇyatamā tithiḥ |
na tu sā tena saṃyuktā tāvaty eva praśasyate ||
kecid evaṃ vyācakṣate yadā kṛtsnā śravaṇayuktā tadā puṇyā na tu tena [293] yuktā tāvaty eva ṣaṣṭināḍyavasitaiva puṇyā bhavatīti |
tad yuktaṃ śravaṇayuktā satī kṛtsnā puṇyā na tu yāvatī śravaṇayuktā tāvaty evety arthapratīteḥ |
evaṃ śaṅkaragītāyām |
kṛttikādibharaṇyantā tārāvāravisaptakam |
na te saṃyogamātreṇa punanti sakalāṃ tithim || iti ||
tena yāvatkālā tithir nakṣatreṇa yujyate tāvaty eva puṇyety avadhāryate, tena śravaṇadvādaśyām api tathaiva prāpnoti, tadartham idam uktaṃ “yuktaamātrā nakṣatreṇa sakalā puṇyatameti na tu yāvatī yuktā tāvaty eva praśasyate” iti | śravaṇaspṛṣṭeti pāṭhe tu sṛṣṭaśabdaparyālocanayaiva ca sā tathyena śravaṇayogākṣepaḥ sa iti pratīyate | tathā ca śravaṇadvādaśīṃ prakṛtyoktaṃ nāradīyapurāṇe |
tithinakṣatrayor yogo yogaś caiva narādhipa |
dvikalo yadi labhyeta sa jñeyo hy āṣṭayāmikaḥ ||
tasmād asmadyuktaiv vyākhyā yuktā |
viṣṇupurāṇe |
yāḥ kāścit tithayaḥ proktāḥ puṇyā nakṣatrayogataḥ |
tāsv eva tad vrataṃ kuryāt śravaṇadvādaśīṃ vinā ||
asyārthaḥ | yāḥ kāścin tithayo yena kenacin nakṣatraviśeṣayogena puṇyāḥ proktās tāsu yad vihitaṃ tat tāsv eva kuryāt na tithyantare tannakṣatrayukte yathā phālgunaśuklapakṣadādaśī puṇyarkṣeṇa yuktā govindadvādaśī nāma tasyām upavāsavrataṃ vihitaṃ tat tasyām eva kuryān na puṣyānvitāyām ekādaśyāṃ, so 'yaṃ śravaṇadvādaśīṃ vinā niyamaḥ | śravaṇadvādaśīvrataṃ tu śravaṇaikādaśyām api bhavatīty arthaḥ |
[294]        uktaṃ ca bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca |
dvādaśyās te vidhiḥ proktaḥ śravaṇena yudhiṣṭhira |
sarvapāpapraśamanaḥ sarvasaukhyapradāyakaḥ ||
ekādaśī yadā ca syāc chravaṇena samanvitā |
vijayā yā tithiḥ proktā bhaktānāṃ vijayapradā ||
nāradīyapurāṇe ’pi |
yadā na prāpyate ṛkṣaṃ dvādaśyāṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ kvacit |
ekādaśī tadopoṣyā pāpaghnī śravaṇānvitā ||
ubhayor devatā viṣṇuḥ purāṇapuruṣottamaḥ |
vibhedo ’pi na kartavyo vibhedāt patate naraḥ ||
anye tv evaṃ vyācakṣate | yās tithayo nakṣatrayogāt puṇyāḥ kathitās tāsu tad vrataṃ kuryād eva, śravaṇadvādaśyāṃ tu na kriyate vratam iti, nityakāmyaikādaśīvratā hi vaiṣṇavā bhavanti, tatraikādaśyupavāsānantaraṃ dvādaśyupavāsaḥ kartum aśakyaḥ pāraṇāntatvād vratasya, asamāpte vrate caikakāle anyavrataniṣedhāt |
tad uktaṃ viṣṇudharmottare |
pāraṇāntaṃ vrataṃ jñeyaṃ vratānte viprabhojanam |
asamāpte vrate pūrve kuryān naiva vratāntaram || iti ||
tena vaiṣṇavāḥ kenāpi kāraṇena gṛhītaikādaśīvratās teṣāṃ śravaṇadvādaśyāṃ upavāso na yujyate “śravaṇadvādaśīṃ vineti copalakṣaṇārthaṃ, tathā ca prārabdhaṣaṣṭīsaptamīcaturdaśīvratānāṃ nakṣatrayuktasaptapaurṇamāsyāditithilābhe [295] tadgatopavāsānuṣṭhānaṃ nāptam eva pāraṇāntaṃ vrataṃ jñeyam ityāder upapattikalāpasyātulyatvāt | yathā gṛhītobhayasaptamīvratānāṃ rohiṇyaṣṭamīprāptau katham upavāsasiddhir iti |
tad ayukaṃ, evakārānāñjasyāt upalakṣaṇātvasyārthe ’py arthopapattau anyāyyatvāc ca | tasmāt pūrvaiva vyākhyā yuktā | ekādaśīyuktā śravaṇadvādaśī mahāpuṇyā matsyapurāṇe |
dvādaśī śravaṇāspṛṣṭā spṛśed ekādaśīṃ yadā |
ya eva vaiṣṇavo yogo viṣṇuśṛṅkhalasaṃjñitaḥ |
tasminn upoṣya vidhivan naraḥ saṃkṣīṇakalmaṣaḥ |
prāpnoty anuttamāṃ siddhiṃ punarāvṛttidurlabhām ||
'śravaṇāspṛṣṭā' śravaṇena yuktā | śravaṇaśabdas triliṅgo 'py asti | “śravaṇāspṛṣṭeti" vadan svalpaśravaṇayogenāpi dvādaśyupavāsādiyogyā bhavatīti gamayati | viṣṇudharmottare |
ekādaśī dvādaśī ca vaiṣṇavyam api tatra cet |
tad viṣṇuśṛṅkhalaṃ nāma viṣṇusāyujyakṛd bhavet ||
tasminn upoṣya vidhivad gacchec chvetapuraṃ dhruvam |
dvādaśyām upavāso ’tra trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam |
niṣiddham api kartavyam ājñeyaṃ pārameśvarī ||
nāradīyapurāṇe |
saṃspṛśyaikādaśīṃ rājan dvādaśī yadi saṃspṛśet |
śravaṇaṃ jyotiṣāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati ||
yas tūpavāsāsamarthaḥ svīkṛtaikādaśīvratasś ca tasyaikādaśyām evopavāso dvādaśyāṃ tu pūjāmātravidhiḥ “asamāpte pūrvam" ity udāhṛtavacanāt |
[296]        tathā ca matsyapurāṇe |
dvādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣe tu nakṣatraṃ śravaṇaṃ yadi |
upoṣyaikādaśīṃ tatra dvādaśyāṃ pūjayed dharim ||
yamaḥ |
śravaṇena sitā yatra dvādaśī labhyate kvacit |
upoṣyaikādaśīṃ tatra dvādaśyām arcayed dhariṃ ||
yas tūpavāsadvayāsamarthaḥ asvīkṛtaikādaśīvrataś ca sa dvādaśyām evopavaset |
tathā ca nāradīyapurāṇe |
upoṣya dvādaśīṃ puṇyāṃ viṣṇuṛkṣeṇa saṃyutām |
ekādaśyudbhavaṃ puṇyaṃ naraḥ prāpnoty asaṃśayam ||
vājapeye tathā yajñe karmahīno ’pi dīkṣitaḥ |
sarvaṃ phalam avāpnoti asnāto ’py ahuto ’pi san ||
ahuta iti bahuvrīhiḥ |
evam ekādaśīṃ muktvā dvādaśyāṃ samupoṣaṇāt |
pūrvavāsarajaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvaṃ prāpnoty asaṃśayam ||
yas tūpavāsadvayasamarthas taṃ prati bhaviṣyottare dinadvaye ’py upoṣaṇaṃ vihitam |
ekādaśyām upoṣyaivaṃ dvādaśyām apy upoṣayet |
na cātra vidhilopaḥ syād ubhayor daivataṃ hariḥ || iti ||
asamāpte vrate pūrve naiva kuryād vratāntaram || iti |
niṣedhāt samāptiś ca pāraṇena vinā nāsti, tadabhāve upavāsadvaye [297] hṛto vacanenaiva viṣṇuśṛṅkhalayoge tv ekasmād evopavāsāc chravaṇadvādaśīvratakāryam ekādaśīvratakāryaṃ ca prasaṅgāt sidhyati |
atra kecid āhuḥ | yadā tu bhāvidinaśeṣe rātrau vā śravaṇayogas tadā "prātaḥ saṃkalpayed vidvān upavāsavratādikam iti saṃkalpayogābhāvād anupoṣyaiva sā tithir iti |
tad ayukaṃ śravaṇayogena kṛtsnatithipuṇyatvābhidhānāt tena yathātītenāpi śravaṇayogena puṇyatā tathā bhāvināpi śravaṇena puṇyatā vidyata eva, tathā ca viṣṇuśṛṅkhalayogenāsyām ekādaśyāṃ tatkṣaṇam eva divasapuṇyatvāt nānādvādaśīvratagrahaṇasaṃkalpaḥ kriyate | tathā ca nakṣatropavāse astamayasaṃbandhino nakṣatrasyopoṣyatvāt tasya ca prātaraprāptāv api vratagrahaṇasaṃkalpaś ca pūrṇatvāt prātar eva yuktaḥ | na ca tatrāpi vipratipattiḥ, sakalāhorātrapuṇyatvābhidhānāt tasmāt "muhartam apy ahorātre yasmin yuktaṃ hi labhyate | aṣṭamyāṃ rohiṇīṛkṣaṃ tāṃ supuṇyām upāvased ity anena nyāyena śravaṇayogamātreṇa dvādaśy api sakalā labdhavijayābhidhānā puṇyavatām anuṣṭheyakarmārheti |
atha pāraṇakālaniyamaḥ |
skandapurāṇe |
tithinakṣatraniyame tithibhānte ca pāraṇam |
ato ’nyathā pāraṇāyāṃ vratabhaṅgam avāpnuyāt ||
tathā |
yāḥ kācit tithayaḥ proktāḥ puṇyā nakṣatrasaṃyutāḥ |
ṛkṣānte pāraṇaṃ kuryāt vinā śravaṇarohiyīm ||
[298]        vahnipurāṇe |
sāṃyogike vrate prāpte yatraiko ’pi viyujyate |
tatraiva pāraṇaṃ kuryād evaṃ vedavido viduḥ ||

tithinakṣatrasaṃyoge upavāso bhaved yadā |
pāraṇaṃ tu na kartavyaṃ yāvan naikasya saṃkṣayaḥ ||
iti śravaṇadvādaśīnirṇayaḥ |
atha śivarātrinirṇayaḥ |
skandapurāṇe |
kṛṣṇāṣṭamī skandaṣaṣṭī śivarātriś caturdaśī |
etāḥ pūrvayutāḥ kāryās tithyante pāraṇaṃ bhavet ||
janmāṣṭamī rohiṇī ca śivarātris tathaiva ca |
pūrvaviddhaiva kartavyā tithibhānte ca pāraṇam ||
śrāvaṇī durganavamī tathā dūrvāṣṭamī ca yā |
pūrvaviddhā tu kartavyā śivarātrir baler dinam |
jayantī śivarātriś ca kārye bhadrājayānvite ||
tatra bṛhaspatismṛtiṭīkākṛtaḥ kecid āhuḥ |
yadi tāvan niṣiddhāyās trayodaśīyuktāyāś caturdaśyāḥ pratiprasavo ’yaṃ tataḥ śuklapakṣacaturdaśīviṣayatā syāt tasyā eva pūrvaviddhāyā niṣiddhatvād itaratra tu “kṛṣṇapakṣe ’ṣṭamī caiva kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśī" ityādinā pūrvaviddhāyā eva grahaṇāt | athopavāsaviṣaye amāvāsyāyuktāyāś caturdaśyā [299] apavādo ’yaṃ |
tad asat upavāsāśravaṇāt |
śivarātriśabdenocyate iti cet |
evaṃ tarhi yatra trayodaśyām upavāso vihitaś caturdaśyāṃ jāgaraṇaṃ tadviṣayaṃ syāt | atha śivarātriśabdena jāgaraṇam abhidhīyate cet tarhi nedam apavādakam upavāsāvidhānāt |
bhuktvā jāgaraṇe nakte candrādyarthavrate tathā |
tato vrateṣu sarveṣu rātriyogo viśiṣyate ||
iti jāgaraṇasya pūrvaviddhāyām eva vidhānād anarthakam idaṃ vacanaṃ | tattulyārtham idam iti cen, na, vacane śivarātripadasyāvivakṣitatvaprasaṅgāt | tasmāt yatra dvitīye ’hani caturdaśī na vidyate ādityodayasamaye vā vidyate tatra pūrvaviddhāyā niṣiddhatvād amāvāsyāgrahaṇe prāpte |
jayantī śivarātriś ca kārye bhadrājayānvite |
ity ucyate, yad vā
muhūrtaiḥ pañcabhir viddhā grāhyaivaikādaśī tithiḥ |
tadardhaviddhāny anyāni dināny upavased budhaḥ ||
atha tadardhaviddhāyā eva tither grahaṇe yatra tv adhikaviddhā bhavati tatra “upavāsaniṣedhe tu bhakṣyaṃ kiṃcit prakalpayed" iti bhakṣyakalpanāyāṃ prāptāyām idam ucyate "jayantī śivarātriś ceti | yadā tu dinadvaye ’pi caturdaśī vidyate dvitīye ’hani rātrau na vidyate rātrau ca jāgaraṇaṃ vihitaṃ tadā
ekādaśīm upoṣitvā dvādaśīm apy upoṣayet |
naivātra vidhilopaḥ syād ubhayor daivataṃ hariḥ ||
iti nyāyena samānadevatākatvenāmāvāsyāyām eva jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ [300] sadṛśatvād yathaiva hi |
aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ yaḥ śivaṃ śaṃsitavrataḥ |
mumukṣuḥ pūjayen nityaṃ sa labhed īpsitaṃ phalam ||
iti śivavrataṃ caturdaśyāṃ dṛśyate |
tathā |
parvaṇy apūjya deveśaṃ gurum agniṃ ca bhaktitaḥ |
adattvā ca baliṃ tatra śivasyāṣṭaśataṃ japet ||
ity amāvāsyāyāṃ dṛṣyata eva | api ca śivarātriśabdena upavāsaśivapūjājāgaraṇāny abhidhīyante, dve vā ekaṃ vā ādye pakṣe upavāsasya yā vihiitā saivetarayor api, dvitīyapakṣe yady upavāsavyatirikte dve abhidhīyete tarhy ekamavāsyāyāṃ (?) bhaviṣyatīti dvitīyaiva syāt, tṛtīyaḥ pakṣas tāvad upapannaḥ | yadi jāgaraṇasyotpattau śivarātriśabdavācyasya kālaviśiṣṭasya vidhānaṃ syāt tato ’dhikāravākye śivarātrivratasya phalasaṃbandha ucyamāne jāgaraṇaphalasaṃbandha ukto bhavati yathotpattivākye ṣaṇṇām api yāgānāṃ kālasaṃbandhe ’vagate darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svargakāmo yajeteti darśapūrṇamāsavācyāḥ ṣaḍeva phale vidhīyanta ity avadhāritam, evam ihāpi syāt | na ca tathāsti | yatra tāvat prathamaṃ durvāsasā vyādhaṃ prati |
kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ na kiṃcin mṛgam aṇvapi |
prāptavān prāṇayātrārthaṃ kṣudhāsaṃpīḍito ’vaśaḥ ||
ity upakramya |
dhanuḥkoṭyāhatāny eva bilvapatrāṇi mānada |
[301]        patitāni mahārāja śambhoḥ śirasi bhūmipa ||
tasthau sa eva tatraiva sarvarātram atandritaḥ |
svodarārthaṃ mahārāja mṛgalipsur ahaṅkṛtaḥ |
rātriśeṣaṃ sthito vyādhaḥ stabdhadṛṣṭir anāmikaḥ ||
ity upavāsaśivapūjājāgaraṇāni prāsaṅgikāni tava jātānīty abhidhāya |
prabhāte vimale jāte dṛṣṭvā natvaiva śaṅkaram |
snātvā sarasi rājendra pūjayitvā maheśvaram |
bilvapatrair nṛpaśreṣṭha kandamūlaiś ca pāritam ||
ity etāvati kathite kena viśeṣeṇa bhagavān jāgaraṇam ekaphalasaṃbandhaṃ bravīti | yad apīśvaravacanaṃ pārvatīṃ prati vratanirūpaṇe
māghe kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ kartavyaṃ vratam uttamam |
ity upakramya |
trayodaśyāṃ viśālākṣi ekabhaktaṃ samācaret |
upoṣito varārohe caturdaśyāṃ varānane ||
ityādigranthasaṃdarbheṇa snāpanagandhapuṣpādibhir abhyarcanaṃ pādād ārabhya sarvāṅgapūjām abhidhāya gomayamaṇḍalaṃ dīpamālābhir veṣṭayitvārghyapradānāntam |
sa vai śudhyati pāpena trividhena varānane |
iti prāśastyasahitam abhidhāya “jāgaraṃ tatra kartavyaṃ gītavāditramaṅgalair iti jāgaraṇam abhidhāya “kartavyā yāmapūjā ca snānaṃ pañcāmṛtena tu" ityevamantena kṛtaṃ, yatra prādhānyena kaści dviśeṣaḥ, tasmāt [302] prādhānyaṃ sarveṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ dayor vā ādyapakṣadaye "mukhyaṃ vā pūrvacodanāl lokavad" iti nyāyenopavāsadina eva sarveṣām anuṣṭhānam |
tṛtīyapakṣe tu "caturdaśāṃ tu kīnāśasaparyā yena me kṛtā | tathā jāgaraṇaṃ rātrau" ityatra jāgaraṇasyaiva rātrau śravaṇāt | itarasya caturdaśyām eva śravaṇāt | yadi parakhaṇḍatithau caturdaśyanurodhena divaiva pūjā ārabhyate tathāpi doṣo nāsti, asti ca purāṇāntare “yamapūjāto bhinnā divāpūjeti divaiva sarvasyāḥ pūjāyāḥ prārambhaḥ | vastutas tu trayāṇām eva prādhānyaṃ ity ayam eva pakṣaḥ |
mama bhaktojano devi śivarātrim upoṣakaḥ |
gaṇatvaṃ mokṣadaṃ divyam akṣayaṃ divyaśāsanam |
sakṛt kṛtvā tu bubhuje bhogān amṛtasambhavān || iti ||
tathā |
tuṣṭo ’haṃ bhavabhaktasya śivarātrim upoṣakaḥ |
varaṃ dadāmi te tubhyaṃ devadānavadurlabham ||
ity evamādibahuvacanānusārād upavāsasyāpi prādhānyam eva tasmāt trayāṇām api phalasambandhitvāt |
māghe kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ kartavyaṃ vratam uttamam |
itīha pradhānānāṃ vrataśabdavācyatvāt vratasya ca caturdaśyāṃ vihitatvāt khaṇḍacaturdaśyāś ca pañcadaśīyuktāyā upavāse grahaṇād anyatra jayānvitāyā eva kṛṣṇacaturdaśyā grahaṇād iha ca tadasambhavād ekasminn eva dine upavāsapūjājāgaraṇānāṃ ca kartavyatvād avaśyam anyatarakālabādhāyām āpatitāyāṃ pūjājāgaraṇakālāsya pāścātyasya bādhā yuktā | [203]] upavāsasya ca tayoḥ pūrvam apy anuṣṭheyatvād anupasaṃjātavirodhitvāt svakāla evānuṣṭhānaṃ yuktam | api copavāsasyāhorātravyāpakasya tanmadhyagatakālaikadeśe ’nuṣṭhīyamānayoḥ pūjājāgaraṇayos tithiviṣaye aprayojakayoḥ prādhānyāviśeṣe ’pi bādhyatvam eva yuktaṃ nopavāsakālasyānyānantarbhūtatvād yatra tūpavāsaṃ vinā jāgaraṇaṃ dṛśyate | yathā,
kaścit puṇyaviśeṣeṇa vihīno ’pi ca yaḥ pumān |
jāgaraṃ kurute tatra sa rudrasamatāṃ vrajet || iti |

anye tu nyāyasiddhe ’py arthe purāṇam evaṃ paṭhanti |
māghāsite bhūtadinaṃ hi rājan
upaiti yogaṃ yadi pañcadaśyāḥ |

tad etad apeśalaṃ |

amāvāsyā tṛtīyā ca tā upoṣyāḥ parānvitāḥ |

kṛṣṇapakṣe 'ṣṭamī caiva kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśī |

iti nigamavacane ’bhihitaḥ, evam aviśeṣe sati |

'agaṅgaḥ' trayodaśī | yat tu vacanam |

nāgarakhaṇḍe ’pi |

tasyāṃ sarveṣu liṅgeṣu sadā saṃkramate haraḥ ||
tathā ca tatraiva māghamāse kṛṣṇacaturdaśīṃ prakṛtyoktam |
yāni kāny atra liṅgāni calāni sthāvarāṇi ca |
teṣu saṃkramate devas tasyāṃ rātrau yato haraḥ |
śivarātris tataḥ proktā tena sā haravallabhā ||
śivarahasye |
tatprabhṛty atha devarṣe māghakṛṣṇacaturdaśī |
śivarātrir iti khyātā priyeyaṃ tripuradviṣaḥ ||
tasmād atraivaṃ viṣayavyavasthā | yadā dinadvaye ’pi pradoṣavyāpinī [307] prathamadina eva vā trayodaśī ca dinaparyāptā tadā pūrvaiva catudaśī “trayodaśī yadā devīti vacanāt | yadā prathamadina eva pradoṣavyāpinī trayodaśī ca dinaparyāptā tadā pūrvaiva |
pradoṣavyāpinī grāhyā śivarātricaturdaśī |
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ yasmāt tasmāt tāṃ samupoṣayet ||
iti vacanāt |
nanu yadā dvitīyadina eva pradoṣavyāpinī tadā kiṃ "ardharātrāt purastāc ced" iti vacanāt pūrvā grāhyā, uta "pradoṣavyāpinīti vacanād uttareti kathaṃ nirṇayaḥ |
ucyate yady api "ardharātrāt purastāc ced" iti vākyaṃ dvitīyadine pradoṣavyāpitvābhāve ’py upapadyate “pradoṣavyāpinīti vākyaṃ cārdharātrād upari jayāyoge ’pi tathāpy evaṃvidhe viṣaye dvitīyacaturdaśīgrahaṇe prāgudāhṛtapūrvaviddhaśivarātripratipādaka-bahuvākyasaṃkocaprasaṅgaḥ, pūrvaśivarātrigrahaṇe tu tadabhāva iti saiva grāhyā | kiṃ ca pūrvā bahukarmakālavyāpinī uttarā tu na tatheti saiva grāhyā | yadā tu dinadvaye pradoṣakāle caturdaśyabhāvas tadāpi “ardharātrāt purastāc ced" iti vacanāt pūrvaiva | yat tu māghāsitavacanaṃ tadetadvākyaparyālocanayārdharātrād uparijayāyoganiṣedhakam | śivarātrivratāntarbhūtamāghamāsavyatiriktakṛṣṇacaturdaśīnirṇayas tv evam | “ekādaśy aṣṭamī ṣaṣṭhītivacanād amāvāsyāviddhā sā prāptā “kṛṣṇapakṣe 'ṣṭamīti vacanāt trayodaśīviddhā | evaṃ virodhe sati rātrau yāmacatuṣṭaye pūjāvidhānāj jāgaraṇavidhānāc ca tadanusāreṇa bahukarmakālavyāpinī grāhyā | yadā tu tatkarmakālavyāptikṛto viśeṣas tadā |
[308]        rudravrateṣu sarveṣu kartavyā saṃmukhī tithiḥ |
anyeṣu vratakalpeṣu pūrvoddiṣṭām upāvaset ||
iti brahmavaivartavacanān nirṇayaḥ |
atra kecid āhuḥ |
yadā pāraṇaparyāptāmāvāsyā tadā pūrvā no cet parā |
bhūtāṣṭamyor divā bhuktvā rātrau bhuktvā tu parvaṇi |
ekādaśyāṃ divārātrau bhuktvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret ||
iti bhojananiṣedhāt |
trayodaśī yadā devi dinabhuktipramāṇataḥ |
jāgare śivarātriḥ syān niśi pūrṇā caturdaśī ||
'dinabhuktipramāṇataḥ' divasabhojanānurodhena, yasyāṃ trayodaśyāṃ upoṣitāyāṃ tithyante vihitaṃ pāraṇaṃ rātrau nopapadyate sātra trayodaśī dinabhuktipramāṇata ity ucyata iti |
tad ayuktaṃ bhuktiśabdasya bhojanavat kālaprāptāv api tithinakṣatravārabhuktir ityādiṣu jyotiḥśāstre nirūḍatvāt | evaṃ ca bhuktiśabdena bhojanagrahaṇe "ardharātrāt purastāc ced" iti saṃkocaprasaṅgaḥ, kālavyāptigrahaṇe tu na saṃkoca iti saivātra bhuktiśabdenocyate | kiṃ ca "trayodaśī yadā devītivākyāt tithyante vihitaṃ pāraṇaṃ yadā dina eva saṃbhavati tadā pūrvā grāhyety ayam artho na lakṣaṇādikleśaṃ vinā labhyate | dinaśabdena ca saṃnihitatrayodaśīsaṃbaddhadinaparityāgeṇa bhavatpakṣe dināntaraṃ grāhyaṃ dvitīyadinabhojanapramāṇatrayodaśī yadā pūrvadine tadā niśi saṃpūrṇa caturdaśī grāhyety ukte ca yadā trayodaśī ghaṭikādiparimitabhojanapramāṇā [309] tadaiva caturdaśī pūrvaviddhā kāryeti prasajyeta | tataś ca prāgudāhṛtavākyavirodhaḥ | athaivam ucyate yasyāṃ trayodaśyāṃ upoṣitāyāṃ divā bhojanaṃ saṃbhavati sā grāhyeti tad api na sarvasyām api trayodaśyām upoṣitāyāṃ divābhojanasaṃbhavāt |
atha tithyantavihitaṃ bhojanaṃ yadā divā saṃbhavati tadā pūrvā grāhyeti |
tan na lakṣaṇāprasaṅgāt rātribhojane ’pi bādhakābhāvāc ca | niṣedhasya rāgaprāptabhojanaviṣayatvāt rāgaprāptalābhe vidhispṛṣṭe niṣedhāpravṛtter vidhivaiṣamyavikalpādiprasaṅgāt agnīṣomīyahiṃsādivat | upapāditaṃ caitat tailābhyaṅgādikālanirṇayaprastāve | tasmāt sakaladoṣaparihārārthaṃ bhutiśabdena kālavyāptir evocyate na bhojanam iti siddham | evaṃ ca śivarātrau sakalavacanaparyalocanayā vyavasthāyāṃ kālpanikī bṛhaspatismṛtiṭīkākṛtoktā vyavasthā heyā | śivapūjājāgaraṇakālabādhaś ca vinā kāraṇaṃ prasajyeta | upavāsasyāpi pūrvaviddhāyām upapāditatvāt bahutaravākyasaṃkocaprasaṅgāc ca | śivarātriśabdena copavāsapūjājāgaraṇāny abhidhīyante | trayāṇām api prādhānyapratīteḥ |
tathā ca skandapurāṇe |
evaṃ dvādaśa varṣāṇi śivaratrim upoṣakaḥ |
yo māṃ jāgarate rātriṃ manujaḥ svargam āruhet ||
śivaṃ ca pūjayitvā yo jāgarti ca caturdaśīm |
mātuḥ payodhararasaṃ na pibet sa kadācana ||
nāgarakhaṇḍe |
upavāsaprabhāvena balād api ca jāgarāt |
[310]        śivarātriṃ tathā tasya liṅgasyāpi prapūjayet |
tato rājyaṃ samāsādya pitṛpaitāmahaṃ mahat ||
nāgarakhaṇḍe |
svayaṃ bhūliṅgam abhyarcya sopavāsaḥ sajāgaraḥ |
ajānann api niṣpāpo niṣādogaṇatāṃ gataḥ ||
anyāny api trayāṇāṃ prādhānyapratipādakāni vacanāni prāgudāhṛtāni |
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevīyasakalaśrīkaraṇādhīśvara-
sakalavidyāviśāradaśrīhemādriviracite
caturvargacitāmaṇau pariśeṣakhaṇḍe kālanirṇaye
śivarātrinirṇayaḥ samāptaḥ ||
[311]
atha parvasaṃdhikālanirṇayaḥ |
tatra parva dvidhā paurṇamāsī amāvāsyā ceti | tayoś ca svarūpaṃ gobhilena darśitam |
yaḥ paramo viprakarṣaḥ sūryācandramasoḥ sā paurṇamāsī yaḥ paramaḥ saṃnikarṣaḥ sāmāvāsā | iti |
smṛtyantaraṃ ca |
yadā astaṃ gate sūrye candramā abhyudiyāt yā paurṇamāsīti |
tatra pūrṇimānām anirvacanaṃ brahmāṇḍa-matsyapurāṇayoḥ |
yadīkṣete vyatīpāte divāpūrṇaṃ parasparam |
candrādityau parāhṇe tu pūrṇatvāt pūrṇimā smṛtā ||
amāvāsyānirvacanaṃ śatapathaśrutau |
te devā aśruvann amā vai nodya vasur vasati yo naḥ prāvātsīd ity upakramyate devā abruvan na vā imasanvatsomādvinuyāt somam evāsmai saṃbharāmeti | tasmai somaṃ samabharann eṣa vai somo rājā devānām annaṃ (?) yac candramāḥ sa yatraiva etāṃ rātriṃ na purastān na paścād dadṛśe tam imaṃ lokam āgacchati sa ya ihāpaś cauṣadhīś ca praviśati sa vai devānāṃ ca svannaṃ hy eṣāṃ tad yad eṣa etāṃ rātrim ihāmā vasati tasmād amāvāsyā nāmeti |
atra prathamavākye vṛtravadhānantaraproṣitendrasamāgamād devānām uktau vasunendreṇa amāsahanivasād amāvāsyeti, dvitīyavākaye tu vasoś candramaso [312] ’syāṃ rātrāv asmiṃl loke nivāsād amāvāsyeti dvidhā nirvacanam |
padmapurāṇe |
agniṣvāttā iti khyātā yajvāno yajñasaṃsthitāḥ |
acchodā nāma teṣāṃ tu mānasī kanyakā nadī ||
tam athāmāvasunnāma pitaraṃ vīkṣya saṃgatā |
vavre varārthinī saṅgaṃ kusumāyudhapīḍanāt ||
yogād bhraṣṭā tu tenāsau vyabhicāreṇa bhāminī |
dharāṃ na spṛśate pūrvaṃ papātātha bhuvastale ||
tithāv amāvasūr yasyām icchāṃ cakre na tāṃ prati |
vīryeṇa tasya sā loke amāvāsyeti viśrutā |
pitṝṇāṃ valabhā yasmād dattasyākṣayakāriṇī ||
paramasaṃyamipitṛgaṇābhimatabrahmacaryapracyutihetubhūtāmāvasudhairyanivarhaṇapratīta-mahimatvād amāvāsyety ucyate ity etad itihāsatātparyam |
skānde nāgarakhaṇḍe |
amā nāma rave raśmiḥ sahasrapramukhaḥ sthitaḥ |
yasyāsya tejasā sūryaḥ proktas trailokyadīpakaḥ |
tasmin viśati yenendur amāvāsyā tataḥ smṛtā ||
matsya-vāyu-brahmāṇḍapurāṇeṣu |
amā vasetāṃ ṛkṣeṣu yadā candradivākarau |
eṣā pañcadaśīrātrir amāvāsyā tatas tu sā ||
amāsaha ekatrety arthaḥ |
skanda-brahmāṇḍapurāṇayoḥ |
[313]        amā nāma rave raśmiś candraloke pratiṣṭhitaḥ |
tasmāt somo vasaty asyām amāvāsyā tataḥ smṛtā ||
matsya-vāyupurāṇayoḥ |
āśritya tām amāvāsyāṃ paśyatas tu samāgamau |
anyonyaṃ candrasūryau tau tadā te darśa ucyate ||
bhagavatīpurāṇe |
kalāḥ ṣoḍaśa somasya śukle vardhayate raviḥ |
amṛtenāmṛtaṃ kṛṣṇe prīyate vibudhaiḥ kramāt ||
kalām ādyāṃ pibed vahnir dvitīyāṃ tapanaḥ kalām |
viśve devās tṛtīyāṃ ca caturthīṃ ca prajāpatiḥ ||
pañcamīṃ varuṇaś cāpi ṣaṣṭhīṃ pibati vāsavaḥ |
saptamīm ṛṣayo divyā vasavo ’ṣṭau tathāṣṭamīm ||
navamīṃ kṛṣṇapakṣasya pibatīnduḥ kalām api |
daśamīṃ marutaś cāpi rudra ekādaśīṃ kalām ||
dvādaśīṃ pibate kālaḥ dhanādhyakṣaḥ trayodaśīm |
caturdaśīṃ paśupatiḥ kalāṃ pibati nityaśaḥ ||
tataḥ pañcadaśīṃ caiva pibanti pitaraḥ kalām |
kalāvaśiṣṭoniṣpītaḥ praviṣṭaḥ sūryamaṇḍalam ||
amāyāṃ viśate yasmād amāvāsyā tataḥ smṛtā |
pūrvāhṇe praviśaty arkaṃ madhyāhne ca vanaspatim ||
aparāhṇe viśaty apsu svāṃ yoniṃ vārisaṃbhavaḥ |
amāṃ praviṣṭaḥ somas tu śeṣayā kalayaikayā |
[314]        tṛṇagulmalatāvṛkṣān niṣpādayati cauṣadhīḥ |
tamoṣadhisthitaṃ gāvaś caranty āpaḥ pibanti ca ||
tadaṅgānugataṃ gobhyaḥ kṣīratvam upagacchati |
tatkṣīram amṛtībhūtvā mantrapūtaṃ dvijātayaḥ |
svāhākāravaṣaṭkārair juhvaty āhutayaḥ kramāt ||
hutam agniṣu somāya punaḥ somaṃ vivardhayet |
evaṃ saṃkṣīyate somaḥ kṣīnaś cāpyāyate punaḥ ||
te ca pūrṇamāsyamāvāsye dvividhe purāṇāt |
rākā cānumatiś caiva paurṇamāsī dvidhā smṛtā |
sinīvālī kuhūś caiva amāvāsyā dvivā tv iti ||
atrānumatiḥ sinīvālī ca caturdaśīmiśre, rākā kuhūś ca pratipanmiśre |
tathā ca kāṭhakaśrutiḥ |
yā paurṇamāsī sānumatiḥ, yottarā sā rākā, yā pūrvāmāvāsyā sā sinīvālī, yottarā sā kuhūr iti ||
vṛddhavasiṣṭhaḥ |
rākā cānumatiś caiva paurṇamāsīdvayaṃ viduḥ |
rākā saṃpūrṇacandrā syāt kalonānumatiḥ smṛtā |
rātridṛṣṭe punās tasmin saiva rāketi kīrtitā ||
bhagavatīpurāṇe |
yadā tv astam iyāt sūryaḥ pūrṇaś cendur upāgamat |
yugapat sottarā rākā tadā bhavati pūrṇimā ||
[315]        matsya-brahmāṇḍapurāṇayoḥ |
yasmāt tām anumanyante pitaro daivataiḥ saha |
tasmād anumatir nāma pūrṇimā prathamā smṛtā ||
atyarthaṃ rājate yasmāt paurṇamāsyāṃ niśākaraḥ |
rañjanāc caiva candrasya rāketi kavayo viduḥ ||
vṛddhavaśiṣṭhaḥ |
dṛṣṭacandrām amāvāsyāṃ sinīvālīṃ pracakṣate |
tām eva ca kuhūm āhur naṣṭacandrāṃ maharṣayaḥ ||
matsya-brahmāṇḍapurāṇayoḥ |
sinīvālīpramāṇas tu kṣīṇaśeṣo niśākaraḥ |
amāvāsyāṃ viśaty arkaṃ sinīvālī tataḥ smṛtā ||
'sinī' sitā avasiteti yāvat, alpo vāla: 'vālī', sinī cāsau vālī ceti sinīvālī | 'sinīvālīpramāṇaḥ' bālāgramātra ity arthaḥ |
kuhv iti kokilenokto yāvān kālaḥ samāpyate |
tatkālasaṃjñitā hy eṣā amāvāsyā kuhūḥ smṛtā ||
tathāntyau yāv anumatyā dvau lavau kāla ucyate |
lavau dvāv eva rākāyā jñeyaḥ kālo ’parāhṇikaḥ ||
tathā |
dvau lavau amāvāsyāyāḥ sa kālaḥ parvasaṃdhiṣu |
dvyakṣaras tu kuhūmātraḥ parvakālaś ca sa smṛtaḥ ||
tathā |
[316]        anumatī ca rākā ca sinīvālī kuhūs tathā |
etāsāṃ dvilavaḥ kālaḥ kāhūmātrā kuhūḥ smṛtā |
ity eṣa parvasandhīnāṃ kālo vai dvilavaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
bhagavatīpurāṇe |
anumatyāś ca rākāyāḥ sinīvālyāḥ kuhūṃ vinā |
etāsāṃ dvilavaḥ kālaḥ kuhūmātrā kuhūḥ smṛtā ||
tatra sandhau yajeteti sandhau yāgaḥ kartavya iti |
tasya cātisūkṣmatvena karmānuṣṭhānāyogyatvāt sandhiśabdaḥ svārthasannihitakarmānuṣṭhānayogyaṃ pūrvāparaṃ kālaṃ lakṣayati |
nanu sandhim abhiyajetety abhiśabdasyoparīty arthaḥ pratipadi kartavyatvāt sandher upari yāgakartavyatāpratīteḥ sandhipūrvakāle yāgo na prāpnoti |
naiṣa doṣaḥ nipātānām anekārthatvāt pratyāsannaṃ sandhim abhilakṣyaa yajeteti vākyārthaḥ, anyathā pratipadam abhiyajetety atrāpy uparyarthagrahāpatteḥ, pratipadi vyatītāyāṃ tata upari dvitīyāyāṃ yaṣṭavyam iti prasajyeta | tasmāt pūrvāparabhāvini kāle saṃdhau yajeteti śrutir yāgaṃ vidhatte, ata eva śrutyantaraṃ “sandhim abhito yajeteti |
tathāha baudhāyanaḥ |
sūkṣmatvāt sandhikālasya sandher viṣaya ucyate |
sāmīpyaṃ viṣayaṃ prāhuḥ pūrveṇātha pareṇa vā ||
tataś ca sandhisaṃnihita eva kāle sāṅgasya karmaṇo ’nuṣṭhāne prāpte vyavasthayāhardvaye niyamam āha śrutiḥ | “pūrvedyur idhmābarhiḥ karoti agrime vārabhya gṛhītvopavasati | tathā “pūrvedyur agniṃ gṛhṇāti uttaram ahar yajatīti" |
[317]        tad apy ahardvayaṃ pratipatparvasavaṃdhītyāha gobhilaḥ |
pakṣāntā upavastavyāḥ pakṣādayo ’bhiyaṣṭavyā iti ||
'pakṣāntāḥ' pañcadaśyaḥ, tāsv agnyanvādhānādi kartavyaṃ, 'pakṣādayaḥ' pratipadaḥ |
nigamaḥ |
upekṣyāntaṃ yajed ādiṃ pakṣayoḥ pakṣacintaka iti |
prāhuḥ laugākṣīyāḥ |
ādiś cāntaś ca pakṣāṇāṃ yajñiyā iti |
kātyāyanaḥ |
pakṣādau yad vātra iti |
bharadvājaḥ |
pakṣādyā yaṣṭavyā bhavantīti |
āpastambeṇāpi |
amāvāsyāyāṃ dīkṣā yajanīye vā paurṇamāsyāṃ yajanīye vā sautyamahaḥ |
iti paurṇamāsyamāvāsyoparitanadinasya pratipadrūpasya yajanīyatvam uktam |
laugākṣiṇātra viśeṣo darśitaḥ |
trīn aṃśān aupavastasya yāgasya caturo viduḥ |
dvāv aṃśāv utsṛjed antyau yāne vratakarṇīti ||
[318]        'aupavastasya' upavāsasyāgnyanvādhānādes trīn aṃśān viduḥ | yāgasya caturo 'śān viduḥ | 'antyāv aṃśau' pañcadaśīpratipatsandhī, tau 'utsṛjet' parityajet | antyam aṃśaṃ pañcadaśyā vratakarmaṇi, yāge ca pratipadaś caturtham aṃśam | apare tu "ḍhāv aṃśāv utsṛjed anyau" iti pāṭham udāhṛtya vyācakṣate | ādyaḥ pādaḥ pañcadaśyā upavaste anvādhānādau parihartavyaḥ, pakṣādeś cāntyaḥ pādo yāge pariharaṇīya iti | etac ca saṃpūrṇapañcadaśīvyatiriktaviṣayaṃ, tasyāḥ prathamapāda evānvādhānānuṣṭhānāt | anye tv asminn eva pāṭhe prathamātikrame kāraṇābhāvād antyaḥ pādaḥ pañcadaśyāḥ vratakarmaṇi pariharaṇīya iti vyācakṣate | etac ca sadyaskālapaurṇamāsīvyatiriktaviṣayaṃ, tasyāḥ parvacaturthāṃśa eva tadanuṣṭhānāt | kathaṃ tarhi yāge catura ity apekṣite yajñapārśvaḥ |
pañcadaśyāḥ paraḥ pādaḥ pakṣādeḥ prathamās trayaḥ |
kālaḥ parvaṇi yāge syād anyathā tu na vidyate ||
kātyāyanaḥ |
na yaṣṭavyaṃ caturthe 'ṃśe yāgaiḥ pratipadaḥ kvacit |
rakṣāṃsi tad vilumpanti śrutir eṣā sanātanī ||
tathā |
pratipadaṃśās trayobhūtaḥ pādaś caikaś ca tiṣṭhati |
yātayāmaḥ sa vijñeyo na hi bhasmani hūyate ||
na ca parvacatuthāṃśādike smārte yānakāle gṛhyamāṇe sandhau yajeteti śrutivirodhaḥ, sandher atisūkṣmatvena tatra sāṅgaprayogānupapatteḥ sandhiśrutyapekṣitasandhisamīpāvadhiviṣayatvāt smṛteḥ | na ca yāvati [319] kāle yaṣṭu śakyate tāvānkālaḥ sandhividhisāmarthyād eva siddha iti kim avadhividhānāntareneti vācyaṃ | sāmarthānusāreṇa vyavasthāyāṃ kasyacid dravyādyabhāvāt pañcamīparyantaprayogaṃ samāpayitum aśaknuvataḥ pañcamīparyantaṃ kālāvadhir jāta iti kālātikramanimittapathikṛdvaiśvānarādīnām aprāptiḥ syāt | na ca yaḥ śīghraṃ samāpayituṃ śaktas tadīyasāmarthyaṃ sāmīpyāvadhiparicchedakam ato ’nyair api tatra yaṣṭavyam iti ata ūrdhvam sutkarṣe prāguktaṃ karmeti vācyam | kaścin muhūrttatrayeṇa samāpayituṃ śakta iti muhūrttacatuṣṭayena samāpayataḥ kālātikramo jāta iti pathikṛdādiprāptiprasaṅgāt tasmāt sāmarthyasyāvasthitaparimāṇatvān na sāmīpyāvadhiparicchedakatvam iti smārtam eva vacanam avadhiparicchedakam | ata eva baudhāyanenoktam "na khalu sandhiḥ sūpapādayantīti" | kiṃ ca svayaṃ viśevākṣepasamartho ’pi vidhir durbalapramāṇaprāpitaṃ viśeṣaṃ svīkaroti yathā "aktāḥ śarkarā upadadhātīti" vākyaśeṣopasthāpitaṃ ghṛtaṃ yathā ca "paśunā yajeteti mantravarṇaprāpitaṃ chāgaṃ tathā "sandhau yajeteti śrutismṛtivākyaprāpitaṃ parvacaturthāṃśatvādikaṃ sandhiparicchedakaṃ svīkaroti | tasmāt parvacaturthāṃśādikāle yaṣṭavyaṃ tena "paurṇamāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyā yajeta” “amāvāsyāyām amāvāsyā yajeteti śrutidvayayuktasandhiparam iti kecit | apare tu parvacaturthāṃśatvena vyācakṣate | tathāpy ahani yāgaḥ kartavyaḥ “pūrvedhur agniṃ gṛhṇāti uttaram ahar devatāṃ yajetety aharvidhānāt | tathā ca saṃkarṣaṇasūtraṃ “ahani vā vyākhyātam iti | tatrāpi pūrvāhṇa eva "pūrvāhṇo vai devānām" iti śruteḥ | tatrāpi prātar eva "parvaṇo yaś caturthāṃśa ādyāḥ pratipadas trayaḥ | [320] yāgakālaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ prātar ukto manīṣibhiḥ” || iti vṛddhaśātātapavacanāt “prātar yajadhvam aśvinau" iti mantraliṅgāc ca | tathā "aṅgirasomāsya yajñasya prātaranuvākair avantu" iti ca | “na tasya sāyam aśnīyād yena prātar yakṣyamāṇaḥ syād" iti prātaḥkālasya yāgasambandhāvagamāc ca | tathā kātyāyanenāpi “sadyo vā prātar" iti sadyaskālaḥ kathitaḥ | tathā ca śrutyantareṇāpi “tatra yajeta yatrainaṃ paścād astamitaṃ purastād ādityo ’bhyudetītyādityodayakāle yajetetyavagamyate | “udita āditye paurṇamāsyās tantraṃ prakramatīty udayānantaram eva yāgānuṣṭānam āpastambenoktam | yat tu prāg udayād amāvāsyāyās tantrakaraṇam uktam “prāg udayād amāvāsyāyām" iti, tad udayāt prāg upakramamātram eva na tv iṣṭir eva “prāg udayād anuṣṭhāneṣv" ity aharvidhānavirodhāt |
atra gobhilaḥ|
trayaḥ paurṇamāsīkālā bhavanti sandhyā vāstamitoditā voccair vā sandhyodite candre sandhyāstamite ravau candrodaye uttarā prāg ravyastamayād uccair udeti tām upavaset |
tathā |
sandhyāpaurṇamāsīm upavased ā uttarān ity eke |
smṛtyantaraṃ ca |
pūrvodite kalāhīne candre pūrvāṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ |
upāvased iti śeṣaḥ |
kātyāyanaḥ |
pūrvaṃ paurṇamāsīm uttarāṃ copavaset |
[321]        tatra divā parvasamdhau pūrvedyur upavāsas tadahar yāgaḥ | rātriparvasandhau tadahar upavāsaḥ paredyur yāgaḥ |
tathā ca baudhāyanaḥ |
atrodāharaty ūrdhvam ardharātrāt paurṇamāsyāṃ candramāḥ pūryate sa etaṃ cāpararātraṃ pūrṇo bhavati sarvaṃ cāhar uttarasyā rātrer ā madhyarātrād amāvāsyāyā aupavasathye [-sathīye] 'hany ūrdhvaṃ madhyandināc candramasādityo rabhate sa etaṃ vāparāhṇam atho bhavati sarvāṃ caitām uttarasyāhna ā madhyandinād etaṃ sandhim abhiyajeteti |
asyārthaḥ | ‘atrodāharati’ śrutim iti śeṣaḥ | 'paurṇamāsyām' iti viṣayanirdeśaḥ, 'ūrdhvam ardharātrāc candramāḥ pūryate' paurṇamāsī pravarttata ity uktaṃ bhavati | 'sa etam apararātraṃ', anantaraṃ ca 'sarvam ahaḥ', 'uttarasyā rātrer ā madhyarātrāt', anuvartate, tato vicchidyate, so ’yaṃ rātrisandhir uktaḥ, athāmāvāsyāviṣaye ‘aupavasathīye 'hani yāgadināt pūrvedyuḥ, 'ūrdhvaṃ madhyandināc candramasādityo rabhate' amāvāsyā pravartate, 'sa etam aparāhṇaṃ', anantaraṃ savāṃ rātriṃ, 'uttarasyāhnaḥ', 'ā madhyandināt,' anuvartate, tataḥ pratipad bhavati, sa eṣa divāsandhir uktaḥ | etaṃ sandhim abhivyāpya sandheḥ pūrvedyur agnīn anvādhāyottaredyur yajeta | tathā evaṃ divāsandhim abhilakṣya tadahaḥ prātar yajeteti |
evaṃ śrutim udāhṛtya tagatau madhyarātramadhyandinaśabdau vyākhyātum āha,
rātrir ha paurṇamāsyāṃ sandhye yā bhavaty ahar amāvāsyāyām iti |
tena śrutigatau madhyarātramadhyandinaśabdau rātrisandhidivāsandhyor upalakṣakau vivakṣitāv iti pratipāditaṃ bhavati |
[322]        anayoś ca paurṇamāsyamāvāsyāviṣayaśrutyoḥ pradarśanārthatvaṃ vaktum uttarasūtraṃ |
dve paurṇamāsyau dve amāvāsye pūrvāṃ pūrvāṃ paurṇamāsīm uttarām uttarām evāmāvāsyām (?) iti |
ayam arthaḥ | rātrisandhidivāsandhimatyau dve paurṇamāsyau, divāsandhirātriisandhimatyau ca dve amāvāsye, tatra divāsandhiḥ pūrvāmāvāsyā paurṇamāsī vā, rātrisandhis tūttarā | atra pūrvāmāvāsyoktā na tu paurṇamāsī tām upamāvyājenāha, 'pūrvāṃ pūrvāṃ paurṇamāsīm' iti | ayam arthaḥ pūrvām amāvāsyām iva pūrvāṃ paurṇamāsīṃ jānīyād iti | tataś ca divāsandhimatyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ yāgaḥ pūrvedyur upavāsa iti siddhaṃ | tathā uttarā paurṇamāsy uktā na tv amāvāsyā | tāṃ paurṇamāsīṃ nirūpayann āha, 'uttarām uttarām amāvāsyām' iti uttarāṃ paurṇamāsīyuktām ivottarām amāvāsyāṃ jānīyād iti | tataś ca rātrigatam amāvāsyāpratipatsandhim upavāsayāgayor madhye kuryād ity arthaḥ |
āpastambas tv āha |
yad ahaḥ purastāc candramāḥ pūrṇa utsarpet tāṃ paurṇamāsīm upavaset śvaḥ pūriteti vā, kharvikāṃ tṛtīyāṃ vājasaneyinaḥ samāmananti | yad ahar na dṛśyeta tad ahar amāvāsyā śvo na draṣṭāra iti veti |
|
tatra kharvikāsutrārtha upariṣṭād vakṣyate | 'yad ahaḥ purastāc candramāḥ pūrṇa utsarpet', 'yad ahar na dṛśyeta' iti sūtradvayasyāyam arthaḥ | sarvadā tāvat rākākuhvor eva candramasaḥ pūrṇatvam adarśanaṃ ceti jyotiḥśāstraprasiddham | yasmin purastāc candramāḥ pūrṇaḥ 'utsarpet' udiyāt, 'na dṛśyeta vā', [323] tatra yady aparāhṇe rātrau vā parvasandhis tadā tāṃ paurṇamāsīṃ amāvāsyāṃ copavased iti, yadā tu pūrvāhṇe madhyandine vā parvasandhis tadā yasminn ahani candramāḥ 'pūritā' pūrṇo bhavati, yasya vā taddraṣṭāro nekṣitāro bhaveyuḥ tām anumatīṃ sinīvālīṃ copavased iti | “śvaḥ pūritā” “śvo na draṣṭāra iti veti sūtradvayasyāyam arthaḥ | uktaṃ ca bhāṣyārthasaṃgrahakāreṇa |
aparāhṇe ’tha vā rātrau yadi parva samāpyate |
upoṣyā tatra rākā syāt sā pūrṇotsarpilakṣaṇā ||
pūrvāhṇe vātha madhyāhne yadi parva samāpyate |
upoṣyānumatis tatra sā śvaḥpūritalakṣaṇā ||
aparāhṇe kṣapāyāṃ vā parvasandhir bhaved yadi |
upoṣyā tu kuhūs tatra yad ahar neti lakṣaṇā ||
pūrvāhṇe vātha madhyāhne parvasandhir bhaved yadā |
tatropoṣyā sinīvālī śvo na draṣṭāralakṣaṇeti ||
tad uktaṃ nibandhibhiḥ |
aparāhṇe ’tha vā rātrau yadi parva samāpyate |
tad ahas tatra copoṣyā pūrṇa utsarpilakṣaṇā ||
pūrvāhṇe vātha madhyāhne yadi parva samāpyate |
pūrvedyus tatra copoṣyā sā śvaḥpūritalackṣṇā ||
aparāhṇe’ tha vā rātrau yadi parva samāpyate |
tad ahas tatra copoṣyā yad ahar netilakṣaṇā ||
pūrvāhṇe vātra madhyāhne yadi parva samāpyate |
tatropoṣyā sinīvālī śvo na draṣṭāralakṣaṇā ||
[324]        gṛhyakarikāpi |
pañcadaśī pratipac ca samete ekadine mahatī yadi tasmin pañcadaśī prakṛter upavāsaḥ pañcadaśīha tanur yadi yāga iti |
tathā saṃkarṣaṇakāṇḍe govindopādhyāyenoktam |
yasminn ahani madhyandine pūrva eva vikramasannipātau tatra pūrvedyur ūpavāsaḥ "śvaḥ pūriteti vā, "śvo na draṣṭāra ity asya viṣayaḥ | yatrāparāhṇe rātrau vā vikramasannipātau tatra tad ahar ūpavāsaḥ “yadahaḥ purastāc candramā pūrṇa utsarpet”, “yad ahar na dṛśyetety asya viṣaya iti |
devasvāmināpy uktām |
yadi pūrvāhṇe parvasandhiḥ samāpyeta tato nitarām eva ca śobhanaṃ, yadi punar aparāhṇe rātrau vā tad ahar upoṣya śvobhūte yāga iti |
tathā ca laugākṣiḥ |
pūrvāhṇe vātha madhyāhne yadi parva samāpyate |
upoṣya tatra pūrvedyus tadahar yāga iṣyate ||
aparāhṇe ’tha vā rātrau yadi parva samāpyate |
upoṣya tasminn ahani śrobhūte yāga iṣyate ||
atra kecit sandhyāyāṃ parvasandhau vyavasthāpakavacanāntarābhāvāt prāyeṇa tatrāpi rātriśabdaprayogāc ca sāpi rātriśabdena gṛhyata ity āhuḥ |
tad ayuktaṃ | sandhyārātryor bhedālakṣaṇāyāṃ ca kāraṇābhāvāt, sandhyāyāṃ parvasandhau ca pūrvedyur yāgasya “āvartate yadā sandhir" ity anenaiva siddheḥ | etena “sa vai sampraty evopavaseta" "sa vā uttarām evopavaset” iti śrutidvayaś ca vyākhyātaṃ |
[325]        śuklapakṣe tithir jñeyā yasyām abhyudiyād raviḥ |
kṛṣṇapakṣe tithir jñeyā yasyām astam iyād raviḥ ||
ityādīni pakṣavyavasthayā yāni vacanāni tāni tithyantaraviṣayāṇi | yat tu “pūrvaḥ pūrvo yajamāno ’vatīyān" iti vākyaṃ tacchāstracodite kāle prāpte yāvad yāvat pūrvaṃ yajate tāvat praśastam iti pratipādayat tatraiva kāle vilambaṃ nivārayati na punaś coditakālānādareṇa pūrvadinaṃ praśastam iti | tathā ca sati caturdaśyādiṣv api tithiṣu yāvad yāvad adhastanatithau yāgaḥ kriyate tāvat tāvat sutarāṃ praśastam ity āpadyate | tasmāt pūrvāhṇādiparvasandhibhedena vyavasthā yuktā |
atra kecid āhuḥ pūrvāparāhṇamadhyāhnās tredhāvibhāgāśrayaṇena pañca pañca muhūrttātmakā atra veditavyā iti |
nanu tredhā vibhāgapakṣe madhyandināntyaghaṭikāyāṃ parvasandhau prātaḥkāle parvacaturthāṃśābhāvāt tṛtīye bhāge yāgaḥ prāpnoti | tatra
parvaṇo yaś caturthāṃśa ādyāḥ pratipads trayaḥ |
yāgakālaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ prātar ukto manīṣibhiḥ ||
ity etad virudhyate |
tad asat | kathaṃ prātaḥkāle parvacaturthāṃśābhāvaḥ, prātaḥkālasya trimuhūrttamātratvād iti cet, kutaḥ,
rekhāprabhṛty athādityān murttās traya eva tu |
prātas tu sa smṛtaḥ kālo bhāgaś cāhnaḥ sa pañcamaḥ ||
iti vacanād iti cet |
na | tasya pañcadhā vibhāgapakṣāśrayatvāt | atra tu pūrvāhṇaparimita eva prātaḥkālaḥ yato mīmāṃsābhāṣyakārodāhṛatāyāṃ śrutau "ṛgbhiḥ prātar divi deva īyate yajurvedena tiṣṭhati madhye ahnaḥ sāmavedenāstamayo mahīyate vedair aśūnyas tribhir eti sūryaḥ”
iti madhyāhnaprāktanaḥ sarvo ’pi prātaḥkālaḥ pratīyate | yadi madhyāhnāt [326] prāk prātaḥkālād ūrdhvaṃ kālāntaraṃ syāt tataḥ prātarmadhyāhnāstamayakāleṣu ṛgyajuḥsāmavedair āgamane sūryasya kālāntare vedaśūnyasyāgamanaṃ syāt | tatra ca “vedair aśūnyas tribhir eti sūrya" iti virudhyate | śākhāntare “ṛgbhiḥ pūrvāhṇa" iti pāṭhāntarāt prātaḥpūrvāhṇayor aikyāvagamaḥ, ata eva prathamaṃ praharam abhidhāyāhuḥ smārtāḥ | "sa evādhyardhasaṃyuktaḥ prātar ity abhidhīyate” ity evam api pūrvāhṇād bhinnaś cet prātaḥkālaḥ tarhi tatropakramya pūrvāhṇe yāgaḥ | yad apy āhuḥ | “prātar devam iti prokaṃ tannopapadyata" iti ca |
tad apy upakramābhiprāyeṇaiva | pūrvāhṇaikadeśaś cet prātaḥkālaḥ tarhi pūrvāhṇavivakṣayā vacanadvaye ’pi prātargrahaṇaṃ, anyathā “pūrvāhṇo vai devānāṃ madhyandinaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ aparāhṇaḥ pitṝṇām" iti śrutivirodhaḥ |
pakṣādāv eva kurvanti sadā pakṣādikaṃ carum |
pūrvāhṇa eva kurvanti viddhe ’py anye manīṣiṇaḥ ||
iti kātyāyanādivacanāt | atha yat prātar anudite juhotīty atrāpi darśanāt |
ṣaṣṭhe ’dhyāye jaimininā “udagayanapūrvapakṣapuṇyāheṣu devāni smṛtirūpāṇy svanyārthadarśanādityukre bhāvyakāreṇāndhārthasandarśanaṃ “ pūrvāhṇo vai devānām iti darśitaṃ |
āha ca karkopādhyāyaḥ, “pūrvāhṇe darśayāga iti | anena “prātar ukro manīṣibhir" ityādi vyākhyātaṃ | teneṣṭiviṣaye tredhā vibhāga iti siddham iti |
tad ayuktaṃ | atra hi pūrvāhṇāparāhṇau dvidhā vibhaktasyāhuḥ pūrvāparabhāgau vivakṣitau,
āvarttanāt tu pūrvāhṇo ’py aparāhṇas tataḥ paraḥ |
[327]        madhyāhnas tu tayoḥ sandhir yadāvarttanam ucyate ||
iti vacanāt | na tu pūrvāhṇādiśabdānāṃ tredhā vibhaktasyāhnaḥ krameṇa bhāgatrayaparatvam |         āvarttane yadā sandhis tataḥ pūrvam athāpi vā |
tadahar yāga iṣyeta parataś cet pare ’hani ||
ityādivacanāt vakṣyamāṇabahuvacanavirodhaprasaṅgāc ca | kiṃcānyasmin pakṣe madhyāhnasyāvartanād upari ghaṭikāpañcakaparyantatvāt tatra sandhau tadahar eva yāgaḥ prasajyeta | na ca prasajyatām iti vācyaṃ | tatra prātaḥ parvacaturthāṃśādivihitakālāsambhavena "parvaṇo yaś caturthāṃśa" ityādivacanavirodhāt prātaḥkālasya trimuhūrtatvāt |
tathā ca vyāsaḥ |
muhūrtatritayaṃ prātas tāvān eva tu saṅgava iti |
parāśaro ’pi |
lekhāprabhṛty athāditye trimuhūrtaṃ gate ravau |
prātaḥ smṛtas tv asau kālo bhāgaś cāhnaḥ sa pañcamaḥ iti ||
padmapurāṇe ’pi |
rekhāprabhṛty athādityān muhūrtās traya eva tu |
prātas tu sa smṛtaḥ kālo bhāgaś cāhnaḥ sa pañcamaḥ ||
skandapurāṇe prabhāsakhaṇḍe |
lekhāprabhṛty athācāditye trimuhūrtasthite ravau |
prātaḥkāla iti prokro bhāgaś cāhnaḥ sa pañcamaḥ ||
evam anyeṣv api prātaḥśabdārthapratipādakeṣu vākyeṣu trikmuhūrtātmakaḥ prātaḥkālaḥ kathitaḥ, na tu tridhā vibhaktasyāhnaḥ pūrvo bhāgaḥ prātaḥkāla iti kvacid api śrūyate | yas tu śrutau prayogaḥ sa na mukhyaḥ anekārthatvasyānyāyyatvāt | [328] sanāḍikāḥ prātaḥkāla iti prokaṃ sthāpanāropaṇādiṣv iti so ’py evam eva |
nanu sārdhapraharaḥ prātaḥkālaḥ "sa evādhyardhasaṃyuktaḥ prātar ity abhidhīyate” iti vacanāt | 'saḥ' praharaḥ, adhika upari ardhasaṃyuktaḥ sārdhapraharaḥ | tataś ca madhyandināntyaghaṭikāyāṃ parvasandhau pañcasu ghaṭikāsv atītāsu prātaḥkālaḥ parvacaturthāṃśaś ca sambhavatīti tadānīṃ sāṅgo yāgaḥ kariṣyate |
tad ayukaṃ | “udita āditye paurṇamāsyās tantraṃ prakramayati prāg udayād amāvāsyāyāḥ” iti āpastambavacanāt |
trimuhūrtātmakaḥ prātaḥkālo yadā parvacaturthāṃśasaṃbhavas tad etad vacanaṃ bhaviṣyatīti cet |
na saṃkoce kāraṇābhāvāt | na cāditye udite paurṇamāsyās tantraprakramaḥ ādityodayāt prāg amāvāsyāyās tantraprakrama ity astu pañcaghaṭikāsv atītāsu kariṣyata iti vācyaṃ | aṅgapradhānavatyāṃ bhāvanāyāṃ yugapat puruṣaṃ pravartayatā prayogavacanena madhye vilambaniṣedhāt | tasmād vacanadvayaparyālocanayā trimuhūrtātmake sārdhapraharātmake ca prātaḥkāle ’vagamyamāne 'py āpastambavacanānurodhāt trimuhūrtātmaka eva grāhyaḥ, tasmād asmin kāle yāgasiddhyarthaṃ asmadukta eva vibhāga āśrayaṇīyaḥ |
nanu dvedhāvibhāge yatrāvartanād upari ghaṭikāmātra eva sandhis tatrottaredyur eva yāga iti tatrāpi kālāsambhavād vacanavirodhas tulya eva |
maivaṃ | parvaṇo yaś caturthāṃśa ityādikālasya yāgānvayāvagater bhavitavyaṃ, tad etad yāgsya kālānvayenety abhyupagantavyaṃ, parvamātrottareyur yāge kriyamāṇe na yāgasya kālānvaya iti pūrvedyur eva yāga ity avirodhaḥ |
nanv evaṃ tarhy aparāhṅasandhāv uttaredyur yāgavidhānaṃ virudhyeta |
maivaṃ | yatrāparāhṇe parvasandhāv uttaredyuḥ pratipaccaturthāṃśe yāgo na bhavati tathābhūtasyaivāparāhṇasyātra grahaṇam [329] ity avirodhaḥ, yuktaṃ caitat, anyathā hemantakāle atikharvaṃ tadahas tatra kiṃcid ūne caturdaśaghaṭikāmātre āvartanaṃ bhavati tadā tatraiva tithivṛddhau kadāc choḍaśanāḍiko ’pi caturthāṃśo bhavati tatrāvarttanād upari ghaṭikāmātrasandhāv ukttaredyur eva yāgaḥ prasajyeta | na ca tad yuktaṃ, tatra vihitakālasambhavāt “na yaṣṭavyam" iti niṣedhāt pūrvedyuḥsambhavāc ca | ato ’trāparāhṇaśabdasaṃkoca eva jyāyān, "ā saptamān muhūrtād vai daivaṃ kāryaṃ praśasyata iti vacanaṃ prātaḥkālavidhānāt tadvyatiriktaviṣayaṃ bhavatāpy etad aṅgīkāryaṃ anyathā tridhā vibhaktasyāhnas tṛtīye bhāge prātarātmake bhavatā yāgāṅgatvena svīkṛte 'pi yāgaprasaṅgāt | tasmāt dvedhā vibhaktasyāhnaḥ pūrvāparabhāgāv eva pūrvāhṇāparāhṇāv atra gṛhītavyau, tatrāparāhṇādigate parvasandhau paredyur yāgaḥ pūrvāhṇagate parvasandhau tadahar yāgaḥ | yadā tu pūrvāparāhṇayoḥ sandhau parvasandhis tadā tadahar eva yāga iti pratipādanārthaṃ madhyāhnagrahaṇam | madhyāhnaśabdo hi pāribhāṣikaṃ madhyāhnam utsṛjyāhno madhyamaṃ kṣaṇam evātra pratipādayati | ata eva śātātapo ’pi madhyamaśabdam eva paṭhati |
pūrvāhṇe madhyame vāpi yadi parva samāpyate |
tadopavāsaḥ pūrvedyus tad ahar yāga iṣyate ||
yat tu
pūrvāhṇaḥ praharaṃ sārdhaṃ madhyāhnaḥ praharaṃ tathā |
ā tṛtīyād aparāhṇaḥ sāyāhnaś ca tataḥ paraṃ ||
iti gobhilavacanāc caturtho vibhāgaḥ, yaś ca
muhūrtatritayaṃ prātas tāvān eva tu saṅgavaḥ |
madhyāhnas trimuhūrtaḥ syād aparāhṇo ’pi tādṛśaḥ |
sāyāhnaḥ trimuhūrtas tu sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtaḥ ||
iti vyāsavacanāt pañcadhāvibhāgaḥ so 'py uktarītyā tridhāvibhāgavat karmāntaraviṣayaḥ, [330] āśritaś cāyaṃ dvidhā vibhāgaḥ sakalasutrabhāṣyakṛdbhir bahubhir api nibandhakṛdbhiḥ, yuktaś ceti sa eva svīkāryaḥ | tatra rātrisandhau paredyur eva yāgaḥ “aparāhṇe ’tha vā rātrāv" iti laugākṣivacanāt "pakṣāntā upavastavyāḥ pakṣādayo ’bhiyaṣṭavyā" iti gobhilavacanāc ca |
nanv astamayād ūrdhvaṃ parvasandhau caturdaśyām astamayāt prāg ūrdhvaṃ vā samāptāyāṃ amāvāsyāyāḥ kṛtsnarātriyogitve tatraiva dohādi yuktaṃ “tad yad eva etāṃ rātrim ihāmāvasati tasmād amāvāsyā nāma taṃ gobhir anuṣṭhāpya samabharann iti śrutyā rātriyuktāyām amāvāsyāyāṃ dadhyādirūpasya somasya sambhṛtir devaiḥ kṛtety uktatvāt | na ca “pakṣādayo ’bhiyaṣṭavyā" iti vacanavirodhaḥ, ahorātravyāpinyām api tatra saṃbhavāt | na ca "aparāhṇe ’tha vā rātrāv" ity etadvirodhaḥ, tasya paurṇamāsyām api sambhavāt smṛtitvena durbalatvāc ca |
ucyate | rātriśabdasya tither upalakṣaṇakatvāt (?) “tad ahar evaiṣa purastān na dṛśyeta tad ahar upavased" iti kvacid ahaḥśabdasyāpi darśanāt, “sa yatraiṣa etāṃ rātriṃ na purastān na pañcād dṛśyeta tad ahar upavased iti kvacid ahaḥśabdasyāpi darśanāt, “ca yatraiṣa etāṃ rātriṃ purastān na pañcād adṛśe” ity atra pūrvasmin rātriśeṣe purastād adarśanam uttararātryādau paścād ekasyām eva vā purastāt paścāc cādarśanaṃ vaktavyam | ādye pakṣe yā divāmāvāsyā saiva syāt | dvitīye pakṣe uttararātrāv api tadrūpaṃ vidyate iti saiva bhavet | athocyeta uttararātrau pratipado vidyamānatvāc chāstrato darśanaṃ pratipady api bhavatīti |
āha karkopādhyāyaḥ |
darśanaṃ śāsvataḥ pratipadyeva bhavatīti |
kātyāyanas tv amāvāsyāśeṣe tv āha |
[331]        aṣṭame ’ṃśe caturdaśyāḥ kṣīṇo bhavati candramāḥ |
amāvāsyāṣṭame ’ṃśe ca tataḥ kila bhaved aṇuḥ || iti |
tad asat yadi rātrisambandhād api śāstrato niṣiddhaṃ siddhaṃ tata udayāt prāk pratipatpraveśa: tatropavāso na karttavyaḥ pūrvadine caturdaśī rātrāv api vidyata iti tatrāpi candrasadbhāvān na karttavya eva |
uktaṃ ca smṛtau |
bhūtadine caturdaśyāṃ māṃ kurvanti ye dvijāḥ |
vihāraṃ pitṛyajñaṃ ca tat sarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet || iti ||
'vihāraḥ' viharaṇam iṣṭyarthaṃ āhavanīyādeḥ ity arthaḥ |
tatra tallopaḥ prasajyeta tasmāt " pakṣāntā upavastavyāḥ pakṣādayo ’bhiyaṣṭavyā ity etad eva yukraṃ tasmād rātrisandhau paredyur yāgaḥ |
nanu rātriyoginyām api pañcadaśyāṃ pratipadi trimuhūrtāyāṃ dvitīyāyāṃ “trimuhūrtā dvitīyā ced" iti vacanāt pañcadaśyāṃ yāgaḥ kasmān na kriyate |
viśeṣāvagamād iti brūmaḥ | yady api rātrisandhiśāstraṃ kṛtsnāharvyāpinyāṃ pratipadi sāvakāśaṃ, trimuhūrtadvitīyāśāstraṃ divāsandhau sāvakāśaṃ, yady api ca “pakṣādayo yaṣṭavyā" ity etad upamardenaiva vṛtter etad bādhakāśritadoṣābhāvas tathāpi rātrisandhiśāstrasyānanyathāsiddhatvāt “pakṣādayo yaṣṭavyā ity ata evottaradine yāge prāpte parvacaturthāṃśasya prātaḥ pūrvadine prāptyabhāvād yāgaprātyabhāve trimuhūrttaśāstre yāvat pūrvasminn ahani prāpapitum aśakayam apekṣate tāvad rātrisandhiśāstraṃ dṛṣṭvā viṣayāntaram eva cintayati, tac copariṣṭād vakṣyāmaḥ | tasmāt rātrisandhau paredyur yāga iti siddhaṃ, aparāhṇasandhāv api paredyur yāgaḥ |
[332]        nanu |
caturdaśyāṃ caturyāme amā yatra na dṛśyate |
śvobhūte pratipady atra bhūte kavyādikī kriyā ||
iti vacanāt pūrvaiva kasmān na gṛhyate | tathā ca vacanāntaraṃ |
caturdaśī caturyāmam amāvāsyā na labhyate |
śvobhūte pratipac cet syāt pūrvān tatraiva kārayet || iti ||
yady api caturdaśyā yāmacatuṣṭayavyāpiny amāvāsyā na labhyate kiṃ tu tadekadeśavyāpiny eva tathāpi śvobhūte pratipad asti cet pūrvedyur evopavāsa ity arthaḥ | kātyāyanavacanena paścād abhyudaya amāvāsyeneṣṭveti, yatropavāsadine pratipatsambhavaḥ tatra trihaviṣkeṣṭiḥ prāyaścittatvenoktā |
ucyate | tasyāḥ pratipadi sadbhāve dvitīyāsadbhāve ’py upapattir anyathāsiddhāparāhṇaśabdasyātra baudhāyana utā, tasmād dvitīye ’hani yāgaḥ |
nanu yadā pūrvedyuḥ prātaḥ parvacaturthaṃśābhāvaḥ paredyuś ca prātaḥ parvacaturthāṃśaḥ tadā kasminn ahani yāgaḥ kriyate | na tāvat pūrvedyuḥ tatra prātaḥkāle parvacaturthāṃśādisamāveśābhāvena yāgakālābhāvād aparāhṇaparvasandhitvāc ca | nāpi paredyur yāgaḥ tatrāpi vihitakālābhāvāt |
atra kecid āhuḥ | aparedyur yāgaḥ karttavyaḥ pūrvedyuḥ parvacaturthaśādivihitakālāsambhavāt pratipaccaturthāṃśe yāganivarttakābhāvāc ca | yas tv ayam asti niṣedho nivarttakaḥ |
na yaṣṭavyaṃ caturthāṃśe yāgaiḥ pratipadaḥ kvacit |
rakṣāṃsi tad vilumpanti śrutir eṣā sanātanīti ||
ucyate madhyāhnasandhiviṣayo ’yaṃ pratiṣedho nāparāhṇasandhiviṣayaḥ, tatra [333] paredyur yāgavidhānāt |
nanu aparāhṇasandhāv eva paredyur yāgaprāptes tatra ca pratipaccaturthāṃśasambhavāt prāptipūrvakatvāc ca niṣedhasya tatraiva sāmañjasyaṃ madhyāhnasandhau tu pūrvedyur yāgavidhānāt pratipaccaturthāṃśagandho ’pi nāstīti niṣedhānupapattiḥ |
atrocyate | “pakṣādayo ’bhiyaṣṭavyā ity asya sampūrṇāyāṃ tithau khaṇḍatithau vā sādhāraṇatvaṃ, tatra dvitīye ’hani pratipaccaturthāṃśasya prātaḥkāle sambhavāt prāptipūrvakatvaṃ pratiṣedhasya ghaṭata eva | na caitāvatā pratipaccaturthāṃśe yāgānuṣṭhāne pratyavāyabhāktvaṃ | “pakṣādayo ’bhiyaṣṭavyā iti tatra yāgasya vihitatvād vihitapratiṣedhe ca vikalpa eva syāt |
uktaṃ ca bṛhadvārttike |
yady api prāpya yat kiṃcid vidhinā tulyagocaraḥ |
pratyavāyamatiṃ kuryād vikalpāśrayaṇān na tat ||
dṛṣṭau vidhiniṣedhau hi tulyavīryaikagocarau |
vikalpena tayor ekaḥ prāmāṇyam anutiṣṭhatāṃ ||
aṅgīkṛtaniṣedhānāṃ naiṣa doṣo ’sty akurvatāṃ |
codanālakṣaṇatvaṃ tu na prāmāṇyaṃ vidhes tadā ||
vidheḥ prāmāṇyapakṣe tu pratiṣedhanirākṛteḥ |
codanālakṣaṇaṃ dharmaṃ na doṣo ’sty anutiṣṭhatām || iti ||
na ca "pakṣādayo ’bhiyaṣṭavyā" ity asyāḥ pratipadbhāgacatuṣṭaye ’pi sādhāraṇatvena sāvakāśatvāt “na yaṣṭavyaṃ caturthāṃśa ity asya pratipaccaturthāṃśaviṣayatvena niravakāśatvāt vikalpo na yukta iti vaktavyaṃ | yataḥ sāmānyaviṣayasyāpi vidher viśeṣaniṣedhena nātyantabādhaḥ kriyate tadadhīnalābhavāt |
[334]        tad ukaṃ vārttikakārais tatra ṭīkāyām |
antadurbalo ’pi vidhis tadadhīnātmalābhena pratiṣedhena tulyabalo bhavati pratiṣedhaḥ pradeśenārabhyavidhāne cety atra vakṣyata iti |
tasmāc chāstraprāptārthasyātyantapratiṣedhāsambhavāt "nānuyājeṣu ye yajāmahaṃ karotītivad vikalpaḥ na tu tadvad eva, tarhi paryudāsāśrayaṇād vikalpaḥ parihartuṃ śakyate | tathā hi sākṣāc coditakālasya parvacaturthāṃśaprapratipadādyabhāgatrayātmakasya prātaḥkāle dinadvaye ’py avidyamānatvena yāgānupapatter nityacoditakarmaṇaḥ parityaktum aśakyatvāt prayogavacanasāmarthyena kiṃcid viguṇe ’pi kāle yaṣṭavyam ity āpatite pūrvedyuḥ prātaḥkāle parvacaturthāṃśābhāve ’pi parvamātrasadbhāvād yaṣṭavyaṃ, atha vā paredyuḥ pratipadādyabhāgatrayābhāve ’pi pratipanmātrasadbhāvād yaṣṭavyam iti pratipaccaturthāṃśe ’pi pākṣikī prāptir na devair api vārayituṃ śakyate | tasmāl lakṣaṇayā paryudāsapratipādane vikalpasyāparihāryatvād varaṃ mukhyārthatvāya vikalpaprasakāv api pratiṣedhavācaka eva nañ astu | kiṃ ca paryudāsāsaṃbhavād api pratiṣedhaḥ | tathā hi yadi tāvat pratipaccaturthāṃśasya varjitatvāviśeṣāt | atha caturthāṃśavarjitāyāṃ pratipadi yajeteti tarhi parvacaturthāṃśe yāgo na prāpnoti | atha pratipaccaturthāṃśavarjite codite kāle yajetety ucyate tarhy aparāhṇaparvasandhāv uttaramahaścoditakālas tatrāpi pratipaccaturthāṃśamātram evāvaśiṣṭam iti tatparyudāsatvena kutrānyatra vidhībate | atha nodyantam ādityam īkṣeteti dhātvarthena nañaḥ sambandhād anīkṣaṇasaṃkalpavad ayāgasaṃkalpo damāgasaṃkalpo vidhīyate |
ucyate | yuktaṃ tatra rāgaprāptam īkṣaṇaṃ paryudasyata iti | iha tv aparāhṇaparvasandhau paredyur yāgaḥ śāstraprāpta iti na [335] paryudasituṃ śakyate | na cātra yathā codakaprāptasyārṣeyavaraṇasya "nārṣeyaṃ vṛṇīte” iti pratyakṣopadeśanabalīyasā paryudāsaḥ tathā na śakyate vaktum | ubhayor api pratipaccaturthāṃśaprāpakaparyudāsayor upadeśaśāstratvāt | na ca yathā yāgamātre prāptasya ye yajāmaha ity asya yāgaviśeṣeṣv anuyājeṣu paryudāsas tathātra saṃbhavati | na hi paryudāsaśāstrasya pūrvāhṇāparāhṇādiparvasandhisādhāraṇasyāparāhṇādiparvasandhiśāstraṃ prati viśeṣaśāstratā saṃbhavati | na ca paryudāsaśāstrasya śrutitvena balīyastvaṃ, śrutitvāsiddheḥ | tathā hi bhāṣyakāreṇa caturthāṃśaniṣedhaḥ kātyāyanavacanād ity uktvā “na yaṣṭavyaṃ catuthe 'ṃśa" iti ślokaḥ paṭhitaḥ | tasmāc chrutimūlatvābhiprāyeṇa “śrutir eṣā sanātanī" ity ucyate |
nanu paryudāsavacane tavyapratyayaśravaṇena vidheḥ spaṣṭatvād aparāhṇādiparvasandhivacane vartamānāpadeśatvena kalpyavidhitvād vilambaprāptau vaiṣamyaṃ |
naitad evam, pratipadā paryudasyāte caturthāṃśo vā yāgo veti saṃdeho yāvatā vilambenāpanīyate tāvatetaratrāpi vartamānāpadeśo vā pañcamalakāro veti saṃdeho ’py apanīyata eva | paryudāse nañopalakṣaṇārthatvaṃ ity adhiko doṣaḥ | tasmāt paryudāsāsambhavāt pratiṣedho ’vaśyaṃbhāvī | evaṃ vikalpe sthite madhyāhnasandhiviṣayatvaṃ niṣedhasyāparāhṇasandhiviṣayatvaṃ vidher iti | yato laugākṣiṇā pūrvāhṇāparāhṇasandhiviṣayabhedena pūrvottaradinayor yāgavyavasthā kṛtā “pūrvāhṇe vātha madhyāhne" ityādinā | yat tu "parvaṇo yaś caturthāṃśa" iti vākyaṃ tad api na pratipaccaturthāṃśe yāgaṃ nivārayati | tathā hi na tāvac caturtham aṃśaṃ niṣedhati, avihitatvān niṣedhatvenāpratīteḥ | nāpi pūrveṣām anyeṣām aṃśānāṃ vidhāyakatvenārthād itaram aṃśaṃ nivārayati, vidhivibhaktiśunyatvena vidhivat tv asyāpy aprīteḥ (?) | [336] nāpy upari hi devebhyo dhārayatītivad vidhiḥ kalpyate, siddhavadanuvādāt pramāṇāntarāvirodhāc ca vidhayaḥ kalpyante | iha tu "parvaṇayoś caturthāṃśa" ity atra pratipadbhāgatrayavidhāne caturthāṃśanivṛttiprayojane kalpyamāne “na yaṣṭavyaṃ caturthāṃśe" iti caturthāṃśasya pākṣikābhyanujñāśāstraṃ virudhyate | na ca vācyaṃ vijñeya iti vidhipratyayaḥ, "arhe kṛtyatṛcaś cety arthatvenāpi ghaṭamānatvāt bhavatu vā vidhipratyayaḥ, tathāpy anapekṣite jñāne na tu yajatau | atha nirvapatyālabhativad anapekṣitadhātugato ’pi vidhir iṣṭam arthaṃ vidhatta iti |
ucyate | sāpi kliṣṭakalpanaiveti na vispaṣṭacaturthāṃśābhyanujñaśāstrabādhane sāmarthyam | tathā hi dhāvarthaḥ śrutyā vidhīyate tadasaṃbhave dhātvartho ’nyatra vidhīyate dhātvarthe vānyat vidhīyate | yatra tv anyad evānyatra vidhīyate tad atikliṣṭam | atha taddoṣaparihārārthaṃ dhātvartho jñānam eva vidhīyate kathaṃ tarhi kālasya prāptiḥ | atha jñānaṃ vidhīyamānaṃ jñeyasaṃskārarūpam iti jñānasaṃskāryasya kālasya yāge viniyogam antareṇānupapadyamānaṃ viniyogavidhiṃ kalpayatīty ucyate |
tan na saṃskārānupapattyā saṃskāryaviniyogakalpanāyāḥ saktvadhikaraṇe nirākṛtatvāt |
nanu “somābhāve pūtīkān abhiṣuṇuyād iti tam asmai bhakṣaṃ prayacchedi ti ca bhakṣābhiṣavasaṃskārāny athānupapattyā phalacamasasya pūtīkānāṃ ca yāgaviniyogo yathā kalpitas tathehāpi jñānasaṃskāryasya kālasya viniyogavidhiḥ kasmān na kalpyate |
ucyate | yuktaṃ tatra somena yajeteti kḷptaviniyogasya somasya somam abhiṣuṇotīti somacamasa iti ca samākhyayā bhakṣābhiṣavasaṃskāravidhir na virudhyate iti siddhe bhakṣyābhiṣavayoḥ somasaṃskāratve [337] nirūḍhasaṃskārasya dravyāntarasaṃskāravidhānena suśakaṃ dravyasya pūrvadravyasamānakāryatvakalpanaṃ, iha tv anirūḍho jñānasaṃskāraḥ saṃskāryasya kālasya kḷptamānāntaralabhyaviniyogād ṛte na nirvahati saktvadhikaraṇanyāyād iti yuktam eva |
kiṃ ca somadravyasyaiva viniyuktasya kadācid alabhyamānasya pratinidhyupādāne prāpte niyamamātraṃ kriyate “pūtīkān abhiṣuṇuyād" iti, na tv apūrvo viniyogaḥ kriyate | na tv iha viniyojakāntareṇa vinā siddhyati, tasmāt "samudraṃ manasā dhyāyati pṛthivīṃ ca manasā dhyāyati dveṣyaṃ ca manasā dhyāyatītivad ārād upakārakatvam eva kālajñānavidhānasyeti na kāle prāpakatvam | bhavatu vā jñānasāmagrīsāṃnidhye jñānasyārthasiddhatvenāvidheyatvāt kālavidhitvam eva kālajñānavidhānasyeti | tathāpi yāgakāla ity ekasmin pade kiṃcid uddiśya kiṃcid upādīyata ity etad anupapannam eva, yathaitat tryaṅgaiḥ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ yajatītivad vaṣaṭkartuḥ prathamabhakṣa itivac ca, yathā hi vaṣaṭkartṛviśeṣitabhakṣaṇe prāthamyasambandho vidhātuṃ na śakyate tathā padāntaropāttaparvacaturthāṃśādiviśeṣitasya kālaśabdārthasya yāgakāla iti samāsapadaikadeśapratipāditasyaikadeśāntarārthena saha paścātsambandho vidhīyata iti nopapadyate samasyamānapadayoḥ parasparasambandhāt prākpadāntarasambandhānupapatteḥ “paripūrṇaṃ padaṃ padāntaram ākāṅkṣatīti" nyāyāt | atha "parvaṇo yaś caturthāṃśa ādyāḥ pratipadas traya iti padāntaropāttasya kālasya yāgena sambandho vidhīyata iti |
ucyate | tathāpi yāgakāla iti samāsapadagatenopasarjanībhūtena yāgena saha sambandhaḥ prāpnoti | [338] kiṃ ca phalena vā kārakeṇa vā kriyāṇāṃ sambandho bhavati | na ca kālo yāgasya phalaṃ, asādhyatvāt | nāpi kārakaṃ, kārakavibhaktinirdeśābhāvāt | na hi "pratipadi yajetetivat parvacaturthāṃśāder adhikaraṇavibhaktinirdeśo dṛśyate | tasmāl lakṣaṇayādhikaraṇārthaḥ kalpanīya ity aparaḥ kleśaḥ |
astu vā kālavidhitvaṃ, tathāpi pratipadādyabhāgatrayavidhānaṃ nopapadyate | tathā hi iha kāladvayam upāttaṃ parvacaturthāṃśaḥ pratipadādyabhāgatrayaṃ ca | na cobhayam ekena vākyena vidhātuṃ śakyate, yāgānuvādena kāladvaye vidhīyamāne vākyabhedaprasaṅgāt | atha kālasya nimittasvarūpakatvāt kālayor yogo vidhīyate na tu yāge kālāv ity ucyate, tarhi sutarām eva vākyabhedaḥ | tatra kālabhedena yāgasambandhabhedapratīteḥ | atha pratigrahaṃ saṃmārgeṣu vidhīyamāneṣv api yathā na vākyabhedas tadvad ihāpi pratikālaṃ yāge vidhīyamāne ’pi na vākyabheda ity ucyate |
tan na yuktam | tatra grahatvasaṃmārgayor ekena yatnena sambandhaṃ vidhāya śraute vidhitātparye paryavasite satyārthikā vyāpārabhedāḥ pratigraham upajāyamānā api na vākyaṃ bhindantīti | iha tu parvacaturthaṃśasya pratipadādyabhāgatrayasya caikenaiva śrautavidhitātparyeṇa yāgasaṃbandho yena śabdena vidhīyate tathāvidhaḥ śabdo nāsty ubhayoḥ pṛthagupāttatvāt tasmāt prāptasya yāgasyānekasmin sambandhe vidhīyamāne revatīvāravantīyādhikaraṇapaurṇamāsyadhikaraṇādipūrvapakṣavad vākyabhedaḥ |
nanu tadvad eva tarhi viśiṣṭavidhānena vākyabhedaparihāraḥ kasmān neṣyate |
ucyate | viśiṣṭavidhāne ’bhyupagamyamāne yāgāntarāpatter na darśapūrṇamāsayor [339] ayaṃ kālavidhiḥ siddhyati | darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ śāstrāntaraprāptayor ekena vākyena kāladvayasambandhe vākyabheda ukta eva | atha ardham antarvedi minoty ardhaṃ bahirvedīty atra lakṣaṇayā sandhau minotīti vidhāya yathā vākyabhedaḥ parihṛtaḥ tadvat parvapratipadbhāgābhyāṃ sandhilakṣaṇayā vākyabhedaparihāra ity ucyate |
tan na yuktaṃ | tatra sandhideśe lakṣite ’rthaprāptatvenāntarvedibahirvediśabdārthayor anuvādasaṃbhavāt | iha tu sandhikāle lakṣite ’pi na parvacaturthāṃśapratipad-bhāgatrayasyānuvādaḥ sidhyati, pūrvāparayor aṃśayor niyatayor viṣamayor arthaprāptyabhāvāt |
kiṃ ca sambandhavidhānasya kiṃ lakṣaṇākleśena "sandhau yajeteti śrutyā sandhikāle vihito ’pi prayogāyogya iti tatsamīpalakṣaṇāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ kiṃ paryantaḥ kāla ity avadhyapekṣāyāṃ pūrvāparasāmīpyāvadhividhānārthaṃ vākyam āgatam iti vaktavyam | yadi parvacatuthāṃśādividhāyakam etad vākyaṃ bhavet "parvaṇo yaś catuthāṃśa ādyāḥ pratipadasvaya iti, tadapīdānīm anupapadyamānam | yadi punar api tam eva sandhiṃ lakṣayituṃ gacchati tadā kiṃ tena kṛtaṃ bhavati, tasmād yāgasya kāladvayasambandhavidhāne vākyabhedo ’parihāryaḥ | atha yo yāgakāla iti yāgakālam anūdya va parvaṇaś caturtho ’ṃśa ādyāḥ pratipadasvayo 'ṃśāś ceti vidhīyate | tarhi yāgakāla iti viśiṣṭānuvāde ekas tāvad vākyabhedaḥ, parvacaturthāṃśasya pratipadbhāgatrayasya cobhayor vidhānād aparo vākyabhedaḥ | yat tadorvyatyāsenānvaya ity aparo doṣaḥ | atha parvacaturthāṃśaṃ pratipadbhāgatrayaṃ vānūdya tayor ubhayor yāgakālatvaṃ vidhīyate | evaṃ tarhi parvaṇo yaś caturtho 'ṃśa iti viśiṣṭānuvādād eko vākyabhedaḥ, ādyāḥ pratipadasvayo 'ṁśā ity api [340] viśiṣṭānuvādād dvitīyo vākyabhedaḥ, tayor ubhayor yāgakālatvavidhānāt tṛtīyo vākyabhedaḥ (?), parvacaturthāṃśasya pratipadbhāgatrayasya ca vidhāyakāntarābhāvād anuvādo ’pi na śakyate kartum ity aparo doṣaḥ |
kiṃ ca kālasyānupādeyatvāt kālavidhipareṣu vākyeṣu kālam uddiśya karmaivopādīyate, tad iha yadi parvacaturthāṃśam uddiśya sa yāgakāla iti vidhīyate tarhi vidheyasya yāgakālasyāpi kālarūpatvenānupādeyatvād uddeśyatvam eva prāpnoti | na coddeśyadvayasya mithaḥ sambandhaḥ sambhavati | na cānayoḥ samudāyīkaraṇārthaḥ ekaḥ śabdo ’sti, yena samudāyasya yāgasambandhavidhānād vākyabhedaḥ parihriyeta |
nanu yāgakāla iti kālaśabdenobhayam ekarūpatayā parāmṛśya yāgasaṃbandho vidhīyate |
tan na | yāgakālaśabdena yāgakālayoḥ sambandhavidhānam aśakām ity uktatvāt |
kiṃ ca yāgakālaśabdena parvacatuthāṃśādikālo ’nūdyate punas tenaiva śabdena yāgasya kālasambandho vidhīyate, tadā vājapeyotkaṃ vairūpyam āpadyeta | na hy ekasminn eva vākye ekam eva vastu tadvākyagatam eva kiṃcid apekṣyānūdyate kiṃcid apekṣya vidhīyate iti sambhavati | yadi tu vairūpyaparihārārthaṃ parvacaturthāṃśapakṣādiparāmarśam antareṇa śuddhasyaiva kālasya yāgasaṃbandho vidhīyate |
tad ayukaṃ | kālasambandhavidhānam antareṇāpi siddheḥ | atha "yāgakālaḥ sa vijñeya" iti tacchabdena parvapratipadbhāgān parāmṛśya yāgasaṃbandho vidhīyate, tathāpi pūrvoktaṃ vairūpyaṃ tadavastham eva |
kiṃ ca sa ity ayaṃ tacchabda ekavacanāntaś caturaḥ kālabhāgān parāmarṣṭuṃ [341] na śaknoti | athānuṣaṅganyāyena pṛthag ekaikaṃ parāmṛśatīty ucyate |
maivam | ekasmin vākye pratipadam anuṣaṅgeṇaikasthānekeṣu sambandheṣu gṛhyamāṇeṣu vākyabhedaprasaṅgāt |
kiṃ ca ekavacanāntasya sa ity asya tacchabdasya “ādyāḥ pratipadasvaya ity atra bahuvacanapratinirdeśāt anuṣaṅgo ’pi nopapadyate | yathā gacchatām ity asya saṃyajatrair aṅgānīty atra nānuṣaṅgaḥ |
kiṃ ca yattador nityābhisambandhāt parvaṇo yaś caturthāṃśa iti parvacaturthāṃśe yacchabdaśravaṇāt sa eva tacchabdena parāmarṣṭuṃ yujyate na pratipadbhāgāḥ | atha tatrāpi yacchabdo 'dhyāhriyate śrutyadhyāhṛtayoḥ śruteḥ śīghraṃ sampratyayāt punar api na tasya parāmarśaḥ | bhavatu vādhyāhāraḥ tathāpi pratipadbhāgā iti bahuvacanāntāsyaiva yacchabdasyādhyāhārād ekavacanāntena tacchabdena punar api kathaṃ sambandhaḥ | atha parvapratipadbhāgasamudāya ekavacanānte tacchabdena parāmarṣṭuṃ śakyate ity ucyate |
tan na | ekāvacchedam antareṇa samudāyānupapatteḥ | athaikena tacchabdenopādānāt samudāyatvam ity ucyate | yathā vidvadvākye paurṇamāsyādiśabdopādānād āgneyādīnāṃ samudāyatvasiddhiḥ, yathā vā rājasūyaśabdenopādānād anumatyādīnāṃ mallādīnāṃ pavitrādīnāṃ ca yāgādīnāṃ samudāyatvasiddhiḥ |
tan na | tacchabdopādānāt (?) samudāyatvaṃ samudāyatvād ekavacanāntatacchabdopādānam itītaretarāśrayāpatteḥ | āgneyādīnāṃ tv ekaśabdopādānavyatirekeṇāpy ekopādhisambandho vidyata eva | yad utpattau kālaviśeṣayogitvaṃ nāma tad uktam | “ekakālābhisaṃyogād bhinnānām api karmaṇām | samudayārpaṇaṃ [342] śakyam ekadeśasthavṛkṣavat” || iti | rājasūye ’pi prakṛtatvaviśiṣṭayāgatvopādhisadbhāvāt samudāyatvaṃ bhaviṣyaty ekaphalasādhanatvād vā |
nanv atrāpi prakṛtatvaviśiṣṭakālatvopādhisadbhāvāt parvacaturthāṃśasya pratipadbhāgatrayasya ca samudāyatvaṃ bhaviṣyati |
maivaṃ | kiṃ padārtharūpeṇa kālayoḥ prakṛtatvaṃ, kiṃ vā vākyārtharūpeṇa, na tāvad vākyārtharūpeṇa, mahāvākye ’vāntaravākyārthavivakṣābhāvād vivakṣyamāṇe ’vāntaravākyabhedaprasaṅgāt | nāpi padārtharūpeṇa, na hi parvaṇo yaś caturthāṃśa ity atra kasyacid ekasya padasyārthaḥ parvacaturthāṃśaḥ pratipadbhāgatrayaṃ vā, tasmān na prakṛtatvāvacchedāt samudāyatvaṃ parvapratipadbhāgānām |
nanu yāgasādhanatvaikopādhisadbhāvāt samudāyatvaṃ bhaviṣyati |
naitad evam | yāgasādhanatvāt samudāyatvaṃ, samudāyatvād ekavacanāntena tacchabdena parāmarśaḥ, tacchabdaparāmarśād yāgavidhānaṃ, yāgavidhānād yāgasādhanatvaṃ, yāgasādhanatvāt samudāyatvam iti cakrakāpattiḥ | ata evaikāvacchedam antareṇa samudāyatvānupapatteḥ kāladvayapratipādakāv eva śabdau kāladvayasamudāyaṃ lakṣayata ity etad apāstam | atha "parvaṇo ’ṃśe turīye tu karttavyeṣṭir dvijātibhiḥ” iti parvacaturthāṃśasya yāgasādhanatvāvagamāt “pakṣādayo ’bhiyaṣṭavyāḥ,” “na yaṣṭavyaṃ caturthāṃśe" iti vākyābhyāṃ caturthāṃśavarjitapratipadbhāgatrayasya yāgasādhanatvāvagamāt "parvaṇo yaś caturtho ’ṃśa iti vākyapramiteḥ prāg eva kālāvayavānāṃ yāgasādhanatvalakṣaṇasyopādheḥ siddhatvāt “parvaṇo yaś caturthāṃśa" iti vākye teṣāṃ samudāyāpādanan nānupapannam iti na cakrakāpattir ity ucyate |
tad ayutaṃ | ekenānekeṣu kālabhāgeṣu yāgasādhanatayābhidhīvamāneṣu [343] vākyabhedāpattes tatparihārārthaṃ samudāyarūpatayāpy ekatvāpatter vidhethānāṃ kālabhāgānām apekṣyate yāgasādhanatvam eva vidhātum | tatra yadi param idānīṃ samudāyatvāpatteḥ prāg eva vākyāntaraiḥ kālabhāgānāṃ yāgasādhanatvaṃ siddhaṃ kim idānīṃ samudāyatvāpattyā kriyate |
kiṃ ca kāladvayam idaṃ vidhīyamānaṃ kiṃ samuccayena vidhīyate, kiṃ vā vikalpena | na tāvat samuccayena kāladvayasambandhaḥ, tathā saty ubhayor api kālayor yāgānuṣṭhānaprasaṅgāt | nāpi vikalpena, vikalpo hi viruddhārthayoḥ śāstrayoḥ parasparato vidhānasāmarthyāvirbhāvatirobhāvādinā viruddhavyāpāracatuṣṭayadvayena kleśena sampādyamāno ’pi gatyantarābhāvāt khedenaivābhyupeyate | tatraikenaiva vidhānāt tāvat kleśo ’nubhūyata iti kim etad vājapeyoktavairūpyāpatteḥ, evaṃ kāladvayābhyupagamena sarvam etad uktam |
kiṃ ca prātarātmakas tṛtīyo ’pi kālo ’traivopātta iti tasminn api vivakṣyamāṇe pūrvokteṣu pakṣabhedeṣu sutarāṃ vākyabhedādayaḥ sambhavati, tasmād atimandaśaktitvād asya vacanasya na pratipadbhāgatrayavidhānamukhena caturthāṃśavyudāsakatvaṃ, kiṃ tarhy anena vacanena kriyate, na kiṃcit kriyate | kiṃ tu "parvaṇo ’ṃśe tarīye tu kartavyeṣṭir" iti parvacaturthāṃśe prāpte “pakṣādayo ’bhiyaṣṭavyā" iti pratipadi prāptāyāṃ “prātar yajadhvam" iti prātaḥkāle prāpte "na yaṣṭavyaṃ caturthe ’ṃśa" iti pūrvoktaprakāreṇa pratipaccaturthāṃśe vikalpena niṣiddhe vaikalpikaniṣedhena lakṣito yāvatkālarāśir avaśiṣyate, nānāśāstraprāptaḥ sa sarvaḥ piṇḍīkṛtyaikena yājñikakārikāvākyena kathyate, smaraṇasaukaryārthaṃ "parvaṇo yaś caturthāṃśa" iti | yathā sphyena vedim uddhantītyādinānāśāstraprāpto ’rthaḥ piṇḍīkṛtyānūcyate “etāni vai daśayajñāyudhnīti | [344] yathāha vārttikakāraḥ: “sphyāder utpattisambandhaḥ kāryair uddhananādibhiḥ | tatra yajñāyudhānīti prāptam evānukīrtyate” || tathā "parvaṇo yaś caturtho ’ṃśa ity api nānāśāstrapiṇḍīkṛtānuvādaḥ na punaḥ kāsyacit kālasya vidhāyakam etat yenārthāt pratipaccaturthāṃśaṃ vyudasyet |
kiṃ ca “ukto manīṣibhir" ity uktaśabdena vākyāntarair ukta evārthaḥ smaraṇe saukaryārtham ekatra piṇḍīktyānūdyate na tv apūrvo ’rtho ’nena vacanena vidhīyata iti darśayati| tasmāt pratipadādyabhāgatrayasyaiva yāgakālatvam iti vidhānābhāvāt "na yaṣṭavyaṃ caturthe 'ṃśa" ityanena niṣedhenāpi caturthāṃśasya pākṣikaprāptyābhyanujñānapāyān nātyantam ayāgakālatvaṃ pratipaccaturthāṃśasya | yady avaśyam anena vacanena vidhāyakena bhavitavyaṃ tarhi prātarvidhānam astu sarvam anyad vākyāntaraprāptam anūdyate |
nanu prātaḥkālo ’pi prātar yajadhvam iti śāstraprāpta eva |
naiṣa doṣaḥ | na hi pauruṣeyavākyānāṃ vedamūlatvāparādhena vidhātṛtvaṃ vihanyate, sarvasmṛtīnām aprāmānyaprasaṅgāt | yeṣām api vaktṛjñānānumāpakāni pauruṣeyavacanāni te ’pi kathaṃcit pauruṣeyeṣu vacaneṣu vidhyanuvādavirodhyanuvādavivekaṃ kurvanty eva na pumaḥ sarvānuvādakatvaṃ (?) manyate | yenaivamāhuḥ yaś codanālakṣaṇa ity anūdya sa dharma iti vidhīyata iti |
nanu yadi vākyāntaraprāpto ’py artho vidhātuṃ śakyate tarhi parvacaturthāṃśādir api kasmān na vidhīyate |
ucyate | na parvacatuthāṃśādir vākyāntaraprāpta iti na vidhīyate kiṃ tv anekavidhāne vākyabhedabhayād vākyāntaraprāptatvena kathaṃcid anuvaditum api śakyatvān na vidhīyata |
nanu yadi eka eva vidhātavya iti parvacaturthāṃśādikālasya vākyāntaravihitatvāt prātaḥkālo vidhīyate [345] tarhi viparītaṃ kasmān na bhavati |
ucyate | "parvaṇo yaś caturthāṃśa iti caturthāṃśasya yacchandopabandhād avidheyatvaṃ, prātaḥkālas tu tadabhāvād vidhīyate |
kiṃ ca parvacaturthāṃśasya "ādyāḥ pratipadas traya ity etad vihitasya yāgakālaḥ sa iti tacchabdena parāmarśa ity aparaḥ kleśaḥ |
kiṃ ca yenaiva hetunā vākyabhedabhayādinā kālatritayam etena na vidhīyate tenaiva parvacatuthāṃśādir eko ’pi kālo na vidhīyate, tathā hi parvaṇaś caturtho ’ṃśa iti, traya ete arthāḥ kiṃ teṣāṃ aruṇaikahāyanīnyāyena prathamaṃ kriyayā saha saṃbandham anubhūya paścātpārṇikaḥ parasparasambandhaḥ, āhosvit prathamaṃ parasparasambandhaḥ paścātkriyayā saha sambandhaḥ iti yadāpi prathamaṃ kriyayā sambandhaḥ tadāpi kiṃ viśiṣṭavidhānanyāyena kriyayā sambandhaḥ, ahosvit kriyānuvādena teṣāṃ sambandhaḥ iti | yadi tāvad viśiṣṭavidhānaṃ tathā sati karmāntarāpatter na darśapūrṇamāsayor ayaṃ kālavidhiḥ sidhyati | atha kriyānuvādena parvaṇaś caturthāṃśasya ca sambandho vidhīyate, tadā prāptakriyānuvādenānekaguṇavidhānād ekas tāvad vākyabhedaḥ punas teṣāṃ parasparasambandhavidhāne ’pi sa eva doṣaḥ | atha vākyabhedaparihārārthaṃ caturthāṃśādiviśeṣaṇam anādṛtya parvamātrasya yāgasambandho vidhīyate, tarhi parvaṇi yadā kadācid yāgaḥ prāpnoti | caturthāṃśagrahaṇaṃ ca vidhitvenānuvādatvena vānupapadyamānaṃ vyāhanyate |
nanu parvaṇi yadā kadācid ījānaḥ kadācic caturthāṃśe ’pi yajata ity anuvādaḥ sambhavati | naitad evaṃ | pākṣikānuvādasya nyāyavidām asaṃmatatvāt |
[346]        atha caturthāṃśayāgayoḥ sambandho vidhīyate, tad api yasya kasyacid dravyasya catuthāṃśo yāgārtha ity uktaṃ syāt na tv abhilaṣito ’rthaḥ siddhyati |
nanv aṃśavidhānasyāṃśinā vinānupapatter aṃśini kasmiṃścid ākṣeptavye buddhisthaḥ parvarūpo ’ṃśiviśeṣaḥ kim iti tyajyate |
ucyate | buddhistho 'pi vidhyasaṃspṛṣṭo na siddhyati | atha yadi vidhinā spṛṣyate tarhi tadevānekavidhānam āpadyate |
nanu vidhinā spṛśyamāno ’py arthāt spṛśyate na śrutyā na tatrānekavidhānaṃ doṣaḥ |
maivaṃ | na hy anenāṃśiviśeṣeṇa vināṃśavidher anupapattir yenārthād imam evaśiviśeṣaṃ spṛśet | na hi sādhāraṇasyānupapattir abhidhānamātreṇa buddhisthe viśeṣe paryavasyati, tathā sati sarvatra guṇavidher utsādaḥ “somena yajeta" iti yāgamātraṃ vidhāya vidhau paryavasite yā sādhāraṇī dravyākāṅkṣā sā vidhānam antareṇaiva buddhisthe dravyaviśeṣe some paryavasyatīti kathaṃ viśeṣavidhānaṃ syāt | yatrāpi prāpte karmaṇy anekaguṇavidhānād vākyabhedaḥ prasajyate tatrāpy ekaguṇavidhānam evāstu, itaras tu guṇaviśeṣaḥ, sāmānyānupapattyāpy ākṣipyata iti vaktuṃ śakyatvāt |
nanv evaṃ tarhi "parvaṇe ’ṃśe turīye tu kartavyeṣṭir dvijātibhiḥ” iti vākyena kathaṃ parvacaturthāṃśo yāgāya vidhīyate tatrāpi pūrvoktānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ aviśiṣṭatvāt |
ucyate | "parvaṇo ’ṃśe turīya" iti parvāṃśarūpaṃ padārthadvayaṃ parasparasambandhaviśiṣṭam ekībhūtaṃ yāgāya vidhīyata iti vidheyabhedābhāvān na vākyabhedaḥ |
nanu "parvaṇo' ṃśe tarīya" iti parvāṃśayoḥ parasparasambandho vidhivyāpāram antareṇa na siddhyati |
satyaṃ na sidyati | kiṃ tu vidhyantaram evānayoḥ parasparasṃbandhavidhāyakam asti tad yathā |
[347]        pañcadaśyāḥ paraḥ pādaḥ pakṣādeḥ prathamās trayaḥ |
kālaḥ pārvaṇayāgasya anyathā tu na vidyate ||
iti pañcadaśyāḥ pādaḥ ity anayoḥ sambandho vidhīyate |
nanv evaṃ pañcadaśyā ādye ’pi pāde yāgaḥ prāpnoti atha paraḥ pādaḥ iti viśiṣyate tarhi vākyabhedaḥ |
naiṣa doṣaḥ | “sandhau yajeteti" sandhikālasya yāgārthasya vihitasyāyogyatvāt sandhisamīpavartini kāle lakṣayitavye kriyāsamīpakālo lakṣitaḥ kiṃ nāḍikā kiṃ vā praharas tithyardhaṃ tithir vety apekṣāyāṃ pañcadaśīpādaḥ sāmīpyaviśeṣākāṅkṣāparipūraṇāya vidhīyamānaḥ sāmīpyāvaṣṭambhena sandhipratyāsannatara eva siddhyati na dūravartī |
nanv atra vākye na kevalaṃ pañcadaśīpādayoḥ sambandhaḥ pratīyate kiṃ tu yāgasambandho ’paraḥ pratīyate |
satyam evaṃ | kiṃ tu “parvaṇo ’ṃśe turīye tu kartavyeṣṭir iti vidhīyamāno ’nūdyate āgāminyā api prāpter anuvādasambhavāt | tasmāt pañcadaśauvākye pañcadaśaupādamārtha vidhīyate | tasya sambandhasya yāgasambandhamātraṃ "parvaṇo ’ṃśe turīye tu" ity anena vidhīyate | tasya parvāṃśasya turīyatvam avihitam api sandhiśāstrākṣiptam anūdyata iti pūrvam evoktam | “parvaṇo yaś caturthāṃśa" ity anena prātaḥkālasambandhamātraṃ vidhīyate sarvam anyad anūdyate | tasmāt kvacid apy anekārthavidhānābhāvān na vākyabhedaḥ |
nanu pañcadaśyāḥ pādasya sambandho vākyāntaravihito yāgasambadhavidhānapare vākye vākyabhedaṃ na karotīti yady ucyate tarhi "parvaṇo yaś caturthāṃś" iti vākyenāpi pañcadaśīpādasya yāgasambandho vidhātuṃ śakyata eva |
satyaṃ śakyata eva | kiṃ tv asau viśiṣṭakālo yāgāya vidhātavyaḥ sa cāviśiṣṭasya prātarātmakasya kālasya vidhānenāpi [348] vākyopapattau na yukraḥ viśiṣṭasya vākyāntarasampāditatvena viśiṣṭavidhāne vākyabhede parihṛte ’pi svarūpamātravidhānāpekṣayā kiṃcid vidhigauravasyāparihāryatvād viśiṣṭāpādakavākyāntarasāpekṣatvāc ca | yatra tu svarūpamātravidhānayogyaṃ kiṃcid upāttaṃ nāsti tatra gatyabhāvād viśiṣṭam api yāgāya vidhīyata eva yathā "parvaṇo’ ṃśe turīye tu" iti |
nanu yadi kālabhāgayoḥ viśiṣṭatvam ekena vākyena kriyate tasya viśiṣṭasya yāgasambandho ’pareṇa vākyena tarhy anenaiva prakāreṇa pratipadādyabhāgatrayasya yāgasambandhaḥ kasmān neṣyate | tathā hi "pañcadaśyāḥ paraḥ pādaḥ pakṣādeḥ prathamās trayaḥ” | iti pakṣādeḥ pādā api sandhisāmīpyākṣepabalāt sandhipratyāsannāḥ pādāḥ prathamā eva siddhyantīti |
