naitad evaṃ | iha kālāvayavadvayasambandhaḥ pratīyamāna āste | na caikasminn eva sambandhe vidheye itarasmin hātavye prathamapratītaṃ pañcadaśyāḥ pādasya ca sambandhaṃ hitvā paścād avagataḥ pakṣādeḥ pādānāṃ ca sambandho vidhīyata iti ko ’yaṃ nayaḥ | kiṃ ca pañcadaśyāḥ pādasya ca sambandhaḥ pāṭhaṣiddhaḥ pakṣādeḥ pādānāṃ ca sambandho ’dhyāhārya ity api tasya daurbalyam | kiṃ ca vidhīyatāṃ nāma kāmaṃ pakṣādeḥ pādānāṃ ca sambandhas tathāpi kena vākayena saṃyogo vidhīyate, na tāvat tenaiva, vākyabhedaprasaṅgāt | nāpi "parvaṇo yaś caturtho 'ṃśa ādyāḥ pratipadas traya" ity anena, tasya prātaḥkālasambandhavidhānenaiva caritārthatvam ity uktatvāt | na cānyad vākyām asti yena pratipadbhāgatrayasya yāvān sambandho vidhīyate | tasmād bhāgatrayavidhānāsambhavāt “na yaṣṭavyaṃ caturthe 'ṃśe" ity etad eva caturthāṃśaniṣedhakam avaśiṣyate | tan na pratipaccatuthāṃśasyāpi vikalpena prāptim [349] anujānātīty uktam | tasmāt pūrvoktavyasthayāparāhṇādiparvasandhau pratipaccaturthāṃśo na niṣiddhyate pūrvāhṇaparvasandhau tu niṣidhyata iti siddham |
tathā ca trikāṇḍamaṇḍanenoktam |
sandhir yady aparāhṇe syād yāgaṃ prātaḥ pare ’hani |
kurvāṇaḥ pratipadbhāge caturthe ’pi na duṣyati ||
tad etat trikāṇḍamaṇḍanādimatam anye nānumanyante | kasmāt pūrvāhṇāparāhṇasandhyayor ubhayor apy upavāse dvitīye ’hani ca yāge ’nuṣṭhīyamāne pakṣādeḥ pratipaccaturthāṃśasya ca sambhavāt “pakṣādayo ’bhivaṣṭavyāḥ” | “na yaṣṭavyaṃ caturthe ’ṃśe” iti śāstradvayasyāpy anugrāhyatvān madhyāhnasandhāv ekam aparāhṇasandhāv aparam iti vyavasthāyāṃ pramāṇabhāvāt | na ca laugākṣivā (?) dvayaṃ pramāṇaṃ, tasya pūrvottaradinadvayayāgavyavasthāparatvena vidhiniṣedhavyavasthāyāṃ tātparyābhāvād asambhavāc ca | tathā hi ādityodayasamanantaraṃ parvasandhau tadaharyāge kriyamāṇe pakṣādiśāstrasya niṣedhānugrahadarśanāt | aparāhṇasandhāv apy arvāg astamayāt parvasandhau dvitīye ’hani yāgānuṣṭhāne ’py ubhayor anugrahadarśanāt | evaṃ rātrisandhāv apy ubhayor anugrahaḥ |
atha pratipaccaturthāṃśe yāgābhāvāt pūrvāhṇasandhau pakṣādiśāstrasyānugraho nāstīty ucyate, tarhy aparāhṇasandhāv api pratipadādyabhāge yāgo nāstīti pakṣādiśāstram anugrahāntam ucyate | tathā śāstrāntaravaśād ādye bhāgatraye yāge ’nuṣṭhite "pakṣādayo’ bhiyaṣṭavyā" ity asyārtho ’pi kriyata eva | tathā kṛṣṇapakṣādidarśapūrṇamāsayāgo na vyāpnotīty ekadeśe evam anuṣṭhānaṃ | yad api " na yaṣṭavyaṃ caturthe ’ṃśe" iti niṣedhānyathānupapattyā pratipaccaturthāṃśe yāgakalpanaṃ tad apy atrārṣeyasya hānaṃ syād ity etad  [350] adhikaraṇaviruddham | atra hy ārṣeyaṃ vṛṇīte ity asya trīn vṛṇīte ity asmin vidyamāne na caturo vṛṇīta iti niṣedhakalpavidhiparatvaṃ na sambhavatīty uktam | tad ihāpi "pakṣādayo ’bhiyaṣṭavyā" ity asya " pakṣādeḥ prathamās traya ity asmin vidyamāne "na yaṣṭavyaṃ caturthe 'ṃśa" iti niṣedhād vidhyantarakalpanā na sambhavatīti | tasmāt "na yaṣṭavyaṃ caturthe 'ṃśa" iti nityānuvādo ’yaṃ na caturo vṛṇīte itivat | atha vā paryudāso ’yaṃ, "pakṣādayo ’bhiyaṣṭavyā" iti pratipadi yāgakāla ucyamāne "na yaṣṭavyaṃ caturthe ’ṃśa" ity anena caturthāṃśavarjite pratipadi yaṣṭavyam ity ucyate, etad eva spaṣṭīkṛtaṃ smṛtyantare “pakṣādeḥ prathamās traya" iti, “ādyāḥ pratipadas traya" iti ca | evaṃ ca sati "pakṣādayo ’bhiyaṣṭavyā" ity asya "na yaṣṭavyaṃ caturthe ’ ṃśa" ity asya ca pratipadbhāgatrayasmṛtyā sahaikaśrutimūlatvaṃ bhaviṣyati | yat tu paryudāsapakṣe dūṣaṇam abhihitaṃ aparāhṇaparvasandhau ṣaḍghaṭikātmake ca tithidvaye pūrvedyuḥ parvacaturthāṃśābhāve ’pi parvatṛtīyāṃśe yaṣṭavyam, paredyuḥ pratipadādyabhāgatrayābhāve ’pi caturthabhāge yaṣṭavyam iti prayogavacanasāmarthyād āpatito vikalpo na devair api vārayituṃ śakyate, paryudāsaś ca na naño mukhyo ’rthaḥ kiṃ tu lakṣaṇayeti |
tad asat | yadi hi parvatṛtīyabhāgavat pratipaccaturthāṃśo na paryudastaḥ syāt tadaivam api bhavet, iha tu “na yaṣṭavyaṃ caturthe 'ṃśa" iti paryudāsasadbhāvāt parvatṛtīyabhāga eva yāgaḥ prāpnoti | na ca paryudāse lakṣaṇety ekādaśīnirṇaye darśitam, anenaiva nyāyena niṣedhapakṣe ’pi pūrvedyur eva yāgaḥ prāpnoti | anupapattyā hi parvatṛtīyapratipaccaturthabhāgayor vikalpena yāge prāpte "na yaṣṭavyaṃ caturthe ’ṃśa" iti pratipaccatudhāṃśe yāgasya nivāritatvāt | [351] anyathā mudgapratinidhitvena māṣāṇāṃ grahaṇe prāpte ṣaṣṭhe ’dhyāye jaimininābhihitaṃ "pratiṣiddhaṃ vā viśeṣeṇa vihitaṃ tu śrutir" iti, kātyāyanena ca "pratiṣiddhaṃ pratyayād" iti, tathāpi vaktuṃ śakyate pratiṣiddhānām api māṣāṇām astu grahaṇam iti | yas tatra parihāro ’rthaprāpte niṣedho bādhaka eveti sa iha samāna iti | yat kiṃcid etat parvacaturthāṃśasya śrutatvam asiddham ity ukaṃ |
tan na | kātyāyanena "śrutir eṣā sanātanī" ity abhidhānāt | yat tu bhāṣyakāreṇa kātyāyanavacanād ity ukaṃ tacchrutitve ’py aviruddhaṃ “śrutir eṣā sanātanī" ity atra kātyāyanavacanatvāt | diṅmātram atra darśitaṃ granthavistarabhayād iti | tasmāt yathokta eva kāle yāga iti siddham |
anye tv evam āhuḥ "na yaṣṭavyaṃ caturthe 'ṃśa" iti yad vacanaṃ tat pūrvāhṇasandhiviṣayam iti vyākhyeyam | na ca pūrvāhṇamadhyāhnasandhiśāstraṃ hi parvacaturthāṃśe yāgavidhāyakaṃ na tataḥ pratipaccaturthāṃśe yāgasya prāptir asti ataḥ prāptyabhāvena pratiṣedhānarthakyaṃ prāptipūrvakatvāt pratiśedhasyeti vācyam | tataḥ prāptyabhāve ’pi "pakṣādayo ’bhiyaṣṭavyā" ity anena prāptisambhavāt | na ca " ādyāḥ pratipadas traya" ity anenāsyopasaṃhāra iti vācyam | asya kālāntaropalakṣaṇakatvenāvirodhād upasaṃhāraparatvānupapatter dinadvaye ’py uktayāgakālacatuṣṭayālābhe tv avaśyaṃ yāgakālāntaram abhyupagantavyam | na ca tasyānyat prāpakaṃ śāstram asti | vyavasthāśāstrāṇāṃ vyavasthāparatvenāpūrvakālavidhāyakatvānupapatteḥ ubhayaparatve vākyabhedaprasaṅgāt kevalakālavidhiparatve ca vyavasthā niṣprāmāṇiko syāt tasmāt kālāntaropalakṣakam evaitad iti siddhaṃ |
tad ayukaṃ | vinā [352] kāraṇaṃ lakṣaṇāprasaṅgāt yāgakālasambandhasya trimuhūrttā dvitīyā cetyādiśāstreṇārthasiddheḥ, ato na vākyabhedo ’pīti yat kiṃcid etat | tasmān na pratipaccaturthāṃśe yāga iti siddham |
nanu hemantakāle ’hnām atihrasvatvāt kiṃcin nyūne caturdaśaghaṭikāmātra āvartanaṃ bhavati, tatra tithivṛddhau satyāṃ ṣoḍaśanāḍiko ’pi parvacaturthāṃśo bhavati, tatra tantropakramakālād ārabhya prātaḥ parvacaturthaṃśo ’sti dvitīyadine ca prātaḥ pratipattṛtīyāṃśas tatra kutra yāgaḥ |
atra kecid āhuḥ aparāhṇaparvasandhitvāt paredyur yāga iti |
tad ayukaṃ |
parvaṇo ’ṃśe turīye tu karttavyeṣṭir dvijātibhiḥ |
dvitīyāsahitaṃ yasmād dūṣayanty āśvalāyanāḥ ||
iti hārītavacanāt, “trimuhūrttā dvitīyā ca" ityādivākya virodhāc ca | aparāhṇasandhiśāstraṃ tu trimuhūrttaśāstrāviruddhe viṣaye vyavatiṣṭhate |
nanv aparāhṇasandhiśāstrāviruddhe viṣaye pūrvāhṇaparvasandhau trimurttaśāstraṃ kim iti na vyavatiṣṭhate |
ucyate | pūrvāhṇasandhau trimuhūrttonadvitīyāprasaktyabhāvāt trimuhūrttagrahaṇam avivakṣitaṃ syāt | trimuharttadvitīyāśabdena vyavahitataraniṣprayojanapūrvāhṇaparva-sandhilakṣaṇāprasaṅgāc ca candradarśanadine yāganiṣedhakabahuvākyavirodhāc ca | aparāhṇaparvasandhiviṣayatve tūktadoṣābhāvāt tadviṣayataiva yuktā |
kiṃ ca matpakṣe sandhisāmīpyaṃ tvatpakṣe tan nāstīty etāvān viśeṣaḥ | tasmāt prātarvihitakālasambhavāt tatraiva yāga iti | yadā tu sārdhaṃ praharadvayaṃ kiṃcidadhikaṃ caturdaśī pañcadaśyāṃ muhūrttatrayaṃ pratipatpratipadi muhūrttatrayaṃ dvitīyā tadā pūrvasyāṃ yāgaḥ,
yasyāṃ tithāv astamiyāt sūryaś ca trimuhūrttakaḥ |
yāgadānajapādibhyas tām evopakramet tithim ||
[353]        iti vacanāt |
nanu,
pañcadaśyāḥ paraḥ pādaḥ pakṣādeḥ prathamās trayaḥ |
kālaḥ pārvaṇayāgasya anyathā tu na vidyate ||
ityetatpratipāditayāgakālavyatirike kāle yāgo na yuktaḥ |
tan na, yathā pakṣādayo ’bhiyaṣṭavyā ityetat pratipāditayāgakālavyatirikte kāle parvacaturthāṃśe vacanāntarād yāga iṣyata evam ihāpi bhaviṣyati | yadā tu sampūrṇā caturdaśī pañcadaśī pratipadyādityāstamayād arvāg eva samāpyate, dvitīyāprabhṛter vātyantikaḥ kṣayaḥ tadā pūrvedyur eva yāgaḥ |
caturdaśī ca sampūrṇā dvitīyā kṣayagāminī |
catur iṣṭiramāyāṃ syāt bhūte kavyādikī kriyā ||
iti vacanāt | yadā caturdaśī sampūrṇā pañcadaśyāṃ nyūnatrimuhūrttā pratipat pratipadi trimuhūrttā dvitīyā tadā pūrvedyur eva yāgaḥ |
trimuhūrttā dvitīyā cet pratipady āparāhṇikī |
anvādhānaṃ caturdaśyāṃ parataḥ somadarśanāt ||
iti vacanāt |
tathā |
āditye ’stamite candraḥ prakṣīṇa udayād yadā |
pratipadyatipattiḥ syāt pañcadaśyāṃ yajeta ca || iti |
yadā pañcadaśyāṃ muhūrttatrayādhikā pratipat pratipadi ca tāvatī dvitīyā tato ’dhikā vā tadā pūrvānuṣṭhānam iti tanmuhūrttatrayasyādhikeṣu muhūrtteṣu vidyamānatvāt pūrvasyām eva yāgaḥ
uktaṃ ca|
pratipadi yam uditā ced agnīn anvādadhīta bhūtadine |
[354]        viramati parvadivā cet sadyaḥkālaṃ tu paurṇamāsyāṃ ||
antyāpi |
apūrṇe ’nastage caiva aupavasthāsanaṃ mataṃ |
pratipatsu yaḍā paśyed dhīno vābhyuditaḥ śaśī || iti |
nanu yad etat
carur iṣṭir amāvāsyāṃ bhūte kavyādikī kriyā |
iti, tathā
pratipady atipattiḥ syāt pañcadaśyāṃ yajeta ca |
iti, tathā
anvādhānaṃ caturdaśyāṃ parataḥ somadarśanāt |
ityevamādibhiḥ pañcadaśyāṃ yāgavidhānaṃ kṛtaṃ tat parvacaturthāṃśe prātar vidyamāne tu bhavatu | "parvaṇo yaś caturthāṃśa" iti parvacaturthāṃśasyaiva yāgakālatvena vidhānāt parvatṛtīyacaturthāṃśe yāgo na yukta ity ucyate |
arvāg astamavād yatra dvitīyā tu pradṛṣyate |
tatra yāgaṃ na kurvīta viśvedevāḥ parāṅmukhāḥ ||
ityetāvanmātram |
yadi tu śrūyate tarhi parvacaturthāṃśa eva pūrvasminn ahani yāga ity uktaṃ syād iha tu “trimuhūrttā dvitīyā ced" ityādinimittaviśeṣe pañcadaśyāṃ yānavidhānāt na parvacaturthāṃśānurodhena bādho yuktaḥ | tasmād yathokta eva kāle yāga iti siddhaṃ | yadā tu grīṣmadināntyaghaṭikāyāṃ parvasandhir muhūrttatrayahrāsāc ca prātaḥ parvadvitīyāṃśaḥ paredyus trimuhūrttāṃ dvitīyā tadā parvadvitīyāṃśe yāgaḥ |
tathā ca āśvalāyanaḥ |
parvaṇo 'ṃśe tṛtīye tu karttavyeṣṭir dvijātibhiḥ |
dvitīyāsahitaṃ yasmād dūṣayanty āśvalāyanāḥ |
[355]        yadā tu muhūrttatrayād ūrdhvaṃ pūrvedyuḥ parvacaturthāṃśasya praveśaḥ paredyuś ca mujharttaṣaṅkāddūrdhvaṃ pratipacaturthaśaḥ syāt tadā pareṣuryāgaḥ, -
iṅkhātprāk praveśe tu pūrvedyuḥ |
yad āha gārgyaḥ |
yajñakālas tithidvaidhe ṣaṭkalo yadi lakṣyate|
parva tatrottaraṃ kāryaṃ hīne pūrvam upakramet ||
kalātra muhūrttaṃ na tu ghaṭikā “trimuhūrttāṃ dvitīyā ced" iti śāstravirodhāt | smṛtipradīpakṛtāpy atra kalāśabdasya muhūrttārthatoktā | parāśaravākye tu "ṣaṇmuhūrttas tu vidyata" iti pāṭhaḥ ||
atra vākye kecid vivadante | tathā hi candradarśane yāgaḥ sarvathaiva na kartavyaḥ kiṃ tu tatpūrvadine yāgaḥ pūrvataradine tv anvādhānam iti tasya vākyasyārthaḥ pratibhāti, sa cāyuktaḥ āpastambo hy anvādhānayāgadinayor anyataratra vikalpena candradarśanaṃ pariharaṇīyam ity āha na punar niyamena yāgadine candradarśanaṃ pariharaṇīyam iti | yathāha,
yad ahar na dṛśyate tad ahar amāvāsyāṃ śvo na draṣṭāra iti veti |
vājasaneyino 'py ubhayor anyataratraiva candradarśanaṃ niyacchanti na punar ubhayatrāpi |
yathāhuḥ |
tad vaike dṛṣṭvopavasanti tasmād yadaivainaṃ na purastān na ca paścāt paśyeta tarhy evopavased iti ca |
kātyāyano ’py āha |
candrādarśanenāmāvāsyām upavaset sampūrṇena paurṇamāsīm iti kecit |
[356]        laugākṣir apy āha |
yad ahas tv eva candramā na dṛśyeta tām amāvāsyāṃ kurvīta dṛśyamāne ’py anāgatād vā bhavantīti |
tathā somadarśanadine yāgavidhāyikā niṣedhādhikāraśrutir dṛśyate |
yad ahaḥ paścāc candramā abhyudeti tad ahar yajanta imān lokān abhyudeṣyatīti eṣā vai sumanā nāmeṣṭir yamadyejānaṃ paścāc candramā abhyudety asmin kāle vāsmai loke ’rddhakaṃ bhavatīti yasminn ahani purastāt parataś ca somo na dṛśyate tad ahar yajata iti |
tad eteṣāṃ viruddhaśāstrāṇāṃ vyavasthā parvavicāre pratipāditā bahvācāryamatānusārād aparāhṇādiparvasandhau somadarśanadine yaṣṭavyam anyathā veti |
kiṃ caivaṃ śrūyate uttarām upavased aniryāyeti (?) |
tasyārthaḥ kiṃ pūrvām upavased uttarāṃ vety aniryāya yatra etādṛśaṃ niścitaṃ jñānaṃ nāsti tatrottarām evopavased iti | evaṃ saṃdehe ’pi ced uttaram eva parvopavasanīyaṃ kiṃ punar yadā parvavicāroktayā vyavasthayottaram eva parva niścitaṃ pratīyata iti, tadanusāreṇaiva “trimuhūrttā dvitīyā ced" iti vākyaṃ vyākhyātavyaṃ na svātantryeṇa | yadi tu svamahimārthaṃ kathyate tāvad adhyāhārakleśena prathamato vidhisahitam ākhyātārthapadalabdhavyaṃ (?) tasmiṃl labdhe 'pi punar anāyāsena kiṃcid api na śakyate | tathā hi yadi caturdaśyām anvādhānāya karṣo vidhīyate tadaivaṃ yojanā, caturdaśyām anvādhānaṃ kartavyaṃ parataḥ somadarśanād iti | tatredam ucyate | anvādhānotkarṣaḥ kasmān na vidhīyata iti | tathā hi pratipady āparāhṇikī [357] yady api dvitīyā tathāpi caturdaśyāṃ somadarśanāt parato ’nvādhānaṃ paratra dine ’nvādhānaṃ kartavyam iti candradarśane yāganiṣedhavad anvādhānasyāpi niṣiddhatvāt | tad yathā “yadaivainaṃ na purastān na paścāt paśyet tarhy evopavased" iti candradarśanenāmāvāsyām upavased iti, “yad ahar na dṛśyeta tad ahar amāvāsyām" iti ca, tasmāc caturdaśyāṃ somadarśanāt tatparityāgenānvādhānotkarṣavidhānam eva yuktam |
nanv evaṃ caturdaśyāṃ somadarśanāc caturdaśītaḥ paratra dine ’nvādhānaṃ kartavyam iti caturdaśīgrahaṇasyobhayatra sambandhād vākyabhedaś caturdaśīta iti vipariṇāmakalpanā ca syāt |
ucyate, na tāvad vipariṇāmakalpanā caturdaśyāṃ somadarśanād iti vyavahitānvayasyāduṣṭatvād vākyabhedo ’pi nāsti śrutyarthābhyāṃ sambandhadvayābhyupagamāt |
yathāha |
śrutyarthābhyām anekārthavidhānaṃ na virudhyata iti |
śrautānvayanānātve hi vākyabhedo bhavati |
yathāha |
kumārilaḥ śrautavyāpāranānātve śabdānām atigauravam iti |
ata evārthikatvād dvitīyasambandhasya śabdavipariṇāmakalpanādoṣo ’pi na prāpnoti | yathā rātrisatrārthavādatvenopakṣīṇāpi pratiṣṭhārthāt pratiṣṭhākāma ity adhikāreṇa viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavantī na vākyaṃ bhinatti, na ca vipariṇāmadoṣaṃ janayati |
nanu vyavahitakalpanādayo doṣāḥ gatyantarāsambhave ’bhyupagamyante | asti tv iha gatyantaraṃ caturdaśyām anvādhānāpakarṣavidhānaṃ nāma |
ucyate | yadi vyavahitakalpanādibhayād anvādhānāpakarṣavidhānam āśrīyate tarhi tavāpi kiyanto doṣāḥ prasajyante tad ākarṇyatāṃ | [358] tathā hi tatra hi pakṣe somadarśanād iti kva sambadhyate, kiṃ caturdaśyāṃ somadarśanād iti, kiṃ vā caturdaśītaḥ paratra dina iti, kiṃ vāmāvāsyāyāḥ parataḥ pratipadi, kiṃ vā parataḥ parasyāṃ diśi somadarśanād iti, na tāvac caturdaśyāṃ somadarśanād iti, sarvato ’sammatatvād evaṃvidhānvayasya somadarśanasya doṣatveneṣṭatvāc ca | kathaṃ tadvaty eva dine ’nvādhānaṃ vidhīyate | nāpi caturdaśyāḥ paratra dine somadarśanād iti, anvādhānayogyacaturdaśītaḥ paratra dine kadācit somadarśanābhāvāt | nāpi pratipadi somadarśanād iti, tathā sati parātparataḥ somadarśanād ity ucyeta na punaḥ parataḥ somadarśanād iti | atha lakṣaṇayā sa evārthaḥ parata ity anenocyate, tarhi lakṣaṇaiva doṣaḥ | atha pratipad api caturdaśītaḥ parā bhavatīti parata ity anena mukhyayaiva vṛttyā pratipad ucyate, tarhi pañcamyāṃ somadarśanād api caturdaśyām anvādhānaṃ vidhīyeta | atha pratipady āparāhṇikīty atra sākṣād upāttena pratipadīty anena sambandhaṃ kṛtvā pratipadi somadarśanād ity ucyate, tathā sati pratipacchabdasya dvitīyāśabdena somadarśanena ca sambandhād vākyabhedo vyavahitakalpanā ca parataḥśabdo ’py anarthakaḥ prāpnoti | pratipadi ca kadācid api somadarśanābhāvād asaṃbhāvyam ānārthatvaṃ prāpnoti | atha "tad vaike dṛṣṭvopavasantīty upavāsadine somadarśanasya jñātatvena guṇatvam eva na doṣatvam iti caturdaśyām anvādhānaṃ kartavyaṃ caturdaśyāṃ somadarśanād iti yady ucyeta, tarhi caturdaśīgrahaṇasyānvādhānaṃ somadarśanād iti yadi vyākhyeyaṃ tataḥ kasminn ahanīti vaktavyam | na tāvac caturdaśyāṃ, parataḥ somo dṛśyate yena tatrānvādhānaṃ vidhīyeta | nāpy amāvāsyāyāṃ, parataḥ [359] somadarśanād iti, tasyātrānupāttatvād anvādhānayogyacaturdaśyanantarāyām amāvāsyāyāṃ somadarśanāsambhavāc ca | nāpi pratipadi parasyāṃ diśi somadarśanād iti, tatra pūrvavākyabhedavyavahitakalpanayoḥ prasaṅgāt | tatra niyamena parasyām eva diśi somadarśanaṃ bhavatīti parata ity etad api anuvādamātratvenāpravṛttiviśeṣakaraṃ prāpnoti | atha paurṇamāsīpratipannivṛttyarthaṃ parataḥ parasyāṃ diśi somadarśanād iti yady ucyeta, tad ayuktaṃ paurṇamāsīpratipady apy ahorātre parasyāṃ diśi somadarśanasya vidyamānatvāt | atha pratipadi parasyāṃ diśi pūrvarātre somadarśanād iti vā, pratipadi rekhāmātrasya darśanāt prathamadarśanād iti vā, śuklapratipadi somadarśanād iti vā kṛṣṇapratipannivṛttyarthaṃ vyākhyāyate |
naitad evaṃ | pūrvarātrādigrahaṇānām adhyāhāraprasaṅgāt śrutair eva padais tatra dravyalakṣaṇāprasaṅgād vā pūrvoktānām api doṣāṇāṃ tadavasthatvāc ca uttarayoḥ pakṣayoḥ parataḥ śabdānarthakyaprasaṅgāc ca śuklapratipadi kadācid api somadarśanābhāvenāsaṃgatārthatvaprasaṅgāc (?) ca | atha śukladvitīyāyāṃ somadarśanād ity ucyate
tan na | ditīyāśabdena śukladvitīyālakṣaṇāprasaṅgāt prathamāntadvitīyāśabdasya saptamyantatayā vipariṇāmaprasaṅgāc ca| kiṃ caivaṃ saty anapekṣite ’pi viṣaye kadācid anvādhānāpakarṣaḥ prasajyeta tatra spaṣṭārthaṃ yaṃ kaścid eva vāram adhikṛtya tithikḷptir udāhriyate, ādityavāre udayāstamayavyāpinyām amāvāsyāyāṃ, somavāre udayāstamayavyāpinyāṃ pratipadi, maṅgalavāre udayāstamayavyāpinyāṃ ditīyāyāṃ somadarśanāc caturdaśyām anvādhānāpakarṣaḥ prasajyeta dvitīyāsomadarśanatvāviśeṣāt | atha pratipadi yā śukladvitīyā tasyāṃ somadarśanād ity ucyate |
[360]        tan na | anantaraikadoṣavarjaṃ pūrvoktasarvadoṣāṇāṃ tadavasthatvāt prapipadi kadācid api dvitīyāsambhavād asambhāvyamānārthatvam apy uktaṃ syāt |
atha pratipatsaṃyuktāyāṃ dvitīyāyāṃ somadarśanād ity ucyate |
tan na | sarvasyā api dvitīyāyāḥ pratipatsaṃuktatvāviśeṣeṇāviśeṣaṇatvaprasaṅgāt pūrvoktānām api doṣāṇāṃ tadavasthatvāt |
atha divaiva pratipady uktāyāṃ śukladvitīyāyāṃ somadarśanād ity ucyate |
tan na | anantaraikadoṣavarjaṃ pūrvoktadoṣāṇām anyatrāpy aparihārāt |
kiṃ ca ādityavāre ṣaṣṭināḍikāyām amāvāsyāyāṃ satyāṃ pratipadi ghaṭikādvayavivṛddhyātha somavāraṃ vyāpya maṅgalavāre ghaṭikādvayamātrāyāṃ pratipadi satyāṃ divaiva pratipatsaṃyuktā dvitīyā jāteti tatra somadarśanāc caturdaśyām anvādhānam apakṛṣyeta |
atha trimuhūrttāyāṃ dvitīyāyāṃ somadarśanād ity ucyate |
tan na | na hi kadācid api trimuhūrttaiva dvitīyā bhavati | yady apy atyantahrāso bhavati tathāpi trimuhūrttādhikahrāsābhāvāt saptaviṃśatimuhūrttanyūnadvitīyā na kadācit sambhavati |
atha yasminn ahani trimuhūrtaiva dvitīyā tatra somadarśanād ity ucyate | \
tan na | tṛtīyāyuktā dvitīyā yasmin dine tatra somadarśanād api hi caturdaśyāṃ anvādhānāpakarṣaḥ prasajyate |
atha pratipaddinavartinyāṃ trimuhūrttāyāṃ somadarśanād ity ucyate |
tarhi ṣaṇmuhūrttāyāṃ vā pratipadi dvitīyāyām api caturdaśyām anvādhānāpakarṣo na vidhīyeta |
atha nyūnatadvyudāsārthaṃ trimuhūrtagrahaṇaṃ sādhikavyuāsārtham ity ucyate |
tarhy eṣa tāvad eko doṣaḥ saṃkhyāśabdānāṃ nyūnādhikanivartkasvabhāvānāṃ nyūnamātranivarttakatvam iti kṣayamātranyūnatrimuhūrtāyāṃ [361] somadarśanāviśeṣe ’pi anvādhānānapakarṣaḥ prasajyeta |
athāparāhṇikyāṃ dvitīyāyāṃ somadarśanād ity ucyate |
naitad evaṃ | na hi kadācid api tithiḥ kevalapūrvāhṇasambandhinī vidyata iti, sarvathā aparāhṇasambandhitvāviśeṣeṇa vyāvṛttyabhāvena vyarthaviśeṣaṇatvaprasaṅgāt |
athāparāhṇamātreṇa yā dvitīyā saivāparāhṇikī tasyāṃ somadarśanād ity ucyate |
naivaṃ aparāhṇamātravarttinyāṃ dvitīyāyāṃ kadācid api somadarśanābhāvenārthasambhavād arthatvam utkaṃ syāt | aparāhṇikyāṃ dvitīyāyāṃ sandhyādivarttinyām eva somasya dṛśyamānatvāt |
athāparāhṇikī dvitīyā yasmin dine vidyate tadīyasandhyādikāle somadarśanād ity ucyate |
tarhi tadīyasandhyādibahūnāṃ padānāṃ adhyāhāraḥ prasajyeta | pūrvoktavākyāntaravyavahitakalpanādayo doṣā api tadavasthā eva | tasmāt somadarśanadine yāganiṣedhaśrutīnāṃ taddine yāgavidhāyakaśrutīnāṃ ca bahvācāryamatānusāreṇa vyavasthitavikalpaḥ parvavicāre pratipāditas tathaivaitad api vacanaṃ netavyaṃ na svātantryeṇa | tasmān niyamena caturdaśyām anvādhānāpakarṣavidhāyakam etadi ti yuktaṃ |
tad ayukaṃ | "yasminn ahani purastāt parataḥ somo na dṛṣyate tadahar yajata" iti śrutyā yāgasya candrādarśanadine vidhānāt |
tathā ca smṛtiḥ |
yad ahaś ca na dṛśyeta sampūrṇaś ca yadā bhavet |
sa eva kālo yāgasya etena haviṣā yajet || iti ||
upavāso ’pi tasmāt “yadaivaitan na purastān na pañcāt paśyet tarhy evopavased" iti vacanena candrādarśanadine vihitas tayor ekactrāvaśyambhāvini candradarśane ’ṅgaguṇavirodhe ca tādarthyād iti nyāyenāṅgakāla eva [362] parityājyaḥ, pradhānavirodhenāṅgam api parityājyaṃ kim aṅga guṇam api |
ata evopavased ity anuvadaty āpastambaḥ |
yad ahar na dṛśyate tad ahar amāvāsyāyāṃ śvo na draṣṭāra iti veti |
saṃpūrṇāyām amāvāsyāyāṃ tatropavāsaḥ, anyasyāṃ tu pūrvadine upavāsaḥ, candrādarśanadine yāga ity arthaḥ, anyathāṅgakālānurodhena pradhānakālabādhaprasaṅgāt |
nanu “yad ahaḥ pañcāc candramā abhyudeti tad ahar yajanta" iti candradarśane ’pi yāgaṃ darśayati |
ucyate | iyaṃ śrutiḥ candrodayadine yāgam āha, ma candradarśanadine| tathāpi candrodayāt prāg eva yāga ity āha śrutiḥ, “tad enam adbhyaḥ auṣadhībhyaḥ sambhṛtyāhutibhyo ’dhijanāṃ janayatīti" | uditaṃ ca janā na tasminn ahani paśyanti kiṃ tu dvitīya eveti | ataḥ khaṇḍatithāv api tathaiva yaṣṭavyaṃ anyathā śrutivirodhaḥ | yad api "sa eva āhutibhyo jātaḥ paścād dadṛśe” ityādiśāstrābhiprāyeṇaiva | atha vā pratipady āhutibhyo jātaḥ paścād dvitīyadine dadṛśa ity arthaḥ, ata eva smṛtikārāś ca śvaś candradarśanadine yāgakaraṇad ity ata āhuḥ |
anvādhānaṃ caturdaśyāṃ parataḥ somadarśanād iti |
tathā |
yajanīye ’hni somaś ced vāruṇyāṃ diśi dṛṣyate |
tatra vyāhṛtibhir hutvā daṇḍaṃ dadyād dvijātaye || iti ||
tasmāc candradarśanadine sarvathā yāgo na karttavyaḥ, candradarśane yāganiṣedhenaiva pratipaccaturthāṃśe nivṛtte tasmin niṣedho gurutvakhyāpanārthaḥ | etena “trimuhūrtā dvitīyā ceti vākyam anvādhānotkarṣavidhāyakam iti nirastam |
[363]        kiṃ ca anvādhānotkarṣāvidhāne caturdaśyāṃ somadarśanāc caturdaśītaḥ paratra dine anvādhānam iti vyavahitasambandhadvayaṃ prasajyate bhavaduktadoṣaprasaṅgāc ca | yadi pratipadyāparāhṇiko trimuhūrttā dvitīyā tadā caturdaśyām anvādhānaṃ kartavyaṃ parataḥ pratipadi trimuhūrttadvitīyāyāṃ somadarśanād ity arthe svīkriyamāṇe anvādhānāpakarṣavidhāne ’pi doṣābhāvāt | na hy atra pratipacchabdasya vā dvitīyāśabdasya vā somadarśanād ity anena sambandhaḥ yena vākyabhedavipariṇāmavyavahitakalpanāḥ bhaveyuḥ parata ity anenaiva tallābhābhāvāt caturdaśyām anvādhānaṃ parataḥ somadarśanād ity ukte caturdaśīparataḥ tithigrahaṇe prāpte amāvāsyāyāḥ pratipadi candradarśanāsambhavāt tu dvitīyā gṛhyate tasyā api caturdaśīparatvāt tadatikrameṇa tithyantaragrahaṇe pramāṇābhāvāc ca | na dvitīyāmātre somadarśanaṃ caturdaśyām anvādhāne hetus trimuhūrttagrahaṇavirodhāt tasmāc caturdaśyām anvādhānaṃ, paratas trimuhūrttadvitīyāyāṃ somadarśanād ity arthe svīkriyamāṇe doṣābhāvāt pratīyamānānvayanirvāhād aṅgakālānurodhena pradhānakālabādhābhāvāc cānvādhānāpakarṣavidhānam eva yuktaṃ |
kiṃ ca candradarśanadine yāge svīkriyamāṇe bahuvākyavirodho ’pi prasajyeta cārāyaṇīyagṛhyapariśiṣṭāt |
yāvat pūrvasya hīnatvaṃ yāvan nāstamitodayaḥ |
aupavastaṃ ca yāgaṃ ca tāvad vidur iti śruteḥ ||
yāvat pūrvasya paurṇamāsīcandramaso hīnatvaṃ na bhavati tāvad aupavastaṃ kāryam ity arthaḥ | yāvac cāmāsyāyāṃ candramaso ’staṃgatasya pratipady udayo na bhavati tāvad yāgakāla ity arthaḥ |
[364]        pūrṇe śaśiny aupavastaṃ yāgaṃ ca samasaptake |
parvāṇy astaṃgate kuryāt yāgaṃ candrārkasammite ||
iti pūrvkta evārtho ’nena vākyena spaṣṭīkriyate, paurṇamāsyāṃ pūrṇe candramasi aupavastākhyaṃ vrataṃ kāryaṃ tadantaraṃ candrārkayoḥ samasaptake pratipadi yāgaḥ kāryaḥ ity arthaḥ |
udito yadi vā hīno dṛśyate yadi candramāḥ |
pratipatsu na kāryaḥ syāt viśvedevāḥ parāṅmukhāḥ ||
udito darśapratipadi hīnaḥ paurṇamāsīpratipadi candramā dṛṣyate tadā yāgo na kartavyaḥ yataḥ sarve devās tatra parāṅmukhā bhavanti |
tathā |
purā tu sūryāstamayād (?) dvitīyā yadi dṛśyate |
yāgas tatra na dṛśyeta viśvedevāḥ parāṅmukhāḥ ||
asyāpavādaḥ |
niśāyāṃ prathame bhāge dṛṣyate pūrṇatā tathā |
tadvyatyayo divā nāsti tatra yāgaḥ pare ’hani ||
rātres tu prathame bhāge na dṛśyet pūrṇatā tathā |
hīnodito divā yatra tatreṣṭyā yāgam ādiśet ||
atra kecid āhuḥ | pratipadi somadarśane satīṣṭer akaraṇaṃ vaikalpikaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ, yadi hi prātaḥ pratipattṛtīyāṃśe labhyamāne ’pi somadarśanenaiva darśayāgaḥ pratiṣidhyate tadā |
yajanīye ’hni somaś ced vāruṇyāṃ yadi dṛṣyate |
tatra vyāhṛtibhir hutvā daṇḍaṃ dadyād dvijātaye ||
[365]        iti kātyāyanavacanam asaṃgatārtham eva syāt | "trimuhūrttā dvitīyā ced" ity anena caturdaśyām anvādhānaṃ vidhāya pañcadaśyām arthād vihite yāge kṛte dvitīye ’hani pratipadi yajanīye ’hani somaś ced ity ucyamānam asaṃgataṃ syāt | tasyāhno yajanīyatvābhāvāt tatpūrvāhṇasya tadā yajanīyatvāt "tatra vyāhṛtibhir hutvā daṇḍaṃ dadyād dvijātaye” iti yāgābhāve vyāhṛtihomo daṇḍadakṣiṇādānaṃ vidhīyamānam api ākasmikatvād asaṃgataṃ, somadarśanena tu pākṣike yāgapratiṣedhe ’bhyupagamyamāne candradarśane ’pi sati yady anenaiva vacanena vyāhṛtihomadaṇḍadakṣiṇādānasahito yāgo vidhīyate tadaivamarthavan nānyathā |
tad ayuktaṃ | tathā hi kim ayaṃ prāyaścittavidhir nimittavidhir vā | ādye ’pi kiṃ yajanīyadine candradarśane prāyaścittam, uta candradarśane prāyaścittam, uta candradarśanadine yāge na tāvat prathamaḥ kalpaḥ, yo hy ajñānāc candradarśanadine yāgaṃ anutiṣṭhati tasya pañcāc candradarśane prāyaścittavidhāyakatvenāsyopapatteḥ śrautasmārtaniṣedhapākṣikatvāpādanasāmarthyābhāvāt | kiṃ ca prāyaścittaṃ vihitaniṣiddhātikrame bhavati, tatra yadi yajanīyadine candradarśane prāyaścittam idaṃ bhavet tarhi tanniṣedhakalpanā prasajyeta yadi candradarśanadine yāge idaṃ vidhīyeta | uta candradarśanadine yāge nimitte prāyaścittaṃ bhavet tadā tanniṣedhasya śrutatvān na kācit kalpaneti tatraivedaṃ prāyaścittam | nāpi dvitīyaḥ niṣedhapākṣikatvābhāvaprasaṅgāt | nimittavidhitvena kiṃ yajanīyadine candradarśananimittam idaṃ vidhīyate uta candradarśanadine yāge nimitte iti | nobhau pūrvoktadoṣāt | dvitīyapakṣe yajanīyadine candradarśananimittatvapratītir api bādhyate | tasmāc candradarśanadinayāganiṣedho na pākṣika [366] iti |
atra kecid āhuḥ | sarvadā pratipady eva yāgo na dvitīyāviddhapratipadi yāgaḥ, nāpi parvacaturthāṃśe yāga iti |
yad āha kātyāyanaḥ |
pakṣādāv eva kurvīta sadā pakṣādikarma yat |
pūrvāhṇa eva kurvanti viddhe ’thānye manīṣiṇaḥ | iti ||
anye grahaṇaṃ vikalpasūcanārthaṃ anye na kurvantīty arthaḥ, yathā vaṣāḍ ity eke samāmananti vauṣaḍ ity eke iti |
tad apy ayuktaṃ | pūrvāhṇasandhinimittapūrvadinayāgavidhāyakaparvacaturthāṃśa-yāgavidhāyakadvitīyāviddhapratipanniṣedhacandradarśanadinayāganibandhananindāvacana-bahutaraśrautasmārtavacanasaṃkocaprasaṅgāt anekadoṣaduṣṭavikalpaprasaṅgāc ca | na cātra vidhivibhaktir asti, ācāramātropadeśāt | na cedṛśasya spaṣṭavidhivibhakter yuktaṃ bahutaravākyārthavikalpāpādane sāmarthyam, tasmād etad vākyam 'amanīṣiṇa' ity akārapraśleṣeṇa vyākhyeyam | tasmād uktaiva vyavasthā yuktā |
atha baudhāthanasūtranibandhakārāḥ kecid aparāhṇagate ’pi parvasandhau pūrvedyur upoṣya tadahar yāgānuṣṭhānaṃ vadanti | tatrāpy aparāhṇa eva sandhisamīpe yāgam icchanti |
tad anupapannaṃ, prātar yajadhvam iti mantraliṅgavirodhāt |
nanu prātar yajamāne ’pi sandhau yajeteti virudhyate |
naiṣa doṣaḥ | sandhiśāstrasya sāmīpyaparatvāt sāmīpyasya cāpekṣikatvāt prātaḥkālo ’nyāpekṣayā samīpa iti vaktuṃ śakyata iti na sandhiśāstravirodhaḥ, aparāhṇaṃ tu na kathaṃcit prātar iti vaktuṃ śakyata iti aparāhṇayāgānuṣṭhāne bhavati prātaḥkālavirodha iti na tatra yaṣṭuṃ yujyate |
nanu yāvatsandhir atisāmīpyaṃ bhavati tāvat sandhiśāstram anugṛhṇātīty aparāhṇagatasandhau [367] tatsamīpa eva yāgāpekṣā|
hanta rātrigate ’pi parvasandhau tatraivānuṣṭhānaṃ prāpyate |
atha pūrvedyur agniṃ gṛhṇāty uttaram ahar devatā yajata ity aharvidhānād rātres tu sākṣādvidhānābhāvāt sandhisamīpasya kathaṃcid ahany apy upapatter na rātrau yāgānuṣṭhānam iti |
hantāparāhṇagate ’pi sandhau tatra yāge ’nuṣṭhīyamāne prātarvidhivirodhād aparāhṇasya sākṣādvidhānābhāvāt sandhisāmīpyasya prātar apy upapatter nāparāhṇe yāgānuṣṭhānaṃ |
atha sandhau yajeteti pratyakṣavidhitvāt prātar yajadhvam iti māntravarṇiko ’spaṣṭavidhir durbalaḥ |
atrottaram ahardevatā yajata ity api varttamānāpadeśatvenāspaṣṭavidhitvāt durbalatvam aviśiṣṭaṃ |
athocyate | virodhe sati balābalaṃ cinyate rātrigatasya sandher ahar api samīpaṃ bhavati iti sandhiśāstrasya sāmīpyaparasyāhaḥśāstreṇāvirodhaḥ |
hanta tata eva hetoḥ prātaḥśāstreṇāpy avirodhaḥ |
kiṃ ca sandhiśāstrasya sāmīpyaṃ na mukhyo ’rthaḥ, kiṃ tu lākṣaṇika iti, tatrāpy aviśiṣṭam aspaṣṭatvam | na ca prātarvidher aprakaraṇādhīnatvaṃ doṣaḥ, aprakaraṇādhīnam api smārtadakṣiṇācārādikaṃ prakaraṇādhīnāc chrautāt pratyāsattyapekṣakāt prayogaśāstrād balīya ity ukaṃ śiṣṭākopādhikaraṇe | tasmāc coditadeśakālādyabādhena yāvat sāmīpyaṃ sambhavati tāvad eva gṛhṇāti | anyathā sāmīpyalobhena prātaḥkālabādhe kriyamāṇe sarvāṅgāntarabādho ’pi prasajyate | tasmāt sandhisamīpavartini parvacaturthāṃśādicoditakālānurodhini prātaḥkāle yaṣṭavyam |
nanu "na sāyam asti devayāgāya juṣṭam" iti sāyaṃkāle yāganiṣedhād avaśiṣṭo ’parāhṇādir abhyanujñāto gamyate viśeṣaniṣedhasya śeṣābhyanujñāparatvāt yathā vāmena [368] cakṣuṣā paśyatīty ukte dakṣiṇena na paśyatīti gamyate |
bhaved evaṃ yady ayaṃ nibedhaḥ syān na tv ayaṃ niṣedhaḥ ekasminn eva vākye prātaḥkālavidhiḥ sāyaṃkālaniṣedha ity ubhayaparatve vākyabhedaprasaṅgād avaśyam eko vidhir itaro nityānuvāda ity abhyupagantavyam | tatra yadi sāyaṃkālaniṣedho ’bhyupagamyate tadā pāriśeṣyāt prātaraparāhṇādikālaḥ sarvo ’pi yāgārthaḥ pākṣikaḥ prāpnoti iti na prātaḥkālasya nityavad yāgasambandhānuvāda upapadyate |
atha vā yadi prātaḥkālavidhir abhyupagamyate tadā tadvyatiriktānāṃ sarvakālānāṃ nityam eva nivṛttatvāt sāyaṃkālanivṛttir api nityānuvādaḥ |
kiṃ ca "prātar yajadhvam" iti praiṣarūpatvāt praiṣasya ca pravarttanātmakatvād vidhikalpanam eva suśakaṃ, na sāyam astīti tu varttamānāpadeśatvena pravarttanāleśaḥ pratītir api nāstīti nedaṃ niṣedhavidhānaṃ niṣedhasya spaṣṭam anavagateḥ prāgudāhṛtaprātaḥpūrvāhṇe yāgapratipādakabahuvacanavirodhaprasaṅgāt |
nanu yadā prātaḥ parvacaturthāṃśo ’sti tadaivaṃ bhavatu, yadā tu tasyābhāvaḥ tadā kiṃ prātaḥkālo bādhyeta uta parvacaturthāṃśa iti kathaṃ nirṇayaḥ |
ucyate | aparāhṇe yāge kriyamāṇe pūvāhṇaprātaḥkālatantraprakramakālā bādhyeran, prātas tu kriyamāṇe parvacaturthāṃśamātrabādhaḥ iti bādhalāghavāya sa eva yuktaḥ | tasmād aparāhṇagate ’pi parvasandhau paredyur eva yāga iti siddham | madhyāhnasandhau tu tadahar eva yāgaḥ prāgudāhṛtalaugākṣyādivacanāt |
atra kecid āhuḥ |
pratipady apraviṣṭāyāṃ yadi tv iṣṭiḥ samāpyate |
[369]        punaḥ praṇīya kṛtsneṣṭiṃ tataḥ kuryāc ca nānyathā |
iti gargavacanena pañcadaśyām iṣṭisamāptau punar yāgavidhānāt dvitīye ’hany eva yāgo yuktaḥ | madhyāhnasandhiśāstraṃ tu kṣayagāminyāṃ tithau uttaradine yāgakālābhāve “pratipady apraviṣṭāyām" ity anena saha vikalpanād upapadyate, vṛddhigāminyāṃ tu parato yāgakālasya saṃbhave madhyāhnaśāstraṃ na pravarttata eva "pakṣādayo ’bhiyaṣṭavyā iti niyamaś ca bādhyate" |
tad ayukaṃ | “trimuhūrttā dvitīyā ced" ityādibahuvākyavirodhāt | vikalpasyāpy anyāyyatvāc ca | tasmād etadvākyaparyālocanayā prātaḥkāle samāptivarjaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtvā viramya pratipadi praviṣṭāyāṃ brāhmaṇabhojanam antyapadārthasamāptiś ca kartavyā |
atra kecid vivadante | sāṅgasya pradhānasya pūrvāhṇe eva kartavyatvād brāhmaṇatarpaṇasya cāṅgatvād viramya vyāpāre cāṅgapradhānavatyāṃ bhāvanāyāṃ vidhinā pravartitatvāt tadvirodhaḥ | vārttikakāraiś ca yāvajjīvādhikaraṇe paurṇamāsyatiriktāharvyavacchedaparā śrutiḥ | "avyāptāv api tadvat syān na tv ihaivaṃ pratīyata" ity etatślokavyākhyāne uktaṃ, yadi tatrālpatvāt karmaṇaḥ pūrvāhṇacodanāvaśena paurṇamāsī na vyāpyate na kiṃcid duṣyatīti vadadbhir iṣṭisamāptir api pūrvāhṇe darśitā | tasmāt paurṇamāsyāṃ sadyaskālatvapakṣāṅgīkāre “pūrvāṃ paurṇamāsīṃ uttarāṃ vopavased iti pūrvopavāsapakṣe sadyaskālatā nāstīty etadartham idaṃ vacanaṃ, yāvatā dvitīyadine pratipadaḥ pūrvāhṇasya ca vidyamānatvāt punaḥkaraṇaṃ yuktam iti |
tad ayukam | “pratipady apraviṣṭāyām" itivākyasaṃkocaprayaṅgāt prayogavacanākṣiptāṅgapradhānaikakālasya vacanavaśena heyatvāt na tadvaśena [370] saṃkoco yuktaḥ “sandhim abhito yajeta" iti śrutivirodhāc ca | sā hi sandher ubhayato yāgaprayogo yathā bhavati tathā yaveteti pratipādayati | tathāparāhṇādiparvasandhau tadacaḥ prātaranvādhāca pareṣuryāge ’nuṣṭhīyamāne sandhigarbhatā bhavaty evety avirodhaḥ | pūrvāhṇaparvasandhau tu pūrvedyur anvādhāya tadahaḥsandheḥ pratyak samāptau sandhigarbhatvaṃ hīyate tenottamaḥ padārthaḥ samāptiśabdavācyo brāhmaṇatarpaṇātmakaḥ kevalaṃ sandher ūrdhvaṃ utkraṣṭayaḥ, tāvatā prayoge sandhigarbhatā setsyati na tu madhye virāmaḥ kasmāt sandhigarbhaśāstravaśād iti brūmaḥ |
nanu sandhigarbhatvam utkṛṣyamāṇam api sarvam utkṛṣyate prayoganairantaryārtham |         tan na, prātaḥkālabādhaprasaṅgān nairantaryaṃ hi prayogavacanenārthād ākṣipyamāṇaṃ spaṣṭacoditakālādipadārthavirodhe durbalaṃ tadevaṃvidhodāharaṇe prātaḥkāle samāptivarjaṃ nirvartya viramya sandhiparyantaṃ pratīkṣya sandher upari pratipatkāle samāptipadārtha eva kevalaḥ karttavyaḥ tasmān madhyāhnasandhau paredyur yāga iti | pūrvāhṇaparvasandhāv api tadahar eva yāgaḥ cārāṇīygṛhyapariśiṣṭāt |
viprakarṣe pare yāgaḥ saṃnikarṣe pare tathā |
śokakṛd vaḥ samākhyāto munibhis tattvadarśibhiḥ ||
ṣaṣṭhāṣṭe ’pi ca yāgaḥ syāt tathā dvirdvādaśe ’pi ca |
sūryācandramasoḥ pūrvaṃ pūrvāhṇe saṃnikarṣataḥ ||
ṣaṣṭhāṣṭe paurṇamāsyāṃ, dvirdvādaśe tv amāvāsyāyāṃ, sūryācandramasoḥ parasparaṃ pūrvāhṇe yadā saṃnikarṣaḥ tadā yāgaḥ karttavya iti vākyārthaḥ |
tathā |
āgatāṃ tithim utkṛṣya tithiśeṣaṃ tu yoyajet |
[371]        vṛthā yajñam upāsīta na hi bhasmani hūyate ||
“pratipady apraviṣṭāyām" ity uktaparihāraṃ |
atra kecid āhuḥ | grīṣmakāle ’hnām atidīrghatvāt kiṃcidadhike ṣoḍaśaghaṭike āvartanaṃ bhavati tatra tithihrāse sati kadācic caturdaśaghaṭikaḥ parvacaturthāṃśaḥ tatrāvartanasamīpe pūrvāhṇe parvasandhir yadi bhavati tadā sarvodayasamīpe tantropakamakāle parvacaturthāṃśābhāve ’pi pradhānayāgāvasare prātaḥkāle vidyamānatvāt tatraiva yāgaḥ na paredyuḥ prātaḥ pratipaccaturthāṃśe “na yaṣṭavyaṃ caturthāṃśa" iti niṣedhāt | yatra hi pradhānayāgāṅgabhūtaviśiṣṭakālavirodho bhavati tatrāṅgaguṇavirodhanyāyenāṅgakāla-parityāgasyaiva yuktatvād ato ’tra na paredyur yāgaḥ | yadā tv asminn eva viṣaye paredyuḥ prātaḥ pratipattṛtīyāṃśaḥ tadāpi na tatra yāgaḥ “trimuhūrttā dvitīyā ced" ityādiśāstrāc candradarśanadine yāganiṣedhakabahuvacanavirodhāc ca, tasmād uktaviṣaye pūrvadina eva yāga iti | yad api vacanāntaraṃ |
ṣoḍaśe 'hany abhīṣṭeṣṭir madhyā pañcadaśe ’hani |
caturdaśī jaghanyeṣṭiḥ pāpā saptadaśe ’hani || iti |
tena saptadaśe ’hani iṣṭiṃ na kuryān na tv ādadhīteti |
nanv ādhānam eva niṣidhyate na yāgaḥ, tathātve (?) tithivṛddhāv iṣṭer ananuṣṭhānam eva syāt | ato yajanīyād ārabhya saptadaśe ’hani aupavasathaṃ karma na kāryam ity avagantavyam |
ata eva baudhāyanaḥ | "ata eva svasvasthānāni caturdaśī ṣoḍaśī na tu trayodaśī saptadaśīti" |
[372]        tathā ca vacanāntare |
yatraupavasathaṃ karma yajanīyāt trayodaśe |
bhavet saptadaśe vāpi tat prayatnena varjayet || iti |
nanu ca dinadvayasya kṣayavṛddhyor asambhavāt trayodaśe ’hani saptadaśe vā kadācid aupavasathaṃ karma na kāryam iti kathaṃ niṣedhaḥ |
ucyate yady aprāptis tarhi nāntarikṣe na divītivann ityānuvāda iti |
nanu ṣoḍaśyām upavasathe kriyamāṇe “pakṣānte upavastavyā" iti vacanaṃ virudhyate pañcadaśadinātmako hi pakṣaḥ tatra prāktanayajanīyadinād ārabhya pañcadaśabhiḥ pakṣe gate ṣoḍaśīyam atiricyate | atha vā prāktanayajanīyoparitanadinād ārabhya pakṣaḥ kriyate tarhi prāktanayajanīyāt pakṣāditvaṃ hīyate |
ucyate | pañcadaśabhis tithibhiḥ pakṣo bhavati, na tu pañcadaśabhir dinair jyotirvidāṃ smaraṇāt tathā ca tithayaḥ kadācic caturdaśasu dineṣu samāpyate pañcadaśasu ṣoḍaśasu vā tāvat smaraṇāt pañcadaśaiva tatra pakṣādiśabdena pratipad ucyate pakṣāntaśabdena pañcadaśī tithiḥ tasmāc choḍaśādidinagatāyām api tasyām evopavasathaḥ kriyata iti | yad vāsya vacanasya pūrvārdham amāvāsyāyām uttarārdhaṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ veditavyaṃ paurṇamāsyādisadyaskālapakṣasyāpi vidyamānatvāt | pratipady aupavasathaṃ karma yāgaś ca tatrāyaṃ saptadaśīti niṣedha ucyate |
uktam |
same pañcadaśī yājyā māse yājyā tu ṣoḍaśī |
ūne vāpy adhike vāpi nejyā saptadaśī kvacit ||
atha kālamātrasya viśeṣavacanair eva bādhyatvāt kṣayavṛddhivacanam anyaviṣayaṃ |
[373]        kṣayavṛddhī na jānīte tithīnāṃ candramaṇḍale |
yātudhānaḥ sa vijñeyo yathā bhasmani hūyate ||
ity asya kṣayavṛddhijñānavidher ayam upayoga uttaradinakṣayavṛddhyor ardhayoḥ
pūrvadinapraveśanam iti |
tathā ca smṛtyantare |
titheḥ parasyā ghaṭikās tu yāḥ syur
nyūnās tathaivābhyadhikās tu tāsām |
ardhaṃ viyojyaṃ ca tathā prayojyaṃ
hrāse ca vṛddhau prathame dine tat || iti |
‘parasyās titheḥ’ pratipadaḥ, yā ghaṭikāḥ pūrvasyās tither nyūnā adhikā vā samānād ūrdhvaṃ pūrvasmin dine hrāse ’sya viyojyaṃ vṛddhau ca saṃyojyam ity arthaḥ | tad anena parvasandhijñānaṃ kāryam ity uktaṃ bhavati | paurṇamāsyāṃ tv āpastambenokto viśeṣaḥ |
yaḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ tv ānvadhānaparistaraṇopavāsāḥ sadyo vā sadyaskālāyāṃ sarvaṃ kriyata iti |
asyārthaḥ sadyaskālāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ agnyanvādhānādīni sadyaḥ tapaḥsamāne ’hani kriyante pūrvedyur vā tatra sarvaṃ brāhmaṇatarpaṇāntaṃ kriyate tena tad ekam iti | uktaṃ ca bhāṣyārthasaṃgrahakāreṇa |
anvāhitiṣv āstaraṇopavāsau
pūrvedyur etat khalu paurṇamāsyām |
āvarttanāt prāk yadi parvasandhiḥ
sadyas tadā vā kriyate samastam |
[374]        'āvarttanāt prāk' saṅgavād ūrddhvam iti śeṣaḥ |
sandhiś cet saṅgavād ūrddhvaṃ prāk paryāvarttanād raveḥ |
sā paurṇamāsī vijñeyā sadyaskālavidhau tithiḥ ||
iti kātyāyanasmaraṇāt |
etac ca sadyaskālatvaṃ vaikalpikaṃ “sadyas tadā vā kriyate samatam" iti
vacanāt |
tathā ca āpastambaḥ |
kharvikāṃ tṛtīyāṃ vājasaneyinaḥ samāmananti |
'kharvikāṃ' alpikām iti yāvat | alpatvaṃ ca dinād ūrddhvavyāpitvābhāvāt |
uktaṃ ca gṛhyārthasaṃgrahakāreṇa |
madhyandināt syād ahanīha yasmin
prāk parvaṇaḥ sandhir iyaṃ tṛtīyā |
sā kharvikā vājasaneyimanyā
tasyām upoṣyātha paredyur iṣṭiḥ || iti |
kecit “paurṇamāsyām" ityādi “sadyo vā" ityetadantam ekaṃ sūtram | aparaṃ tu "sadyaskālāyāṃ sarvaṃ kriyata" iti vadanti, tathā sarvasyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ agnyanvādhānādīni sadyaḥ pūrvedyur vā kriyanta iti pūrvasūtrasyārthaḥ (?), dvitīyasya tu sadyaskālā vikṛtis tasyāṃ sarvaṃ brāhmaṇatarpayāntaṃ kriyate neḍāntādikam iti |
naitad yuktam | aparāhṇasaṇdhau sadyaskālapakṣe “sandhim abhito yajetetiśrutivirodhāt |
vidhiratnakṛtāpy uktaṃ |
[375]        prakṛteś ca na kadācit sadyaskāśatvam | iti |
yathāha |
prakṛter anyathābhāvaṃ na praśaṃsanti paṇḍitāḥ |
sadyo vā sarvam ity etad vikṛtyartham udāhṛtam || iti |
tad ayuktaṃ prakaraṇabādhaprasaṅgāt |
evaṃ prakṛtāv uktaṃ, vikṛtau tu yady api 'darśapūrṇamāsāv iṣṭīnāṃ prakṛtir ity anena darśapaurṇamāsikavidhyantātideśāt tatrāpi sa eva caturthāṃśādilakṣaṇaḥ kāla iti pratibhāti, tathāpi “yadīṣṭyā yadi paśunā fyadi somena yajeta, amāvāsyāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vā yajetety āpastambena vikṛtau punaḥ kālavidhānāt pañcadaśyām eva yāgasamāptir ato yatra saṃpūrṇaiva pañcadaśī pratipac ca tatra pañcadaśyām eva vikṛtiṃ samāpyānantaraṃ prakṛter agnyanvādhānādi | khaṇḍatithau tu yadā pūrvāhṇe parvasandhis tadā pūrvedyur upadiṣṭakālāsambhavāt sambhave ’pi karmopakramadaśāyām asambhavena sāṅgapradhānanyāyitvāsambhavāt "sahāṅgaiḥ pradhānaṃ deśe kāle karttari nirdiśyata" ity āpastambena sāṅgasyaiva vihitakālasambandhavidhānād uttaredyur api prakṛteḥ pūrvoktatvāt "apūrvam ante syād" ity āpastambenaiva vikṛteḥ pūrvaṃ prakṛtividhānāt tadanantaram evātideśike pratipadādyabhāgatraye 'ṅgapradhānaparyāpte vikṛtyanuṣṭhānam ity avagantavyam | yadā tv aparāhṇe rātrau yā parvasandhis tadā tadahar eva yāgaḥ tatraivopadiṣṭakālasambhavāt| etat sarvam abhisandhāyoktam |
āvarttanāt prāg yadi parvasandhiḥ
kṛtvā tu tasmin prakṛtiṃ vikṛtyāḥ |
[376]        tadaiva yāgaḥ parato yadi syāt
tasmin vikṛtyāḥ prakṛteḥ paredyur iti ||
atra kecid āhuḥ |
agrāhyāḥ ṣaṇmuhūrttāḥ syur yasyāṃ vṛddhiḥ pare ’hani |
trimuhūrttam api grāhyaṃ yasyāṃ hrāsaḥ pare ’hani |
trimuhūrttaṃ na kartavyaṃ hīnaṃ tatrāpi nirdiśet || iti |
sandhiś cet saṅgavād ūrddhvaṃ prāk paryāvartanād raveḥ |
sā paurṇamāsī vijñeyā sadyaskālavidhau tithiḥ ||
ity anenaiva smṛtivacanenāgrayaṇādivikṛtitithiṣu sadyaskālatvena vihitāsu dvitīyadine pratipadvṛddhau pūrvadine sadyaskālatvaṃ nāstīti |
tathā |
trimuhūrttā dvitīyā cet pratipady āparāhṇikī |
anvādhānaṃ caturdaśyāṃ parataḥ somadarśanāt ||
ity asmin vacane pradarśito yāganiṣedhaḥ pratipadi tithivṛddhau nāstīty alpatve “aparāhṇe trimuhūrttaṃ grāhyam eva" iti vacanadvayasyābhiprāya iti |
atrocyate | yat tāvad uktaṃ “sandhiś cet saṅgavād ūrdhvam" iti vacanaṃ vikṛtiviṣayam iti |
tad ayuktaṃ | idaṃ hi vacanaṃ darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇapaṭhitaṃ vā anārabhyādhītaṃ vā ubhayathāpi vikṛtiniveśo na sambhavati | na ca vikṛtiviśeṣaprakaraṇapāṭhaḥ sarvavikṛtiviṣayatvam aṅgīkurvatā svīkriyate vidyate vā | na ca sarvavikṛtipāṭhaḥ sambhavati, tena prakṛtiviṣayam etat | na ca tatrāpi sadyaskālatvāpavādaḥ sambhavati, tadabhāve kiṃ pratipadi yāgas tasmin parvaṇi vā, na prathamaḥ evaṃvidhaviṣaye [377] dvitīyadine pratipadddhāv api trimuhūrttādhikadvitīyāsadbhāvena “trimuhūrttā dvitīyā ced" ityādivacanavirodhāt, na vājasaneyimatābhiprāyam idaṃ “trimuhūrttaṃ na karttavyam" iti vacanasya madhyāhnāt prāk parvasandhau pratipadvṛddhau tatra yāgo na kartavyaḥ kiṃ tv anvādhānam evety etadarthapratipādakatvābhāvāt | atha pratipadi trimuhūrttā dvitīyā cety asyaitadvaśena hrāsaviṣayety anena saṃkoca iti nirastam | “agrāhyāḥ ṣaṇmuhūrttāḥ syur" ity api vacanaṃ naitadarthapratipādakaṃ, tasmād evam idaṃ vacanadvayaṃ vyākhyeyaṃ ṣaṇmuhūrttam api yadā caturdaśīdinasambandhi anvādhānena grāhyaṃ yadi dvitīyadine varddhate hrāse tad api grāhyam | anyathā “trimuhūrttā dvitīyā ca" iti vākye candradarśanasāṅganiṣedhavākyavirodhaḥ | evaṃ "trimuhūrtthaṃ na kartavyam" iti vacanāntarāvirodhenānvādhānaviṣayam eva vyākhyeyam |
apare tv ādyaṃ vacanaṃ parvavyatiriktaviṣayam ity āhuḥ | kiṃ bahunā bahuvākyavirodhān na tadīyā vyākhyā yujyata iti |
evaṃ paśāv api draṣṭavyaṃ, ata eva tatrāpy uktaṃ “ardhād ahno bhavati niyataḥ parvasandhiḥ parastāt kṛtvā tasminn ahani ca paśuṃ sadya eva dvyahaṃ vā ārabhyātha prakṛtir atha cet parvasandhiḥ purastāt kṛtvā tasmin prakṛtim atha tu syāt paśuḥ sadya eva” iti, pūrvāhṇasandhāv uttaredyur vihitakālāsaṃbhavāt sadya evety uktam | ayaṃ ca avihitaviśeṣakālāsu vikṛtiṣu paśuṣu ca nirṇayḥ, yatra kālaviśeṣo dvyahakālavaṃ vā śrūyate tatra tathaivānuṣṭhānam ity avagantavyaṃ |
āgrayaṇeṣṭyāṃ tu śrutau viśeṣo darśitaḥ |
[378]        yasmin kāle amāvāsyā sampadyeta tayeṣṭyāthaitayā yajeta yadi paurṇamāsī syāt tayeṣṭyātha pūrṇamāsena yajeteti |
yasmin kāla ity āvartanāt pūrvaṃ, 'tayety amāvāsyayā, 'etayety āgrayaṇeṣṭyā, yadi paurṇamāsyāvartanāt pūrvaṃ sadyaskālā ca syāt tadā tayāgrayaṇeṣṭyātha pūrṇamāsena yajetety arthaḥ |
tad uktaṃ vārttikakṛtā |
paurṇamāsyāṃ tu pūrṇaḥ syāt dvitīye ’hni śaśikṣaye |
yajet pūrvaṃ pūrṇamāsā dūrdhvaṃ darbhena ced yajet || iti |
atrejyāśabdenāgrayaṇeṣṭiḥ |
upavastadinavarjyāni pariśiṣṭe darśitāni |
śākaṃ māṃsaṃ masūrāṃś ca caṇakān koradūṣakān |
māṣān madhuparānnāni varjayed aupavastake |
parvajñānopāyo gobhilaḥ |
adhīyīta tadvidbhyo vā parvāgamayet |
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevīyasamastaśrīkaraṇādhīśvarasakalavidyāviśārada- śrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau
pariśeṣakhaṇḍe kālanirṇaye parvasandhinirṇayaḥ |
atha navamo ’dhyāyaḥ |
atha grahaṇakālanirṇayaḥ |
tatra matsyapurāṇe |
candrasūryagrahe nādyād adyāt snātvā tu muktayoḥ |
avimuktāstaṃgatayor dṛṣṭvā snātvā pare ’hani ||
atra kecid āhuḥ | candrasūryagrahaśabdena tadyuktam ahorātraṃ lakṣyate śātātapādivacanaiś candrasūryagrahe ahorātraṃ bhojananiṣedhād iti |
tad ayuktaṃ candrasūryagrahaśabdena svasambandhakālalakṣaṇāyā evocitatvāt | vākyāntarasyāpy artho ’nenaiva pratipādyata iti ca niṣprāmāṇikaṃ mārkaṇḍeyādivākyaiś ca grahaṇakāle yāmacatuṣṭayādiṣu bhojananiṣedhāt tadupalakṣaṇatāyā api prasaṅgāt |
viṣṇur api |
candrārkoparāge nāśnīyād avimuktayor astaṃgatayor dṛṣṭvā snātvā pare 'hani |
brahmapurāṇe |
nāśnīyād atha tatkāle grastayoś candrasūryayoḥ |
muktayos tu kṛtasnānaḥ paścād bhuñjyāt svaveśmani ||
yatra tu "paścāt kuryād" iti pāṭhaḥ tatrāśanam iti vipariṇatam anuṣajyate |
viṣṇudharmottare |
candrasya yadi vā bhānor yasminn ahani bhārgava |
[380]        grahaṇaṃ tu bhavet tatra na pūrvaṃ bhojanakriyā || iti |
nācaret sagrahe caiva tathaivāstam upāgate |
yāvat syān nodayas tasya nāśnīyāt tāvad eva tu |
muktaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu bhuñjīta snātvā caiva yathāvidhi ||
'tatra' tasminn ahorātre |
śaṅkhalikhitau |
tasminn ahani nāśnīyāt grastās taṃ yāvad eva tu |
muktaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu bhuñjīta snātvā caiva yathāvidhi ||
viṣṇu-śātātapau |
ahorātraṃ tu nāśnīyāt candrasūryagrahe sadā |
muktaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu bhuñjīta snānaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ ||
sūryācandramasor lokān akṣayān yāti mānavaḥ |
dhautapāpo viśuddhātmā modate tatra devavat ||
nādyāt sūryagrahāt pūrvaṃ ahni sāyaṃ śaśikṣayāt |
grahakāle ca nāśnīyāt snātvāśnīyāt tu muktayoḥ ||
mukte śaśini bhuñjīta yadi na syān mahāniśā |
snātvā dṛṣṭvā pare ’hny adyād grastāstamitayos tayoḥ ||
brahmavaivarte |
ardharātrād adhaś candraṃ rāhur grasati nārada |
tadā muktau prakartavyaṃ sadbhir eva ca bhojanam ||
padmapurāṇe |
ardharātrād adhaś cordhvaṃ yadā candragraho bhavet |
[381]        pūrvaṃ pūrvatra bhoktavyam uttare cottare ’pi ca ||
'pūrvatra' pūrvājṇe, 'uttare' uttarāhṇe ’pi |
skandapurāṇe |
yadā candragrahas tāta niśīthāt parato bhavet |
bhoktavyaṃ tāta pūrvāhṇe nāparāhṇe kathaṃcana ||
pūrvaṃ niśīyād grahaṇaṃ yadā candrasya vai bhavet |
tadā divā na kartavyaṃ bhojanaṃ śikhivāhana ||
mārkaṇḍeyaḥ |
grahaṇaṃ tu bhaved indoḥ prathamād adhiyāmataḥ |
bhuñjītāvartanāt pūrvaṃ prathame prathamād adhaḥ ||
'āvartanaṃ' dinamadhyam | anena yasmin yāne grahaṇaṃ tataḥ pūrvaṃ yāmatrayaṃ tyaktvā bhuñjītety uktaṃ bhavati |
smṛtyantare |
sandhyākāle yadā rāhur grasate śaśibhāskarau |
tadā divā na bhoktayaṃ āturastrīśiśūn vinā ||
brahmavaivarte |
candrasūryagrahe nādyād ādyaṃ yāmacatuṣṭayaṃ |
kecit tritayam ity āhur munayo bhṛgunandana ||
vṛddhagautamaḥ |
sūryagrahe tu nāśnīyād ādyaṃ yāmacatuṣṭayam |
candragrahe tu yāmāṃs trīn bālavṛddhāturair vinā ||
mārkaṇḍeyaḥ |
[382]        sāyāhne grahaṇaṃ cet syād aparāhṇe na bhojanam |
aparāhṇe na madhyāhne madhyāhne na tu saṅgave |
bhuñjīta saṅgave cet syān na pūrvaṃ bhojanakriyā ||
etad bālādiviṣayaṃ asamarthaviṣayaṃ vā samarthasya tu bhojane prāyaścittam uktaṃ kātyāyanasmṛtau ṣaṭtriṃśanmate ca |
candrasūryagrahe bhuktvā prājāpatyena śudhyati |
tasminn eva dine bhuktvā trirātreṇaiva śudhyati ||
smṛtyantare |
sāyāhne saṅgave ’śnīyāc chārade saṅgavād adhaḥ |
madhyāhne parato ’śnīyān nopavāso ravigrahe ||
'śārade' aparāhṇa ity arthaḥ, yad aparāhṇaṃ śarad iti śruteḥ, 'ravigraha' iti śaśigrahasyāpy upalakṣaṇaṃ, etac ca putravadgṛhasthaviṣayam |
tathā ca jaiminiḥ |
āditye ’hani saṃkrāntau grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ |
pāraṇaṃ copavāsaṃ ca na kuryāt putravān gṛhī || iti |
smṛtyantare |
āditye ’hani saṃkrāntau grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ |
upavāso na kartavyo gṛhiṇā putriṇā tathā ||
nanu yadā sandhyākāle sūryagrahas tadā divā tāvad uktavākyān na bhojanaṃ nāpi rātrau, “amuktāyor astaṃgatayor dṛṣṭvā snātvā pare ’hanīti vacanāt | nāpy upavāsaḥ putravato gṛhasthasya tanniṣedhāt ataḥ sandhyākāle grahaṇe grastāstasamaye putravatā gṛhiṇā kiṃ kāryaṃ |
[383]        ucyate| tadā mārkaṇḍeyādyuktaḥ “sāyāhne grahaṇaṃ cet syād" iti pakṣa āśrāyaṇīyaḥ |
dakṣaḥ |
uṣasy uṣasi yat snānaṃ sandhyāyām udite ravau |
candrasūryoparāge ca prājāpatyena tatsamam ||
viṣṇuḥ |
ayane viṣuve caiva candrasūryagrahe tathā |
ahorātroṣitaḥ snātvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
atra kecid ahorātropoṣitaḥ pūrvasmin dine kṛtopavāsa iti vyācakṣate |
tad ayuktaṃ candrasūryagrahasambaddhāhorātraparityāgenāhorātrāntaragrahaṇe pramāṇābhāvāt |
brahmapurāṇe |
nityaṃ dvayor ayanayos tathā viṣuvator dvayoḥ |
candrārkayor grahaṇayor vyatīpāteṣu parvasu ||
ahorātroṣitaḥ snānaṃ śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ tathā japam |
yaḥ karoti prasannātmā tasya tasyākṣayaṃ ca tat ||
yamaḥ |
ayane viṣuve caiva candrasūryagrahe tathā |
kṛtopavāso yaḥ snāyāt sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
liṅgapurāṇe |
ekarātram upoṣyaivaṃ snātvā dadyāc ca śaktitaḥ |
kañcukād iva kośasya nivṛttiḥ pāpakośataḥ ||
[384]        trirātraṃ samupoṣyaivaṃ grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ |
snātvā dadyāc ca vidhivan modate brahmaṇā saha ||
mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
candre vā yadi vā sūrye dṛṣṭe rātrau mahāgrahe |
akṣayaṃ kathitaṃ puṇyaṃ tatrārke tu viśeṣataḥ ||
'dṛṣṭe' darśanayogya ity arthaḥ |
vyāsaḥ |
sūryavāre ravigrāhaḥ some somagrahas tathā |
cūḍāmaṇir iti khyātas tatrānantaphalaṃ labhet ||
vāreṣv anyeṣu yat puṇyaṃ grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ |
tat puṇyaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ grāse cūḍāmaṇau smṛtam ||
kātyāyanaḥ |
svardhunyambhaḥsamāni syuḥ sarvāṇy ambhāṃsi bhūtale |
kūpasthāny api somārkagrahaṇe nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
'svardhunī' gaṅgā |
vyāsaḥ |
sarvaṃ bhūmisamaṃ dānaṃ sarve brahmasamā dvijāḥ |
sarvaṃ gaṅgāyamaṃ toyaṃ rāhugraste divākare ||
indor lakṣaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ raver daśaguṇaṃ tataḥ |
gaṅgātoye tu saṃprāpte indoḥ koṭī raver daśa ||
gaṅgākoṭisahasrasya yat phalaṃ labhate naraḥ |
tat phalaṃ jāhnavīsnāne rāhugraste divākare |
[385]        divākareṇa śuddhasya daśasaṅkhyam udāhṛtam ||
candrasūryagrahe caiva yo ’vagāheta jāhnavīm |
sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu kimartham aṭate mahīm |
devīpurāṇe |
kārttike grahaṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ gaṅgāyamunasaṃgame |
gaṅgāyamunam ity atra “sarvo dvandvo vibhāṣayaikavad bhavatīty ekavadbhāvaḥ |
mārge tu grahaṇaṃ proktaṃ devikāyāṃ mahāmune |
pauṣe tu narmadā puṇyā māghe sannihitā śubhā ||
phālgune varuṇā puṇyā caitre caiva sarasvatī |
vaiśākhe tu mahāpuṇyā candrabhāgā saridvarā ||
jyaiṣṭhe tu kauśikī puṇyā āṣāḍe tāpikā nadī |
śrāvaṇe sindhunāmā tu tathā bhādre tu gaṇḍakī ||
āśvine śarayūḥ śreṭhā bhūyaḥpuṇyā tu narmadā |
godāvarī mahāpuṇyā candre rāhusamanvite ||
sūrye ca rāhuṇā graste tamobhūte mahāmune |
narmadātoyasaṃsparśāt kṛtakṛtyā bhavanti te ||
ye sūrye saiṃhikeyena graste revājalaṃ janāḥ |
spṛśanti cāvagāhanti na sā prakṛtimānavī ||
smṛtvā śatakratuphalaṃ dṛṣṭvā godānajaṃ phalam |
spṛṣṭvā gomedhatulyaṃ tu pītvā sautrāmaṇiṃ labhet ||
snātvā vājimaṇaṃ puṇyaṃ prāpnuyād avicārataḥ |
ravicandroparāge tu ayane cottare tathā |
[386]        evaṃ gaṅgāpi draṣṭavyā tadvad eva sarasvatī ||
śivādityaphalaṃ yac ca maṇḍale samudāhṛtam |
sagrahe maṇḍale yāte tad api prāpnuyān naraḥ ||
ūṣarāraṇyakṣetreṣu puṇyaṃ yat samudāhṛtam |

matsyapurāṇe |
gaṅgā kanakhale puṇyā prayāgaṃ puṣkaraṃ gayā |

āha ṛṣyaśṛṅgaḥ |

tenaiva sakalā pṛthvī dattā viprasya vai kare ||
viṣṇuḥ |
rāhudarśanadattaṃ hi śrāddham ācandratārakam |
puṇyaṃ ca sarvakāmīyaṃ pitṝṇām upatiṣṭhate ||
sarvasvenāpi kartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ vai rāhudarśane |
akurvāṇas tu tac chrāddhaṃ paṅke gaur iva sīdati ||
[387]        śātātapaḥ |
snānaṃ dānaṃ tapaḥ śrāddham anantaṃ rāhudarśane |
āsurī rātrir anyatra tasmāt tāṃ parivarjayet ||
devalaḥ |
yathā snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sūryasya grahaṇe divā |
somasyāpi tathā rātrau snānaṃ dānaṃ vidhīyate ||
śrāddhaṃ prakṛtya kūrmapurāṇe |
naimittikaṃ tu kartavyaṃ grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ |
bāndhavānāṃ ca maraṇe nārakī sthād ato ’nyathā |
kāmyāni caiva śrāddhāni śasyante grahaṇādiṣu |
mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
viśiṣṭe brāhmaṇe prāpte sūryendugrahaṇe 'yane |
janmarkṣagrahapīḍāsu śrāddhaṃ kurvīta cecchayā ||
atra sūryagrahaṇādikāleṣu tathā icchayā śrāddhaṃ prati sarvaśrāddhaṃ kuryād atha vā pūrvokteṣv eva kāleṣu icchayā svargādiphalakāmanayā śrāddhaṃ kuryād itīcchayety arthaḥ, na punar yadīcchati karttuṃ tarhi kuryāt na cen na kuryād iti |
śātātapaḥ |
āpady anagnau tīrthe ca candrasūryagrahe tathā |
āmaśrāddhaṃ dvijo dadyāc chūdro dadyāt sadaiva hi || iti |
kvacit ūttarārddham evaṃ padyate |
āmaśrāddhaṃ prakurvīta hemaśrāddham athāpi vā | iti |
[388]        bhaviṣyottare | |
annābhāve dvivābhāve pravāse putrajanmani |
hemaśrāddhaṃ saṃgrahe ca tathā strīśudrayor api ||
jābājiḥ |
saṃkrāntau puṇyakālas tu ṣoḍaśobhayataḥ kalāḥ |
candrasūryoparāge tu yāvad darśanagocaraḥ ||
tatra kecid āhuḥ | candrasūryoparāge tu nimittatvapratipādanāt jñānasyaiva ca nimittatvāt jñānamātre prāpte "yāvad darśanagocaraḥ” iti "rāhudarśane" ityādivacanāc cākṣuṣajñānaviṣayasyaiva nimittatvāc cākṣuṣa eva jñāne darśanapadasya mukhyatvāt tena na meṣādicchanne snānādi kartavyam iti |
tad ayukaṃ cakṣurjanitajñānaviṣayavivakṣāyām |
nekṣetodyantam ādityaṃ nāstagaṃ tu kadācana |
nopasṛṣṭaṃ na vāristhaṃ na madhyaṃ nabhasogatam ||
iti manunā gṛhasthasya grastādityadarśananiṣedhāt snānādyabhāvaprasaṅgāt tadbādhe tu sa eva doṣaḥ | na ca śāstrīyajñānavivakṣāyāṃ deśāntaragrahaṇe ’pi snānādiprasaṅga iti vācyaṃ |
sūryagraho yadā rātrau divā candragrahas tathā |
tatra snānaṃ na kurvīta dadyād dānaṃ na ca kvacit ||
iti ṣaṭtriṃśanmatanigamavacanena tatra snānādiniṣedhāt grastaṃ candraṃ sūryaṃ vānavekṣamāṇair eva śiṣṭaiḥ snānādyācaraṇāc ca |
[389]        kiṃ ca yadā cakṣurjanitajñānaviṣayatā na tadā snānādi sambhavati, yadā ca snānādi na tadā sety anupapannārthaṃ vākyaṃ syāt, yogyatāvivakṣāyāṃ abhrādicchanne ’pi snānādikaṃ kartavyaṃ svarūpayogyatāyās tatrāpi bhāvāt | vyavahitasya tu ayogyatayā na snānādiniyamo yadi tarhi ya ūrdhvaṃ na nirīkṣate tasyāpi snānādi na syāt | abhrādicchanne ’pi śiṣṭaiḥ snānādyācaraṇāc ca | tasmād yāvati kāle candrasūryoparāgaḥ śāstrāt pratītaḥ tāvān puṇyakāla ity arthaḥ | yad ārabhya cākṣuṣajñānaviṣayatvayogyatā vivakṣiteti kecit |
apare tu grastāstamayābhiprāyeṇa vyācakṣate yāvad darśanagocaraḥ tāvat  puṇyakālaḥ yadā tv astaṃgato na dṛśyate |
tan na tadā puṇyakāla iti | tathā ca grastāstamaye ca śiṣṭāḥ pūrvam eva snānādy anutiṣṭhanti nordhvam |
śivarahasye |
sūryendor grahaṇaṃ yāvat tāvat kuryāj japādikam |
na snāyān na ca bhuñjīta snātvā bhuñjīta muktayoḥ ||
śaṅkha-likhitasmṛtau tu "candrasūryagraho yāvad" iti prathamaḥ pādaḥ |
vṛddhavaśiṣṭhaḥ |
tridaśāḥ sparśasamaye tṛpyanti pitaras tathā |
manuṣyā madhyakāle tu mokṣakāle tu rākṣasāḥ ||
atra kecid āhuḥ | sparśasamaye devapitṛtṛptyabhidhānāt tatsādhanam aviśeṣāt sarvaṃ devapitṛdevatyaṃ karma kāryam iti |
tad ayukam |
snānaṃ syād uparāgādau madhye homaḥ surārcanam |
[390]        iti brahmavaivartavacanena homadevārcanayor madhye vidhānāt |
grasyamāne bhavet snānaṃ graste homo vidhīyate |
mucyamāne (?) bhaved dānaṃ mukte snānaṃ vidhīyate ||
iti vacanāc ca |
tasmād dhomadevapūjāvyatiriktaviṣayam etat |
padmapurāṇe |
upamarde lakṣaguṇaṃ grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ |
puṇyaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ madhye muktikāle tv anantakam ||
śātātapaḥ |
ayanādau sadā deyaṃ dravyam iṣṭaṃ gṛhe tu yat |
ṣaḍaśītimukhe caiva vimokṣe candrasūryayoḥ ||
vimokṣe vartamāne na tu vimuktavor ity arthaḥ, “uparāge tu tat kālam" iti vaśiṣṭhavacanāt |
ṣaṭtriṃśanmate |
sarveṣām eva varṇānāṃ sūtakaṃ rāhusūtake |
sacelaṃ tu bhavet snānaṃ sūtakānnaṃ ca varjayet ||
'sūtakānnaṃ' rāhusūtakānnaṃ, na vratimāṃ vrate na satriṇāṃ satre na rājñāṃ rājakarmaṇi kurvati śṛtam annaṃ vivarjayet |
liṅgapurāṇe |
candrasūryagrahe snāyān sūtake mṛtake ’pi ca |
asnāyī mṛtyum āpnoti snāyī pāpaṃ na vindati ||
sutake mṛtake caiva na doṣo rāhudarśane |
[391]        tāvad eva bhavec chuddhir yāvan muktir na dṛṣyate ||
dānaśrāddhādiviṣayam etat na tu snānamātraviṣayam |
grahaṇe śāvam āśaucaṃ vimukte sūtakaṃ smṛtam |
tayoḥ sampātamātreṇa upaspṛṣya kriyākramaḥ ||
iti brahmāṇḍapurāṇavacanavirodhāt snānahomadevapūjādānakriyānuṣṭhāne hi krama upapadyate | snānamātrānuṣṭhāne snānasya pūrvavākyenaiva siddher dvitīyavākyavaiyarthyaprasaṅgāc ca | bhavatpakṣe dvitīyavākayenaiva snānasiddheḥ pūrvavākyavaiyarthyaprasaṅga iti cet | na | asnātasyāniṣṭaviśeṣasambandhapratipādanārthatvāt yāvattāvacchabdānupapattiprasaṅgāc ca snātasyodāhṛtavākyair uparāgādāv eva vidhānāc ca rāhusūtake mṛtasūtakayor abhāvāc ca |
tathā ca samṛtyantare |
sūtake mṛtake caiva yadi syād rāhudarśanam |
tāvat tatsūtakaṃ nāsti yāvad rāhur na muñcati ||
skandapurāṇe |
sūtake mṛtake caiva sūtakaṃ rāhudarśane |
tāvad eva bhavet tatra yāvan muktir na dṛśyate ||
ṣaṭtriṃśanmate |
smārtakarmapariyāgo rāhor anyatra sūtake |
rāhusutakaṃ vinā anyasmin sūtaka ity arthaḥ | apare tv evaṃ vyācakṣate sūtake yaḥ smārtakarmaparityāgaḥ sa rāhusūtakaṃ vineti | kvacit tu "rāhor anyatra darśanād" iti pāṭhaḥ, bahuvākyasaṃkocaprasaṅgāc ca, tasmān na snānamātraviṣayam etat |
[392]        matsyapurāṇe |
candrasūryagrahe caiva maraṇe putrajanmani |
malamāse ’pi deyaṃ syāt dattam akṣayakārakam |
kvacit tu dattam ity atra śrāddham iti paṭhyate | atra gargaḥ |
puṇyam ājapadaṃ caiva yāmyaṃ bhāgyaṃ ca paitṛkam |
aindrāgnam agnidevatyaṃ saptaitāny analā gaṇāḥ ||
'ājapadaṃ' pūrvā bhādrapadā | yāmyaṃ' bharaṇī | 'bhāgyaṃ' pūrvaphalagunī |
paitṛkaṃ maghā | 'aindrāgnaṃ' viśākhā | 'agnidevatyaṃ kṛttikā |
ānale maṇḍale dṛṣṭaṃ grahaṇaṃ ravisomayoḥ |
rājñāṃ bhayaṅkaraṃ vidyāt prajānāṃ bahudoṣakṛt ||
ahirbudhnyaṃ tathā pauṣṇaṃ mūlamāpyaṃ ca śāṅkaram |
vāruṇaṃ sarpadaivatyaṃ vāruṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ smṛtaṃ ||
'ahirbudhnyaṃ' uttarā bhādrapadā | 'pauṣṇaṃ' revatī | 'apyaṃ' pūrvāṣāḍhā| 'śāṅkaram' ārdrā | 'vāruṇaṃ' śatatārakāḥ | 'sarvadaivatyam aśleṣā |
etasminn uparāge syān maṇḍale soma-sūryayoḥ |
durbhikṣāmayanāśas tu prajānām iti niścayaḥ ||
ṛkṣāṇām āryamādīnāṃ caturṇāṃ ca punarvasuḥ |
saumyaṃ caivāśvidaivatyaṃ vāyavyaṃ maṇḍalaṃ bhavet ||
'āryamādīni uttarāphālgunyādīni | 'saumyam' mṛgaśīrṣaḥ | 'aśvidaivatyaṃ' aśvinī |
samaraṃ sabhayaṃ caiva durbhikṣaṃ kurute cirāt |
vyādhiśastrādhikopaś ca maṇḍale ’smin upaśnute ||
[393]        jyeṣṭhā brāhmaṃ tathā maitraṃ prāgdeśaṃ vāsavaṃ tathā |
vaiṣṇavaṃ vaiśvadevaṃ ca puruhūtasya maṇḍalam ||
'brāhmaṃ' rohiṇī | 'maitram' anurādhā | 'prāgdeśam' abhijit | 'vāsavam'
dhaniṣṭhā | 'vaiṣṇavam' śravaṇaṃ | 'vaiśvadevam' uttarāṣāḍhā |
maṇḍale ’smin samutpanne grahaṇe jagatāṃ śubham |
ānandaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ vidadhāti viśeṣataḥ ||
kāśyāpas tv etāny eva maṇḍalāny uktvā,
āgneyīṃ kārayec chantiṃ śāntiṃ kuryāc ca vāruṇīṃ |
vāyavyā śāntir iṣyeta māhendrīṃ tatra kārayet ||
iti tat tad devatāyāgahomajapādikam uktavān | tasmād rājabhir lokahitārthaṃ tathā kāryaṃ | evaṃ jagato grahaṇadoṣasya śamanaṃ ca |
pratipuruṣaṃ tu yathā |
eṣāṃ tu bhāskarasthāne rāhuś candram upakramet |
karmakṣayaparikleśān prāpnuvanti ca te janāḥ ||
pitṛpakṣavināśāya sūryasthāne bhaved grahaḥ |
mātṛpakṣavināśāya candrasthāne bhaved grahaḥ ||
horāyāṃ gṛhyate yatra nakṣatre vā niśākaraḥ |
prāṇasaṃdeham āpnoti sa vā maraṇam ṛcchati ||
abhibhavati hi saiṃhikeyaś candrārkau yasya yasya janmanakṣatre |
tasyāntakādibhayaṃ vidyād ugraṃ manastāpaṃ ||
yasyeti janmanakṣatre grasete śaśibhākarau |
tajjātīnāṃ bhavet pīḍā narāḥ śāntivivarjitāḥ ||
[394]        saṅkramamanasā yeṣāṃ janmatritaye ca vāhisaṃsparśaḥ |
bahurogamṛtyujanano dānāhutayo japaś ca kartavyaḥ ||
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevīyasamastaśrīkaraṇādhīśvara-
sakalavidyāviśāradaśrīhemādriviracite
caturvargacintāmaṇau pariśeṣakhaṇḍe kālanirṇaye
grahaṇakālanirṇayaḥ |
[395]
atha daśamo ’dhyāyaḥ |
athopākarmakālanirṇayaḥ |
tatra yājñavalkyaḥ |
adhyāyānām upākarma śrāvaṇyāṃ śravaṇena tu |
hastenauṣadhibhāve vā pañcamyāṃ śrāvaṇasya tu ||
'adhyāyānāṃ' vedānāṃ, 'śrāvaṇṇyāṃ' śrāvaṇasya paurṇamāsyāṃ śravaṇena yukto ’hani vā | pañcamyāṃ hastena yuktāyām upākarma kāryam |
apare tu hastena yukte ’hani vā pañcamyāṃ veti vyācakṣate, 'oṣadhibhāve' prādurbhāve, 'śrāvaṇasyeti ca sarvaiḥ sambadhyate |
āśvalāyanaḥ |
athāto ’dhyāyopākaraṇam oṣadhīnāṃ prādurbhāve śravaṇena vā śrāvaṇasya pañcamyāṃ hastena veti |
nigamaḥ |
śrāvaṇyāṃ śrāvaṇīkarma yathāvidhi samācaret |
upākarma tu kartavyaṃ karkaṭasthe divākare |
hastena śuklapañcamyāṃ śrāvaṇyāṃ śravaṇena vā ||
kātyāyanaḥ |
athātopākarma śravaṇena śrāvaṇyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ |
baudhāyanaḥ | [396]
śrāvaṇyāṃ paurṇamāsyām āṣāḍhyāṃ copākṛtya chandāṃsy adhīyīta eteṣāṃ pakṣāṇāṃ svagṛhyānusāreṇa vyavasthā | yadā tv atra śrāvaṇe māsi oṣadhayo na prādurbhavanti grahasaṃkrāntidoṣā vā kathaṃcid vā śrāvaṇamāsātikramaḥ tadā proṣṭhapadyāṃ kāryam |
ata eva śaumakaḥ tadvārṣikam ity etad ācakṣata iti |
varṣākāle bhavaṃ 'vārṣikaṃ' |
vaśiṣṭho ’pi |
athātaḥ svādhyāyopākarma śrāvaṇyāṃ proṣṭhapadyāṃ veti |
'proṣṭhapadī' bhādrapadasya paurṇamāsī |
gobhilaḥ |
proṣṭhapadīṃ hastenopākaraṇam iti |
proṣṭhapadīṃ prāpyety arthaḥ |
manur api |
śrāvaṇyāṃ proṣṭhapadyāṃ vāpy upākṛtya yathāvidhi |
yuktaś chandāṃsy adhīyīta māsān vipro 'rdhapañcamān ||
apiśabdena bhādrapadaśravaṇahastapañcamīnām upādānam | tathā ca gṛhyapariśiṣṭakārikā |
avṛṣṭyauṣadhayas tasmin māse tu na bhavanti cet |
tadā bhādrapade māsi śravaṇena tad iṣyate || iti |
upākarmaprabhṛti sārdhāṃś caturo māṣān śuklapakṣeṣu nirantaraṃ svādhyāyam adhīyītety arthaḥ |
vaśiṣṭhaḥ |
[397]        ardhapañcamān māsān adhītyotsṛjati, pañcārdhamāsān ṣaṣṭhārddhamāsān vā |
gautamaḥ |
śrāvaṇādivārṣikaṃ proṣṭhapadīṃ copākṛtyādhīyīta chandāṃsy ardhapañcamān māsān pañca dakṣiṇāyanān vā |
hārītaḥ |
ardhapañcamān māsān adhītyotsṛjati pañcārdhaṣaṣṭhān vā |
kātyāyanaḥ |
upākṛtyodagayane tato ’dhīyīta dharmavit |
etac ca grahaṇādhyayanaṃ gṛhasthasyāpi | yad āha śaunakaḥ |
samāvṛtto brahmacārikalpena yathānyāyam itare jātīyā ye ’pīty eke |
'itare' brahmacāriṇaḥ | ata eva gṛhasthasyāpi grahaṇādhyayane ’dhikāraṃ jñāpayituṃ tatprakaraṇe ’dhyayanavidhiḥ |
kālavṛddhāv upākarmotkarṣaḥ kātyāyanena darśitaḥ |
utkarṣaḥ kālavṛddhau syād upākarmādikarmaṇi |
abhiṣekādivṛddhīnāṃ na tūtkarṣo yugādiṣu ||
yat tv anutkarṣapratipādakaṃ ṛṣyaśṛṅgavacanaṃ,
daśaharāsu notkarṣaś caturṣv api yugādiṣu |
upākarma mahāvaṣṭhyā hy etad iṣṭaṃ vṛṣād itaḥ || iti |
tac chandogaviṣayam | teṣāṃ hi kālavṛddhāv api siṃhe ’rka evopākarma |
yad āha gārgyaḥ |
siṃhe ravau tu puṣyarkṣe madhyāhne vicared bahiḥ |
chandogā militāḥ kuryur utsargaṃ sarvachandasām |
[398]        śuklapakṣe tu hastena upākarmāparāhnikam ||
etac ca grahaṇādyaduṣṭaśrāvaṇyādau kāryam |
tathā ca smṛtiḥ |
upākarma prakurvanti kramāt sāmargyajurvidaḥ |
grahasaṃkrāntyayukteṣu hastaśravaṇaparvasu ||
tathā |
saṃkrāntau grahaṇe caiva sūtake mṛtake tathā |
gaṇasnānaṃ na kurvīta nāradasya vaco yathā ||
atha ced doṣasaṃyuke parvaṇi syād upakriyā |
duḥkhaśokāmayagrastā rāṣṭre tasmin dvijātayaḥ ||
tathā |
yadi syāc chrāvaṇaṃ parva grahasaṃkrāntidūṣitam |
syād upākaraṇaṃ śuklapañcamyāṃ śrāvaṇasya tu ||
smṛtimahārṇave |
saṃkrāntir grahaṇaṃ vāpi yadi parvaṇi jāyate |
tanmāse hastayuktāyāṃ pañcamyāṃ vā tad iṣyate ||
atra kecid āhuḥ | hastayuktāyāṃ pañcamyāṃ kevalāyāṃ veti vikalpaḥ, na tv atra saṃkrāntiyuktaparvaṇo vikalpaḥ tatra doṣaśravaṇāt | na ca hastayuktāyām anyasyāṃ tithau pañcamyāṃ veti vikalpaḥ | hastayuktāyām ity asya viśeṣākāṅkṣyāṃ upāttapañcamyaivānvayāt | “yadi syāc chrāvaṇaṃ parvetyādivākyasya parvaṇo grahasaṃkrāntidoṣe pañcamīmātre upākarmavidhāyakasyāsmin pakṣe saṃkocaprasaṅgāt |
nanv evaṃ pañcamīpadasyāvṛtiḥ [399] prasajyate sā ca saṃkocād duṣṭā |
maivaṃ | hastayuktāyām ity asya viśiṣyākāṅkṣāyām avaśyabhāvini pakṣadvaye ’py adhyāhāre buddhisthasyaivādhyāhāra ity bhidhānāt tathāpi hastayuktvāsambhave kevaleti |
tad ayukaṃ | pañcamyāṃ veti pañcamyās tithyantaravikalpapratītes tadviśeṣāpekṣāyāṃ hastayuktāyām ity asya tadviṣayatāyā eva yuktatvāt | evaṃ ca pakṣadvaye ’pi buddhisthasyaivādhyāhāre saty asmin pakṣe pañcamīparva yathāśrutaṃ tu bhavatpakṣe tu hastayuktatvābhāvaviśiṣṭapañcamīparam iti viśeṣaḥ |
nanu hatayuktapañcamyāṃ proṣṭhapadyā vikalpaḥ kasmān na bhavati |
ucyate | svavākyopāttalābhe vākyāntarīyānāśrayaṇāt, evaṃ ca vikalpe sthite saṃkoco ’pi balād āpatitaḥ svīkriyate | tasmāt pañcamyā hastayuktatithyantareṇa vikalpaḥ | tatrāpi hastayuktāyā asaṃbhave kevaleti, etac ca vājasaneyiviṣayam | tathā ca smṛtimahārṇave vacanāntaram |
saṃkrāntir grahaṇaṃ vāpi paurṇamāsyāṃ yadā bhavet |
upākṛtis tu pañcamyāṃ kāryā vājasaneyibhiḥ ||
atra kecit pūrvavākyasādhāraṇyād vājasaneyipadasyopalakṣaṇatāṃ manvānāḥ taitirīyāṇām api pañcamyām upākarmecchanti |
tad ayuktam | lakṣaṇāprasaṅgāt lakṣaṇātaś copahārasya yuktatvāt | yadi ca pūrvavākyasya sādhāraṇyād atra lakṣaṇā tarhi "puroḍāśaṃ caturdhā karotīty asya sādhāraṇyād āgneyaṃ caturdhā karotīty atra lakṣaṇāprasaṅgaḥ | atra ca pañcamī tanmāsagataiva gṛhyate nānyamāsagatā aprakṛtatvāt, tasmād vājasaneyiviṣayam etat | tiṣṭhatu vājasaneyivākyaṃ tathāpi na pūrvasmād vākyāt grahasaṃkrāntidoṣe taitirīyāṇam upākarma prāpnoti | tathā hi atropākarmaṇi smṛtiṣu nānākālāvihitāḥ [400] teṣāṃ ca tattadgṛhyānusāreṇa vyavasthitavikalpāśrayaṇaṃ yuvyate | na ca taittirīyagṛhya pañcamyām upākarma śrūyate | yeṣāṃ tu gṛhye pañcamyām api śrūyate teṣām avyavasthitavikalpaprāptau yad vā prāthamyāt pañcamīsaṃbhave na kālāntaram iti vyavasthāprāptāv idaṃ vacanam upatiṣṭhate, evaṃ cāpekṣitaṃ samarpayiṣyate na tu taittirīyāṇāṃ upākarmaṇi aprāptakālavidhau, tasmād grahasaṃkrāntiduṣṭāyāṃ śrāvaṇasya paurṇamāsyāṃ taittirīyakaiḥ proṣṭhapadyām upākarma kāryam iti siddham |
atra kecid āhuḥ | parvaṇi grahaṇe ’pi caturdaśīsthe ’pi śravaṇenopākarma kāryam,
trayodaśyādito varjyaṃ dinānāṃ navakaṃ dhruvam |
māṅgalyeṣu samasteṣu grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ ||
iti vacanāt | prakārāntareṇāpi vedhaḥ smṛtyantare darśitaḥ |
dvādaśyādis tṛtīyānto vedha indugrahe smṛtaḥ |
ekādaśyādikaḥ saure caturthyantaḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
khaṇḍagrahe tayoḥ proktam ubhayatra dinadvayam ||
dinadvayam atra pūrvottaraṃ "tryahaṃ khaṇḍagrahe tayor" iti vacanāt |
tad ayukam,
nityanaimittike japye home yajñakriyāsu ca |
upākarmaṇi cotsarge grahavedho na vidyate ||
iti vacanāt | hastaśravaṇaparvāṇy audayikāni grāhyāṇi | tathā ca pariśiṣṭe |
dhaniṣṭhāpratipady uktaṃ tvāṣṭraṛkṣasamanvitam |
[401]        śrāvaṇaṃ karma kurvīran ṛgyajuḥsāmapāṭhakāḥ ||
vyāsaḥ |
śravaṇena tu yat karma uttarāṣāḍhasaṃyutam |
saṃvatsarakṛto ’dhyāyas tatkṣaṇād eva naśyati ||
dhaniṣṭhāsaṃyutaṃ kuryāc chrāvaṇaṃ karma yad bhavet |
tat karma saphalaṃ vidyād upākaraṇasaṃjñitam ||
nigamaḥ |
grahayogo guruṃ hanti saṃkrāntiḥ śiṣyaghātinī |
tapo hanty uttarāṣāḍhā upākarmaṇi vaiṣṇave |
dhaniṣṭhāmiśrite kāryam upākaraṇasaṃjñitam ||
kālikāpuraṇe |
caturdaśyāṃ samutpannāv asurau madhukaiṭabhau |
vedān svīkurvataḥ padmayones tau jahratuḥ śrutīḥ ||
hatvā tāv asurau devaḥ pātālatalavāsinau |
āhatya tāḥ śrutīs tasmai dadau lokaguruḥ svayam ||
abhūl labdhaśrutir brahmā parvaṇy audayike punaḥ |
ato bhūtayute tasmin nopākaraṇam iṣyate |
āsuraṃ varjayet kālaṃ vedāharaṇaśaṅkayā ||
bṛhatpracetāḥ |
bhaved upākṛtiḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ pūrvāhṇa eva tu |
brāhmaṇān bhojayet tatra pitṝn uddiśya devatāḥ |
bhaviṣyottare |
[402]        saṃprāpte śrāvaṇasyānte paurṇamāsyāṃ dinakṣaye |
snānaṃ kurvīta matimān śrutismṛtividhānataḥ ||
tato devān pitṝṃś caiva tarpayet paramāmbhasā |
upākarma divaivoktam ṛṣīṇāṃ caiva tarpaṇam |
kuvīta brāhmaṇaḥ śrāddhaṃ vedān uddiśya śaktitaḥ ||
atra caudayike parvaṇy upākarma taittirīyakaiḥ kāryam | etad uktaṃ bahvṛcapariśiṣṭakārikāsu |
parvaṇy audāyike kuryuḥ śrāvaṇaṃ taittirīyakāḥ |
bahvṛcāḥ śravaṇe kuryur grahasaṃkrāntivarjite || iti |
anyais tu pūrvaviddhā eva |
śrāvaṇī durganavamī tathā dūrvāṣṭamī ca yā |
pūrvaviddhā tu kartavyā śivarātrir baler dinam ||
iti vacanāt |
atra kecid āhuḥ | naitat yujyate tathā hi atra taittirīyakā eva parvaṇīti na niyantuṃ śakyante anyeṣām api caraṇānāṃ parvaṇy upākarmavidhānāt | na ca parvaṇy audayike yad upākarma taittirīyakā eva kuryur iti vākyārtho yujyate, viśiṣṭānuvāde vākyabhedaprasaṅgāt viśeṣaṇānām aprāpter anuvaditum aśakyatvāt etāvati ca viśiṣṭe karmaṇi taittirīyakāṇāṃ vidhānānupapatteḥ kartur hi karma vidhīyate na karmaṇi kartā |
kiṃ ca upākarma tatkālaś ca paurṇamāsī tayor gṛhyagrantheṣv eva vihitatvāt nātra kārikāyāṃ tadvidhānam | atra tu paurṇamāsīkālasyāṅga [403] audayikakālena sambandha uddiśyate | tatra yadi taittirīyakair audayikatvasyāparaḥ sambandha uddiśyate tadā sambandhadvayābhidhānāt bhidyate vākyam |
kiṃ ca taitirīyakāḥ kartāro ’py aṅgam eva, na cāṅgānāṃ mithaḥ sambandho ’sti | na cāruṇaikahāyanīnyāyena paścāt tato guṇānāṃ sambandha iti vācyaṃ | tatra hi aruṇaguṇaikahāyanīdravyaviśiṣṭaḥ krayo vidhīyate anantaraṃ dravyaguṇayoḥ parasparākāṅkṣatvāt samānādhikaraṇatvāt anvayo bhavati | atra punaḥ kārikāyāṃ nopākarmavidhānam | na ca parvaudayikataittirīyakathoḥ dravyaguṇatvenāpi sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ anyonyadravyākāṅkṣā ca ato havir ubhayatvavad avivakṣitārthaṃ taittirīyapadam upalakṣaṇārthaṃ bhūtvānuvādaḥ, śākhāntarādhikaraṇanyāyena ca sarvagṛhyeṣu upākarmavyavasthā, taittirīyāṇām uktaṃ parvaudayikatvam avirodhād anyair api grāhyam |
tathā ca pariśiṣṭe vihitam |
yn nāmnātaṃ svaśākhāyāṃ pārakyam avirodhi yat |
vidvadbhis tad anuṣṭheyam agnihotrādikarmavat ||
"śrāvaṇī durganavamītyādivacanasya karmaviśeṣānupādānāt hiraṇyagarbhasya pavitrāropaṇaṃ viṣayaḥ, upākarmāṅgabhūtam ābhyudayikaṃ ca śrāvaṇīkarma ceti | tasmāt taittirīyāṇām evaudayike parvaṇy upākarmety ayuktam iti |
tad ayukaṃ | yatra tv ananyagatipadaṃ tatra padavaiyarthyabhiyā viśiṣṭasyoddeśyatvaṃ yathā “aṣṭavarṣaṃ brāhmaṇam upanayītetyādiṣu, ubhayapadasya tu prāthamyenāgneyahavirārttinimittatvam iti bhramāpanodanārthatvān nānanyagatikatā | na ca vākyabhedaḥ, uddeśyaviśeṣaṇavivakṣāyāṃ hi sa [404] na tu viśiṣṭoddeśe | prapañcitaṃ caitad bhavadevena | “yo ’tra vipratipadyate taṃ prati viśiṣṭavidhyāśrayaṇena parihāro vaktavyaḥ grāhyatvāt” | api ca pūrvodāhṛtavacanair audayike parvaṇy upākarmaprāpter anuvādopapatteḥ, karmaṇy api ca kartṛvidhir upapannaḥ aprāptaviṣayatvāt vidheḥ | na ca sambandhadvayavidhānād vākyabhedaḥ, viśiṣṭavidhyāśrayaṇāt, granthakartṛbhedena paunaruktyaparihārāt anyathā sarvasmṛtyucchedāpatteḥ | evam anabhyupagame ca lakṣaṇāniṣprayojanānuvādau syātāṃ |
nanu yathā vaiśvadevena yajetety atra viśiṣṭavidhau gauravaprasaṅgāt vaiśvadevaśabdo lakṣaṇayā chatrinyāyena prakṛtayāgeṣu pravarttata iti svīkṛtam, tathā viśiṣṭavidhigauravāl lakṣaṇāpi svīkriyata iti cet | na | tatrāpi lakṣaṇāyā abhāvāt | na hi viśvedevadevatāyogād vaiśvadevaśabdapravṛttiḥ, kiṃ tu viśvadevakartṛyogāt | tathā ca taittirīyake śrūyate “yad viśvedevāḥ samayajanta tad viśvedevasya vaiśvadevatvam" iti, arthavādagataśabdapravṛttinimittatvaṃ sarvatra svīkṛtaṃ “yadājimīyus tadājyānām ājyatvam" ity evamādiṣu, yat tu lakṣaṇābhidhānaṃ tadabhyupagamād apavādena viśiṣṭavidheyatayā lakṣaṇāsvīkāre avyavasthāprasaṅgāt | kiṃ ca tatra viśiṣṭavidhau gauravaṃ karmāntarātideśakalpanā ca anuvādaś ca saprayojanaḥ | atra viśiṣṭavidhau gauravamātraṃ tadabhāve tu lakṣaṇā niṣprayojanaś cānuvāda iti vaiṣamyaṃ | viśiṣṭavidhau ca guṇānāṃ pārṣṇikasambandha upapadyate | kartuś ca karmānuṣṭhānārthaṃ kālaviśeṣākāṅkṣā vidyata eva | na cātra śākhānkarādhikaraṇanyāyaḥ, “parvaṇy audayike kuryuḥ śrāvaṇam" ity anenaivānyeṣām api prāptau taittirīyakapadavaiyarthyaprasaṅgāt | na ca taitirīyagṛhye parvaudayikatvaṃ vihitaṃ | yadi ca kālikāpurāṇe gatākhyānasādhāraṇyāt taittirīyavyatiriktānām apy [405] audadhike parvaṇy upākarma tadā bahvṛcānām api tatraivopākarma syāt vākyāntaraparyālocanayā tu teṣāṃ kālāntarāśrayaṇam ity atra samānam | kiṃ caivaṃ bahvṛcapadam apy avivakṣitaṃ syāt taittirīyapadavivakṣāyām uktadūṣaṇasya tatrāpi samānatvāt | tasmād evaṃ vyavasthā yadaikasminn eva dine karmakālavyāpi parva tadā sarveṣāṃ tatropākarma yadā tu dinadvaye ’pi karmakālavyāpi na vā tadā taittirīyāṇāṃ audayike parvaṇy upākarma anyeṣāṃ tv anyatreti |
athotsarjanakālaḥ |
tatra yājñavalkyaḥ |
pauṣamāsasya rohiṇyām aṣṭakāyām athāpi vā |
jalānte chandasāṃ kuryād utsargaṃ vidhivad bahiḥ ||
pauṣamāsasya rohiṇyāṃ kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ vā jalasaṃnidhau grāmād bahir vedānām utsarjanaṃ kuryāt yena prakāreṇopākarmaprabhṛtyadhyayanaṃ kṛtaṃ taṃ prakāram idānīṃ parityajet na tu sarvātmanety arthaḥ, ata evotsarjanānantaram āha manuḥ |
puṣye tu chandasāṃ kuryād bahir utsarjanaṃ dvijaḥ |
māghaśuklasya vā prāpte pūrvāhṇe prathame ’hani ||
śrāvaṇyāṃ yady upākarmakaraṇaṃ tadotsarjanaṃ, puṣyasya śuklapratipadi pūrvāhṇe yadā proṣṭhapadyāṃ tadā māghasyety arthaḥ, “ardhapañcamān māsān adhīyīteti" tenaivoktatvāt |
baudhāyanaḥ |
śrāvaṇyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ āṣāḍhyāṃ vopākṛtya taiṣyāṃ māthyāṃ (?) votsṛjet |

kātyāyanaḥ |
upākṛtyodagayane tato ’dhīyīta dharmavit |

brahmavaivarte |
dvādaśaiva bhavanty eṣāṃ dvija nāmāni me śṛṇu |

viṣuvaṃ ca tṛtīyaṃ ca anye dve dakṣiṇottare ||
kumbhāligohariṣu viṣṇupadaṃ vadanti
strīcāpamīnamithune ṣaḍaśītivaktram |
arkasya saumyam ayanaṃ śaśidhāmni yāmyaṃ
ṛkṣe jhaṣe viṣuvati tvajataulinoḥ syāt ||
'aliḥ' vṛścikaḥ | 'gauḥ' vṛṣabhaḥ | 'hariḥ' siṃhaḥ | 'strī' kanyā | 'cāpaṃ' dhanuḥ | 'śaśidhāmni' karkaṭake | 'yāmyaṃ' dakṣiṇāyanaṃ | 'saumyaṃ' uttarāyaṇaṃ | ‘jhaṣaḥ’ makaraḥ | 'ajaḥ' meṣaḥ | 'taulī' tulā ||
vaśiṣṭho ’pi |

'tayor madhye' makarakarkaṭayor madhye, viṣuvatī', kvacit “golamadhye tato ’parā" iti pāṭhaḥ, 'golaḥ' rāśicakram |

jyotiḥśāstre |

tathā |

nakṣatraviśeṣayogenaikaikasyāḥ sapta saṃjñāḥ kathitāḥ devīpurāṇe |
saptadhā sā tu boddhavyā ekaikaiva yathā śṛṇu |
yena prakāreṇaikaikaiva meṣādisaṃkrāntiḥ saptadhā saptaprakārā śṛṇu |

sūrye ghorā vidhau dhvāṅkṣī bhaumavāre mahodarī |
[409]        budhe mandākinī nāma mandā surapurohite ||
miśritā śukravāre syād rākṣasī ca śanaiścare |
etāḥ saṃkrāntayaḥ sapta phalam āsāṃ tathocyate ||

carair mahodarī jñeyā krūrair ṛkṣais tu rākṣasī |
miśritā caiva nirdiṣṭā miśritarkṣais tu saṃkrame ||
'dhruvāṇi' sthirāṇi trīṇy uttarāṇi rohiṇī ca | 'mṛdūni' anurādhācitrārevatīmṛgaśīrṣāṇi | 'laghūni' abhijithastāśvinīpuṣyāṇi | 'ugrāṇi' pūrvātrayaṃ bharaṇī maghā ca | 'carāṇi' punarvasuśravaṇa-dhaniṣṭhāsyātīśatabhiṣāḥ | 'krūrāṇi' tīkṣyāni tāni ca mūlajyeṣṭhārdrāśleṣāḥ | 'miśraṃ' kṛttikā viśākhā ca |
tricatuḥpañcasaptāṣṭanavadvādaśa eva ca |

mandā viprajanaiḥ śastā mandākinyas tu rājani |

mahodarī tu corāṇāṃ śauṇḍikānāṃ jayāvahā |
caṇḍālapukkasānāṃ ca ye cānye krūrakarmiṇaḥ |

'mandākinyas tu rājanīti kṣatriyasya praśastā bhavantīty arthaḥ | 'śauṇḍikānāṃ jayāvahety atra rākṣasīti draṣṭavyam | evaṃ ca yā yasya jayāvahā sa tasyāṃ bhūtāyāṃ abhyudayasādhanāni karmāṇi kuryāt | yasya yā jayāvahā tasyāṃ doṣanivṛttyarthaṃ śāntikāni kuryāt | anyam api śāntikānuṣṭhānārthaṃ viśeṣam āha |
nṛpāḥ pīḍyanti pūrvāhṇe madhyāhne tu dvijottamāḥ |
aparāhṇe tathā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāś cāstamaye raveḥ ||

ayane viṣuve caiva grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ |
ahorātroṣitaḥ snātaḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
etac ca putravadgṛhasthavyatiriktaviṣayaṃ |
āditye ’hani saṃkrāntau grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ |
upavāso na kartavyo gṛhiṇā putriṇā tathā ||
iti putriṇo gṛhasthasya tatropavāsaniṣedhāt |
brahmapurāṇe |
tulāṃ pratyāgamatsūrye viṣuve divase sati |
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradeyāni sasyāny abhinavāni vā ||
tathā |
[413]        meṣañjigamiṣau (?) sūrye śaiśiraṃ ghṛtakambalam |
apāsya deyād devebhyaḥ pūjā kāryā prayatnataḥ ||
kālikāpurāṇe |
kanakaṃ kuliśaṃ nīlaṃ padmarāgaṃ ca mauktikam |
etāni pañcaratnāni nyased devasya mūrddhani |
ratnānāṃ cāpy abhāve tu karṣaṃ karṣārdham eva ca |
suvarṇaṃ yojavitvā tu tasminn evottarāyaṇe |
vidhivac ca tathābhyarcya gavyenājyena bhūriṇā |
prakṣālya mardayitvā tu pradadyāt ghṛtakambalam ||
dattvā copaskaraṃ bhūyo brāhmaṇān yatibhiḥ saha |
sambhojya dakṣayitvā tu kalpayed anivāritam ||
'kuliśaṃ' hīrakaṃ | dakṣayitvā' dakṣiṇayā sampūjya | 'kalpayed bhojanam" iti śeṣaḥ |
upoṣya sarvam evaitat kuryād bhaktipuraḥsaram |
pañcagavyaṃ tilair yuktaṃ pītvā vai pārayet svayam ||
tilaiḥ snānaṃ prakurvīta tair evodvartanaṃ budhaḥ |
devatānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca ubhābhyāṃ tarpaṇaṃ tathā ||
'pārayet' pāraṇaṃ kuryāt | tilasnānapāraṇayor nātra kramo vivakṣitaḥ | ubhābhyām iti tādarthye caturthī |
homaṃ taiś ca prakurvīta sarvadaivottarāyaṇe |
tān vai devāya viprebhyo hāṭakena samaṃ dadet ||
yatnād eva karoty evaṃ cittaṃ śambau niveśya yaḥ |
[414]        uttarāyaṇamāśādya naraḥ kasmāt sa śocate ||
brahmapurāṇe |
śuklapakṣe tu saptamyāṃ yadā saṃkramate raviḥ |
mahājayā tadā sā vai saptamī bhāskarapriyā ||
snānaṃ dānaṃ tapo homaḥ pitṛdevādipūjanam |
sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ proktaṃ tapanena mahojasā ||
yas tv asyāṃ mānavo bhaktvā ghṛtena snāpayed ravim |
so ’śvamedhaphalaṃ prāpya tataḥ sūryapuraṃ vrajet ||
payasā snāpayed yas tu bhāskaraṃ bhaktimān naraḥ |
vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyo yāti sūryasalokatām ||
karbureṇa vimānena kiṅkiṇījālamālinā |
tejasā ravisaṃkāśaḥ kāntyātreyasamo bhavet |
sthitvā tatra ciraṃ kālaṃ rājā bhavati kiñjayaḥ ||
mayaiṣā kathitā puṇyā saptamī tripurāntaka |
yām upoṣya naro bhaktyā acalān maṅgalān labhet |
tato yāti paraṃ brahma yatra gatvā na śocati ||
saṃkrāntiviśeṣeṇa deyaviśeṣam āha viśvāmitraḥ |
meṣasaṃkramaṇe bhānau meṣadānaṃ mahāphalam |
vṛṣasaṃkramaṇe dānaṃ gavāṃ proktaṃ tathaiva ca ||
vastrānnapānadānāni mithune vihitāni tu |
ghṛtadhenupradānaṃ tu karkaṭe pariśasyate ||
bahuvarṣa patradānaṃ siṃhe ca vihitaṃ sadā |
[415]        kanyāpraveśe vastrāṇāṃ surabhīṇāṃ tathaiva ca ||
tulāpraveśe dhānyānāṃ bījānām eva cottamam |
kīṭapraveśe vastrāṇāṃ veśmanāṃ dānam eva ca ||
atra 'kīṭaḥ' vṛścikaḥ |
dhanuḥpraveśe vastrāṇāṃ yānānāṃ ca mahāphalam |
jhaṣapraveśe dārūṇāṃ dānam agnes tathaiva ca ||
kumbhapraveśe dānaṃ tu gavām ambutṛṇasya ca |
mīnapraveśe hy amlānamālyānām api cottamam ||
dānāny athaitāni mayā dvijendrāḥ
proktāni kāle tu naraḥ pradattvā |
prāpnoti kāmaṃ manasas tv abhīṣṭam
tasmāt praśaṃsanti hi kāladānam ||
skānde |
dhenuṃ tilamayīṃ rājan dadyād yaś cottarāyaṇe |
sarvān kāmān avāpnoti vindate paramaṃ sukham ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
uttare tv ayane viprā vastradānaṃ mahāphalam |
tilapūrvam anaḍvāhaṃ dattvā rogaiḥ pramucyate ||
śivarahasye |
purā makarasaṃkrāntau śaṅkaro gosave kṛte |
tilān utpādayāmāsa tṛptaye sarvadehināṃ ||
tasmāt tasyāṃ tilaiḥ snānaṃ kāryaṃ codvartanaṃ budhaiḥ |
[416]        devatānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca sodakais tarpaṇaṃ tilaiḥ ||
tilā deyāś ca viprebhyaḥ sarvadaivottarāyaṇe |
tilāṃś ca bhaṣayet puṇyān hotavyāś ca tathā tilāḥ ||
tasyāṃ tithau tilair hutvā ye ’rcayanti dvijottamān |
tridive te virājante gosahasrapradāyinaḥ ||
tilatailena dīpāś ca deyāḥ śivagṛhe śubhāḥ |
satilais taṇḍulair devaṃ pūjayed vidhivad dvijaḥ ||
ghṛtābhiṣekaṃ vā kuryān mahāpuṇyaphalepsayā |
ghṛtapūrṇena bhāṇḍena sāvitreṇa tv aharniśam ||
gavyenājyena vā śambhoḥ pradadyāt ghṛtakambalam |
sarpiṣā rūpakaṃ ramyaṃ kṛtvā śreyo ’bhivṛddhaye ||
iyaṃ ca saṃkrāntir atisūkṣmakālāḥ |
tathā ca devīpurāṇe |
etat sthūlavibhāgaṃ tu muktikāmasya kīrtitam |
paramārthena yā saṃkhyā kathayāmi nṛpottama ||
svasthe nare sukhāsīne yāvat syandati locanam |
tasyāṃ triṃśattamo bhāgas tatparaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||
tatparāc chatabhāgas tu truṭir ity abhidhīyate |
truṭeḥ sahasrabhāgārdhaṃ tat kālaṃ ravisaṃgrahe ||
tatkāle tu dravībhūtaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram |
atra brahmāpi saṃdigdhaṃ uvāca surasattamaḥ ||
dānādhyayanajapyādi vispaṣṭaṃ vahnihomataḥ |
[417]        vasor dhārāsu labhyeta anyathā tat kathaṃcana ||
ataś cāsyām atisūkṣmāyāṃ karmānuṣṭhānaṃ na śakyata iti saṃnihitakālo grāhyaḥ, sa ca kiyān grāhya ity apekṣāyām āha vasiṣṭhaḥ |
saṃkrāntisamayaḥ sūkṣmo durjñeyaḥ piśitekṣaṇaiḥ |
tadyogāc cāpy adhaś cordhvaṃ triṃśannāḍyaḥ pavitritāḥ ||
adhaś ca triṃśannāḍyaḥ ūrdhvaṃ ca triṃśannāḍyaḥ puṇyakālaḥ | yad vā triṃśannāḍyaḥ pūrvaṃ pañcadaśa paścāt pañcadaśeti jñeyam | evaṃ hi sati vakṣyamāṇadevīpurāṇavacanena saha saṃvādo bhavati |
jābālaḥ |
saṃkrāntau puṇyakālas tu śoḍaśobhayataḥ kalāḥ |
atra 'kalāḥ' nāḍyaḥ bahuvākyānurodhāt |
marīciḥ |
nāḍyaḥ ṣoḍaśa pūrveṇa saṃkrāter apareṇa yāḥ |
rāhor darśanamātreṇa puṇyakālaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
śātātapaḥ |
arvākṣoḍaśa vijñeyā nāḍyaḥ paścāc ca ṣoḍaśa |
kālaḥ puṇyo ’rkasaṃkrānter vidvadbhiḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||
atra kecid āhuḥ ubhayataḥ ṣoḍaśaghaṭikāpuṇyatvavacanaṃ viṣṇupadīviṣayam "puṇyakālo viṣṇupadyāḥ prāk paścād api ṣoḍaśa” iti skandapurāṇavacanāt |
tad ayukaṃ |
ayanādau sadā deyaṃ dravyam iṣṭaṃ graheṣu yat |
ṣaḍaśītimukhe caiva vimokṣe candrasūryayoḥ ||
[418]        itivacanādau ṣaḍaśītyāṃ ca dānaṃ vidhāya paramasūkṣmatvāt dānādhikaraṇatvānupapatteḥ kālaviśeṣākaṅkṣāyāṃ śātātapenoktam "arvāk ṣoḍaśa vijñeyā" iti |
tasmād asya vacanasya tadanuguṇaṃ sarvasaṃkrāntiviṣayatvam eva yujyate na punar anupāttaviṣṇupadīmātraviṣayatvam iti | “puṇyakālo viṣṇupadyā" iti vākyasya gatir vakṣyate |
anye tv āhuḥ “arvāk ṣoḍaśa vijñeyā" iti vacanaṃ viṣṇupadīṣaḍaśītiviṣayaṃ | tad uktaṃ vaśiṣṭhena |
ṣaḍaśītyāṃ vyatītāyāṃ ṣaṣṭir uktās tu nāḍikāḥ |
puṇyākhyā viṣṇupadyāś ca prākpaścād api ṣoḍaśa ||
atra caśabdāt ṣaḍaśītyām api prāk paścād api ṣoḍaśeti gamyate iti | etad api pūrvam eva nirākṛtaṃ devīpurāṇe |
atītānāgato bhogo nāḍyaḥ pañcadaśa smṛtāḥ ||
saṃkrāntau nimitte vihitasya snānadānāder niṣiddhasya vādhyayanādeḥ pālanaṃ bhogaḥ “bhuj pālanābhyavahārayor" iti smaraṇāt |
sāṃnidhyaṃ tu bhavet tatra grahāṇāṃ saṃkrame raveḥ |
vyavahāro bhavel loke candrasūryopalakṣitaḥ |
kālo vikalate sarvaṃ brahmādyaṃ sacarācaram ||
kālaśabdasaṃkhyānayoḥ kāle saṃkrāntiprāpte 'vikalate' vigataśabdaṃ bhavatīty arthaḥ |
puṇyapāpavibhāgena phalaṃ devī prayacchati |
'devī' saṃkrāntikālasvarūpā durgā, etad eva saṃkrāntyupakrame ’bhihitaṃ |
[419]        samādhana-ṛtumāsapakṣāhādikrameṇa tu |
sthūlasukṣmāvibhāgena devī sarvagatā vibho ||
saṃkrāntyadhyāyasamāptāv apy uktam |
devī kālagatā vātsa yathā sūkṣmā prakīrtitā |
sādhakī sarvakāmānāṃ mahābhayavināśinī || iti |
ekadhāpi kṛtaṃ tasmin koṭikoṭiguṇaṃ bhavet |
dharmād vivardhate hy āyūr ājyaṃ putrasukhādayaḥ |
adharmād vyādhiśokādi viṣuvāyanasaṃnidhau ||
saṃnidhāv api vacanenāyane viṣuve ca saṃnidhau phalaviśeṣo darśitaḥ |
tathā |
ayaneṣu vikalpo yas tan me nigadataḥ śṛṇu |
yāvad viṃśatkalā bhuktāḥ tat puṇyaṃ tūttarāyaṇe |
niraṃśe bhāskare duṣṭe dinānte dakṣiṇāyane ||
