'ayaneṣu vikalpa' ity asyāyam arthaḥ yā ayane divā saṃkrāntau pūrvāparavibhāgena sāmānyataḥ prāptāḥ pañcadaśa nāḍyaḥ yat tu rātrisaṃkrāntau praharadvayaṃ tatra viṃśatināḍyo ’dhikāḥ sambandhanīyāḥ, tenārdharātrāt prāk paścād vā saṃkrame dinadvayaṃ puṇyam iti | yad vā yā ayane pūrvāparavibhāgena pañcadaśa tāsyetā viṃśannāḍyo vibhajya yojyāḥ, tathātrobhayataḥ pañcaviṃśatināḍyaḥ puṣṇā ityukaṃ bhavati | athavā pūrvāstevada
ubhayato dadaśādhikā puṇyā ity arthaḥ |
anye tv evaṃ vyācakṣate viṃśatitamā kalā saṃkrāntikṣaṇād ūrdhvaṃ yāvad bhavati tāvat puṇyaṃ |
anye tv evaṃ vyācakṣate yāvad ity anvayaṃ [420] sākalyavidhipariṇāmeṣu vartate, yāvatyo viṃśatighaṭikāḥ puṇyakālasāpyayane bhuktā ghaṭikās tāvad adhikaṃ tat puṇyam uttarāyaṇa iti vikalpo viśeṣaḥ, niraṃśe aṃśakaśūnye saṃkrāntikāle bhāskaro ’ṃśakarahito bhavati, dinānte dakṣiṇāyane udagayanaṃ devānāṃ divasaḥ, tataś ca dakṣiṇāyanam iti svarūpānuvādaḥ |
brahmavaivarte |
viṣuve ṣaṇmuhūrttaṃ syāc chaḍaśītimukhe trayam |
tathā viṣṇupade trīṇi puṇyāni kavayo viduḥ ||
iti marīcyādivākyeṣu yad alpakālapratipādanaṃ tat puṇyātiśayapratipādanārthaṃ na tu niyamārtham iti draṣṭavyam |
ata eva śātātapaḥ |
yā yāḥ saṃnihitā nāḍyas tās tāḥ puṇyatamāḥ smṛtāḥ |
jyotiḥśāstre |
madhye viṣuvati dānaṃ viṣṇupade dakṣiṇāyane cādau |
ṣaḍaśītimukhe ’tīte tathodagayane ca bhūriphalaṃ ||
atra madhyaśabdena saṃkrāntipratyāsannapūrvāparakālagrahaṇaṃ saṃkrāntimadhyamakālasyātisūkṣmatvāt |
baudhāyanaḥ |
bhaviṣaty ayane viṣṇau vartamāne tathā viṣau |
ṣaḍaśītimukhe ’tīte atīte cottarāyaṇe ||
vaśiṣṭhaḥ |
madhyaṃ tu viṣuve puṇyaṃ prāk viṣṇor dakṣiṇāyane |
[421]        ṣaḍaśītimukhe ’tīte atīte cottarāyaṇe ||
laugākṣiḥ |
yāmyāyane viṣṇupade tathādau
dānādyanantaṃ viṣuve tu madhyaṃ |
vadanty atīte ṣaḍaśītivaktre
maharṣayaḥ khalv ayane ca saumye ||
“ṣaḍaśītimukhe ’tīte vṛtte ca viṣuvadvaye | kvacitpāṭhaḥ “atīte viṣuvadvaya" iti |
“bhaviṣyaty ayane puṇyam atīte cottarāyaṇe” | atra caśabdād bhaviṣyaty api puṇyaṃ vijñeyam |
brahmavaivarte |
triṃśat karkaṭake nāḍyo makare tu daśādhikāḥ |
bhaviṣyaty ayane puṇyā atīte cottarāyaṇe ||
atra caśabdād uttarāyaṇe paścād api catvāriṃśadghaṭikāḥ puṇyā iti darśitam |
madhye dānaṃ viṣuvati dakṣiṇe vaiṣyave purā |
ṣaḍaśītimukhe ’tīte vyatīte cottarāyaṇe |
ity eṣa nirṇayo dāne saṃkrāntau havaneṣu ca ||
vaśiṣṭhaḥ |
atītānāgate puṇye dve tūdagdakṣiṇāyane |
uparāge tu tat kālam atīte cottarāyaṇe ||
anāgate ’pi puṇyatvaprāptyarthaṃ “atīte cottarāyaṇe” ity uktam, [422] udagdakṣiṇāyanayor atītānāgatayoḥ puṇyam ity uktaṃ tat kiyati kāla ity apekṣāyām āha |
triṃśat karkaṭake nāḍyo makare viṃśatiḥ smṛtāḥ |
vartamāne tulāmeṣe nāḍyas tūbhayato daśa ||
skandapurāṇe |
yugānteṣu tu ṣaḍ vipra ṣaḍaśītimukhe tathā |
kulīre viṃśad evādyā makare triṃśad uttarāḥ ||
vasiṣṭhaḥ |
ṣaḍaśītyāṃ vyatītāyāṃ ṣaṣṭir uktās tu nāḍaikāḥ |
puṇyākhyā viṣṇupadyāś ca paścād api ca ṣoḍaśa ||
kvacit tu “ṣaṣṭibhuktās tt nāḍikā" iti pāṭhaḥ | tatra ṣaḍaśītimukhīnāṃ saṃkrāntīnāṃ catasṛṇām ekaikasyāḥ pañcadaśa pañcadaśeti | tena puṇyākhyāḥ ṣaṣṭināḍyo bhavanti |
etadvākyaparyālocanayā kecid vadanti
atītānāgato bhogo nāḍyaḥ pañcadaśa smṛtāḥ |
iti devīpurāṇavacanaṃ ṣaḍaśītiviṣayam iti |
tad ayuktam, devīpurāṇavacanaṃ atītānāgatabhogapratipādakaṃ idaṃ tv atītapuṇyaśeṣapratipādanārtham ity upasaṃhārānupapatteḥ | tathā ca vyotiḥśāstra uktaṃ "ṣaḍaśītimukhe ’tīte tathodagayane ca bhūriphalam" iti | api ca devīpurāṇe saṃkrāntimātradharmaprakaraṇam ekaṃ aparaṃ ca viśeṣasaṃkrāntidharmaprakaraṇam | tatra sāmānyadharmaprakaraṇe idaṃ vākyaṃ paṭhyate
atītānāgato bhogo nāḍyaḥ pañcadaśa smṛtāḥ |
iti | tatropasaṃhārapakṣe prakaraṇabādho ’pi prasajyate | tasmāc chaḍaśītimukhīṣu pratyekam atītapañcadaśaghaṭikāsu puṇyaviśeṣapratipādanārtham [423] etad iti nopasaṃhāraḥ | yadi tv ekasyāḥ ṣaṣṭināḍyaḥ puṇyā ity arthaḥ syāt tad etan mūlaśrutyantarakalpanāprasaṅgaḥ | yadā tu pratyekaṃ pañcadaśaghaṭikāsu puṇyaviśeṣapratipādanārtham etad vākayaṃ tadā na mūlaśrutyantarakalpanam,
atītānāgato bhogo nāḍyaḥ pañcadaśa smṛtāḥ |
iti vacanenātītāsv api pañcadaśaghaṭikāsu puṇyapratipādanārthaṃ "ṣaḍaśītimukhe ’tīte tathodagayane ca bhūriphasam" itivacanenātīte phalaviśeṣapratipādanāt tanmūlaśrutyaivopapattau
ṣaḍaśītimukhe ’tīte nāḍyaḥ pañcadaśa smṛtāḥ |
iti skandapurāṇavacanāt | tasmāt pūrvaiva vyākhyā jyāyasī |
baudhāyanaḥ |
puṇyaṃ viṣuvati proktaṃ daśapūrvā daśāparāḥ |
puṇyakālo ’rkasaṃkrāntau snānadānajapādiṣu ||
bṛhaspatiḥ |
bhaviṣyaty ayane puṇyās triṃśad eva tu dakṣiṇe |
atīta uttare nāḍya iti prāhuḥ purāvidaḥ ||
gautamaḥ |
arvāk ṣoḍaśa nāḍyas tu parāḥ śoḍaśa eva tu |
tāv eva dakṣiṇe pūrvam atīte cottarāyaṇe ||
sarvasaṃkrāntiṣu pūrvaṃ ṣoḍaśa nāḍyaḥ parataś ca ṣoḍaśa nāḍyaḥ puṇyāḥ tāv eva samūhau ṣoḍaśadvayalakṣaṇau dakṣiṇāyane puṇyatamau | “atīte cotarāyaṇe” cakārāt pūrvam apīty arthaḥ | kvaci ttu "tā eva dakṣiṇe pūrvam" iti pāṭhaḥ sugama eva | yad eṣu vākyeṣu pūrvāparavibhāgena saṃkrāntiviśeṣe puṇyakālapratipādanaṃ tad api puṇyātiśayapratipādanārthaṃ na niyamārtham [424] ity avagantavyam | “madhye viṣuvati dānaṃ viṣṇupade dakṣiṇāyane cādau" ityāder niyamaparatve “puṇyākhyā viṣṇupacāś ca prāk paścād api ṣoḍaśa" iti “tadyogaś cāpy adhaś cordhvaṃ triṃśannāḍyaḥ pavitritā" ityādy asaṅgataṃ syāt |
gobhilaḥ |
rātrau saṃkramaṇe bhānor divā kuryāt tu tatkriyām |
pūrvasmāt parato vāpi pratyāsatteś ca tatphalam ||
kecid etad vākyaṃ ardharātrajātaviṣuvadviṣṇupadīviṣayatayā vyācakṣate tayor evārdharātrajātathoḥ vyavasthayā dinadvayasya puṇyatvād iti |
tad ayukaṃ | ardharātrisaṃkrāntau pūrvāparadinadvayayoḥ pratyāsattau viśeṣābhāvād viṣuvadviṣṇupadīvyatiriktārdharātrisaṃkrāntau dinadvayapuṇyatvasya yatpramāṇatvaṃ tatpramāṇatvāc ca | tasmāt pūrvāparakālabhāvisarvasaṃkrāntiviṣayam etat “pratyāsatteś ca tatphalam" iti vacanāt |
gārgyaḥ |
kāle nyūne ’rdharātrau tu yadā saṃkramaṇaṃ bhavet |
tad ahaḥ puṇyam icchanti gārgyagālava gotamāḥ ||
devīpurāṇe |
ardharātre asaṃpūrṇe divā puṇyam anāgatam |
saṃpūrṇe ardharātre tu udaye ’stamaye ’pi ca ||
mānārdhaṃ bhāskare puṇyaṃ apūrṇe sarvarīdale |
saṃpūrṇe ubhayor deyam atireke pare ’hani ||
na āgatam 'anāgataṃ', saṃkrāntikālena napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ, aprāpte saṃkrāntikāla iti yāvat | 'udayaḥ’prātaḥsaṃdhyā | 'astamayaḥ' sāyaṃsaṃdhyā | [425] 'mānārdham' praharadvayaṃ, 'bhāskaraḥ' divasaḥ, bhāskaropalakṣitatvāt bhāsaṃ karotīti vyutpatteś ca, sa apūrṇe śarvarīdale dalam ardhaṃ asaṃpūrṇa ardharātra ity arthaḥ | saṃdhyākāle rātrau ca saṃkramaṇe divasagataṃ praharadvayaṃ puṇyam ity arthaḥ | asaṃpūrṇe ardharātre ubhayoḥ pūrvottaradivasayoḥ praharadvaye deṣam ity arthaḥ | atireke ardharātrāt parataḥ saṃkramaṇe pare ’hani praharadvaye deyam ity arthaḥ | astamaye pūrvadinapraharadvayaṃ grāhyaṃ, udaye tūttaradinapraharadvayaṃ pratyāsatteḥ, kvacit tu "atīte śarvarīdale" iti paṭhyate |
anye tv evaṃ paṭhanti |
asaṃpūrṇe ’rdharātre tu udaye ’stamaye ’pi ca |
mānārdhaṃ bhāskare puṇyaṃ saṃpūrṇe śarvarīdale || iti |
atrāsaṃpūrṇe ’rdharātra ity anenaiva asaṃpūrṇe śarvarīdale ity ukam | athāpi yat punar ucyate tat puṇyasaṃbandhārthaṃ yathā divāpuṇyaṃ tathā asaṃpūrṇe ’pi śarvarīdale puṇyam ity arthaḥ |
atra kecid āhuḥ | ardharātrisaṃkramaṇe ubhayor ahnor eva saṃkrāntinimittasya snānāder naimittikasya sakṛdanuṣṭhānāt tatsamuccayaḥ, na tulyavad vikalpo dinadvaye tasyāṣṭadoṣaduṣṭatvāt tasmād vyavasthayā pūrvāhṇe pare’ hni vā snānādipuṇyavikalpo veditavyaḥ | atra vyavasthākāraṇam etad vākyam |
ṣaḍaśītimukhe ’tīte vṛtte ca viṣuvadvaye |
bhaviṣyaty ayane puṇyam atīte cottarāyaṇe ||
na tāvad etad vākyaṃ udayāstamayanyūnārdharātrasaṃkrāntiviśevaviṣayaṃ tatra praharadvayapuṇyatvasyoktatvāt | nāpi divasasaṃkrāntiviṣayaṃ
saṃkrānteḥ puṇyakālas tu ṣoḍaśobhayataḥ kalāḥ |
iti vacanavirodhāt | yadi ca [426] divase saṃkrāntau "ṣaḍaśītimukhe ’tīta" ity anvayaḥ tadā "ṣaḍaśīta ity etāvad eva vatavyaṃ kiṃ “ṣoḍaśobhayataḥ kalā" ity anena, asmin sati ṣoḍaśakalātiriktasyāpi kālasya puṇyatāprasaktir iti cet, na, rātrisaṃkrāntes tu praharadvayasa puṇyavād arthād anyatrāpi viśeṣāpekṣāyāṃ tasyaivocitatvāt tasyāḥ ṣoḍaśanāḍītulyatvād iti, tasmād ardharātre ṣaḍaśītimukhyāṃ atītāyāṃ paradine puṇyaṃ viṣuvavadvaye ca vṛtte saty aparadine puṇyam ity evaṃ dakṣiṇāyane ardharātre bhaviṣyati pūrvadinaṃ puṇyaṃ uttarāyaṇe ardharātre atīte sati paradinaṃ puṇyam iti vyavasthā | evaṃ pūrṇe ardharātre yāny ayanādīni tāni "ṣaḍaśītimukhe ’tīte" iti vākyena pūrvadinārdha uttaradinārdhe ca vyavasthāpitāni, viṣṇupadī tu vyavasthāvacanābhāvād vyavasthāṃ prati sākāṅkṣā satī anantaravākyena vyavasthāpyate |
ādau puṇyaṃ vijānīyād yady abhinnā tithir bhavet |
ardharātre vyatīpāte viśeṣam apare ’hani ||
ādāv ahani puṇyaṃ vijānīyād yady ardharātre ’bhinnā pūrvadinatithyā ekaiva tithir bhavati yadi saṃkrāntikāle tithir anyā syāt tadā ādāv ahani na puṇyam ity arthasiddhaṃ kiṃ tu paradina eveti | ardharātre vyatīte punar bhinnāyām abhinnāyāṃ vā tithau saṃkramaṇe pare ’hny eva puṇyaṃ jñeyam iti | tad ayuktaṃ, ṣaḍśītimukhe viṣṇau viṣuve cottarāyaṇe pūrvam api puṇyakālasya pratipāditatvāt | na ca viṣṇupady api vyavasthāṃ prati sākāṅkṣā, tasyāḥ api prāk puṇyatvapratipādakavacanasyodāhṛtatvāt | na ca devīpurāṇīyenaiva sākāṅkṣatvaparihāra iti niyame pramāṇam asti | na ca tāni vacanāni [427] divāsaṃkrāntiviṣayāṇi "ṣaḍaśītimukhe ’tīta" iti devīpurāṇavacanam ardharātrisaṃkrāntiviṣayam iti vyavasthāyāṃ pramāṇam asti | tasmāt ādau puṇyaṃ vijānīyād iti sarvasaṃkrāntisādhāraṇam | ataś ca pariśeṣāt divāsaṃkrāntiviṣayam etat | na ca tadiṣayatve "saṃkrānteḥ puṇyakālas tu ṣoḍaśobhayataḥ kalā" iti vacanavirodhaḥ | puṇyaviśeṣapratipādanaparatvāt, na ca divāsaṃkrāntiviṣayatve "ṣoḍaśobhayataḥ kalā" ity asya vaiyarthyaṃ, ghaṭikāviśeṣalābhārthatvāt | na ca rātrisaṃkrāntiṣu praharadvayasya puṇyatvād arthād anyatrāpi viśeṣāpekṣāyāṃ tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ, arthāl lābhe ’pi śabdataḥ pratipādanasya yuktatvāt | na ca tasmād api lābhaḥ, ṣoḍaśadvayapraharadvayayor bhedāt | etena yat kaiścid uktaṃ "ādau puṇyaṃ vijānīyād" iti vākyam ardharātrajātaviṣuvadvayaviṣayaṃ tadd hi madhye saṃpādanīyatvād vyavasthām apekṣate, viṣṇupadī tu prākpuṇyābhidhānān nirākāṅkṣeti na tadviṣayam iti tad api nirākṛtaṃ |
anye tv āhuḥ “ādau puṇyaṃ vijānīyād ity ardharātrabhavatsarvasaṃkrāntiviṣayaṃ bhavatu "ṣaḍaśītimukhe ’tīte" ity api bhavatu bādhakābhāvād iti |
tad ayukaṃ | yadottarabhāgā saṃkrāntiḥ ardharātre bhavati pūrvadinatithau kiṃcit tadā tadvacanadvayavirodhaprasaṅgāt |
ekenaiva vacanena vyavasthāsiddher na vacanad vyavastheti tasmāt “ādau puṇyaṃ vijānīyād" iti vacanam ardharātrabhavat sarvasaṃkrāntiviṣayaṃ “ṣaḍaśītimukhe ’tīta" iti tu divāsaṃkrāntiviṣayam ity anye |
tad apy ayuktaṃ, ardharātrajātayor makarakarkaṭayor dinadvayapuṇyatvābhāvasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt tadabhāve vyavasthānapekṣaṇāt na tadviṣayam etad vākyaṃ kiṃ tu makarakarkaṭasaṃkrāntivyatiriktārdharātrabhavatsaṃkrāntiviṣayam iti siddham |
[428]        vasiṣṭhaḥ |
ahni saṃkramaṇe puṇyam ahaḥ prakīrtitam |
rātrau saṃkramaṇe puṇyaṃ dinārdhaṃ snānadānayoḥ ||
ardharātrād adhas tasmin madhyāhnasyoparikriyā |
ūrdhvaṃ saṃkramaṇe cordhvaṃ udayāt praharadvayam ||
pūrṇe ced ardharātre tu yadā saṃkramate raviḥ |
prāhur dinakṣayaṃ puṇyaṃ muktvā makarakarkaṭau ||
ardharātrāt pūrvaṃ parataś ca saṃkramaṇe pūrvottaradinapraharadvayapuṇyatvavacanaṃ viṣuvanmātraviṣayaṃ na tu viṣṇupadīṣaḍītiviṣayam |
viṣṇupadyāṃ dhanurmīnanṛyukkanyāsu vai yadā |
pūrvottaragate rātrau bhānoḥ saṃkramaṇaṃ bhavet ||
pūrvāhṇe pañcanāḍyas tu puṇyāḥ proktā manīṣibhiḥ |
aparādhe tu pañcaiva śraute smārte ca karmaṇi ||
iti nigamavacanavirodhāt | nāpy ayanaviṣayaṃ tatra samagradinasya puṇyatvāt |
tathā ca yajñapārśvaḥ |
āsannasaṃkramaṃ puṇyaṃ dinārdhaṃ snānadānayoḥ |
rātrau saṃkramaṇe bhānor viṣuvaty ayane dinam ||
yatra tu “viṣuvaty ayame dina" iti pāṭhaḥ tatrāyam arthaḥ dine rātrau vā saṃkramaṇe viṣuvadayanayor dinārdhaṃ puṇyam iti, asmin pāṭhe tv ayanaviṣayatāpi svīkriyate | yat tu keṣāṃcid vyākhyānaṃ dakṣiṇottarāyaṇayor dina eva saṃkrame sati dina eva puṇyakāla iti tat kḷṣṭatvād upekṣaṇīyam |
[429]        apare tu nigamavākyaṃ puṇyātiśayapratipādanārtham iti manyamānāḥ sarvasaṃkrāntiṣv ardharātrāt prāg ūrdhvaṃ vā jātāsu dinārdhaṃ puṇyam icchanti |
skandapurāṇe |
dhanurmīnāv atikramya kanyāṃ ca mithunaṃ tathā |
pūrvāparavibhāgena rātrau saṃkramate yadā ||
dinānte pañca nāḍyas tu tadā puṇyatamāḥ smṛtāḥ |
udaye ca tathā pañca daive pitrye ca karmaṇi ||
'uḍaye puṇyatamā' iti vacanāt paradinaṃ puṇyatamam iti manyate | “pūrve ced arddharātre tu" iti vacanaṃ kecid evaṃ vyācakṣate, ardharātre pūrṇe yadi saṃkrāntir bhavati tadā dinadvayaṃ puṇyaṃ prāhuḥ, pūrvadinaṃ āvartanād uparitanaṃ, uttaram āvartanāt pūrvaṃ, “saṃpūrvaṃ tv ardharātre tu" iti devīpurāṇavacanānurodhāt | pūrṇe ardharātre jātau makarakarkaṭau muktvā vihāya tayor dinadvayaṃ puṇyaṃ na bhavati kiṃ tu rātriḥ puṇyā, tatas tatraiva tayor bhoga ity arthaḥ | yat tv atroktaṃ kiṃcit "muktvā makarakarkaṭau" iti vacanena makarakarkaṭayor dinadvayasya puṇyatvaṃ paryudaśyate na tu rātrau puṇyatvam ucyate ekapadasyārthadvayāsaṃbhavāt, na hi bhavati devadattaṃ bhuktvā bhojanārthaṃ viprā ākārayitavyā ity ukte devadattas tu tatraiva bhojayitavya ity aparo 'rtha iti |
tad ayuktam, “muktvā makarakarkaṭau" ity asya tayor dinadvayam apuṇyam ity atra na tātparyaṃ kiṃ tu rātriḥ puṇyā ity atrānyathā tayoḥ puṇyakālapratipādanaṃ na kṛtaṃ syāt sarvasaṃkrāntīnāṃ puṇyakālapratipādanasya ca prakṛtatvāt | evaṃ dṛṣṭānte ’pi devadattaṃ muktvety asya devadattoyākārayitavvya [430] ity atra na tātparyaṃ kiṃ tu asau tathaiva bhojayitavya ity atra anyathā tasya nimantritasyāpi bhojanadānapratipādanaṃ na kṛtaṃ syāt nimantritānāṃ sarveṣāṃ bhojanadānapratipādanasya ca prakṛtatvāt | tasmād ekasya padārthadvaye tātparyābhāvān na kaścid doṣaḥ | yat tūktaṃ prāptam eva paryudasyate na ca dinadvayasya puṇyatvaṃ prāptaṃ dinārdhasyaiva puṇyatvokteḥ, tena dinaśabdena dinārdhaṃ lakṣayitavyam ity anyo ’pi doṣa iti |
tad apy ayuktam, mukhyāsaṃbhave lākṣaṇikārthaparigrahasyādoṣatvāt | na hi pratyāsanne saṃkramaṇe saty ekasyaiva dinasyārdham eva puṇyaṃ tasminn eva vyavahite tu dinadvayaṃ samagraṃ iti sambhavati | tenāyanadvaye rātrau puṇyam iti | tad ayukaṃ, “muktvā makarakarkaṭau" ity asya makarakarkaṭayoḥ rātrau puṇyam ity evaṃparatve pramāṇābhāvān makarakarkaṭavyatirekeṇa hi dinadvayaṃ puṇyām ity ukte, tayor dinadvayapuṇyatvābhāvamātraṃ sidhyati na tu rātrau puṇyatvam | tataś ca vacanāntaraparyālocanayā makare tūttaraṃ dinaṃ puṇyaṃ dināntaram iti karkaṭe ca pūrvadinam iti ekaikadinapuṇyatvapratipādakavacanavatkevalamakarakarkaṭasaṃkāntipuṇyatvapratipādaka-vacanāntarābhāvāc ca | tenāyanadvaye ardharātrasaṃkrānāv ekasminn eva dine puṇyaṃ  na tv ayanadvaya eva rātrau puṇyam iti |
tacā ca baudhāyanaḥ |
astaṃ gate yadā sūrye ṛkṣaṃ yāti divākaraḥ |
pradoṣe vārdharātre vā tadā puṇyaṃ dināntaram || iti |
atra kecid āhuḥ | asmin vacane “pradoṣe vā" ity anena vacanena yadi pradoṣajātāyā makarasaṃkrānteḥ paradine bhogaḥ pratipādyeta tadā āsannasaṃkramapuṇyaṃ [431] “dinām ardham" ityādinā yajñapārśva-vasiṣṭhavacanena “dhanurmīnāv atikramya" ityādinā skandapurāṇavacanena "asaṃpūrṇe ardharātre udaye ’stamaye ’pi ca" ityādinā devīpurāṇavākyena ca virodhaḥ prasajyeta | "astaṃ gate yadā sūrye" ityādivacane ca "astaṃ gate" ity anenaiva pradoṣārdharātrayor labdhatvāt pṛthakgrahaṇam anarthakam ity aparo doṣaḥ | tasmād etad vacanam evaṃ vyākhyeyaṃ pradoṣe vety ayaṃ vāśabdo yathārthe “vopamānavikalpayor" iti nighaṇṭusmaraṇāt | tad ayaṃ dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikayor arthaḥ yathā pradoṣe pūrvadinārdhaṃ puṇyaṃ tathārdharātre paradinaṃ puṇyam | dvitīyo ’yaṃ vāśabdas tathārthe avyayānām anekārthatvāt |
anye tv 'astaṃ gate' ity asya vaiyarthyabhiyānyathā vyācakṣate | astaṃ gate pradoṣe ca yathā pūrvadinaṃ puṇyaṃ evam ardharātre parataś ca makarasaṃkrame paraṃ dinaṃ puṇyam iti |
apare tu vacanānām ārjavaparihārāthaṃ pradoṣe makarasaṃkrāntau dinadvaye ’pi vikalpe ma puṇyam icchanti |
anye tv āhuḥ | pradoṣe makarasaṃkrāntau paradinapuṇyatvābhidhānāt "dhanurmīnāv atikramya" itivacanaṃ pradoṣavyatirikrārdharātrapūrvakālaviṣayam iti |
tad ayuktaṃ, "dhanurmīnāv atikramya⌈ iti vākyagatasya pūrvaśabdasya makarasaṃkrāntau pradoṣavyaritiktārdharātrapūrvakālaparatve saṃkrāntyantare tv ardharātrapūrvasamastakālaparatve vairūpyāpatteḥ |
anye tv āhuḥ | ardharātra ity atra atīta iti pūraṇīyaṃ "saṃpūrṇe ubhayor deyam atireke pare ’hani" ivacanāt |
tad ayukaṃ asya saṃkrāntyantaraviṣayatvāt "prāhur dinadvayaṃ puṇyaṃ muktvā makarakarkaṭau" iti vacanāt |
[432]        smṛtyantare |
kārmukaṃ tu parityajya jhaṣaṃ saṃkramate raviḥ |
pradoṣe vārdharātre vā tadā bhogaḥ pare ’hani ||
mithunāt karkasaṃkrāntir yadi syād aṃśamālinaḥ |
prabhāte vā niśīthe vā kuryād ahani pūrvataḥ ||
tenārdharātrajātayor makarakarkaṭayor dinadvaye na puṇyaṃ kiṃ tu makarasaṃkrāntau paradine karkaṭe pūrvadine puṇyam iti |
kecit saṃpūrṇe ardharātra iti vākyam ardharātrajātaviṣṇupadīviṣayatvena vyācakṣate | tanmate hi viṣṇupadyām eva vyavasthayā dinadvaye puṇyam iti |
anye tv ardharātrajātaviṣuvadviṣayatvena vyācakṣate | tanmate hi viṣuva eva vyavasthayā dinadvaye puṇyam | ata eva makarakarkaṭayoḥ parapūrvabhogasaṃkrāntyupalakṣalam iti |
tad ubhavam apy ayuktaṃ viduvadviṣṇupadīvyatirisaṃkrāntāv api vyavasthayā dinadvayapuṇyatvasya pratipāditatvāt kāraṇaṃ vinā saṃkocaprasaṃgāc ca makarakarkaṭapadayor vinā kāraṇam upalakṣaṇatvaprasaṃgāc ca darśitamārgeṇa vacanasyārjavenaivopapatteḥ |
anye tv evaṃ vyācakṣate ardharātre pūrṇe yadi saṃkrāntir bhavati tadā dinadvayaṃ puṇyaṃ adhyāpaṇādhyayanayogyaṃ prāhuḥ, 'muktvā' varjayitvā, pūrve 'rdharātre jātau makarakarkaṭau tayor dinadvayaṃ puṇyaṃ na bhavati kiṃ tv apuṇyaṃ ashāpanādhyayanāyogyam ity arthaḥ, makarakarkaṭayor dinadvaye ’nadhāya iti yāvad iti |
tathā ca smṛtiḥ |
ahni ced rātriyugmaṃ syād rātrau ced vāsaradvayam |
[433]        saṃkrāntiḥ pakṣiṇī jñeyā dānādhyayanakarmasu ||
amena vākyena makarakarkaṭayor dinadvayasyāpuṇyatvama uktaṃ, tat dānādhyayanakarmaviṣayaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ, 'dānaṃ' adhyāpanaṃ vedasya, adhyayanam api tasyaiva, yāni karmāṇi teṣu ca dānādhyayanakarmasu dinadvayaṃ puṇyaṃ veditavaṃ |
tathātrādhyāpakānāmadhyedvayāṃ ca samācāraḥ | te hi rācau makarakarkaṭayor dinadvayaṃ nādhyāpayanti nādhīyatne ca |
tad ayukaṃ prakaraṇasamāveśasambhave tadutkarṣasyānucitatvāt | niśādvayaṃ divā rātrau vā saṃkrāntau divāpuṇyapratipādakāni vākyāni darśitāni, adhunā rātripuṇyapratipādakāni vākyāni pradarśyante |
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe sumantuvākyaṃ |
rātrau snānaṃ na kurvīta dānaṃ caiva viśeṣataḥ |
naimittikaṃ ca kurvīta snānaṃ dānaṃ ca rātriṣu ||
grahaṇodvāhasaṃkrāntiyātrārttiprasaveṣu ca |
śravaṇe cetihāsasya rātrau dānaṃ praśasyate ||
viṣṇuḥ |
vivāhavratasaṃkrāntipratiṣṭhāṛtujanmasu |
tathoparāmapātādau snāne dāne niśā śubhā ||
'ṛtuḥ' garbhādhānaṃ | 'pātaḥ' vyatīpātaḥ |
gobhilaḥ |
rāhudarśanasaṃkrāntivivāhātyayavṛddhiṣu |
snānadānādikaṃ kuryur niśi kāmyavrateṣu ca ||
atra kecid āhuḥ | [434] etāni vākyāny arketarasaṃkrāntiviṣayāṇīti | ata eva gobhilenokatam |
rātrau saṃkramaṇe bhānor divā kuryāt tu tatkriyām || iti |
āsannasaṃkramaṃ puṇyaṃ dinārdhaṃ snānadānayoḥ |
rātrau saṃkramaṇe bhānor viṣuvaty ayane dinaṃ || iti ca |
rātrivākyeṣu tu grahaviśeṣanāmarahitaṃ saṃkrāntimātraṃ śrūyate tenārketarasaṃkrāntiviṣayam etad iti |
tad ayukaṃ |
putrajanmani yajñe ca tathā saṃkramaṇe raveḥ |
rāhoś ca darśane snānaṃ praśastaṃ nānyathā niśi ||
iti vaśiṣṭhavacanavirodhāt |
yac cātra jitāmitrādimataṃ rātreḥ sarvakarmānaṅgatvāt kathaṃcid divā snānādyasambhave rātrāv api pratyavāyaparihārārthaṃ saṃkrāntinimittakam avaśyaṃ snānādy anuṣṭheyam ity evaṃparāṇi rātrivākyāni |
rātrau saṃkramaṇe bhānor divā kuryāt tu tatkriyām |
iti divāgrahaṇena rātrivyudāsāt rātrisaṃkramaṇe dinārdhapuṇyatvābhidhānāc ceti |
yac cānyeṣāṃ mataṃ paramasūkṣmatamasaṃkrāntikālāntarbhāvena snānadānādikaṃ yena rātrāv api kartuṃ śakyate tasyātiśayaphalam, anantarbhūtasaṃkrāntirātris tu kālaḥ karmānaṅgam evānyathā hi rātrau saṃkramaṇe saṃnihitanāḍīparityāgena vyavasthā dinadvayasnānādividhānam anupapannaṃ praharadvayapuṇyatvavacanāc ca | etac ca kuto ’vagatam iti cet, paurāṇikād vākyād evaṃ | tathā hy uktam |
[435]        dharmād dhi vardhate hy āyūrājyaputrasukhādayaḥ |
adharmād vyādhiśokādi viṣuvāyanasaṃnidhau || iti ||
na ca paramasūkṣmeṇa saṃkrāntikālena saha kaścit kasyacit padārthasya saṃnidhānaṃ sampādayituṃ samarthaḥ, tadantarbhāvena tu kriyamāṇe karmaṇi siddhas tasya saṃnidhiḥ | ataḥ snānadānādau prayogasyāntarbhūtasaṃkrāntikālasyaikasya rātrāv anuṣṭhānam iti |
tad apy ayuktaṃ | saṃkrāntiniṣedhasyobhayataḥ ṣoḍaśanāḍikāpuṇyatvasya rātrisaṃkrāntāv apy anapāyāt |
rātrau saṃkramaṇe bhānor divā kuryāt tu tatkriyāṃ |
pūrvasmāt parato vāpi pratyāsatteś ca tatphalam ||
iti vacanasya rātrisaṃkrāntau pratyāsannadinapuṇyapratipādakasya rātrivyudāsakatvābhāvāt dinārdhavacanasyāsannadinārdhapuṇyatvapratipādakasya rātrinivartakatvābhāvāc ca |
saṃkrānteḥ puṇyakālas tu ṣoḍaśobhayataḥ kalāḥ |
atīto ’nāgato bhogo nāḍyaḥ pañcadaśa smṛtāḥ |
yā yāḥ saṃnihitā nāḍyas tās tāḥ puṇyatamāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
ityevamādīnāṃ vākyānāṃ saṃkocaprasaṅgāt | rātrau snānādipratipādakānāṃ bhaviṣyatpurāṇādivākyānāṃ vinā kāraṇena saṃkocaprasaṅgāt | tasmād rātrisaṃkrāntau rātrau divā ca puṇyaṃ pratyāsattiviśeṣāt tu phalaviśeṣa iti siddhaṃ |
apare tv āhuḥ, ayane viṣuve ca dinadvaye pañcanāḍyaḥ |
dhanurmīnāv atikramya kanyāṃ ca mithunaṃ tathā |
pūrvāparavibhāgena rātrau saṃkramate yadā ||
[436]        dinānte pañcanāḍyas tu tadā puṇyatamāḥ smṛtāḥ |
udaye ca tathā pañca daive pitrye ca karmaṇi ||
iti skandapurāṇavacanāt |
viṣṇupadyāṃ ṣaḍaśītimukhe sarvasminn api śraute smārte ca karmaṇi rātrau pratyāsannatvāt puṇyaviśeṣadinadvayapañcaghaṭikāsu puṇyamātram iti |
viṣṇupadyāṃ dhanurmīnanṛyukkanyāsu vai yadā |
pūrvottaragate rātrau bhānoḥ saṃkramaṇaṃ bhavet ||
pūrvāhṇe pañca nāḍyas tu puṇyāḥ proktā manīṣibhiḥ |
aparāhṇe tu pañcaiva śraute smārte ca karmaṇi ||
iti nigamavacanāt | yatrāniṣedhe ’pi pūrvāparanāḍīgrahaṇam aviśiṣṭaṃ saṃkrāntikālasyātisūkṣmatvāt |
viṣuvādisūkṣmatamaṃ puṇyam āha gālavaḥ |
sthirabhe viṣṇupadaṃ ṣaḍaśītimukhaṃ dvitanubhe tulāmeṣe viṣuve turye dakṣiṇāyanaṃ saumyakaṃ sūrye |
pūrvaślokair vyākhyātam etat | atha,
ayanāṃśakatulyena kālenaiva sphuṭaṃ bhavet |
mṛgakarkādige sūrye yāmyodgayane sati |
tadā saṃkrāntikālāḥ syur uktā viṣuvadādayaḥ ||
ayam arthaḥ | rāśiṃ prati triṃśadaṃśakā bhavanti sūryo ’tra pratidinam ekaikam aṃśaṃ bhuṅkte | tatra yāvadbhir aṃśair (?) ayanacyutir bhavati tāvatā sūryasya bhogyakālena bhāvinā viṣṇupadādikānāṃ cyutir bhavati tataś ca dvādaśabhir [437] aṃśair ayanacyutir bhavati tatra bhāvinyāḥ saṃkrānter dvādaśabhir dinair arvāk puṇyakālo bhavati tasmin saṃkrāntinimittaṃ dānādi karttavyam iti | evaṃ nyūnātirikte ’pi boddhavyam |
tathā ca laugākṣiḥ |
yātrāniṣedhā api sūkṣmākatve
padaṃ sthirīkartum aśaknuvantaḥ |
ālocya tat tasya tayopadiṣṭaṃ
bhavanti nityaṃ paripūrṇakāmāḥ ||
grahāntarasaṃkramasamayasyāpi puṇyatvam āha jaiminiḥ |
nakṣatrarāśau ravisaṃkrame syur
arvāk paratrāpi rasendunāḍyaḥ |
puṇyās tv athendos tridharāpalair yug
ekaiva nāḍī munibhiḥ śubhoktā ||
nāḍyaś catasraḥ sapalāḥ kujasya
budhasya tisro manavaḥ palāni |
sārdhāś catasraḥ palasaptayuktā-
guroś ca śukre sapalāś catasraḥ ||
dvināganāḍyaḥ palasaptayuktāḥ
śanaiścarasyābhihitāḥ sapuṇyāḥ |
ādyantamadhye japadānahomaṃ
kurvann avāproti narendradhāma ||
nakṣatre rāśau vā sūrvasya saṃkramaṇe sati pūrvataḥ parato ’pi 'ravendunāḍyaḥ' [438] ṣoḍaśaghaṭikās tu, puṇyakālaḥ | indos tu 'tridharāpalair yuk’ trayodaśabhiḥ palair yuktā, ekaiva ghaṭikā | 'kujasya maṅgalasya, tu ekapalayuktāś catasro ghaṭikāḥ | budhasya caturdaśapalayukāḥ tisraḥ | 'guroḥ' bṛhaspateḥ, saptatriṃśatpalayuktāś catasraḥ | śanaiścarasya palasaptakayuktāḥ 'dvināganāḍyaḥ' nāgā aṣṭau dvirāvṛttā nāgāḥ 'dvināgāḥ' |
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevīyasamastaśrīkaraṇādhīśvara-
sakalavidyāviśāradaśrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau pariśeṣakhaṇḍe kālanirṇaye saṃkrāntinirṇayaḥ |
[439]
atha dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ |
atha śrāddhakālanirṇayaḥ prārabhyate |
ādau nityaśrāddhakālanirṇayaḥ |
tatra amāvāsyānirṇayas tāvat kriyate | tathā amāvāsyāyās trayo bhedā ādiparvanirṇaye darśitāḥ | tatra sampūrṇayām amāvāsyāyāṃ aparāhṇe śrāddhaṃ kartavyam “aparāhṇaḥ pitṝṇam" iti śruteḥ |
tathā ca śātātapaḥ |
darśaśrāddhaṃ tu yat proktaṃ pārvaṇaṃ tat prakīrttitam 1
aparāhṇe pitṝṇāṃ tu tatpradānaṃ praśasyate ||
yamaḥ |
pakṣānte nirvapet tebhyo hy aparāhṇe tu paitṛkam |
yadā tu dinadvayasambandhinī tadāpi yasmin dine aparāhṇavyāpinī tathaiva śrāddham anuṣṭheyam |
tathā ca chāndogapariśiṣṭe kātyāyanaḥ |
piṇḍānvāhāryakaṃ śrāddhaṃ kṣīṇe rājani śasyate |
vāsarasya tṛtīye 'ṃśe nātisandhyāsamīpataḥ ||
'piṇḍānvāhāryakaṃ śrāddham' piṇḍapitṛyajñānantaraṃ kriyamāṇaṃ, 'kṣīṇe rājani' kṣīṇe candre amāvāsyāyām ity arthaḥ | 'vāsarasya tṛtīye 'ṃśe' tridhāvibhaktasya divasasya tṛtīyabhāge aparāhṇa ity arthaḥ | yadā ca [440] dinadvaye ’py aparāhṇavyāpinī na bhavati tadāpi pūrvadinasaṃbandhinī sinīvāly eva grāhyā | tathā ca sa evāha |
yadā caturdaśīyāmaṃ turīyam anupūrayet |
amāvāsyā kṣīyamāṇā tadaiva śrāddham iṣyate ||
'kṣīyamāṇā' aparasmin divase sarvāparāhṇavyāpinī na bhavatīty arthaḥ |
tathā ca yajñapārśvo ’pi |
ardhe caturdaśī yatra ardhe pañcadaśī bhavet |
caturdaśyavasāne tu pitṛyajñaṃ tu kārayet ||
''ardhe' divasasyottarārdhe |
vṛddhabaudhāyanaḥ |
caturdaśyāḥ caturyāme amāvāsyā ca dṛṣyate |
śvobhūte pratipady atra bhūte kavyādikā kriyā ||
tathā ca gobhilaḥ |
yaḥ paramo viprakarṣaḥ sūryācandramasoḥ sā paurṇamāsī yaḥ paraḥ saṃnikarṣaḥ sāmāvāsyā yad ahaḥ khe candramā na dṛśyate tām amāvāsyāṃ kurvīta dṛśyamāne ’py eke amāvāsyāyāṃ bhavatīti |
vyāso ’pi |
dṛṣṭacandrā sinīvālī naṣṭacandrā kuhuḥ smṛtāḥ |
sinīvālī sadā pitrye kuhūr daive tu karmaṇi ||
ataś caturdaśyante ’pi piṇḍānvāhāryakāryo nirvāpaḥ kartavya iti sthite kecid āhuḥ | naitad asti caturdaśyāṃ tan nirvāpa iti piṇḍapitṛyajñānantaraṃ hi tadvihitaṃ piṇḍapitṛyajñaś cāmāvāsyāyām aparāhṇe [441] vihitaḥ, “amāvāsyāyām aparāhṇe piṇḍapitṛyajñena carantīti" kalpasūtrakāravacanāt |
yat tu mataṃ caupavasathyadivasopalakṣaṇārtho ’māvāsyāśabda iti, tan na, lakṣaṇāyāṃ pramāṇābhāvāt vidhāvanyāyyatvāc cāsyāḥ | yā ca śrutiḥ “tasmāt pūrvedyuḥ pitṛbhyaḥ kriyate uttaram ahar devān yajante pitṛbhya evaṃ tadyajñaṃ niṣkriyaṃ yajamānaḥ pratanuta" iti | tathā agnyanvādhānaṃ prakṛtya “aparāhṇe piṇḍapitṛyajñena caranti" iti kalpasūtrakāravacanaṃ, tad etad yasminn aupavasathye ’hani aparāhṇe amāvāsyāsti tadviṣayam iti kṛtvā na pūrvadinamātraparaṃ, na tu lakṣaṇāyāṃ pramāṇaṃ bhavitum arhati |
anye tv āhuḥ candrakṣayopalakṣitadināntargatāyām amāvāsyāyām api piṇḍānvāhāryakaṃ na kartavyaṃ tasya piṇḍapitṛyajñānantaraṃ vihitatvāt | piṇḍapitṛyajñaś ca candrādarśanavatyām amāvāsyāyāṃ vihitaḥ | tathā ca śrutiḥ: "yadaivaiṣa na purastān na paścād dadṛśe 'tha tebhyo dadātīti" | sūtrakāravacanaṃ “yad ahaś candramasaṃ na paśyanti tad ahaḥ piṇḍapitṛyajñaṃ kurute" iti | na cātrādarśanaṃ kṣayopalakṣaṇaparaṃ “kṣīṇe rājanīty asyādarśane ’py anatikramāt | na ca kramo ’vivakṣitaḥ pramāṇābhāvāt | atha mataṃ yadaikasmin dine dvayaṃ tadāyaṃ kramo nānyadeti, yadā caupavasthya eva candrādarśanaṃ tadaikasmin dine dvayam anyadā piṇḍapitṛyajño yajanīyadinaṃ pratyutkṛṣyata iti |
tan na | tadādyutkarṣanyāyenānvāhāryakasyāpy utkarṣāt | yat tu laugākṣivacanam,
sinīvālī dvijaiḥ kāryā sāgnikaiḥ pitṛkarmaṇi |
strībhiḥ śūdraiḥ kuhūḥ kāryā tathā cānagnikair dvijaiḥ || iti |
[442]        tat piṣḍapitṛyajñapiṇḍānvāhāryakānyapitṛkāryaviṣayam astu |
tad etad ayuktaṃ pūrvodāhṛtavacanavirodhāt | yathoktaṃ caturdaśyante na nirvāpa iti, tad ayuktaṃ yataḥ chandogapariśiṣṭe piṇḍapitṛyajñaṃ prakṛtyāha kātyāyanaḥ |
yathoktaṃ dṛśyamāne ’pi na caturdaśyapekṣayā |
amāvāsyāṃ pratīkṣeta tadante vāpi nirvapet || iti |
yat tu dṛśyamāne ’pi candre piṇḍapitṛyajñaḥ, tad ayuktaṃ dṛṣyamānety eke ityādibhir vākyair vā na caturdaśīvivakṣayā, 'tadante' caturdaśyante | yadā tv aparadine aparāhṇavyāpinī tadā amāvāsyāṃ pratīkṣeteti dṛśyamāne ’pi candre nirvāpaḥ, tathā “yad ahaś candramasaṃ na paśyanti tad ahaḥ piṇḍapitṛyajñaṃ kuruta" ityādiśrutivirodhaḥ syād ity āśaṅkya adarśanaśrutiḥ, kṣayopalakṣaṇaṃ matvāha sa eva, yad uktaṃ "yadahaḥsv eva darśanaṃ neti candramāḥ tatkriyopalakṣaṇaṃ jñeyaṃ kṣīṇe rājanīty apīti, yac cānyat pūrvapakṣitaṃ candrodayopalakṣitadināntargatāyāṃ amāvāsyāyām api na piṇḍapitṛyajñānvāhāryaka iti tad api yayoktadṛśyamāne ’pītyādikātyāyanavacanena nirākṛtam eva, dṛśyamāneṣv ekadety anena gobhilīyavacanena ca hārītenāpi nirākṛtaṃ |
yasyāṃ sandhyāṃ gataḥ somo mṛṇāla iva dṛṣyate |
aparāhṇe kṣayas tasyāṃ piṇḍānāṃ karaṇaṃ dhruvam ||
ity atra piṇḍānām iti nirdeśaḥ piṇḍapitṛyajñaṃ nātivartitum īhate |
punaḥ kātyāyanaḥ |
yadā caturdaśīyāmaṃ turīyam anupūrayet |
[443]        amāvāsyā kṣīyamāṇā tadaiva śrāddham iṣyate || iti |
kiṃ ca yajanīyadināt pūrvadine hi piṇḍapitṛyajñaśraddhe vihite "tasmāt pitṛbhyaḥ pūrvedyuḥ kriyate” iti | yadā ca pratipaddine pūrvāhṇe ’py atha madhyāhne ’māvāsyā samāpyate tadā tad ahar eva yāga iti pūrvasyāṃ candrodayavatyāṃ piṇḍapitṛyajñādi, “sinīvālī dvijaiḥ kāryā sāgnikaiḥ pitṛkarmaṇīty asya piṇḍānvāhāryakavyatirikaviṣayatve pramāṇābhāvāc ceti | indukṣayas tu kadā bhavatīty apekṣāyāṃ sa evāha |
aṣṭame ’ṃśe caturdaśyāṃ kṣīṇo bhavati candramāḥ |
amāvāsyāṣṭame ’ṃśe tu punaḥ kila bhaved aṇuḥ || iti ||
iha khalu grahacāravido rāśitryaṃśāṃśaiḥ dvādaśabhir dvādaśabhiś candramasaḥ kṣayaḥ tadā candrāpakarṣe caikaikā tithir bhavatīti varṇayati, ataś caturdaśī vā amāvāsyā vā dvādaśāṃśo bhavati | tatra caturdaśyām aṣṭamāṃśānte candraḥ kṣīyate amāvāsyāṣṭame ’ṃśe punar aṇur bhūtvā jāyate | kilaśabdo ’tra jyautiṣikaiḥ kila tadākhyāyata ity etadartham āha |
atra śatapathaśrutiḥ |
sa eṣa saṃvatsaraḥ prajāpatiḥ ṣoḍaśakalas tasya sandhaya eva pañcadaśakalā dhruvaivāsyāḥ ṣoḍaśī kalā sa rātribhir evāpūryate yatra kṣīyate so ’māvāsyāṃ rātrim etayā ṣoḍaśyā kalayā sarvam idaṃ prāṇabhṛd anupraviśya tataḥ prātar jāyate tasmād etāṃ rātriṃ prāṇabhṛtaḥ prāṇaṃ na vicchindyād api kṛkalāsasyaitasyā eva devatāyā apacityā iti |
atrāyam āśayaḥ ṣoḍaśakalasya candrarūpasya prajāpateḥ kṛṣṇapakṣapratipadam ārabhya caturdāśyantāsu tithiṣu kramād ekaikakalākṣaye ’pi caturdaśakalāḥ [444] kṣīṇā bhavanti caturdaśītṛtīyāṃśe tu pañcadaśy api kalā kṣīyate tato ’māvāsyāyāṃ dhruvayā avinaśvarayā ṣoḍaśyā kalayā bhūlokam āgatya sarvaṃ prāṇijātaṃ praviśati amāvāsyātṛtīyāṃśe tu tathaiva ṣoḍaśyā kalayā divasam apekṣya punaḥ prādur bhavatīti |
amāvāsyāviśeṣe candrakṣayasya kālam āha kātyāyanaḥ |
āgrayāṇyamāvāsyā tathā jyeṣṭhasya yā bhavet |
viśeṣam asyā bruvate candracāravido dvijāḥ ||
atrādya eva prahare ’vatiṣṭhate
caturthabhāgo na kalāvaśiṣṭaḥ |
tadanta eva kṣayam eti candraḥ
evaṃ jyotiścakravido vadanti ||
asyārthaḥ vṛṣasthe candre jyaiṣṭhāmāvāsyā vṛcikasthe cāgrahāyaṇyamāvāsyā iti, te ca candrasya paramoccanīcasthāne, tadvaśāc candrasaya gativailakṣaṇyaṃ yad anyāsv amāvāsyāsv aṣṭame prahare svarūpaṃ tad anayor amāvāsyayoḥ prathama eva bhavatīti | ye tu candrādarśana eva piṇḍapitṛyajñādikaṃ manyante na tasya kṣaye ’pi tān nirākartuṃ kadācid dvitīyāyām api candrādarśanaṃ darśayati |
yasminn abde dvādaśaikaś ca madhye
tasmin tṛtīyāparato na dṛśyate |
evaṃ cāraṃ candramaso viditvā
kṣīṇe tasminn aparāhṇe ca dadyāt ||
asyārthaḥ | madhye māso yasminn abde dvādaśādhiko bhavati tasminn [445] abde malamāsānantaraṃ tṛtīyāyā aparasyāṃ dvitīyāyāṃ tithau candro na dṛśyate na caitāvatā candradarśanavihitaḥ piṇḍapitṛyajñas tatra kriyate | ataś candracāraṃ viditvā tasmin kṣīṇe ’pi caturdaśīmiśrāyām amāvāsyāyām aparāhṇe piṇḍapitṛyajñādikaṃ kuryād iti |
evaṃ ca yāpi śātapathī śrutiḥ |
tad vā ekatanmāsi māsy annaṃ pitṛbhyo dadāti yadaivaiṣa na purastān na paścād dadṛśe ’tha tebhyo dadāti eṣa vai somo rājā devānām annaṃ yaś candramāḥ sa etāṃ rātriṃ kṣīyate tasmin kṣīṇe dadāti tathaitebhyo ’samadaṃ karoti atha yadā kṣīṇe dadātīti |
yāni tu sinīvālīniṣedhakāni tāni niragnikaśrāddhaviṣayāṇi |
anye tv āhuḥ tāni vacanāny aparāhṇapraviṣṭacaturdaśīviddhasinīvālīviṣayāṇīti |
anenābhiprāyeṇāha vṛddhamanuḥ |
yasyām astaṃ ravir yāti pitaras tām upāsate |
tithis tebhyo yato dattā hy aparāhṇe svayambhuvā || iti ||
aparāhṇavyāpinī cet sinīvālī tadaiva sā grāhyā anyadā kuhūr eva grāhyety uktaṃ bhavati |
tad āha hārītaḥ |
aparāhṇe pitṝṇāṃ tu yāparāhṇānuyāyinī |
sā grāhyā pitṛkāryeṣu na pūrvāhṇānuyāyinī ||
yadāpy ubhayadine ’py aparāhṇasambandhas tadāpi saṃśayarūpaṃ nirṇayam āha sa eva |
[446]        saṃmiśrā yā caturdaśyā amāvāsyā bhavet kvacit |
kharvikāntāṃ viduḥ kecid upendum iti cāpare ||
yasmin dine caturdaśyāṃ satyām alpīyasy amāvāsyā bhavati sā kharvikety ucyate kharvaśabdasyālpavācitvāt | anenaiva caśabdena anupayuktatā darśitā | ataḥ kecid agrāhyety evaṃ viduḥ, apare tu upendum anuṣṭhānāya prayuktāṃ kurudhvam ity evaṃ vidur ity arthaḥ | evaṃ saṃdehe nirṇayam āha |
vardhamānām amāvāsyāṃ lakṣayed apare ’hani |
yāmāṃs trīn adhikān vāpi pitṛyajñas tadā bhavet ||
amāvāsyāvṛddhau kharvikā nānyathety arthaḥ | atha dvipakṣe tu vardhitāpi sinīvāly upeyeti | paiṭhīnasir api |
ādityasyodaye yā vā amāvāsyā vivardhate |
apareti ca vijñeyā pitṝṇāṃ dattam akṣayam ||
yā caturdaśī bhavaty aparāhṇavyāpinī amāvāsyā vardhate tasyāṃ pitṝṇāṃ dattam akṣayam ity arthaḥ |
tathā hārītaḥ |
trimuhūrtā tu kartavyā pūrvā kharvā ca bahvṛcaiḥ |
kuhūr adhvaryubhiḥ kāryā yatheṣṭaṃ sāmagītibhiḥ ||
parvaṇo ’ṃśe dvitīye tu kāryā iṣṭir dvijātibhiḥ |
dvitīyāsahitaṃ yasmād dūṣayanty āśvalāyanāḥ ||
baudhāyanaḥ |
sinīvālīm upoṣyātha kṛtveṣṭiṃ ca pare ’hani |
pitṛyajñaṃ tadā kuryuḥ svakāle taittirīyakāḥ ||
[447]        pūrvāhṇe ced amāvāsyā aparāhṇe na ced yadi |
atra ca hārītavacanaṃ |
pratipady api kartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ śrāddhavido viduḥ || iti ||
atra ca harihareṇoktam "anirjñātasthalam idaṃ vacanaṃ parasparavyāhatapadopabaddhaṃ ca" iti | tathā hi 'pūrvāhṇe ced' ity etāvat pratipaddinaviṣayaṃ, pūrvāhṇaśabdena ca divasasya tṛtīyabhāgo vā pūrvārdhaṃ vā, evaṃ ca sati sarvathā kasmiṃcid aparāhṇe na bhaved ity etan na yujyate yasmāt pratipaddine pūrvāhṇamātrāvasthitāyāś caturdaśīdine aparāhṇasambandhasyāvaśyakatvāt ṣaḍghaṭikādhikatithihrāsasyābhāvāt | atha yadi pratipaddināparāhṇasyaiva bhaved ity ucyate tarhi 'pūrvāhṇe ced' ity anarthakaṃ syād iti | tenaivaṃ vyākhyeyaṃ tithivṛddhau pratipady uktāyāṃ amāvāsyāyām eva śrāddhavidhānaṃ, tathā pitṛyajñānantaraṃ manunā vihitaṃ, piṇḍapitṛyajñaś cānaṅgatve śrutyāparāhṇe vihito nānyathā kartuṃ śakyaḥ tasya cirakālatvāt tenaiva sakalāparāhṇavyāptāv amāvāsyāśrāddhasya kā gatir ity ata uktaṃ pūrvāhṇa iti nāparāhṇe kṛtsne ity arthaḥ | evaṃ cāparāhṇavyāpinyāṃ sinīvāyām amāvāsyāyāṃ śrāddhavidhānam agnimadviṣayaṃ, anagnikānāṃ tu kutapakālavyāpinyāṃ kuhvām amāvāsyāyāṃ śrāddhavidhānam |
tathā ca laugākṣismṛtau saurapurāṇe ca |
sinīvālī dvijaiḥ kāryā sāgnikaiḥ pitṛkarmaṇi |
strībhiḥ śūdraiḥ kuhūḥ kāryā tathā cānagnikair dvijaiḥ ||
vyāso ’pi |
dṛṣṭacandrā sinīvālī kāryā viprais tu sāgnikaiḥ |
[448]        naṣṭacandrā kuhūḥ kāryā śūdrair viprair anagnikaiḥ ||
baudhāyano ’pi |
sinīvālī kuhūś caiva śrutyukte śrāddhakarmaṇi |
sāgnikais tu sinīvālī kuhūḥ kāryāpy anagnikaiḥ || iti ||
kuhūr iti kutapakālavyāpinī |
tathā ca hārītaḥ |
bhūtaviddhāpy amāvāsyā pratipanmiśritāpi vā |
pitrye karmaṇi vidvadbhiḥ kāryā kutapakālikī ||
kutapalakṣaṇaṃ tu matsyapurāṇe |
ahno muhūrttā vikhyātā daśa pañca ca sarvadā |
atrāṣṭamo muhūrtto yaḥ sa kālaḥ kutapaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
evaṃ sati dinadvayasambandhinyāṃ amāvāsyāyāṃ satyāṃ yā kutapakālavyāpinī saivānagnikair grāhyety uktaṃ bhavati |
ata eva baudhāyanaḥ |
madhyāhnāt parato yatra caturdaśyanuvartate |
sinīvālī tu sā jñeyā pitṛkārye tu niṣphalā ||
bṛhaspatir api |
madhyāhnād yā tv amāvāsyā parastāt saṃpravartate
bhūtaviddhā tu yā jñeyā na ca pañcadaśī bhavet ||
kārṣṇājinir api |
bhūtaviddhām amāvāsyāṃ mohād ajñānato ’pi vā |
śrāddhakarmaṇi ye kuryus teṣām āyuḥ prahīyate ||
[449]        yadā tu dinadvaye ’pi kutapakālavyāpinī na bhavati tadā bhūtaviddhaiva grāhyā |
tathā ca baudhāyanaḥ |
ghaṭikaikāpy amāvāsyā pratipatsu na cet tadā |
bhūtaviddhāpi kartavyā daive pitrye ca karmaṇi ||
pratipatsu ghaṭikaikāpi karmakālasambandhinī yadi na syād ity arthaḥ |
jābālir api |
pratipatsv apy amāvāsyā pūrvāhṇavyāpinī yadi |
bhūtaviddhaiva sā kāryā pitrye karmaṇi sarvadā ||
yadā tu dinadvaye ’pi kutapakālavyāpinī amāvāsyā pūrvāhṇe tadā vṛddhau sāmye vā parā grāhyā, kṣaye pūrvā |
tathā ca pracetāḥ |
sinīvālī kuhūś caiva śrutyukte śrāddhakarmaṇi |
syātāṃ te cet tu madhyāhne śrāddhādi syāt kathaṃ tadā ||
tithikṣaye sinīvālī tithivṛddhau kuhūḥ smṛtā |
sāmye 'pi ca kuhūr jñeyā vedavedāṅgavedibhiḥ || iti |
kātyāyano ’pi |
kṣīyamāṇām amāvāsyāṃ prathame ’hani lakṣayet |
vardhamānām amāvāsyāṃ dvitīye ’hani lakṣayet ||
yat tu vṛddhavasiṣṭhavacanam |
aruṇodayavelāyām amāvāsyā yadā bhavet |
sa kālaḥ paramo jñeyaḥ pitṝṇāṃ dattam akṣayam || iti |
[450]        tatpitṛtarpaṇādiviṣayam |
yad api nigamavacanam |
muhūrttam apy amāvāsyā pratipady api ced bhavet |
tadānīm uttamaṃ jñeyaṃ parvaśeṣas tu parvavat || iti |
tat tulāpuruṣādiviṣayam |
ata eva ca padmapurāṇe |
amā vā pratipady uktā sarvapāpaharā tithiḥ |
candrasūryagrahais tulyā snānadānajapādiṣu ||
anyatra tu "tad dānam uttamam" iti nigamavacanapāṭhaḥ |
yad api pracetasoktam |
ghaṭikaikāpy amāvāsyā bhaved yadi caturdaśī |
tadā vyarthaṃ mataṃ daive pitrye karmaṇi coditam || iti |
tad api devapitṛpradhānopavāsādiviṣayam |
nanu pitṛkāryaviṣayam eva kimiti na bhavati |
ucyate | yadā pūrvadina evāparāhṇavyāpinī tadā tāvat pūrvaiveti nirūpitam |
sinīvālī tadā pitrye daive ca satataṃ kuhūḥ ||
iti jābālismṛteś ca, bhūtaviddhā pitṛkṛtye śasyate tatra tulādiṣu bhūtaviddhāpi pūjyeti parisaṅkhyānam upapannam | nāpi dinadvaye ’parāhṇavyāpitvābhāvaviṣayam idaṃ, uktād eva hetoḥ | na ca pūrvottaradinayor aparāhṇavyāpitve amāvāsyā bhūtaviddhāpi pūjyeti vyavasthā ghaṭate tatra hi tithisāmyvṛddhau parā grāhyā, tithikṣaye ca pūrvaiveti tulādiparisaṅkhyānam anarthakam | tasmād devakāryaparam etat |
[451]        tathā skandapurāṇe darśitam |
ṣaṣṭhyekādaśyamāvāsyā pūrvaviddhā tathāṣṭamī |
saptamī paraviddhā ca nopoṣyaṃ tithipañcakam || iti |
tad āha pracetāḥ |
nāgaviddhā ca yā ṣaṣṭhī saptamyā ca tathāṣṭamī |
daśamyaikādaśī viddhā trayodaśyāṃ caturdaśī |
bhūtaviddhā amāvāsyā na grāhyā munipuṅgaaiḥ || iti |
tenopavāsādidevakārye bhūtaviddhāyā amāvāsyāyā apūjyatvopadeśāt tulādiyoge bhūtaviddhā pūjyeti |
hārītaḥ smarati |
pratipanmiśrā bhaved devakārye pūjyaiva, tulāmakarayoge
bhūtaviddhāpi pūyeti|
nanu devakāryaviṣayatve ’pi bādhenaiva niveśa iti pitṛkālaviṣayatā kiṃ nāśrīyate |
ucyate | bādhagauravabhiyā tāvad ekasminn eva kārye niveśaḥ | na ca vinigame kāraṇabhāvaḥ |
yataḥ kātyāyanena,
nāgaviddhā tu yā ṣaṣṭhī daśamyaikādaśī tathā |
bhūtaviddhāpy amāvāsyā varjanīyā vicakṣaṇaiḥ ||
ity uktvoktam |
tulāmakaramīneṣu kanyāyāṃ mithune tathā |
bhūtaviddhāpy amāvāsyā pūjyā bhavati yatnataḥ ||
naitat sāhacaryād etad api devakāryaviṣayam iti tasya ca vratopavāsādidevakāryaviṣayatvaṃ sāmānyatithiprastāve darśitam |
iti camāvāsyānirṇayaḥ |
[452]
athāṣṭakāḥ
aṣṭakāśabdena mārgaśīrṣādimāsacatuṣṭayāparapakṣāṣṭamyaḥ, "hemantaśiśirayoś caturṇām aparapakṣāṇām aṣṭamīṣv aṣṭakā" iti śaunakasmaraṇāt | keṣāṃcin mate tisra evāṣṭakāḥ tisraś cānvaṣṭakāḥ |
tathā ca viṣṇuḥ |
amāvāsyās tisro ’ṣṭakās tisro 'nvaṣṭakā iti |
aṣṭakānām anu pañcād bhavantīty anvaṣṭakā aṭakānām uparitanā navamyaḥ |
kūrmapurāṇe |
amāvāsyāṣṭakās tisraḥ pauṣamāsādiṣu triṣu |
tisraś cānvaṣṭakāḥ puṇyāḥ māghī pañcadaśī tathā || iti |
viṣṇudharmottare |
āgrahāyaṇyatikrāntau kṛṣṇās tisro ’ṣṭakās tathā | iti |
atha pūrvoktāṣṭakācatuṣṭayavyatiriktāpi bhādrapadāparapaṇe ’ṣṭakā tasyāś cetihāsapūrvakam utpattiḥ praśaṃsā cocyate padmapurāṇe |
agniṣvāttā iti khyātā yajvināṃ yajñasaṃsthitāḥ |
acchodā nāma teṣāṃ tu mānasī kanyakā nadī ||
tam athāmāvasun nāma pitaraṃ vīkṣya saṅgatā |
vavre varārthinī saṅgaṃ kusumāyudhapīḍanāt ||
yogaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu tenātha vyabhicāreṇa bhāminī |
dharān na spṛśate pūrvaṃ papātātha bhuvastale ||
atho adhomukhī dīnā lajjitā tapasaḥ kṣayāt |
sāpi taṃ prārthayāmāsa punar ātmasamṛddhaye ||
[453]        vilapyamānā pitṛbhir idam uktā tapasvinī |
idam ūcur mahābhāgāḥ prasādaśubhayā girā ||
aṣṭāviṃśe bhāvinī tvaṃ dvāpare martyayonijā |
nāmnā satyavatī khyātā vyāsasya jananī śubhā ||
vyatikramāt pitṝṇāṃ tvaṃ kaṣṭaṃ kulam avāpsyasi |
tasmād rājño vasoḥ kanyā tvam avaśyaṃ bhaviṣyasi ||
prauṣṭapadyaṣṭakā bhūyaḥ pitṛloke bhaviṣyasi |
āyurārogyadā nityaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradā ||
brahmavaivarta-vāyupurāṇayoḥ |
atha kālaṃ pravakṣyāmi śrāddhakarmaṇi pūjitam |
kāmyanaimittikājasraṃ śrāddhadharmavidhāyibhiḥ ||
puttradā dhanamūlāḥ syur aṣṭakās tisra eva ca |
kṛṣṇapakṣe dhaniṣṭhādipūrvā caindrī udāhṛtā |
prājāpatyā dvitīyā syāt tṛtīyā vaiśvadevikī ||
ādyā pūpaiḥ sadā kāryā māṃsair anyā bhavet sadā |
śākair anyā tṛtīyā syād evaṃ dravyagato vidhiḥ ||
anvaṣṭakā pitṝṇāṃ vai nityam eva vidhīyate |
yā vānyā tu caturthī syāt tāṃ ca kuryād viśeṣataḥ ||
tāsu śrāddhaṃ budhāḥ kuryuḥ sarvasvenāpi nityaśaḥ |
paratreha ca sarveṣu nityam eva sukhī bhavet ||
[454]        pūjakānāṃ sadotkarṣo nāstikānām adhogatiḥ |
pitaraḥ sarvakāleṣu tithikāleṣu devatāḥ ||
sarve puruṣam āyānti nipātam iva dhenavaḥ |
yasya te pratigaccheyur aṣṭakābhir apūjitāḥ ||
moghas tasya bhavel loko labdhaṃ cāsya vinaśyati |
devāṃs tu dāyino yānti tiryag gacchanty adāyinaḥ ||
atra caturthī phālgunakṛṣṇapakṣāṣṭamī "hemantaśiśirayoś caturṇām aparapakṣāṇām aṣṭamīṣv aṣṭakā" iti śaunakasmaraṇāt | pauṣamāsakṛṣṇāṣṭamīm ārabhyeti tisro ’ṣṭakā ity etanmataparigrahe caturthī bhādrapadamāsāparapakṣāṣṭamī saṃnihitadarśitapadmapurāṇetihāsānusārāt | brahmapurāṇe ca catasṛṣv aṣṭakāsu krameṇa devatānirūpaṇe pitṛtarpakadravyanirūpaṇe ca bhādrapadāparapakṣāṣṭamyā grahaṇāt |
aindryāṃ tu prathamāyāṃ ca śākaiḥ saṃtarpayet pitṝn |
prājāpatyā dvitīyā syāt māṃsaiḥ śuddhaiś ca tarpayet ||
vaiśvadevyāṃ tṛtīyāyām apūpaiś ca yathākramam |
varṣāsu madhye śākaiś ca caturthyām eva sarvadā || iti |
atra śākamāṃsāpūpaśabdāḥ śrāddhārhasya sarvasyāpi bhojyasya tattaddravyapradhānakatvapratipādanaparāḥ, na tu dravyāntaranivṛttiparāḥ, yato vidher ekavidhyantarābādhenaiva tāvadgatinyāyaṃ manyante kim uta bahutaravidhyantarabādheneti | dṛṣṭaṃ hi śākapradhānasya bhojyasya tarpakatvaṃ na tu kevalaśākasyeti |
āha vasiṣṭhaḥ |
[455]        śrāvaṇyāgrahāyaṇyoś cānvaṣṭakāsu pitṛbhyo dadyāt | aṣṭakānvaṣṭakāsv api cāvaśyakam eva śrāddham |
yad āha pitāmahaḥ |
amāvāsyāvyatīpātapaurṇamāsyaṣṭakāsu ca |
vidvān śrāddham akurvāṇo narakaṃ pratipadyate || iti |
vāyupurāṇe "tiryag gacchanty adāyina" ity aṣṭakāśrāddham akurvāṇasya tiryagyoniprāptirūpāniṣṭābhidhānāc ca | viṣṇunā ca "amāvāsyāḥ tisro ’ṣṭakāḥ tisro ’nvaṣṭakā māghīprauṣṭhapadyūrdhvaṃ kṛṣṇatrayodaśī vrīhiyavapākau vā" ity anukramyoktam |
etāṃs tu śrāddhakālān vai nityān āha prajāpatiḥ |
viṣṇudharmottare ’py uktaṃ |
śrāddhakālam amāvāsyā nityaṃ pārthivasattama |
paurṇamāsī tathā māghī śrāvaṇī ca nṛpottama ||
pauṣṭhapadyām atītāyāṃ tathā kṛṣṇatrayodaśī |
āgrahāyaṇyatikrāntau kṛṣṇās tisro ’ṣṭakās tathā ||
śākaiś ca prathamā kāryā māṃsaiś ca tadanantaram |
tṛtīyā ca tathāpūpair nityam eva vijānatā ||
etāni śrāddhakālāni nityāny āha prajāpatiḥ |
śrāddham eteṣv akurvāṇo narakaṃ pratipadyate || iti |
devalasmṛtau |
mānavaḥ śrāddhakalpo ’yaṃ manunā samudāhṛtaḥ |
[456]        bahupinḍāṣṭakā ca syād ekapiṇḍā tu nāṣṭakā || iti |
atra bahupiṇḍaikapiṇḍaśabdau pārvaṇaikoddiṣṭavidhiniṣedhaparau |
brahmapurāṇe |
aṣṭakāsu ca kartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ haimantikāsu vai |
anvaṭakāsu kramaśo mātṛpūrvaṃ tad iṣyate || iti |
atra smṛtiḥ |
anvaṣṭakāsu vṛddhau ca pratisaṃvatsaraṃ tathā |
atra mātuḥ pṛthak śrāddham anyatra patinā saha || iti |
śaṅkhasmṛtiḥ |
anvaṣṭakāṃ tathā mātuḥ śrāddhaṃ caiva mṛte ’hani |
ekoddiṣṭaṃ tathā muktvā strīṣu nānyat pṛthak bhavet || iti |
viṣṇudharmottare cāsmin mātṛśrāddhe pṛthagvidhir uktaḥ |
anvaṣṭakāsu ca strīṇāṃ śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ tathaiva ca |
aṣṭakāvidhinā hutvā krameṇaitāsu pañcakam ||
mātre rājan pitāmahyai śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ yathāvidhi |
tathaiva prapitāmahyai vaiśvadevapuraḥsaram ||
piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ kāryaṃ tasyaiva pitṛvan nṛpa |
bhuktavatsu ca vipreṣu tatra karma nibodha me ||
prādeśamātrā rājendra caturaṅgulam āyatāḥ |
tāvad eva samutsedhāḥ ṣaṭkarṣūs tatra kārayet ||
pratyekaṃ karṣūmūle tu paristīrṇahutāśanaḥ |
agnīṣomayamānāṃ ca yāgaṃ kṛtvā yathā purā ||
[457]        karṣūtṛtīyamūleṣu puruṣāṇāṃ tu kārayet |
piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ prāg yad ekaikasmin yathāvidhi ||
karṣūṇāṃ tritayaṃ tac ca kṣīrānnābhyāṃ prapūrayet |
karṣūtritayamūle ca strīṇāṃ nirvapaṇaṃ bhavet ||
dadhnā māṃsena payasā karṣūṇaṃ caiva pūrayet |
atrodakavimiśreṇa kāryaṃ manujapuṅgava |
bhavatībhyo bhavatv etad akṣayyam iti tat tyajet ||
ity aṣṭakānirūpaṇam |
atha vṛddhiśrāddhakālanirṇayaḥ |
vṛddhir nāma putrajanmādinimittopalakṣitaḥ kālaḥ |
tathā ca vṛddhavasiṣṭhaḥ |
putrajanmavivāhādau vṛddhiśrāddham udāhṛtam |
jābāliḥ |
yajñodvāhapratiṭhāsu mekhalābandhamokṣayoḥ |
putrajanmavṛṣotsarge vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ samācaret ||
viṣṇupurāṇe |
jātasya jātakarmādikriyākāṇḍam aśeṣataḥ |
putrasya kurvīta pitā śrāddhaṃ cābhyudayātmakam ||
kātyāyano ’py āha |
svapitṛbhyaḥ pitā dadyāt sutasaṃskārakarmasu |
piṇḍānodvahanāt teṣāṃ tasyābhāve tu tatkramāt || iti |
atra saṃskārāḥ | [458]
garbhādhānapuṃsavanasīmantonnayanajātakarmanāmakaraṇanikramaṇānnaprāśana- cūḍopanayanavratacaryādhyayanasamāvartanavivāhagodānāni |
tatraiteṣu vivāhānteṣu sutasaṃskāreṣu pitā svapitṛbhyo dadyāt | śeṣe saṃskārya evety etad vistareṇoktam evādhikārinirūpaṇe śrāddhakalpe |
viṣṇupurāṇe |
kanyāputravivāheṣu praveśe navaveśmanaḥ |
nāmakarmaṇi bālānāṃ cūḍākarmādike tathā ||
sīmantonnayane caiva putrādimukhadarśane |
nāndīmukhaṃ pitṛgaṇaṃ pūjayet prayato gṛhī ||
putrasyādye mukhadarśane putrajanmanīty arthaḥ |
brahmapurāṇe |
karmaṇy athābhyudayike māṅgalye cātiśobhane |
janmany athopanayane vivāhe putrakasya ca |
pitṝn nāndīmukhān nāma tarpayed vidhipūrvakam ||
vaśiṣṭaḥ |
pūrvedyur mātṛkaṃ śrāddhaṃ karmāhe paitṛkaṃ tathā |
uttaredyuḥ prakurvīta mātāmahagaṇasya tu ||
asyānukalpam āha vṛddhaśātātapaḥ |
pṛthagdineṣv aśaktaś ced ekasmin pūrvavāsare |
śrāddhatrayaṃ tu kurvīta vaiśvadevaṃ ca tāntrikam ||
ekasminn api dine kriyamāṇānāṃ kālabhedenānuṣṭhānam āha |
[459]        pūrvāhṇe mātṛkaṃ śrāddhaṃ madhyāhne paitṛkaṃ tathā |
tato mātāmahānāṃ tu vṛddhau śrāddhatrayaṃ smṛtam ||
evaṃvidhasyāpi kālabhedasyāsambhave tv āha bṛhanmanuḥ |
alābhe bhinnakālānāṃ nāndīśrāddhatraye budhaḥ |
pūrvedyur vai prakurvīta pūrvāhṇe mātṛpūrvakam ||
baudhāyanasutre |
vedakarmaṇi prayogāt pūrveyur eva yugmān brāhmaṇān bhojayedi ti | "nāndīmukhā evam uktā bhavanti, naikāhena pitryaṃ daivaṃ kurvanti yasyaikāhnā pitryaṃ daivaṃ ca kuvanti prajā asya pramāyuktā bhavanti, tasmāt pūrvedyuḥ pitṛbhyaḥ kriyate yat pitṛbhyaḥ pūrvedyuḥ karoti pitṛbhya eva tadyajñaṃ niṣkrīya yajamānaḥ pratanute” iti brāhmaṇaṃ |
atra vakṣyamāṇasakalaśrāddhakāloddeśasthānīye yājñavalkyavākye vṛddhiśabdasyāśeṣanāndīmukhaśrāddhakālopalakṣaṇaparatvāt karmāṅgaśrāddhakālā api gṛhītāḥ |
tān āha pāraskaraḥ |
niṣekakāle some ca sīmantonnayane tathā |
jñeyaṃ puṃsavane śrāddhaṃ karmāṅgaṃ vṛddhivat kṛtam ||
niṣekakālaḥ ṣoḍaśarātrātmako bhāryāyā ṛtukālaḥ | tatra puṇyanakṣatrānvitadine garbhādhānasya karmāṅgaṃ śrāddhaṃ kāryam | somagrahaṇam ādhānāgnihotrādikarmaṇām upalakṣaṇārtham |
iti vṛddhiśrāddhakālanirūpaṇam |
[460]
atha kṛṣṇapakṣaśrāddhanirṇayaḥ |
tatra vājasaneyas tatraiva kātyāyanaḥ |
aparapakṣe śrāddhaṃ kurvītordhvaṃ vā caturthyā yadahaḥ sampadyeteti | aparapakṣe pratipatprabhṛtyamāvāsyānte kṛṣṇapakṣe ūrdhvaṃ vā caturthyāḥ yasminn ahani śrāddhasādhanasampattiḥ tasminn ahani śrāddhaṃ kurvīteti |
gautamo ’pi |
amāvāsyāyāṃ pitṛbhyo dadyāt pañcamīprabhṛti vāparapakṣasya yathāśrāddhaṃ sarvasmin vā dravyadeśabrāhmaṇasambhave kālaniyamaḥ śaktita iti | aparapakṣe ekasminn ahani śrāddham ity ekaḥ pakṣaḥ, pratyaham ity aparaḥ |
'kālaniyamaḥ śaktitaḥ' yathāsāmarthyaṃ kālavyavasthety arthaḥ | atra ca nityaṃ śrāddham |
tathā ca kātyāyanaḥ |
śākenāpi nāparapakṣam atikrāmet | iti |
yat tu mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇādiṣu | “pratipaddhanalābhāya dvitīyā dvipadapradetyādibhir vacanair aparapakṣāntārgatāsu sarvāsv api tithiṣu pratyekaṃ phalasambandha ukto na tenāparapakṣaśrāddhasya nityatā hīyate darśapaurṇamāsādivan nityatvakāmyatvayor upapatteḥ | yadāpi caitad ekasminn evāhani kriyate tadāmāvāsyāśrāddhāt pṛthag eva kāryam |
amāvāsyāṣṭakā vṛddhiḥ kṛṣṇapakṣo 'yanadvayam |
ityatra yājñavalkyavacane amāvāsyāyāḥ kṛṣyapakṣasya pṛthag upanyāsāt |
[461]        ato yat kaiścid uktam | “amāvāsyāśrāddhena saha āparapakṣikaṃ śrāddhaṃ vikalpata" iti tad apāstaṃ | yan nigamasmaraṇaṃ “aparapakṣe yad ahaḥ sampadyetāmāvāsyāyāṃ viśeṣeṇa" iti tat pṛthaktve ’py ubhayapakṣāvirodhīti na vikalpe pramāṇam iti smṛticandrikākāraḥ | kecit tu vikalpam eva manyante |
āha āpastambaḥ |
māsi māsi kāryam aparapakṣāparāhṇaḥ śreyāṃs tathāparapakṣasya
jaghanyāny ahāni || iti |
'jaghanyāni' daśamyādīni, naitat pūrveṣāṃ navamyādīnām anyatamāśreyastvābhidhānārthaṃ, kiṃ tu pūrvebhyaḥ pareṣāṃ śreṣṭhatamatvapratipādanārthaṃ | tad etac caturdaśīṃ varjayitvāha manuḥ |
kṛṣṇapakṣe daśamyādau varjayitvā caturdaśīm |
śrāddhe praśastās tithayo yathaitā na tathetarā || iti ||
atra caturdaśī nityaṃ na varjanīyā kiṃ tu śastrādihatavyatiriktatridevatyaśrāddhe eveti |
āha yājñavalkyaḥ |
pratipat prabhṛti hy ekāṃ varjayitvā caturdaśīm |
śastreṇa tu hatā ye vai tebhyas tatra pradīyate || iti |
śastragrahaṇam anyeṣām api keṣāṃcin maraṇakāraṇānām upalakṣaṇārtham iti vakṣyate |
[462]
atha bhādrapadāparapakṣaḥ |
atra yady api "aparapakṣe śrāddhaṃ kurvīta śākenāpi nāparapakṣam atikrāmed" ityādibhir dvādaśāparapakṣagrāhakaiḥ sāmānyavacanair bhādrapadāparakṣo ’pi gṛhīta eva tathāpi tasya puṇyatamatvapratipādanārthaṃ tadatikrame pratyavāyātiśayapratipādanārthaṃ ca smṛtipurāṇādau viśeṣatas tasyābhidhānaṃ kṛtam |
tad yathā viṣṇudharmottare |
uttarād vacanād rājan śreṣṭhaṃ syād dakṣiṇāyanam |
yāmyāyanāc caturmāsaṃ tatra supte tu keśave ||
prauṣṭhapadāparapakṣas tatrāpi ca viśeṣataḥ |
pañcamyūrdhvaṃ tu tatrāpi daśamyūrdhvaṃ tato ’py ati |
maghāyuktā tu tatrāpi śreṣṭhā rājan trayodaśī || iti |
uttarāyaṇād dakṣiṇāyanaṃ śrāddhakaraṇe śreṣṭham | tasmād dakṣiṇāyanād api tanmadhyavartyupendranidrādinād āṣāḍhyāḥ paurṇamāsyāḥ prabhṛti māsacatuṣṭayaṃ śreṣṭham | tasmād api sarvasmāt prauṣṭhapadamāsāparapakṣaḥ | tatrāpi pañcamyā ūrdhvaṃ daśadivasāḥ | tatrāpi daśamyā ūrdhvaṃ pañca | tatrāpi maghāyuktā trayodaśīti |
brahmapurāṇe |
aśvayuk kṛṣṇapakṣe tu śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ dine dine |
tribhāgahīnaṃ pakṣaṃ vā vibhāgaṃ tv ardham eva vā |
śyāmākais tu viśeṣeṇa prasiddhais tu pitṛpriyaiḥ ||
atra viṣṇudharmottarapurāṇe |
[463]        "prauṣṭhapadasaṃbandhini kṛṣṇapakṣe śrāddham" ityuktam |
brahmapurāṇe tu “aśvayuksaṃbandhinīti," so ’yam anayor visaṃvādaḥ parihriyate | tathā hi iha khalu śuklapakṣapratipady upakramya māsanāmapravarttikāṃ paurṇamāsīṃ madhyāvayavīkṛtyāmāvāsyāntaṃ cāndramāsaṃ dākṣiṇātyāḥ parikalpayanti | auttarās tu kṛṣṇapakṣapratipady upakramya māsanāmapravartakapaurṇamāsyantam | evaṃ ca sati dākṣiṇātyavyavahāreṇa prauṣṭhapadayuktāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ prauṣṭhapadamāsasyādyapakṣasamāptau taduttaraḥ pakṣaḥ aśvayuṅmāsamadhye bhavati | eka evāyaṃ pakṣo vyavahāradvayena vyapadeśadvayaṃ labhate |
ādityapurāṇe |
prāvṛṣy ṛtau yamaḥ pretān pitṝṃś cātha yamālayāt |
visarjayati mānuṣye kṛtvā śūnyaṃ svakaṃ puram ||
kṣudhārttāḥ kīrtayantaś ca duṣkṛtaṃ ca svayaṃ kṛtam |
kāṅkṣanti putrapautrebhyaḥ pāyasaṃ madhusaṃyutam ||
tasmāt tāṃs tatra vidhinā tarpayet pāyasena tu |
madhvājyatilamiśreṇa tathā śītena cāmbhasā ||
grāsamātraṃ paraṃ grāhyaṃ dattaṃ yaḥ prāpnuyāt tataḥ |
bhikṣāmātreṇa yaḥ prāṇān saṃdhārayati vā svayam ||
yāvat saṃdhārayed dehaṃ pratyahaṃ svātmavikrayāt |
śrāddhaṃ tenāpi kartavyaṃ tais tair dravyaiḥ susaṃcitaiḥ || iti |
atra nāgarakhale pitṝn prati brahmavacanam |
āṣāḍhyāḥ pañcame pakṣe kanyāsaṃsthe divākare |
[464]        yo vai śrāddhaṃ naraḥ kuryād ekasminn api vāsare|
tasya saṃvatsaraṃ yāvat tṛptāḥ syḥ pitaro dhruvam ||
śāṭyāyanir āha |
nabhasyasyāpare pakṣe tithiṣoḍaśakas tu yaḥ |
kanyāgatānvitaś cet syāt sa kālaḥ śrāddhakarmaṇi ||
brahmapurāṇa-mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇayoḥ |
divyabhaumāntarīkṣāṇi sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca |
piṇḍam icchanti pitaraḥ kanyārāśigate ravau ||
kanyāgate savitari yāny ahāni tu ṣoḍaśa |
ṛtubhis tāni tulyāni devo nārāyaṇo ’bravīt ||
rājasūyāśvamedhābhyāṃ ya icchet durlabhaṃ phalam |
ayaṃ tu śākamūlānnaiḥ pitṝn kanyāgate ’rcayet ||
yady api kanyāgamanaṃ māsamātre bhavati tathāpy aparapakṣasyaiva paitratvād vacanāntarasaṃvādāc ca tatraiva śrāddham ity anusaṃdheyam |
ādityapurāṇe ’pi |
kanyāgate savitari yāny ahāni tu ṣoḍaśa |
ṛtubhis tāni tulyāni pitṝṇāṃ dattam akṣayam || iti |
atra yady api vacaneṣu pakṣasyaiva śrāddhakālatvam uktam, pakṣaś cāyaṃ pañcadaśatithyātmako ’pi kadācit tithivṛddhau ṣoḍaśadinātmako bhavati | tatraikadinahānir mā bhūt ity anenābhiprāyeṇātra tithiṣoḍaśakam ity ukaṃ āmāvāysottarapratipadam api vā saṃgrahītuṃ pūrvāṃ paurṇamāsīṃ vā, tasyāṃ hi nāndīmukhānāṃ śrāddhaṃ vakṣyate | atra pakṣamadhye yasmin kasmiṃścid [465] apy ahani kanyāsaṃkramaṇe sati pratipadādiṣoḍaśāhāny upādeyāni ity evaṃ veditavyam | na tu saṃkramaṇāt pūrvāṇi heyānīty evam |
ata evāha bṛhanmanuḥ |
madhye vā yadi vāpy ante yatra kanyāṃ ravir vrajet |
sa pakṣaḥ sakalaḥ pūrṇaḥ śrāddhaṃ tatra vidhīyate || iti |
atra kanyāgatatvasyoktiḥ praśastataratvapratipādanārthā na tu kanyāgatarāhitye ’py etatparityāgārthā |
ādityapurāṇe |
pakṣāntare ’pi kanyāsthe ravau śrāddhaṃ vidhīyate |
kanyāgate pañcame tu viśeṣeṇaiva kārayet || iti |
ādityapurāṇe ’py etad evoktam |
āṣāḍhīm avadhiṃ kṛtvā yaḥ syāt pakṣas tu pañcamaḥ |
tatra śrāddhaṃ prakurvīta kanyāṃ gacchatu vā na vā || iti |
kārṣṇājiniḥ |
putrān āyus tathārogyam aiśvaryam atulaṃ tathā |
prāpnoti pañcame datvā śrāddhaṃ kāmāṃs tu puṣkalān ||
evaṃ bhādrapadāparapakṣe śrāddhe kṛte viśiṣṭeṣṭāptir uktā | tasminn akṛte tv aniṣṭaprāptim āha kārṣṇājiniḥ |
pretās taṃ caiva hiṃsanti pañcamaṃ yo vyatikramet |
tasmān nātikramed vidvān pañcame paitṛkaṃ vidhim ||
nāgarakhaṇḍe |
āṣāḍhyāḥ pañcame pakṣe yaḥ śrāddhaṃ na kariṣyati |
[466]        śākenāpi daridro ’pi so 'ntyajatvam upeṣyati ||
āsanaṃ śayanaṃ bhojyaṃ sparśaṃ saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ tathā |
tena sārdhaṃ kariṣyanti ye te pāpatamā narāḥ ||
bhaviṣyanti na saṃdehaḥ santatyā vivarjitāḥ |
na sukhaṃ dhanadhānyaṃ ca teṣām bhāvi kadācana || iti |
brahmapurāṇe |
sūrye kanyāgate kuryāt śrāddhaṃ yo na gṛhāśramī |
dhanaṃ putrāḥ kutas tasya pitṛniśvāsapīḍayā ||
na santi pitaraś ceti kṛtvā manasi yo naraḥ |
śrāddhaṃ na kurute tatra tasya raktaṃ pibanti te ||
atha kenacit prakāreṇa śrāddham antareṇoktasya pakṣasyātikrame tannimittasya śrāddhasya taduttaradineṣv avadhiviśeṣāvacchinneṣu kartavyatocyate |
yamasmṛtau |
haṃse varṣāsu kanyāsthe śākenāpi gṛhe vasan |
pañcamyor antare dadyād ubhayor api pakṣayoḥ ||
'haṃsaḥ' sūryaḥ | 'ubhayapakṣapañcamyor antara iti bhādrapadakṛṣṇapañcamyāḥ parastād āśvinaśuklapañcamyāḥ pūrvam antarālakāla ity arthaḥ | anenāśvinaśuklapakṣapañcamīparyantaṃ śrāddham abhyanujñātaṃ bhavati |
brahmapurāṇe |
yāvan na kanyātulayoḥ kramād āste divākaraḥ |
tāvat śrāddhasya kālaḥ syāt śūnyaṃ pretapuraṃ tadā ||
tathā |
[467]        kanyāgate savitari pitaro yānti vai sutān |
śūnyā pretapurī sarvā yāvat vṛścikadarśanam ||
tato vṛścikasaṃprāptau nirāśāḥ pitaro gatāḥ |
punaḥ svabhavanaṃ yānti śāpaṃ datvā sudāruṇam ||
nāgarakhaṇḍe |
na dadāti naraḥ śrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ candrasaṃkṣaye |
kṣutpipāsāparītāṅgāḥ pitaras tasya dūṣitāḥ ||
pretapakṣaṃ pratīkṣante guruvāñchāsamanvitāḥ |
karṣakā jaladaṃ yadvad divānaktam atandritāḥ ||
pretapakṣe ’py atikrānte yāvat kanyāgato raviḥ |
tāvat śrāddhaṃ pravāñchanti dattaṃ svaiḥ pitaraḥ sutaiḥ ||
tatas tulāgate ’py eke sūrye vāñchanti pārthiva |
śrāddhaṃ svavaṃśajair dattaṃ kṣutpipāsāsamākulāḥ ||
tasminn api vyatikrānte kāle vṛścikage ravau |
nirāśāḥ pitaro hīnās tato yānti nijālayam ||
māsadvayaṃ pratīkṣante gṛhadvārasamāśritāḥ |
vāyubhūtāḥ pipāsārttāḥ kṣutkṣāmāḥ pitaro nṛṇām |
yāvat kanyāgataḥ sūryaḥ tulāsthaś ca mahīpate ||
sumantur āha |
kanyārāśau mahārāja yāvat tiṣṭhet vibhāvasuḥ |
tasmāt kālāt bhaved deyaṃ vṛścikaṃ yāvad āgataḥ ||
yeyaṃ dīpānvitā rājan khyātā pañcadaśī bhuvi |
[468]        tasyāṃ dadyāc ced dattaṃ pitṝṇāṃ vai mahālaye ||
atra mahālayo bhādrapadāparapakṣaḥ |
yat tu jātūkarṇenoktam |
ākāṅkṣanti sma pitaraḥ pañcamaṃ pakṣam āśritāḥ |
tasmāt tatraiva dātavyaṃ dattam anyatra niṣphalam || iti |
tatphalātiśayahāniparaṃ na sarvathā phalahānipratipādakam | etac cāparapakṣaśrāddhaṃ malamāse na kartavyam iti malamāsanirṇaye nirūpitam | atra cedaṃ vicāryate | kim ayam āparapakṣikasya ekasyaiva śrāddhasyāvṛttasya prayogaḥ, kiṃ vā bhinnānāṃ śrāddhānāṃ ete prayogā iti, uktaṃ pakṣadvayam apīti |
atra kecit tāvad āhuḥ | ekasyaiva śrāddhasyāyaṃ prayogaḥ yad āha śāṭyāyaniḥ |
nabhasyasyāpare pakṣe tithiṣoḍaśakas tu yaḥ |
kanyāgatānvitaś cet syāt kālaḥ sa śrāddhakarmaṇi ||
atra saṅkhyāyukteṣu samuccaya iti nyāyāt tithīnāṃ śrāddhe samuccayo ’vagamyate | na cānāvṛtte śrāddhe tad upapadyata iti, tad eva śrāddham āvarttate | tena somayāge vihitāṅgasampattyartham āvṛttir abhyupagatā yathā evam ihāpīti | “aparapakṣe śrāddhaṃ kurvato 'rdhaṃ vā caturthyāṃ yad ahaḥ sampadyeteti vājasaneyasūtrakātyāyanavacanāt pakṣasya vāṅgatvam avagamyate, pakṣaś ca pañcadaśatithyātmakaḥ, evaṃ samuccaya eva |
tathā gautamo ’pi |
amāvāsyāyāṃ pitṛbhyo dadyāt pañcamīprabhṛti vāparapakṣasya yathā śrāddhaṃ sarvasmin vā dravyadeśabrāhmaṇasaṃbhave kālaniyamaḥ śaktitaḥ || iti |
[469]        atra cāparapakṣapañcamīprabhṛtipakṣāmāvāsyānāṃ vikalpaḥ pratīyate | tenāmāvāsyāvad ekasminn eva śrāddhe samagraḥ kṛṣṇapakṣo ’py aṅgam eva | tataś ca tatsiddhyartham āvṛttir eva yuktā |
aśvayukkṛṣṇapakṣe tu śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ dine dine |
tribhāgahīnaṃ pakṣaṃ vā tribhāgaṃ tv ardham eva vā ||
iti brahmapurāṇavacane dvitīyāśravaṇād atyantasaṃyogāvagamād ekam eva śrāddham āvartanīyam iti pratīyate |
nanv evaṃ sati “yadāgneyo ’ṣṭākapālo ’māvāsyāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ cācyuto bhavati” ity atrāpy ekasminn eva yāge kālasamuccayaḥ syāt tataś ca ṣaḍbhāgaprasiddhis tantravidāṃ vyāhanyeta |
ucyate | tatrāpi samuccaya eva caśabdaśravaṇāt, na tv āgneyadvayaṃ, ṣaḍbhāgaprasiddhis tv āvṛttyabhiprāyeṇeti | na tu vṛttivārttikanibandhakṛdbhir evaṃ kaiścid uktaṃ, tenaika evāyaṃ prayoga iti |
anye tv āhuḥ | bhinnānāṃ śrāddhānām ete prayogāḥ śrāddhabhedāt |
ante vā yadi vā madhye yatra kanyāṃ ravir vrajet |
sa pakṣaḥ pañcamaḥ pūjyaḥ śrāddhaṣoḍaśakaṃ prati || iti |
atra ca saṅkhyayā karmabhedaḥ pratīyate | na ceyaṃ “ekādaśa prayājān yajatītivad abhyāsāśrayā, tatra prakṛtau saṅkhyāntaraśravaṇād evam āśritam, na tv atrāpy udāhṛtavākyair ekatvāvagamād abhyāsāśrayā bhaviṣyati | bhaved evaṃ yadi tāny utpattivākyāni idaṃ cotpanne karmaṇi guṇavidhāyakaṃ bhavet, na tv etad asti, anekaguṇaśravaṇenotpattivākātvāvagamāt | ata eva “pratipaddhanalābhāya dvitīyā dvipadapradetyādibhir vacanair aparapakṣāntargatāsu sarvāsv api tithiṣu pratyekaṃ phalasambandha uktaḥ | tena bhinnānāṃ śrāddhānām [470] ete prayogā iti |
vayaṃ tu brūmaḥ | udāhṛtānanyathāsiddhadvividhavākyadarśanāt pakṣadvayam api yuktam iti | tena prayogaikyapakṣe samāptidina eva dakṣiṇā deyā prayogāṅgatvād dakṣiṇāyāḥ, prayogabhede tu pratidinam eveti |
atha trayodaśīśrāddhanirṇayaḥ |
manusmṛtau |
yat kiṃcin madhunā miśraṃ pradadyāt tu trayodaśīm |
tad apy akṣayam eva syād varṣāsu ca maghāsu ca
yamasmṛtau |
gāthāś ca pitṛbhir gītāḥ kīrtayanti purāvidaḥ |
api naḥ sa kule bhūyād yo no dadyāt trayodaśīm ||
pāyasaṃ madhusarpirbhyāṃ prākchāye kuñcarasya ca |
ājena sarvalohena varṣāsu ca maghāsu ca ||
atha pitṛagāthā bhavatīty uktvāha viṣṇuḥ |
api jāyeta so ’smākaṃ kule kaścin narottamaḥ |
prāvṛḍkāle site pakṣe trayodaśyāṃ samāhitaḥ ||
madhūttareṇa yaḥ śrāddhaṃ pāyasena samācaret |
kārttikaṃ sakalaṃ vāpi prākchāye kuñjarasya ca ||
tatra paiṭhīnasir apy āha |
chāgena sarvalohena varṣāsu ca maghāsu ca |
putro vā yadi vā pautro yo no dadyāt trayodaśīm ||
[471]        jāyate kim asau kaścid dhārmiko vaṃśavarddhanaḥ ||
mahābhārate |
api naḥ sa kule bhūyād yo no dadyāt trayodaśīm |
maghāsu sarpiṣā yuktaṃ pāyasaṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ ||
śaṅkha-likhita-yamāś cāhuḥ |
pitā pitāmahaś caiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ |
jātaṃ putraṃ praśaṃsanti pippalaṃ śakunā iva ||
madhumāṃsena khaḍgena payasā pāyasena vā |
eṣa dāsyati naḥ śrāddhaṃ varṣāsu ca maghāsu ca ||
yājñavalkyo ’pi |
yad dadāti gayāsthaś ca sarvam ānantyam aśnute |
tathā varṣātrayodaśyāṃ maghāsu ca viśeṣataḥ ||
prauṣṭhapadyām atītāyāṃ maghāyuktāṃ trayodaśīm |
prāpya śrāddhaṃ prakartavyaṃ madhunā pāyasena vā ||
praśastatarā caiṣā tithir bhādrapadaparapakṣakebhyaḥ tithyantarebhyaḥ |
tathā ca brahmapurāṇe |
yo vā saṃvardhayed dehaṃ pratyahaṃ svātmavikrayāt |
śrāddhaṃ tenāpi kartavyaṃ tais tair dravyaiḥ susaṃcitaiḥ |
trayodaśyāṃ viśeṣeṇa varṣāsu ca maghāsu ca ||
nāsmāt parataraḥ kālaḥ śrāddheṣv anyatra vidyate |
yad atra sākṣāt pitaro gṛhaṃ tv amṛtam akṣayam ||
mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
[472]        uttarād ayanād rājan śreṣṭhaṃ syād dakṣiṇāyanam |
cāturmāsyaṃ tu tatrāpi prasupte keśave ’dhikam ||
proṣṭhapadyāḥ paraḥ pakṣas tatrāpi ca viśeṣataḥ |
pañcapūrvaṃ ca tatrāpi daśapūrvaṃ tato ’pyati |
maghāyuktā ca tatrāpi śastā rājan trayodaśī || iti |
atra 'pañcapūrvaṃ' pañcamīm ārabhya, 'daśapūrvaṃ' daśamīm ārabhyety arthaḥ | āvaśyakaṃ ca tac chrāddham |
uktaṃ hi viṣṇudharmottare |
śrāddhakālam amāvāsyā nityaṃ pārthivasattama |
paurṇamāsī tathā māghī śrāvaṇī ca nṛpottama ||
prauṣṭhapadyām atītāyāṃ tathā kṛṣṇā trayodaśī |
aṣṭakānvaṣṭakās tisras tathaiva ca nṛpottama |
etāṃs tu śrāddhakālān vai nityān āha prajāpatiḥ |
śrāddham eteṣv akurvāṇo narakaṃ pratipadyate || iti |
viṣṇuḥ |
amāvāsyās tisro ’ṣṭakās tisro ’nvaṣṭakā māghīprauṣṭhapadyūrdhvaṃ kṛṣṇā trayodaśīty upanyasya etāṃs tu śrāddhakālān ity amum eva ślokam uktavān |
athātra niṣedhavacanāni |
jyotirbṛhaspatiḥ |
kṛṣṇapakṣe trayodaśyāṃ śrāddhaṃ yaḥ kurute naraḥ |
pañcatvaṃ tasya jānīyāt jyeṣṭhaputrasya niścitam ||
ṣaṭtriṃśanmate |
[473]        gṛhī trayodaśīśrāddhaṃ na kuryāt putravān api |
upavāsaṃ ca saṃkrāntau grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ ||
vāmanapurāṇe |
trayodaśyāṃ tu vai śrāddhaṃ na kuryāt putravān gṛhī |
neṣyate ’tropavāsaś ca kecid apy ayanadvaye ||
āpasambaḥ |
trayodaśyāṃ bahuputro bahumitro darśanīyāpatyo yuvamāriṇas tu bhavanti | iti |
kātyāyanaś cāha
yuvānas tatra mriyante iti |
skānde nāgarakhaṇḍe |
yo vāñchati naro muktiṃ pitṛbhiḥ saha cātmanaḥ |
asantānaś ca yas tasya śrāddhe proktā trayodaśī |
santānayukto yaḥ kuryāt tasya vaṃśakṣayo bhavet ||
ānartta uvāca |
trayodaśyāṃ kṛte śrāddhe kasmād vaṃśakṣayo bhavet |
etan me sarvam ācakṣva vistareṇa mahāmune |'
bhartṛyajña uvāca |
āsīd rathāntare kalpe pūrvaṃ pārthivasattama |
sitāśvo nāma pāñcāladeśīyaḥ pitṛbhaktimān ||
madhunā kālaśākena khaḍgamāṃsena kevalam |
sa hi śrāddhaṃ trayodaśyāṃ kurute pāyasena ca ||
[474]        kadācid brāhmaṇair bhūyaḥ saṃpṛṣṭaḥ kautukānvitaiḥ |
anneṣu vidyamāneṣu vicitreṣu kuto nṛpa ||
asmād u khaḍgamāṃsaṃ naḥ kālaśākaṃ prayacchati |
apratyākhyeyam ity āhuḥ śrāddhe dattaṃ havir dvijaiḥ ||
iti tad bhujyate ’smābhis taddāne kāraṇaṃ vada |
etac chrutvā vacas teṣāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ nṛpo ’bravīt ||
avācyam api vakṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ susamāhitāḥ |
aham āsaṃ purā hiṃsro lubdhakaḥ pitṛbhaktimān ||
bhraman kadācit prāpto ’ham agniveśāśramaṃ niśi |
sa śiṣyān ādiśan vipro dūrasthena mayā śrutaḥ
agniveśa uvāca |
ṛkṣe paitrye yadā candro haṃsaś caiva kare sthitaḥ |
trayodaśyāṃ tu sā chāyā vijñeyā kuñjarāhvayā ||
śrāddhe ’py atipraśastā sā pitṝṇāṃ tṛptikāriṇī |
tat prātaḥ śrāddhasaṃbhārāḥ saṃskriyantām ataḥ śubhāḥ ||
'paitryam ṛkṣaṃ' maghā | ‘haṃsaḥ' sūryaḥ | 'karaḥ' hastaḥ |
sitāśva uvāca |
iti tasya muner vākyam ākarṇyāham acintayam |
ahaś cāpi kariṣyāmi prātaḥ śrāddhakriyām iti ||
tataḥ prabhāte śrāddhīyadravyāthaṃ paryaṭan vane |
khaḍgamāṃsaṃ kālaśākaṃ madhu ca prāptavān aham ||
yathopapannais tair dravyais trayodaśyāṃ samāhitaḥ |
[475]        nijān pitṝn samuddiśya svajātīyān abhojayam ||
śrāddhena tādṛśenāpi pitaro dvādaśābdikīm |
tṛptim āpur ahaṃ cāpi nṛpo jātismaro ’bhavam ||
ato maghātrayodaśyām etair eva hi sādhanaiḥ |
karomi śraddhayā śrāddhaṃ tatprabhāvam anusmaran ||
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā ye cānye ca janā bhuvi |
aśapanta trayodaśyāṃ śrāddhakartṝn kṣudhāvitāḥ ||
īrṣyālavas tatas teṣu vasurudrādayaḥ surāḥ |
nabhasyasya trayodaśyāṃ śrāddhaṃ kartur mudānvitāḥ |
prāpuś ca paramāṃ siddhiṃ spardhamānāḥ surottamaiḥ ||
adyaprabhṛti yaḥ śrāddhaṃ trayodaśyāṃ kariṣyati |
kanyāgate sahasrāṃśau tasya śrāddhasya saṃkṣayaḥ ||
iti śāpena devānāṃ nirdagdheyaṃ mahātithiḥ |
tataḥ prabhṛti naitasyāṃ kriyate śrāddham uttamam ||
yaḥ pramādāc ca kurate tasya śrāddhasya saṃkṣayaḥ |
etat trayodaśīśrāddhaṃ vaṃśocchedasya kāraṇam ||
ataḥ śrāddhaṃ vinā devaṃ taddine madhupāyasam |
khaḍgamāṃsaṃ kālaśākaṃ māṃsaṃ vārdhrīṇasasya ca ||
'vārdhrīṇasaḥ' bṛhacchāgaḥ |
tasyābhāve ’pi dātavyaṃ kṣīrodanam anuttamam |
tasminn ahani viprebhyaḥ pitṝṇāṃ tuṣṭaye nṛpa |
tasyābhāve ’pi dātavyaṃ jalaṃ tilavimiśritam || iti |
[476]        atra kecid āhuḥ | trayodaśīśrāddhaniṣedhavākyānām aprāmāṇyam eva “yat kiṃcin madhunā miśram" ityādimanuvacanavirodhāt | manusmṛtir hi svādhyāyavat prasiddhataratvāt bahubhiḥ sampradāyena paṭhyamānatvāc cāpabhraṣṭapāṭhāsambhavān mūlāntarāc ca kṣudratarebhyo nāmamātreṇāpy aprasiddhebhyaḥ kenacid apy apaṭhyamānebhyo ’navasthitapāṭhebhyaḥ sambhāvitabhrāntyādimūlebhyaḥ svavirodhe pratyakṣaśrutivad balīyasīti |
ata eva bṛhaspatiḥ |
vedārthapratibaddhatvāt prāmāṇyaṃ tu manoḥ smṛtam |
manvarthaviparītā tu yā smṛtiḥ sā na śasyate || iti |
manur apy āha |
yaḥ kacit kasyacit dharmo manunā parikīrtitaḥ |
sa sarvo ’bhihito vede sarvajñānamayo hi saḥ || iti |
ucyate | yat tāvad uktaṃ manusmṛteḥ śrutimūlatvena viruddhasmṛtyantarebhyo balīyastvam iti tatkalpanāmātram | bṛhaspativacanaṃ tu manvarthaviparītānāṃ buddhādismṛtīnām aprāmāṇyam āha, na tu śiṣṭatraivarṇikasvīkṛtakātyāyanādismṛtīnāṃ vedārthapratibaddhatvād ity asya prāmāṇyahetos tāsyapi vidyamānatvāt | ato manuśabdenātra vedārthasmartāraḥ kātyāyanādayo 'py upalakṣyante | atha vā manu jñāne iti dhātupāṭhāt vedārthajñānavān munir manur ucyate | tasmān manusmṛtivirodhe ’pi kātyāyanādismṛtīnāṃ nāprāmāṇaṃ bhavitum arhati |
anye tv āhuḥ | kasyacid api śrāddhasya niṣedhānupapatter niṣedhavākyānām aprāmāṇyam iti | tathā hi na tāvan nityasya śrāddhasya niṣedho ’yaṃ |
[477]        ata āha manuḥ |
dadyād ahar ahaḥ śrāddham annādyenodakena vā |
payomūlaphalair vāpi pitṛbhyaḥ prītim āvahan ||
dakṣo 'py āha |
asnātvā cāpy ahutvā ca adattvā yaḥ samaśnute |
devādīnām ṛṇībhūtvā saprajaḥ sa vrajaty adhaḥ || iti |
paṇḍitaparitoṣe tu 'narakaṃ sa vrajaty adhaḥ' iti caturthaḥ pādaḥ paṭhitaḥ |
mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
tasmāt putreṇa tuṣṭena devarṣipitṛdevatāḥ |
bhūtāni cānudivasaṃ poṣyāṇi svatanur yathā ||
tathā
ahar ahaḥ svadhā kuryād odapātrāt tathaiva ca |
pitṛyajñaṃ samāpnoti ||
iti evam etair vacanair nityasya śraddhasyāhar ahar vidhānād akaraṇe cādhogamanābhidhānāt trayodaśyāṃ tadanuṣṭhānaṃ na pratiṣedhaḥ pratiṣeddhum arhati | nāpi naimittikasya niṣedhaḥ | na tāvan mṛtāhanimittakasya |
yata āha yājñavalkyaḥ |
mṛtāhani tu dātavyaṃ pratimāsaṃ tu vatsaram |
pratisaṃvatsaraṃ caivam ādyam ekādaśe ’hani || iti |
kātyāyano ’py āha |
tataḥ saṃvatsaraṃ pretāyānnaṃ dadyād yasminn ahani pretaḥ syād | iti |
śrāddhānāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sāṃvatsaraṃ smṛtam |
tat prayatnena vai kuryād akurvan narakaṃ vrajet ||
evam anyāsv api smṛtiṣu ca purāṇeṣu ca mṛtāhādivihitasya [478] mṛtāhādiṣv apekṣitatvāt tadanuṣṭhānaṃ na pratiṣedhaḥ pratiṣeddhum arhati | nāpi vṛddhyādinaimittikasya |
akṛtvā mātṛyāgaṃ tu vaidikaṃ yaḥ samācaret |
tasya krodhasamāviṣṭā hantum icchanti mātaraḥ ||
vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ tu kartavyaṃ jātakarmādikeṣu vai |
tatra yugmān dvijān āhur mātṛpūrvāṃś ca mātṛvat || iti |
putrajanmani kartavyaṃ jātakarmasamaṃ naraiḥ ||
ityādibhir vākyaiḥ putrajanmādikāleṣu jātakarmavad āvaśyakatvena vihitatvāt tadanuṣṭhānam iti na pratiṣedhaḥ pratiṣeddhum arhati | nāpi trayodaśīnimittakasya pārvaṇasyaiva, yataḥ,
necchet trayodaśīśrāddhaṃ putravān yaḥ sutāyuṣe |
ekaikasya na kuryāt sa pārvaṇaṃ tu samācaret ||
iti tasyāpy āvaśyakatvena vidhānāt | ekasyaiva tu vargasya na kuryāt pārvaṇaṃ tu samācaret pitṛvargasya mātāmahavargasya caivaṃ vargadvayasya tu kuryād ity arthaḥ | na caikavargāya dīyamānasya śrāddhasya niṣedhaḥ, tathāvidhasya tannimittakasya śrāddhasya prāpter abhāvāt |
pitaro yatra pūjyante tatra mātāmahā dhruvam |
iti dhaumavacanena vargadvayasyaiva śrāddhavidhidarśanāt | nāpi kāmyasya, tasyāpi trayodaśīsambandhenaiva vihitatvāt | tad evaṃ viṣayāsaṃbhavāt pratiṣedhavākyānām aprāmāyam iti |
ucyate | nityanaimittikasya ca kadācit pratiṣedho bhavati yathā sūtakādau | viśeṣavihitasyāpi trayodaśīnimittakasya viśeṣavacanena tanmātraviśeṣakeṇa [479] pratiṣedhaḥ saṃbhavati | yathā “nātirātre ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhṇāti" ity atra grahaṇapratiṣedhaḥ | trayodaśīśrāddhasya ca nityatvād yathā kathaṃcid anuṣṭhānaprāptau satyām api dhaumyasmṛtau vyāmohād ekavargīyaśrāddhasyānuṣṭhāne prasakte pratiṣedhasaṃbhavāt | tasmād viṣayāsambhavāt pratiṣedhavākyānāṃ prāmāṇyaṃ matam | tasmād atra vyavasthā vaktavyā |
tatra tāvac chaṅkhadharaḥ |
maghātrayodaśīśrāddhavidhivākyāni vargadvayoddeśenānuṣṭhīyamānaṃ śrāddham āśrayante niṣedhas tv ekavargoddeśenānuṣṭhīyamānam |
ata eva kārṣṇājiniḥ |
śrāddhaṃ naivaikavargasya trayodaśyām upakramet |
na tṛptās te trayo yasya prajāṃ hiṃsanti tasya te || iti |
ekavargasya pitrādimātrasya nopakramet kiṃ tu mātāmahādisahitasya kuryāt ṣaṇṇāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ śrāddhakaraṇe na trayodaśīpratiṣedhadoṣa ity arthaḥ |
anye tv āhuḥ | santi pramītānāṃ pitṛbhāvaṃ gatānāṃ vargāḥ pitṛvargo mātṛvargo mātulavarga ity evamādayaḥ | atha vā pitṛpakṣīyāṇāṃ sapiṇḍānāṃ vargo mātṛpakṣīyāṇāṃ sapiṇḍānāṃ ca varga ity evaṃ vargadvayam | eṣāṃ vargāṇāṃ madhye kasyacid ekasyaiva vargasya sarveṣāṃ vargāṇāṃ śraddhe labdhādhikāreṇa puruṣeṇa dināntare kasyacid vargasya śrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ kariṣyate ca kasyacid ity evamādi kiṃcit kāraṇam anusandhāya maghātrayodaśyāṃ na kartavyaṃ kiṃ tu sarveṣāṃ vargāṇāṃ kartavyam | yato maghātrayodaśyāḥ pitṛtṛptikāraṇabhūtānāṃ tithīnāṃ madhye śreṣṭhatamatvāt [480] sarveṣāṃ pitṝṇāṃ madhumiśrapāyasādidravyeṇa dīyamānasya śrāddhasyāpekṣitatvāt yebhya eva na dīyate ta eva kupitāḥ śrāddhakartuḥ prajāṃ nāśayantīti vargadvayasya viṣayatvena saṅkocaśrutiḥ prāmāṇikī | tad evaṃ niṣedhavākyānām ekasyaiva vargasya kriyamāṇaṃ śrāddhaṃ viṣaya iti siddham |
anye tv āhuḥ | putravatāpi gṛhiṇā kriyamāṇaṃ trayodaśīśrāddhaṃ viṣaya iti | yathāha jyotirbṛhaspatiḥ |
kṛṣṇapakṣe trayodaśyāṃ yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute naraḥ |
pañcatvaṃ tasya jānīyāt jyeṣṭhaputrasya niścitam ||
ṣaṭtriṃśanmate |
gṛhī trayodaśīśrāddhaṃ na kuryāt putravān api |
upavāsaṃ ca saṃkrāntau grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ ||
smaranti ca |
trayodaśyāṃ tu vai śrāddhaṃ na kuryāt putravān gṛhī |
neṣyate copavāsaś ca kaścid apy ayanadvaye ||
āpastambaḥ
trayodaśyāṃ bahuputro darśanīyāpatyo yuvamāriṣas tu bhavanti || iti |
kātyāyanaś cāha |
yuvānas tatra mriyante | iti |
govindarājas tu putramaraṇarūpeṇa doṣeṇa trayodaśīśrāddhanivṛttiṃ manyate | sa hy evam āha, niyogikatvād asya phalasya kāmyamānam evaitad bhavati, na tv evam eva | tad uktam |
kāmyamānaṃ phalaṃ jñānaṃ nānicchos tad bhaviṣyati | iti |
[481]        tasmāt kriyamāṇe ’pi śrāddhe na putramaraṇarūpam akāmyamānaṃ karmaphalaṃ bhaviṣyati, iti gṛhiṇā putravatāpi kāryaṃ trayodaśīśrāddham iti |
tad ayukam |
trayodaśyāṃ tu vai śrāddhaṃ na kuryāt putravān gṛhī |
ityādiniṣedhavākye ’pekṣitānartharūpaphalaviśeṣaprāpaṇaṃ,
pañcatvaṃ tasya jānīyāj jyeṣṭhaputrasya niścitam |
ityādivākyaiḥ kriyate na punaḥ kasyacin maraṇe abhicārarūpaṃ trayodaśīśrāddhaṃ vidhīyate, niṣidhyamānakriyāphalaṃ cānartharūpatvān na kaścid icchati | na ca sakṛd uccaritaṃ vākyaṃ kaṃcit puruṣaṃ pratīṣṭārthatvena kaṃcic ca pratyanarthatvena putramaraṇaṃ bodhayituṃ śaktaṃ. vākyabhedaprasaṅgāt | paṇḍitaparitoṣakāras tv evaṃ govindarājamataṃ praticikṣepa | na tāvad atra "svargakāmo yajeta" itivat kāmapadaṃ śrūyate | na cābhicaran yajetetivat phalasaṃbandhabodhakaṃ vacanam asti | na ca viśvajidrātrisattravad adhyāhāravipariṇāmau saṃbhavataḥ, anyathāpy upapatteḥ |
maghāyāṃ piṇḍadānena jyeṣṭhaḥ putro vinaśyati |
ityādiśrutīnāṃ vartamānāpadeśanyāyena parvaśrāddhaniṣedhabhūtānāṃ nindārthavādatayopapattes tatra kuto ’tra phalapadaprāptir dūre ca kāmyamānatā | tad āha |
na hy evaṃ kāmyaśabdena vinā yuktā phalaśrutiḥ |
vartamānāpadiṣṭena karaṇatvaṃ na gamyate || iti |
tasmāt,
kṛṣṇapakṣe trayodaśyāṃ yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute naraḥ |
pañcatvaṃ tasya jānīyāj jyeṣṭhaputrasya niścitam ||
[482]        ityādiśrutīnām arthavādatayopapattiḥ, yathā “barhiṣi rajataṃ na deyam" iti śruteḥ, “purā hāsyaṃ saṃvatsarād gṛhe rodanaṃ bhavati yo barhiṣi rajataṃ dadāti" iti | kiṃ caivaṃvādinā,
necchet trayodaśīśrāddhaṃ putravān yaḥ sutāyuṣe |
ekasyaiva na kuryāt sa pārvaṇaṃ tu samācaret ||
iti kathaṃ samarthanīyam | tasmād avicāritamanohare govindarājavyākhyāne nātīvādaraḥ karaṇīyaḥ |
yat tu kaiścid uktaṃ maghātrayodaśyāṃ śrāddhācaraṇasya dharmarūpatvāt tadanuṣṭhāne putramaraṇādyaniṣṭaṃ phalaṃ bhavatīti na yuktam iti | tathā tṛptāḥ santaḥ pitaro ’niṣṭaṃ phalaṃ prayacchantīty api na yukram iti |
tan na vaktavyam | yataḥ śāstrabodhito ’rtho na yuktimātreṇa nivartayituṃ śakyate śāstraikagamyasyārthayuktyaviṣayatvāt |
yat tu mahābhārate dānadharmeṣu,
jñātīnāṃ tu bhavec chreṣṭhaḥ kurvan śrāddhaṃ trayodaśīm |
nāvaśyaṃ tu yuvāno ’sya pramīyante narā gṛhe ||
iti putramaraṇarūpasya doṣasya āpastambādy uktasya nirākaraṇaṃ kṛtaṃ, tad api nātyantakṛtam | nāvaśyam ity abhidhāne doṣasya pākṣikatvābhyanujñānāt |
yat tv avaśyaṃ na mriyanta eveti smṛticandrikākārasya vyākhyānaṃ, tad ayuktam, udāhṛtavākyavirodhāt | tasmāt putravatā gṛhiṇā trayodaśīśrāddhaṃ na kartavyam iti |
tad ayukaṃ | putravato ’pi gṛhiṇo ’nekavargaśrāddhānuṣṭhāne doṣābhāvasya pūrvavākyāvagatatvāt |
kecit tu tat pāyasādidravyavyatirikadravyeṇa śrāddhācaraṇaṃ niṣiddham ity evaṃvidhaṃ viṣayam āhuḥ |
tad ayuktaṃ, pāyasādidravyeṇāpi śrāddhakaraṇe nāgarakhaṇḍe doṣasyoktatvāt | putravato ’pi gṛhiṇo ’nekavargaśrāddhānuṣṭhāne [483] doṣābhāvasya pūrvavākyāvagatatvāt | hariharas tv atraivaṃ dūṣaṇam uktavān | "ayutam etat apadārthavākyāpatteḥ | putrī gṛhī śrāddhaṃ na kuryād ity ete padārthāḥ pāyasavyatiriktadravyeṇa śrāddhaṃ na kartavyam iti vākyārtha" iti |
svayaṃ cedṛśīṃ vyavasthām āha | bhādrapadāparapakṣāntargatamaghānvitatrayodaśyāṃ nityaṃ mahāphalaṃ ca śrāddham | tadartham eva ca pitṝṇāṃ paurāṇikīgāthāsu putraprārthanaṃ mahatā prabandhena śrūyate | atra trayodaśīśrāddhasaṃbandhīni niṣedhavākyāni sāmānyaśāstrarūpatvād bhādrapadāparapakṣatrayodaśīṃ parityajya śeṣāsv ekādaśasu trayodaśīṣu kṛtārthayanty ātmānamiti |
etat tu viśeṣato bhādrapadāparapakṣatrayodaśyām eva śrāddhaniṣedhasya nāgarakhaṇḍetihāse spaṣṭam eva darśitatvāt anatiślāghanīyaṃ | tad evaṃ niṣedhavākyaṃ ekasyaiva vargassa kriyamāṇaśrāddhaviṣayam iti siddham |
tathā ca vacanāntaram |
necchet trayodaśīśrāddhaṃ putravān yaḥ sutāyuṣe |
ekasyaiva na kuryāt sa pārvaṇaṃ tu samācaret ||
atra kecid āhuḥ | kim ayaṃ niṣedhaḥ barhiṣi rajataṃ na deyam itivat, utoktānuvādaḥ na girā gireti brūyād itivat | pūrvasmin kalpe abhāgipratiṣedhaḥ, na khalu pārvaṇaṃ kuryād ity ukte katham apy ekavargaprāptir atsi | parvaṇi amāvāsyāyāṃ kriyamāṇatvāt pārvaṇam | tatra ca tripauruṣeyatvavidhiḥ |
yad āha yājñavalkyaḥ |
dvau daive prāk trayaḥ pitrye ekaikam ubhayatra vā |
[484]        mātāmahānām apy evaṃ tantraṃ vā vaiśvadevikam || iti |
avaśyakartavyatayā śruter ekavargasyāpi yathā kathaṃcit prāptir iti cet, na, tatra sarvathā vargadvayaprāpteḥ |
tad āha dhaumyaḥ |
pitaro yatra pūjyante tatra mātāmahā dhruvam |
aviśeṣeṇa kartavyam anyathā narakaṃ vrajet || iti |
kiṃ caivaṃvādinā niṣedho vidhiś cety ubhayam apy abhyupagantavyam | niṣedhe sati tāvat pārvaṇānuvādo na yujyate | 'bahuvargasya vṛddhiśrāddhasyāpi prāpteḥ pārvaṇaṃ kuryād' iti vidhir abhyupagantavyaḥ | na caikasaṃbhave dvitīyābhyupagamo yujyate | tasmād airaṅ kṛtvodgeyaṃ sa girā gireti brūyād itivad anuvāda evāstv iti cet | na, anarthakānuvādānupapateḥ | gatyantarābhāve hi piṇḍapitṛyajñena hotāraṃ vṛṇīta iti nityānuvādo ’bhyupagataḥ | iha tu na satyāṃ gatau bhavitum arhati | tathāpi 'pārvaṇaṃ kuryād' ity ukte trayodaśīkālasyāpi praśastatvāt |
sapiṇḍīkaraṇe viprān bhojayet pārvaṇe yathā |
iti smṛteḥ, pārvaṇetikartavyatākaṃ śrāddhaṃ prāpnoti tadartho ’yaṃ niṣedhaḥ |
yat tūktam aniyatakālatvāt sapiṇḍīkaraṇasyāprāptiḥ |
tad asat | yadi hi niyatadivasam etat trayodaśyāṃ prāpnuyād etad vargam eva niṣedho gatyantarābhāvād avatiṣṭheta yatas tv aniyamenātrāpi prāpnoti tadā niṣedho yujyate | tasmād ekavargasapiṇḍīkaraṇapratiṣedha evāyaṃ |
ekavargasya na śrāddhaṃ trayodaśyām upakramet | iti |
na tṛptās tatra ye yasya prajāṃ hiṃsanti tasya te | iti |
[485]        tarhi kathaṃ boddhavyaṃ sapiṇḍite itaratṛpter asambhavāt naitatkālasyāpi pitṛvallabhatvāt tatkāle sarva eva mātāmahādayas tatra tṛptim ākāṅkṣanti tatra tatparihāreṇa nānyadivase ’pi śakyakaraṇaṃ śrāddham iti trayodaśyām eva kriyata ity abhipretyāha 'na tṛptās tatra ye yasya prajāṃ hiṃsanti tasya te' iti |
ata evāha |
ekasyaiva na kuryāt sa pārvaṇaṃ tu samācaret |
ekasyaiva vargasya yac chrāddhaṃ tan na kuryāt | na caikasya śrāddhaṃ sapiṇḍanam antareṇa kvacid vihitam asti | tasmāt tasyaivāyaṃ viśeṣataḥ pratiṣedhaḥ putramaraṇanindārthavādo ’pi tasyaiva karaṇe sambhavatīti jñeyaṃ na tu pārvaṇaśrāddhakaraṇe |
yat tu kātyāyanavacanaṃ “yuvānas tatra mriyante” iti tasyārthaḥ | akṣayatṛptiphalatvāt trayodaśīśrāddhasya tasya yuvāno ’pi marttum icchanti na tu mriyante iti |
tathā ca āpastambaḥ |
trayodaśyāṃ bahuputro bahumitraḥ saṃdarśanīyāpatyo ’putramaraṇaś
ca bhavatīti |
aputramaraṇa ity arthaḥ | anyathā bahuputrādiśrutir nirudhyeta |
yathoktam |
yukṣu kurvan dinarkṣeṣu sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt |
ayukṣu tu pitṛśrāddhaṃ prajām āpnoti puṣkalam ||
'yukṣu' dvitīyādiṣu | 'ayukṣu' trayodaśīpratipadādiṣu | 'ṛkṣeṣu' [486] bharaṇyādiṣu | kiṃ ca yājñavalkyena jñātiśraiṣṭhyaṃ trayodaśīśrāddhaphalam uktaṃ na tu jyeṣṭhaputramaraṇam |
vṛddhamanuś cāha |
dvādaśyāṃ mūrttisampannaḥ trayodaśyāṃ bahuprajaḥ |
ayuṣmantīṃ prajāṃ caiva dhanaṃ vaśyaṃ ca vindati ||
tathā ca maghātrayodaśīśrāddhaṃ vidhāyāhatuḥ śaṅkhalikhitau |
prajāṃ puṣṭiṃ yaśaḥ svargyam ārogyaṃ bhūtim eva ca |
nṛṇāṃ śraddhe tathā prītāḥ prayānti ca pitāmahāḥ ||
jñātīnāṃ ca bhavec chreṣṭaḥ kurvan śrāddhaṃ trayodaśīm |
nāvaśyaṃ ca yuvāno ’sya pramriyante narā gṛhe || iti |
tad etad ayuktam |
tathā hi tatra yat tāvad uktaṃ naikavargaśrāddhaṃ sapiṇḍanam antareṇa kvacid vihitam astīti |
tad ayuktaṃ | kṣayāhaśrāddhasyāpy ekavargīyasya vidhānāt |
yata āha saṃgrahakāraḥ |
yājñavalkyena kālas tu amāvāsyādinoditaḥ |
aviśeṣeṇa pitryasya tathā mātāmahasya ca ||
yugapac ca sa vijñeyo vacanād vakṣyamāṇakāt |
kālabhedena tantraṃ syād deśabhedena caiva hi |
tasmāt tatra vidhānāt tu yaugapadyaṃ pratīyate ||
amāvāsyādikāleṣu kālaikatvāt sahakriyā |
mṛtāhani tadābhāvān na pujyeta sahakriyā ||
asyāyam arthaḥ | 'amāvāsyāṣṭakāvṛddhir ityādinā yājñavalkyavacanena [487] pitṛśrāddhasya sāmānyenāmāvāsyādikāla uktaḥ | sa ca yugapadanuṣṭhīyamānayoḥ pitṛśrāddhamātāmahaśrāddhayor aṅgatvenāvagantavyaḥ | 'mātāmahānām apy evaṃ tantraṃ vā vaiśvadevikam' iti tasminn eva prakaraṇe vaiśvadevikatantratvābhidhānasya yugapadanuṣṭhāna evopapadyamānatvāt | ata ekakāla evānuṣṭhīyamānatvenāvagatayoḥ paitṛkamātāmahaśrāddhayoḥ samānatantratā yujyate | mṛtāhe tu pratipuruṣam āyuḥpramāṇabhedāt pitṛmātāmahakṣayāhabhedena mātāmahaśrāddhasya pitṛkṣayāho na kāla iti tannibandhanāt samānatantratā na yujyate |
nanv etenaiva nyāyena pitṛpitāmahādikṣayāhabhedāt pitṛkṣayāhe pitāmahādīnāṃ śrāddhaṃ na kartavyaṃ syāt |
maivam | 'kurvīta darśavac chrāddham' ityatideśavacanāt pitāmahaprapitāmahayor api pitṛkṣayāhe devatātvāt | na ca vācyaṃ darśavadityatideśavacanād eva,
pitaro yatra pūjyate tatra mātāmahā dhruvam |
iti vacanāt, mātāmahādīnām api devatātvam iti |
yata āha vyāsaḥ |
darśavat syāt trayoddeśaḥ sapiṇḍīkaraṇe kṛte |
āha pāraskaraḥ |
pitur gatasya devatvam aurasasya tripauruṣam |
sarvatrānekagotrāṇām ekasyaiva mṛte 'hani ||
devatvaṃ gatasya sapiṇḍīkareṇena pitṛtvaṃ prāptasya pituḥ kṣayāhani aurasasya putrasya tripauruṣaṃ tridevatyaṃ śrāddhaṃ kartavyam anekagotrāṇāṃ [488] bhinnagotrāṇāṃ dauhitrādīnām anapatyamātāmahakṣayāhādiśrāddham ekoddiṣṭam evety arthaḥ | tena darśavad ity atideśaprāpte ṣaḍdevatye tripauruṣam iti punar abhidhānāt pitṛkṣayāhe pitāmahādīnāṃ parisaṅkhyā bhavati |
nanu yat tripuruṣaṃ tad aurasasyeti tripauruṣoddeśenaurasasya niyamāt tritvasyaiva coddeśyaviśeṣaṇatvenāvivakṣitatvāt na mātāmahādiparisaṅkhyā |
