maivam | kṣayāhani tridevatyaśrāddhaprāpyabhāvāt | 'darśavat syāt trayoddeśa' iti vacanāt sapiṇḍīkaraṇottarakālaṃ mṛtāhe ’pi sāmānyena tridevatyaprāptir iti cet, evaṃ tarhy anenaiva mātāmahādīnāṃ parisaṅkhyā bhaviṣyati | kiṃ caurasasya tripauruṣam iti atra trigrahaṇasyāvivakṣitatve vākyam evānarthakaṃ syāt | na hi tripauruṣam atripauṣaṃ ca śrāddham asti yena tripauraṣam aurasasya atripauruṣam anyeṣām ity evaṃ vyavasthānāṃ nānarthakaṃ vākyaṃ bhavet | ekavargīyasakalavihitaśrāddhaniṣedha evāyaṃ bhavatv iti cet | na | vyāmohād ekavargīyaśrāddhaprāpter api prāgabhihitatvāt tatrāpi niṣedhapratipatter durnivārakatvāt | astu ubhayatrāpi niṣedhapravṛttir iti cet | na | vidhivaiṣamyaprasaṅgāt vidhiprāptapratiṣedhe śāstrāntarabādhasāpekṣatvāt vyāmohaprāptapratiṣedhe ca tannirapekṣatvāt | vaiṣamyaparihārārthaṃ vidhiprāptasyaiva niṣedho ’stv iti cet, śāstrabādhaṃ vinā niṣedhasambhave tadbādhasyānupapatteḥ | tena yathā rāgaprāptalābhe vidhispṛṣṭe niṣedho na pravartate evaṃ vyāmohaprāptalābhe ’pīti na kiṃcid anupapannam | "pitaro yatra pūjyante” iti dhaumyavacanenaiva trayodaśyānm apy ekavargaśrāddhaniṣedhasiddhiḥ, viśeyaniṣedho ’yaṃ doṣaviśeṣapradarśanārthaḥ | [489] sa ca doṣaviśeṣaḥ 'śrāddhaṃ naivaikavargasyeti' kārṣṇājinivacanena darśitaḥ |
yat tv 'aputramaraṇa' ity akārapraśleṣeṇa vyākhyānaṃ kṛtaṃ tad ayuktaṃ | udāhṛtanāgarakhaṇḍe 'pi itihāsakātyāyanādivacanavirodhāt | yat tu mriyanta ity asyecchārthatvena vyākhyānaṃ tad api lakṣaṇāprasaṅgād ayuktaṃ | yat tu trayodaśyāṃ bahuputrādiphalaśravaṇaṃ tad anekavargaśrāddhaviṣayam | yathoktam niṣedhe sati pārvaṇānuvādānupapatter niṣedho vidhiś ceti dvayam abhyupagantavyaṃ, na caikasambhave tad yuktam iti, tad apy ayuktaṃ | vidhiniṣedhayor ubhayor api pratīter bādhakābhāvāt | ekavargaśrāddhaniṣedhena bahuvargasya vṛddhiśrāddhasya prāptes tadbādhanārthaṃ 'pārvaṇaṃ tu samācared' iti vidhir abhyupagantavyaḥ | anyathā bhavatpakṣe 'py asyaiva vaiyarthyaṃ syāt | syād etat evaṃ sati kṣayāhaśrāddham api vyāvartate tasya ṣāṭpauruṣatvābhāvāt | athocyate ṣāṭpauruṣatvābhāve ’pi pārvaṇavidhinā kriyamāṇatvāt pārvaṇam | tarhi vṛddhiśrāddham api na vyāvartate tasyāpi pārvaṇavidhinānuṣṭhīyamānatvāt |
ucyate | trayodaśyāṃ kriyamāṇasya mukhyapārvaṇavidhinā kriyamāṇasya mukhyapārvaṇatvābhāvāt pārvaṇasadṛśaṃ pārvaṇam ity abhyupagantavyam |
kṣayāhaśrāddhasya sadṛśaṃ vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ tu na tatheti tad eva vyāvartate na kṣayāhaśrāddham iti kecit |
tad ayuktam | ṣāṭpauruṣasya śrāddhasyātisusadṛśasyālābhe kṣayāhādiśrāddhavyāvṛtter api yuktavāt |
etenaiva siddhaṃ ekavargaśrāddhaṃ sarvam api na kartavyam ity apare |
tad apy ayuktam | niṣedho hi vyāmohaprāptaśrāddhaviṣaya ity uktaṃ | tena tatparyālocanayā tāvat sapiṇḍanakṣayāhaśrāddhādi na vyāvartate | nāpi 'pārvayaṃ tu samācaret' ity asmād [490] bahuvargavṛddhiśrāddhasya kṣayāhādiśrāddhānāṃ ca vyāvṛttiḥ trayodaśyām amāyākavicitacāviśeṣavidhitayopapatteḥ | tathā hi "śrāddhakālam amāvāsvām" iti, “amāvāsyās tisro ’ṣṭakā" iti viṣṇudharmottara-viṣṇusmṛtivacanābhyām udāhṛtatrayodaśyām āvaśyakaṃ śrāddhaṃ vihitaṃ tac ca pārvaṇam evety anenocyate | evaṃ cāsminn upapadyamāne vākye na śrāddhāntaranivṛttiparatve pramāṇam asti | tenaitat siddhaṃ vyāmohaprāpyaikavargaśrāddha-niṣedho ’yam ekasyaiva na kuryād iti | 'pārvaṇaṃ samācared' iti tu trayodaśīvihitāvaśyakaśrāddhaviśeṣavidhir iti |
nanu tatrāpy atideśād eva pārvaṇasiddhiri ti kiṃ vidhinā |
ucyate | pitṛvyādīnām ekoddiṣṭaṃ prāptaṃ tadbādhanārtham ayaṃ pārvaṇavidhiḥ |
tatra kātyāyanaḥ |
sapiṇḍīkaraṇād ūrdhvaṃ pitror eva hi pārvaṇam |
pitṛvyabhrātṛmātṝṇam ekoddiṣṭaṃ sadaiva tu || iti |
etat pitṛvyādisamabhivyāhārāt mātṛsapatnīparaṃ veditavyaṃ | aputrāṇāṃ sāṃvatsarikaśrāddham āha āpastambaḥ |
aputrā ye mṛtāḥ kecit striyo vā puruṣāś ca ye |
teṣām api tu deyaṃ syād ekoddiṣṭaṃ na pārvaṇaṃ ||
mitrabandhusapiṇḍebhyaḥ strīkumārībhya eva ca |
dadyād vai māsikaṃ śrāddhaṃ sāṃvatsaram ato ’nyathā ||
pracetāḥ |
sapiṇḍīkaraṇād ūrdhvam ekoddiṣṭaṃ vidhīyate |
aputrāṇāṃ tu sarveṣām apatnīnāṃ tathaiva ca ||
[491]        'apatnīnāṃ' akṛtavivāhānām |
atriḥ |
bhrātre bhaginyai putrāya śvaśure mātulāya ca |
pitṛvyagurave śrāddham ekoddiṣṭaṃ na pārvaṇaṃ ||
evam ebhir vākyaiḥ pitṛvyādīnām ekoddiṣṭaṃ prāptam iti tadbādhanārthaṃ pārvaṇavidhiḥ | tena
pitṛvyabhrātṛmātṝṇām aputrāṇāṃ tathaiva ca |
mātāmahasyāputrasya śrāddhaṃ tatpitṛvad bhavet ||
iti jātūkarṇyavacanaṃ trayodaśīviṣayaṃ jñeyam | 'pitṛvad' iti pārvaṇavidhinety arthaḥ |
yat tu “pitṛvad bhaved" ity avaśyakartavyatādyotanārtham iti vyākhyātaṃ, tad ayuktaṃ | 'pitṛvad bhaved' ity asyāvaśyakatvamātraviṣayatvena saṃkoce kāraṇābhāvāt pitṛvyādiśrāddhaikoddiṣṭavidhīnāṃ tu trayodaśīvyatiriktaviṣayatvena saṃkocaḥ jātūkarṇyavacanasya ca trayodaśīviṣayatvena saṃkocaś ca, 'pārvaṇaṃ samācared' ityananyathāsiddhatvād yuktam āśrayituṃ | tena niṣedhavākyāny uktaikavargaśrāddhaviṣayāṇīti siddham |
anye tu,
ayanadvitaye śrāddhaṃ viṣuvadvitaye tathā |
yugādiṣu ca sarvāsu piṇḍanirvapaṇād ṛte ||
iti pulasthyavacanād bhādrapadāparapakṣatrayodaśyāś ca yugāditvāt piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ vinā śrāddhaṃ kartavyam iti, niṣedhavākyānāṃ piṇḍadānasahitaṃ śrāddhaṃ viṣaya ity āhuḥ |
kāmyaśrāddhaviṣayatvena vā pratiṣedhavacanāni vyavasthāpanīyāni | yataḥ kāmasambandha eva śrāddhe doṣaḥ smaryate | tathā hi trayodaśīśrāddhakartuḥ [492] jñātiśraiṣṭhyabahuputratvādiphalaṃ kīrtayadbhyāṃ vyāsa-āpastambābhyāṃ putramaraṇe doṣo ’pi tatraivodbhāvitaḥ |
iti aparapakṣatrayodaśīśrāddhanirṇayaḥ |
athāparapakṣa eva caturdaśīśrāddhanirṇayaḥ ||
tatra yājñavalkyaḥ |
pratipatprabhṛtiṣv ekāṃ varjayitvā caturdaśīm |
śastreṇa tu hatā ye vai tebhyas tatra pradīyate || iti ||
mārkaṇḍeya-brahmapurāṇayoḥ |
yuvānaḥ pitaro yasya mṛtāḥ śastreṇa vā hatāḥ |
tena kāryaṃ caturdaśyāṃ teṣāṃ tṛptim abhīpsatā ||
brahmavaivarta-vāyupurāṇayoḥ |
yuvānas tu gṛhe yasya mṛtās teṣāṃ pradāpayet |
śastreṇa ca hatā ye vai teṣāṃ dadyāc caturdaśīm ||
vṛddhamanuḥ |
caturdaśīṃ varjayitvā śrāddhaṃ śrāddhaviśāradāḥ |
prīyante pitaras tasya ye ca śastrahatā raṇe ||
kāmyopakrame ca manuḥ |
jñātiśraiṣṭhyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ tu suprajāḥ |
prīyante pitaraś cāsya ye ca śastrahatā raṇe || iti |
śastragrahaṇam upalakṣaṇam |
ata eva brahmapurāṇe |
[493]        prāyo’naśanaśastrāgniviṣodbandhanināṃ tathā |
caturdaśyāṃ bhavet śrāddhaṃ tṛptyartham iti niścayaḥ || iti |
nāgarakhaṇḍe ’pi |
apamṛtyur bhaved yeṣāṃ śastramṛtyur athāpi vā |
upasargamṛtānāṃ ca viṣamṛtyum upeyuṣām ||
vahninā ca pradagdhānāṃ jalamṛtyum upeyuṣāṃ |
sarpavyāghrahatānāṃ ca śṛaṅgair udbandhanair api ||
śrāddhaṃ teṣāṃ prakartavyaṃ caturdaśyāṃ narādhipa |
teṣāṃ tasmin kṛte tṛptis tatas tatpakṣājā bhavet ||
‘apamṛtyuḥ' akālamṛtyuḥ aprāptajarasām eva mṛtyur ity arthaḥ | yakṣabhūtagrahādyupasṛṣṭānāṃ tu yan maraṇaṃ tad upasargān maraṇam | 'tatpakṣajā' sarvasminn aparapakṣe śrāddhakaraṇād yāvatī tṛptis tāvatīty arthaḥ |
marīcir api |
viṣasarpaśvāpadāditiryagbrāhmaṇaghātinām |
caturdaśyāṃ kriyāḥ kāryā anyeṣāṃ tu vigarhitāḥ ||
viṣādibhir ghāto yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ | anena śastrādihatānām eva caturdaśīkālamātraṃ niyamyate, na tu caturdaśyām eva śastrādihatānām, kiṃ tu teṣām anyasminn api kāle bhavaty eva śrāddham iti |
pracetāpi |
vṛkṣārohaṇalohādyair vidyujjālāviṣādibhiḥ |
nakhadaṃṣṭrivipannānāṃ teṣāṃ śastā caturdaśī || iti |
ādiśabdena giriśikharādiviṣamasthānārohaṇasvaguḍakuṭādy[494] abhighātodbandhanopalapātādayaḥ proktasadharmāṇo maraṇopāyāḥ saṃgṛhyante | yat tūktaviruddhārthaṃ śākaṭāyanavacanam |
jalāgnibhyāṃ vipannānāṃ saṃnyāse vā gṛhe pathi |
śrāddhaṃ kurvīta teṣāṃ vai varjayitvā caturdaśīm || iti |
tatprāyaścittārthavihitajalāgnyādimaraṇaprayuktaprāṇiviṣayam, ye tu pāpamṛtyavas teṣām eva caturdaśyāṃ śrāddhaṃ kartavyam | “vṛkṣārohaṇetyādau pracetovacane pāpamṛtyuprāyapāṭhāt | ata eva pramīte patyau vihitāgnipraveśavidhinānumaraṇakṛtāṃ yoṣitām api na caturdaśīśrāddhaṃ | tad evam avihitair jalajvalanādibhir mṛtānāṃ manu-brahmapurāṇavacanaprāmāṇyāt saṃgrāmaprāyopaveśanamṛtānāṃ ca kṛṣṇacaturdaśīśrāddham iti siddham | tatkṛtasapiṇḍīkaraṇasyāpy ekoddiṣṭam eva kartavyam |
yad āha gārgyaḥ |
caturdaśyāṃ tu yat śrāddhaṃ sapiṇḍīkaraṇāt param |
ekoddiṣṭavidhānena tat kāryaṃ śastraghātinaḥ || iti |
manuḥ |
ekapiṇḍīkṛtānāṃ tu pṛthaktvaṃ nopapadyate |
sapiṇḍīkaraṇād ūrdhvaṃ mṛte kṛṣṇacaturdaśīm || iti |
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
samatvam āgatasyāpi pituḥ śastrahatasya tu |
ekoddiṣṭaṃ sutaiḥ kāryaṃ caturdaśyāṃ mahālaye ||
pretatvaparityāgena pitṛtvaṃ prāptaiḥ pitāmahādibhiḥ saha sapiṇḍīkaraṇe pretatvaparityāgena pitṛtvaprāptyā sārūpyam āgatasyāpīty arthaḥ | śastrahatasya [495] pitur mahālaye caturdaśām ekoddiṣṭaśrāddhe kṛte ’pi dināntare pārvaṇaśrāddhaṃ kāryam ekoddiṣṭaśrāddhena pitāmahāditṛptyasiddheḥ |
nanv evaṃ mṛtāhe ’py ekoddiṣṭe kṛte pārvaṇaśrāddham api pitāmahāditṛptisiddhyarthaṃ kartavyaṃ syāt |
maivaṃ | pitur mṛtāhe pitāmahādes tarpaṇīyatvāsmaraṇāt tattṛptyarthaṃ śrāddhasyānuṣṭhānaṃ syāt | mahālaye tu |
kāṅkṣanti putrapautrebhyaḥ pāyasaṃ madhusaṃyutam |
tasmāt tāṃs tatra vidhinā tarpayet pāyasena tu ||
madhvājyatilamiśreṇeti pitāmahāder api tarpaṇīyatvasmaraṇāt tattṛptaye dināntare pārvaṇaśrāddhaṃ kāryam eva | yasya tu pitāmaho ’pi śastrādihatas tasya mahālaye pitāmahaśrāddham api caturdaśyām ekoddiṣṭaṃ kāryam | tathā ca smṛtyantare | “ekasmin dvayor vaikoddiṣṭavidhir" iti | ekasmin pitari pitāmahe vā śastrādinā hate pitrāditrayamadhye dvayor vā śastrādinā hatayoś caturdaśyām ekoddiṣṭavidhinā pratyekaṃ śrāddhaṃ
kāryamityarthaḥ | dvayor ekoddiṣṭavidhānena pratyekaṃ śrāte kṛte ’pi prapitāmahatṛptisiddhyarthaṃ dināntare’pi śrāddhaṃ kāryam | pitrādiṣu triṣv api śastrādinā hateṣu pṛthag ekoddiṣṭāny eva kāryāṇi |
atra kaścid āha | ekasmin dvayor vā" ity abhidhānāt triṣu pitṛpitāmahaprapitāmaheṣu naikoddiṣṭavidhir iti gamyate, tena triṣu śastrādihateṣu caturdaśyāṃ pārvaṇavidhir eva | yuktaṃ caitat | sapiṇḍīkṛtānāṃ trayāṇām api caturdaśīvihitarūpakālasaṃbhave saty api śastrahatādiprāptikṛtaikakālāsambhavanibandhanasyaikoddiṣṭavidher anavatārāt | anenaivābhiprāyeṇa aparākeṇāpy uktaṃ [496] "tatra caikasya śastrahatatve ekoddiṣṭavidhānaṃ na tu trayāṇaṃ, tathātve tatra tu pārvaṇam eveti | trayāṇāṃ 'tathātve' śastrahatatve, naikoddiṣṭavidhānaṃ kiṃ tu tatra pārvaṇam eveti tasyārthaḥ |
anye tv āhuḥ | ayuktam etat | “ekasmin dayor vā" ity asyopalakṣaṇatvāt ekoddiṣṭavidheś ca śastrādihatatvanimittatvān na kālāsambhavanibandhanatvaṃ kālāsambhavasyāśrutatvāt | ekoddiṣṭavidhes tannibandhanatve kalpanāmātramūlatvāpatteḥ | ata eva devasvāminābhihitaṃ, “triṣv api śastrādihateṣu pṛthag ekoddiṣṭatrayam eva kāryaṃ na tu pārvaṇaṃ āhatavacanābhāvād" iti |
tad ayuktaṃ, upalakṣaṇatve lakṣaṇāprasaṅgāt |
atra śastrādihatānāṃ caturdaśyām eva ekoddiṣṭam iti vākyārthāvagamāt mṛtāhādau pārvaṇaṃ kartavyam | ye tu caturdaśyām eva śastrādibhir mṛtās teṣāṃ mṛtāhe kiṃ pārvaṇam ekoddiṣṭaṃ veti saṃśaye ’bhidhīyate | caturdaśīnimittikasya mṛtāhanimittakasya ca śrāddhakalpīyakālasamavāyaprakaraṇoktanyāyena bhede ’pi yugapad anekanimittopanipāte ekenaiva naimittikena kutapādikālavirodhe dvitīyasyānavakāśe deśakālakartṛdevataikye viśeṣāgrahaṇāt tantreṇa naimittikānuṣṭhāne sati svakulavṛddhaparamparānusārān mṛtāhe ’pi yair ekoddiṣṭapakṣaparigrahaḥ kṛtaḥ teṣāṃ mṛtāhanimittakam api caturdaśyām ekoddiṣṭam eva | yais tu pārvaṇaparigrahaḥ kṛtaḥ sa tair uditahomavad yāvajjīvaparigṛhīta eveti caturdaśyām api na tair asau parityājyaḥ | yas tu caturdaśyāṃ pārvaṇaniṣedhaḥ śrāddhasya sa caturdaśīnimittasya na mṛtāhanimittakasyāpi |
nanu caturdaśyāṃ pārvaṇam ity atra caturdaśīnimittakaṃ yac caturdaśyām iti [497] viśeṣaṇādhyāhāravākyabhedau syātāṃ |
maivaṃ | prakṛtatvādinā viśeṣalābhasyopanyastadoṣānāspadatvāt | anyathāvaghātādiniyamo ’pūrvīyeṇa na sambadhyate | yac ca nāgarakhaṇḍe caturdaśyāṃ kriyamāṇasya pārvaṇasya vaiphalyam uktam | tad api caturdaśīnimittakasyeti |
atha sa kiṃ caturdaśīnimittam ekoddiṣṭaṃ mṛtāhanimittaṃ ca pārvaṇam iti śrāddhadvayaṃ kuryāt ekam eva vā aṅgavaidharmyād gṛhyamāṇaviśeṣatvena tantrānuṣṭhānāsambhavāt saṃśayaḥ | tatra samāne ’hani naikaḥ śrāddhadvayaṃ kuryād ity asya niṣedhasya bhinnanimittakaśrāddhagocaratvābhāvāt śrāddhadvayaṃ kuryāt |
maivaṃ | devataikyāt pradhānadvayasahānuṣṭhāne bhūyasāṃ śrāddhadharmāṇām anugrahāya pārvaṇadharmair ekoddiṣṭadhadharmabādhe pārvaṇenaiva naimittikadvayasiddhau na bhedena śrāddhadvayānuṣṭhānam iti |
nanu kāmyam api caturdaśīśrāddham asti kāmapravaṇapravṛttitvāc ca narāṇāṃ kāmyapravṛtter utkaṭatvāc caturdaśīnimittake śrāddhe ’nuṣṭheye saty ekoddiṣṭadharmā eva prāpnuvanti, bhaved evaṃ yadi bhūyasām anugraho ’tra viśeṣo nāvagamyeta | astu vāsyāṃ tithau nimittabhedāt naimittikabhede śrāddhadvayam iti | mahālayapakṣe ca kathaṃcic caturdaśyāṃ śrāddhāsambhave tatpakṣamadhye kasmiṃścid api dine śrāddhaṃ kartavyaṃ praśastataramukhyakālāsambhave ’pi tatpakṣakartavyasya śrāddhasyāvaśyakatvāt dināntare ca śastrahatānām api pārvaṇam eva caturdaśyām evaikoddiṣṭavidhānāt | caturdaśyāṃ śastrādihatānām ekoddiṣṭaṃ kartavyam ity atra kāraṇam uktaṃ nāgarakhaṇḍe |
ānartta uvāca |
kasmāc chastrahatānāṃ ca prokrā śrāddhe caturdaśī |
[498]        ekoddiṣṭaṃ kutaś cātra kāraṇaṃ prabravīhi me ||
bhartṛyajña uvāca |
bṛhatkalpe purā rājan hiraṇyākṣo mahāsuraḥ |
babhūva balavān śūraḥ sarvadevabhayaṅkaraḥ ||
brahmā pratoṣitas tena vidhāya vividhaṃ tapaḥ |
kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ nabhasye māsi saṃsthite ||
brahmovāca |
parituṣṭo ’smi te vatsa prārthayasva yathepsitaṃ |
adeyam api dāsyāmi durlabhaṃ yat surāsuraiḥ ||
hiraṇyākṣa uvāca |
bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācāś ca rākṣasā daityadānavāḥ |
bubhukṣitāḥ pradhāvanti māṃ nityaṃ padmasambhava ||
pitṛpakṣe kṛte śrāddhe kanyāsaṃsthe divākare |
etasminn ahani prāyas tṛptiḥ syād varṣasambhavā |
tad eṣām atra divase tṛpyupāyaṃ kuru prabho ||
brahmovāca |
yaḥ kaścin mānavaḥ śrāddhaṃ svapitṛbhyaḥ pradāsyati |
pitṛpakṣe caturdaśyāṃ nabhasye māsi saṃsthite ||
pretānāṃ rākṣasānāṃ ca bhūtānāṃ tad bhaviṣyati |
mama vākyād asaṃdigdhaṃ ye cānye kīrttitās tvayā ||
durmṛtyunā mṛtā ye ca saṃgrāmeṣu hatāś ca ye |
ekoddiṣṭe sutair datte teṣāṃ tṛptir bhaviṣyati ||
[499]        evam uktvā tato brahmā gataś cādarśanaṃ nṛpa |
hiraṇyākṣo ’pi saṃhṛṣṭaḥ svam eva bhavanaṃ yayau ||
yac ca śastrahatānāṃ ca tasminn ahani dīyate |
ekoddiṣṭaṃ naraiḥ śraddhaṃ tat te vakṣyāmi kāraṇam ||
saṅkhye śastrahatā ye ca nirvikalpena cetasā |
yudhyamānā na te martyā jāyante manujāḥ punaḥ ||
parāṅmukhā ye hanyante palāyanaparāyaṇāḥ |
te bhavanti narāḥ pretā etad āha pitāmahaḥ |
saṃmukhā api vai dainyaṃ hanyamānā vadanti ca |
paścāttāpaṃ ca vā kuryuḥ prahārair jarjarīkṛtāḥ ||
te ’pi pretā bhavantīha manuḥ svāyambhuvo ’bravīt |
kadācic cittacalanaṃ śūrāṇām api jāyate |
teṣām api dine tatra deyaṃ pretatvaśaṅkayā ||
apamṛtyumṛtānāṃ ca sarveṣām eva dehinām |
pretatvaṃ jāyate yasmāt tasmāt teṣāṃ hi tad dinam ||
śrāddhāhaṃ pārthivaśreṣṭha viśeṣeṇa prakīrttitaṃ |
ekoddiṣṭaṃ prakartavyaṃ tasmāt tatra dine naraiḥ |
sapiṇḍīkaraṇād ūrdhvaṃ tat te vakṣyāmi kāraṇam ||
yadi pretatvam āpannaḥ kadācit tatpitā bhavet |
tṛptyarthaṃ tatra kartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ tatra dine nṛpa ||
pitāmahādyās tatrāhni śrāddhaṃ nārhanti karhicit |
[500]        atha ced bhrāntito dadyād hriyate rākṣasais tu tat ||
brahmaṇo vacanād rājan bhūtapretaiś ca dānavaiḥ |
tenaikoddiṣṭam evātra kartavyaṃ na tu pārvaṇam ||
pitṛpakṣe caturdaśyāṃ kanyāsaṃsthe divākare |
etasmāt kāraṇāt śrāddhaṃ pārvaṇaṃ naiva kārayet |
etasminn ahani prāpte vyarthaṃ śrāddhaṃ bhaved yataḥ ||
ity aparapakṣacaturdaśīkālanirṇayaḥ |
athāyanādayaḥ śrāddhakālāḥ |
tatra viṣṇupurāṇe |
upaśave candramaso raveś ca
triṣv aṣṭakāsv apy ayanadvaye ca |
pānīyam apy atra tilair vimiśraṃ
dadyāt pitṛbhyaḥ prayato manuṣyaḥ ||
śrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ tena samāsahasraṃ
rahasyam etat pitaro vadanti |
atra kila 'pānīyam api' iti vacanād āvaśyakatā śrāddhasyocyate iti manyante | yat tu
ādityasaṃkramaṃ viṣuvad dvayaṃ vyatīpāto janmarkṣaṃ candrasūryagrahas tathā | etāṃs tu śrāddhakālān vai kāmyānāha prajāpatiḥ |
iti viṣṇuvacane grahaṇādeḥ kāmyaśrāddhakālatvam uktam |
tan na nityatvanirākaraṇakṣamaṃ vākyadvayabalenāgnihotrādivan nityatvakāmyatvayor avirodhāt |
[501]        āha śaṅkhaḥ |
hasticchāyāsu yad dattaṃ yad dattaṃ rāhudarśane |
viṣuvaty ayane caiva sarvam ānantyam ucyate |
atrāyanadvayam, “viṣuvatsūryamaṃkrama" ity asmin yājñavalkyavacane ayanayor viṣuvatoś ca saṃkrāntipadenaiva saṃgrahasiddhāv api yat pṛthag abhidhānaṃ tat saṃkrāntyantarebhyo viṣuvat, viṣuvād ayanam iti yathā pūrvaṃ prāśastyātiśayapratipādanārtham iti mantavyam |
tathā ca viṣṇudharmottare |
śrāddhe saṃkramaṇaṃ bhānoḥ praśastaṃ pṛthivīpate |
viṣuvad dvitayaṃ tatra ayane dve viśeṣataḥ ||
viṣuvator ayanayoś ca lakṣaṇaṃ nāgarakhaṇḍe |
yadā syān meṣago bhānus tulāṃ vātha yadā vrajet |
tadā syād viṣuvākhyas tu kālaś cākṣayakārakaḥ ||
makare karkaṭe caiva yadā bhānur vrajen nṛpa |
tadāyanābhidhānaś ca viṣuvāc ca viśiṣyate ||
asmiṃś ca kāle piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ vinaiva śrāddhaṃ kartavyaṃ |
yad āha pulastyaḥ |
ayanadvitaye śrāddhaṃ viṣuvadvitaye tathā |
saṃkrāntiṣu ca kartavyaṃ piṇḍanirvapaṇād ṛte || iti |
eteṣu kāleṣu piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ vinā śrāddhaṃ kartavyam | etatkālanimitta [502] eva śrāddhe piṇḍanirvapaṇapratiṣedho ’yaṃ, na mṛtāhādinimitakaprasaṅgād ayanādiṣv āpatite, yasmāt 'ayanadvitaye śrāddham' ity anenāyanādibhir nityānvitaṃ śrāddham avagamyate | tannimittakam eva ca tair nityānvitaṃ nānyat nityānvayaś cānityānvayād balīyān bhavati |
kiṃ ca |
atra hi vidhīyamānasya śrāddhasya piṇḍanirvapaṇād ṛte iti viśeṣaṇaṃ na prasaṅgāt tatkālapatitamṛtāhādiśrāddham āśrayitum arhati yady evaṃvidhaṃ śrāddham eteṣu kāleṣu vidhīyate, tathā hi bhāvārthavidhir ity eṣa guṇo bhavati |
śātātapasmṛtau liṅgapurāṇe ca |
sarvasvenāpi kartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ vai rāhudarśane |
akurvāṇas tu yac chrāddhaṃ paṅke gaur iva sīdati ||
itivacanaṃ śrāddhasyāvaśyakatāṃ gamayati |
kūrmapurāṇe cāsya śrāddhasya naimittikatvenāvaśyakatvaṃ pratipādya kāmyatvaṃ pratipāditam |
amāvāsyāṣṭakās tisraḥ pauṣamāsādiṣu triṣu |
tisraś cānvaṣṭakāḥ puṇyā māghī pañcadaśī tathā ||
trayodaśī maghāyuktā varṣāsu ca viśeṣataḥ |
tasya pākaśrāddhakālā nityāḥ proktā dine dine ||
naimittikaṃ tu kartavyaṃ grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ |
bāndhavānāṃ ca maraṇe nārakī syād ato ’nyathā ||
kāmyāni caiva śrāddhāni śasyante grahaṇādiṣu |
ayane viṣuve caiva vyatīpāte ’py anantakam ||
[503]        saṃkrāntyām akṣayaṃ śrāddhaṃ yathā janmadineṣv api |
nakṣatreṣu ca sarveṣu kāryaṃ kāmyaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||
ityādi | mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
viśiṣṭabrāhmaṇaprāptau sūryendugrahaṇe ’yane |
viṣuve ravisaṃkrāntau vyatīpāte ca putraka ||
śrāddhārhadravyasampattau tathā duḥkhapradarśane |
janmarkṣagrahapīḍāsu śrāddhaṃ kurvīta cecchayā | iti ||
atra sūryagrahaṇādikāleṣu tathā icchayā śrāddhaṃ prati rucyā vā śrāddhaṃ kuryāt | atha vā pūrvokteṣv eva kāleṣu icchayā svargādiphalakāmanayā śrāddhaṃ kuryād itīcchayety asyārthaḥ | na punar yadīcchati kartuṃ tarhi kuryād iti |
ity ayanādayaḥ śrāddhakālāḥ |
atha dravyabrāhmaṇasampattyupalakṣitaḥ kālaḥ |
tatra hārītaḥ |
tīrthe dravyopapattau ca na kālam avadhārayet |
pātraṃ ca brāhmaṇaṃ prāpya sadyaḥ śrāddhaṃ vidhīyate ||
'tīrthaṃ' gayādi | 'dravyaṃ' annādi | śrotriyatvādiviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭaṃ ca brāhmaṇaṃ prāpya na kālāntaraṃ pratīkṣeta | kiṃ tu tasminn eva kāle śrāddhaṃ kuryāt | atra ca sadya iti vacanād āvaśyakatvaṃ pratīyate |
yat tu mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
viśiṣṭabrāhmaṇaprāptau sūryendugrahaṇe ’yane |
śrāddhārhadravyasampattau tathā duḥkhapradarśane ||
janmarkṣagrahapīḍāsu śrāddhaṃ kurvīta cecchayā || iti |
atra cecchāpadaṃ nityatvena virudhyate, tathā vyākhyātam evāyanādiśrāddhakālanirūpaṇe |
brahmapurāṇe |
yadā ca śrotriyo ’bhyeti gṛhaṃ vedavid agnivat |
tenaikenāpi kartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ viṣuvavac chubhaṃ ||
śrāddhīyadravyasaṃprāptir yadā syāt sādhusaṃmatā |
pārvaṇena vidhānena śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ dijottamaiḥ ||
viṣṇupurāṇe dravyabrāhmaṇasampattyupalakṣite kāle kāmyam api śrāddham uktaṃ | tathā hi tatra kāmyān śṛṇuṣvety anantaraṃ bhavati vacanaṃ |
śraddhārham āgataṃ dravyaṃ viśiṣṭam atha vā dvijaṃ |
śrāddhaṃ kurvīta vijñāya vyatīpāte ’yane tathā ||
iti brāhmaṇasampattyupalakṣitakālanirūpaṇaṃ |
atha gajacchāyā |
skandapurāṇādau |
yadenduḥ pitṛdaivatye haṃsaś caiva kare sthitaḥ |
tithir vaiśravaṇīyā ca gajacchāyeti sā smṛtā || iti |
[505]        'induḥ' candramāḥ, 'pitṛdaivatye' nakṣatre maghāyāṃ, 'haṃsaḥ' sūryaḥ, 'kare' hastanakṣatre | 'tithir vaiśravaṇīyā' trayodaśī |
narasiṃhapurāṇe |
haṃse haṃsasthite yā tu maghāyuktā trayodaśī |
tithir vaivasvatī nāma sā chāyā kuñjarasya tu ||
brahmapurāṇe |
yogo maghātrayodaśyāṃ kuñjaracchāyasaṃjñakaḥ |
bhaven maghāyāṃ saṃsthe ca śaśiny arke karasthite || iti |
ayam arthaḥ, sūrye hastasthite candrādhiṣṭhitābhir maghābhiḥ trayodaśyāṃ yogo gajacchāyasaṃjñakaḥ sa ca bhādrapadāparapakṣe saṃbhavati | "vibhāṣā senāsurācchāyeti" chāyāśabdasya napuṃsakatvaṃ |
haṃse haṃsasthite yā tu amāvāsyā karānvitā |
sā jñeyā kuñjaracchāyā iti baudhāyano ’bravīt ||
'haṃsa' sūryaḥ, haṃsadevatvāt hastanakṣatram api 'haṃsaḥ' | 'karānvitā' candrayuktahastānvitā |
saiṃhikeyo yadā sūryaṃ grasate parvasandhiṣu |
gajacchāyā tu sā proktā tasyāṃ śrāddhaṃ prakalpayet || iti |
‘saiṃhikeyaḥ' rāhuḥ | ‘parvasandhiṣu' amāvāsyāpradipadoḥ sandhiṣu |
atha prakīrṇakālaḥ |
matsyapurāṇe |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi viṣṇunā yad udīritam |
[506]        śrāddhaṃ sādhāraṇaṃ nāma bhuktimuktiphalapradam ||
ayane viṣuve yugme sāmānye vārkasaṃkrame |
amāvāsyāṣṭakāyāṃ ca kṛṣṇapakṣe viśeṣataḥ ||
ādrāmaghārohiṇīṣu dravyabrāhmaṇasaṅgame |
gajacchāyāvyatīpāte viṣṭivaidhṛtivāsare ||
tathā |
vaiśākhyām uparāgeṣu tathotsavamahālaye |
brahmapurāṇe |
śrāddhaṃ deyam uśantīha māsi māsy uḍupakṣake |
pūrṇamāse ’pi ca śrāddhaṃ karttavyam ṛkṣagocare ||
nityaṃ śrāddhaṃ vidheyaṃ ca manuṣyair iha gīyate |
vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ ca karttavyaṃ jātakarmādike budhaiḥ ||
kanyāgate savitari dināni daśa pañca ca |
pārvaṇeneha vidhinā śrāddhaṃ tat tu vidhīyate ||
āha jātūkarṇaḥ |
grahoparāge ca sute ca jāte
pitrye maghāyām ayanadvaye ca |
nityaṃ ca śaṅkhe ca tathaiva padme
dataṃ bhaven niṣkasahastratulyam ||
atra ca nityaṃ dattam ity anvayāvagamāt grahoparāgādiṣu śrāddhāder nityatāṃ bruvate | atha vā "nityam ahar ahar yāvajjīvaṃ pitrye maghāyām"iti bhādrapadāparapakṣasthitamaghāsv ity arthaḥ | [507]
śaṅkhapadmayor lakṣaṇam api sa evāha |
śaṅkham āhur amāvāsyāṃ kṣīṇacandrāṃ dvijottamāḥ |
aṣṭakāsu bhavet padmaṃ tatra dattaṃ tathākṣayam || iti |
śaṅkhas tv āha |
yadā viṣṭir vyatīpāto bhānuvāras tathaiva ca |
padmakaṃ nāma tat proktam ayanāc ca caturguṇam || iti |
viṣṇudharmottare |
āśvinasyāparaṃ pakṣaṃ prathamaṃ kārttikasya tu |
yas tu śrāddhaṃ sadā kuryāt so ’śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ||
nidrāṃ tyajati sarvātmā yasmin kāle janārdanaḥ |
tatra śrāddham athānantaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
tathā |
akṣayaṃ ca tataḥ śrāddhaṃ vijñeyaṃ rāhudarśane |
vrīhipākena karttavyaṃ yavapākena pārthiva |
na tau varjyau mahārāja vinā śrāddhaṃ kathaṃcana ||
śātātapaḥ |
navodake navānne ca gṛhaprasthāpane tathā |
pitaraḥ spṛhayanty annaṃ varṣāsu ca maghāsu ca |
tasmād dadyāt sadodyukto vidvatsu brāhmayeṣu ca ||
āha pitāmahaḥ |
amāvāsyāvyatīpātapaurṇamāsyaṣṭakāsu ca |
[508]        vidvān śrāddham akurvāṇo narakaṃ pratipadyate ||
iti prakīrṇakālaḥ |
iti nityaśrāddhakālaḥ |
atha kāmyaśrāddhakālaḥ |
tatra tāvat tithayaḥ |
āha kātyāyanaḥ |
atha kāmyāni bhavanti, striyo ’pratirūpāḥ pratipadi | dvitīyāyāṃ ca tṛtīyāyāṃ ca sarvān kāmān | caturthyāṃ kṣudrapaśavaḥ | putrāḥ pañcamyāṃ | ṣaṣṭhyāṃ śrāddhabhāgī | kṛṣiḥ saptamyāṃ | vāṇijyam aṣṭamyāṃ | ekaśaphaṃ navamyāṃ | daśamyāṃ gāvaḥ | paricārakā ekādayāṃ | dvādaśyāṃ dhanadhānyakulaṃ | jñātiśraiṣṭhyaṃ hiraṇyāni trayodaśyāṃ yuvānas tatra mriyante | śastrahatasya caturdaśyāṃ | amāvāsyāyāṃ sarvam || iti |
āpastambaḥ |
sarveṣv evāparapakṣasyāhaḥsu kriyamāṇe pitṝn prīṇayanti | kartuḥ kālābhiniyamāt phalaviśeṣaḥ | prathame ’hani kriyamāṇe strīprāyam apatyaṃ jāyate | dvitīye stenāḥ | tṛtīye brahmavarcasvinaḥ | caturthe kṣudrapaśumān | pañcame madhumāṃso bahvapatyo na cānapatyaḥ pramīyate | ṣaṣṭhe duḥśīlasya | saptame kṛṣiḥ | aṣṭame puṣṭiḥ | navame ekakhurāḥ | daśame vyavahārarddhiḥ | ekādaśe kṛṣṇāyasaṃ trapusīsaṃ | dvādaśe paśumān | trayodaśe ca bahuputro bahumitro darśanīyāpatyo yuvamāriṇas tu bhavanti | caturdaśe tu āyurvṛddhiḥ | pañcadaśeṣu puṣṭiḥ satataṃ śrāddhaṃ kurvann āpnoti | iti |
[509]
adhikāre viṣṇuḥ |
gṛhe surūpāḥ striyaḥ pratipadi | kanyāṃ varāṃ dvitīyāyāṃ | sarvān kāmān tṛtīyāyām | caturthyāṃ śriyaṃ | pañcamyāṃ dyūtavijayaṃ | ṣaṣṭhyāṃ kṛṣiṃ | saptamyāṃ vāṇijyaṃ | aṣṭamyāṃ vājinaḥ | paśūn navamyāṃ | daśamyāṃ gāvaḥ | putrāḥ brahmavarcasvinas tv ekādaśyām | kanakarajate dvādaśyāṃ | saubhāgyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ | sarvān kāmān pañcadaśyām | śastrahatānāṃ śrāddhakarmaṇi caturdaśī śastā |
śrāddhaṃ kuryād ity adhikāre hārītaḥ |
pañcamīṃ putrakāmaḥ | ṣaṣṭhīṃ dhanakāmaḥ | saptamīṃ paśukāmaḥ | aṣṭamīṃ śastrahatānām ārogyakāmaḥ | navamīṃ senākāmaḥ | daśamīm annādyakāmaḥ | ekādaśīm ṛddhikāmaḥ | dvādaśīṃ strīkāmaḥ | trayodaśīṃ yaśaskāmaḥ | caturdaśīṃ bhūtikāmaḥ | svastikāmo ’māvāsyāyāṃ sarvakāmaḥ |
paiṭhīnasiḥ |
pañcamyāṃ putrakāmo yajeta | ṣaṣṭhyāṃ paśukāmaḥ | saptamyām ṛddhikāmaḥ | aṣṭamyām annādyakāmaḥ | navamyāṃ brahmavarcasakāmaḥ | daśamyāṃ sarvakāmaḥ | ekādaśyāṃ dhanakāmaḥ | dvādaśyāṃ kṣetrakāmaḥ | trayodaśyāṃ strīvaśitvam | caturdaśyāṃ śastreṇa hatānām | sarvakāmo ’māvāsyāyām |
manuḥ |
kurvan pratipadi śrāddhaṃ surūpān labhate sutān |
kanyakān tu dvitīyāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ tu bandinaḥ ||
paśūn kṣudratan tu pañcamyāṃ śobhanān sutān |
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ dyūtaṃ kṛṣiṃ vāpi saptamyāṃ labhate naraḥ ||
[510]        aṣṭamyām api vāṇijyaṃ labhate śrāddhadaḥ sadā |
syān navamyām ekakhuraṃ daśamyāṃ tu khuraṃ bahu ||
ekādaśyāṃ tathārogyaṃ brahmavarcasvinaḥ sutān |
dvādaśyāṃ jātarūpaṃ ca rajataṃ kupyam eva ca ||
jātiśraiṣṭhyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ tu suprajāḥ |
prīyante pitaraś cātra ye śastreṇa hatā raṇe ||
ityādīṃś ca vinirdiṣṭān vipulān manasaḥ priyān |
śrāddhadaḥ pañcadaśyāṃ tu sarvān kāmān samaśnute ||
'bandinaḥ' stāvakān |
brahmapurāṇa-mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇayoḥ |
kanyāgate savitari dināni daśa pañca ca |
pārvaṇeneha vidhinā śrāddhaṃ tatra vidhīyate ||
pratipad dhanalābhāya dvitīyā dvipadapradā |
varārthinī tṛtīyā tu caturthī śatrunāśinī ||
śriyaṃ prāpnoti pañcamyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ puṣṭo bhaven naraḥ |
gaṇādhipatyaṃ saptamyām aṣṭamyāṃ buddhim uttamām ||
striyo navamyāṃ prāpnoti daśamyāṃ pūrṇakāmatām |
vedāṃs tathāpnuyāt sarvān ekādaśyāṃ kriyāparaḥ ||
dvādaśyāṃ ca prajālābhaṃ prāpnoti pitṛpūjakaḥ |
prajāṃ medhāṃ paśuṃ vṛddhiṃ svātantryaṃ puṣṭim uttamām ||
dīrgham āyur athaiśvaryaṃ kurvāṇas tu trayodaśīm |
avāpnoti na saṃdehaḥ śrāddhaṃ śraddhaparo naraḥ ||
[511]        yuvānaḥ pitaro yasya smṛtāḥ śastreṇa vā hatāḥ |
tena kāryaṃ trayodaśyāṃ teṣāṃ tṛptim abhīpsatā ||
śrāddhaṃ kurvann amāyāṃ tu yatnena puruṣaḥ śuciḥ |
sarvān kāmān avāpnoti svargaṃ cānantyam aśnute ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
striyaḥ svarūpāś ca gṛhe kanyājanma tathā dhanam |
sarvān kāmān yaśaś caiva śriyaṃ dyūtajayaṃ kṛṣim ||
vāṇijyaṃ paśavaś caiva vājinaś ca tathā sutān |
suvarṇaṃ rūpasaubhāgyaṃ prāpnoti śrāddhadaḥ kramāt ||
pratipatprabhṛtiṣv etad yāvad rājaṃs trayodaśīm |
caturdaśyāṃ tu kartavyaṃ ye narāḥ śastraghātitāḥ ||
śrāddhaṃ sadā pañcadaśīṣu kurvan
kāmān samagrān labhate manuṣyaḥ |
tasmāt prayatnena narendra kāryaṃ
śrāddhaṃ sadā pañcadaśīṣu tajjñaiḥ ||
viṣṇudharme
kanyāgate savitari kṛṣṇapakṣe ’ṣṭamī tu yā |
sā ca pāpaharā puṇyā śivasyānandavardhinī ||
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ pitṛdevābhipūjanam |
sarvaṃ prītikaraṃ syād dhi kṛtaṃ tasyāṃ trilocane ||
viśeṣataḥ kṛtaṃ śrāddhaṃ homaś ca vidhivan mune |
tasmāc chrāddhaṃ prayatnena tasyāṃ kuryād vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
[512]        ekabhaktaṃ tu pañcamyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ naktaṃ vidur budhāḥ |
upavāsas tu saptamyām aṣṭamyāṃ pūjayec chivam ||
pūjayitvā śivaṃ bhaktyā pituḥ śrāddhaṃ tu kalpayet |
kṛtvā tu vidhivac chrāddhaṃ bhuñjīta pitṛsevitaṃ ||
yas tasyāṃ kurute śrāddhaṃ pūjayitvā trilocanaṃ |
tasya varṣāṇi tṛptāḥ syuḥ pitaro daśa pañca ca ||
iti kāmyās tithayaḥ |
atha nakṣatrāṇi |
tatra manuḥ |
yukṣu kurvan dinarkṣeṣu sarvān kāmān samaśnute |
ayukṣu ca pitṝn arcan prajāṃ prāpnoti puṣkalām ||
'yukṣu' sameṣu, 'ayukṣu' viṣameṣu |
yamaḥ |
yukṣu kurvan dinarkṣeṣu sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt |
gajacchāyāṃ pitṝn arcan prajāḥ prāpnoti puṣkalāḥ ||
yājñavalkyaḥ |
svargaṃ hy apatyam ojaś ca śauryaṃ kṣetraṃ balaṃ tathā |
sutān średhyaca saubhāgyaṃ samṭaddhiṃ sukhamatāṃ śubhām ||
pravṛttacakratāś caiva vāṇijyaprabhṛtīṃs tathā |
arogitvaṃ yaśo vītaśokatāṃ paramāṃ gatim ||
dharmavidyāṃ bhiṣaksiddhiṃ kupyaṃ gām apy ajādikam |
aśvān āyuś ca vidhivad yaḥ śrāddhaṃ saṃprayacchati ||
kṛttikādibharaṇyantaṃ sa kāmān āpnuyād imān |
āstikaḥ śraddadhānaś ca vyapetamadamatsaraḥ ||
'pravṛttacakratā' apratihatajñānaśālitvam |
viṣṇuḥ |
svargaṃ kṛttikāsu | apatyaṃ rohiṇīṣu | brahmavarcasaṃ saumye | sendrāṇa siddhiṃ raudre | bhuvaṃ punarvasau | puṣṭiṃ puṣye | śriyaṃ sārpe | sarvān kāmān pitrye | saubhāgyaṃ bhāgye | dhanam āryamne | jñātirśraiṣṭhyaṃ haste | rūpavataḥ sutāṃs tvāṣṭre | vāṇijyasiddhiṃ vāyau | kanakaṃ viśākhāsu | sumitrāṇi maitre | kṛṣiṃ mūle | samudrayānasiddhim āpye | sarvān kāmān vaiśvadeve | śraiṣṭhyam abhijiti | sarvān kāmān śravaṇe | balaṃ vāsave | ārogyaṃ vāruṇe | kupyadravyam āje | gṛham āhirbudhne | gāḥ pauṣṇe | turagān āśvine | jīvitaṃ yāmye |
'saumyaṃ' mṛgaśiraḥ | 'raudram' ārdrā | 'sārpam' aśleṣā | 'pitryaṃ' maghā | 'bhāgyaṃ' pūrvaphalgunyaḥ | 'āryamnaṃ' uttaraphalgunyaḥ | 'tvāṣṭraṃ' citrā | 'vāyuḥ' svātiḥ | 'maitram' anurādhā | 'śākraṃ jyeṣṭhā | 'āpyaṃ' pūrvāṣāḍhā | 'vaiśvadevam' uttarāṣāḍhā | 'vāsavaṃ' dhaniṣṭhā | 'vāruṇaṃ' śatabhiṣak | 'ājaṃ' pūrvabhādrapadā | 'āhirbudhnam' uttarabhādrapadā | 'pauṣṇaṃ' revatī | 'āśvinam' aśvinī | 'yāmyaṃ' bharaṇī |
viṣṇudharmottare |
svargaṃ hy apatyāni tathā brahmavarcasam eva ca |
raudrāṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ siddhiṃ bhuvaṃ puṣṭiṃ tathā śriyam ||
[514]        sarvān kāmāṃś ca saubhāgyaṃ dharmaṃ jñātipradhānatām |
rūpayuktāṃś ca tanayān vāṇijyaṃ dhanasampadaṃ ||
kanakaṃ suhṛdo rājyaṃ saphalāṃ ca tathā kṛṣim |
samudrayānalābhaṃ ca sarvān kāmāṃs tathaiva ca ||
śraiṣṭhyaṃ kāmāṃs tathā sarvān balam ārogyam eva ca |
kupyadravyaṃ gṛhaṃ gāvas turaṅgāṃś caiva jīvitam ||
kṛttikādibharaṇyante kramād uḍugaṇe naraḥ |
ekaikasmin kramāt kurvan śrāddham āpnoty asaṃśayam ||
mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
kṛttikāsu pitṝn arcan svargam āpnoti mānavaḥ |
apatyakāmo rohiṇyāṃ saumye tejasvitāṃ labhet ||
śauryam ārdrāsv avāpnoti kṣetrādi ca punarvasau |
puṣṭiṃ puṇye sadābhyarcya aśleṣāsu varān sutān |
maghāsu svajanaśraiṣṭhyaṃ saubhāgyaṃ phālgunīṣu ca |
pradānśīlo bhavati sāpatyaś cottarāsu vai ||
prayāti śreṣṭhatāṃ satsu haste śrāddhaprado naraḥ |
rūpayuktastu citrāsu tathāpatyāny avāpnuyāt ||
vāṇijyalābhaṃ svātantryaṃ viśākhā putrakāmadā |
kurvatāṃ cānurādhāsu dadyuś cakrapravartitām ||
ādhipatyaṃ ca jyeṣṭhāsu mūle cārogyam uttamam |
āṣāḍhāsu yaśaḥprāptiḥ uttarāsu viśokatām ||
śravaṇe tu śubhān lokān dhaniṣṭhāsu dhanaṃ mahat |
[515]        vedavittvaṃ tv abhijiti bhiṣaksiddhiṃ ca vāruṇe ||
ajāvikaṃ prauṣṭhapade vindet bhāryāṃ tathottare |
revatīṣu tathā kupyam aśvinīṣu taraṅgamān ||
śrāddhaṃ kurvaṃs tathāpnoti bharaṇīṣv āyur uttamam |
tasmāt kāmyāni kurvīta ṛkṣeṣv eteṣu tattvavit ||
brahmavaivarte |
yamas tu yāni śrāddhāni provāca śaśavindave |
tāni tvaṃ śṛṇu kāmyāni nakṣatreṣu pṛthak pṛthak ||
śrāddhayoge tu yaḥ śrāddhaṃ karoti satataṃ naraḥ |
agnidārāsu dhīmān yo jāyate sa gatajvaraḥ ||
apatyakāmo rohiṇyāṃ saumye tejasvitā bhavet |
krūrāṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ siddhim ārdrāyāṃ śrāddham ācaret ||
kṣetrabhāgī bhavet putrī śrāddhaṃ kurvan punarvasau |
puṣṭikāmaḥ punas tiṣye śrāddhaṃ kurvīta mānavaḥ ||
āśleṣāsu pitṝn arcan vīrān putrān avāpnuyāt |
śreṣṭho bhavati jñātīnāṃ maghāśrāddhaṃ samācaret ||
phālgunīṣu piṭṝn arcan saubhāgyaṃ labhate naraḥ |
pradānaśīlaḥ sāpatya uttarāsu karoti yaḥ ||
saṃsatsu sukhyo bhavati haste yas tarpayet pitṝn |
citrāyāṃ caiva yaḥ kuryāt paśyed rūpavataḥ sutān ||
svātīṣu caiva yaḥ kuryāt vāṇijye lābham āpnuyāt |
putrārthaṃ tu viśākhāsu śrāddham āhitamānavaḥ ||
[516]        anurādhāsu kurvāṇo bhuvaś cakraṃ pravarttayet |
ādhipatyaṃ labhet śreṣṭhaṃ jyeṣṭhāsu satataṃ tu yaḥ ||
mūlenārogyam icchanti āṣāḍhāsu maheśvaraḥ |
uttarāsu āṣāḍhāsu tīrṇaśoko bhaven naraḥ ||
śravaṇe manulokeṣu prāpnuyāt paramāṃ gatim |
rājyabhāgaṃ dhaniṣṭhāsu prāpnuyād vipulaṃ dhanam ||
śrāddhaṃ rv abhijiti kurvan vedān sāṅgān avāpnuyāt |
nakṣatre vāruṇe kurvan bhaiṣajye siddhim āpnuyāt ||
pūrvaproṣṭhapade bhakto vindet tv ājāvikaṃ bahu |
uttarāsv anatikramya vindet gāvaḥ sahasraśaḥ ||
bahukupyakṛtaṃ dravyaṃ vindet kurvaṃs tu revatīm |
aśvānāśvayuje bhuṅkte bharaṇyām āyur uttamam ||
imaṃ śrāddhavidhiṃ kurvan śaśabindur mahīm imām |
kṛtsnāṃ ca lebhe sotkṛṣṭo lakṣavarṣaṃ śaśāsa tām ||
kūrmapurāṇe |
svargaṃ ca labhate kṛtvā kṛttikāsu dvijottamaḥ |
apatyam atha rohiṇyāṃ saumye tu brahmavarcasam ||
raudrāṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ siddhim ārdrayāṃ śauryam eva ca |
punarvasau kṣetrasiddhiṃ puṣye puṣṭim avāpnuyāt ||
sarvān kāmāṃs tathā sārpe pitrye saubhāgyam eva ca |
āryamṇe tu dhanaṃ vidyāt phālgunyāṃ pāpanāśanam ||
jātiśraiṣṭhyaṃ tathā haste citrāyāṃ ca bahūn sutān |
[517]        vāṇijyasiddhiṃ svātau tu viśākhāsu suvarṇakam ||
maitre bahūni mitrāṇi rājyaṃ śākre tathaiva ca |
mūle kṛṣiṃ labhet jñānaṃ siddhim āpye samudrataḥ ||
sarvān kāmān vaiśvadeve śraiṣṭhyaṃ tu śravaṇe punaḥ |
dhaniṣṭhāyāṃ tathā kāmān vāruṇe ca paraṃ balam ||
revatyāṃ bahavo gāvaḥ aśvinyāṃ turagāṃs tathā |
yāmye tu jīvitaṃ tatra yaḥ śrāddhaṃ saṃprayacchati ||
atrānyāny api brahmapurāṇavacanāni vailakṣaṇye ’pi sarvathā pūrvokrānatirikrārthanīti na likhyante |
brahmapurāṇe |
maghāsu kurvan śrāddhāni sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt |
pratyakṣam arcitās tena bhavanti pitaraḥ sadā ||
iti kāmyāni nakṣatrāṇi |
atha vārāḥ |
atra viṣṇuḥ |
satatam āditye ’hni śrāddhaṃ kurvann ārogyam āpnoti | saubhāgyaṃ cāndre | samaravijayaṃ kauje | sarvān kāmān baudhe | vidyām abhīṣṭāṃ jīve | dhanaṃ śaukre | jīvitaṃ śanaiśvare |
'kauje' maṅgaladine | 'jīve' bṛhaspatidine |
viṣṇudharmottare |
[518]        ataḥ kāmyāni vakṣyāmi śrāddhāni tatra pārthiva |
ārogyam atha saubhāgyaṃ samare vijayaṃ tathā ||
sarvān kāmāṃs tathā vidyāṃ dhanaṃ jīvitam eva ca |
ādityādidineṣv evaṃ śrāddhaṃ kurvan sadā naraḥ |
krameṇaitad avāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
kūrmapurāṇe |
ādityavāre tv ārogyaṃ some saubhāgyam eva ca |
kuje sarvatra vijayaṃ sarvān kāmān budhasya tu ||
vidyām abhīṣṭāṃ tu gurau dhanaṃ vai bhārgave punaḥ |
śanaiśvare labhed āyur ārogyaṃ ca sudurlabham ||
bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
brahmovāca |
ye tv ādityadine prāpte śrāddhaṃ kurvanti mānavāḥ |
sapta janmāni te jātāḥ saṃbhavanty avirodhinaḥ ||
pañcatāraṃ bhaved yatra nakṣatraṃ govṛṣadhvaje |
vāre tu devadevasya vāsaraḥ putradaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
upavāso bhaved atra śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ tathā bhavet |
prāśanaṃ vāpi piṇḍasya madhyamasya prakīrtitam ||
sopavāsas tu vai bhaktyā pūjayec caiva gopatim |
dhūpamālyopahārais tu divyagandhasamanvitaiḥ ||
evaṃ pūjya vivasvantaṃ tasyaiva purato niśi |
bhūmau svapiti vai vīra japan śvetaṃ mahāmate ||
prātar utthāya ca snānaṃ kṛtvā dattvārgyam uttamam |
[519]        raktacandanasaṃmiśraiḥ karavīrair gaṇādhipam ||
prapūjya grahabhūteśam īśānaṃ tu trilocanam |
vīraṃ ca pūjayitvā tu tataḥ śrāddhaṃ prakalpayet ||
pañcabhir brāhmaṇair deva divyair bhaumaiś ca suvrata |
divyam aṅgais tatra devaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ parikalpayet ||
pitryāṃs tu brāhmaṇān bhaumān prakalpyāndhakasūdanam |
kuryād evaṃ tataḥ śrāddhaṃ pārvaṇaṃ bhāskarapriyam ||
śrāddhe tv atha samāpte tu adyāt piṇḍaṃ sumadhyamam |
purato devadevasya sthitvā mantreṇa suvrata ||
sa eṣa piṇḍo deveśa yo ’bhīṣṭas tava sarvadā |
aśnāmi puratas tubhyaṃ yena me santatir bhavet ||
prasādāt tasya devasya yan me prārthayate manaḥ |
itthaṃ saṃpūjito hy atra bhāskaraḥ putrado bhavet ||
ato ’yaṃ putrado vāro devasya parikīrttitaḥ |
evam atra sadā yas tu bhāskaraṃ pūjayen naraḥ |
upavāsaparaḥ śrāddhe sa putraṃ labhate dhruvam ||
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca ārogyaṃ sukham uttamam |
svargalokaṃ svayaṃ prāptas tato rājā bhaven nṛṣu ||
prabhayā dvijasaṃkāśaḥ kāntyā jambūkasannibhaḥ |
vīryeṇa gopates tulyo gāmbhīryaiḥ kalaśodbhavaḥ ||
'avirodhinaḥ' śatruśūnyāḥ | rohiṇyaśleṣāmaghāhastākhyāni cātvāri vai nakṣatrāṇi pañcatārāṇi | śreṣṭho gauḥ govṛṣaḥ sa dhvajo yasya saḥ [520] ‘govṛṣadhvajaḥ’ |  vṛṣavyāghrapuṅgavakuñjarādyānāṃ śraiṣṭhyavācinām uttarapade bharatarṣabhādiṣu darśanāt | 'devadevaḥ' sūryaḥ | upavāso ’tra śanaiśvaradine śrāddham ādityavāre | etac ca "prātar utthāya" ityādinā granthena vyaktībhaviṣyati | madhyamapiṇḍaprāśanam atra yajamānasyaiva pratīyate, śrāddhāntareṣu tu patnyā vihitatvāt tatkartṛkam eva | anye tu dampatyoḥ putrakāmayoḥ sahādhikārād viśeṣābhidhānāt dvayor api piṇḍaprāśanam iti yukram | dṛśyate ca putrīyakarmāntare dvayor api haviḥśeṣaprāśanaṃ | tad yathā | śatapathe | “kṣīraudanaṃ pācayitvā sarpiṣmantam aśnīyātām" ityādi | tathā tatraiva homānantaraṃ “hutvoddhṛtya prāśnāti prāśyetarasyāḥ prayacchati" iti | ‘gopatiḥ’ sūryaḥ, sa ca suvarṇadipratimādi-bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktaprakāreṇa vyomni vā pūjanīyaḥ | 'śvetaḥ' mahāśvetākhyaḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ sūryamantraḥ oṃ śvaśvolkāya namaḥ ityevaṃprasiddhaḥ | arghyadānam ambarasthasūryābhimukho bhūtvā sthaṇḍile kuryāt | 'pūjayitveti punaḥ pūjanopādānāt pūjyāntarāvagatau grahabhūteśādayaḥ pañca devatāḥ praṇavādibhiś caturthyantaiḥ svanāmabhiḥ pīṭhe pūjyāḥ | divyā maṅgā bhojakākhyā brāhmaṇaviśeṣās te cottarāpathe prasiddhāḥ, tadanye bhaumāḥ | atra vaiśvadevikasthāne maṅgān upaveśya pitryasthāne brāhmaṇāntarān upaveśayet | evam atra sadeti viśiṣṭaphalalābhārthaṃ āvṛttikathanaṃ, 'prabhā' aujvalyaṃ, 'dvijaḥ' candramāḥ | 'kāntiḥ' tejaḥ 'jambūkaḥ' varuṇaḥ, “varuṇo vai jambūka" iti śruteḥ | varuṇaś cādityaḥ, “varuṇo māghamāse tapati" iti darśanāt | 'gopatiḥ' paśupatiḥ śambhur ity arthaḥ | ‘kalaśodbhavaḥ' agastyaḥ, sa ca gabhīratarasamudrapānād atigabhīratayā vivakṣitaḥ |
[521]        brahmapurāṇe |
śuklāṅgārakayuktā yā caturthī jāyate yadā |
śraddhayā śrāddhakṛd vipro na preto jāyate mṛtaḥ |
skandapurāṇe |
amāyāṃ yadi somaḥ syāt saptamyāṃ vai divākaraḥ |
caturdaśyāṃ caturthyāṃ vā vāraḥ syān māṅgalasya tu |
tadā śrāddhaṃ prakartayaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tṛptim icchatā |
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭivarṣaśatāni ca |
nandanti pitaraḥ svarge vimānavaram āsthitāḥ |
tāvantam eva kālaṃ hi śrāddhakartus tathā phalam ||
iti kāmyā vārāḥ ||
atha kāmyāḥ prakīrṇakālāḥ |
tatra viṣṇupurāṇe |
māsi māsy asite pakṣe pañcadaśyāṃ nareśvara |
tathāṣṭakāsu kurvīta kāmyān kālān śṛṇuṣva me ||
śrāddhārham āgataṃ drayaṃ viśiṣṭam atha vā dvijam |
śrāddhaṃ kurvīta vijñāya vyatīpāte ’yane tathā ||
viṣuve vāpi saṃprāpte grahaṇe śaśi-sūryayoḥ |
samas teṣv eva bhūpāla rāśiṣv arke ca gacchati ||
nakṣatragrahapīḍāsu kurvīta nabhasyasyāgame tathā |
[522]        mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
kāryaṃ śrāddham amāvāsyāṃ māsi māsy uḍupakṣaye |
tathāṣṭakāsv āpy avaśyam iṣṭaṃ kālaṃ nibodha me |
viśiṣṭabrāhmaṇaprāptau sūryendugrahaṇe ’yane |
viṣuve ravisaṃkrāntau vyatīpāte tu putraka |
śrāddhārhadravyasaṃpattau tathā duḥkhapradarśane |
janmarkṣagṛhapīḍāsu śrāddhaṃ kurvīta cecchayā |
viṣṇur apy āha |
saṃkrāntiviṣuve caiva viśeṣeṇāyanadvayam |
vyatīpāto ’tha janmarkṣaṃ candrasūryagrahas tathā ||
ity etān śrāddhakālāṃs tu kāmyān āha prajāpatiḥ |
śrāddham eteṣu yad dattaṃ tad ānantyāya kalpate ||
brahmavaivarte |
amāvāsyāṃ prayatnena śrāddhaṃ kuryāc chuciḥ sadā |
sarvān kāmān avāpnoti svargaṃ cānte samaśnute ||
ghṛtaṃ dadyād amāvāsyāṃ somasyāpyāyanaṃ mahat |
evam āpyāyitaḥ somas trīn lokān dhārayiṣyati ||
siddhacāraṇagandharvaiḥ stūyate nityapūjitaḥ |
sarvaiḥ puṣpair manojñaiś ca sarvakāmaparicchadaiḥ ||
nṛtyavāditragītaiś ca apsarobhiḥ sahasraśaḥ |
upakrīḍadvimānasthaḥ pitṛbhakto dṛḍhavrataḥ ||
stuvanti devagandharvāḥ siddhasaṅghāś ca taṃ sadā |
[523]        pitṛbhaktas tv amāvāsyāṃ sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt |
ptṝan devān yajan bhaktyā yato ’syām akṣayaṃ phalam ||
tathā |
puṣṭiṃ prajāṃ smṛtiṃ medhāṃ putrān aiśvaryam eva ca |
kurvāṇaḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ tu sarvaṃ sampūrṇam aśnute ||
brahmapurāṇe |
nāndīmukhānāṃ pratyabdaṃ kanyārāśigate ravau |
paurṇamāsyāṃ tu kartavyaṃ varāhavacanaṃ yathā ||
bhādrapadamāsāntargate yatra kvacama dine kanyārāśau ravisaṃkramaṇe jāte tanmāsamadhyavarttinyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ nāndīmukhānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ śrāddhaṃ kartavyam | tac cāvaśyakaṃ 'pratyabdam' iti vacanāt | nāndīmukhaśabdena cātra prapitāmahāt pare vivakṣitāḥ yasmād asminn eva purāṇe ’sya vacanasyānantaram evoktam |
ye syuḥ pitāmahād ūrdhvaṃ te syur nāndīmukhās trayaḥ |
prasannamukhasaṃjñās tu maṅgalīyā yatas tu te || iti |
atra pitāmahavacanena prapitāmahaḥ lakṣaṇīyaḥ yad uktaṃ brahmapurāṇavacanāt |
pitā pitāmahaś caiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ |
trayo hy aśrumukhā hy ete pitaraḥ prakīrttitāḥ |
tebhyaḥ pūrve trayo ye tu te tu nāndīmukhāḥ smṛtāḥ || iti |
atha nāndīmukhavacanasyaitat paurṇamāsīnimittakaśrāddhavidhinaikavākyatāparatvāc chrāddhāntare nāndīmukhaśabdena prapitāmahāt pare trayo na [524] grāhyāḥ | athaiteṣu nāndīmukhasaṃjñāḥ kimarthāḥ | atha yathā caśabdaḥ pitaro gatāḥ ityādau ca yadiśabdo vacanasyāpy abhedadṛṣṭividhānārthaḥ, tathātra vārāhakalpīyaḥ pitṛgaṇabhedaprakaraṇoktanāndīmukhākhyapitṛgaṇābhedadṛṣṭividhinārtha ucyate | tena yato ’tra prasannamukhasaṃjñā ityādinā nandanamukhayogān nāndīmukhaśabdaniṣpattir abhipreteti darśitam | ato nābhedadṛṣṭyupadeśārthaḥ | atha kauṇḍapāyinīye māsahome ’gnihotram iti paraśabdaḥ paratra prayujyamānas tadvadbhāvaṃ gamayan naiyamikāgnihotradharmātideśārthaḥ, tathātra nāndīmukhaśabdo ’pi putrajanmādikālavihitaprasiddhanāndīmukhadharmātideśārthaḥ uktottaratvāt | na hy ayaṃ paraśabdaḥ parasārūpyavivakṣayā prayuktaḥ, kiṃ tu nandanamukhatvayogād iti | ato ’sya praśaṃsaiva prayojanaṃ manyāmahe |
hārītaḥ |
aṣṭakāmādyabhyudayās tīrthayātropapattayaḥ |
pitṝṇām atireko ’yaṃ māsikārtho dhruvaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
brahmavaivartta-vāyupurāṇayoḥ |
atha kālaṃ pravakṣyāmi śrāddhakarmaṇi pūjitam |
kāmyanaimittikājasraṃ śrāddhakarmavidhāyibhiḥ |
putrārādhanamūlāḥ syur aṣṭakās tisra eva ca ||
iti kāmyāḥ prakīrṇakālāḥ |
atha sāmānyataḥ śrāddhatithinirṇayaḥ |
tatra yasyāṃ tithau śrāddhaṃ vihitaṃ sā ced dinadvayasambandhinī tadā [525] yasmin dine aparāhṇavyāpinī tathaiva śrāddham anuṣṭheyam |
tathā ca nigamaḥ |
pūrvāhṇikās tu tithayo devakāryaphalapradāḥ |
aparāhṇikās tathā jñeyāḥ pitrarthe tu śubhapradāḥ ||
dakṣaḥ |
pūrvāhṇe devakāryāṇi manuṣyāṇāṃ ca madhyame |
pitṝṇāṃ cāparāhṇe tu kāryāṇy etāni yatnataḥ ||
yadā tu dinadvaye cāparāhṇavyāpinī tadā pūrvaiva grāhyā |
yathāha bṛhanmanuḥ |
yasyām astaṃ ravir yāti pitaras tām upāsate |
tithis tebhyo yato dattā hy aparāhṇe svayaṃbhuvā ||
manur api |
yayām astaṃ ravir yāti pitaras tām upāsate |
sā pitṛbhyo yato dattā hy aparāhṇe svayaṃbhuvā ||
yasyām aparāhṇasambandhe saty astamayānuvṛttiḥ sā pitṛkārye praśastā na tv astamayamātrasambaddhety arthaḥ |
tathā ca hārīto ’pi |
aparāhṇaḥ pitṝṇāṃ tu yāparāhṇānuyāyinī |
sā grāhyā pitṛkārye tu na pūrvāhṇānuyāyinī ||
yadā tūbhayadinadvaye ’py aparāhṇavyāpinī na labhyate tadāpi pūrvaiva |
tathāha vṛddhayājñavalkyaḥ |
[526]        devakārye tithir jñryā yasyām abhyudito raviḥ |
pitṛkārye tithir jñeyā yasyām astamito raviḥ |
śivarahasya-saurapurāṇayoḥ |
prātaḥ prātar upoṣyā syāt tithir devaphalepsubhiḥ |
mūlaṃ hi pitṛtṛptyarthaṃ paitraṃ coktaṃ maharṣibhiḥ ||
nāradīyapurāṇe ’pi |
titheḥ prāntaṃ surākhyaṃ hi upoṣyaṃ kavayo viduḥ |
pitryaṃ mūlaṃ titheḥ proktaṃ śāstrajñaiḥ kālakovidaiḥ ||
pitrye ’stamayavelāyāṃ spṛśet pūrvair nigadyate |
ma tatraudayikī grāhyā deveṣv audayikī tithiḥ || iti |
gobhilo ’pi |
sāyāhnavyāpinī yā tu pārvaṇe sā udāhṛtā |
sāpi muhūrtatrayānvitaivāstamayasambandhinī grāhyā |
tathā ca baudhāyanaḥ |
udite daivataṃ bhānau pitryaṃ cāstamite ravau |
dvimuhūrttaṃ trir ahnaś ca sā tithir havyakavyayoḥ ||
manuḥ |
yasyām astaṃ ravir yāti pitaras tām upāsate |
sā pitṛbhyo yato dattā hy aparāhṇe svayaṃbhuvā || iti |
aparāhṇavyāpiny evāstamayasambandhinī grāhyā na tu tacchūnyeti vacanāt pratīyate | ato vācanikakālābhāvāc chrāddham eva na karttavyam anadhikārāt, satyaṃ kiṃ tu vastutaḥ trimuhūrttāyā api |
[527]        tithyādiṣu bhaved yāvān hrāso vṛddhiḥ pare ’hani |
tāvān grāhyas tu  pūrvedyur adṛṣṭo ’pi svakarmaṇi ||
iti vacanāt adhikakālakalpanayā aparāhṇe ’pi sambhavāt | etaddinakṣaye, sāmye vṛddhau tūttareṇa grāhyā |
tathā ca vyāghraḥ |
kharvo darpas tathā hiṃsā trividhaṃ tithilakṣaṇam |
kharvadapau parau pūjyau hiṃsā syāt pūrvakālikī ||
etadākyaviṣayavivekas tu tithiviśeṣaśrāddhe, śuklapakṣe pūrvāhṇavyāpinī tithir grāhyā, kṛṣṇapakṣe ’parāhṇavyāpinī tithir grāhyā |
dve śukle dve tathā kṛṣṇe yugādīn kavayo viduḥ |
śukle pūrvāhṇike grāhye kṛṣṇe caivāparāhṇike ||
ityādivacanebhyaḥ pūrvāhṇāparāhṇau “āvarttanāt pūrvāhṇo hy apavapāhṇas (?) tathāpara" iti darśitau ahnaḥ pūrvāparau bhāgau, iti nirṇayaḥ, śeṣaṃ pūrvavat | yadā tūbhe tulyakālaikadeśaṃ vyāpnutas tadā vṛddhau kṣaye sāmye ’py uttaraiva na punaḥ vṛddhāv evottarā kṣaye sāmye tu pūrveti "pūrvā tu kartavyā' ityādivacanasya mṛtāhatithiviṣayatvāt prathamātikrame kāraṇāsadbhāvāc ca |
yo yasya vihitaḥ kālaḥ karmaṇas tadupakrame |
vidyamāno bhaved aṅgaṃ nojjhitopakrameṇa tu ||
ityādivacanāt | ekoddiṣṭādiśrāddheṣu punar madhyāhnavyāpinī grāhyā |
tathā ca vṛddhagautamaḥ |
madhyāhnavyāpinī yā syāt saikoddiṣṭe tithir bhavet |
[528]        aparāhṇavyāpinī yā pārvaṇe sā tithir bhavet |
baudhāyano ’pi |
madhyāhnavyāpinī yā tu tithiḥ pūrvāparāpi vā |
tasyāṃ pitṛbhyo dātavyaṃ hrāsavṛddhau na kāraṇam ||
tathā ca hārītaḥ |
āmaśrāddhaṃ tu pūrvāhṇe ekoddiṣṭaṃ tu madhyataḥ |
pārvaṇaṃ cāparāhṇe tu prātar vṛddhinimittakam ||
daivikāśrāddhe tu pūrvāhṇavyāpinī tithir grāhyā |
karmaṇo yasya yaḥ kālas tatkālavyāpinī tithiḥ |
ityādivacanāt tasya ca pūrvā eva vidhānāt |
tathā ca manuḥ |
pūrvāhṇe daivikaṃ śrāddham aparāhṇe tu pārvaṇam |
ekoddiṣṭaṃ tu madhyāhne prātar vṛddhinimittakam ||
daivikaśrāddhalakṣaṇaṃ pāraskaroktaṃ grāhyam |
devān uddiśya kriyate yat tad daivikam ucyate |
tan nityaśrāddhavat kuryād dvādaśyādiṣu yatnataḥ ||
iti nirṇayaḥ, śeṣaṃ pūrvavat | yadāpi tithivṛddhivaśāt ubhe api samagraṃ karmakālaṃ vyānutaḥ kṣayavaśād vā karmakālaṃ na spṛśatas tadāpy uttaraiva grāhyā |
dvimuhūrttaṃ trir ahno vā sā tithir havyakavyayoḥ |
udite daivataṃ bhānau pitryaṃ cāstamite ravau |
upavāsavratādīnāṃ ghaṭikaikāpi dṛśyate |
[529]        udaye sā tithir jñeyā viparītā tu paitṛkī ||
iti vacanāt |
nanv asmād eva vacanāt yadāpi pūrvāhṇaṃ vyāpnoti udaye ’pi dvimuhūrttārdhavyāpinī pūrvāhṇaṃ vyāpnoti tadāpy uttaraiva kasmān na gṛhyate “karmaṇo yasya" ityādeḥ sāmānyaśāstratvād iti |
ucyate | satyaṃ, yatrobhayadine ’pi karmakālavyāpinī tithiḥ karmakālaṃ na spṛśati vā tatra kā tithir grāhyeti saṃdehe vacanākāṅkṣāyāṃ sāmānyaśāstrād viśeṣaśāstrasya śīghrapravṛttes taduktā tithir gṛhyate | atra punar ekasminn eva dine vihitakarmakāle vihitatithilābhena kā tithir grāhyeti saṃdehābhāvān niścāyakavacanānavakāśaḥ |
iti sāmānyataḥ śrāddhanirṇayaḥ |
atha pretaśrāḍhakālaḥ |
tatra tāvann avasaṃjñakānāṃ śrāddhānāṃ, tatra cāntardaśāhaṃ kriyamāṇānāṃ navaśrāddhasaṃjñāṃ niveśayann āśvalāyano daśāhaparyantaṃ navaśrāddhakālaṃ manyate "navaśrāddhaṃ daśāhāni navamiśraṃ tu ṣaḍṛtūn" iti | evāṃ tu ahaḥsaṅkhyayā deśakālavibhāgam ekādaśāhnikasya ca navaśrāddhasaṃjñakatvam āha, nāgarakhaṇḍe bhartṛyajñaḥ |
trīṇi sañcayanasyārthe tāni vai śṛṇu sāmpratam |
yatra sthāne bhaven mṛtyus tatra śrāddhaṃ tu kārayet ||
ekoddiṣṭaṃ tato mārge viśrāmo yatra kāritaḥ |
[530]        tataḥ sañcayanasthāne tṛtīyaṃ śrāddham iṣyate |
pañcame saptame tadvad aṣṭame navame tathā |
daśamaikādaśe caiva navaśrāddhāni tāni vai |
saṃprāptāyāṃ vaitariṇyāṃ tatas tṛptim avāpnuyāt ||
brahmapurāṇe |
tṛtīye ’hani kartavyaṃ pretadāhāvanau dvijāḥ |
sūtakānte gṛhe śrāddham ekoddiṣṭaṃ pracakṣate ||
āha kātyāyanaḥ |
caturthe pañcame caiva navamaikādaśe tathā |
yad atra dīyate jantos tan navaśrāddham ucyate ||
vyāsaḥ |
prathame saptame caiva navamaikādaśe ’hani |
yat tu vai dīyate janmos tan navaśrāddham ucyate ||
āha śaṅkhaḥ |
ādyaṃ śrāddham aśuddho 'pi kuryād ekādaśe tathā |
kartus tātkālikī śuddhir aśuddhaḥ punar eva saḥ ||
'ādyaṃ' navam |
paiṭhīnasiḥ |
sadyaḥśauce pradātavyaṃ pretasyaikādaśe ’hani |
sa eva divasas tasya śrāddhaśayyāsanādiṣu ||
kūrmapurāṇe |
pretāya ca gṛhadvāri caturthe bhojayed dvijān |
[531]        dvitīye ’hani kartavyaṃ kṣurakarma sabāndhavaiḥ ||
caturthe bāndhavaiḥ sarvair asthnāṃ saṃcayanaṃ labhet |
pūrvān dvijān prabhuñjīta yugmāṃs tu śraddhayā śucīn ||
pañcame navame caiva tathaivaikādaśe ’hani |
yugmāṃs tu bhojayed viprān navaśrāddhaṃ tu tad viduḥ ||
brahmapurāṇe |
caturthe brāhmaṇān pañca pañcame ’hani bhūbhṛtām |
navame vaiśyajātīnāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ daśamāt pare ||
atriḥ |
pretārthaṃ sūtakānte tu brāhmanān bhojayet tataḥ |
navaśrāddhanimittaṃ tu ekam ekādaśe ’hani ||
evaṃ ca saty ekādaśāhikān navaśrāddhād aśaucānte vidhīyamānaṃ brāhmaṇabhojanaṃ karmāntaram iti gamyate |
bṛhaspatiḥ |
caturthe ’hani viprebhyo deyam annaṃ hi bāndhavaiḥ |
gāvaḥ suvarṇaṃ vittaṃ ca pretam uddiśya śaktitaḥ ||
'caturthe ’hani' saṃcayāha ity arthaḥ |
yad iṣṭaṃ jīvataś cāsīt tad dadyāt tasya yatnataḥ |
'tasya' pretasya, ‘jīvataḥ', 'yad iṣṭaṃ' kiṃcid abhīṣṭaṃ, āsīt tad dadyād ity arthaḥ |
iti navaśrāddhakālaḥ |
[532]
atha ṣoḍśaśrādānīty evaṃprasiddhānāṃ
pretaśrāddhānāṃ kālaḥ |
tatra brahmapurāṇe |
nṛṇāṃ tu tyaktadeśānāṃ śrāddhāḥ ṣoḍaśa sarvadā |
caturthe pañcame caiva navamaikādaśe tathā ||
tato dvādaśabhir māsaiḥ śrāddhā dvādaśasaṅkhyayā |
kartavyāḥ śrutitas teṣāṃ tatra viprāṃs tu bhojayet ||
jātūkarṇyaḥ |
dvādaśa pratimāsāni ādyaṃ ṣāṇmāsike tathā |
sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ caiva ity etac chrāddhaṣoḍaśam ||
ṣāṇmāsike ity etena vihitayoḥ śraddhayor nirūpaṇam āha |
ekāhena tu ṣaṇmāsā yadā syur api vā tribhiḥ |
nyūnāḥ saṃvatsaraś caiva syātāṃ ṣāṇmāsike tadā ||
ekenāhnā tribhir vā yadā ṣaṇmāsā nyūnāḥ syuḥ saṃvatsaraś ca tadā ṣāṇmāsikābdike śrāddhe kartavye ity arthaḥ |
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
asthisaṃcayane śrāddhaṃ tripakṣe māsikāni ca |
riktayoś ca tathā tithyoḥ pretaśrāddhāni ṣoḍaśa ||
riktayos tithyor ity ekenāhnā nyūne ṣaṣṭhe dvādaśe ca māsa ity arthaḥ |
tathā paiṭhīnasiḥ |
ṣāṇmāsikābdike śrāddhe syātāṃ pūrvedyur eva te |
[533]        māsikāni svakīye tu divase dvādaśe ’pi ca ||
tathā |
sapiṇḍīkaraṇād arvāk kuryāt śrāddhāni śoḍaśa |
ekoddiṣṭavidhānena kuryāt sarvāṇi tāni tu ||
brahmapurāṇe |
dvādaśe ’hani māse ca tripakṣe ca tataḥ param |
māsi māsi tu kartavyaṃ yāvat saṃvatsaraṃ dvijaiḥ ||
tataḥ parataraṃ kāryaṃ sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ kramāt |
kṛte sapiṇḍīkaraṇe pārvaṇaṃ cocyate punaḥ |
tataḥ prabhṛti nirmuktaḥ pretatvāt pitṛtāṃ gatam ||
vyāghrapādaḥ |
ekādaśe caturthe ca māsi māsi ca tatparam |
pratisaṃvatsaraṃ caivam ekoddiṣṭaṃ mṛtāhani ||
agnimatpretaśrāddhe viśeṣam āha kātyāyanaḥ |
śrāddham agnimataḥ kāryaṃ dāhād ekādaśe’ hani |
dhruvāṇi tu prakurvanti pramītāhāni sarvadā ||
tripakṣikād ūrddhvāni 'dhruvāṇi' | ata eva jātūkarṇyaḥ |
ūrdhvaṃ tripakṣāt yat śrāddhaṃ mṛtāhny eva tad bhavet |
adhas tu kārayed dāhād āhitāgner dvijanmanaḥ || iti |
hārītas tv asamarthaviṣaye māsikānāṃ kālavikalpān āha |
mukhyaṃ śrāddhaṃ māsi māsi aparyāptāv ṛtuṃ prati |
dvādaśāhena vā kuryād ekāhe dvādaśātha vā || iti |
[534]        atroparitane prakaraṇe vṛddhāv upasthitāyāṃ sapiṇḍīkaraṇāpakarṣaṇaṃ vakṣyate tannibandhanaṃ ca māsikānām apakarṣaṃ punarāvṛttiṃ ca tatraiva vakṣyāmaḥ, atra ca māsikāni māsopakrama eva kartavyāni | tathā hi māsasaṃbandhi māsikaṃ, māsasaṃbandhaś ca māsāntargatadinasaṃbandhenāpy upapadyate, evaṃ ca prathamātikrame kāraṇābhāvāt māsopakrama eva kartavyatā nicīyate | evaṃ ca "prathamamāsikonamāsikadvitīyamāsika-traipakṣikatṛtīyacaturthapañcamonaṣāṇmāsikaṣānmāsikasaptamāṣṭamanavama-daśamaikādaśamāsikonābdikāni ṣoḍaśa śrāddhāni krameṇa dadyād iti kalpasūtravihitakramo ’py upapadyate | anyathā sa na syāt ṣāṇmāsikasyonaṣāṇmāsikottarakālatvāt, evam anyatrāpi | yat tu "tato dvādaśabhir māsaiḥ śrāddhāni daśasaṅkhyayā" iti vacanān māsānte māsikaṃ kāryam ity uktaṃ, tadvicārāsahatvād upekṣaṇīyam | tasmād ācārānuguṇyāc ca māsopakrama eva māsikānīti siddham |
iti ṣoḍaśaśrāddhānīty evaṃprasiddhānāṃ kālāḥ |
atha sapiṇḍīkaraṇakālaḥ|
tatra yathākālaṃ daśasu māsikeṣu anuṣṭhiteṣu pūrṇe saṃvatsare tadūrdhvam utsargiko (?) ’nagnikasapiṇḍīkaraṇakālaḥ |
tathā ca mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe māsikāntāni śrāddhāny uktvābhihitam |
atha saṃvatsare pūrṇe yathāvat kriyate naraiḥ |
sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ samyak tatrāpi vidhir ucyate ||
[535]        kālasyānagnikakartṛkānagnimaddaivatyasapiṇḍīkaraṇāṅgatvaṃ naimittikaṃ ca kālāntaram uktaṃ bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ kuryāt yajamāno hy anagnimān |
anāhitāgneḥ pretasya pūrṇe ’bde bharatarṣabha ||
uktaṃ ca pulastyena |
niragnikaḥ sapiṇḍavaṃ piturmātukha dharmataḥ |
pūrṇe saṃvatsare kuryāt vṛddhir vā yad ahar bhavet ||
'vṛddhiḥ' caulamauñjīvivāhādirūpo ’bhyudayaḥ | upalakṣaṇaṃ caitat | nāndīśrāddhanimittabhūtasya karmamātrasya, etat "svapnādhyāyādhyayanādyupasaṃprāptāv (?)" ity uśanovacane “kartur nāndīmukham" iti śāṭyāyanavacane ca sphuṭībhaviṣyati | saiṣā yasmin dine vṛddhir āpadyeta tataḥ prāg evāpakṛṣya sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ kṛtvā tadaṅgabhūtaṃ nāndīmukhasaṃjñitaṃ śrāddhaṃ kuryād ity arthaḥ | anena pravṛttādhikārasyoparisamāpitapretaśrāddhasya caulamauñjīvivāhādhānādau tadaṅgabhūtena nāndīmukhaśrāddhenādhikāro ’pi darśitaḥ |
āha laghuhārītaḥ |
bhrātā vā bhrātṛputro vā sapiṇḍaḥ śiṣya eva ca |
sahapiṇḍakriyāṃ kṛtvā kuryād abhyudayaṃ tataḥ ||
nāgarakhaṇḍe |
tataḥ sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ vatsarād ūrdhvataḥ sthitam |
vṛddhir vā gāminī syāt tad arvāg api kārayet ||
ādhānāṅgabhūtān nāndīśrāddhāt prāgapakarṣam abhipretyāha uśanāḥ |
pituḥ sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ vārṣike mṛtavatsare |
[536]        ādhānādyupasaṃprāptāv etat prāg api vatsarāt ||
tatra cāpakṛṣyamāṇe sapiṇḍīkaraṇe tadantam apakarṣe syād iti nyāyāt pūrvāṇi māsikādīny apakṛṣya kṛtvā sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ kartavyam |
vṛddhavaśiṣṭho (?) ’py āha |
śraddhāṇi ṣoḍaśādatvā naiva kuryāt sapiṇḍanam ||
taddhānau tu kṛte pretaḥ pitṛtvaṃ nopapadyate ||
apakarṣapakṣa evaitat, anapakarṣe tu kramavidhānād eva tatsiddhiḥ |
ata eva śaṭyāyaniḥ |
pretaśrāddhāni sarvāṇi sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ tathā |
apakṛṣya prakurvīta kurvan nāndīmukhaṃ tataḥ ||
yat tu laugākṣivacanam,
yasya saṃvatsarād arvāk sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ bhavet |
māsikaṃ codakumbhaṃ ca deyaṃ tasyāpi vatsaram || iti |
tat tu tadantāpakarṣanyāyena kṛteṣv api māsikeṣu "tāny eva tu punaḥ kuryād" iti kalpasūtrakāravacanoktapunaranuṣṭhānaviṣayatvena vyākhyeyam | apakṛṣyetyanuvṛttāv āha uśanāḥ |
vṛddhiśāstravihīnas tu pretaśrāddhāni yaś caret |
śrāddhī sa narake ghore pitṛbhiḥ saha pacyate ||
anupasthitāyāṃ vṛddhau yaḥ pretaśrāddhāny apakarṣed ity arthaḥ | vṛddhiśrāddham antareṇānapakarṣo ’yaṃ samarthaviṣayaḥ | asamarthaviṣaye tu vṛddhiśrāddhapratyupasthānaṃ vināpy apakarṣaṇam |
apakṛṣyamāṇasya ca kālavikalpam āha gobhilaḥ |
[537]        pūrṇe saṃvatsare ṣaṇmāse tripakṣe vā yad ahar vā vṛddhir āpadyeteti |
atra kecit "pūrṇe saṃvatsare yad ahar vā vṛddhir āpadyetety etayoḥ pakṣayor anagnikaikaviṣayatvaṃ “ṣaṇmāse tripakṣe vā" ity etayos tu sāgnikaikaviṣayatvam iti vyavasthāṃ manyante udbhāvayanti cātra paiṭhīnasivacanam |
tripakṣe ’gnimataḥ kālo vṛddhīṣṭāpūrtakarmasu |
sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ kuryāt pūrṇe saṃvatsare ’pi ca || iti |
anagnimatsapiṇḍīkaraṇavacanāny apy upanyasyanti | tatredaṃ vaktavyaṃ yad agnimattvaviśeṣaṇavatas tripakṣādipakṣāḥ santi santu te tasya saṃvatsarānte kartuṃ samarthasyāpi mukhyakalpāḥ | anagnikasya tv asāmarthyaprayuktāḥ prakṛtagobhilavacanoktasaṃvatsarapakṣeṇaikavākyatāṃ gatāḥ santaḥ santv anukalpāḥ |
caturviṃśatimate |
svapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ cābde sampūrṇe ’bhyudaye ’pi vā |
dvādaśāhe tu keṣāṃcit mataṃ caikādaśe tathā ||
ity anagnikasapiṇḍīkaraṇakālaḥ |
atha sāgnikasapiṇḍīkaraṇakālaḥ |
tatrāha laghuhārītaḥ |
anagnis tu yadā vīra bhavet kuryāt tadā gṛhī |
pretaś ced agnimāṃs tu syāt tripakṣe vai sapiṇḍanam ||
atra gṛhī śrāddhakartā yady āhavanīyarahitaḥ pretaś cāhavanīyavān [538] bhavet tadā va kartā tasya pretasya mṛtāhadivasād ārambhya pakṣatraye pūrṇe sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ kuryāt |
tathā |
yajamāno ’gnimān rājan pretaś cānagnimān yadā |
dvādaśāhe bhavet kāryaṃ sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ sutaiḥ |
atra mṛtāhād ārabhya dvādaśe dine iti veditavyam |
āha kātyāyanaḥ |
ekādaśāhaṃ nirvartya pūrvaṃ darśād yathāvidhi |
prakurvītāgnimān vipro mātāpitroḥ sapiṇḍanam ||
asyābhiprāyaḥ | agnimatā hy amāvāsyāyāṃ piṇḍapitṛyajñaḥ piṇḍānvāhāryakaṃ ca kartavyam | tac ca pramītamātāpitṛkasya sapatnīkapitrādidevatyaṃ | na cākṛtasapiṇḍīkaraṇayos tayor darśaśrāddhādau devatātvam upapadyate tasya sapiṇḍīkaraṇakālikatvasmaraṇāt | ataḥ piṇḍapitṛyajñaśrāddhayoḥ lopo mā bhūd iti matvāgnimān vipra ekādaśāhe kartavyaṃ pretakāryaṃ nirvartya daśāhāt prāg eva yasmin kasminn ahani mātāpitroḥ sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ kuryād iti |
ata evāha prajāpatiḥ |
nāsapiṇḍyāgnimān putraḥ pitṛyajñaṃ samācaret |
na pārvaṇaṃ nābhyudayaṃ kurvan na labhate phalam || iti |
vipragrahaṇam upalakṣaṇaṃ kṣatriyādiṣv api nyāyasya tulyatvāt |
pakṣāntaram āha hārītaḥ |
yā tu pūrvam amāvāsyā mṛtāhād daśamī bhavet |
[539]        sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ tasyāṃ kuryād eva suto 'gnimān ||
mṛtāhād ārabhya yad daśamam ahar bhavati tasmāt parā yāmāvāsyā tasyām ity arthaḥ |
ata evāha jābāliḥ |
sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ kuryāt pūrvadarśe ’gnimān sutaḥ |
parato daśarātrasya pūrṇe ’bde ca tathāparaḥ ||
mṛtāham ārabhya daśarātraṃ tasmāt parato yaḥ prathamo daśo bhavet tasminn agnimān sutaḥ pitroḥ sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ kuryād ity arthaḥ | daśarātragrahaṇaṃ āśaucopalakṣaṇārtham | tad evaṃ sāgnikasya trayaḥ sapiṇḍīkaraṇakālā uktā bhavanti, dvādaśāhaḥ, daśāhāt parakālīnāyā amāvāsyāyāḥ pūrvaṃ kim apy ekam ahaḥ, daśāhāt param amāvāsyā ceti |
iti sāgnikasapiṇḍīkaraṇakālāḥ |
iti traivarṇikānām |
atha śūdrasya sapiṇḍīkaraṇakālaḥ |
tatra "sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ kartavyam" ity anuvṛttau viṣṇuḥ |
mantravarjaṃ hi śūdrāṇāṃ dvādaśe ’hani kīrtitam || iti |
amāvāsyāśrāddhakāriśūdraviṣayam etad iti vṛddhāḥ, vacanabalād āśaucamadhya eva śraddhāṅgīkaraṇam |
iti śudra sapiṇḍīkaraṇakālaḥ |
[540]
atha sāṃvatsarikakālanirṇayaḥ |
tatra tāvat kṣayāhanirṇayaḥ |
brahmapurāṇe |
pratisaṃvatsaraṃ kāryaṃ mātāpitror mṛte ’hani |
pitṛvyasyāpy aputrasya bhrātur jyeṣṭhasya caiva hi ||
mātrādīnāṃ śrāddhaṃ kāryam ity anenārthāt putrādīnāṃ kartavyatvam uktam | etac cādhikārimātropalakṣaṇārtham | bhrātur ity atrāputrasyety anuṣañjanīyaṃ | jyeṣṭhasyety anena tu kaniṣṭhasya bhrātur nāvaśyakaṃ sāṃvatsarikam iti darśitam |
tathā ca |
na putrasya pitā dadyān nānujasya tathāgrajaḥ |
iti niyatādhikāranirākaraṇāt | snehādinā tv aniyatenādhikāreṇa putrasya kaniṣṭhasyāpi sāṃvatsarikaṃ kartavyam eva |
tathā coktam |
api snehena kuryātāṃ sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ vinā | iti |
prabhāsakhaṇḍe |
mṛtāhani pitur yas tu na kuryāc chrāddham ādarāt |
mātuś caiva varārohe vatsarānte mṛte ’hani |
nāhaṃ tasya mahādevi pūjāṃ gṛhṇāmi no hariḥ ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
sarveṣām eva śrāddhānāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sāṃvatsaraṃ matam |
kriyate yat khagaśreṣṭha mṛte ’hani budhaiḥ sadā ||
[541]        mṛte ’hani pitur yas tu na kuryāc chrāddham ādarāt |
mātuś ca khagaśārdūla vatsarānte mṛte ’hani ||
nāhaṃ tasya khagaśreṣṭha pūjāṃ gṛhṇāmi no hariḥ |
na brahmā na ca vai rudro na cānye devatāgaṇāḥ ||
tasmād yatnena kartavyaṃ varṣe varṣe mṛte ’hani |
nareṇa khagaśārdūla bhojakena viśeṣataḥ ||
bhojako yas tu vai śrāddhaṃ na karoti khagādhipa |
mātāpitṛbhyāṃ satataṃ varṣe varṣe mṛte ’hani ||
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ tāmisraṃ nāma nāmataḥ |
tato bhavati duṣṭātmā nagare śukaraḥ khagaḥ ||
tatra mṛtāhaśabdena maraṇāharvartinī tithir vivakṣitā saṃvatsarānte mukhyamṛtāhasyāsambhavāt | na hi tāny evāhāni parivartate | na hy ahnāṃ prātisvikaṃ nāmākṣi cihnaṃ vā, ato yatra kvacid ahni sāṃvatsarikaṃ prāpnuyāt | saṃvatsarāntam ahar gaṇaneti cet | na | mṛtāhagrahaaṇānarthakyāpatteḥ | ato maraṇāharvarttinī tithir vivakṣitā | ahargrahaṇaṃ rātrer apy upalakṣaṇārthaṃ, tena rātrimṛtasyāpi yā tithir labhyate, evaṃ ca saṃvatsarānte mṛtāhasambandhinyāṃ tithau sāṃvatsarikaṃ kartavyam iti labhyate |
atra ca |
yāṃ tithiṃ samanuprāpya udayaṃ yāti bhāskaraḥ |
sā tithiḥ sakalā jñeyā dānādhyayanakarmasu ||
yāṃ tithiṃ samanuprāpya astaṃ yāti divākaraḥ ||
[542]        yā tithiḥ sakalā jñeyā dānādhyayanakarmasu ||
iti devalādivacanānusārād yathā karmakāleṣv avidyamānāyā api titheḥ saṃpūrṇatvakalpanayā grahaṇaṃ na tathā mṛtāhavarttinyās tither maraṇasambandhitayā grahaṇaṃ kiṃ tu maraṇakālikyā eva | ataḥ sāṃvatsarike mṛtāhaśabdenoktā maraṇakāliky eva tithir veditavyā |
tad āha nāradīyapurāṇe vaśiṣṭhaḥ |
pāraṇe maraṇe nṝṇāṃ tithis tātkālikī smṛtā
pitrye ’stamayavelāyāṃ spṛṣṭā pūrṇā nigadyate ||
'tātkālikī' yasmin kāle upavāsādivratapāraṇaṃ maraṇaṃ vā tātkāliky eva tayos tithiḥ, na punar atatkālavartinī prātarādiṣu trimūharttādimānā, pitrye sāṃvatsarikādau astamayavelāyāṃ aharantaḥspṛṣṭāpi maraṇakālikī tithiḥ sampūrṇā nigadyate | etad uktaṃ bhavati maraṇakālikyāṃ tithau sāṃvatsarike kartavye prāpte yadi sāstamayavelāyām api dinānte ’sti tadā sā kutapāparāhṇayor astīti matvā tadupalakṣita eva divase kutapakālikaṃ śrāddhaṃ kartavyam iti | atha vātra mṛtāhaśabdenopalakṣaṇatrayaviśiṣṭam ahorātram abhipretaṃ |
tad āha vyāsaḥ |
māsapakṣatithispṛṣṭhe yo yasmin mriyate ’hani
pratyabdaṃ tat tathābhūtaṃ kṣayāhaṃ tasya taṃ viduḥ || iti |
'tathābhūtam' ity upalakṣaṇatrayopetam |
atra ca sāṃvatsarikādipitṛkārye cāndrasyaiva māsasya grahaṇam āha vyāsaḥ |
[543]        vivāhādau smṛtaḥ sauro yajñādau sāvanaḥ smṛtaḥ |
ābdike pitṛkārye ca māsaś cāndramasaḥ smṛtaḥ || iti |
laghuhārītaḥ |
cakravat parivarteta sūryaḥ kālavaśād yataḥ |
ataḥ sāṃvatsaraṃ śrāddhaṃ kartavyaṃ māsacihnitam ||
māsacihnaṃ tu kartavyaṃ pauṣamāghādyam eva hi |
yatas tatra vidhānena māsaḥ sa parikīrtitaḥ ||
pauṣādisaṃjñā cāndrasyaiva, tathā hi puṣyeṇa yuktaś candro yasyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ sā pauṣī sā yasmin māse sa pauṣo māsaḥ, evaṃ māghādo ’pi |
tad āha pāṇiniḥ |
nakṣatreṇa yuktaḥ kālaḥ sāsmin paurṇamāsīti saṃjñāyām | iti |
na ca saurasāvanayor evaṃvidhāsti saṃjñā evaṃvidhapaurṇamāsīyoganiyamo vā, ataḥ sāṃvatsarikādau cāndra eva māso grāhyaḥḥ |
yat punar vacanam,
yasmin rāśau gate sūrye vipattiṃ yāti mānavaḥ |
tadrāśāv eva kartavyaṃ pitṛkāryaṃ mṛte ’hani ||
tad etad adhimāsamṛtaviṣayam |
adhimāsavipattiś cet sauraṃ mānaṃ samāśrayet |
sa eva divasas tasya śrāddhapiṇḍodakādiṣu ||
atha kṣayāhadvaidhe nirṇayaḥ | tatra kṣayāhaśrāddhe tithidvaidhe karmakālavyāpinī grāhyā |
[544]        yad āha vyāsaḥ |
karmaṇo yasya yaḥ kālas tatkālavyāpinī tithiḥ |
tathā karmāṇi kurvīta hrāsavṛddhī na kāraṇam ||
skandapurāṇe |
yasmin kāle tu yat karma tatkālavyāpinī tithiḥ |
tac ca sāṃvatsarikaṃ dvividhaṃ pārvaṇam ekoddiṣṭaṃ ca, tatra pārvaṇasyāparāhṇaḥ kālaḥ ekoddiṣṭasya madhyāhnaḥ |
tathā ca vṛddhagautamaḥ
madhyāhnavyāpinī vā syāt saikoddiṣṭe tithir bhavet |
aparāhṇavyāpinī yā tu pārvaṇe sā tithirbhavet ||
atra kecid āhuḥ | yadā tithisāmye dvayor api tithyor aparāhnasambandhas tadānīṃ pārvaṇetikartavyatāke sāṃvatsarike pūrvaiva tithir grāhyā, tatra yady api parasminn api dine karmakālavyāptisambhavaḥ tathāpi prathamātikrame kāraṇābhāvāt pūrvasminn evāhani śrāddham |
āha sumantuḥ |
dviraharvyāpinī cet syāt mṛtāhasya tu yā tithiḥ |
pūrvasyāṃ nirvapet piṇḍam ityāṅgirasabhāṣitam ||
vṛddhayājñavalkyaḥ |
devakārye tithir jñeyā yasyām abhyudito raviḥ |
piṇḍakārye tithir jñeyā yasyām astamito raviḥ ||
śivarahasya-saurapurāṇayoḥ |
prātaḥ prānta upoṣyā syāt tithir daivaphalepsubhiḥ |
[545]        mūlaṃ hi pitṛtṛptyarthaṃ paitraṃ maharṣibhiḥ ||
'mūlaṃ' ārambhaḥ |
nāradīyapurāṇe ’pi |
titheḥ prāntaṃ surākhyaṃ hi upoṣyaṃ kavayo viduḥ |
paitraṃ mūlaṃ titheḥ proktaṃ śāstrajñaiḥ kālakovidaiḥ ||
nigamaḥ |
pūrvāhṇikās tu tithayo devakārye phalapradāḥ |
aparāhṇikās tathā jñeyāḥ pitrarthe tu sukhāvahāḥ ||
atrāparāhṇaḥ sūkṣmakālaprakaraṇe vakṣyamāṇeṣv aparāhṇeṣv anyatamo veditavyaḥ |
tathā ca śivarahasya-brahmavaivarta-saura-nāradīyapurāṇeṣu |
darśaṃ ca paurṇamāsaṃ ca pituḥ sāṃvatsaraṃ dinam |
pūrvaviddham akurvāṇo narakaṃ pratipadyate || iti |
tad evaṃ tithisāmye pūrvā grāhyeti siddham |
vaiṣamye tv āha baudhāyanaḥ |
yā tithis tad ahorātraṃ yasyām abhyudiyād raviḥ |
vardhamānasya pakṣasya hrāse tv astam iyād raviḥ ||
kṣayāham eva viṣayīkṛtya sa evāha |
aparāhṇadayavyāpī pramītasya yadā tithiḥ |
kṣaye pūrvā tu kartavyā vṛddhau kāryā tathottarā |
yat tu vyāghreṇa tithisāmye ’pi paratithigrahaṇam uktam,
kharvo darpas tathā hiṃsā trividhaṃ tithilakṣaṇam |
[546]        kharvadarpau parau pūjyau hiṃsā syāt pūrvakālikī ||
tad etat sāmānyaśāstraṃ kṣayāhavyatiriktatithiviṣayam āsannadinadvayasamagrāparāhṇavyāpitve tithivṛddhau paraiva grāhyeti |
tad ayukaṃ | yadā hi tithivṛddhivaśād dve api samagraṃ aparāhṇaṃ vyāpnutas tadā sāmyavadd vṛddhāv api "dvyahavyāpinī cet syād" ityādyanekavacanavaśāt "prathamaṃ vā niyamyeta kāraṇād atikramaḥ syād" ityanenaiva nyāyena pūrvatithigrahaṇasya yuktatvāt | tathā dinadvaye aparāhṇaikadeśavyāpitvasāmye pūrveti vakṣyate | tathā dinadvayasamagrāparāhṇavyāpitve vṛddhāv api pūrveti, tatra sāmye tithiḥ pūrvaiva grāhya | yady api "dvyaharvyāpinī cet syād" iti vacanāni kṣayāhatithisāmyavyatiriktaviṣayatvenāpy upapadyante kharvaśāstraṃ ca mṛtatithisāmānyavyatiriktasāmyaviṣayatvena, tathāpi bahuśāstrānurodhāt sarvaśāstram eva bādhyata iti cet | na | vṛddhāv api tulyatvāt | "aparāhṇadvayavyāpī pramītasya yadā tithir ityādivacanasya tulyāparāhṇaikadeśadvayavyāpitithidvayaviṣayatvāt anyathā tithikṣaye samastāparāhṇadvayavyāpitvāsambhavāt, “kṣaye pūrvā tu kartavyety abhidhānānupapatte vākyabhedaprasaṅgāc ca na vākyadvayakalpanā yuktā | yady api pauruṣeyatvād vākyabhedo na doṣāyeti manyase, tathāpi anekavacananyāyaviruddhakalpanā niṣprāmāṇikī |
anye (?) tv āhuḥ, yadā amāvāsyā dinadvaye ’py aparāhṇasambandhinī tadā kṣaye pūrvā vṛddhau sāmye cottarā |
sinīvālī kuhūś caiva śrutyukte śrāddhakarmaṇi |
[547]        syātānte cet tu madhyāhne śrāddhādi syāt kathaṃ tadā ||
tithikṣaye sinīvālī tithivṛddhau kuhūḥ smṛtā |
sāmye ’pi ca kuhur jñeyā vede vedāṅgavedibhiḥ ||
iti vacanāt | śrāddhāntare ’py evaṃ pārvaṇavikāratvāt tasya |
tathā coktaṃ vyāsena |
dvitīyādiṣu yugmānāṃ pūjyatā niyamādiṣu |
ekoddiṣṭavivṛdhyādau vṛddhihrāsādicodanāt || iti |
tad ayuktam | udāhṛtabahuvākyavirodhāt | tena yadā tithir vṛddhivaśād dinadvaye ’pi samagrāparāhṇavyāpinī tadā pūrvaiva, sāmye tu dinadvaye samgrāparāhṇavyāpinīti na tasyātra prasaktiḥ | yadobhe api samagrāparāhṇaṃ na vyāpnutaḥ tadā yādhikāparāhṇavyāpinī sā grāhyā |
tathā ca hārītaḥ |
aparāhṇaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tu yāparāhṇānuvyāpinī |
yā grāhyā pitṛkārye tu na pūrvāstānuyāyinī ||
yadā tu dvitīye ’hani kṛtsnam aparāhṇaṃ vyāpnoti pūrvatraikadeśavyāpinī tadā dvitīyaivārmbhopayogitvād api grāhyā |
yo yasya vihitaḥ kālaḥ karmaṇas tadupakrame |
vidyamāno bhaved aṅgaṃ nojjhitopakrameṇa tu ||
iti viṣṇuvacanāt | anyatrāpy ārabhayoginyā eva tither grahaṇam uktam |
bhūtaviddhāpy amāvāsyā pratipanmiśritāni vā |
pitrye karmaṇi vidvadbhir grāhyā kutapakālikī || iti |
[548]        matsyapurāṇe ’pi kutapa evārambho vihitaḥ |
madhyāhne sarvadā yasmān mandī bhavati bhāskaraḥ |
tasmād anantaphaladas tatrārambho viśiṣyate || iti |
na ca "bhūtaviddhāpy amāvāsyā" ity amāvāsyāyām evāyaṃ viśeṣaḥ nānyatreti vaktavyaṃ, yataḥ |
madhyāhnavyāpinī yā tu tithiḥ pūrvā parāpi vā |
iti tithimātrāvagateḥ | yadā tūbhe api tulyam aparāhṇaikadeśaṃ vyāpnutaḥ tadā tithivṛddhau paraiva grāhyā kṣaye sāmye ’pi pūrvaiva | tad uktam |
aparāhṇadvayavyāpī pramītasya yadā tithiḥ |
kṣaye pūrvā tu kartavyā vṛddhau kāryā tathottarā ||
“darśaṃ ca pūrṇamāsaṃ ca" ity udāhṛtavacanāc ca | sāmye ’pi pūrvaiva "dvyaharvyāpinī" ityādivacanāt | kharvaśāstraṃ tu kṣayāhaviṣayabahuvākyānurodhāt tadvyatiriktaviṣayaṃ jñeyaṃ ata evodāhṛtavākye kharvagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ | yadā pūrvā sāyāhnavyāpinī cāparāhṇaṃ spṛśati tadā pūrvaiva grāhyā |
tad uktaṃ manunā |
dvyaharvyāpinī cet syāt mṛtāhasya yadā tithiḥ |
pūrvaviddhaiva kartavyā trimuhūrttā bhaved yadi ||
tacā ca baudhāyanaḥ |
udite daivataṃ bhānau pitryaṃ cāstamite ravau |
dvimuhūrttā trirahnaś ca sā tithir havyakavyayoḥ || iti |
asyārthaḥ | bhānāv udite saty uttarakāle ’hno muhūrttadvayaṃ 'daivataṃ' [549] devadaivatyaṃ tasmiṃś cāstamite tatkālīnam ahno muhūrttatrayaṃ 'pitryaṃ' pitṛdevatyaṃ, atas tāvatkālavyāpinī yā tithir bhavati saiva kramād dhavyakavyayor grāhyeti tad evam astamayāt pūrvaṃ trimuhūrttā grāhyeti sthite yad bhaviṣyatpurāṇoktam |
vratopavāsasnānādau ghaṭikaikāpi yā bhavet |
udaye sā tithir grāhyā viparītā tu paitṛke || iti |
'viparītā' astamayasambandhinī |
yac ca vyāsoktam,
ahny astamayavelāyāṃ kalāmātrāpi yā bhavet |
saiva pratyābdike grāhyā netarā putrahānidā || iti |
yac ca vasiṣṭhoktam |
pitrye ’stamayavelāyāṃ spṛṣṭā pūrṇā nigadyate | iti |
tad etat pūrvadināparāhṇatrimuhūrttavyāpinyāḥ “kiṃ punar nyāyena praśaṃsārthaṃ, na tu ghaṭikādimātrakālīnāyāḥ parigrahārthaṃ, tathāvidhāyāḥ karmāparyāptatvāt uttaradine karmaparyāptāparāhṇavyāpikālalābhāc ca |
ata eva hārītaḥ |
aparāhṇaḥ pitṝṇāṃ tu yāparāhṇānuyāyinī |
sā grāhyā pitṛkārye tu pūrvā nāstānuyāyinī || iti |
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe ’pi |
vratopavāsaniyame ghaṭikaikā yadā bhavet |
sā tithiḥ sakalā jñeyā pitryarthe cāparāhṇikī ||
astādiśabdāś cāparāhṇaparā eva |
tathā ca vṛddhamanuḥ |
[550]        yasyām astaṃ ravir yāti pitaras tām upāsate |
tithis tebhyo yato dattā hy aparāhṇe svayaṃbhuvā ||
manur api |
yasyām astaṃ ravir yāti pitaras tām upāsate |
yā pitṛbhyo yato dattā hy aparāhṇe svayaṃbhuvā ||
na tv atrāstamayayoginyā grahaṇaṃ yuktaṃ, astamayasamaye śrāddhaniṣedhāt | aparāhṇe ’pi śrāddhanimittatithyabhāve yadi śrāddhaṃ kriyate tadā tām upāsate ity anupapannam aparāhṇasya dattatvena hetuvan nigadārthavādānupapatteś ca tām upāsata ity avidhyasaṅgateḥ | astamayaśabdenāpi kevalenāgnau tiṣṭhatītivat samīpalakṣaṇayāparāhṇo lakṣyate, "ṛgbhiḥ prātar divi deva īyate yajurvede tiṣṭhati madhye ahnaḥ sāmavede nāstameti vedair aśūnyas tribhir eti sūrya ity atrāstametīty etāvanmātraṃ vivakṣyate tadā aparāhṇe devasambandhābhāvāt tad eva śūnya ity upasaṃhāro nāvakalpyeta, tasmāt 'astam eti' astasamīpe aparāhṇe etītyartho gṛhītavyaḥ | evaṃ smṛtau yatra yatrāstamayasambandhinyāṃ tithau śrāddhaṃ vidhīyate tatra tatra tasyāṃ aparāhṇavyāpinyāṃ tithau śrāddhaṃ vihitam abhimantavyam | anyathā kutaparohiṇāparāhṇavākyair virodhaḥ syāt |
ahny astamayavelāyāṃ kalāmātrāpi yā tithiḥ |
saiva pratyābdike śrāddhe na parā putrahānidā ||
iti vacanād astamayamātrakāle yā tithiḥ saiva pratyābdike śraddhe gṛhyate cet tadāstamayakāla eva śrāddhaṃ prāpnoti vacanabalāt | atha sandhyākāle tatsamīpe ca śrāddhapratiṣedhāt tadā na kriyata iti [551] yady ucyeta tarhy aparāhṇakāle mṛtatither abhāvena śrāddhakaraṇe saiva pratyābdike iti vidhyartho nānuṣṭhitaḥ syāt | itarasyāṃ putrahānidāyāṃ pratiṣiddhāyāṃ tithāv anuṣṭhānaṃ bhavet |
yāṃ tithiṃ samanuprāpya udayaṃ yāti bhāskaraḥ |
sā tithiḥ sakalā jñeyā snānadānajapādiṣu ||
yāṃ tithiṃ samanuprāpya astaṃ yāti divākaraḥ |
sā tithiḥ sakalā jñeyā dānādhyayanakarmasu ||
iti devalavacanābhyāṃ udayāstamayayoginyos tithyoḥ sakalatvābhidhānāt yadā kadācit kṛtaṃ karma vihitathāv eva kṛtaṃ bhavatīti cet | na | yathāstamayasambandhena pūrvedyus tasyāḥ sakalatvaṃ tathaiva paredyur apy udayasambandhena sakalatvāt | ahny astamayavelāyāṃ dinadvaye ’pi vidyamānatvena na jñāyate saiva pratyābdike iti, kā vidhīyate pūrvā vā parā veti, kā ca pratiṣiṣyate netarā putrahānideti | kiṃ ca evaṃ paribhāṣitaṃ avāstavaṃ sakalatvaṃ yadi gṛhyate tadā sarvā evodayāstamayayogitvena sakalā na kadācit khaṇḍatithir asti | tatra sarvāsāṃ sakalatvena sarvakarmakālavyāpitvāt,
yo yasya vihitaḥ kālas tatkālavyāpinī tithir iti |
madhyāhnavyāpinī yā syāt saikoddiṣṭe tithir bhavet |
parāhṇavyāpinī yā syāt pārvaṇe sā tithir bhavet ||
ityādivacanajātasya nivartanīyābhāvāt ānarthakyam eva syāt | kiṃ ca kim atrāparāhṇābādhenāstamayavelākalāyāṃ pratyabdaśrāddhavidhānaṃ atha vā dvimuhūrttaṃ trirahnaś ceti trimuhūrttabādhena vā | ādye pakṣe aparāhṇaḥ pitṝṇām iti śrutivirodhaḥ |
[552]        tad uktaṃ smṛtyantare |
aparāhṇaḥ pitṝṇāṃ tu yāparāhṇānuyāyinī |
yā grāhyā pitṛkārye tu na sā yāstānuyāyinī ||
iti sampūrṇāyām api tithāv astamayavelāyāṃ śrāddhaṃ prasajyeta | kiṃ ca pratyābdikaśabdena kiṃ śrāddham abhidhīyate karmāntaraṃ vā, śrāddhapakṣe ’pi mṛtāhaśrāddham akṣayatṛtīyāśrāddhaṃ ceti yāvat pramāṇāntaravaśād avadhāryate tāvad aparāhṇaḥ pitṝṇām iti śrutyā kathaṃcin na bādhyate | dvitīye pakṣe cāyaṃ viśeṣaḥ tithyabhāve aparāhṇe śrāddhe kṛte mṛtāhe śrāddhaṃ na kṛtaṃ syāt
māsapakṣe tithispṛṣṭe yo yasmin mriyate ’hani |
pratyabdaṃ tu tathābhūtaṃ mṛtāhaṃ tasya taṃ viduḥ ||
iti tallakṣaṇāt | na caivam api dinānte vidyamānayā tithyā tad ahaḥ spṛṣṭam iti tanmṛtāhaḥ syād iti tatrāpi śrāddhaṃ prāpnotīti vaktavyam |
yataḥ |
anagnimata utkrānte sāgneḥ saṃskārakarmaṇaḥ |
śuddhiḥ saṃcayanaṃ dāhān mṛtāhas tu yathā tithiḥ ||
iti maraṇakālīnatithivaśena mṛtāha ity uktaṃ na maraṇatithiyogavaśena, anyathaikasminn ahani tithidvayayoge saty ubhayatrāpi śrāddhaṃ prāpnoti na kvacid vā aviśeṣāt | “pūrvasyāṃ nirvapet piṇḍam" ityādau ca saptamyā tither ādhāratvāvagamāt tat tithiṃ vinā śrāddhe kriyamāṇe
akāle yat kṛtaṃ karma vidhiśaucavivarjitam |
akṛtaṃ tad vijānīyāt punar ijyā śruter balāt ||
ity āpatati, tasmān māsapakṣatithispṛṣṭa ity asyāyamarthaḥ, yasmin [553] māse yasmin pakṣe yasyāṃ tithau yo mṛtas tasya teṣu vidyamāneṣu mṛtāha iti | astamayavelāśabdena kiṃ sāyaṃsaṃdhir ucyate tato ’rvāg vā upari vā, ādye pakṣe ahnīti nopapadyate, sampūrṇādityamaṇḍalopalabdhāvaḥaḥśabdaṃ prayuñjate vṛddhāḥ | dvitīyapakṣe madhyāhnād upari sarvāpy astamayavelā syāt |
udaye vardhamānābhir ā madhyāhnaṃ taped raviḥ |
tataḥ paraṃ hrasantībhir gobhir astaṃ sa gacchati ||
ity astamayasambandhinaḥ kālasya madhyāhnād upari purāṇe pratipādanāt | tathā sati "aparāhṇaḥ pitṝṇām" iti śrutyā saha virodho na bhavet | tṛtīyapakṣo ’pi na yuktaḥ ahny astamayavelāyām ity ahny astamayavelāyāḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyānupapatteḥ | tasmād ayam artho ’sya vacanasya, ahny ayastamayavelāyāṃ ahni divasamadhye yāstamayavelā yo ’stamayasannihitaḥ kālaḥ sāyāhnas trimuhūrttaḥ pañcamo vibhāgas tasya praveśe yā kalāmātrāpy asti saiva pratyābdike grāhyā tasyāḥ śrāddhādimuhūrttapañcakarūpāparāhṇavyāpitvāt, netarā pūrvā yā sāyāhnamātravarttinī śrāddhayogyaṃ na aparāhṇaṃ vyāpnoti sā putrahānidā na grāhyety arthaḥ | evaṃvidhe vacanārthe nānupapannaṃ kiṃcit | nāpi vacanāntarasyānarthakyaṃ virodho vā | atha vā pūrvasminn ahani lokaprasiddhakṛtsnāstamayakālavyāpinī dvitīye ’hani tadaikadeśavyāpinī yadā tadā dvitīye ’hani pūrvatithyapavādena śrāddhaṃ niyamyate iti niravadyam | smṛticandrikākāraḥ | astamayaspṛṣṭhāpi tithiḥ pūrvaiva grāhyeti | na cātra caturthapraharottarārddhavyatiriktāparāhṇe kāle tithisaṃyogāsambhavena tithiyuktāparāhṇa- [554]kālābhāvād ananuṣṭhānam eva śrāddhasyeti vācyam | yad āha nāradīyapurāṇe vaśiṣṭhaḥ |
pāraṇe maraṇe nṝṇāṃ tithis tātkālikī smṛtā |
pitrye ’stamayavelāyāṃ spṛṣṭā pūrṇā nigadyate || iti |
astamayavelāyāṃ yā spṛṣṭā mṛtatithis tattithau karttavye pitrye ābdikādiśrāddhe pūrṇā nigadyatety arthaḥ | astamayavelāyāṃ spṛṣṭety anenāstamayasamaye kalāsadbhāve ’pi mṛtatitheḥ pūrṇatvam uktam iti mantavyam |
yat tu smṛtyantaram,
dinānte pañca nāḍyas tu puṇyāḥ proktā manīṣibhiḥ |
udaye ca tathā pitrye daive caiva ca karmaṇi ||
iti, pitrye karmaṇi kālatvena coditatithisambandhinyo dinānte varttamānāḥ pañca nāḍyaḥ puṇyās tataḥ prakṛtanāḍītithiyogajanyapuṇyatvāpādikāḥ na tu tato nyūnāḥ, daive karmaṇi kālatvena coditatithisambandhinya udaye sati varttamānāḥ pañca nāḍyaḥ puṇyāḥ tata uparitananāḍīnām api tithiyogajanyapuṇyāpādakā na tu tato nyūnā iti tasyārthaḥ | tad etat | “pratipaddhanalābhāya dvitīyā dvipadapradetyādinā śrāddhaṃ kurvann amāvāsyāṃ yatnena puruṣaḥ śuciḥ | sarvān kāmān avāpnotītyantena śrāddhakālatayā vihitakṛṣṇapakṣapratipadāditithidvaidhaviṣayaṃ na tu śrāddhāntarakālatayā vihitatithidvaidhaviṣayam | pitryaṃ śrāddhaṃ kṛṣṇapakṣadine ’stamayayoginīti prastutya tatraiva viśeṣābhidhānaparatvād asya vacanasya, tena pūrvoktavaśiṣṭhavacanena saha na kaścid virodhaḥ |
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe ’pi |
[555]        vratopavāsaniyame ghaṭikaikā yadā bhavet |
yā tithiḥ sakalā jñeyā pitrarthe cāparāhṇikī || iti |
sandhyāsamīpasthāparāhṇikī ghaṭikaikā yadā bhavet sā tithiḥ pitrarthe sakalā jñeyety arthaḥ | yadā tu pūrvadine ’stamayāt pūrvakṣaṇe tithiyogaḥ uttaradine ca astamayād upari trimuhūrttayuktā tadā uttaram ahaḥ śrāddhakālaḥ |
tathā ca sumantuḥ |
udite daivataṃ bhānau paitryaṃ vāstamite ravau |
dvimuhūrttaṃ trirahno vā sā tithir havyakavyayoḥ || iti |
asyārthaḥ udite bhānau saty ahnaḥ sambandhinī devakarmāṅgabhūtā tithir yā dvimuhūrttād anyūnā bhavati sā sampūrṇatithivat kṛtsnasyāhno havyadānakālatām āpādayati tena tasminn ahani daivaṃ karma kuryāt | pitṛkarmāṅgabhūtā tithir astamite ravau sati yā trimuhūrttam anuvartate sā kavyadānakālatāṃ svasambandhasyāhna āpādayati tena tatsambaddhe ’hni pitṛsambandhisāṃvatsarikādiśrāddhaṃ kuryād iti | anenottaradine astamayād upari trimuhūrttānuvṛttyabhāve 'stagāminī pūrvatithir eva grāhyety arthād uktam |
evaṃ ca yad uktaṃ nāradīyapurāṇe |
darśaṃ ca pūrṇamāsaṃ ca pituḥ sāṃvatsaraṃ dinam |
pūrvaviddham akurvāṇo narakaṃ pratipadyate || iti |
taduparidine ’stamayād upari muhūrttatrayābhāve draṣṭavyam | yadā tu pūrvedyur astagāminī tithiḥ sambhavati uttaredyur asamite ravau trimuhūrttavyāpinī [556] na bhavati kiṃ tv astagāminī bhavati tadāpi saiva grāhyā śrāddhādāv astagāminīti smaraṇāt | yadā tu dinadvaye ’py astagāminī tithir na bhavati tadottaredyur evāstagāmitvarūpaguṇābhāve ’pi guṇalopanyāyena sāṃvatsarikaśrāddhaṃ kartavyaṃ, tithiyuktāparāhṇakālavyatikrameṇa pratyavāyāpatteś ceti |
tad ayuktaṃ | astamayasparśamātreṇa sāṃvatsarikaśrāddhe pūrvaviddhatithigrahaṇe |
dvyaharvyāpinī cet syān mṛtāhasya yadā tithiḥ |
pūrvaviddhaiva karttavyā trimuhūrttā bhaved yadi ||
iti manuvacanavirodhāt | "vratopavāsaniyama" iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇavacanam aparāhṇikyā eva tither grahaṇaṃ pratipādayati | vacanāntaravirodhena ghaṭikaikety asyānuvṛttau pramāṇābhāvāt uktaprakāreṇa gatisambhavāc ca paredyuḥ śrāddhāsambhavaviṣayatvenopapatteś ca |
yad api ca sumantuvacanasyāstamayoparitanatrimuhūrttaviṣayatvena vyākhyātam,
tad apy ayuktam | ahaḥśabdaparyālocanayā dvimuhūrttasya ca dinasambandhitvāvagateḥ |
anye tv āhuḥ dvitīye ’hany aparāhṇavyāpitve trimuhūrttā cet pūrvaviddhā karttavyā “trimuhūrttā bhaved yadi" iti manuvacanāt | "aparāhṇaḥ pitṝṇāṃ tu" iti hārītavacanaṃ sāṃvatsarikavyatiriktaviṣayam | evaṃ ca sati "dviraharvyāpinī" iti sumantuvacanasya, "devakārye tithir jñeyā" iti vṛddhayājñavalkyavacanasya, “prātaḥ prātar upoṣya" iti śivarahasya-saurapurāṇasya, “titheḥ prāntam" iti nāradīyapurāṇavacanasya, “udite devatam" iti [557] baudhāyanavacanasya, "vratopavāsasnānādau" iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇavacanasya, "astamayavelāyām" iti vyāsavacanasya, “pitrye ’stamayavelāyām" iti
vasiṣṭhavacanasya, "darśaṃ ca paurṇamāsaṃ ca" iti śivarahasyāhṛtamanuvacanasyety evaṃ vacanadaśakabādhalāghavaṃ syāt, bhavatpakṣe tu bādhagauravaṃ syāt | syād etat bhavatpakṣe ’pi “karmaṇo yasya yaḥ kālaḥ" iti vyāsavacanasya, "yasmin kāle hi yat karma" iti skandavacanasa, “āparāhṇikās tathā" iti nigamavacanasya, “aparāhṇaḥ pitṝṇām" iti hārītavacanasya, “vratopavāsaniyama" iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇavacanasya, “yasyām astaṃ ravir yāti" iti laghu-vṛddhamanuvacanayoḥ, “aparāhṇavyāpinī" iti vṛddhagautamavacanasya, "vihitaḥ kālaḥ" iti baudhāyana-laghuuviṣṇuvacanayoḥ, “madhyāhnavyāpinī" iti baudhāyanavacanasyety evaṃ vacanaikādaśakasya bādhagauravaṃ bhaviṣyati |asmatpakṣe tu bādhalāghavam iti cet | ucyate | pakṣadvaye bahuvākyabādhāviśeṣe ’py ācārānuguṇyāt pūrvaviddhā trimuhūrttā gṛhyate |
tad ayukaṃ | ācāradvaividhyāt | bhavatpakṣe mṛtatithisāṃvatsarikavidhāvakavākyabādho ’pi bhavet | tataś ca bahuvākyabādhān nāyaṃ pakṣo jyāyān | kiṃ ca yathā śrāddhe trimuhūrttatithigrahaṇaśravaṇāt karmakālavyāpiśāstrabādho ’ṅgīkriyate tathā |
yasyāṃ tithāv astam iyāt sūryas tu triuhūrttke |
yāgadānajapādibhyas tām evopakramet tithim ||
iti vacanāt karmāntare ’pi trimuhūrtatithigrahaṇaśravaṇāt tadbādhaḥ prasajyeteti vaiṣamyāṅgīkaraṇam ayuktam | tatrāpi caivam abhyupagame doṣaḥ prāg abhihitaḥ |
[558]        anye tv āhuḥ, kṣayāhaśrāddha ācāravipratipatter vacanavipratipatteś ca paraṃparāprāptācārāśrayaṇena tither grahaṇam iti | teṣāṃ paraṃparāprāptāḥ pūrvajair apy anuṣṭhitāḥ, “tad eva tair na duṣyeyur ācārair netaraiḥ punar" iti vacanāt |
tathā ca vyāsaḥ |
tarko 'pratiṣṭhaḥ śrutayo vibhinnā
nāsāv ṛṣir yasya mataṃ na bhinnam |
dharmasya tattvaṃ nihitaṃ guhāyāṃ
mahājano yena gataḥ sa panthāḥ ||
iti yad atra yuktaṃ tat grāhyam ||
iti kṣayāhadvaidhanirṇayaḥ |
atha kṣayāhāparijñāne sāṃvatsarikaśrāddha-
kālanirṇayaḥ ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
aruṇa uvāca ||
na jānāti dinaṃ yas tu māsaṃ vāpy amarādhipa |
mṛtayos tu mahāprājñaḥ pitror yas tu kathaṃ naraḥ |
śrāddhaṃ karotu vai tābhyāṃ vidhivat vatsarātmakam ||
atra pitror ity upalakṣaṇam anyeṣāṃ api śrāddhasa māsadinājñāne tathaivācaraṇāt |
āditya uvāca ||
mṛtāhaṃ yo na jānāti mānavo vinatātmaja |
[559]        tena kāryam amāvāsyāṃ śrāddhaṃ sāṃvatsaraṃ nṛpa ||
yasya proṣitasyāproṣitasya vā mṛtasya tithir na jñāyate māsas tu jñāyate tasya tanmāsāmāvāsyāyāṃ sāṃvatsarikaṃ kāryam ity arthaḥ |
tad āha bṛhaspatiḥ |
na jñāyeta mṛtāhaś cet pramīte proṣite sati |
māsaś cet prativijñātas tad darśe syān mṛtāhani ||
'tad darśe' tanmāsāmāvāsyāyāṃ, 'mṛtāhani" ity atra yat kartavyaṃ tad iti śeṣaḥ, 'proṣite" ity ajñānakāraṇopalakṣaṇam |
tathā ca bhaviṣyottare |
pravāsam antareṇāpi syātāṃ tau vismṛtau yadā |
tadānīm api tau grāhyau pūrvavat tu mṛtāhnike ||
asminn eva viṣaye ekādaśyāṃ śrāddham āha marīciḥ |
śrāddhavighne samutpanne avijñāte mṛte ’hani |
