śrāddhasamāptau mārkaṇḍeyaḥ |
tato nityakriyāṃ kuryād bhojayec ca tathātithīn |
tatas tad annaṃ bhuñjīta saha bhṛtyādibhir naraḥ ||
'nityakriyāṃ' vaiśvadevahomabaliharaṇanityaśrāddhādirūpām | tad evam anagnikartṛkasya vaiśvadevasya trayas tu kālāḥ | eko ’gnaukaraṇānantaraḥ, anyo vikirād upari, tṛtīyo brāhmaṇavisarjanāt paścād iti |
ity anagnikakartṛkavaiśvadevakālanirṇayaḥ |
atha sāgnikakartṛkasya vaiśvadevasya kālanirṇayaḥ |
asya na śrāḍūmadhye śrāddhānte vānuṣṭhānaṃ kiṃ tv akṛta eva śrāddhe, yataḥ śrāddhāt pūrvaṃ piṇḍapitṛyajño vihitas tasmād api pūrvaṃ vaiśvadevaḥ |
tathā ca devalaḥ |
akṛte vaiśvadeve tu sthālīpākaḥ prakīrttitaḥ |
anyatra piṇḍayajñāt tu so ’parāhṇe vidhīyate ||
[609]        atra sthālīpākasādhyāni karmāṇi sthālīpākaśabdenocyante tāni piṇḍapitṛyajñād anyāni akṛta eva vaiśvadeve kriyante, piṇḍapitṛyajñas tu kṛte vaiśvadeve paścād aparāhṇe kriyate |
piṇḍapitṛyajñaś ca śrāddhāt pūrvam ukto manunā |
pitṛyajñaṃ tu nirvartya vipraś candrakṣaye ’gnimān |
piṇḍānvāhāryakaṃ śrāddhaṃ kuryān māsānumāsikam || iti |
amum evārthaṃ spaṣṭam āha laugākṣiḥ |
pakṣāntaṃ karma nirvartya vaiśvadevaṃ ca sāgnikaḥ |
piṇḍayajñaṃ tataḥ kuryāt tato ’nvāhāryakaṃ budhaḥ || iti |
'pakṣāntaṃ' agnyanvādhānaṃ, 'anvāhāryakaṃ' darśaśrāddhaṃ |
nanu pakṣāntapiṇḍapitṛyajñayor madhye vidhānād eva vaiśvadevasya sāgnikakartṛkatvāvagamāt kimarthaṃ sāgnikagrahaṇaṃ |
na, pakṣādisthālīpākapiṇḍapitṛyajñakartur niragnikasya nivṛttyartham | atas tenāpy anagnikāntaratatpūrvaprakaraṇokteṣv eva kāleṣu vaiśvadevaḥ kartavyaḥ | gobhilenāpi "pitryasya svastyayanasya vākyārthasya cety atra sūtre sarvaprakārasyāpi śrāddhasādāv eva vaiśvadeva" ity uktam | śrutāv api sāgnikasyādāv eva vaiśvadevaḥ śrūyate, "nāhutasyāśnīyur nāhutaṃ dadhur" iti | sāgnikasyāpi śrāddhaviśeṣe paścād eva vaiśvadevaḥ |
tathā ca pariśiṣṭe |
saṃprāpte pārvaṇaśrāddhe ekoddiṣṭe tathaiva ca |
agrato vaiśvadevaḥ syāt paścād ekādaś 'hani ||
atra parvagrahaṇam anekadevatyaśrāddhopalakṣaṇārtham | tataś caikādaśāha[610]vyatirikteṣu śrāddheṣu sāgnikasya pūrvam eva vaiśvadevaḥ | ekādaśāhika eva tu paścād iti nirṇayaḥ |
tad āha śālaṅkāyanaḥ |
śrāddhāt prāg eva kurvīta vaiśvadevaṃ tu sāgnikaḥ |
ekādaśāhikaṃ muktvā tat tu hy ante vidhīyate ||
iti sāgnikakartṛkavaiśvadevakālanirṇayaḥ ||
atha bhūtayajñādikālanirṇayaḥ |
tatra karkopādhyāyo manyate | yadaiva vaiśvadevas tadaiva tadanantaraṃ bhūtayajñasaṃjñako baliḥ | yas tu "tato gṛhabaliṃ kuryād" iti manunā śrāddhānte balir uktaḥ, sa tu vāstudevatābhyaḥ na bhūtayajñasya | ata eva brāhmaṇavisarjanam abhidhāyāha pāraskaraḥ |
visṛjya balidānena pūjayed gṛhadevatāḥ | iti |
śaṅkhadharo ’pi |
yadaiva vaiśvadevas tadaiva tadanantaraṃ bhūtayajño ’pi na kadācid api vaiśvadevabhūtayajñayor madhye karmāntarānuṣṭhānena vyavadhānaṃ kartavyaṃ avyavadhānavacanāt |
tathā hi |
devayajñaḥ smṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ bhūtayajñas tathā paraḥ | iti |
tathā |
devebhyas tu hutād annāc cheṣād bhūtabaliṃ haret | iti |
yat punaḥ pūrvakṛte vaiśvadeve śrāddhānte bhūtayajñasya vacanaṃ tadvaiśvadevānantaram [611] eva bhūtayajñe kṛte ’pi śrāddhāṅgatayā tāvanmātrasya punar anuṣṭhānaṃ kartavyam ity evaṃparaṃ | yad api pūrvakṛte vaiśvadeve śrāddhānte gṛhabaler vacanaṃ tad api vaiśvadevakāla eva kṛtasyāpi gṛhabaleḥ śrāddhāṅgatayaiva tāvanmātrasya punaḥ karaṇārtham iti |
tad etad anupapannaṃ bhūtayajñādeḥ puruṣārthasya śrāddhāṅgatvavirodhāt |
atha saṃyogapṛthaktvavad ekasyobhayārthatā na virudhyata iti manyase |
tan na, śrutyādeḥ śrāddhāṅgatāpādakasyādarśanāt saṃyogapṛthaktvasyāsiddheḥ |
atha karmāntaram evedaṃ prakaraṇāpāditaśrāddhāṅgabhāvaṃ vidhīyate ity ucyate |
tad api na, puruṣārthasyaiva ca bhūtayajñasya vaiśvadevavat pratyabhijñānāt | anyathā “vaiśvadevaṃ tataḥ kuryād" ity atrāpi śrāddhāṅgatayā vaiśvadevāntaravidheḥ prasaṅgaḥ | na caitad yujyate, gauravāt | kramamātravidhau hi lāghavaṃ pratyabhijñānugrahaś ceti guṇaḥ | ato vacanāvyavadhānam api tathāvidham abhyupeyam | vacanaṃ ca smṛticandrikākāreṇa darśitam |
vaiśvadevāhutir agnāv arvāg brāhmaṇabhojanāt |
juhuyād bhūtayajñādi śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā tu tad bhavet || iti |
na cātrāhutimātraśravaṇād vaiśvadevāṅgabaliharaṇaṃ paścāt kartavyam iti manatavyaṃ, uttarārdhe bhūtayajñāder eva śrāddhānantarakāle vidhānāt | ata eva
vaiśvadevaṃ prakurvīta naityakaṃ balimeva ca |
iti śrāddhaprakaraṇa eva matsyenānayor nairantaryam uktaṃ |
iti bhūtayajñādikālanirṇayaḥ |
[612]
atha nityaśrāddhakālanirṇayaḥ |
bhūtayajñādiprakaraṇanirṇītaṃ nityam api śrāddhaṃ kiṃcid viśeṣābhidhānāya punaḥ prastūyate |
tatra mārkaṇḍeyaḥ |
tato nityakriyāṃ kuryād bhojayec ca tathātithīn |
tatas tad annaṃ bhuñjīta saha bhṛtyādibhir naraḥ ||
'tataḥ' tena śrāddhaśeṣānnena, 'nityakriyāṃ' annasādhyāṃ | ato nityaśrāddham api tenaiva kartavyaṃ | atha vā nityaśrāddhaṃ pṛthakpākena kāryaṃ tasya śrāddhātmakatvena śrāddhadharmabhūtasya pākasya pṛthakaprayuktisambhavāt | ata eva nityaśrāddham adhikṛtya mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe ’bhihitaṃ "pṛthakpākena nety anya" iti | asyārthaḥ darśādiśrāddhapākāt pṛthak pākena nityaśrāddhaṃ kartavyaṃ, anye tv etan nety āhuḥ, darśādiśrāddhārthapākaśeṣeṇa nityaśrāddham api kartavyam ity arthaḥ | etac ca śrāddhāntare kṛte saty aniyataṃ |
yad uktaṃ tatraiva |
nityakriyāṃ pitṝaṇāṃ ca kecid icchanti mānavāḥ |
na pitṝṇāṃ tathaivānye śeṣaṃ pūrvavad ācaret ||
'pitṝṇāṃ', 'nityakriyāṃ' nityaśrāddhaṃ | asya ca nityaśrāddhavikalpasyaivaṃ vyavasthā, amāvāsyādisādhāraṇakālikeṣu śrāddheṣu tathā nāndīmukhatīrthaśrāddheṣu ca nityaśrāddhadevatānām iṣṭatvāt prasaṅgasiddhatayā nityaśrāddhaṃ na kartavyaṃ, sāṃvatsarikaikoddiṣṭādiṣu tu sarvāsāṃ nityaśrāddhādidevatānām iṣṭatvaniyamābhāvān nityaśrāddham avaśyaṃ kartavyam | 'śeṣaṃ' vaiśvadevādikaṃ, 'pūrvavad ācaret' niyamenaiva kuryād ity arthaḥ |
[613]        tad uktaṃ nāgarakhaṇḍe |
nityaśrāddhaṃ na kurvīta prasaṅgād yatra sidhyati |
śrāddhāntare kṛte ’nyatra nityatvāt tan na hāpayet ||
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevīyasamastakaraṇādhīśvara-
sakalavidyāviśāradaśrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau
pariśeṣakhaṇḍe kālanirṇaye śrāddhakālanirṇayaḥ ||
[614]
atha trayodaśo ’dhyāyaḥ |
atha pratipatprabhṛtikrameṇa puṇyatithayaḥ |
tatra tāvat puṇyā pratipat | padmapurāṇe |
caitre māsi mahābāho puṇyā pratipadā purā |
tasyāṃ yas tapanaṃ dṛṣṭvā snānaṃ kuryān narottamaḥ ||
na tasya duritaṃ kiṃcit nādhayo vyādhayo nṛpa |
bhavanti kuruśārdūla tasyāṃ snānaṃ samācaret ||
divyanīrājanaṃ tad dhi sarvarogavināśakam |
gomahiṣyādi yat kiṃcit tat sarvaṃ bhūṣayen nṛpaḥ ||
cūrṇavastrādibhiḥ sarvais toraṇadhas tato nayet |
brāhmaṇānāṃ tathā bhojyaṃ kuryāt kurukulodvaha ||
tisra etāḥ purā proktās tithayaḥ kurunandana |
kārttikāśvayuje māsi caitre vāpi tathā nṛpa |
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
tithīnāṃ pravarā yasmād brahmaṇā samudāhṛtā |
pratipāditā yadā pūrve pratipat tena cocyate ||
tisro hy etāḥ purā prokrās tithayaḥ kurunandana |
kārttike vāśvine māsi caitre māsi ca bhārata |
snānaṃ dānaṃ śataguṇaṃ kārttike yā tithir bhavet ||
agnim iṣṭvā ca hutvā ca pratipady api bhārata |
[615]        haviṣā sarvadhānyāni prānuyād amitaṃ dhanam ||
vārāhe |
kārttike sitapakṣādau tithau tu kusumāṃśukaiḥ |
yātrārcā yatra rātrau syāt kāryā ceṣṭasukhāya sā |
vāsobhir ahataiḥ pūjya gacched vai brahmaṇaḥ padam ||
brahmapurāṇe |
kārttike śuklapakṣe tu vidhānaṃ dvitayaṃ hi tat |
nārīnirājanaṃ prātaḥ sāyaṃ maṅgalamālikā |
atha cet pratipat svalpā nārīnirājanaṃ bhavet |
dvitīyāyāṃ tadā kuryāt sāyaṃ maṅgalamālikā ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
abhyetya yadi vā prātaḥ pratipadghaṭikādvayam |
tasyāṃ nīrājanaṃ kāryaṃ sāyaṃ maṅgalamālikā ||
tathā ca devīpurāṇe |
prātar vā yadi labhyeta pratipadghaṭikā śubhā |
dvitīyāyāṃ tadā kuryāt sāyaṃ maṅgalamālikā ||
aśvinānte yadā darśe nārīnīrājanaṃ bhavet |
nārīṇāṃ tatra vaidhyavyaṃ deśe durbhikṣam eva ca ||
kārttike śuklapakṣādāv amāvāsyāghaṭīdvayam |
deśabhaṅgabhayān naiva kuryāt maṅgalamālikā ||
[616]        brahmapurāṇe |
kārttike śuklapakṣe tu prathame ’hani satyavān |
jitaś ca śaṅkaras tatra jayaṃ lebhe ca pārvatī ||
tato ’haṃ śaṅkaro duḥkhī gaurī nityasukhoṣitā |
tasmād dyūtaṃ prakartavyaṃ prabhāte tatra mānavaiḥ ||
tasmin dyūte jayo yasya tasya saṃvatsaraḥ śubhaḥ |
parājayo viruddhaś ca lābhanāśakaro bhavet ||
śrotavyaṃ gītavādyādi svanuliptaiḥ svalaṃkṛtaiḥ |
viśeṣataś ca bhoktavyaṃ praśatair bāndhavaiḥ saha ||
tasyāṃ niśāyāṃ kartavyaṃ śayyāsthānaṃ suśobhanam |
gandhaiḥ puṣpais tathā vasbtrair divyaratnair alaṅkṛtam ||
dīpamālāparikṣiptaṃ tathā bhūpena dhūpitam |
dayitābhiś ca sahitair neyā sā ca bhaven niśā |
navair vastraiś ca saṃpūjyā dvijasambandhibāndhavāḥ ||
padmapurāṇe |
pratipadi ca brahmāṇaṃ guḍamiśraiḥ pradīpakaiḥ |
vāsobhir ahataiḥ pūjya gacched vai brahmaṇaḥ padam ||
gandhaiḥ puṣpair navair vastrais tat sthānaṃ bhūṣayen naraḥ |
tasyāṃ pratipadāyāṃ tu sa gacched brahmaṇaḥ padam ||
mahāpuṇyā tithir iyaṃ balir ājyapravarttinī |
brahmaṇo hi priyā nityaṃ bāleyī parikīrttitā ||
brāhmaṇān pūjayed yo ’syām ātmānaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ |
[617]        sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ viṣṇor amitatejasaḥ ||
vāmanapurāṇe baliṃ prati trivikrama uvāca |
vīrapratipadā nāma tava bhāvī mahotsavaḥ |
tatra tvāṃ naraśārdūla tato hṛṣṭāḥ svalaṃkṛtāḥ ||
puṣpadhūpapradānena arcayiṣyanti tatvataḥ |
tatrotsava mukhyatamo bhaviṣyati divāniśam ||
iti puṣyapratipat |
atha puṇyadvitīyā |
tatra devīpurāṇe |
umāṃ śivaṃ hutāśaṃ ca ditīyāyāṃ tu pūjayet |
haviṣyam anaṃ naivedyaṃ deyaṃ gandhārcanaṃ tathā ||
atra caitrādau damanakapūjā prakāntā skandapurāṇe |
aśvine māsi vai puṇyā dvitīyā śuklapakṣajā |
dānaṃ pradattam etasyām anantaphalam ucyate ||
liṅgapurāṇe |
vṛścike ca dvitīyāyāṃ śuklāyāṃ pratipūjanam |
yo na kuryād vinaśyanti bhrātaraḥ saptajanmagāḥ ||
brahmapurāṇe |
bṛhaspatau dvitīyāyāṃ vidhivad vidhipūjanam |
[618]        kṛtvā naktaṃ samaśnīyāl labhate bhūtim īpsitām ||
'vidhiḥ' brahmā | tatpūjanaṃ ca gāyatryā vrakṣmaprakaraṇoktanyānyena mantreṇa vā kāryam |
iti puṇyadvitīyā |
atha puṇyatṛtīyā |
tṛtīyāyāṃ yajed devīṃ śaṅkareṇa samanvitām |
sugandhapuṣpadhūpaiś ca damanena sumālinā ||
atra caitro māsaḥ prakṛtaḥ |
padmapurāṇe |
vaiśākhamāse yat puṇyā tṛtīyā śuklapakṣajā |
anantaphaladā sā tu snānadānādikarmasu ||
bhaviṣyottare |
yā tv eṣā kuruśārdūla vaiśākhe tu mahātithiḥ |
tṛtīyā mākṣayā loke gīrvāṇair abhivanditā ||
yat kiṃcid dīyate dānaṃ svalpaṃ vā yadi vā bahu |
tat sarvam ackṣyaṃ yasmāt teneyam akṣyā smṛtā ||
śravaṇena samāyuktā tṛtīyā yā viśeṣataḥ |
budhaśravaṇasaṃyuktā tṛtīyā yadi labhyate |
tasyāṃ snānopavāsādyam akṣayaṃ parikīrttitam ||
tathā |
vāridānaṃ praśastaṃ syān modakānāṃ tathaiva ca |
[619]        vaiśākhe māsi rājendra tṛtīyāyāṃ ca candanam ||
deyam iti śeṣaḥ |
guḍāpūpāś ca dātavyā māsi bhādrapade tathā |
pāyasaṃ ve tṛtīyāyāṃ vāmadevasya prītaye ||
māghe māsi tṛtīyāyāṃ guḍasya lavaṇasya ca |
dānaṃ śreyaskaraṃ rājan strīṇāṃ ca puruṣasya ca ||
tena sutā vācyamānā tṛtīyā rohiṇīyutā |
viśeṣād budhasaṃyuktā tadā sā sumahatphalā ||
iti puṇyatṛtīyā |
atha puṇyacaturthī |
varāhapurāṇe |
caturthyāṃ tu gaṇeśasya pārvatyāś ca viśeṣataḥ |
pūjā kāryety anuvartate |
devīpurāṇe |
gaṇeśe kārayet pūjāṃ laḍḍukādivibhāvanam |
caturthyāṃ vighnanāśāya sarvakāmaprasiddhaye ||
caitraśuklacaturthyāṃ ca damanakair iyaṃ pūjā |
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
śivā śāntā sukhā rājan caturthyāṃ trividhā matā |
māsi bhādrapade śuklā śivā lokeṣu pūjitā ||
[620]        tasyāṃ snanaṃ ca dānaṃ ca upavāso japas tathā |
bhavet sahasraguṇitaṃ prasādād dantino nṛpa ||
tasyāṃ tu kuruśārdūla pūjayanti sadā striyaḥ |
guḍalavaṇapūpaiś ca śvaśrūṃ śvaśuram eva ca ||
tāḥ sarvāḥ subhagāḥ syur vai vighneśasya tu modanāt |
kanyakā tu viśeṣeṇa vidhinānena pūjayet ||
māghe māsi tathā śuklā yā caturthī mahīpate |
jñeyā sā śāntidā nityaṃ śāntiṃ kuryāt sadaiva tu ||
jñānadānādikaṃ karma bhavet sāhasrikaṃ smṛtam |
viśeṣataḥ striyo rājan pūjayantyo guruṃ nṛpa |
guḍalavaṇa-ghṛtair vīra subhagāḥ syuḥ kurūdvaha ||
yadā śuklacaturthyāṃ tu vāro bhaumasya vai bhavet |
tadā sā sukhadā jñeyā sukhā nāmeti kīrttitā |
snānadānādikaṃ karma sarvam akṣayam ucyate || iti |
yamaḥ |
caturthyāṃ bharaṇīyogaḥ śanaiścaradine yadi |
tadābhyarcya yamaṃ devaṃ mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ ||
iti puṇyacaturthī |
atha puṇyapañcamī |
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
pañcamī dayitā rājan nāgānandapravarddhanī |
pañcamyāṃ snāpayantīha nāgān kṣīreṇa ye narāḥ |
teṣāṃ kule prayacchanti abhayaṃ prāṇarakṣaṇam ||
brahmapurāṇe |
śuklāyām atha pañcamyāṃ caitre māsi śubhānanā |
śrīr viṣṇulokān mānuṣyaṃ samprāptā keśavājñayā ||
tasmāt tāṃ pūjayet tatra yas taṃ lakṣmīr na muñcati |
eṣā śrīpañcamī kāryā viṣṇulokagatipradā ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
supte janārdane kṛṣṇe pañcamyāṃ bhāvanānt tataḥ |
pūjayen manasā devīṃ snuhīviṭapasaṃśrayām ||
picumardapalāśāni sthāpayed bhavanāntare |
pūjayitvā naro devīṃ na sarpair bhayam āpnuyāt ||
śrāvaṇe māsi pañcamyāṃ śuklapakṣe narādhipa |
dvārasyobhayato lekhyā gomayena viṣolvaṇāḥ ||
pūjayed vidhivad vīra dadhidūrvāṅkuraiḥ kuśaiḥ |
gandhapuṣpopahāraiś ca brāhmaṇānāṃ ca tarpaṇaiḥ ||
ye tasyāṃ pūjayantīha nāgān bhaktipuraḥsarāḥ |
na teṣāṃ sarpato vīra bhayaṃ bhavati ca kvacit ||
tathā bhādrapade māsi pañcamyāṃ śraddhayānvitaḥ |
[622]        samālikhya naro nāgān śuklakṛṣṇādivarṇakaiḥ |
pūjayed gandhapuṣpaiś ca sarpirguggulapāyasaiḥ ||
tasya tuṣṭāḥ prayānty āśu pannagās takṣakādayaḥ |
ā saptamāt kulāt tasya na bhayaṃ sarpato bhavet ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
puṇyā bhādrapade proktā pañcamī nāgapañcamī |
skandapurāṇe |
śuklā mārgaśire puṇyā śrāvaṇe yā ca pañcamī |
snānadānair bahuphalā nāgalokapradāyinī ||
vārāhapurāṇe |
māghaśuklacaturthyāṃ tu varām ārādhya ca śriyam |
pañcamyāṃ kundakusumaiḥ pūjā kaundī samṛddhaye ||
iti puṇyapañcamī |
atha puṇyaṣaṣṭhī |
brahmapurāṇe |
jātaḥ skandaś ca ṣaṣṭhyāṃ tu śuklāyāṃ caitranāmani |
saināpatye ’bhiṣiktaś ca devānāṃ brahmaṇā svayam |
jitavāṃs tārakaṃ daityaṃ krauñcaṃ śaktyā vibheda ca ||
tasmāt sarvatra vidhinā skando mālyaiḥ sugandhibhiḥ |
dīpālaṅkāravastrānnakukkuṭaiḥ pūjya eva hi |
sakukkuṭakrīḍanakair ghaṇṭācāmaradarpaṇaiḥ ||
[623] sarvāsu śuklaṣaṭīṣv ity avadheyam iti |
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
yeyaṃ bhādrapade māsi ṣaṣṭhī tu bharatarṣabha |
snānadānādikaṃ sarvam asyām akṣayam ucyate ||
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ phalāśano rājan viśeṣāt kārttike nṛpa |
kṛṣṇāśuklāsa niyato brahmacārī samāhitaḥ ||
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ phalāśano yas tu naktāhāro bhaviṣyati |
iha cāmutra so ’tyarthaṃ labhate khyātim uttamām |
rājyacyuto viśeṣeṇa svaṃ rājyaṃ labhate ’cirāt ||
tathā |
ṣaṣṭhī bhādrapade bhānuprītyai puṇyākṣayāya ca |
yeyaṃ bhādrapade māsi ṣaṣṭhī syād bharatarṣabha ||
iyaṃ puṇya pāpaharā śivā śāntā śubhā nṛpa |
snānadānādikaṃ kiṃcit sarvam akṣayam ucyate ||
ye ’syāṃ paśyanti gāṅgeyaṃ dakṣiṇāpathavāsinam |
brahmahatyādipāpais tu mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
tasyāṃ tasyāṃ sadā paśyet kārttikeyaṃ sadaiva hi |
triḥ kṛtvā dakṣiṇām āśāṃ gatvā yaḥ śraddhayānvitaḥ |
pūjayed devadeveśaṃ sa gacchec chāntimandiram ||
triḥ kṛtvā dakṣiṇām āśāṅgatvety ukter vindhyottarato gacchatām etat phalaṃ |
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
yā ṣaṭhī śuklapakṣasya mārgaśīrṣe haripriyā |
[624]        mahāṣaṣṭhīti sā khyātā yasyāṃ home hutāśanaḥ ||
iti puṇyaṣaṣṭhī |
atha puṇyasaptamī |
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
ṣaṣṭhyām upoṣya yaḥ samyak saptamyāṃ kūrmam arcayet |
rogamukto vittavāṃś ca saṃprāpnotīpsitaṃ phalam ||
māsi bhādrapade śuklā saptamī yā gaṇādhipa |
aparājiteti vikhyātā mahāpātakanāśinī ||
yā tu mārgaśire māsi śuklapakṣe tu saptamī |
nandā sā kathitā vīra sarvānandakarī śubhā |
snānadānādikaṃ karma tasyām akṣayam ucyate ||
tathā |
nandā mārgaśire śuklā saptamy ānandadāyinī |
jayantī nāma sā proktā puṇyā pāpaharā smṛtā ||
matsyapurāṇe |
yasyāṃ manvantarasyādau rathārūḍho divākaraḥ |
māghamāsasya saptamyāṃ sā tasmād rathasaptamī ||
ity eṣā kathitā vīra rathāhvā saptamī parā |
mahāsaptamī vikhyātā mahāpātakanāśinī ||
viṣṇuḥ |
[625]        sūryagrahaṇacatulyā tu śuklā māghasya saptamī |
araṇodayavelāyāṃ tasyāṃ snānaṃ mahāphalam ||
tathā |
māghamāsasya saptamyām udayaty eva bhāskare |
vidhivat tatra ca snānaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam ||
māghamāsasite pakṣe saptamī koṭibhāskarā |
kuryāt snānārghadānābhyām āyurārogyasampadaḥ ||
bhaviṣyatpurāye |
śuklapakṣasya saptamyāṃ ravivāro bhaved yadi |
saptamī vijayā nāma tatra dattaṃ mahāphalam ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
śuklapakṣasya saptamyāṃ nakṣatraṃ pañcatārakam |
rohiṇyaśleṣāhastapuṣyamaghāḥ |
śuklapakṣe tu saptamyāṃ nakṣatraṃ savitur bhavet |
ādye pāde tu deveśa tadā sā bhadratāṃ vravet |
svapanaṃ tatra devasya ghṛtena kathitaṃ budhaiḥ ||
ity eṣā kathitā vīra bhadrā nāmeti saptamī |
yām upoṣya naro bhīrur brahmalokam avāpnuyāt ||
'savitur nakṣatram' hastaḥ, tathā prathamapādayoga iti |
tathā |
śuklapakṣe tu saptamyāṃ yady arkṣaṃ tu karo bhavet |
tamāsāt sātu mahāpuṇyā saptamī pāpanāśinī ||
[626]        tasyāṃ saṃpūjya deveśaṃ citrabhānuṃ divākaram |
saptajanmakṛtāt pāpān mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
yaś copavāsaṃ kurute tasyāṃ niyatamānasaḥ |
sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā svargaloke mahīyate ||
śuklapakṣe tu saptamyāṃ yadā saṃkramate raviḥ |
mahājayā tadā syād dhi saptamī bhāskarapriyā ||
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ pitṛdevādipūjanam |
sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ proktaṃ bhāskarasya vaco yathā ||
ādityapurāṇe |
revatī ravisaṃyuktā saptamī syān mahāphalā |
revatī yatra saptamyām ādityadivase bhavet ||
iti puṇyasaptamī |
atha puṇyāṣṭamī |
tatra viṣṇuḥ |
punarvasau budhopetā caitramāsi sitāṣṭamī |
prātas tu vidhivat snātvā vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet ||
aśokair arcayed durgāṃ aśokakalikāṃ pibet |
caitre māsi sitāṣṭamyāṃ ye pibanti punarvasau |
aśokasyāṣṭakalikāṃ na te śokam avāpnuyuḥ ||
tvām aśoka śivābhīṣṭaṃ madhumāsasamudbhavam |
pibāmi śokasaṃtapto mām aśokaṃ sadā kuru ||
[627]        iti pānamantraḥ |
kvacit harābhīṣṭeti pāṭhaḥ |
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
pauṣe budhāṣṭamī suklā mahābhadrā mahāphalā |
brahmāṇḍapurāṇe mahādeva uvāca |
pauṣe māsi yadā devi śuklāṣṭamyāṃ budho bhavet |
tadā sā tu mahāpuṇyā mahābhadreti kīrttitā ||
tasyāṃ snānaṃ japo homas tarpaṇaṃ viprabhojanam |
matprītaye kṛtaṃ devi śatasāhasrikaṃ bhavet ||
kvacit tasyāṃ snānaṃ tathā dānam iti pāṭhaḥ |
tasmāt tasyāṃ sadā devi pūjyo ’haṃ vidhivan naraiḥ |
gandhapuṣpopahāraiś ca brāhmaṇānāṇ ca tarpaṇaiḥ ||
pauṣe māsi yadā devi aṣṭamyāṃ yamadaivatam |
nakṣatraṃ jāyate puṇyaṃ |
yamalokalvāt 'yamadaivataṃ' bharaṇī |
tadā tu sā mahāpuṇyā jayantī cāṣṭamī smṛtā |
tasyāṃ snānaṃ tathā dānaṃ japohomaś ca tarpaṇam |
sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ devi kṛtaṃ bhavati kṛtsnaśaḥ ||
bhaviṣyottare |
siṃhage ’rke hi rohiṇyāṃ yadā kṛṣṇāṣṭamī bhavet |
tasyām abhyarcanaṃ saurer hanti pāpaṃ trijanmajam ||
vārāhapurāṇe |
[628]        śuklāṣṭamyāṃ tu māṣasya dadyād bhīṣmāya yo jalam |
saṃvatsarakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇād eva muñcati ||
kvacit tv anyathā paṭhyate |
māghe māsi sitāṣṭamyāṃ salilaṃ bhīṣmavarmaṇe |
śrāddhaṃ ca ye narāḥ kuryus te syuḥ santatibhāginaḥ ||
vaiyāghrapadyagotrāya sāṅkṛtyapravarāya ca |
aputrāya dadāmy etat salilaṃ bhīṣmavarmaṇe ||
iti jalamatraḥ |
atra kecid āhuḥ | prāṅmukhaḥ śrāddhaṃ kuryād bhīṣmasya vasvavatāratvād devatvasyāpy upapatteḥ | na ca vācyaṃ vasvavatāratve ’pi tasya kṣatriyasya sataḥ sakalajanapitṛtvāvagamād dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ śrāddhaṃ kuryād iti, kṣatriyatvapuraskāreṇa prakṛtau śiṣṭācāravirodhaprasaṅgāt |
brāhmaṇo hīnavarṇasya yaḥ karoty aurddhvadehikam |
sa tāṃ gatim avāpnoti iha loke paratra ca ||
ityādinā marīcyādibhir brāhmaṇasya kṣatriyaurddhvadehikānuṣṭhānapratiṣedhāt devatvapuraskāreṇānuvṛttau na śiṣṭācāravirodhaḥ, dṛśyate ca śiṣṭācāraḥ brāhmaṇā śrapi bhīṣmasya śrāddhaṃ kurvāṇā iti |
tad ayuktam, "bhīṣmavarmaṇa" iti mantravarṇaparyālocanayā kṣatriyatvapuraskārāvagamāt “varmāntaṃ kṣatriye proktam" iti śaṅkhasmaraṇāt |
māghe māsi sitāṣṭamyāṃ salilaṃ bhīṣmavarmaṇe |
[629]        iti vidhivākyād apy evam evāvagamyate | na cāprāpta eva devaśabde varmaśabdo vidhīyate iti vācyaṃ | kṣatriyaśabde bhrātṛpālādiśabdānām api vidhānaniṣedhasya tadanyakṣatriyaviṣayateti vācyam, kṣatriyaśrāddhe brāhmaṇarūpakarṭaviśeṣaniṣedhād bhīṣmaśrāddhaviṣayatvam iti yadi tarhi vaiparītyaprasaṅgaḥ | na cāsya niṣedhasya caiva prāptyapekṣatvād vikalpopapattau bhīṣmaśrāddhe brāhmaṇasyāpy adhikāra iti vācyaṃ | vikalpabhayād eva tan na, “anuyājeṣu ye yajāmahaṃ karotītivat paryudāsāśrayaṇāt | śiṣṭācāraś ca niyato na vidyate, vidyamānatve ’pi bādhyate "śrutismṛtivihito dharmas tadalābhe śiṣṭācāraḥ pramāṇam" iti vaśiṣṭhasmaraṇāt |
saṅgate bhāskare kanyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe viśiṣyate |
aṣṭamī sāṣṭakā nāma śākenāpi na hāpayet ||
brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
āgrahāyaṇyāḥ paratas tv aṣṭakās tisraḥ, kṛṣṇapakṣe pūrvā aindrī, prājāpatyā dvitīyā, vaiśvadevī tṛtīyā, ādyā śākaiḥ, divitīyā māṃsaiḥ, tṛtīyā pūpaiḥ |
śivarahasye |
mārgādyaparapakṣeṣu pūrvā madhyānuśabditā |
syuḥ khalv anvaṣṭakās tisraḥ sapuṣyādiṣv anukramāt ||
āśvalāyanaḥ |
hemantaśiśirayoś caturṇām aparapakṣāṇām aṣṭamīṣv aṣṭakā iti
devatā iti |
śatapathe tu | [630]
dvādaśa paurṇamāsyo dvādaśāṣṭakāḥ dvādaśāmāvāsyā iti |
'aṣṭakā' iti kṛṣṇāṣṭamya ity arthaḥ |
mahābhārate |
aṣṭakāsu ca yad dattaṃ tad anantam udāhṛtam |
śaśiputrasamāyuktā paripūrṇā sitāṣṭamī |
tasyāṃ niyamakarttāro na syuḥ khaṇḍitasampadaḥ ||
'śaśiputraḥ' budhaḥ |
iti puṇyāṣṭamī |
atha puṇyā navamī |
vārāhapurāṇe |
navamyāṃ hi sadā pūjyā gaurī devī samādhinā |
varadā sarvalokasya bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||
kecit tv āśvinaśuklanavamī gṛhītavyety āhuḥ |
tṛtīyā caiva vaiśākhe navamy āśvayuje tathā |
iti bhaviṣyatpurāṇe prāśastyaśruter iti |
tad ayuktam | prāśastyaśravaṇe phalādhikayam avagamyate na tu navamīviśeṣaparatvaṃ, saṅkoce pramāṇābhāvāt |
devīpurāṇe |
navamyāṃ pūjayed devīṃ mahāmahiṣamardinīṃ |
kuṅkumāgurukarpūradhūpānnadhvajatarpaṇaiḥ |
damanair marupatraiś ca vijayākhyaṃ padaṃ labhet ||
[631]        brahmapurāṇe |
caitraśuklanavamyāṃ bhadrakālī mahābalā |
yoginīnāṃ tu sarvāsām ādhipatye niṣevitā ||
tasmāt tāṃ pūjayet tatra sopavāso jitendriyaḥ |
vicitrair balibhir bhaktyā sarvāsu navamīṣu ca ||
devīpurāṇe |
aśvine navamī śuklā tasyāṃ koṭiguṇaṃ phalam |
tathā |
āśvinasya tu māsasya navamī śuklapakṣajā |
jāyate koṭiguṇitaṃ dānaṃ tasyāṃ narādhipa |
śuklapakṣe navamyāṃ yaḥ kārttikasya samāhitaḥ |
snāyād dadyān namaskuryād akṣayaṃ labhate phalam ||
padmapurāṇe |
kārttike navamī śuklā pitṝṇām utsavāya ca |
tasyāṃ snānaṃ hutaṃ dattaṃ anantaphaladaṃ bhavet ||
iti puṇyā navamī |
atha puṇyā daśamī |
jyaiṣṭhasya śukladaśamī saṃvatsaramukhī smṛtā|
tasyāṃ snānaṃ prakurvīta dānaṃ caiva viśeṣataḥ ||
brāhme |
jyeṣṭhe māsi site pakṣe daśamī hastasaṃyutā |
[632]        harate daśa pāpāni tasmād daśaharā smṛtā |
tasyāṃ snānaṃ prakurvīta dānaṃ caiva viśeṣataḥ ||
daśapāpāny āha manuḥ |
pāruṣyam anṛtaṃ caiva paiśunyaṃ cāpi sarvaśaḥ |
asambaddhapralāpaś ca vāṅmayaṃ syāt caturvidham ||
adattānām upādānaṃ hiṃsā caivāvidhānataḥ |
paradāropasevā ca kāyikaṃ trividhaṃ smṛtam ||
paradravyeṣv abhidhyānaṃ manasāniṣṭacintanam |
vitathābhiniveśaś ca trividhaṃ karma mānasam ||
bhaviṣye |
jyaiṣṭhe śukladaśamyāṃ ca bhaved bhaumadinaṃ yadi |
jñeyā hastarkṣasaṃyuktā sarvapāpaharā tithiḥ ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
daśamyāṃ śuklapakṣe ca jyaiṣṭhe māsi kuje dine |
gaṅgāvatīrṇa hastarkṣe sarvapāpaharā smṛtā ||
hastānvitā jyaiṣṭhaśukle daśamī daśapāpaharā saiva gaṅgāsnānān maṅgaladinasaṃyuktā sarvapāpaharety arthaḥ | 'praśastā tu hastarkṣa' ity asyānantaram evaṃ paṭhyate, "saivā daśaharā smṛtā" |
gaṅgāsnāne kṛtārthaḥ syād asmin yoge sakṛn naraḥ |
hared vai daśapāpāni gaṅgā tatra na saṃśayaḥ ||
laghupāpakṣayaś cātra draṣṭavyaḥ na tu gurupāpaparikṣayaḥ, taviṣayaguraprāścittavidhyānarthakyaprasaṅgāt |
[633]        tathā ca gautamaḥ |
enāṃsi gurūṇi laghūni |
brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
kārttikasya tu māsasya daśamī śuklapakṣajā |
tasyāṃ vratādi kurvāṇo labhate phalam uttamam ||
iti puṇyadaśamī |
atha puṇyaikādaśī |
vārāhapurāṇe |
ekādaśyāṃ tu naktena naraḥ kuryād yathāvidhi |
mārgaśīrṣaśuklapakṣād ārabhyābdaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
tad vrataṃ dhanadaśreṣṭhaḥ kṛtaṃ vittaṃ prayacchati |
tasmai brahmā dadau prītas tithim ekādaśīṃ prabhuḥ ||
tasyām anagnipakvāśī yo bhaven niyataḥ śuciḥ |
tasyāsau dhanado devaḥ tuṣṭo vittaṃ prayacchati ||
devīpurāṇe |
puṣyarkṣaikādaśī śuklā supuṇyā pāpanāśinī |
viṣṇudharmottare |
ekādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣe yadarkṣaṃ vai punarvasu |
nāmnā sā vijayā khyātā tithīnām uttamā tithiḥ ||
yo dadāti tilaprasthaṃ yaś ca saṃvatsaraṃ tathā |
upavāsaparas tasyāṃ tayos tulyaphalaṃ smṛtam ||
[634]        tasyāṃ jagatpatir devaḥ sarvadeveśvaro hariḥ |
prayāty āśu tam āyāntaṃ tenānantaphalaṃ smṛtam ||
ekādaśyāṃ site pakṣe puṣyarkṣaṃ yatra sattama |
tithau bhavati sā proktā viṣṇunā pāpanāśinī ||
tasyām ārādhya govindaṃ jagatām īśvareśvaram |
saptajanmakṛtāt pāpān mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
yathopavāsaṃ kurute tasyāṃ snāto hi sarvvataḥ |
sarvapāpavinirmuko viṣṇuloke mahīyate ||
dānaṃ yad dīyate kiṃcit samuddiśya janārdanam |
homo vā kriyate tasyāṃ akṣayaṃ kathitaṃ phalam ||
iti puṇyaikādaśī |
atha puṇyadvādaśī |
vārāhapurāṇe |
ekādaśyām upavasam pakṣayor ubhayor api |
dvādaśyāṃ yo’ rcayed viṣṇum anantaphalabhāg bhavet ||
brahmapurāṇe |
dvādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣasya campakair arcayed dharim |
viṣṇudharmottare |
dvādaśīṣu ca yad dattaṃ śaklāsu ca viśeṣataḥ |
śravaṇena tu yuktāsu tatrāpi dvijasattamāḥ ||
[635]        viśeṣād budhayuktāsu śuklapakṣāsu sarvathā |
bhāgyarkṣasaṃyutā caitre dvādaśī syān mahāphalā ||
'bhāgyarkṣaṃ' purvāphālgunī |
hastayuktā tu vaiśākhe jyaiṣṭhe tu svātisaṃyutā |
jyeṣṭhayā ca tathāṣāḍhe mūlopetā ca vaiṣṇave ||
'vaiṣṇave' śrāvaṇe māsi |
tathā bhādrapade māsi śravaṇena tu saṃyutā |
āśvinaikādaśī puṇyā bhavaty ājarkṣasaṃyutā ||
'ājarkṣaṃ' pūrvābhādrapadā |
kārttike revatīyuktā akṣayyaphaladāyikā |
viṣṇuḥ |
mārgaśīrṣe śuklaikādaśyām upoṣito dvādaśyāṃ bhagavantaṃ vāsudevam arcayet vastragandhapuṣpadhūpadīpanaivedyair vahnibrāhmaṇatarpaṇaiḥ vratam etat susaṃpūrṇaṃ kṛtvā pāpena pūto bhavati, yāvajjīvaṃ kṛtvā śvetadvīpam avāpnoti, ubhayapakṣe dvādaśīty evaṃ saṃvatsareṇa svargalokaṃ prāpnoti, yāvajjīvaṃ viṣṇulokaṃ |
gāruḍapurāṇe |
māsī bhādrapade śuklā dvādaśī sā mahāphalā |
phalaṃ dattahutānāṃ ca tasyāṃ lakṣaguṇaṃ bhavet ||
viṣṇudharme |
māghyāṃ tu samatītāyāṃ śravaṇena tu saṃyutā |
dvādaśī yā bhavet kṛṣṇā proktā sā tiladvādaśī ||
[636]        tilaiḥ snānaṃ tilair homaḥ tarpaṇaṃ ca tilodakaiḥ |
dīpaṃ ca tilatailena tathā deyaṃ tilodakam |
tilāś ca deyā viprebhyas tasminn ahani pārthiva ||
mūlarkṣage śaśadhare māghe māsi prajāpate |
ekādaśyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe sopavāso jitendriyaḥ |
dvādaśyāṃ ṣaṭtilāhāraṃ kṛtvā pāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
tilodvarttī tilasnāyī tilahomo tilodakī |
tilabhuk tiladātā ca ṣaṭtilāḥ pāpanāśanāḥ ||
asakṛt ṣaṭtilān kṛtvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate |
trīṇi varṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate ||
jyotiḥśāstre |
pañcānanasthau gurubhūmiputrau
maitre raviḥ syād yadi śuklapakṣe |
samābhidhānā karabheṇa yuktā
tithir vyatīpāta iti prayogaḥ ||
asmiṃs tu gobhūmihiraṇyavastra-
dānena sarvaṃ pravihāya pāpaṃ |
suratvam indratvam anāmayatvaṃ
martyādhipatyaṃ labhate manuṣyaḥ ||
'pañcānanaḥ' siṃhaḥ, 'samābhidhānā' pāraṇābhidhānā, 'tithiḥ' dvādaśī, 'karabheṇa' hastanakṣatreṇa |
iti puṇyā dvādaśī |
[637]
atha puṇyatryodaśī |
skandapurāṇe |
kṣetre trayodaśī puṇyā tasuāṃ daśaguṇaṃ phalam |
padmapurāṇe |
yas tu caitre trayodaśyāṃ snānaṃ dānaṃ samācaret |
phalaṃ daśaguṇaṃ tasya karmako labhate naraḥ ||
tathā |
caitre śuklatrayodaśyāṃ madanaṃ campakātmakam |
kṛtvā saṃpūjya yatnena yojayed vyajanena tu |
tataḥ sandhukṣitaḥ kāmaḥ putrapautrsamṛddhidaḥ || ||
devīpurāṇe |
kāmadevas trayodaśyāṃ pūjanīyo yathāvidhi |
ratipatnīsamāyuktaḥ aśokaguṇabhūṣitaḥ ||
kumbhena sitavastre vā lekhyā vastraphalādibhiḥ |
khaṇḍaśarkaranaivedyaiḥ saubhāgyam atulaṃ labhet ||
kramāc ca damanakapūjety avadheyam |
brahmapurāṇe |
trayodaśyāṃ yathākāmaṃ kāmaḥ pūjyas (?) tathā janaiḥ |
jyotiḥśāstre |
kṛṣṇapakṣe trayodaśyāṃ maghāsv induḥ kare raviḥ |
yadā tadā gajachāyā śrāddhe puṇyair avāpyate ||
iti puṇyatrayodāśī |
[638]
atha puṇyacaturdaśī |
vārāhapurāṇe |
caitre sitacaturdaśyāṃ bhavet kāmamahotsavaḥ |
jugusitoktibhis tatra gītavādyādibhir nṝṇām ||
bhagavān sṛjyate kāmaḥ putrapautrasamṛddhidaḥ ||
caitre sitacaturdaśyāṃ yaḥ snāyāc chivasaṃnidhau |
gaṅgāyāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa sa na preto ’bhijāyate ||
caitrakṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ aṅgārakadinaṃ yadi |
piśācatvaṃ punar na syād gaṅgāyāṃ snānabhojanāt ||
brahmapurāṇe |
āṣāḍhe māsi bhūte ’hni śivaṃ saṃpūjya mānavaḥ |
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sarvasampadam āpnuyāt ||
matsyapurāṇe |
ārādhite mahendre ca dhvajākārāsu yaṣṭiṣu |
tataḥ śuklacaturdaśyāṃ anantaṃ pūjayed dharim
kṛtvā darbhamayaṃ caiva vāridhānīsamanvitam |
dhūpadīpādibhiḥ devam īpsitaṃ kāmam āpnuyāt ||
liṅgapurāṇe |
vṛścike śuklapakṣe ca yā pāṣāṇacaturdaśī |
tasyām ārādhayed gaurīṃ naktaṃ pāṣāṇabhakṣaṇaiḥ ||
pāṣāṇākārapiṣṭakair ity arthaḥ |
[639]        brāhme |
kārttike bhaumavāreṇa citrā kṛṣṇacaturdaśī |
tasyām ārādhitaḥ sthāṇur yacchec chivapuraṃ dhruvam ||
skandapurāṇe |
caitre caturdaśī śuklā śrāvaṇaproṣṭhapādayoḥ |
māghasya yā kṛṣṇapakṣe dāne bahubalā hi sā ||
matsyapurāṇe |
yāṃ kāṃcit saritaṃ prāpya kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśī |
yā punar yāti tasyāṃ tu niyatas tarpayed yamam ||
yamāya dharmarājāya mṛtyave cāntakāya ca |
vaivasvatāya kālāya sarvabhūtakṣayāya ca ||
dadhnād dhāraya daṇḍāya pretādhipāya pāśine |
audumbarāya ghorāya citraguptāya te namaḥ ||
ekaikasya tilair miśrān dadyāt trīṃs trīñ jalāñjalīn |
saṃvatsarakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇād eva naśyati ||
devīpurāṇe |
tathā kṛṣṇatrayodaśyāṃ bhaumāhe pitṛtarpaṇam |
'bhaumāha' iti prāśastyātiśayaṃ darśayati | sarvāsu ca caturdaśīṣu nadījale snāto dharmarājaṃ pūjayitvā pāpebhyaḥ pūto bhavati |
iti caturdaśī |
[640]
atha puṇyapaurṇamāsī |
saṃvartaḥ |
māghe māsi tu saṃprāpte paurṇamāsyām upoṣitaḥ |
brāhmaṇebhyas tilān dattvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
atra dānaṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vidhīyate pradhānatvāt | tataś cārthāc caturdaśyām upavāsaḥ |
viṣṇudharmottare |
paurṇamāsīṣu sarvāṣu magharkṣasahitāsu ca |
dattānām iha dānānāṃ phalaṃ daśaguṇaṃ bhavet ||
mahatī paurṇamāsī yā yuktā pūrṇendunā gurau |
vaiśākhī kārttikī māghī pūrṇimā tu mahāphalā ||
skandapurāṇe |
yasyāṃ pūrṇendunā yogaṃ yāti jīvo mahābalaḥ |
paurṇamāsīti yā jñeyā mahāpūrvā dvijottama |
snānaṃ dānaṃ tathā japyam anantaphaladaṃ smṛtam ||
jyotiḥśāstre |
dṛśyete sahitau yasyāṃ divi candrabṛhaspatī |
paurṇamāsī tu mahatī proktā saṃvatsareṇa sā |
tasyāṃ dānopavāsādyam akṣayaṃ parikīrttitam ||
māsākhyarkṣe candragurū tasmāt pañcadaśe raviḥ |
pūrṇimā jīvavāre tu mahacchabdā hi sā tithiḥ ||
[641]        harikṣetre ca gaṅgāyāṃ samudre naimiṣe tathā |
mahāśabdatithau snānaṃ dānaṃ śrāddham anantakam ||
aindre guruḥ śaśī caiva prājāpatye ravis tathā |
pūrṇimā jyaiṣṭhamāsasya mahājyaiṣṭhīti kīrttitā ||
'aindram' jyeṣṭhā, 'prājāpatyaṃ' rohiṇī |
padmapurāṇe |
āgneyaṃ hi yadā ṛkṣaṃ kārttikyāṃ tu bhavet kvacit |
mahatī sā tithir jñeyā snānadānādiṣūttamā ||
'āgneyam ṛkṣaṃ' kṛttikā |
yadā yāmyaṃ bhaved ṛkṣaṃ tadā tasyāṃ tithau kvacit |
tithiḥ sāpi mahāpuṇyā ṛṣibhiḥ parikīrttitā ||
'yāmyam ṛkṣaṃ' bharaṇī |
prājāpatyaṃ yadā ṛkṣaṃ tithau tasyāṃ narādhipa |
sā mahākārttikī proktā devānām api durlabhā ||
'prājāpatyam ṛkṣaṃ' rohiṇī |
mande vārke gurau vāpi vāreṣv eteṣu ca triṣu |
trīṇy etāni ca ṛkṣāṇi svayaṃ prokrāni brahmaṇā |
atrāśvamedhikaṃ puṇyaṃ snātasya bhavato nṛpa |
dānām akṣayatāṃ yāti pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ tathā
kṛttikārohiṇīyāmyayuktā yā kārttikī bhavet |
sā mahākārttikī proktā devānām api durlabhā ||
brahmapurāṇe |
[642]        puṇyā mahākārttikī syāj jīvendau kṛttikāsu ca
maghāsyayoś ca jīvendor mahāmāghīti kathyate ||
jyotiḥśāstre |
meṣapṛṣṭhe yadā sauriḥ siṃhe ca gurucandramāḥ |
bhāskaraḥ śravaṇarkṣe syān mahāmāghīti sā smṛtā ||
śālagrāme mahājyaiṣṭhakṛtā puṃsāṃ mahāphalā |
gaṅgāyāṃ caiva vaiśākhī jyaiṣṭhī vai puruṣottame ||
āṣāḍhī vai kanakhale kedāre śrāvaṇī tathā |
mahābhādrī vadarṣāṃ ca kubjāyām eva cāśvinī |
puṣkāre kārttikī kānyakubje mārgaśirī tathā |
ayodhyāyāṃ mahāpauṣī kṛtāḥ syuḥ sumahāphalāḥ |
mahāmāghī prayāge tu naimiṣe phālgunī tathā ||
liṅgapurāṇe |
āśvine paurṇamāsyāṃ ca arkṣair jāgaraṇaṃ niśi |
kaumudī sā samākhyātā kāryā lokavibhūtaye ||
kaumudyāṃ pūjayel lakṣmīm indram airāvate sthitam |
sugandhair niśitaiḥ sarvair akṣair jāgaraṇaṃ bhavet ||
phālgune paurṇamāsī ca sadā bālavilāsinī |
jñeyā phālgunikā sā ca jñeyā lokavibhūtaye ||
vārāhapurāṇe |
phālgune paurṇamāsyāṃ tu paṭavāsavilāsinī |
jñeyā yā phālgunī loke kāryā lokasaṃṛddaye ||
iti puṇyapūrṇimā |
[643]
atha puṇyāmāvāsyā |
śātātapaḥ |
amāvāsyā bhaved vāre yadā bhūmisutasya vai |
jāhnavīsnānamātreṇa gosahasraphalaṃ labhet ||
mahābhārate |
amā some tathā bhaume guruvāre yadā bhavet |
tat tīrthaṃ puṣkaraṃ nāma sūryaparvaśatādhikam ||
viṣṇupurāṇe |
amāvāsyā yadā maitraviśākhāṛkṣayogiyī |
śrāddhe pitṛgaṇas tṛptiṃ tadāpnoty aṣṭavārṣikīm ||
kvacit tu 'viśākhāsvātiyoginī' iti pāṭhaḥ | 'maitraṃ' anurādhā |
amāvāsyā yadā puṣye raudrarkṣe vā punarvasau |
dvādaśābdīṃ tadā tṛptiṃ prayānti pitaro ’rcitāḥ ||
'raudrarkṣaṃ' ārdrā |
vāsavājaikapādarkṣe pitṝṇāṃ tṛptim icchatā |
vāruṇe cāpy adaivatye devānām api durlabhā |
'vāsavaṃ' dhaniṣṭhā, 'ajaikapādaṃ' pūrvabhādrapadā, 'vāruṇaṃ'
śatabhiṣak, 'āpyaṃ' pūrvābhādrapadā |
māghāsite pañcadaśī kadācid
upaiti yogaṃ yadi vāruṇena |
ṛkṣeṇa kālaḥ sa paraḥ pitṝṇāṃ
na hy alpapuṇyair nṛpa labhyate 'sau ||
[644]        'vāruṇaṃ ṛkṣaṃ' śatatārakā |
iti puṇyāmāvācsyā |
atha nānā puṇyāḥ |
vārāhapurāṇe |
pratipady api pūjā tu ṣaṣṭhyāṃ proktā grahasya tu |
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
śuklapakṣe tṛtīyāyāṃ caturthyāṃ caiva bhārata |
kṛṣṇapakṣe ca pañcamyāṃ snātaḥ kim anuśocati ||
śāmbapurāṇe |
śuklā vā yadi vā kṛṣṇā ṣaṣṭhī vā saptamī tathā |
ravivāreṇa saṃyuktā tithiḥ puṇyatamā smṛtā ||
saurapurāṇe |
sopavāsaś caturdaśyām āṣṭamyāṃ ca sureśvaraṃ |
yas tu pūjayate nityaṃ tasya tuṣyati śaṅkaraḥ ||
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ yaḥ śivaṃ śaṃsitavrataḥ |
mumukṣuḥ pūjayen nityaṃ sa labhed īpsitaṃ phalam ||
vārāhapurāṇe |
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ rākṣasādiprapūjanam |
navamyāṃ mātṛyāgaṃ tu pañcamyāṃ tu janārdanam ||
pauṣamāghāṣṭamī puṇyā caitre māsi trayodaśī |
[645]        kārttikī paurṇamāsī ca dvādaśī kīrtitottarā ||
'uttarā' mārgaśīrṣī |
skandapurāṇe |
jyaiṣṭhasya śukladaśamī dvādaśī ca tathāvidhā |
caturthī paurṇamāśī ca nityaṃ puṇyātamā smṛtā ||
upavāsād eva |
paurṇamāsyām amāvāsyām aṣṭamyām aṣṭakāsu ca |
caturdaśyāṃ kṛtaṃ snānam aṣṭamyāṃ śivasaṃnidhau ||
mārkaṇḍeyaḥ |
ekādaśyāṃ site pakṣe puṣyarkṣe yadi sattama |
dvādaśyāṃ vā yadāśeṣapāpakṣayakaraṃ smṛtaṃ ||
vyāsaḥ |
śukle vā yadi vā kṛṣṇe caturthī vā caturdaśī |
bhaumavāreṇa puṇyāsau somavāre kuhūr yathā ||
amā vai somavāreṇa ravivāreṇa saptamī |
caturthī bhaumavāreṇa viṣuvatsadṛśaṃ phalam ||
śaṅkhaḥ |
amāvāsyā tu somena saptamī bhānunā saha |
caturthī bhūmiputreṇa budhavāreṇa cāṣṭamī ||
catasras tithayaḥ puṇyāḥ tuyāḥ syur grahaṇādibhiḥ |
sarvam akṣayam atroktaṃ snānadānajapādikam ||
śātātapaḥ |
[646]        amāvāsyā somavāre sūryavāre ca saptamī |
aṅgārakadine prāpte caturthī vā caturdaśī |
tatra yaḥ kurute karma śubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham |
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi kartā tatpālam aśnute ||
brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
durgotsavasya navamī viṣṇusthāpanadvādaśī |
vahnisthāpanaṣaṣṭhī ca mahatyo māghasaptamī ||
viṣṇuḥ |
pañcadaśī paurṇamāsī pañcamī dvādaśīdvayam ||
saṃvatsaram abhuñjānaḥ satataṃ vijitendriyaḥ |
mucyate sarvapāpaiś ca svargalokaṃ ca gacchati ||
liṅgapurāṇe |
vahnyutsavaṃ site pakṣe māghe māsyārdrabhe niśi |
dvādaśyām atha kartayaḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ mahotsavaḥ |
pitāmahaḥ |
pratipaddhanasyoktā dvitīyā tu śriyaḥ smṛtā |
tṛtīyā tu bhavānyāś ca caturthī tatsutasya ca |
nāgānāṃ pañcamī proktā ṣaṣṭhī proktā guhasya tu |
saptamī bhāskare proktā durgāyā aṣṭamī smṛtā |
mātṝṇāṃ navamī proktā daśamī vāsukeḥ smṛtā ||
ekādaśī ṛṣīṇāṃ tu dvādaśī cakrapāṇinaḥ |
[647]        trayodaśī hy anaṅgasya śivasyoktā caturdaśī ||
paurṇamāsī tathā dhātus tithīnām uttamā smṛtā |
amāvāsyā sarvadaivapitrye karmaṇy udāhṛtā ||
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevīyasamastakaraṇādhīśvara-
sakalavidyāviśāradaśrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau
pariśeṣakhaṇḍe kālanirṇaye pratipadādipuṇyatithayaḥ ||
[648]
atha caturdaśo ’dhyāyaḥ |
atha nakṣatrayuktatithinirṇayaḥ |
skandapurāṇe |
prājāpatyarkṣasaṃyuktā kṛṣṇe nabhasi cāṣṭamī |
muhūrttam api labhyeta sopoṣyā sā mahāphalā ||
śravaṇadvādaśyām apy evam eva |
uktaṃ ca |
dvādaśī śravaṇaspṛṣṭā kṛtsnā puṇyatamā smṛtā |
na tu sā tena saṃyuktā tāvaty eva praśasyate || iti |
anyatra tu yāvatā kālena yat karma samāpyeta tāvati kāle nakṣatrādiyuktāpekṣaṇīyā | yad uktaṃ śāṅkaragītāyām |
kṛttikādibharaṇyantaṃ vārā vā ravisaptamaṃ |
naite saṃyogamātreṇa punanti sakalāṃ tithim || iti |
uktaṃ ca brahmavaivartte |
pūrvabhāgas tither yaḥ syād ṛkṣayogānvito bhavet |
sā tithiḥ sakalā jñeyā nānte ṛkṣeṇa saṃyutā ||
yāvat sā tiṣṭhate brahmas tāvatkālaḥ praśasyate |
dānapūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ tasyāṃ tatphaladaṃ bhavet ||
iti nakṣatrayuktatithinirṇayaḥ |
[649]
atha yugādinirṇayaḥ |
skandapurāṇa-bhaviṣyatpurāṇayoḥ |
navamyāṃ śuklapakṣasya kārttike niragātkṛtam |
rādhe sitatṛtīyāyāṃ tretā vai samapadyata ||
darśe tu māghamāsasya pravṛttaṃ dvāparaṃ yugam |
kaliḥ kṛṣṇatrayodaśyāṃ nabhasye māsi nirgataḥ |
yugādayaḥ smṛtā hy etā dattasyākṣayakārakāḥ ||
nāgarakhaṇḍe |
adhunā śṛṇu rājendra yugādyāḥ pitṛvallabhāḥ |
yāsāṃ saṃkīrtanenāpi kṣīyate pāpasaṃcayaḥ ||
navamī kārttike śuklā tṛtīyā mādhave sitā |
amāvāsyā tapasye ca nabhasye ca trayodaśī ||
tretākṛtakalīnāṃ tu dvāparasyodayaḥ kramāt |
snāne dāne jape home viśeṣāt pitṛtarpaṇe |
kṛtasyākṣayakāriṇyaḥ sukṛtasya mahāphalāḥ ||
'mādhave' vaiśākhe, 'sitā' śuklā, 'tapasye' māghe |
matsyapurāṇe |
vaiśākhasya tṛtīyā yā navamī kārttikasa tu |
pañcadaśy api māghasya nabhasye ca trayodaśī |
yugādayaḥ smṛtā hy etā datasyākṣayakārakāḥ ||
devalaḥ |
tṛtīyā rohiṇīyuktā vaiśākhasya sitā tu yā |
[650]        maghābhiḥ sahitā kṛṣṇā nabhasye tu trayodaśī |
yugādayaḥ smṛtā hy etā dattasyākṣayakārakāḥ ||
viṣṇupurāṇa-bhaviṣyatpurāṇayoḥ |
vaiśākhamāsasya tu yā tṛtīyā
navamy asau kārttikāśuklapakṣe |
nabhasyamāsasya tu kṛṣṇapakṣe
trayodaśī pañcadaśī ca māghe ||
etā yugādyāḥ kathitāḥ purāṇe
anantapuṇyātithayaś catasraḥ |
'pañcadaśī māghe' ity atra kṛṣṇapakṣapadam anuṣajyate |
ata eva nāradīyapurāṇe |
dve śukle dve ca kṛṣṇe tu yugādyāḥ kavayo viduḥ |
śukle pūrvahṇike grāhye kṛṣṇe caivāparāhṇike |
brahmapurāṇe māghasya paurṇamāsī yugādir ity ukaṃ |
vaiśākhe śuklapakṣasya tṛtīyāyāṃ kṛtaṃ yugam |
kārttike śuklapakṣe tu tretā ca navame ’hani ||
atha bhādrapade kṛṣṇatrayodaśyāṃ tu dvāparam |
māghe tu paurṇamāsyāṃ ca ghoraṃ kaliyugaṃ tathā ||
yugārambhās tu tithayo yugādyās tena viśrutāḥ |
phalaṃ dattahutānāṃ ca anantaṃ parikīrttitam ||
tathā |
[651]        etāś catasras tithayo uugādyā
dattaṃ hutaṃ cākṣayam āśu vindyāt |
yuge yuge varṣaśatena yac ca
yugādikāle divasena tat syāt ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
vaiśākhasya tṛtīyā yā samā kṛtayugena tu |
navamī kārttike yā tu tretāyugasamā tu sā ||
trayodaśī nabhasye tu dvāpareṇa samā tu sā |
māghe pañcadaśī rājan kalikālasamā tu sā ||
kvacit tu kalikālādir ucyata iti pāṭhaḥ |
etāś catasro rājendra yugānāṃ prabhavāḥ śubhāḥ |
yugādayas tu kathyante tenaitāḥ pūrvasūribhiḥ ||
upavāsas tapo dānaṃ śrāddhaṃ homo japas tadā |
yadā tu kriyate kiṃcit sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet ||
'kṛtayugena samā' iti samagre ’pi kṛtayuge pratyahaṃ kriyamāṇena karmaṇā yāvat puṇyaṃ bhavati tāvad asyām ekasyām eva tithāv ity arthaḥ |
prabhāsakhaṇḍe |
yadā candraś ca sūryaś ca tiṣyabṛhaspatī |
ekarāśau sameṣyanti pravekṣyati tadā kṛtam ||
atra kecid āhuḥ | [652] na gavādiśabdavad vaiśākhādiśabdā luptāvayavārthaḥ kiṃ tu sauracāndramāsavacanā iti prāg uktam | tathā sati vaiśākhasya dvitvāt ubhayatrāpi tithidvaidhāt tatra yugādidvayaprasaktiḥ, tathā sati catasra iti parisaṅkhyānam anupapannaṃ, ekatve sati sauracāndramāsavinigamanārtham |
iha kecid āhuḥ | cāndramāsasamāśrayā yugādir anuṣṭhānārhā pitṛkāryapradhānatvāt yugādīnāṃ pitṛkārye ’pi cāndramāsaprārambhāt |
yad uktam |
ābdike patṛkārye ca māsaś cāndramasaḥ smṛtaḥ |
iti | sitāsitapakṣavyapadeśe pakṣadvayātmakatvāt cāndramāsāśrayataiva yujyate | kiṃ ca |
māghāsite pañcadaśī kadācid
upaiti yogaṃ yadi vāruṇena |
ṛkṣeṇa kālaḥ sa paraḥ pitṝṇaṃ
na hy alpapuṇyair nṛpa labhyate ’sau ||
iti smṛteḥ,
yāsau vaiśākhasyāmāvāsyā rohiṇyāṃ samapaścata |
iti śruteḥ cāndramāsagatā eva yugādayaḥ samavagamyante na hi makarāditye māghe śatabhiṣāyogo ’māvāsyāyāṃ sambhavati, tathātve hi ravimaṇḍalāntarniveśāc candrasya ravisaṃyuktatvāt śaśino ’pi makaragāmitā syāt, tathā sati śatabhiṣāyogo na syāt kumbhasambandhivāt [653] tasyāḥ, kumbhāditye ravicandramasor ekarāśivarttitve vāruṇayogo ’nusandheyaḥ, tathā prauṣṭhapadyūrdhvaṃ kṛṣṇatrayodaśīti viśiṣṭayugādau pātra-
māsaṃ darśayati, naivaṃ sati yugādiṣūtkarṣaprasaktiḥ, pitṛkāryaparatayā sauramāsāgocarāyās tither ayugāditvenotkarṣaprasakteḥ |
utkarṣaḥ kālavṛddhau syād upākarmādikarmaṇām |
abhiṣekādivṛddhīnāṃ na tūtkarṣo yugādiṣu ||
iti niṣedhāt | atha vā saty api yugādidvitve caiva pitṛkāryāṅgatvāt titheḥ sauramānatā "tithir devakāryāgnival loke cāndramasīyā pitṛkāryabhimatā ūrdhvam anuyājaiś carantīty aparaḥ kālaḥ pitṝṇām iti vacanāt, tatpūrvakālasambandhipitṛkāryotkarṣo nānupapannaḥ, tena kumbhādirāśigataravimāse ’pi māghādilābhād amāvāsyāditithīnāṃ yugāditvaṃ sauramāsagatānāṃ tu devakārye catasro yugādyā iti śrāddhakāsābhidhānaparaṃ bhavati |
viṣṇuḥ |
etāni śrāddhakālāni nityāny āha prajāpatiḥ | iti |
tatra yugādicatuṣṭayaṃ tathā ca yad varuṇamāghasita ityādi tatcāndramāsagatayugādipratipādanaparaṃ vyākhyānaṃ, tathoktaṃ "sa eva kālaḥ ṣaḍrasakṣayatvāt puṇyo yugāditvāt puṇyataro nakṣatrayogāt puṇyatama iti |
yac ca,
daśaharāsu notkarṣaś caturṣv api yugādiṣu |
upākarmamahāṣaṣṭhyor hy etad iṣṭaṃ vṛṣāditaḥ ||
iti paṭhanti, tad asanmūlatvād upalakṣaṇatvād upekṣaṇīyam iti | atra [654] paṇḍitaparitoṣakṛtā dūṣaṇam abhihitam anupapannam etat, cāndramāsa eva māse vaiśākhādivyapadeśabhāgitā tatra ca gauṇī śabdapravṛttir iti, tāvat pūrvam eva nirākṛtam |
yat tu pitṛkāryapradhānatvād yugādīnāṃ pitṛkārye ’pi cāndramāsaḥ smṛtas tadgatayugādigrahaṇam iti, tan na, saure cāndre pitṛkārye vidhir ity uktvā proktam | na ca pitṛkārye prādhānyaṃ yugādiṣu devapitṛkāryasambandhitvāt | tathā coktam | "anantapuṇyās tithayaś catasra" iti | tathā vyāsaḥ |
snānadānādikaṃ sarvaṃ yugādāv akṣayaṃ bhavet | iti |
na ca sitāsitapakṣam eva tāvac cāndrasya, saure ’pi tatsambhavāt |
yat tu “māghāsite pañcadaśīty udāhṛtaṃ na tena cāndramāsādigatāmāvāsyādikā tithir yugādir ity ucyate, kiṃ tu cāndre māse nakṣatrayuktā sinīvālī pitṛtṛptaye bhavatīti na tu yo ’yaṃ kālaḥ pitṛvallabhaḥ sa yugādir maghāparapakṣādiṣv abhāvāt | māghe amāvāsyā yugādiś cāndre 'pi sā tithir yugādir iti cet |
naivaṃ | sauracāndramāsavinigamahetor abhāvāt | na cobhayatrāpi yugāditvaṃ, catasra iti parisaṅkhyānān upapatteḥ | na ca śrāddhakālābhiprāyeṇaitad vacanaṃ, “ catasro yugādaya" iti vāṣṭakā vrīhiyavapākād iti vacanād yugādayaś catasras tithaya iti gamyate, tathāpi kā yugādir ity ucyate sauramāsagateti, anyathotkarṣaḥ syāt | na ca pitṛkāryotkarṣo vacanād iti mantavyaṃ, vacanābhāvāt [655] tūkarṣo yugādiṣv iti tithayaś ca sarvathotkarṣaṃ pratiṣedhanti, vṛṣādirāśigataravibhāge daśaharāditithipūjyatvāpadeśāt |
ṛṣyaśṛṅgeṇa |
daśaharāsu notkarṣaḥ caturṣv api yugādiṣu |
upākarmamahāṣaṣṭhyor hy etad uktaṃ vṛṣāditaḥ ||
iti utkarṣaniṣedhāc ca | "paraḥ kālaḥ pitṝṇām" iti paraśabdaḥ śreṣṭhatāvacanaḥ na tu pūrvakālagatakāryotkarṣapratipādakaḥ | na ca vā (?) daśaharāsv iti vacanam amūlaṃ, vacanāt samastaśāstravitparigrahān mūlopanyāsāc ca | yat tu śāṅkhadharaṃ vyākhyānaṃ naitad vaidikaṃ vacanaṃ yenāvicāritam upādadīmahe, tasmāt sakalajanaprasiddhyānuguṇyād anuṣṭhānādarāc ca sauramāsagataiva yugādirupā deyā, na cāndramāsagatā, na hi mithunāditye śukladaśamī daśaharā kumbhāditye cāsitapañcadaśī amāvāsyā iti vidhāne ’pi śraddadhate, tasmāt sauramāsagatā yugādir iti siddhānataḥ | vayaṃ tu brūmaḥ yady api vaiśākhādiśabdāś cāndramāsavacanā eveti māsaprastāve nirūpitaṃ, tadāpi prāgudāhṛtayugotkarṣaniṣedhakavacanaparyālocanaprasiddhyānuṣṭhādarārthaṃ sauramāsagataiva yugādir grāhyeti |
iti yugādinirṇayaḥ |
atha yugāntāḥ |
brahmapurāṇe |
sūryasya siṃhasaṃkrāntyām antaḥ kṛtayugasya tu |
atha vṛścikasaṃkrāntyām antas tretāyugasya tu ||
jñeyas tu vṛṣasaṃkrāntyāṃ dvāparāntas tu saṃjñayā |
tathā tu kumbhasaṃkrāntyām antaḥ kaliyugasya tu ||
ādityapurāṇe |
dinarkṣaṃ revatī yatra gamanaṃ caiva rāśiṣu |
yugāntadivasaṃ viddhi tatra dānam anantakam |
grahaṇe viṣuve caiva saumye vā mihiro yadi |
saptamī śuklakṛṣṇā vā yugāntadivasaṃ viduḥ ||
'saumye vā' ity udagayanam |
brahmapurāṇe |
yugādyeṣu yugānteṣu śrāddham akṣayam ucyate |
padmapurāṇe |
yugādiṣu yugānteṣu snānadānajapādikam |
yat kiṃcit kriyate tasya yugādyāḥ phalasākṣiṇaḥ ||
manuḥ |
sahasraguṇitaṃ dānaṃ bhaved dattaṃ yugādiṣu |
karma śrāddhādikaṃ caiva tathā manvantarādiṣu ||
iti yugāntāḥ |
atha nānāyugadharmāḥ |
tatropakātyāyanaḥ |
śrutiś ca śaucam ācāraḥ pratikālaṃ vibhidyate |
nānādharmāḥ pravarttante mānavānāṃ yuge yuge ||

anye kṛtayuge dharmaḥ tretāyāṃ dvāpare pare |
anye kaliyuge nṝṇāṃ yugahrāsānurūpataḥ ||
tapaḥ paraṃ kṛtayuge tretāyāṃ jñānam uttamaṃ |
dvāpare yajñam evāhur dānam eva kalau yuge ||
'tapaḥ' kṛcchracāndrāyaṇādi, 'jñānaṃ' dhyānam |

'tiṣyaḥ' kaliḥ |

[658]        pravṛttaṃ dvāpare yuddhaṃ dānam eva kalau yuge ||

dhyānaṃ paraṃ kṛtayuge tretāyāṃ havanakriyā |
ahiṃsā dvāpare caiva kalau śarvotsavaḥ smṛtaḥ || iti ||
tathā |

dvāpare liṅgapūjā ca kalau śaṅkarakīrttanaṃ |
viṣṇudharmottare |

dvāpare ca tathā yajñaḥ pratiṣṭhā ca kalau yuge ||

varāhapurāṇe |

śrībhāgavate |

nānāvarṇābhidhākāro nānaiva vidhinejyate ||

kṛṣṇājinopavītākṣānvibhraddaṇḍakamaṇḍalūn ||
manuṣyās tu tadā śāntā nirvairāḥ suhṛdaḥ samāḥ |

vṛṣākapir jayantaś ca uragāya itīryate ||
[660]        dvāpare bhagavān rāmaḥ pītavāsā nijāyudhaiḥ |
śrīvatsādibhir aṅkaiś ca lakṣaṇair upalakṣitaḥ ||
taṃ tathā puruṣaṃ martyā mahārājopalakṣaṇam |
yajanti vedatantrābhyāṃ paraṃ jijñāsayo nṛpa ||
namas te vāsudevāya namaḥ saṃkarṣaṇāya ca |
pradyumnāyāniruddhāya tubhyaṃ bhagavate namaḥ ||
nārāyaṇāya ṛṣaye puruṣāya mahātmane |
viśveśvarāya viśvāya sarvabhūtātmane namaḥ ||
iti dvāpara urvīśa stuvanti jagadīśvaram |
nānātantravidhānena kalāv api yathā śṛṇu ||
kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ tviṣā kṛṣṇaṃ sāṅgopāṅgāsv apārṣadam |

evaṃ yugānurūpeṇa bhagavān yugavarttibhiḥ |
manujair iṣyate rājaṃś chreyasām īśvaro hariḥ ||
aparājitapṛcchāyām |
somaṃ vāmena hastena dakṣiṇena raviṃ vahet |
vahniṃ hṛdayamadhye yo vāsudevaṃ prakīrtayet ||
ādimūrttir dijaiḥ pūjyaḥ śvetavarṇaḥ kṛte yuge |
saṃkarṣaṇo vahaty evaṃ lāṅgalaṃ muṣalaṃ tathā ||
raktavarṇaḥ prapūjyeta tretāyāṃ kṣatrajātibhiḥ |
pradyumno dvāpare pūjyo vaiśyaiḥ śaradhanurdharaḥ ||
pītavarṇaḥ pītavāsāḥ śilpajñānapradāyakaḥ |
[661]        kalau yuge niruddhākhyaḥ pūjyate śudrajātibhiḥ ||
kṛṣṇavarṇo vahaty eva carma khaḍgaṃ karadvaye |
trāsayann akhilaṃ vighnaṃ pāpavṛndaṃ vināśayet ||
aparājitapṛcchāyām |
ṛgvedādivibhedena kṛtādiyugabhedataḥ |
viprādivarṇabhedena caturvaktraś caturbhujaḥ ||
brahmā pitāmahaś caiva viriñciḥ kamalāsanaḥ |
catasra iti saṃproktā mūrttayaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ ||
pustakaṃ cākṣasūtraṃ ca sruvā caiva kamaṇḍaluḥ |
brahmaṇaś ca bhaven mūrttiḥ kṛte tu sukhadāyinī ||
suvaktraś ca subāhuś ca karṇakuṇḍalamaṇḍitaḥ |
mālāyuktaḥ suśobhāḍhyo māṃsalāṅgaḥ sukeśakaḥ ||
taptakāñcanavarṇabho ratnahārojjvaladyutiḥ |

dakṣiṇādhaḥkarakramād āyudhāni veditavyāni |

parāśaraḥ ||
