ayaṃ kartayugo dharmo na kartavyaḥ kalau yuge |
dīrghakālaṃ brahmacaryaṃ dhāraṇaṃ ca kamaṇḍaloḥ ||
gotrān mātṛpiṇḍāc ca vivāho govadhas tathā |
narāśvamedho madyaś ca kalau varjyaṃ dvijātibhiḥ ||
tathā |
ūḍhāyāḥ punar udvāhaṃ jyeṣṭāṃśaṃ govadhaṃ tathā |
kalau pañca na kurvīta bhrātṛjāyāṃ kamaṇḍalum ||
smṛtyantare |
devarāc ca sutotpatiṃ govadhaṃ ca kamaṇḍalum |
akṣatāṃ pauruṣaṃ medhaṃ kalau pañca vivarjayet ||
tathā |
yathāniyogaṃ dharmyāṇāṃ na hi dhenvā vadho ’pi ca |
tathoddhāravibhāgo ’pi naivaṃ samprati vartate ||
ādityapurāṇe |
śapathāḥ śakunāḥ svapnāḥ sāmudrikam upaśrutiḥ |
upayācitam ādeśāḥ sambhavati kalau kvacit ||
[667]        tasmāt tanmātralābhena kāryaṃ pañca na kārayet |
tathā dharmasamāveśād anyāny api kalau yuge ||
varjyāni |
vihitāny api karmāṇi dharmalopabhayād budhaiḥ |
samayena nivṛttāni sākṣyabhāvāt kalau yuge ||
vidhavāyāṃ prajotpattau devarasya niyojanam |
bālikākṣatayonyās tu nareṇānyena saṃskṛtiḥ ||
kanyānām asavarṇānāṃ vivāhaś ca dvijanmabhiḥ |
ātatāyidvijāgryāṇāṃ dharmayuddhena hiṃsanam ||
dvijasyābdhau tu nauyātuḥ śodhitasyāpi saṃgrahaḥ |
satradīkṣā ca sarveṣāṃ kamaṇḍaluvidhāraṇam ||
mahāprasthānagamanaṃ gosaṃjñaptiś ca gosave |
sautrāmaṇyām api surāgrahaṇasya ca saṃgrahaḥ ||
agnihotrahavaṇyāś ca leholīḍhāparigrahaḥ |
vānaprasthāśramasyāpi praveśo vidhicoditaḥ ||
vratasyādhyāyasāpekṣam aghasaṃkocanaṃ tathā |
prāyaścittavidhānaṃ ca viprāṇāṃ maraṇāntikam ||
saṃsargadoṣas teṣāṃ ca mahāpātakaniṣkṛtiḥ |
varātithipitṛbhyaś ca paryupākaraṇakriyā ||
dattaurasetareṣāṃ tu putratveṇa parigrahaḥ |
savarṇānyāṅganāduṣṭaḥ saṃsargaḥ śodhitair api |
[668]        ayonau saṃgrahe vṛtte parityāgo gurustriyaḥ ||
paroddeśātmasaṃtyāga uddiṣṭasyāpi varjanam |
pratimābhyarcanārthāya kaṅkalpasya sadharmakaḥ ||
asthisaṃcayanād ūrdhvam aṅgasparśanam eva ca |
saumitraṃ caiva viprāṇāṃ somavikrayaṇaṃ tathā |
ṣaḍbhaktānaśanenānnaharaṇaṃ hīnakarmaṇaḥ ||
etāni lokagupyarthaṃ kaler ādau mahātmabhiḥ |
nivarttitāni vidvadbhir vyavasthāpūrvakaṃ budhaiḥ |
samayaś cāpi sādhūnāṃ pramāṇaṃ vedavad bhavet ||
āpastambo ’pi |
sarvajñasamayaḥ pramāṇaṃ vedāś ceti |
nanu kaliyuge yad varjyaṃ tad vākyādhyāhārārthaṃ dṛṣṭārthaṃ vā | na ca tāvad dṛṣṭārthaṃ, anuṣṭhānānupayogitayā tadarthāvabodhasya prayojanatvānupapatteḥ | nāpy anyathā, vairūpyāpatteḥ |
ucyate | tadvākyārthānanuṣṭhāne ’pi bhedaprakṛtijñānādyupayogitayā dṛṣṭārthatvād adoṣaḥ | anyathā brāhmaṇasya rājasūyādivākyādhyayanam api na syāt | yad vā rājasūyādau yā gatiḥ saivehāpi | kiṃcaivaṃ vadatā kaliyugavarjanasmṛtyantarāprāmāṇyam ucyate | adhyayanavidhidṛṣṭārthatvābhāvān na tāvad aprāmāṇaṃ smṛtyantaravad atrāpi śiṣṭatraivarṇikadṛḍhaparigrahasyāviśeṣāt | adhyayanavidhidṛṣṭārthatvābhāvaś cet prakṛte kim āyātam iti |
iti kaliyugavarjyāni |
[669]
atha manvantarādayaḥ |
matsyapurāṇāt |
aśvayukśuklanavamī dvādaśī kārttikasya tu |
caitrasya tu tṛtīyā yā tathā bhādrapadasya ca ||
phālgunasya tv amāvāsyā pauṣasyaikādaśī tathā |
śrāvaṇasyāṣṭamī kṛṣṇā tathāṣāḍhasya purṇimā ||
āṣāḍhasya tu daśamī māghamāsasya saptamī |
kārttikī phālgunī caitrī jyaiṣṭhī pacadaśī tathā |
manvatarādayaś caitā dattasyākṣayakārikāḥ ||
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyaḥ pitṛtarpaṇam |
sarvam evākṣayaṃ vindyāt kṛtaṃ manvantarādiṣu ||
atrāmāvāsyāvyatirekeṇa sarvāḥ śuklā eva | purāṇāntare śrāvaṇāmāvāsyā bhādrapadakṛṣṇāṣṭamī yugādir iti pratipāditam |
tathā hi |
āśvine daśamī śuklā śrāvaṇe kārttikī tathā |
manvanarādayo hy etā dattasyākṣayakārikāḥ ||
manuḥ |
sahasaguṇitaṃ dānaṃ bhaved dattaṃ yugādiṣu |
karma śrāddhādikaṃ caiva tathā manvantarādiṣu ||
iti manvantarādayaḥ |
[670]
atha kalpādayaḥ |
tatra nāgarakhaṇḍe |
atha kalpādayo rājan kathyante tithayaḥ śubhāḥ |
yāsu śrāddhe kṛte tṛptiḥ pitṝṇām akṣyā bhavet ||
caitraśuklapratipadi śvetakalpaḥ purābhavat |
tasyāṃ śuklatrayodaśyām udānaḥ samajāyata ||
kalpas tu nārasiṃhākhyaḥ kṛṣṇāyāṃ pratipady abhūt |
atha kṛṣṇātrayodaśyāṃ gaurīkalpo ’py akalpyata ||
vaiśākhasya tṛtīyāyāṃ śuklāyāṃ nīlalohitaḥ |
caturdaśyāṃ tu śuklāyāṃ pravṛtto gāruḍābhidhaḥ ||
samānas tu tṛtīyāyāṃ kṛṣṇāyām udapadyata |
māheśvaraś caturdaśyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe samāgamat ||
jyaiṣṭhaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ mahādevasya saṃbhavaḥ |
paurṇamāsyāṃ tu tasyaiva kaurmaḥ pravavṛte nṛpa ||
kṛṣṇapakṣe tṛtīyāyām āgneyaḥ samagacchata |
tasyāṃ tasyaiva kṛṣṇāyāṃ somakalpaḥ samāpatat ||
śrāvaṇe suklapañcamyāṃ rauravaḥ samavartata |
tasyaiva kṛṣṇapañcamyāṃ mānavaḥ pratyapadyata ||
ṣaṣṭīṃ prauṣṭhapade śukle prāpya prāṇādhipo ’bhavat |
sitetarāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ tu tasya tatpuruṣābhidhaḥ ||
vṛhatkalpas tu saptamyāṃ śuklāyām āśvinasya tu |
[671]        kṛṣṇāyām api vaikuṇṭhaḥ praviveśa viśāmpate ||
kārttikasya site ṣaṣṭhyāṃ kalpaḥ kandarpasaṃjñāakaḥ |
asitāyāṃ punar jajñe lakṣmīkalpasya kalpanā ||
mārge śuklanavamyāṃ tu kalpaḥ sadyo ’bhyapadyata |
asitāyāṃ ca sāvitrīkalpaḥ prārambham abhyagāt ||
pauṣe daśamyāṃ śuklāyām īśānaḥ prādurāsa ha |
asitāyām aghorasya kaṣpasyopakramo ’bhavat ||
ekādaśyāṃ tu śuklāyāṃ māghe vyānaḥ prajajñivān |
tasyām eva tamisrāyāṃ vārāhaḥ prāpa bhūtaye ||
sārasvatas tu dvādaśyāṃ śuklāyāṃ phālgunasya tu |
kṛṣṇāyām api vairājo virarāja mahāmanāḥ ||
iti triṃśad amī kalpās tithayaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ |
ārambhe tithayas tv iṣṭāḥ śuklāḥ puṇyatamā matāḥ |
tāsu śrāddhe kṛte puṇyam ākalpasya vikalpane ||
matsyapurāṇe |
brahmaṇo yaddinād arvāk kalpasyādiḥ prakīrtitā |
vaiśākhasya tṛtīyāyāṃ kṛṣṇāyāṃ phālgunasya ca ||
pañcamī caitramāsasya tasyaivāntyā tathāparā |
śuklatrayodaśī māghe kārttikasya tu saptamī ||
navamī mārgaśīrṣasya saptaitāḥ saṃsmarāmy aham |
kalpānām ādayo hy etā dattasyākṣayakārikāḥ ||
[672]        atra 'antyā' amāvāsyā, vaiśākhe tṛtīyā, phālgune tṛtīyā, caitre pañcamī, caitrāmāvāsyeti kṛṣṇā | māghatrayodaśī, kārttike saptamī, mārgaśīrṣe navamī hy etāḥ śuklāḥ |
iti kalpādayaḥ |
atha vyatīpātaḥ |
tatra yājñavalkyaḥ |
śatam indukṣaye dānaṃ sahasraṃ tu dinakṣaye |
viṣuve daśasāhasraṃ vyatīpāte tv anantakam ||
vārāhapurāṇe |
darśe śataguṇaṃ dānaṃ tacchataghnaṃ dinakṣaye |
śataghnaṃ tatra saṃkrāntau śataghnaṃ viṣuve tathā ||
yugādau tacchataguṇaṃ ayane tacchatāhatam |
somagrahe tacchataghnaṃ tacchaghnaṃ ravigrahe |
asaṅkhyeyaṃ vyatīpāte dānaṃ vedavido viduḥ ||
'śataghnaṃ' śataguṇaṃ, vyatīpāto ’tra viṣkumbhādiyogeṣu saptaśoyogaḥ |
asyotpattim āha gālavaḥ |
candrārkayor nayanavīkṣaṇajātamūrttiḥ
kālānaladyutinibhaḥ puruṣo ’tiraudraḥ |
astrodyato bhuvi pataṃś ca nirīkṣyamāṇaḥ
saṅghātaye ’ham iti ca vyatipātayogaḥ ||
asya cotpattibhramaṇapatanasamayeṣu patanānantaraṃ ca kriyamāṇaṃ snānadānaśrāddhādikaṃ mahāphalaṃ bhavati | [673]
tad āha yājñavalkyaḥ |
utpattau lakṣaguṇaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhramaṇanāḍikāyāṃtu |
arbudaguṇitaṃ patane japadānādyakṣarya patite ||
nṛsiṃhapurāṇe |
phalaṃ lakṣaghnam utpattau bhramaṇe koṭir ucyate |
patane daśakoṭyas tu patite dattam akṣayam ||
utpattyādimānaṃ ca jyotiḥśāstre |
viṃśati dviyutotpattau bhramaṇe caikaviṃśati |
patane daśanāḍyas tu patite saptanāḍikāḥ ||
vṛddhamanunā prakārāntareṇa vyatīpāto darśitaḥ |
śravaṇāśvidhaniṣṭhārdrā nāgadaivatamastake |
yady amā ravivāreṇa vyatīpātaḥ sa ucyate ||
'nāgadaivataṃ' aśleṣā | 'mastakaṃ' prathamacaraṇaḥ | mastaka iti śravaṇādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ saṃbadhyate | kecit tu mastakaṃ mṛgaśira iti vyācakṣate | 'amā' amāvāsyā, yadaiteṣu nakṣatreṣv ādityavārayuktā bhavati tadā sa eṣa yogo vyatīpātasaṃjño bhavati |
śāstrāntare |
pañcānanasthau gurubhūmiputrau
meṣe raviḥ syād yadi śuklapakṣe |
pāśābhidhānā karabheṇa yuktā
tithir vyatīpāta itīha yogaḥ ||
asmin hi gobhūmihiraṇyavastra-
[674]                dānena sarvaṃ pravihāya pāpam |
suratvam indratvam anāmayatvam
martyādhipatyaṃ labhate manuṣyaḥ ||
'pañcānanaḥ' siṃhaḥ | ‘gurubhūmiputrau ' bṛhaspatyaṅgārakau | 'pāśābhidhānā' dvādaśī | 'karabhaṃ' hastanakṣatram |
iti vyatīpātaḥ |
atha vaidhṛtivyatīpātau |
tatra bhṛguḥ |
krāntisāmyasamayaḥ samīritaḥ
sūryaparvasadṛśo munīśvaraiḥ |
tatra dattahutajaptapūjanam
koṭikoṭiguṇam āha bhārgavaḥ ||
asyārthaḥ sūryācandramasoḥ krāntisāṃye kutapakāle dvayaṃ saṃbhavati | vyatīpāte vaidhṛtiḥ sā tatra saṃkrāntisāmyalakṣaṇavyatīpātasya gaṇḍontarārdhād ārabhya kramāt, sārdheṣu bhayogeṣu saṃbhavo ’sti, vaidhṛtasya tu śuklayogād ārabhya kramāt sārdheṣu pañcayogeṣu saṃbhavaḥ |
atra vyatīpāte śrāddhaṃ kartavyam ity āha pitāmahaḥ |
amāvāsyāvyatīpātapaurṇamāsyaṣṭakāsu ca |
vidvān śrāddham akurvāṇaḥ prāyaścittīyate tu saḥ || iti |
atra prāyaścittīyata iti vacanaṃ śrāddhasyāvaśyakatāṃ gamayati | tatparvakālasaṃkhyā ca daśaghaṭikābhyaḥ samārabhya ekasaptatyadhikaśataparyantaṃ saṃbhāvyate |
[675]        tathā ca vedāṅge jyotiṣi |
gaṇḍottarārdhavyatipātasaṃbhavaḥ
śuklādiko vaidikasaṃbhavo bhavet |
sārdheṣu pañcasv apareṣu ceṣyate
evaṃ dvayaṃ tatsukṛtaikasādhakam ||
viṣṇuḥ |
vaidhṛte ca vyatīpāte dattam akṣayakṛd bhavet |
bhāradvājaḥ |
vyatīpāte vaidhṛte ca dattasyānto na vidyate |
vyatīpāte viśeṣeṇa sa hi sūkṣmaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
sthūlaprakāreṇa prasiddhas tu saptaviṃśatitamo yogo vaidhṛta iti |
iti vaidhṛtivyatīpātau |
atha prakīrṇapuṇyakālaḥ |
tatra viṣṇuḥ |
amāvāsyāvyatīpātau grahaṇaṃ candrasūryayoḥ |
manvādayo yugādiś ca saṃkrāntir vaidhṛtis tathā ||
dinakṣayaṃ dinacchidram avamaṃ ca tathāparam |
dve ’yane viṣuvadyugmaṃ ṣaḍaśītimukhaṃ tathā ||
catasro viṣṇupadyaś ca putrajanmādi cāparam |
ādityādigrahāṇāṃ ca nakṣatraiḥ saha saṅgamaḥ ||
vijñeyaḥ puṇyakālo ’yaṃ jyotirvidbhir vicāribhiḥ |
[676]        tatra dānādikaṃ kuryād ātmanaḥ puṇyavṛddhaye ||
dinakṣayalakṣaṇam uktaṃ padmapurāṇe |
dvau tithyantāv ekavāre yasmin saḥ syād dinakṣayaḥ |
vasiṣṭhaḥ |
ekasmin sāvane tv ahni tithīnāṃ tritayaṃ yadā |
tadā dinakṣayaḥ proktas tatra sāhasrikaṃ phalam ||
dinacchidralakṣaṇam āha bhṛguḥ |
tithyardhatithiyogarkṣavedādī śaśiparvaṇaḥ |
sadṛśau divasaccidrasamākhyau prāha bhārgavaḥ ||
asyārthaḥ, 'tithyarddhaṃ' karaṇaṃ, karaṇatithiyoganakṣatrāṇām ante ādī parvakālasomagrahaṇatulye, sa ca dinacchidrasaṃjña iti |
kālamānam api sa evāha |
chedādikālaḥ kathitas tithikṛtyor ghaṭīdvayam |
nāgavahnipalopetaṃ tadbhetattvapalair yutam ||
palaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhir yuktaṃ nāḍikādvitayaṃ yutau |
chedādisamayaḥ prokto dāne ’nantaphalapradaḥ ||
‘kṛtiḥ' karaṇam | ‘nāgāḥ' aṣṭau | 'vahnayaḥ' trayaḥ | 'bhaṃ' nakṣatraṃ | 'tattvāni' pañcaviṃśatiḥ | 'yutiḥ' yogaḥ | tenāyam arthaḥ tithikaraṇayor ādyante ghaṭikādvayaṃ aṣṭatriṃśatpalāni puṇyakālaḥ | nakṣatrasya tu pañcaviṃśatipalair yuktaṃ ghaṭikādvayam | yogasyāpi ṣoḍaśabhiḥ palair yuktaṃ ghaṭikādvayam iti |
avamalakṣaṇam uktaṃ viṣṇunā |
[677]        tithitrayaṃ spṛśaty eko vāraḥ syād avamaṃ hi tat |
trivāraspṛk tithir yatra tridinaspṛk tad ucyate ||
atra dinakṣayāvamayor iyān bhedaḥ | yatra tithidvayāvasāne vārāvasānaṃ sa dinakṣayaḥ | yatra tithidvaye ’pi vārānuvṛttiḥ so ’vama iti | viṣuvādīni saṃkrāntinirṇaye ’pi darśitāni |
padmapurāṇe |
mande vārke gurau vāpi vāreṣv eteṣu ca triṣu |
trīṇy etāni ca ṛkṣāṇi proktāni brahmaṇā ||
aśvamedhādhikaṃ puṇyaṃ snānasya tu bhaven nṛpa |
dānam akṣayatāṃ yāti pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ tathā ||
'trīṇi ṛkṣāṇi' āgneyayāmyaprājāpatyāni |
mātsye |
yadā mṛgaśire ṛkṣe śaśī sūryo bṛhaspatiḥ |
tiṣṭhanti sā tithiḥ puṇyā akṣayā parigīyate ||
brahmaprokte |
ekādaśy apy amāvāsyā pūrṇimā putrajanma ca |
vaidhṛtiś ca vyatīpāto bhadrā cāvamavāsaraḥ ||
yugamanvādayas te syur induparvasamānakāḥ |
krāntisāmyaṃ dinacchidraṃ grahaṇam bhagamas tathā ||
'bhagamaḥ' rāśinakṣatragamanam |
devīpurāṇe |
vyatīpāto viṣṇudinaṃ ṣaḍaśītimukhaṃ tathā |
[678]        krāntisāmyam amāvāsyā grahaṇaṃ vaidhṛtis tathā ||
saṃkrāntiś ca dinacchidraṃ tithivṛddhir dinakṣayaḥ |
ityādipuṇyakālas tu homadānādikarmaṇaḥ ||
skandapurāṇe |
grahaṇaṃ candrasūryābhyāṃ uttarāyaṇam uttamam |
viṣuvaṃ ca vyatīpātaḥ ṣaḍaśītimukhaṃ tathā ||
dinacchidrāṇi saṃkrāntir jñeyaṃ viṣṇupadaṃ punaḥ |
iti kālaḥ samākhyātaḥ puṃsāṃ puṇyavivardhanaḥ ||
asmin dānāni dattāni snānahomatapāṃsi ca |
anantaphaladāni syuḥ svargamokṣapradāny api ||
cyavanaḥ |
amāvāsyāsaṃkrāntivyatīpātaviṣuvāyanaṣaḍaśītimukhaviṣuvādivaidhṛtigrahaṇānāṃ sa eva puṇyakālaḥ |
ādityapurāṇe |
grahaṇe ṣaḍaśītau ca candrasūryagrahe tathā |
yugādau vaidhṛte caiva dattaṃ bhavati cākṣayam ||
tathā |
tithayaś ca pravakṣyāmi yāsu dattaṃ mahāphalam |
grahoparāge saṃkrāntau gamane caiva rāśiṣu ||
mihire vai caturdaśyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ saptamīṣu ca |
[679]        ṣaḍaśītimukhe parvaṇy ayane dakṣiṇottare |
gṛhṇāmi nityaṃ bhaktānāṃ viśeṣāt tu prakīrtitāḥ ||
tithiṣu daśaguṇaṃ vadanti dānam
śataguṇitaṃ tv ayanāvasāne |
daśaguṇitaṃ grahoparāge
viṣuvati cākṣayaṃ yugānte ||
śātātapaḥ |
ayaneṣu tu yad dattaṃ ṣaḍaśītimukheṣu ca |
candrasūryoparāge ca dattaṃ bhavati cākṣayam ||
śivarahasye |
mahacchabdaprayujyā yā yā ca sopapadā tithiḥ |
amāvāsyāsamā jñeyā dānādhyayanakarmasu ||
śaṅkhaḥ |
yadā viṣṭir vyatīpāto bhānuvāreṇa saṃyutaḥ |
padmakaṃ nāma tat proktaṃ ayanāc ca caturguṇam ||
yadā ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vyatīpāto bhānuvāras tathaiva ca |
padmakaṃ nāma tat proktam ayanāc ca caturguṇam ||
viśākhāsu yadā bhānuḥ kṛttikāsu ca candramāḥ |
sa yogaḥ padmako nāma puṣkareṣv api durlabhaḥ ||
iti prakīrṇapuṇyakālaḥ |
[680]
atha nimittānurodhena sadā puṇyakālaḥ |
viṣṇudharmottare |
kālaḥ sarvo ’pi nirdiṣṭaḥ pātraṃ sarvam udāhṛtam |
avāptasya pradāne tu nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
tadaiva dānakālas tu yadobhayam upasthitam ||
tathā |
na kālaniyamo diṣṭo dīyamāne pratiśraye |
tadaiva dānam asyoktaṃ yadā pānthasamāgamaḥ ||
na hi kālaṃ pratīkṣeta jalaṃ dātuṃ tṛṣānvite |
annodakaṃ sadā deyam ity āha bhagavān manuḥ ||
skānde |
ardhaprasūtāṃ gāṃ dadyāt kālādi na vicārayet |
kālaḥ sa eva grahaṇe yadā vai vimukhī tu gauḥ ||
vyāsaḥ |
āsannamṛtyunā deyā gauḥ savatsā tu pūrvavat |
tadabhāve ca gaur eva narakoddhāraṇāya vai ||
tadā yadi na śaknoti dātuṃ vaitaraṇīṃ tu gāṃ |
śakto ’nyo ’ruktadā dattvā śreyo dadyāt mṛtasya ca ||
vārāhapurāṇe |
vyatīpāto ’tha saṃkrāntis tathaiva grahaṇaṃ raveḥ |
puṇyakālās tathā sarve yadā mṛtyur upasthitaḥ |
tadā gobhūhiraṇyādi dattam akṣayatām iyāt ||
[681]        adṛṣṭam aśrutaṃ dānaṃ bhuktvā caiva na dṛśyate |
iti vyāsasmṛtivacanaviśeṣaḥ śāstrāvaruddhe viṣaye pravarttate, sūryoparāgeṇa tam āhuḥ samayaṃ samam |
viṣṇudharmottare |
acchinnanāḍyāṃ yad dattaṃ putre jāte dvijottamāḥ |
saṃskāreṣu ca putrasya tad akṣayyaṃ prakīrttitam ||
viṣṇupurāṇe |
yadā vā jāyate vittaṃ cittaṃ śraddhāsamanvitam |
tadaiva dānakālaḥ syād yato ’nityaṃ hi jīvitam ||
iti nimittānurodhena sadā puṇyakālaḥ |
atha tithiviśeṣeṇa varjyani |
atha caturthīvarjyam |
tatra mārkaṇḍeyaḥ |
siṃhāditye kṛṣṇapakṣe caturthyāṃ candradarśanam |
mithyābhidūṣaṇaṃ kuryāt tasmāt paśyen na taṃ tadā ||
iti caturthīvarjyam |
atha saptamīvarjyāni |
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
[682]        saptamyāṃ na spṛśet tailaṃ nīlavastraṃ na dhārayet |
na cāpy āmalakaiḥ snānaṃ na kuryāt kalahaṃ naraḥ |
saptamyāṃ naiva kurvīta tāmrapātreṇa bhojanam ||
budhaḥ |
nimbasya bhakṣaṇaṃ tailaṃ tilais tarpaṇam añjanam |
saptamyāṃ naiva kurvīta tāmrapātreṇa bhojanam ||
iti saptamīvarjyāni |
atha parvānuṣṭheyam |
tatra manuḥ |
sāvitrān śāntihomāṃś ca kuryāt parvasu nityaśaḥ |
'sāvitrāḥ' savitṛdevatākāḥ |
asmiṃś ca home gāyatrī mantraḥ, akṣataṃ ca dravyaṃ |
yad āha śaṅkhaḥ |
śāntikāmas ta juhuyād gāyatryā cākṣataiḥ śuciḥ |
śāntiś ca dharmeṇaihikāniṣṭanivṛttiḥ |
varjyāni tu viṣṇupurāṇe darśitāni |
caturdaśy aṣṭamī caiva amāvāsyā ca pūrṇimā |
parvāṇy etāni rājendra ravisaṃkrāntir eva ca |
tailastrīmāṃsasaṃbhogī parvasv eteṣu no bhavet || iti |
'nityaśa' iti vacanāt parvasv avaśyaṃ kartavyo ’yaṃ homaḥ, asya ca sāvitrahomasya śāntiḥ phalam |
[683]        viṣṇuḥ |
parvasv avaśyaṃ tilahomān kuryād alaṃkṛtas tiṣṭhed evam ācārasevī syāt |
kātyāyanaḥ |
paurṇamāsīm amāvāsyām adhaḥsvāpo vidhīyate |
anāhitāgner apy eṣa paścād agner vidhīyate ||
'anāhitāgniḥ' smārtāgnimān |
āpastambaḥ |
divādityasya sattvāni gopāyati naktaṃ candramās tasmād amāvāsyāniśāyāṃ sādhīyasīm ātmano guptim icchet | prāyatyabrahmacaryakālena ca jāyayā sahaitāṃ rātriṃ sūryācandramasau vasataḥ |
'sādhīyasī' bhṛśam | 'guptiḥ' rakṣā |
ṣaṭtriṃśanmate kātyāyanasmṛtau ca |
māse nabhasy amāvāsyā darbho grāhyo navaḥ smṛtaḥ |
ayātayāmās te darbhā niyojyāś ca punaḥ punaḥ || iti ||
tathā ca kātyāyanenāmāvāsyāyāṃ darbhacchedaṃ vidhāyoktam |
pitṛdevajapārthaṃ ca vāsam ādadyād iti |
tathā |
te dvijena niyoktavyā daive pitrye ca karmaṇi | iti |
tasmāt pitrādikāryārthaṃ kuśā grāhyā eva |
marīcinā tu śrāvaṇāmāvāsyāyāṃ darbhopādānam uktam |
māse nabhasy amāvāsyā tasyāṃ darbhoccayo mataḥ |
ayātayāmās te darbhā viniyojyāḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||
[684]        yas tv amāvāsyāyāṃ kuśacchedaniṣedhaḥ sa tūktavyatiriktaviṣayaḥ |
iti parvānuṣṭheyam |
atha parvavarjyani |
tatra baudhāyanaḥ |
parvasu ca nādhīyīta, na māṃsam aśnīyāt, na ca striyam upeyāt, parvasu hi rakṣaḥpiśācavyabhicārivan nitambinīti |
viṣṇuḥ |
parvasu na tṛṇam api chindyāt |
paiṭhīnasiḥ |
na parvasu tailaṃ kṣuraṃ maithunaṃ māṃsam ity upeyāt |
'upeyāt' upayuñjīta |
viṣṇupurāṇe caturdaṣyādipañcaparvāṇy abhidhāyoktam |
tailastrīmāṃsabhogī yaḥ parvasv eteṣu vai pumān |
viṇmūtrabhojanaṃ nāma prayāti narakaṃ nṛpa ||
manuḥ |
caturdaśy aṣṭamī darśaḥ paurṇamāsy arkasaṃkramaḥ |
eṣu strītailamāṃsāni dantakāṣṭhāni varjayet ||
pañcadaśyāṃ caturdaśyām aṣṭamyāṃ ca viśāradaḥ |
tailaṃ māṃsaṃ vyavāyaṃ ca kṣuraṃ caiva vivarjayet ||
hārītaḥ |
[685]        tailaṃ māṃsaṃ bhagaṃ kṣauraṃ parvakāleṣu varjayet |
eteṣv alakṣmīr vasati puṇyakāseṣu nityaśaḥ ||
śleṣmātake tathālakṣmīr nityam eva kṛtālayā |
bhage māṃse kṣure taile nityaṃ parvasu tiṣṭhati ||
vṛddhaśātātapaḥ |
dantakāṣṭham amāvāsyāṃ maithunaṃ ca caturdaśīm |
hanti saptakulaṃ tasya tailagrahaṇam aṣṭamīm |
yamaḥ |
āsaptamaṃ kulaṃ hanti śiro’bhyaṅgāc caturdaśī |
māṃsāśane pañcadaśī kāmadharme tathāṣṭamī ||
matsyapurāṇe |
chinatti vīrudho yas tu vīrutsaṃsthe niśākare |
patraṃ vā pātayaty eṣāṃ brahmahatyāṃ sa vindati ||
'vīrutsaṃsthe' vanaspatigate |
paiṭhīnasiḥ |
amāvasyāyāṃ na chindyāt kuśāṃś ca samidhas tathā |
sarvatrāvasthite some hiṃsāyāṃ brahmahā bhavet ||
kvacid amāvāsyāyāṃ na hiṃsyād iti pāṭhaḥ | pitrādikāryārthaṃ kuśā grāhyā eveti parvānuṣṭheyaprastāve darśitam |
tathā |
[686]        sāyaṃ sandhyāṃ parānnaṃ ca tilapiṣṭaṃ tathaiva ca |
amāvāsyāṃ na seveta rātrau maithunabhojane ||
smṛtisamuccayāt |
sāyaṃ sandhyāṃ parānnaṃ ca parabhojanamaithune |
tailaṃ māṃsaṃ śilāpiṣṭam amāvāsyāṃ vivarjayet ||
sūryaṛkṣagate some parānnaṃ yo hi bhakṣayet |
tasya māsagataṃ puṇyaṃ yasyānnaṃ tasya tad bhavet |
amāvāsyāsu sarvāsu navavastraṃ na dhārayet ||
iti parvavarjyāni |
atha kālaviśeṣeṇa nānāvarjyāni |
skandapurāṇe |
śiraḥ kapālam āntrāṇi nakhacarmatilāṃs tathā |
etāni kramaśo nityam aṣṭamyādiṣu varjayet ||
‘śiraḥ' nārikelam | 'kapālam' alābu | 'āntraṃ' paṭolīphalaṃ | niṣpāvāḥ | 'carma' masūryaḥ | 'tilāḥ' vārttīkaṃ, iti vṛddhā vyākurvate |
caturviṃśatimate tūttarārddham evaṃ paṭhyate |
yadīcched ūrdhvagamanam aṣṭamyādiṣu varjayet |
vyāsaḥ |
ṣaṣthy aṣṭamī tv amāvāsyā pakṣadvayacaturdaśī |
atra saṃnihitaṃ pāpaṃ taile māṃse bhage kṣure ||
[687]        atra kecid āhuḥ | ṣaṣṭhyādiṣu kramāt tailādīnāṃ niṣedhaḥ,
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ tailam anāyuṣyam aṣṭamyāṃ piśitaṃ tathā |
kāmabhogaś caturdaśyām amāvāsyāṃ kṣurakriyā ||
iti smaraṇāt | tataś cānyatra tailādau doṣābhāva iti |
tad ayuktaṃ, anyatrāpi tailādiniṣedhāt |
tatra manuḥ |
māṃsāśane pañcadaśī tailābhyaṅge caturdaśī |
aṣṭamī grāmyadharmeṣu jvalantam api pātayet ||
'grāmyadharmaḥ' maithunam |
kṣurakarma caturdaśyām amāvāsyāṃ ca maithunam | iti |
ṣaṭtriṃsaṇmate |
saṅkrāntyāṃ pañcadaśyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ śrāddhavāsare |
vastraṃ saṃpīḍayen naiva na kṣureṇāpi hiṃsyate ||
tilatailaniṣedhaś ca tithyantaraprastāve darśitaḥ |
vyāso 'pi |
tailaṃ ca na spṛśed dāmavṛkṣādīn chedayen na ca |
pakṣādau ca ravau ṣaṣṭhyāṃ riktāyāṃ ca tathā tithau ||
caturdaśy aṣṭamī caiva amāvāsyā ca pūrṇimā |
varjyāny etāni parvāṇi ravisaṃkrāntir eva ca ||
tailastrīmāṃsasaṃbhogī parvasv eteṣu yo bhavet |
viṇmūtrabhojanaṃ nāma prayāti narakaṃ nṛpa ||
bṛhaspatiḥ |
[688]        amāvāsyendusaṃkrānticaturdaśyāṣṭamīṣu ca |
naraś caṇḍālayonau syāt tailastrīmāṃsasevanāt ||
purāṇāt |
kuhūpūrṇendusaṃkrānticaturdaśyāṣṭamīṣu ca |
atrottarārddhaṃ pūrvaślokasya tasmād atrāpi tailādiniṣedhe siddhe tithiviśeṣasambandhena tailādiviśeṣaniṣedho doṣaviśeṣārthaḥ | atra ca yāvac chaṣṭhyāditithikālaṃ tailādiniṣedhaḥ, na tu ṣaṣṭhyādisambandhād ahorātrādilakṣaṇaṃ pramāṇābhāvāt |
vāmanapurāṇe |
nandāsu mābhyaṅgam upācareta
kṣauraṃ ca riktāsu jayāsu māṃsam |
pūrṇāsu yoṣit parivarjanīyā
bhadrāṇi sarvāṇi samārabheta ||
nābhyaṅgam arke na ca bhūmiputre
kṣauraṃ ca śukre ca kuje ca māṃsaṃ |
budheṣu yoṣāṃ na samācareta
śeṣeṣu sarvāṇi sadaiva kuryāt ||
citrāsu haste śravaṇe ca tailam
kṣauraṃ viśākhāpratipatsu varjyam |
mūle mṛge bhādrapadāsu māṃsam
yoṣin maghākṛttikasottarāsu |
caturdaśyaṣṭamīdarśapaurṇamāsyarkasaṃkramāḥ |
[689]        eṣu strītailamāṃsāni dantakāṣṭhaṃ vivarjayet ||
devalaḥ |
pañcadaśyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ aṣṭamyāṃ ca viśārada |
tailaṃ māṃsaṃ vyavāyaṃ ca kṣuraṃ ca parivarjayet ||
yamaḥ |
yathā sitāsv aṣṭamīṣu bhūtāhendukṣaye tathā |
tailābhyaṅgaṃ kṣaurakarma strīsaṅgaṃ ca vivarjayet ||
vārāhapurāṇe |
caturdaśyāṃ tathāṣṭamyāṃ pañcadaśyāṃ ca parvasu |
tailābhyaṅgaṃ tathā bhogaṃ yoṣitaś ca vivarjayet ||
na mṛc ca nodakaṃ cāpi na niśāyāṃ tu gomayam |
gomūtraṃ ca pradoṣe ca gṛhṇīyād buddhimān naraḥ ||
niśāyām api mṛdudakābhyām iti sambadhyate | ayaṃ cādṛṣṭakarmārthatvena niśāyāṃ grahaṇaniṣedhaḥ |
skānde |
snānaṃ caiva mahādānaṃ svādhyāyaṃ pitṛtarpaṇam |
prathame ’bde na kurvīta mahāgurunipātane ||
māṇḍavyaḥ |
śrutivedhajātakānnaprāśanayātrāpratimārcāḥ |
ravibhavanasthe kāryā jīve na kāryo vivāhas tu ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
supte viṣṇau nivartante kriyāḥ sarvāḥ śubhādikāḥ |
[690]        vivāhavratabandhādicūḍāsaṃskāradīkṣaṇam ||
yajño gṛhapraveśaś ca pratiṣṭhā devabhūbhṛtām |
puṇyāni yāni karmāṇi na syuḥ supte jagatpatau ||
iti kālaviśeṣeṇa nānāvarjyāni |
atha kṣaurakarmaniṣiddhakālaḥ |
tatra vyāsaḥ |
kṣaure śanaiśvarādityabhaumāhorātram eva ca |
tathā pratipadaṃ riktāṃ tithiṃ ca parivarjayet ||
jyotiḥśāstre |
nābhyaktabhuktaraṇakālanirāśanānām
na snātasuptagamanāṃśukabhūṣitānām |
sandhyāniśārkakujasauradineśvarāṇām
kṣauraṃ hitaṃ bhavati cāhni na cāpi viṣṭyām || iti ||
mārkaṇḍeyaḥ |
aṣṭamī ca tathā ṣaṣṭhī navamī ca caturdaśī |
kṣurakarmaṇi varjyā ca parvasandhis tathaiva ca ||
iti kṣaurakarmaṇi niṣiddhakālaḥ |
atha śmaśrukarmaṇi niṣiddhakālaḥ |
marīciḥ |
nirāśanasya suptasya tiṣṭhata tathaiva ca |
sāyaṃ bhuktavataś caiva sātasya ruṣitasya ca |
[691]        yātrāyuddhodyatasyāpi śmaśrukarmāṇi varjayet ||
iti śmaśrukarmaniṣiddhakālaḥ |
atha māṃsavarjanakālaḥ |
nandipurāṇe īśvaravacanam |
yadi nāma caturdaśyāṃ sadā māṃsaṃ vivarjayet |
varjayed ayane mukhye kṛtasvargamatir naraḥ ||
caturthī cāṣṭamī caiva dvādaśī ca caturdaśī |
tathā pañcadaśī cāryāḥ ṣaḍaśītimukhāni ca ||
saṃkramaṃ cāpi sūryasya viṣuve cāpi vārṣike |
māṃsāt tu virato martyo yāti svargaṃ dinatrayam ||
atha vāśvayujaṃ māsaṃ varjayen māṃsabhakṣaṇam |
bahumāsakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ labhetāśvayujān naraḥ ||
māṃsabhojanasaṃtyāgāt puruṣaḥ śuddhamānasaḥ |
yo naraḥ kārtike māse māṃsaṃ tu parivarjayet |
saṃvatsarasya labhate puṇyaṃ māṃsavivarjanāt ||
iti māṃsavivarjanakālaḥ |
atha śayane vihitaniṣiddhakālaḥ |
tapa dakṣaḥ |
pradoṣapaścimau yāmau vedābhyāsarato nayet |
yāmadvayaṃ śayānas tu brahmabhūyāya kalpate ||
śaṅkhalikhitau |
[692]        trayāṇāṃ varṇānāṃ pūrvarātre jāgaraṇam |
pracetāḥ |
na sandhyāyāṃ na cāyane |
aṅgirāḥ |
nocchiṣṭo na divā supyāt sandhyayor na ca bhasmani |
vyāsaḥ |
na divā prasvapej jātu na pūrvāpararātrayoḥ |
manuḥ |
na niśānte pariśrānto brahmādhītya punaḥ svapet |
pariśrāntaḥ punar na svaped ity arthaḥ |
gautamaḥ |
apararātram adhītya punar na saṃviśet |
hārītaḥ |
brāhmye muhūrte pratibudhya svādhyāyam āvartya na pratisaṃviśed iti |
āpastambaḥ |
mithumībhūya na ca tathā saha sarvāṃ rātriṃ śayīta |
iti śayane niṣiddhakālaḥ |
atha dantadhāvanakālanirṇayaḥ |
tatra kātyāyanaḥ |
utthāya netre prakṣyālya śucir bhūtvā samāhitaḥ |
parijapya ca mantreṇa bhakṣayed dantadhāvanam ||
[693]        āyur balaṃ yaśo varcaḥ prajāḥ paśuvasūni ca |
brahma prajñāṃ ca medhāṃ ca tvan no dhehi vanaspate ||
iti mantraḥ |
vyāsaḥ |
śuddhyarthaṃ prātar utthāya bhakṣayed dantadhāvanam |
śrāddhe yajñe ca niyamān nādyāt proṣitabhartṛkā ||
vyāsaḥ |
śrāddhe janmadine caiva vivāhe mukhadūṣite |
vrate caivopavāse ca varjayed dantadhāvanam ||
saṃvarttaḥ |
ādyatithau navamyāṃ ca kṣaye candramasas tathā |
ādityavāra āśauce varjayed dantadhāvanam ||
kātyāyanaḥ |
pratipaddarśaṣaṣṭhīṣu navamyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ |
dantānāṃ kāṣṭhasaṃyogo dahaty āsaptamaṃ kulam ||
vyāsaḥ |
pratipaddarśaṣaṣṭhīṣu navamyāṃ dantadhāvanam |
parṇena patrakāṣṭais tu jihvollekhaṃ sadaiva tu ||
vyatīpātasaṃkrāntinandāparvasu dantakāṣṭhaniṣedhaḥ kālaviśeṣeṇa nānāvarjyaprastāve darśitaḥ |
alābhe dantakāṣṭhānāṃ niṣiddhāyāṃ tathā tithau |
apāṃ dvādaśagaṇḍūṣair vidadhyād dantadhāvanam ||
[694]        kvacit tūttarārddham evaṃ paṭhanti |
apāṃ dvādaśagaṇḍūṣaiḥ patrair vā śodhayayen mukhaṃ |
tathā |
yo mohāt snānavelāyāṃ bhakṣayed dantadhāvanam |
nirāśās tatra gacchanti devatāḥ pitaras tathā ||
pālāśam āsanaṃ yānaṃ dantakāṣṭhaṃ ca pāduke |
varjayet tu prayatnena sarvam āśvattham eva ca ||
madhyāhnasnānaviṣayam etat prātaḥsnāne vidhānāt |
yad āha parāśaraḥ |
dantān pūrvam adho gharṣet prātaḥ siñcec ca locanam |
toyapūrṇamukho grīṣme śīte na śaradi smṛtaḥ |
prakṣālya bhakṣayet pūrvaṃ prakṣālyaiva tu tat tyajet |
iti dantadhāvanakālanirṇayaḥ |
atha sandhyākālanirṇayaḥ |
tatra gautamaḥ |
tiṣṭhet pūrvam āsītottarāṃ sajjyotiṣo darśanād vāgyataḥ |
sajjyotiṣaḥ kāle prārambhaḥ vyotirantaradarśanān nivṛttir ity arthaḥ |
saṃvartaḥ |
prātaḥsandhyāṃ sanakṣatrām upāsīta yathāvidhi |
atha brāhmaṇaparaṃ ca karmābhidhāyoktam |
śātātapaḥ |
[695]        sanakṣatrāṃ tu yaḥ pūrvāṃ sādityāṃ caiva paścimām |
nopāsīta dvijaḥ sandhyāṃ va bhraṣṭo brāhmaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
yogiyājñavalkyaḥ |
sāyaṃ sandhyām upāsīta jāsta nāstage nodgate ravau |
vyāsaḥ |
sūrye tamasi saṃprāpte pādaśaucakriyānvitaḥ |
bahiḥ sandhyām upāsīta kuśapāṇiḥ samāhitaḥ ||
kvacit tu sūrye ’stācalasaṃprāpte iti pāṭhaḥ |
manuḥ |
pūrvasandhyāṃ japan tiṣṭhet sāvitrīm ārkadarśanāt |
paścimāṃ tu samāsīnaḥ samyag arkṣavibhāvanāt ||
yājñavalkyaḥ |
japann āsīta sāvitrīṃ pratyag ā tārakodayāt |
sandhyāṃ prāk prātar evaṃ hi tiṣṭhed ā sūryadarśanāt ||
ahorātrasya yaḥ sandhiḥ sūryanakṣatravarjitaḥ |
yā tu sandhyā samākhyātā ṛṣibhis tattvadarśibhiḥ ||
iti uktvā "tatra sandhyām upāsītety uktaṃ, tat pūrvadarśitavacananicayaparyālocanayaivaṃ vyākhyeyaṃ, pūrvasandhyopāstiḥ sūryadarśanāvadhikā paścimasandhyopāstir nakṣatradarśanāvadhiketi |
śrutiḥ |
evaṃ vidvān sāyaṃ prātaś ca sandhyām upāsta iti |
atra sāyaṃśabdena pūrvokta eva sandhyākālo gṛhyate |
yadā tu,
[696]        nakṣatradarśanāt sandhyā sāyaṃ tatparataḥ sthitaḥ |
tatparā rajanī jñeyā tatra dharmān vivarjayet ||
iti vacanāt, nakṣatradarśanordhvakālasya sāyaṃśabdenopādānaṃ, tadā pūrvavacanaparyālocanayā kathaṃcit sūryakālātikrama eva veditavyaḥ |
yogiyājñavalkyaḥ |
hrāsavṛddhī tu satataṃ divasānāṃ yathākramam |
sandhyā muhūrttamātraṃ tu hrāse vṛddhau samā smṛtā ||
viṣṇupurāṇat |
sarvakālam upasthānaṃ sandhyāyāḥ pārthiveṣyate |
anyatra sūtakāśaucavibhramāturabhītitaḥ ||
pulastyaḥ |
sandhyām iṣṭiṃ caru homaṃ yāvajjīvaṃ samācaret |
na tyajet sūtake vāpi tyajan gacched adhogatim ||
evaṃvidhe sati vyavasthām āha |
sūtake mṛtake caiva sandhyākarma na saṃtyayet |
manasoccārayen mantrān prāṇāyāmam ṛte dvijaḥ ||
evaṃ ca yāni sūtakādau sandhyāniṣedhaparāṇi vacanāni tāni mantraprayoganivṛttiparāṇīti mantavyaṃ, añjaliprakṣepaś ca uccāryamāṇyaiva sāvitryā kāryaḥ |
tathā ca paiṭhīnasiḥ |
sūtake tu sāvitryāñcaliṃ prakṣipya pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā sūryaṃ dhyāyan
namaskurvīta |
iti sandhyākālanirṇayaḥ |
[697]
atha sandhyākālavarjyāni |
tatrāha manuḥ |
catvārīmāni karmāṇi sandhyāyāṃ parivarjayet |
āhārāj jāyate vyādhiḥ garbho raudraś ca maithunāt |
nidrāto jāyate ’lakṣmīḥ svādhyāyād āyuṣaḥ kṣayaḥ ||
vṛddhamanuḥ |
āhāraṃ maithunaṃ nidrāṃ sandhyākāle vivarjayet |
karma cādhyayanaṃ vāpi tathā dānapratigrahau ||
āhārāj jāyate vyādhiḥ garbho raudraś ca maithunāt |
svapanāt syād alakṣmīkaḥ karma caivātra niṣphalam ||
adhyetā narakaṃ yāti dātā nāpnoti tatphalam |
pratigrāhī bhavet pāpī tasmāt sandhyāṃ vivarjayet |
dātā vai narakaṃ yāti grahītādho nimajjati ||
iti sandhyākālavarjyāni |
atha rātrikaraṇīyavarjyāni |
rātrau dānaṃ na kartavyaṃ kadācidapi kenacit ||
haranti rākṣasā yasmāt tasmād dātur bhayāvaham ||
viśeṣato niśīthe tu na śubhaṃ karma dharmaṇe 1
ato ’pi varjayet prājño dānādiṣu mahāniśām ||
devalaḥ |
rāhudarśanasaṃkrāntivivāhātyayavṛddhiṣu |
[698]        annadānādikaṃ kuryān niśi kāmyavrateṣu ca ||
vasiṣṭhaḥ |
grahaṇodvāhasaṃkrāntiprāṇārttiprasaveṣu ca |
dānaṃ naimittikaṃ jñeyaṃ rātrāv api tad iṣvyate ||
yātrādāv iti pāṭhaḥ |
yajñe vivāhe yātrāryāṃ tathā pustakavācane |
dānāny etāni śastāni rātrau devālaye tathā ||
mahābhārate |
rātrau dānaṃ na śaṃsanti vinā tv ayanadakṣiṇām |
vidyāṃ kanyāṃ dvijaśreṣṭhā dīpam annaṃ pratiśrayam ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
pūjanaṃ cātithīnāṃ ca pānthānām api pūjanam |
tac ca rātrau tathā jñeyaṃ gavām uktaṃ ca pūjanam ||
mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
mahāniśā tu vijñeyā madhyasthaṃ praharadvayam |
snānaṃ tatra na kurvīta kāmyanaimittikād ṛte ||
viśvāmitraḥ |
mahāniśātvaṃ vijñeyaṃ rātrau madhyamayāmayoḥ |
naimittikaṃ tadā kuryān nityaṃ tu na manāg api ||
kvacit 'na tu kāvyaṃ manāg api' iti pāṭhaḥ |
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
rātrau snānaṃ na kurvīta dānaṃ caiva viśeṣataḥ |
[699]        naimittikaṃ tu kurvītānaṃ dānañca rāciṣu ||
grahaṇodvāhasaṃkrāntivātrārttiprasaveṣu ca |
śravaṇe cetihāsassa rātrau dānaṃ praśasyate || iti |
vivāhavratasaṃkrātipratiṣṭhāṛtujanmasu |
tathoparāgapātādau snāne dāne niśā śubhā ||
'ṛtuḥ' garbhādhānaṃ, 'pātaḥ' vyatīpātaḥ |
putrajanmani yajñe ca tathā saṃkramaṇe raveḥ |
rāhoś ca darśaṇe snānaṃ praśastaṃ nānyathā niśi ||
tathā |
putrajanmani yātrāyāṃ śarvaryāṃ dattam akṣayam |
iti rātrikaraṇīyavarjyāni |
atra catuṣpathāsevanakālaḥ |
vyāsaḥ |
madhyandina uṣaḥkāle arddharātre ca sarvadā |
catuṣpathaṃ na seveta ubhe sandhye tathaiva ca ||
manuḥ |
madhyandine ’rddharātre ca śrāddhaṃ bhuktvā tu sāmiṣam |
sandhyayor ubhayoś caiva na seveta catuṣpatham ||
atha kālaviśeṣāvalokanīyānavalokanīyāni |
kātyāyanaḥ |
śrotriyaṃ subhagaṃ gāṃ ca agnim agnicitaṃ tathā |
[700]        prātar utthāya yaḥ paśyed āpadbhyaḥ sa pramucyate ||
vaiyāghrapādaḥ |
śrotriyaṃ subhagaṃ gāṃ ca agnim agnicitaṃ tathā |
yaḥ paśyed āyataprāṇa āpadbhyaḥ sa pramucyate ||
kātyāyanaḥ |
rocanaṃ candanaṃ hema mṛdaṅgaṃ darpaṇaṃ maṇim |
gurum agniṃ tathā sūryaṃ prātaḥ paśyet samāhitaḥ ||
loke ’smin maṅgalāny aṣṭau brāhmaṇo gaur hutāśanaḥ |
hiraṇyaṃ sarpir āditya āpo rājā tathāṣṭamaḥ |
etāni satataṃ paśyen namasyec ca samāhitaḥ ||
yajñam iṣṭānnadaṃ satraṃ śatāyur dhārmikān śuciḥ |
jñānasiddhāṃs tapaḥsiddhān dṛṣṭvā pāpāt pramucyate ||
agnicit kapilā satrī rājā bhikṣur mahodadhiḥ |
dṛṣṭamātrāḥ punanty eva tasmāt paśyeta nityaśaḥ ||
pāpiṣṭhaṃ durbhagaṃ mattaṃ nagnam utkṛttanāsikaṃ |
prātar utthāya yaḥ paśyet tat kaler upalakṣaṇam ||
iti kālaviśeṣeṇāvalokanīyānavalokanīyāni |
atha nadīnāṃ rajaḥkālanirṇayaḥ |
tatra mārkaṇḍeyaḥ |
dvimāsaṃ saritaḥ sarvā bhavanti hi rajasvalāḥ |
apraśastaṃ tataḥ snānaṃ varṣādau navavāriṇā ||
kātyāyanaḥ |
[701]        māsadvayaṃ śrāvaṇādau sarvā nadyo rajasvalāḥ |
tāsu snānaṃ na kurvīta varjayitvā samudragāḥ ||
tathā |
nabhonabhasyāyor madhye sarvā nadyo rajasvalāḥ |
tāsu snānaṃ na kurvīta devarṣipitṛtarpaṇam ||
dhanuḥsahasrāṇy aṣṭau ca gatir yāsāṃ na vidyate |
na tā nadīśabdavahā garttās te parikīrttitāḥ ||
siṃhakarkaṭayor madhye sarvā nadyo rajasvalāḥ |
na snānādīni karmāṇi tāsu kurvīta mānavaḥ ||
yogiyājñavalkāḥ |
agrāhyās tv āgatā hy āpo nadyāḥ prathamavegikāḥ |
prakṣobhitāś ca kenāpi yāś ca tīrthād viniḥsṛtāḥ ||
kvacit tv agrimā iti pāṭhaḥ | 'tīrthaḥ' jalāvatāraṇamārgaḥ |
tathā ca smṛtyantare |
ajā gāvo mahiṣyaś ca brāhmaṇyaś ca prasūtikāḥ |
daśarātreṇa śudhyanti bhūmiṣṭhaṃ ca navodakam ||
yājñavalkyaḥ |
yāvan nodeti bhagavān dakṣiṇāśāvibhūṣaṇaḥ |
tāvad retovahā nadyo varjayitvā tu jāhnavīm ||
prathame karkaṭe devi tryahaṃ gaṅgā rajasvalā |
sarvā raktavahā nadyaḥ karatoyāḥ prakīrttitāḥ ||
[702]        kātyāyanaḥ |
prāvṛṭkāle mahānadyaḥ santi nityaṃ rajasvalāḥ |
caturthe ’hani saṃprāpte śuddhā bhavati jāhnavī ||
ādityaduhitā gaṅgā plakṣajā ca sarasvatī |
rajasā nābhibhūyante ye cānye nadasaṃjñakāḥ ||
ādityaduhitā gaṅgā plakṣajā ca sarasvatī |
aparyuṣitapāpās te nadīs tisraḥ pibanti ye ||
gaṅgā ca yamunā caiva plakṣajā ca sarasvatī |
rajasā nābhibhūyante śoṇaś cāpi mahāhradaḥ ||
kālindī gomatī gaṅgā pavitrā devanirmitā |
sāmānyād guṇayogāc ca rajo nābhibhavanty ataḥ ||
gaṅgā dharmadravī puṇyā yamunā ca sarasvatī |
antargatarajoyogāḥ sarvāheṣv api cāmalāḥ ||
nigamaḥ |
pratisrotorajoyogo rathyājalaniveśanam |
gaṅgāyāṃ naiva duṣyanti sa hi dharmadravaḥ svāyam ||
yāḥ śoṣam upagacchanti grīṣme kusarito bhuvi |
tāsu snānaṃ na kurvīta prāvṛśeṇyāmbudarśanāt ||
kātyāyanaḥ |
yāḥ śoṣam upagacchanti grīṣme kusarito bhuvi |
tāsu prāvṛṣi na snāyād apūrṇe daśavāsare ||
karkaṭādau rajoduṣṭā gautamī vāsaratrayam |
[703]        candrabhāgā satī bindhuḥ śarayūr narmadā tathā ||
upākarmaṇi cotsarge snānārthaṃ brahmavādinaḥ |
pipāsavas tu gacchanti saṃśliṣṭāś ca śarīriṇaḥ ||
vicchandāṃsi ca sarvāṇi brahmaṇyāś ca divaukasaḥ |
jalārthino 'tha pitaro marīcyādyās tatharṣayaḥ ||
samāgamas tu yatraiṣāṃ tatrāste tūdayo ’malaḥ |
nūnaṃ sarvaṃ kṣayaṃ yāti kim utaikaṃ nadīrajaḥ ||
upākarmaṇi cotsarge pretasnāne tathaiva ca |
candrasūryagrahe caiva rajodoṣo na vidyate ||
svardhunyambhaḥsamāni syuḥ sarvāny ambhāṃsi bhūtale |
kūpasthāny api somārkagrahaṇe nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
'svardhunī' gaṅgā |
navāmbu śuci bhūmiṣṭhaṃ tryahād ūrdhvam iti sthitam |
pravāhavegena samaṃ purāṇaṃ satataṃ bhuvi ||
iti nadīnāṃ rajaḥkālanirṇayaḥ |
athāśvatthasāgarasparśāsparśakālaḥ |
aśvatthasāgarau sevyau na spraṣṭavyau kadācana |
kālavāre spṛśet pūrvam uttaraṃ parvaṇi spṛśet ||
kvacit tu mandavāre iti pāṭhaḥ |
ity aśvatthasāgarasparśāsparśakālaḥ |
[704]
atha snānakālanirṇayaḥ |
kātyāyanaḥ |
yathāhani tathā prātar nityaṃ snāyād atandritaḥ |
atyantamalinaḥ kāyo navacchidrasamanvitaḥ ||
sravaty eva divārātrau prātaḥ snānaṃ viśodhanam |
prātaḥ snānaṃ praśaṃsanti dṛṣṭādṛṣṭakaraṃ hi tat ||
vaiyghrapādaḥ |
prātaḥ saṅkhepataḥ (saṃkṣepa-?) snānaṃ śaucārthaṃ tu tad iṣyate |
mantrais tu vidhiniṣpādyaṃ madhyāhne tu savistaram ||
prātaḥsnāyī bhaven nityaṃ madhyasnāyī bhavet sadā |
saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ trivarṣeṇa vyapohati ||
uṣasy uṣasi yat snānaṃ candrasūryagrahe tathā |
prājāpatyena tat tulyaṃ nṝṇām anudite ravau ||
caturviṃśatimate |
uṣasy uṣasi yat snānaṃ sandhyāyām udite ravau |
prājāpatyena tat tulyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam ||
prātarmadhyāhnayoḥ snānaṃ vānaprasthagṛhasthayoḥ |
yates triṣavaṇaṃ proktaṃ sakṛt tu brahmacāriṇaḥ ||
yogiyājñavalkyaḥ |
ubhe sandhye tu snātavyaṃ brahmaṇais tu gṛhāśritaiḥ |
tisṛṣv api ca sandhyāsu snātavyaṃ ca tapasvinā ||
vyāsaḥ |
[705]        dvādaśyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe tu na snātavyaṃ kathaṃcana |
śubhasantānam icchadbhir dhanadhānyaparair api ||
daśamī putranāśāya svanāśāya trayodaśī |
dvitīyo bhayanāśāya snāne caitāni varjayet ||
kvacit tṛtīyapādo ’nyathā paṭhyate "tṛtīyā bhartṛnāśāya" iti |
vaśiṣṭhaḥ |
pratipady anapatyaḥ syāt tṛtīyāyāṃ kvapatyakaḥ |
daśamyām adhanaḥ snāne sarvaṃ hanti trayodaśī |
sa eva |
daśamī navamī caiva tṛtīyā ca trayodaśī |
pratipac ca viśeṣeṇa snāne tās tu vivarjayet ||
ṣaṭtriṃśanmate |
darśe snānaṃ na kurvīta mātāpitros tu jīvatoḥ |
navamyāṃ ca na cet tatra nimittāntarasaṃbhavaḥ ||
yamaḥ |
darśe snānaṃ na kurvīta mātāpitros tu jīvatoḥ |
putraḥ kurvan nirācaṣṭe mātāpitros tu jīvitam |
kuryād anyatame ’tīte rāhugraste divākare |
garga-jābālī |
trayodaśyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ daśamyāṃ caiva sarvaśaḥ |
[706]        śudraviṭkṣatriyāḥ snānaṃ nācareyuḥ kadācana ||
smṛtyantarāt |
bhogāya kriyate yat tu snānaṃ yādṛcchikaṃ naraiḥ |
tan niṣiddhaṃ daśamyādau nitye naimittike na tu ||
garga-jābālī |
kriyate vā na vā yatra śāstrayantraṇayā vinā |
malavyapohanapalaṃ snānaṃ yādṛcchikaṃ tu yat ||
tat na kuryāt tṛtīyāyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ tathā tithau |
śāśvatīṃ bhūtim anvicchan daśamyām api paṇḍitaḥ ||
tathā |
nityaṃ na hāpayet snānaṃ kāmyaṃ naimittikaṃ ca yat |
daśamyām api kartavyaṃ na tu yādṛcchikaṃ kvacit ||
baudhāyanaḥ |
vinā tu satatasnānaṃ na snāyād daśamīṣu ca |
vaśiṣṭha-paiṭhīnasī |
putrajanmani saṃkrāntyāṃ śrāddhe janmadine tathā |
nityaṃ snānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ tithidoṣo na vidyate ||
varjayed ity anuvṛttāv āpastambaḥ |
asamite ca snānam |
parāśaraḥ |
divākarakaraiḥ pūtaṃ divā snānaṃ praśasyate |
apraśastaṃ niśi snānaṃ rāhor anyatra sūtakāt |
[707]        yathā snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sūryasya grahaṇe divā |
somasyāpi tathā rātrau snānaṃ pūtaṃ vidhīyate ||
apraśastaṃ niśi snānaṃ rāhor anyatra darśanāt |
parāmbhasi tathaivānyair nāśirakaṃ kathaṃcana ||
vaśiṣṭhaḥ |
putrajanmani yajñe ca tathā saṃkramaṇe raveḥ |
rāhoś ca darśane snānaṃ praśastaṃ nānyathā niśi ||
vyāsaḥ |
snānaṃ dānaṃ japaḥ śrāddham anantaṃ rāhudarśane |
āsurī rātrir anyatra tasmāt tāṃ parivarjayet ||
tathā |
rātrau snānaṃ na kurvīta dānaṃ caiva viśeṣataḥ |
naimittikaṃ tu kurvīta snānaṃ dānaṃ ca rātriṣu ||
parāśaraḥ |
uparāge paraṃ snānaṃ mṛte dina udāhṛtaṃ |
mahāniśā tu vijñeyā madhyasthaṃ praharadvayam ||
pradoṣapaścimau yāmau dinavat karma cācaret |
divā yad āhṛtaṃ toyaṃ kṛtvā svarṇayutaṃ tu tat ||
rātrisnāne tu saṃprāpte snāyād vānalasaṃnidhau |
ucchiṣṭādyupaghātādau snānaṃ naimittikaṃ smṛtam |
candrasūryoparāge ca tathaiva grahasūtake ||
manuḥ |
[708]        na snānam ācared bhuktvā nāturo na mahāniśi |
na vāsobhiḥ sahājasraṃ nāvijñāte jalāśaye |
'bhuktvā' iti na nityasnānasya niṣedhaḥ tasya bhojanānantaraprāptyabhāvāt | nāpi cāṇḍālasparśanimittasya "nāśuciḥ kṣaṇam api tiṣṭhed" iti vacanavirodhaprasaṅgāt vidhiprāptaniṣedhāsambhavasya tailābhyaṅgakālanirṇaye darśitatvāc ca | tasmād yādṛcchikasnānaniṣedho ’yaṃ, āturasya tu sarvadā vāruṇasnānaniṣedhaḥ | 'ajasraṃ' anavaratam |
na snāyād utsave ’tīte māṅgalyāni nivartya ca |
anuvrajya suhṛdbandhūn pūjayitveṣṭadevatām ||
mārkaṇḍeyaḥ |
mahāniśātvaṃ vijñeyaṃ rātrau madhyamayāmayoḥ |
naimittikaṃ tadā kuryāt kāmyaṃ na ca manāg api ||
kvacin nityaṃ tu na manāg apīti pāṭhaḥ |
asmāc ca vacanān nityaṃ snānaṃ kathaṃcid atikrāntasvakālaṃ mahāniśāvarjaṃ rātrāv api kartavyaṃ, na tu karmaṇo lopa iti gamyate |
mahāniśā tu vijñeyā madhyasthaṃ praharadvayam |
snānaṃ tatra na kurvīta kāmyanaimittikād ṛte ||
atra kāmyaśabdena phalārthaṃ snānam ucyate, pūrvavākye tu yādṛcchikam ity avirodhaḥ |
viśvāmitraḥ |
mahāniśā tu vijñeyā rātrau madhyamayāmayoḥ |
tasyāṃ snānaṃ na kurvīta kāmyam ācamanakriyām ||
[709]        atra kāmyaṃ yādṛcchikam abhimatam |
ācamanasāpi na naimittikasya pratiṣedhaḥ |
tata cāha |
mūtroccāre mahārātrau kuryāc cācamanaṃ budhaḥ |
prāyaścittīyate vipraḥ prāyaścittārdham arhati ||
pulastyaḥ |
ravyaṅgāraśaner vāre snānaṃ kurvanti ye narāḥ |
vyādhibhis te na pīḍyante margaiḥ kesariṇo yathā ||
aparaṃ ca śrūyate |
samudram avagāhayeta nānyatrāvagāhayate |
pulastyaḥ |
puṣye ca janmanakṣatre vyatīpāte vaidhṛtau |
amāvāsyāṃ nadīsnānaṃ punāty āsaptamaṃ kulam ||
aṣṭamī revatīyoge tathā cairāvate ’mbhasi |
śrāvayaṃ samanuprāpya yatra kvacana saṃgame ||
sarvā caturdaśī puṇyā devikāyās tathāmbhasi |
caitraśuklatrayodaśyāṃ yaḥ snāyāc chivasaṃnidhau |
na pretatvam avāpnoti gaṅgāyāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ ||
yamaḥ |
śālagrāme yathā caitrī śaṅkare ca caturdaśī |
śukladaśamyāṃ snānaṃ tu puṇḍarīke tathaiva ca ||
saṃnihatyām amāvāsyāṃ prabhāse ca tathā punaḥ |
[710]        añjasaiva naraḥ snātvā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ ||
pulastyaḥ |
jyaiṣṭhamāse tu saṃprāpte daśamyāṃ hastasaṃyute |
daśajanmāghahā gaṅgā tena pāpaharā smṛtā |
āṣāḍhyāṃ sarayūyoge śrāvaṇyāṃ satataṃ tathā ||
yamaḥ |
prauṣṭhapadasya māghasya śuklā yā ca trayodaśī |
tasyāṃ snātvā vitastāyāṃ sarvaiḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
yadīcched vipulān bhogān candrasūryagrahopamān |
prātaḥsnāyī bhaven nityaṃ māsau dau māghaphālgunau ||
prātaḥsnāyī tu satataṃ māsau dau tu ca phālgunau |
devān pitṝn samabhyarcya mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ ||
bālas tarunako vṛddho naranārīnapuṃsakāḥ |
snātvā māghe śubhe tīrthe prāpnuvantīpsitaṃ phalam ||
māghamāse raṭanty āpaḥ kiṃcid abhyudite ravau |
brahmaghnaṃ vā surāpaṃ vā kaṃ patantaṃ punīmahe ||
prāsādā yatra sauvarṇāstriyaś cāparasopamāḥ |
tatra te yānti majjanti ye māghe bhāskarodaye ||
saṃyataḥ pathi gaccheta maunī paiśūnyavarjitaḥ |
yadīcched vipulān bhogān candrasūryopamān śubhān ||
māghaphālgunayor madhye prātaḥsnāyī sadā bhavet
aprāvṛtaśarīras tu yaḥ kaṣṭaṃ snānam ācaret |
[711]        pade pade ’śvamedhasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ||
pitrā pitāmahaiḥ sārdhaṃ vṛddhamātāmahais tathā |
ekaviṃśakulaiḥ sārdhaṃ bhogān bhuktvā yathepsitān |
māghamāsāmbhasi snātvā viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati ||
nāradīyapurāṇāt |
saṃprāpte māghamāse tu tapasvijanavallabhe |
krośanti sarvavārīṇi samudratadivākare ||
punīmaḥ sarvapāpāni trividhāni na saṃśayaḥ |
brahmaghne ’pi hi yāni syus tīvrakarmakṛtāni ca ||
durlabho māghamāsas tu bahupuṇyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
devais tejaḥ parikṣiptaṃ māghamāse jaleṣu vai ||
ataḥ pavitraṃ hi jalaṃ aśeṣāghaughanāśanam |
naḍbaleṣu tu na snāyāt kaupe ’mbhojaśrite tathā |
na sukhāl labhyate puṇyaṃ puṇyaṃ kṛcchreṇa labhyate ||
tathā ca kātyāyanaḥ |
yatra syāt kaṛcchrabhuyastvaṃ śreyaso ’pi manīṣiṇaḥ |
bhuyastvaṃ bruvate tatra kṛcchrāc chreyo hy avāpyate ||
tasmāt |
snāto vahniṃ na seveta asnāto vā kathaṃcana |
sevetāpi hi homārthaṃ na śītārthaṃ kathaṃcana ||
sarittoyaṃ mahāvegaṃ navakumbhasthitaṃ tathā |
vāyunā tāḍitaṃ rātrau gaṅgāsnānaphalaṃ smṛtam ||
[712]        māghamāse varārohe śastaṃ vai nimnagājalam |
māghasnāyī naro yaḥ syād durgatiṃ neha paśyati ||
tatrāsti mānuṣe loke kilbiṣaṃ naiva śodhayet |
agnipraveśād adhikaṃ māghasnānaṃ varānane ||
viṣṇuḥ |
darśaṃ vai pūrṇamāsaṃ vā prārabhya snānam ācaret |
puṇyāny ahāni triṃśat tu makarasthe divākare |
iti snānakālanirṇayaḥ |
atha uṣṇodakasnānakālanirṇayaḥ |
tatra śaṅkhaḥ |
snānasya vahnitaptena tathaiva paravāriṇā |
śarīraśuddhir vijñeyā na tu snānaphalaṃ labhet ||
yogiyājñavalkyaḥ |
svabhāvadūṣitādbhiś ca uddhṛtābhiś ca mānavaḥ |
uṣṇābhir ācaran snānaṃ na viśudhyati mānavaḥ |
vṛthā tūṣṇodakasnānaṃ vṛthā jāpyam avaidikam ||
ṣaṭtriṃśanmātāt |
āpaḥ svabhāvato medhyā viśeṣād agnitāpitāḥ |
tena santaḥ praśaṃsanti snānam uṣṇena vāriṇā |
yamaḥ |
āpa eva sadā puṇyās tāsāṃ vahnir viśodhakaḥ |
[713]        tasmāt sarveṣu kāleṣu uṣṇāmbhaḥ pāvanaṃ smṛtam ||
atroṣṇodakaniṣedhaḥ (?) kāmyanityanaimittikaviṣayaḥ, vidhis tu tadvyatiriktaviṣayaḥ |
tathātra gārgyaḥ |
kuryān naimittikaṃ snānaṃ śītādbhiḥ kāmyam eva ca |
nityaṃ yādṛcchakaṃ caiva yathāruci samācaret ||
kriyāsnānam apy uṣṇodakena na kāryam |
tathā ca vyāsaḥ |
kriyāsnānaṃ vinā kuryād uṣṇodakaparodakaiḥ |
tathā snātasya nāstīha phalaṃ kiṃcid dvijanmanaḥ ||
atra viśeṣam āha yamaḥ |
nityaṃ naimittikaṃ caiva kriyāmaṅgalakarṣaṇam |
tīrthābhāve tu kartavyam uṣṇodakaparodakaiḥ ||
āturasya tu sarvadoṣṇodakasnānam eva |
tad āha sa eva |
ādityakiraṇaiḥ pūtaṃ punaḥ pūtantu vahninā |
āmnātam āturasnāne praśastaṃ tu śṛtodakam ||
śītādbhiś cābhiṣicyoṣṇaṃ mantrasaṃskārayogataḥ |
gṛhe ’pi śasyate snānaṃ tadvinā na phalaṃ labhet ||
mṛte janmani saṃkrāntau grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ |
aspṛśyasparśane caiva na snāyād uṣṇavāriṇā ||
vṛddhamanuḥ |
[714]        saṃkrāntyāṃ bhānuvāre ca saptamyāṃ rāhudarśane |
ārogyaputramitrārthī na snāyād uṣṇavāriṇā ||
paurṇamāsyāṃ tathā darśe yaḥ snāyād uṣṇavāriṇā |
sa gohatyākṛtaṃ pāpaṃ prāpnotīha na saṃśayaḥ ||
ity uṣṇodakasnānakālanirṇayaḥ |
athāmalakasnānakālanirṇayaḥ |
tatra bṛhaspatiḥ |
tuṣyaty āmalakair viṣṇyur ekādaśyāṃ viśeṣataḥ |
vyāsaḥ |
śrīkāmaḥ sarvadā snānaṃ kurvītāmalakair naraḥ |
saptamīṃ navamīṃ caiva parvakālaṃ vivarjayet ||
atra kecid āhuḥ parvātrāmāvāsyeti |
yad āha vyāsaḥ |
amāvāsyānavamyoś ca saptamyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ |
dhātrīphalāni yatnena dūrataḥ parivarjayet ||
'dhātrī' āmalakī |
vīryahāniṃ prajāhāniṃ yaśohāniṃ tathaiva ca |
karoti tritayaṃ janma tasmād dhātrīṃ vivarjayet ||
tad ayuktam | śrīkāmavākayena saptamīnavamīparvakālavyatirikte kāle phalārthaṃ vihitaṃ, amāvāsyādivākyānām amāvākhādiṣv [715] aniṣṭaparihārārthaṃ pratiṣiddhaṃ, ato nityaviṣayatvān nopasaṃhāraḥ |
yogiyājñavalkyaḥ |
dhātrīphalena na snāyāt saptamīnavamīṣu ca |
yaḥ snāyāt tasya hīyante teja āyur dhanaṃ sutāḥ ||
ṣaṭtriṃśanmate |
saptamyāṃ ca navamyāṃ ca saṃkrāntau ravivāsare |
candrasūryoparāge ca snānam āmakais tyajet ||
kratuḥ |
ṣaṣṭhīṃ ca navamīṃ caiva saptamīṃ ca trayodaśīm |
saṃkrāntau ravivāre ca snānam āmalakais tyajet ||
yadā tv ekādaśyāṃ ādityavāras tadā viṣṇutuṣṭyartham āmalakaiḥ snāyād eva |
āmalakasnānaṃ prakṛtyoktam ṣaṭtriṃśanmate |
tuṣyaty āmalakair viṣṇur ekādaśyāṃ viśeṣataḥ | iti ||
na cādityavāre āmalakasnānaniṣedhād ekādaśyām āmalakasnānavidher vārāntaraviṣayatā, ekādaśyām āmalakasnānavidher ādityavārāmalakasnānaniṣedhasya tithyantaraviṣayatāyā apy upapatteḥ | kathaṃ tarhi nirṇayaḥ ucyate | niṣedho rāgaprāptasnānaviṣayaḥ vidhiprāptaviṣayatve vikalpāpatteḥ tasya cānyāyyatvāt | tasmād ādityavārasyaikādaśyāṃ āmalakasnānaṃ kāryam iti siddham |
ity āmalakasnānakālanirṇayaḥ |
[716]
atha tilasnānavihitaniṣiddhakālau |
tatra bṛhaspatiḥ |
sarvakālaṃ tilaiḥ snānaṃ puṇyaṃ vyāso ’bravīn muniḥ |
ṣaṭtriṃśanmate |
tathā saptamyamāvāsyāsaṃkrāntigrahasūriṣu |
dhanaputrakalatrārthī tilapiṣṭaṃ na saṃspṛśet ||
iti tilasnānavihitaniṣedhakālau |
athābhyaṅgavihitaniṣiddhakālau |
tatra mārkaṇḍeyaḥ |
apuṣṭiḥ kāntir alpāyur dhanī saubhāgyavarjitaḥ |
nirdhano ’nnapatiś caiva vāreṣv abhyaṅgakṛn naraḥ ||
ādityādiṣu vāreṣu yathākrameṇābhyaṅge phalaviśeṣo jñeyaḥ |
jyotiḥparāśaraḥ |
santāpaḥ kāntir alpāyur dhanaṃ nirdhanatā tathā |
anārogyaṃ sarvakāmā abhyaṅgād bhāskarādiṣu ||
yaḥ sadā kurute ’bhyaṅgaṃ proktān muktvā tu vāsarān |
na tāvad apamṛtyuḥ syād yāvad anyo ’rkanandanaḥ ||
baudhāyanaḥ |
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ navamyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ |
śiro’bhyaṅgaṃ varjayet tu parvaṇy api tathaiva ca ||
ity abhyaṅgavihitaniṣiddhakālau |
[717]
aba tailābhyaṅgādikālaniryayaḥ |
tatra kātyāyanaḥ |
pākṣādau ca ravau ṣaṣṭhyāṃ riktāyāṃ ca tathā tithau |
tailenābhyajyamānas tu caturbhiḥ parihīyate ||
atra tilodbhavaṃ tailaṃ na tu kusumbhādiprabhavam iti tasya vikāra iti pāṇinismṛtiḥ, tataś ca pāṇinikṛte niṣpannaḥ tailaśabdo nānyad abhidhātuṃ śaknoti |
kecid āhuḥ sarpiprāṇyudbhavasnehāny asnehavācakas tailaśabdas tatrāpi prayogād iti |
tad ayuktam, kevalasya tailaśabdasya tilavikārānyavācakatvābhāvāt | yat tu vārttikakṛtā 'snehe tailam' iti tailapratyayo vihitaḥ, sa snehamātravācakaḥ atasītailam eraṇḍatailam ityādi | tathā cāyurvedapraṇetāraś caraka-hārīta-suśruta-pārāśara-agniveśa-jātūkarṇādayo na snehamātraṃ kevalena tailaśabdenābhidadhati tilavikāra eva tu prayuñjata iti | na ca tilavikāravacanatve piṇyākādiṣyv api tailaśabdapravṛttes tailaniṣedhe tanniṣedho ’pi prasajyata iti vācyam | tailaśabdasya snehe nirūḍhatvāt yathā paṅkajaśabdaḥ padma eva nirūḍhatvād vartate na tu maṇḍūkādau | yas tu kvacit kevalatailaśabdasya snehāntare ’pi prayogaḥ sa sādṛśyād upapaṇaḥ |
ata evāhuḥ śabdavidaḥ |
niṣpannas tadguṇastho 'tra tailatvam itareṣv api |
yāti tasmāt tilavikāra eva snehas tailaṃ na tu snehamātram iti |
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ tailam anāyuṣyaṃ caturṣv api ca parvasu |
saptamyāṃ na spṛśet tailaṃ navamyāṃ pratipady api ||
[718]        aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyām amāvāsyāṃ viśeṣataḥ |
rajo’bhyupagame kāle bhavan lakṣmyā prahīyate ||
tathā |
upoṣitasya vratinaḥ kṛttakeśasya nāpitaiḥ |
tāvac chrīs tiṣṭhate prītā yāvat tailaṃ na saṃspṛśet |
nakhacchede kṛte śmaśruśiroruhanivarttane |
na snāyīta naraḥ śeṣe tailasnānaṃ vidhīyate ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
saptamyāṃ saṃspṛśet tailaṃ snigdhā bhāryā vinaśyati |
sumantuḥ |
tailābhyaṅgo nārkavāre na bhaume
no saṃkrāntau vaidhṛtau viṣṭiṣaṣṭhyoḥ |
varṣasv aṣṭamyāṃ ca neṣṭaḥ sa iṣṭaḥ
proktān muktvā vāsare sūryasūnoḥ ||
gargaḥ |
pañcamī daśamī caiva tṛtīyā ca trayodaśī |
ekādaśī dvitīyā ca pakṣayor ubhayor api ||
abhyañjanasparśanādyair yo 'tra tailaṃ nivevate |
caturṇāṃ tasya vṛddhiḥ syād dhanāpatyabalāyuṣām ||
yājñavalkyaḥ |
pañcamī daśamī caiva pūrṇimā ca trayodaśī |
tṛtīyā caiva yas tailaṃ naraḥ samupasevate ||
[719]        abhyaṅgāt sparśanād vāpi bhakṣaṇāc ca tathaiva ca |
caturṇāṃ tasya vṛddhiḥ syād dhanāpatyabalāyuṣām ||
yogiyājñavalkyaḥ |
daśamyāṃ tailam aspṛṣṭvā yaḥ snāyād aviṣakṣayaḥ |
catvāri tasya naśyanti āyuḥ prajñā yaśo dhanam ||
mohāt pratipadaṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ kuhūṃ riktāṃ tithiṃ tathā |
tailenābhyañjayed yas tu caturbhiḥ yaha hīyate ||
pañcadaśyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ saptamyāṃ ravisaṃkrame |
dvādaśīṃ saptamīṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ tailasparśaṃ vivarjayet ||
trayodaśyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ pratipannavamīdvaye |
tailābhyaṅgaṃ na kurvīta kuryur vā navamīṃ vinā ||
atra kāsu tithiṣu tailābhyaṅgo vihitaḥ pratiṣiddhaś ca |
tatra kecid āhur vidhiḥ pakvatailaviṣayaḥ niṣedhas tv apakvatailaviṣayaḥ |
tad uktaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśanmate |
sūryaśuklādivāreṣu niṣiddhāsu tithiṣv api |
snāne vā yadi vāsnāne pakvatailaṃ na duṣyati |
navamyāṃ tūbhayor api niṣedhaḥ "kuryur vā navamīṃ vinā" iti vacanād iti |
tad ayukaṃ niṣedhasya rāgaprāptatailābhyaṅgaviṣayatvāt vihitatailābhyaṅgaviṣayatve vikalpaprasaṅgāt | na ca vidhiśāstrāt tailamātraprāptād apakvatailarūpaviśeṣaniṣedhān na vikalpa iti vācyam | "ye yajāmaha karaṇasyāpy eṣa cai saptadaśa prajāpatir yajñe ca yajñe nyāyata" iti vākyāt sarvayajñeṣu prāptāv anuyājāder api viśeṣaniṣedhān niṣedhapakṣe vikalpābhāvaprasaṅgāt [720] tatra ca yaḥ parihāraḥ so ’trāpīty adoṣaḥ | rāgaprāptavidhiprāptobhavaviṣayatve ca niṣedhasyaikatra śāstrāntarabādhasāpekṣo niṣedhaḥ anyatra nirapeṣa iti vidhivaiṣamyaṃ prasajyate | na ca vidhivaiṣamyaparihārārtho vidhiprāptasyaiva pratiṣedha iti vācyam, śāstrāntarabādhaṃ vinā niṣedhasya saṃbhave tadbādhasyānupapatteḥ | tasmān niṣedho rāgaprāptatailaviṣayas tatra ca sarvatailaniṣedhaprāptau "sūryaśukrādivāreṣv" iti vākayena niṣedho na pakvataila iti kriyate | tasmād apakvaṃ tailaṃ vihitatailābhyaṅge upādeyam iti siddham |
bṛhaspatiḥ |
saṃkrāntyāṃ ravivāre ca ṣaṣṭhyāṃ  bhaumadine tathā |
dravyāntaragataṃ tailaṃ na duṣyati kadācana ||
atra kecid āhuḥ: kadācanety anānyasminn api niṣiddhakāle dravyāntāragatasya tailasyāduṣṭatvam ucyate anyathāsya vaiyarthyāpatter iti |
tad ayukaṃ | yadi sarvasminn api niṣiddhakāle dravyāntaragatasya tailasyāduṣṭatvaṃ vivakṣitaṃ syāt tadā uttarārdhenaiva tasiddheḥ pūrvārdhavaiyarthyaṃ prasajyate, pūrvānuvādapakṣāc ca 'kadācanety etāvanmātrānuvādatvam uktam | tasmāt saṃkrāntyādiṣu dravyāntaragatasya tailaṃ kadācid api na duṣyatīty asyārthaḥ |
ataḥ saṃkrāntyādiduṣṭaya eva dravyāntaragatasya tailasyāduṣṭatvaṃ nānyatreti siddham ity anye |
tad ayuktaṃ, sarvasmin kāle dravyāntaragatasya tailasya vacanāntareṇāduṣṭatvābhidhānāt | saṃkrāntyādigrahaṇasya vā niḥśeṣapradarśanārthatvāt saṃkrāntyādāv api na duṣyati kim utānyatreti |
tad āha pracetāḥ |
[721]        sārṣapaṃ gandhatailaṃ ca yat tailaṃ puṣpavāsitam |
anyadravyayutaṃ tailaṃ na duṣyati kadācana ||
yamaḥ |
ghṛtaṃ ca sārṣapaṃ tailaṃ yat tailaṃ puṣpavāsitam |
na doṣaḥ pakvataileṣu snānābhyaṅgeṣu nityaśaḥ ||
kātyāyanaḥ |
māṅgalyaṃ vidyate snānaṃ vṛddhiparvotsaveṣu ca |
snehamātrasamāyukaṃ madhyāhnāt praviśiṣyate ||
iti tailābhyaṅgādikālanirṇayaḥ |
atha tilatarpaṇaniṣiddhakālaḥ |
saptamyāṃ ravivāre ca gṛhe janmadine tathā |
bhṛtyaputrakalatrārthī na kuryāt tilatarpaṇam ||
kvacit tu gṛhīti pāṭhaḥ |
pakṣayor ubhayo rājan saptamyāṃ niśi sandhyayoḥ |
vidyāputrakalatrārthī tilān pañcasu varjayet ||
iti tilatarpaṇaniṣiddhakālaḥ |
atha maithunakālanirṇayaḥ |
tatra yājñavalkyaḥ |
ṣoḍaśartuniśāḥ strīṇāṃ tasmin yugmāsu saṃviśet |
brahmacāry eva parvaṇy ādyāś catasras tu varjayet ||
[722]        evaṃ gacchan striyaṃ kṣāmāṃ maghāṃ mūlaṃ ca varjayet |
sustha indau sakṛt putraṃ lakṣaṇyaṃ janayet pumān |
yathākāmī bhaved vāpi strīṇāṃ varam anusmaran ||
rajodarśanaprabhṛti 'ṣoḍaśa niśāḥ', 'strīṇāṃ', 'ṛtuḥ' garbhagrahaṇakālaḥ, tasmin 'yugmāsu' samāsu rātriṣu, 'saṃviśet' gacchet yadi putrārthī | kanyārthī tv ayugmāsu |
yad āha manuḥ |
yugmāsu putrā jāyante striyo ’yugmāsu rātriṣu |
tasmād yugmāsu putrārthī saṃviśed ārtave striyam ||
śaṅkhaḥ |
ṛtau saṃgacchataḥ puṃso yāvat ṣoḍaśamaṃ dinam |
yugmāsu putrā jāyante striyo ’yumāsu rātriṣu ||
yugmāsv api uttarottaraiva praśastā |
yad āha āpastambaḥ |
caturthīprabhṛty āṣoḍaśasu uttarām uttarāṃ yugmām |
prajāpatiḥ |
aye śamṛtugamanaṃ ity upadiśati |
vyāsaḥ |
rātrau caturthyāṃ putraḥ syād alpāyur dhanavarjitaḥ |
pañcamyāṃ putriṇī nārī ṣaṣṭhyāṃ putras tu madhyamaḥ ||
saptamyām aprajā yoṣid aṣṭamyām īśvaraḥ pumān |
navamyāṃ subhagā nārī daśamyāṃ pravaraḥ sutaḥ ||
[723]        ekādaśyām adharmā strī dvādaśyāṃ puruṣottamaḥ |
trayodaśyāṃ śaṭhā pāpā varṇasaṃkarakāriṇī |
jāyate sarvaduṣṭā strī duḥkhaśokabhayapradā ||
dharmadhvajaḥ kṛtajñaḥ syād ātmavedī dṛḍhavrataḥ |
prajāyate caturdaśyāṃ guṇādyair jagataḥ patiḥ ||
rājaputrī mahābhāgā sā rājavaśagātha vā |
jāyate pañcadaśāṃ tu bahuputrā pativratā ||
vidyālakṣaṇasaṃpūrṇaḥ satyavādī jitendriyaḥ |
āśrayaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ ṣoḍaśyāṃ jāyate pumān ||
niśāgrahaṇād divasaniṣedhaḥ |

yamaḥ |
nāmadheyaṃ daśamyāṃ tu dvādaśyāṃ nāma kārayet |
puṇye tithau muhūrtte vā nakṣatre vā guṇānvite || iti |
atra ca pituḥ kathaṃcin nāmakaraṇāyogyatve 'kārayed' iti vidhīyate |
ata eva śaṅkhaḥ |
kuladevatānakṣatrābhiyasambaddhaṃ pitā kuryād anyo vā
kulavṛddha iti |
pituḥ kathaṃcid ayogyatve abhāve vā kulavṛddhaḥ kuryāt, na tu yogyasya sadbhāve prāgdarśitaviṣṇuvacanavirodhaprasaṅgāt |
atra kecit 'kārayet' kuryād iti vyācakṣate |
tad ayuktaṃ lakṣaṇāyāṃ kāraṇābhāvāt | 'piteva kuryād' iti vacanavirodhasyāpi paripūritatvāt, lakṣaṇātaś ca saṃkocasya yuktatvāt |
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
nāmadheyaṃ daśamyāṃ tu kecid icchanti pārthiva |
dāśamyāṃ pararātrau vā māse pūrṇe tathāpare |
āhur daśāhani tathā vadanty eke manīṣiṇaḥ ||
gṛhyapariśiṣṭe |
jananād daśarātre vyuṣṭe śatarātre saṃvatsare vā nāmakaraṇam |
[739]        atra ca svagṛhyānusāreṇa vyavasthā, yeṣāṃ tu tatra kālaviśeyo noktas teṣāṃ vikalpa eva | tatra tatra pūrvakālāsambhave ’py uttarottaro grāhyaḥ |
jyotiḥśāstre |
mṛdudhruvacarakṣiprabheṣv eṣām udaye ’pi vā |
gurau vā śukre 'tha vā kendre jātakarma ca nāma ca ||
mṛdvādīni nakṣatrāṇi jātakarmakāle pradarśitāni | kendraśabdārthaḥ prāsādādyārambhakāle darśitaḥ |
iti nāmakaraṇakālaḥ |
atha niṣkramaṇakālaḥ|
tatra vārāhapurāṇe |
dvādaśe ’hani kartavyaṃ śiśor niṣkramaṇaṃ gṛhāt |
śaṅkha-likhitau |
ata ūrdhvaṃ tṛtīye māsi niṣkramaṇikā |
yājñavalkya-bṛhaspatī |
māse caturthe kartavyaṃ śiśor niṣkramaṇaṃ gṛhāt |
tatra kiṃ kāryam ity ākāṅkṣāyām āha laugākṣiḥ |
tṛtīye tv ardhamāse darśanam ādityasya |
yamaḥ |
tatas tṛtīye kartavyaṃ māsi sūryasya darśanam |
viṣṇuḥ |
[740]        caturthī māsy ādityasya darśanam |
śaṅkhaḥ |
caturthe māsi kartavyaṃ bālasyādityadarśanam |
yamaḥ |
caturthe māsi kartavyaṃ śiśoś candrasya darśanam |
atrāpi svagṛhyānusāreṇa vyavasthā | yeṣāṃ tu gṛhye kālaviśeṣo na śrūyate taiḥ sarve ete kālā vikalpenopādeyāḥ | tatrāpi pūrvakālāsambhave saty uttarakālagrahaṇam |
iti niṣkramaṇakālaḥ |
athānnaprāśanakālaḥ |
tatra viṣṇu-soma-śaṅkha-bṛhaspati-yājñavalkyāḥ |
ṣaṣṭhe ’nnaprāśanaṃ māsi yad veṣṭaṃ maṅgalaṃ kule |
yamaḥ |
tato ’nnaprāśanaṃ māsi ṣaṣṭhe kāryaṃ yathāvidhi |
aṣṭame vātha kartavyaṃ yad veṣṭaṃ maṅgalaṃ kule |
laugākṣiḥ |
ṣaṣṭhe māse ’nnaprāśanaṃ jāteṣu danteṣu vā pūrṇe vā saṃvatsare prāśanam ardhasaṃvatsara ity eke |
atrāpi nāmakaraṇavat svagṛhyānusāreṇa vyavasthā veditavyā |
ity annaprāśanakālāḥ |
[741]
atha karṇavedhakālaḥ |
jyotiḥśāstre |
kārttike pauṣamāse vā caitre phālgunake ’pi vā |
karṇavedhaṃ praśaṃsanti śuklapakṣe śubhe dine ||
puṃnakṣatre śubhe candre sukhe śīrṣodaye ’pi vā |
dinacchidravyatīpātaviṣṭivaidhṛtivarjite |
śiśor ajātadantasya mātur utsaṅgasarpiṇaḥ |
sauciko vedhayet karṇau sūcyā dviguṇasūtrayā || iti |
hastāśvinīsvātipunarvasau ca
tiṣyenducitrāharirevatauṣu |
candre ’nukūle guruśukravāre
karṇau tu vedhyāv amareḍyalagne ||
'amareḍyaḥ' bṛhaspatiḥ |
tathā |
puṣye 'nurādhā śravaṇe ca maitre
pauṣṇād itau tv ābdasavāsavārke |
śuṣyanti vedhād virujo bhavanti
no pīḍyate jātu śiśuḥ kadācit ||
śuṣyaty arkadine drutaṃ śaśabhṛti syād ārdratā karṇayoḥ
saure bandhuvibhinnatā śravaṇayoḥ ṣaṣṭhe sute truṭyati |
iti karṇavedhakālaḥ ||
atha cūḍākarmakālaḥ |
tatra somaḥ |
saṃvatsare cūḍākaraṇam |
viṣṇuḥ |
tṛtīye 'bde cūḍākaraṇam |
laugākṣiḥ |
tṛtīyavarṣasya bhūyiṣṭhe gate cūḍāṃ kārayet |
bṛhaspatiḥ |
cūḍākarma trivārṣike |
vaijavāpaḥ |
trivarṣe cūḍākaraṇam |
pāraskaraḥ |
saṃvatsarasya cūḍākaraṇaṃ tṛtīye vāpratihate |
manuḥ |
cūḍākarma dvijātīnāṃ sarveṣām eva dharmataḥ |
prathame ’bde tṛtīye vā kartavyaṃ śruticodanāt ||
sāṅkhyāyaṇagṛhye |
saṃvatsare cūḍākarma tṛtīye vā varṣe |
yamaḥ |
tataḥ saṃvatsare vṛtte cūḍākarma vidhīyate |
dvitīye vā tṛtīye vā kartavyaṃ śruticodanāt ||
śaṅkha-likhitau |
[743]        tṛtīye varṣe cūḍākarma pañcame ’pi vā |
śaṅkha-yājñavalkyau |
cūḍākarma yathākulam |
āśvalāyanagṛhye |
tṛtīye varṣe caulaṃ yathākuladharmaṃ vā |
laugākṣiḥ |
śuddhapakṣasya puṇyāhe parvaṇi vā cūḍākaraṇam |
vaijavāpagṛhye |
udagayane āpūryamāṇapakṣe puṇyāhe cūḍākarma |
āśvalāyanagṛhye |
udagayane āpūryamāṇapakṣe kalyāṇe nakṣatre cūḍākarma |
āpastambaḥ |
janmāvadhi tṛtīye varṣe caulaṃ punarvasāv iti |
vyāsaḥ |
āśvinaṃ śravaṇaṃ svātī citrā puṣyapunarvasū |
dhaniṣṭhārevatījyeṣṭhāmṛgahasteṣu kārayet |
vāranakṣatrayogeṣu śubheṣu karaṇeṣu ca ||
hastatrayaṃ mṛgaśiraḥ śravaṇatrayaṃ ca
puṣyāśvinīsvaśubhabhāṇi punarvasau ca |
kṣaure tu karmaṇi hitāmbudayakṣaṇe ca
yuktāni coḍupatinā yadi śastatārā ||
viṣayaviśeṣaḥ sarve nakṣatre śeṣaḥ |
[744]        tathā ca jyotiḥśāstre |
nṛpājñayā brāhmaṇasaṃmate ca
bandhasya mokṣe kratudīkṣaṇe ca |
vivāhakāle mṛtasūtake ca
sarveṣu śastaṃ kṣurakarma teṣu ||
'teṣu' nakṣatreṣu |
iti cūḍākaraṇakālaḥ
atha cūḍākarmaniṣiddhakālaḥ |
vyāsaḥ |
nakṣatre na tu kurvīta yasmin jāto bhaven naraḥ |
na proṣṭhapadayoḥ kāryaṃ naivāgneyeṣu bhārata |
dāruṇeṣu ca sarveṣu duṣṭatāraṃ tu varjayet ||
vāraṃ śanaiścarādityabhaumānāṃ rātrim eva ca |
tithiṃ pratipadaṃ riktāṃ viṣṭiṃ caiva vivarjayet ||
iti cūḍākarmaniṣiddhakālaḥ |
atha vidyārambhakālaḥ|
tatra mārkaṇḍeyaḥ |
prāpte va pañcame varṣe aprasupte janārdane |
ṣaṣṭhīṃ pratipadaṃ caiva varjayitvā tathāṣṭamīm|
[745]        riktāṃ pañcadaśīṃ caiva sauribhaumadinaṃ tathā |
evaṃ suniścite kāle vidyārambhaṃ tu kārayet ||
pūjavitvā hariṃ lakṣmīṃ devīṃ cāpi sarasvatīm |
svavidyāsūtrakārāṃś ca svāṃ vidyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ||
tataḥ prabhṛty anadhyāyān varjanīyān vivarjayet |
aṣṭamīdvitayaṃ caiva pakṣānte ca dinatrayam ||
aśauca indrayātrāyāṃ bhūkampe rājadarśane |
vyatīte cāpy ahorātram ulkāpāte tathaiva ca || iti |
iti vidyārambhakālaḥ |
athopanayanakālaḥ |
atra laugākṣiḥ |
saptame varṣe brāhmaṇasyopanayanaṃ, navame
rājanyasyaikādaśe vaiśyasya |
baudhāyanaḥ |
garbhādisaṃkhyā varṣāṇāṃ tadaṣṭameṣu brāhmaṇam upanayet, tadadhikeṣu rājanyaṃ tasmād adhikeṣu ca vaiśyam |
śaṅkha-likhitau |
garbhāṣṭame brāhmaṇam upanayet rājanyam ekādaśe dvādaśe vaiśyam |
paiṭhīnasiḥ |
garbhapañcame brāhmaṇam upanayet garbhāṣṭame vā, garbhaikādaśe rājanyaṃ garbhadvādaśe vaiṣyāṃ garbhaṣoḍaśe vā |
devalaḥ | [746]
prathamaṃ mātāpitṛbhyāṃ garbhādhānādibhiḥ saṃskṛto garbhāṣṭame varṣe upanayanārho bhavati |
manu-śaṅkhau |
garbhāṣṭameṣu kurvanti brāhmaṇasyopanāyanam |
ekādaśe kṣatriyasya vaiśyasya dvādaśe smṛtam ||
viṣṇuḥ |
garbhāṣṭamābde kurvīta brāhmaṇasyopanāyanam |
garbhasyaikādaśe rājño garbhasya dvādaśe viśaḥ ||
viśvāmitra-yājñavalkyau |
garbhāṣṭame ’ṣṭame vābde brāhmaṇasyopanāyanam |
rājñām ekādaśe saike viśām eke yathākulam ||
upanayanaṃ brāhmaṇasya garbhagrahaṇād ārabhya janmato bāṣṭame varṣe kāryam, ekena saha varttate iti saikaṃ tasminn ekādaśe dvādaśa ityarthaḥ |
eke tv ācāryā manyante, yathākulaṃ upanayanaṃ kāryam ity arthaḥ |
anye tv evaṃ vyācakṣate, kulasthityā garbhāṣṭamādivyavastāṃ kecin manyante |
atra kecid upanāyanaśabdenehopanayanam abhidhīyata ity āhuḥ |
tad ayuktaṃ, upanayanaviṣayaprayoakavyāpārasyopanāyanaśabdavācyatvāt lakṣaṇāyāṃ ca kāraṇābhāvāt |
ata evāha budhaḥ |
garbhāṣṭame varṣe vasante brāhmaṇo ātmānam upanāyayeta | ekādaśe kṣatriyo grīṣme dvādaśe vaiśyo varṣāsu | tasmād upanāyanād upanayanam api vidhīyate |
bṛhaspatiḥ |
[747]        garbhāṣṭame ’bde viprasya kṣatrasyaikādaśe tathā |
vaiśyasya dvādaśe varṣe kāryaṃ mauñjīnibandhanam ||
upanayanaṃ prakṛtya śaṅkha-likhitau ||
dvijātīnāṃ vasanto grīṣmaḥ śarad iti kālaḥ |
vasanto grīśmaḥ śarad iti ṛtavo varṇānupūrvyeṇa |
āpastambaḥ |
vasante brāhmaṇam upanayet grīṣme rājanyaṃ śaradi vaiśyaṃ |
tathā māghādayaḥ pañca māsā upanayane grāhyāḥ |
tathā ca jyotiḥśāstre |
māghādiṣu tu māseṣu mauñjī pañcasu śasyate |
etac ca varṇatrayasādhāraṇaṃ, tan na yuktaṃ | tatraiva |
ṛtur vasantaḥ śubhado ’grajānāṃ
grīṣmo nṛpāṇāṃ ca śarad viśāṃ ca |
vratasya bandhe yadivākhilānāṃ
māghādayaḥ pañca bhavanti māsāḥ ||
etac ca sarvavarṇeṣu ṛtuviṣayam |
yata uktaṃ ratnakośe |
yadi māsaviśeṣeṇa sarvajyeṣṭhasya putraka |
upanītasya viprasya jaḍatvaṃ mṛtyur eva ca ||
yajuḥśākhināṃ sarvata evopanayanaṃ punar vasantagrahaṇaṃ niyamārthatvād ity uktam |
dharmabhāṣye |
[748]        caitre vaiśākhe vasante ca |
tathā ca śrutiḥ |
madhuś ca mādhavaś ca vāsantikāv ṛtū yadā mīnameṣayor
vasantaḥ |
tathā ca jyotiḥśāstre |
mṛgādirāśidvayabhānubhogāt
ṣaḍartavaḥ syuḥ śiśiro vasantaḥ |
grīśmaś ca varṣā ca śarac ca tadvat
hemantanāmnā kathito ’tra ṣaṣṭhaḥ ||
'mṛgaḥ' makaraḥ |
baudhāyanaḥ |
mīnameṣayor meṣavṛṣabhayor vā vasantaḥ |
kāmyopanayanakālam āha gautamaḥ |
navame pañcame vā kāmyaṃ garbhādi saṅkhyā varṣāṇām |
etac ca brāhmaṇaviṣayam |
yad āha aṅgirāḥ |
brahmavarcasakāmasya pañcame ’bde ’grajanmanaḥ |
āyuḥkāmasya navame kāryaṃ mauñjīnibandhanaṃ ||
manuḥ |
brahmavarcasakāmasya kāryaṃ viprasya pañcame |
kṣatriyavaiśyayos tu kāmyopanayanakālam āha aṅgirāḥ |
ṣaṣṭhe tathā dvādaśe ca rājño vṛddhibalāyuṣoḥ |
īhāyuṣos tu vaiśyasya aṣṭame ca caturdaśe ||
[749]        'īhā' kṛṣyādiviṣayaceṣṭā | atra pūrvārddhena krama ādaraṇīyaḥ |
tathā ca manuḥ |
rājño balārthinaḥ ṣaṣṭe vaiśyasyehārthino ’ṣṭame |
āpastambaḥ |
atha kāmyāḥ, saptame brahmavarcasakāmaṃ, aṣṭame āyuḥkāmaṃ, navame tejaḥkāmaṃ, daśame annādyakāmaṃ, ekādaśe indriyakāmaṃ, dvādaśe paśukāmaṃ |
etac ca varṇatrayasādhāradaṃ tadupanayanānantaram asya vidhānād ity uktaṃ tadbhāṣye |
tad ayukaṃ | brahmavarcasakāmasyetyādipūrvapradarśitamanvaṅgirasor vacanavirodhāt | tasmāt atrādyavidhidvayam abrāhmaṇayaviṣayam uttaraṃ tu vidhicatuṣṭayaṃ bādhakābhāvād varṇatrayasādhāraṇam iti draṣṭayam |
jyotiḥśāstre |
hastatraye puṣyadhaniṣṭhayoś ca
pauṣṇāśvisaumyāditiviṣṇubheṣu |
śaste tithau candrabalena yukte
kāryau dvijānāṃ vratabandhamokṣau ||
gurur bhṛgusuto bhūmiputraḥ śaśadharātmajaḥ |
syur ete ṛgyajuḥsāmātharvaṇām adhipāḥ kramāt ||
śākhādhipe balini kendragate tu mauñjī-
bandhas tadīyadivase ’tha sukhāptaye ca |
asmin balena rahite tu punar dvijānāṃ
syād varṇasaṃkara iti pravadanti sajñāḥ ||
kendraśabdo vyākhyātaḥ prāsādāsyārambhakālanirūpaṇe |
[750]        hastatraye śubhatithau vratabandharāśibalena syād dvijānāṃ mauñjībandhaḥ smarabhavedamaś ca kriyāhīnaḥ |
bhavekrūrair jaḍaiḥ pāpaḥ pāṇḍuyakṣmāmayānvitaḥ |
mūrkhaḥ śukrādibhogeṣu krameṇodayavarttiṣu ||
ṣaṭkarmakṛt pravaradhīḥ surarājyapujyaḥ
syād dīkṣito bhṛgusute ’tisukhī dhanī ca |
adhyāpakaḥ śiśisute ravije ’ntyasevī
rājopajīvyahimarociṣi karkaṭasthe ||
śastrāstrajīvī nipuṇo vaiśyāvṛttis tu jāyate |
kaṇṭakathāyini kṣoṇīnandane vratabandhane ||
gurau kendre gate śukre navapañcamavarttini |
candraśukrāṃśage sarve sarvavedī bhaven naraḥ ||
svaptāṃśage kṛtaghno viṣayāt sākṣādbhave gurudrohī |
vidyārthī śīlasaṃyuktaḥ ṣaṣṭhe’ṣṭamage vyasuḥ śaśini ||
jīve sārke nirguṇo vittahīnaḥ
krūraḥ sauraiś cāntyagaś cāpi saumyaḥ |
bhānoḥ putre nābhāsaḥ syāc
chukrenduḥ saumyavat sarvadā me ||
ratnakośe |
[751]        naṣṭe candre ’stage śukre niraṃśe caiva bhāskare |
kartavyaṃ copanayanaṃ nānadhyāye galagrahe |
rāśeḥ prathamabhāgasthitaḥ sūryaḥ 'niraṃśaḥ' |
trayodaśīcatuṣkaṃ ca saptamyāditrayaṃ tathā |
caturthe kākinī proktā aṣṭāv ete galagrahāḥ ||
ity upanayanavihitaniṣedhakālau |
athopanayanagauṇakālāḥ |
tatra manuḥ |
ā ṣoḍaśād brāhmaṇasya sāvitrī nātivarttate |
ā dvāviṃśāt kṣatrabandhor ā caturviṃśater viśaḥ ||
āṅ ayam abhividhau |
āha vyāsaḥ |
aupanāyanikaḥ kālaḥ paraḥ ṣoḍaśavarṣikaḥ |
dvāviṃśatiparo ’nyaḥ svāc caturviṃśatimaḥ paraḥ ||
avantimihiro ’pi |
chandaḥsu padākṣaravad atha samudāya upanayanam | brāhmaṇasya gāyatryopanayanaṃ tasyāś caikasmin pāde ’ṣṭākṣarāṇi evaṃ ca samudāye ṣoḍaśe varṣe pūrṇe upanayanam | etac cābhividhau upapadyate |
asyāpy atikrame pātityaṃ yat tad āha yamaḥ |
sāvitrīpatitā vrātyāḥ parihāryāḥ prayatnataḥ |
[752]        yājñavalkyaḥ |
ā ṣoḍaśād dvāviṃśāc caturviṃśāc ca vatsarāt |
brahmakṣatraviśāṃ kāla upanāyanikaḥ paraḥ ||
ata ūrdhvaṃ patanty ete sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtāḥ |
sāvitrīpatitā vrātyā vrātyastomād ṛtāḥ kramāt ||
śaṅkha-likhitau |
ā ṣoḍaśād brāhmaṇasyānatītaḥ kālo bhavati ā dvāviṃśād rājanyasya ā caturviṃśād vaiśyasyāto niṣkrāntakālāḥ patantīti śrutiḥ | pūrvapūrvottarakālātikrameṣu patitā bhavanti vrātyāḥ |
śaṅkhaḥ |
ṣoḍaśābdāni viprasya rājanyasya dviviṃśatiḥ |
viṃśatiḥ sacatuṣṭvā ca vaiśyasya parikīrttitā |
nātivarteta sāvitrī ata ūrdhvaṃ nivarttate ||
vijñātavyās trayo ’py ete yathākālam asaṃskṛtāḥ |
sāvitrīpatitā vrātyāḥ sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtāḥ ||
gautamaḥ |
ā śoḍaśād brāhmaṇasya nātyayaḥ ā dvāviṃśāt kṣatriyasya
ā caturviṃśāc ca vaiśyasya |
baudhāyanaḥ |
ā ṣoḍaśād dvāviṃśāc caturviṃśād anatyayaḥ |
paiṭhīnasiḥ |
dāviṃśaṣoḍaśacaturviṃśatiś cety atītā viruddhakālā bhavanti |
[753]        brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ bhedakālo vyākhyātaḥ |
yamaḥ |
ā ṣoḍaśāt tathā varṣād brāhmaṇasyākṛtātmanaḥ |
sāvitrī nātivarteta ata ūrdhvaṃ nivartate ||
ā dvāviṃśāt kṣatriyasya triṣṭupcchando nivartate |
ata ūrdhvaṃ trayo ’py ete yathākālam asaṃskṛtāḥ |
sāvitrīpatitā vrātyā bhavanty āryavigarhitāḥ ||
ity upanayanagauṇakālaḥ |
athānadhyāyanirṇayaḥ |
tatrānadhyāyādhyayane doṣam āha likhitaḥ |
chidrāṇy etāni viprāṇāṃ ye ’nadhyāyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ |
chidrebhyaḥ sravati brahma brāhmaṇena yad arjitam ||
tatkāle tasya rakṣāṃsi śriyaṃ brahma yaśo balam |
sarvam ādāya gacchanti varjayantīpsitaṃ phalam ||
śaṅkhaḥ |
chidreṣv evāvatiṣṭhanti ye kecit puruṣādayaḥ |
tatrasthā ghnanti tad brahma brāhmaṇasyālpamedhasaḥ ||
tatkāle tasya rakṣāṃsi śriyaṃ brahma yaśo balaṃ |
sarvam ādāya gacchanti ye ’nadhyāyeṣv adhīyate ||
hārītaḥ |
chidrāṇy etāni viprāṇāṃ ye ’nadhyāyāḥ prakīrttitāḥ |
[754]        hiṃsanti rākṣasās teṣu tasmād etāni varjayet ||
viṣṇuḥ |
yasmād anadhyāyād adhītavedamātraṃ na phalapradaṃ tathānadhyāye ’dhyayanenāyuṣaḥ parikṣayo guruśiṣyayoś ca tasmād anadhyāyān varjayet |
indra-nāradasaṃvāde |
anadhyāyeṣv adhīyānān śakra kiṃ na haniṣyasi |
asurās te durātmāno brahmaghnā brahmadūṣakāḥ ||
anadhyāyeṣv adhīyante na te yānti svavaidikam |
mṛtāḥ svargaṃ na gacchanti kiṃ nārada na te hatāḥ ||
yamaḥ |
chidrāṇy āhur dvijātīnāṃ anadhyāyān manīṣiṇaḥ |
chidrebhyaḥ sravati brahma brāhmaṇena yad arjitam ||
āyuḥ prajāṃ paśūn medhāṃ kṛtam ity akṛtaṃ ca tat |
anadhyāyeṣv abhyasatā tena brahma hataṃ tathā ||
tathā |
anadhyāyeṣv adhyayane prajñām āyuḥ prajāṃ striyaḥ |
brahma vīryaṃ śriyaṃ tejo nikṛntati yamaḥ svayam ||
mantravīryakṣayabhayād indro vajreṇa hanti ca |
brahmarākṣasatāṃ yāti naratvaṃ na punar bhavet ||
āyur asya nikṛntāmi prajāṃ medhāṃ harāmy aham |
ya ucchiṣṭāḥ pravadanti svādhyāyān vāpy adhīyate ||
aṣṭamī hanty upādhyāyaṃ śiṣyaṃ hanti caturdaśī |
[755]        hanti pañcadaśī medhāṃ tasmāt parvāṇi varjayet ||
prajāpatau hi tiṣṭhanti sarvā vidyāḥ suparvasu |
tasmād dharmārthakāmo vā naitāḥ parvasu kīrttayet ||
manuḥ |
amāvāsyā guruṃ hanti śiṣyaṃ hanti caturdaśī |
brahmāṣṭamīpaurṇamāsyau tasmāt tāḥ parivarjayet ||
gautamaḥ |
amāvāsyāyāṃ cāhorātraṃ dvyahaṃ vā yadā dve amāmāsye tadā
dvyaham anādhyāyaḥ |
hārītaḥ |
pratipatsu caturdaśyām aṣṭamyāṃ parvaṇor dvayoḥ |
anadhyāye ’tha sarvaryāṃ nādhīyīta kathaṃcana ||
smṛtyantare ca |
śvo ’nadhyāye saty atha rātrāv anadhyāyaḥ ekānadhyāyayugmeṣu tv apararātre nānadhyāyaḥ anadhyāyayugmāt pūrvadināt pararātre cety eke |
pāraskaraḥ |
vāte amāvāsyāyām iti |
sarvānadhyāye dyuniśam ity anuvṛttau yājñavalkyaḥ |
pañcadaśyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ aṣṭamyāṃ rāhusutake |
ṛtusaṃdhiṣu bhuktvā vā śrāddhikaṃ pratigṛhya vā ||
'rāhusūtake' candrasūryoparāge |
atra ca trirātrākālikāhorātrāṇāṃ vikalpaḥ |
[756]        manuḥ |
pratigṛhya dvijo vidvān ekoddiṣṭasya ketanam |
tryahaṃ na kīrttayed brahma rāhor anyatra sūtake ||
yāvad ekoddiṣṭasandhau gandho lepaṃ ca tiṣṭhati |
viprasya viduṣo dehe tāvad brahma na kīrttayet ||
dhūpacandanagandhādi yāvat tiṣṭhati tāvad anadhyāyaḥ | 'ketanaṃ' nimantraṇaṃ, ekam uddiśya ekoddiṣṭam |
śaṅkhaḥ |
upādhyāye rājani ca śrotriye ca mṛte sabrahmacāriṇi candrārkayoḥ rāhudarśane śakradhvajaprapatane ācārye ca mṛte trirātram |
gautamaḥ |
akālikanirghātabhūkamparāhudarśanolkāpāteṣu ṛtusandhiṣu grastāstamite tryaham anadhyāyam āhuḥ |
'ṛtusandhiṣu' ṛtūnāṃ vasantādīnāṃ sandhiṣu pratipatsu |
tathā ca rāmāyaṇe rāmaṃ prati hanumadvākyam |
sā svabhāvena tanvaṅgī tvadviyogāc ca karṣitā |
pratipatpāṭhaśīlasya vidyeva tanutāṅgatā ||
ślokagautamaḥ |
pradoṣe ca trayodaśyāṃ nādhyeyaṃ pratipatsu ca |
amāvāsyāṣṭakāyuṣye (?) sandhyayor ubhayor api |
amāvāsyāpratipadi kṣipraṃ vidyā praṇaśyati ||
[757]        abdayoḥ sandhiḥ ‘ābdikaṃ’, tadbhaktaṃ pratigṛhya dyuniśam anadhyāya ity arthaḥ |
tathā ca vaśiṣṭhaḥ |
phalāny āpas tilā bhakṣyā yac cānyacchrāddhikaṃ bhavet |
pratigṛhyāpy anadhyāyaḥ pāṇyāsyāḥ brāhmaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
etac caikoddiṣṭavyatiriktaviṣayaṃ tatra pūrvodāhṛatamanuvacanena trirātravidhānāt |
gautamaḥ |
śrāddhinām akālikaṃ bhoktṝṇaṃ pratigrahītṝṇāṃ ca akṛtānnaśrāddhayoge ca tataś cākālikāhorātrayor vikalpaḥ |
smṛtyantare |
navaśrāddhabhuktau tu annajaraṇaparyantam |
manuḥ |
prāṇi vā yadi vāprāṇi yat kiṃcic chrāddhikaṃ bhavet |
tadālabhyāpy anadhyāyaḥ pāṇyāsyāḥ hi divjāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
sātātapaḥ |
pañcadaśyāṃ caturdaśyām aṣṭakāsu mahotsave |
pradoṣe ca trayodaśyām aṣṭamyāṃ pratipady api ||
purāṇāt |
medhākāmas trayodaśyāṃ caturthyāṃ caiva sarvadā |
saptamyāṃ tu pradoṣe tu na smaren nāpi kīrttayet ||
[758]        prajāpatiḥ |
ṣaṣṭhī ca dvādaśī caiva ardharātronanāḍikāḥ |
pradoṣe na tv adhīyīta tṛtīyā navanāḍikāḥ ||
ardharātraghaṭikāyāṃ nety arthaḥ | navanāḍikā niśāyām iti jñeyam | 'pradoṣe' niśāprathamaprahare |
gautamaḥ |
niśāyāṃ caturmuhūrttam |
etac ca trayodaśīviṣayam |
tathā ca uśanāḥ |
trayodaśyāṃ prathamāṃś caturyamān nādhīyīteti |
dakṣaḥ |
pradoṣapaścimau yāmau vedābhyāsarato nayet |
yāmadvayaṃ śayānas tu brahmabhūyāya kalpyate |
āpastambaḥ |
śrāvaṇyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ adhyāyam upākṛtya māsaṃ pradoṣe nādhīyīteti |
udaye ’stamaye vāpi muhūrttatrayagāmi yat |
bheditaṃ tad ahorātram anadhyāyavido viduḥ || iti |
sāmyaviṣayam etat |
dināntaikamuhūrttaṃ vā yā tithiḥ kṣayagāminī |
trimuhūrttādhikā hy eṣā yā tithir vṛddhigāminī |
nakṣatraṃ tithivad grāhyaṃ viparītam athodaye ||
iti vacanāt |
[759]        kecid āhuḥ kvacid deśe yāvad bheditanāḍikāḥ |
tāvad eva tv anadhyāyo na tan miśradināntare ||
upavāsavratādīnāṃ tithīn āhus tathaiva te |
caturthyāṃ pūrvarātreṣu navanāḍiṣu darśane ||
nādhyeyaṃ pūrvarātre syāt saptamī ca trayodaśī |
ardharātrāt paraṃ syāc ced adhyeyaṃ pūrvarātrake ||
nādhīyītety anuvṛttau śaṅkhaḥ |
aṣṭamyāṃ pradoṣa iti |
paiṭhīnasiḥ |
śuklacaturdaśyāṃ sarvāsu cāṣṭamīṣu naktam anadhyāyo ’ṣṭakāvarjam |
purāṇāt |
mahānavamī dvādaśī ca māghamāsasya saptamī |
prapaṭhan taṃ tathā kṛṣṇa dhruvaṃ vidyā vināśayet ||
nṛsiṃhapurāṇāt |
mahānavamyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ bharaṇyām api caivaṃ hi |
tathākṣayatṛtīyāyāṃ śiṣyaṃ nādhyāpayed budhaḥ |
māghamāse tu saptamyāṃ rathākhyāyāṃ tu varjayet ||
'mahānavamī' aśvayukśuklapakṣasya | 'mahādvādaśī' kārttikaśuklapakṣasya |
smṛtyantare |
bhādrapade maghābharaṇyor anadhyāyaḥ saśravaṇayor ekādaśīdvādaśyoś ca āṣāḍhīkārttikīphālgunīsamīpasthadvitīyāsu ca aparapakṣānte tathā dvitīyāyāṃ ca |
[760]        nādhīyītety anvṛttau gautamaḥ |
kārttikī phālguny āṣāḍhī paurṇamāsī |
prabhṛtitrirātram ity arthaḥ | aṣṭakāśabdenāṣṭakākarmāṅgabhūtasaptamyāditrirātram upalakṣyate |
atrāṣṭakāṃ maghāntām evānadhyāyanimittām evāhuḥ |
paiṭhīnasiḥ |
prauṣṭhaprabhṛtayaḥ kṛṣṇe bhavās tisro ’ṣṭakā mārgaśiraḥprabhṛtaya ity eke |
śaunakas tu |
hemantaśiśirayoś caturṇām aparapakṣāṇām aṣṭamīṣv aṣṭakā | ity āha |
manuḥ |
aṣṭakāsu tv ahorātram ṛtvantāsu ca rātriṣu |
nāradīye |
ayane viṣuve caiva śayane bodhane hareḥ |
anadhyāyas tu karttavyo manvādiṣu yugādiṣu ||
manvādayo yugādayaś ca tannirṇaye darśitāḥ |
niśādvayaṃ divā rātrau saṃkrame divasadvayam |
anadhyāyaṃ prakurvīta yāvat sopapadā tithiḥ ||
tathā |
sitā jyeṣṭhe dvitīyā tu āśvine daśamī sitā |
caturthī dvādaśī māghe etāḥ sopapadāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
tryaham ity anuvṛttau yājñavalkyaḥ |
[761]        upākarmaṇi cotsarge svaśākhāśrotriye mṛte | iti |
smṛtyantare |
vedasamāpane prathamasandhyāsu tadahorātraṃ paredyur anadhyāyaḥ, dvitīyādisandhyāsu tu dyuniśaṃ kāṇḍopakramaṇe vāmātṛakasya kāṇḍasamāpane vāpitṛkasya manuṣyaprakṛtīnāṃ ca devānāṃ yajur bhuktety ekaparyuṣitais taṇḍulair āsamāsena vānadhyāyena, tathauṣadhivanaspatimūlaphalair yas kāṇḍam upāyaṃ kurvīta yasya vānuvākyaṃ kurvīta na tad ahar adhīyītopākaraṇasamāpanayoś ca |
manuḥ |
yathāśāstraṃ tu kṛtvaivam utsargaṃ chandasāṃ bahiḥ |
viramet pakṣiṇīṃ rātriṃ yad vāpy ekam aharniśam |
upākarmaṇi cotsarge trirātraṃ kṣapaṇaṃ smṛtam || iti ||
ubhayatodivasā rātriḥ pakṣiṇī, eteṣāṃ pakṣāṇāṃ svagṛhyānusāreṇa vyavasthā |
manuḥ |
vidyutstanitavarṣeṣu mahoṣṇānāṃ ca saṃplave |
ākālikam anadhyāyam eteṣu manur abravīt ||
eteṣu vidyudādiṣu pratyekam ākāmikaṃ nimittakālād ārabhya aparedyur yāvat sa eva kālas tāvad anadhyāya ity arthaḥ | atra vidyudāditraye varṣābhyo ’nyatra sandhyākāle ’nadhyāyaḥ |
yad āha sa eva |
etān abhyuditān vindyāt yadā prāduṣkṛtāgniṣu |
tadā vindyād anadhyāyaṃ anṛtau cābhradarśane ||
[762]        'prāduṣkaraṇaṃ' viharaṇaṃ, tena na sandhyākālalakṣaṇā |
ākālikety anuvṛttau gautamaḥ |
stanayitnuvarṣavidyutaś ca prāduṣkṛtāgniṣu ulkāyāṃ ca
sarvadākālika evānadhyāyaḥ |
yad āha āpastambaḥ |
ulkāyām agnyutpāte ca sarvāsāṃ vidyānām ākālikaḥ |
manuḥ |
caurair upadrute grāme saṃtrāse cāgnikārite |
ākālikam anadhyāyaṃ vindyāt sarvādbhuteṣu ca ||
'adbhuteṣu' rudhiravarṣeṣu |
yathāha vaśiṣṭhaḥ |
dikparvatānāṃ dāhāsvedabhaṅgaprapāteṣūpalarudhirapāṃśuvarṣeṣv
ākālikaṃ |
etat prabalapāṃśuviṣayam | yājñavalkyavacanaṃ tātkālikānadhyāyapratipādakam alpapaṃśuviṣayam |
smṛtyantare |
agnyutpāte cākālavṛṣṭau cākāliko ’nadhyāyaḥ |
śaṅkhaḥ |
nirghātabhūmivegolkāpātadigdāhapāṃśuśoṇitamāṃsāsthikasadadhilājagauravarṣeṣu svastyayanaṃ kṛtvābhyañjanākruṣṭavāntaśramaduḥsvapnadarśaneṣv ekoddiṣṭasūtakamṛtakeṣv ādyaṃ prāyaścittaṃ kṛtvā brāhmagamaneṣṭyādīni datvānujñāpyādhīyīran |
vidyudāditrayayaugapadye tu tryaham anadhyāyaḥ |
[763]        tathā ca trirātram ity anuvṛttau gautamaḥ |
varṣavidyutstanayitnusaṃnipāte | iti |
etad varṣākālād anyatra | yad āha āpastambaḥ |
vidyutstanayitnuvṛṣṭiṣv apartau yatra saṃnipāteṣu tryaham anadhyāyaḥ yāvad bhūmir vyudakety eke, ekena dvābhyāṃ caiteṣām ākālam |
atra bharadvājo ’pi |
agnyutpāte pāṃśuvarṣe grāme ’nadhyayanaṃ bhavet |
ākāmikaṃ trirātraṃ tu savidyutstanayitnuke ||
paiṭhīnasiḥ |
ekādaśāhaṃ bhuktvā rātrāv indradhanur dṛṣṭvā vajrapatanād ācāryamaraṇāt sūryācandramasor upaplavāt ketudarśananirghātabhūmicalanodakeṣv ekasmin trirātram | śrotriyamaraṇe sandhyāstamite karakāpatane nīlalohitaprādurbhāve ca |
yadā tu varṣāsv eva sandhyāyāṃ vidyutstanitaṃ ca tadā sajyotir anadhyāyaḥ |
tathā ca manuḥ |
prāduṣkṛteṣv agniṣu tu vidyutstanitanisvane |
sajyotiḥ syād anadhyāyaḥ śeṣe rātrau yathā divā ||
prātaḥsandhyāyāṃ nimittotpāde sajyotir yāvat sūryas tāvad evānadhyāyo [764] divaivety arthaḥ | aparasyāṃ tu yāvan nakṣatrāṇi tāvad eva | 'śeṣe' vṛṣṭau, yathā divānadhyāyas tathā rātrāv apīty arthaḥ |
hārītaḥ stanite viśeṣam āha |
sāyaṃsandhyāstanite rātrau nādhīyīran, prātaḥsandhyāstanite tv ahorātram |
āpastambaḥ |
sandhau ghanastanite rātrau svapnaparyantaṃ vidyuty uṣasi yāvatā vā kṛṣṇā rohiṇī vā sarpate śamyāprāsād vijānīyād etasmin kāle vidyotamānāyāṃ sapradoṣam ahar anadhyāyo ’hno ’pararātre stanayitnunārdharātrād ity eke gavāṃ cāvarodhā iti |
'sandhau' 'ahorātrasandhilakṣitakāle, 'ghanastanite' meghadhvāne, rātrim anantarāṃ nādhaīyīta 'svapnaparyantaṃ' svapnāntaṃ yāvat, anyedyur utthānād ity arthaḥ | ‘uṣasi' uṣasy apararātre, 'vidyotamānāyāṃ vidyutiḥ,' atha vā śamyākhyaprāsaparimite deśe sthitā gauḥ kṛṣṇā lohitā vā sarpate yadā tadā pradoṣasahitam ahar anadhyāyo ’hno ’pararātre stanayitnunā garjitena nimittena sapradoṣam ahar anadhyāya ity arthaḥ |
nirghātādiṣu varṣāsv ākāliko ’nadhyāyo manunoktaḥ |
nirghāte bhūmicalane jyotiṣāṃ copasarjane |
etān ākālikān vindyād anadhyāyān ṛtāv api ||
[765]        'nirghātaḥ' āntarikṣo dhvaniviśeṣaḥ, 'jyotiṣām upasarjanaṃ' sūryacandramasoḥ pariveṣaḥ, grahayuddhādi vā |
yājñavalkyaḥ |
sandhyāgarjitanirghātabhūkampolkānipātane |
samāpya vedaṃ dyuniśam āraṇyakam adhītya ca ||
'dyuniśaṃ' ahorātram | tataś cākālikāhorātrayor atra vikalpaḥ |
yat tu manuvacanam,
śakradhvajanipāte ca ulkāpāte tathaiva ca |
anadhyāyas trirātraṃ tu bhūmikampe tathaiva ca |
iti, tad ulkāvidyutoḥ sahabhāve veditavyaṃ, ulkāvidyutsamāse trirātraṃ,
karṇaśrave ’nile rātrau divā pāṃśusamūhane |
etau varjyāv anadhyāyāv adhyāyajñāḥ pracakṣate ||
karṇam antareṇa śravaṇāsambhavād atiśayo ’tra vivakṣitaḥ, 'divā vātasamūhane' iti vā pāṭhaḥ |
yājñavakyaḥ |
tryahaṃ preteṣv anadhyāyaḥ śiṣyartviggurubandhuṣu |
gurur atrācāryo na mukhyaḥ tatra daśāhavidhānāt,
trirātram āhur āśaucaṃ ācārye saṃsthite sati |
bandhavo 'trāsapiṇḍā grāhyāḥ sapiṇḍeṣu daśāhavidhānāt |
śiṣyartvigādiṣu vasiṣṭhenāhorātram uktam |
ācāryaputraśiṣyabhāryāsv ahorātram ṛtvigayonisaṃbaddheṣu |
'ayonisaṃbaddhḥ:' mātulādayaḥ |
ahorātram ity anuvṛttau gobhilaḥ |
[766]        sabrahmacāriṇi prete prete bhūmipatau | iti |
smṛtyantare śavānugamanaparicaraṇeṣu cakoraśavadarśane cāhorātram |
yamaḥ |
na garjite nāstamite tathā caṭacaṭāyite |
na candrārkoparāge tu na rājavyasane tathā |
samānavidye ca mṛte tathā sabrahmacāriṇi ||
śvādīnām adhyetṛmadhyagamanena gautamenānadhyayanam uktam |
antarāgamane punar upasadanaṃ nakulasarpamaṇḍūkamārjārāṇāṃ tryaham upavāso viprasya prāṇāyāmo ghṛtaprāśanaṃ cetareṣāṃ śmaśānādhyayane caivaṃ yena kenacid antarāgamane kṛte upasadanaṃ kāryam |
'upasadanaṃ' pāṇinā pāṇim upasaṃgṛhyetyādinā yat pratyahaṃ vihitaṃ punas tad eva kāryaṃ, śvādyantarāgamane śiṣyopādhyāyayos tryaham upavāsāḥ sahavāsau bhavato ’pi trirātram eva |
tathā ca hārītaḥ |
śvagomāyumārjārasarpanakulamūṣikānuvṛttāv eteṣām evādhīyānānām antarāgamane trirātram upavāsaḥ tryahaṃ ca vinivased |
ity uktatvāt |
tathā ca tryaham anadhyāyaḥ | tryaham upavāsāsam arthe tu vasiṣṭha āha |
mārjāranakulavyāghrāṇāṃ tv ahorātram atrābhojanam iti prakṛta upavāsaḥ mārjārāntaragamane ghṛtaṃ prāśya tryaham upavaset |
āpastambaḥ cāṇḍālādivyavāye ṣaṇmāsam anadhyayanam āha |
caṇḍālaśvapākaśaśasya ca ṣaṇmāsān anadhyāya ity anuvarttate |
[767]        hastivyāghrayos tv antarāgamane saṃvatsaram anadhyāya ity āha sa eva |
yadi hastī saṃvatsaro vyāghras tathaiva ca |
yājñavalkyaḥ paśvādigamanenāhorātram anadhyayanam āha |
paśumaṇḍūkanakulaśvāhimārjāramūṣakaiḥ |
kṛte ’ntare tv ahorātraṃ śakrapāte tathocchraye ||

[773]        na vivāde na kalahe na senāyāṃ na saṅgare |

upetasyācāryakule brahmacārivāso ’ṣṭācatvāriṃśadvarṣāṇi pādonam ardhena tribhir vā dvādaśāvarārdhaṃ na brahmacāriṇo varopavāso ’sti |

paiṭhīnasiḥ |

sarveṣu grahaṇante vā |
