atha samāvartanakālaḥ |
tatra dakṣaḥ |
svīkaroti yadā vedaṃ dhatte vedavratāni ca |
brahmacārī bhavet snātas tataḥ paścād gṛhī bhavet ||
vedasvīkaraṇaṃ vedārthavicārasyāpy upalakṣaṇam |
tathā ca smṛtyantare |
vedam adhītya chandoviṣayān arthān buddhvā snāyāt |
tathā ca vyāsaḥ |
na vedapāṭhamātreṇa santoṣaṃ kārayed gurum |
pāṭhamātrāvasānas tu paṅke gaur iva sīdati ||
yathā paśur bhārahārī na tasya labhate phalam |
dvijas tadarthānabhijño na vedaphalam aśnute ||
vedasyādhyayanaṃ sarvaṃ dharmaśāstrasya cāpi yat |
ajānato ’rthaṃ tat sarvaṃ tuṣāṇāṃ kaṇḍanaṃ yathā ||
yo ’dhītya vedavid vipro vedārthaṃ na vicārayet |
sa sānvayaḥ paśusamaḥ pātratāṃ na prapadyate ||
adhītya yat kiṃcid api vedārthādhigame rataḥ |
sa brahmalokam āpnoti brahmānuṣṭhānasiddhitaḥ |
śrutahīnadhanaḥ so ’pi yan nehāmutra tad bhavet ||
tathā |
jñānaṃ karma ca saṃyuktaṃ śraddhayā kalpitaṃ yathā |
[781]        adhītaṃ śrutasaṃyukaṃ tathā śreṣṭaṃ na kevalam ||
pāṭhamātraratān nityaṃ dvijātīṃś cārthavarjitān |
paśūn iva ca tān prājño vāṅmātreṇāpi nārcayet ||
ṛkpādam apy adhītyāntar nyāyatas tu tad arthavit |
samyag vratāni saṃsevya samāvarttanam arhati ||
etat samarthaviṣayam ekaikasamāptāv api snānavidhānāt |
tatra hārītaḥ |
trayaḥ snātakā bhavanti vidyāsnātako vratasnātako
vidyāvratasnātakaś ceti |
yaḥ samāpya vedam asamāpya vratāni samāvartate sa vidyāsnātakaḥ, yas tu samāpya vratāni asamāpya vedaṃ sa vratasnātakaḥ, yaḥ punar ubhayaṃ samāpya sa vidyāvratasnātakaḥ |
yājñavalkyaḥ |
gurave tu varaṃ datvā snāyīta tadanujñayā |
vedaṃ vratāni vā pāraṃ nītvā tūbhayam eva vā ||
āpastambedyayāmnāyīty eke [Ed. notes: pāṭho’yaṃ na samothono vibhāti] | tathā vratenāṣṭācatvāriṃśatparimāyeṇa vidyāvratena cety eke | ādhānādyuparijñātvāc chatriṣavaṇam udakam upaspṛśann anagnipakvṛdhaddhirasthāyogasthānāsatikaḥ (?) saṃvatsaram etad vrataṃ caret etad aṣṭacatvāriṃśatsaṃmitam ity ācakṣate |
vyāsaḥ |
guruśuśrūṣayā vidyāṃ samprāpya vidhivad dvijaḥ |
[782]        snāyīta tadanujñāto dattvāsmai dakṣiṇāṃ hi gām ||
gautamaḥ |
vidyānte gurur arthena nimantryaḥ kṛtānujñātasya snānam | iti |
vidyānte gurur arthena hetunā 'nimantryaḥ' praṣṭavyaḥ, ko ’rthas tubhyaṃ dātavyaḥ iti pṛṣṭaḥ sa khalu yaṃ brūyāt tam artham ācāryāya dattvā snāyād aśaktau tadanujñayā vety arthaḥ |
budho ’pi |
gurunānujñātaḥ snāyāt | iti |
iti samāvartanakālaḥ |
athāśramakālanirṇayaḥ |
tatra caturṇām āśramāṇāṃ samucayo vikalpaś ca | tatra samucayaṃ prakṛtya manur āha |
brahmacārī gṛhasthaś ca vānaprastho yatis tathā |
ete gṛhasthaprabhavāś catvāraḥ pṛthagā śramāḥ ||
sarve ’pi kramaśaś caite yathāśāstraniṣevitāḥ |
yathoktakāriṇaṃ vipraṃ nayanti paramāṃ gatim ||
'gṛhasthaprabhavāḥ' tadupajīvinaḥ | 'kramaśa' iti prātilomyaṃ niṣiddham |
tathā ca dakṣaḥ |
trayāṇām ānulomyaṃ tu prātilomyaṃ na vidyate |
prātilomyena yo yāti na tasmāt pāpakṛttamaḥ ||
yo gṛhāśramam āsthāya brahmacārī bhavet punaḥ |
[783]        na yatir na vanasthaś ca sarvāśramavivarjitaḥ ||
tena mṛtabhāryeṇa punarvivāhāsāmarthye ’pi na brahmacāriṇā bhāvyam, tatra ca brahmacārigṛhāśramaśabdāv uttarottarāśramiṇaḥ pūrvapūrvāśramānāśravaṇapratipādanaparau, anyathā “prātilomyaṃ na vidyate” iti grahaṇam avivakṣitaṃ syāt |
kūrmapurāṇe |
brahmacārī gṛhasthaś ca vānaprastho yatis tathā |
krameṇaivāśramāḥ proktāḥ kāraṇād anyathā bhavet ||
vānaprasthāśramaṃ gatvā na gṛhaṃ praviśet punaḥ |
na saṃnyāsī vane vāsaṃ brahmacaryān na sādhakaḥ ||
purāṇāt |
brahmacārī gṛhasthaś ca vānaprasthaś ca bhikṣukaḥ |
apramatto dvijātena māgāḥ putra kuvartmanā ||
āpastambaḥ |
catvāra āśramā gārhastham ācāryakulavāsaḥ saṃnyāso vānaprastham iti | teṣu sarveṣu yathopadeśam avyagro varttamāna āśramaṃ gacchati |
teṣu sarveṣu vartamāna iti samuccayodarśitaḥ |
jābālaśrutiś ca caturṇāṃ trayāṇāṃ dvayor vā samuccaya ity āha |
brahmacaryaṃ parisamāpya gṛhī bhavet gṛhī bhūtvā vanī bhaved vanī bhūtvā pravrajed yadi vetaracā brahmacaryād eva pravrajed gṛhād vā vanād veti |
samuccaye kālaviśeṣākāṅkṣāyām āha manuḥ |
caturtham āyuṣo bhāgam uṣitvā svaguror dvijaḥ |
[784]        dvitīyam āyuṣo bhāgaṃ kṛtadāro vased gṛhe ||
vaneṣu ca vihṛtyaivaṃ tṛtīyaṃ bhāgam āyuṣaḥ |
caturtham āyuṣo bhāgaṃ tyaktvā saṅgān parivrajet ||
"śatāyur vai puruṣa" iti śrutyābhihitam āyuṣaś caturtho bhāgaḥ pañcaviṃśativarṣāṇi |
gautamas tu vikalpam āha |
tasyāśramavikalpam eke bruvate |
ayaṃ tu vikalpo vratacaryāśramavyatiriktaviṣayaḥ |
vasiṣṭhaḥ |
catvāra āśramā brahmacārī gṛhastho vānaprasthaḥ parivrājakas teṣāṃ vedam adhītya vedo vedān vāviśīrṇabrahmacaryo (?) yam icchet tam āviśet |
vedān vedau veti pakṣau phalabhūyastvam abhipretya vedam adhītyāvisutabrahmacaryas teṣām āśramāṇāṃ madhye yam icchet taṃ 'āviśet' āśrayet tatraiva niṣṭhāṃ yāyād ity arthaḥ |
vāmanapurāṇe |
gārhasthyam icchan bhūpāla kuryād dāraparigraham |
brahmacaryeṇa vā kālaṃ nayet saṃkalpapūrvakam ||
vaikhānaso vātha bhavet parivrāḍ atha vecchayā |
gurave tu varaṃ datvā snāyād gurvanumoditaḥ |
gṛhaṃ vanaṃ vopavased vrajed vāpi dvijottamaḥ ||
uśanāḥ |
ācāryeṇābhyanujñātaś  caturṇām ekam āśramam |
[785]        ā vimokṣāc charīrasya so ’nutiṣṭhed yathāvidhi ||
ayaṃ ca vikalpaḥ samuccayānuṣṭhānarahitānāṃ veditavyaḥ |
ity āśramakālanirṇayaḥ |
athodvāhavikalpaḥ |
tatra bṛhaspatiḥ |
vedān adhītya vidhinā samāvṛtto ’plutavrataḥ |
samānām udahet patnīṃ yaśaḥśīlavayoguṇaiḥ ||
vedān adhītya vedau vā vedaṃ vāpi yathākramam |
aviplutabrahmacaryo gṛhasthāśramam āviśet ||
guruṃ vā samanujñāpya pradāya gurudakṣiṇām |
sadṛśān āhared dārān mātāpitṛmate sthitaḥ ||
vedaṃ vedau ca vedān vā tato ’dhītya yathāvidhi |
aviśīrṇabrahmacaryo dārān kurvīta dharmataḥ ||
atra naiṣṭhikānantaraṃ śaṅkhalikhitau |
athānujñāto muñjādyupanayanaṃ kṛtvā savarṇāṃ pariṇīya
brāhmādinodvāhena (-vāheta?) |
dakṣaḥ |
svīkaroti yadā vedāṃś cared vedavratāni ca |
brahmacārī bhavet tāvad ūrdhvaṃ snāto gṛhī bhavet ||
anadhītya dvijo vedān snātvodvāhya yathā tathā |
adhīte brahmacaryeṇa sāṅgaṃ vedaṃ guror gṛhe |
[786]        yugme ’bde sampradā vidyādharmakāmāyuṣā sadā |
bhartur iṣṭā bhavaty oje varṣe kanyā tv asaṃśayam ||
māghamāse bhaved ūḍhā kanyā saubhāgyasaṃyutā |
phālgunoḍhā bhavet sādhvī vaiśākhe putriṇī bhavet ||
dharmayuktā bhavej jyeṣṭhe dhaninī kārttike bhavet |
devapūjāratā nityaṃ māse syāt somadaivate ||
uktavarjiteṣv anyeṣu māseṣu prāpnuyād yadi |
vivāhaṃ kanyakā sā syāt sutaśīlārthavarjitā ||
sitapakṣe tu yaśasā prakāśayati sā kulam |
kanyoḍhā tv asitādye ca aśeṣe cen nidarśanā ||
tathā |
śuklapakṣaṃ praśaṃsanti viśeṣeṇottarāyaṇam |
vasiṣṭhaḥ |
āpūryamāṇapakṣe tu vivāho brāhmaṇasya tu |
itareṣāṃ tu varṇānāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe vidhīyate ||
vyāsaḥ |
ugrāsanograriktāsu tithiṣu syād amarditā |
durbhagā ceti śeṣāsu sutasaubhāgyasaṃyutā ||
tathā |
kālyaṇabhāvitā prītiḥ saubhāgyaṃ dhanasaṃkṣayaḥ |
[787]        sukhārthau bahuvighnāni śīlasaukhyaprakīrttayaḥ ||
śokāmayau mudaḥ saukhyaṃ bhāgyam evātmajādayaḥ |
upadravāḥ pūrṇaphalaṃ śukle pratipadādayaḥ ||
tathā |
guruśukrenduputrāṇāṃ dineṣu pariṇīyate |
yā kanyā sā bhaven nityaṃ bhartuś cittānusāriṇī ||
arkatatputrabhaumānāṃ dineṣu kalahapriyā |
sāpatnyaṃ samavāpnoti tuṣārakaravāsare ||
aṣṭavargagato ’niṣṭasthānaprāptaśubhagrahaḥ |
yadā tadā taddivase vivāho na praśasyate ||
yad yasya divase proktaṃ grahasya sadasatphalam |
tad aśeṣaṃ tadīyāyāṃ horāyām api nirdiśet ||
praśastaṃ janmatārāsu kecid āhus tathāpare |
dvitāraṃ janmanakṣatre tyaktvā hy eṣāṃ phalapradam ||
arkādīnāṃ dine yuktaṃ yat phalaṃ tad vilagnage |
tadvarge ’pi bhavet kālaṃ horāyāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ ||
ādityādyanyavāreṇa ṛtor arkāyanasya ca |
sagraho ’dhipatis tasya vadantīti maharṣayaḥ ||
divase phalam eteṣāṃ grahaṇe yad ihoditam |
tan māsartvayanābdeṣu sadaivāvikalaṃ bhavet ||
[788]        tiryakpañcordhvagāḥ pañca rekhe dve dve ca koṇage |
śaṅkurekhādibhir nyasya bhāni tatra pradakṣiṇam ||
kṛttikādīni yat tasminn ekarāśisthitaṃ graham |
nakṣatram ambunā viddhaṃ vivāhe syād aśobhanam ||
tathā |
maitraṃ pitryaṃ tathā vaiśyaṃ brahmanairṛtadevatam |
ahirbudhnāryamā vāpi pauṣṇadhātṛniśākarāḥ ||
tathā |
ādye maghācaturbhāge naiṛtasthādya eva ca |
ṣaḍbhāgaśeṣeṣv anyeṣu nakṣatreṣu na śasyate |
revatyarkṣacaturbhāge vivāhaḥ prāṇanāśanaḥ |
svāntyajeṣu triṣu sadā pāṇigrahaṇam iṣyate ||
tathā |
hastottarāṇi vāyavyaṃ maitramūle ca revatī |
rohiṇī saumyamaitraṃ ca śubhaṃ pāṇigrahe sadā ||
tyajed viṣuvataṃ yatnād vyatīpātāyanaṃ tathā |
utpātadūṣitaṃ carkṣaṃ vaidhṛtiś ca viśeṣataḥ ||
vātsyaḥ |
sāvitryānilasaṃyuktān muhūrttān api nirdiśet |
samānadaivatais tulyaṃ nakṣatraiḥ phalam ādiśet ||
muhūrtteṣv abhijidvarjaṃa śuddhāhe kālacintakaḥ |
aṣṭamo divasasyaiva yo ’bhijitsaṃjñitaḥ kṣaṇaḥ ||
[789]        sa brahmaṇā varo nityaṃ sarvakālaḥ śubhapradaḥ |
upagraho dayādyaiś ca pāpais tair na hi badhyate ||
tathā |
vaivāhikarkṣadaivatyamuhūtteṣv api jāyate |
pāṇigrahaḥ kumārīṇam abhīṣṭārthaphalapradaḥ ||
vaidhavyaṃ dinabāndhavasya jagatīsūnor apatyakṣayaḥ
saumyasyārthaparicyutiḥ suraguror dāsyaṃ tathā duḥkhitā |
prāvrajyaṃ bhṛgunandinaḥ stutir api tyāgaś ca saureḥ purar
nārīṇāṃ gaṇikātvam eva tamasaḥ ketoś ca vaidhādvadhaḥ ||
sārāvalyām |
sarve 'py anukūlāḥ śaśisūryau naiva gocaraviśuddhau |
apy ūḍhā śakradhūryam asya dhanadasya vā kulaṭā ||
ravikṣetragate jīve jīvakṣetragate ravau
varjayet sarvakarmāṇi vratasvastyayanāni vā ||
gurau na janmāvṛṣṭamage vivāhaḥ
śanaiścare janmagate tathaiva |
na cāṣṭame śītakare ca kuryād
ravau varānnaidhanage prayatnāt ||
grahaṇadvayam adhyasthaṃ grahaṇādau saptarācam api vṛtaṃ |
yātrāvivāhasamayaṃ manasāpi na cintayet prājñaḥ ||
vratabandhaṃ dvijātīnāṃ udvāhaṃ sundarīṣu ca |
gurāv astamite nityaṃ na kuryād bhārgave tathā ||
[790]        vivāham api necchanti munayaḥ kāśyapādayaḥ |
yathā pauṣe tathā caitre kecid icchanti sūrayaḥ |
tathā siṃhagate jīve vivāhe bādarāyaṇaḥ ||
vasiṣṭhaḥ |
vivāhe vratabandhe ca yātrāyāṃ vratakarmaṇi |
gurāv astamite śakre jātasya pariṇīyate ||
gurur naṣṭaḥ patiṃ hanyāc chukro naṣṭas tu kanyakām |
candre naṣṭa ubhau hanti vivāhe tau vivarjayet ||
paścād abhyudito bālo daśāhaṃ prāg dinakṣayam |
pakṣaṃ vṛddhas tu pūrveṇa pañcāhaṃ paścime sitaḥ ||
vicittam upayāti nāśam balapratāpau dakṣiṇe tv ayane |
varāhaḥ |
deśācāras tāvad ādau vicintyo
deśe deśe yā sthitiḥ saiva kāryā |
loke duṣṭaṃ paṇḍitā varjayanti
daivajño ’to lokamārgeṇa yāyāt ||
bṛhaspatau śobhanagocarasthe
vivāham icchanti hi dākṣiṇātyāḥ |
ravau śubhasthe ca vadanti gauḍaḥ
na gocaro mālavake pramāṇaṃ ||
gauḍāḥ sūryabalaṃ prāhur dākṣiṇātyā guror balam |
māṇavā lagnam icchati lāṭhānāṃ snānajambalam || ||
[791]        tārābalaṃ māgadhīyāḥ śrayanti
kurvanti tārendubalena mādrāḥ |
tathottarām aukulasannikṛṣṭāḥ
māṇḍavyatittīratuṣārakeṣu ||
graharkṣayogās tithivārayogāḥ
śubhāśubhā ye kathitāḥ prabhūtāḥ |
vaṅgeṣu tatproktaphalā bhavanti
nānyeṣu deśeṣu vicintanīyāḥ ||
sārāvalyām |
ṣaṣṭho vilagnād ravir aṣṭamo vā
bhāgo muhūrtto yadi yujyate ca |
sūryendutārābalasaṃprayuktā
godhūlikā sarvaphalapradātrī ||
lagnaśuddhir yadā na syād yauvanaṃ tu praśasyate |
tadā tu sarvavarṇānāṃ kālo godhūlikaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
rāśir na jñāyate yasya nāpi lagnasya niścayaḥ |
lagne sūryo balī yasmin tatra sarvaṃ praśasyate ||
sauras tv ekabalo jñeyo māheyo dvibalaḥ smṛtaḥ |
tribalas tu budho jñeyaś caturguṇabalo guruḥ ||
śukraḥ pañcabalo jñeyaś candraḥ ṣaḍbala ucyate |
sarvagrahaṇair nityaṃ tulya evaṃ divākaraḥ ||
yātrā vivāhakāleṣu kāryeṣu vividheṣu ca |
[792]        yatra sūryabalaṃ nāsti nāsti sarvaṃ tato balam ||
puṃsām arkaḥ smṛto yonir yoṣitām amṛtadyutiḥ |
ato nṛyoṣitor āptaṃ balaṃ candraśaśāṅkajam ||
yatra candraś ca tārā ca dāv etau balavattarau |
doṣās tatra pralīyante yadi syuḥ sarvato ’pagāḥ ||
naṣṭe śukre tathā candre gurāv astam upāgate |
na vivāho na yātrā vai naiva dānaṃ samācaret ||
dvādaśadvaśamacaturthe janmani ṣaṣṭhāṣṭame tṛtīye ca |
prāptā pāṇigrahaṇaṃ jīve vaidhavyam āpnoti ||
siṃhe ca bhagadaivatye gurau putravatī bhavet |
atyantasubhagā sādhvī dhanadhānyapatipriyā ||
vātsyāyanaḥ |
pakṣatithikṣaṇakaraṇalagne indvarke lagnatārābhyaḥ |
pāṇigrahaṇe yojyās tattvavidaikādaśapadārthāḥ ||
vivāhakarma necchanti prasupte śārṅgadhanvani |
rutāv atha gatānāṃ tu māṇḍavyādyā maharṣayaḥ ||
siṃhasthite suragurāv adhimāsake ca
jyaiṣṭhe tathādyatanujasya tathā sutāyāḥ |
kurvīta nārkagurunīcagayor vilagna-
janmasthoś ca nikhilāny api maṅgalāni ||
raviṇā candrayuktena nārī vaidhavyam āpnuyāt |
bhaumena hriyate coraiḥ śukle pāpaṃ samācaret ||
[793]        rahasyanipuṇā saumye tyaktalajjā ratipriyā |
patim anyaṃ vrajet kṣipraṃ ketusandarśanāśrite ||
guruś candraś ca jāmitre tiṣṭhed yadi balānvitaḥ |
dhanasaubhāgyaputrāṃś ca labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
maṇimuktāpravālaiś ca suvarṇābharaṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
śobhate ’numatā śiṣṭā guruṇā yadi vīkṣyate ||
yā tu bhartuḥ priyā nityaṃ budhe candre ’tha saptame |
ādityena tu vaidhavyaṃ mahādāridryam eva ca ||
dṛṣṭe candre ca bhaume ca na kuryād yāmiśāsanaṃ |
vandhyā vā mṛtavatsā vā śanaiścaranirīkṣite ||
vasiṣṭhaḥ |
maraṇaṃ sāhasaṃ tīvraṃ dāsyaṃ dauḥśīlyam eva ca |
candrayoge grahāḥ kuryūr aviraktārkabhārgavāḥ ||
naipuṇyaṃ kulapūjyatvaṃ pauṃścalyaṃ vyādhim eva ca |
budhajīvayutāḥ kuryuḥ kartuś caiva yathākramāt ||
dvābhyāṃ tribhiś caturbhir vā dāruṇaiḥ sahitaḥ punaḥ |
dāridryaṃ maraṇaṃ vāpi kanyāyāḥ kurute dhruvam ||
vrajaty antyanane nārī gairikāvarabhūṣitā |
videśaṃ vā vrajed yatra saumyaiś ceva yutaḥ śaśī ||
lagnānāṃ mithunaḥ śreṣṭhas tataḥ kanyā tatas tulā |
tathā meṣavilagnās tu vivāhe aphalāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
[794]        anye dvicaturādīnām aṃśā grāhyā manīṣibhiḥ |
yugmakanyātulāyāṃ tu na svāṃśo na parāṃśakaḥ ||
suhṛdaḥ saumyaṣaḍvargāḥ lagnasaumyanirīkṣitaḥ |
yo vā vivāhakāleṣu praveśe śubhakarmaṇi ||
brāhmaṇaṃ kurate jāraṃ śukrajīvasamāgame |
jīvabhāskarayoḥ snātaṃ vratasthaṃ kurute patim ||
deveśasaumyayor yoge tyaktvā bandhūn patiṃ tathā |
karoti taskaraṃ jāraṃ kanyā naivātra saṃśayaḥ ||
vilagnāṃśaḥ svanāśena yady udvāhe na dṛśyate |
puṃvināśas tato ’trāṃśe yady evaṃ yoṣitas tataḥ ||
daśamatṛtīye navapañcame caturthāṣṭame kalatraṃ ca |
eśyanti pādavṛddhyā phalāni caivaṃ prayacchanti ||
vyāsaḥ |
meṣādyā ye mayā pūrvam uktā dvādaśa rāśayaḥ |
teṣāṃ kanyā tulā caiva mithunaṃ ca pradṛśyate ||
kanyātulāsu meṣeṣu lagneṣv antyāṃśake na tu |
ato ’ṃśake phalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ vadato me niśāmaya |
teṣāṃ sakoṭakanyānyakumāragatamānasā |
vṛtā vṛṣabhage sādya yugmāṃśe śīlasaṃyutā ||
veśyā kulīrabhāge syāt tīvraśeṣā tathaiva ca |
sakṛtpraśastā siṃhāṃśe pitṛveśmaratā tathā ||
rūpaśīlaguṇopetā kanyāṃśe syāt kumārikā |
[795]        ṛṇānvitā tulasyāṃśe duḥśīlā maladūṣitā ||
veśyā kulamukhītyante vṛścikāṃśe ’tikopanā |
caturthavarge kulaṭā mṛgakumbhaṛṣāṃśake |
suvṛddhyā hy anyasaktā syāt kanyā nāsty atra saṃśayaḥ ||
gargaḥ |
adhimāsakṛtān doṣān ṛtupakṣāyanodbhavān |
muhūrttakarayopetāṃs tithyutpātabhavāṃś ca yān ||
grahadṛṣṭiṃ durādharṣāṃ drekkāṇāṃśakarāśijān |
guruśukrabudhā ghnanti lagne samyagvyavasthitāḥ ||
ācāryaḥ |
lagnarāśiyukto jāmitragataś ca varjito rāhuḥ |
lagnasthe vaiṣamyaṃ jāmitragate ca kanyakāmaraṇam ||
rāśiyukte pravrajyās tā na tritaye sadā varjye |
prāglagnage mṛtyuḥ syād dhanahānir dvitīyage ||
duścikye ’rthavivṛddhiḥ syād bandhunāśaś caturthage |
sutanāśaḥ sutasthe syād bhartṛvṛddhis tathāṅgire
jāmitrasthe ca vaidhavyam āyurvṛddhis tathāṣṭame |
dharmage dhanahāniḥ syāt karmage ’rke viśīlatā ||
lābhaḥ syād āyage bhānau vyayodvādaśage bhavet |
candre vyayapriyā lagne dvitīye dhaninī bhavet ||
tṛtīye subhagā sādhvī bandhau bandhupriyā bhavet |
sutasthe kanyakā mātā ṣaṣṭhasthe mṛtyum āpnuyāt ||
[796]        jāyāsthe sasapatnī syān mṛtyor mṛtyum avāpnuyāt |
kanyā prajāvatī dharme vikārasthārakarmaṇi ||
bhartṛpriyopayuktā ca śaśiny ekādaśasthite |
vargāṇī dvādaśe ca syāt kanyakā śītadā śanau ||
aniṣṭagrahaṇaṃ yātau praśastaphaladaḥ śaśī |
saumyāṃśakastho maitreṇa dṛśyate ced balīyasā ||
vaidhavyaṃ lagnage bhaume kanyakā mṛtyum āpnuyāt |
agnicaurabhayārtā syāt dvitīyasthe dharāsute ||

[797]        taporatā dharmage syān māyāśīlā ca karmaṇā ||

suvarṇamaṇivajrāḍhyā bhavaty. ekādaśe gurau ||

yatra sā bhūṣitā kanyā surūpā dhanasaṃyutā |

vyādhyarditā bhavec chukre mṛtyusthe yamasādhanam |
[798]        bhārgave navamasthe syād dharmayuktā priyaṃvadā ||
satkarmayuktā daśame śukre dharmaparāyaṇā |

punar hīnārttiduḥkhārttā hṛdrogeṇa ca pīḍitā ||

rāhugeheṣv athānyeṣu niṣphalaḥ syād vyayasthitaḥ ||
pañca pāṇigrahe doṣān varjayed eva cintakaḥ |
dāridryaṃ mṛtyuvaiṣamyaṃ pauṃścalyam anapatyatām ||
aṣṭamāsārdhamāsāś ca tīrthe vārthe śubhāśubhāḥ |
lagnasya pañcamakhānāc chubhasthānasthitān grahān |

mūrttikarmātmajasukhatritrikoṇagate gurau |

[802]        bṛhaspatir api |
pitur gṛhe yā kanyā rajaḥ paśyaty asaṃskrtā |

viṣṇuḥ |

atha caturthāśramasvīkārakālanirṇayaḥ
uṣitvaivaṃ tataḥ samyak tṛtīyaṃ hy āśramaṃ prati |
caturtham āśramaṃ gacchet hutahomo jitendriyaḥ ||
matsyapurāṇe |
caturthe tv āyuṣaḥ śeṣaṃ śamayitvā śamaṃ vrayet |
keśalomanakhān vāpya vānaprastho munis tataḥ ||
āśramād āśramaṃ sadyaḥ pūto bhavati karmabhiḥ |
so ’pi tasya pitā tādṛk krameṇa susamāhitaḥ ||
vānaprasthaṃ samāsthāya caturthāśramam abhyagāt |
vane caran vihṛtyaiva tṛtīyaṃ bhāgam āyuṣaḥ |
caturtham āyuṣo bhāgaṃ tyaktāsaṅgaḥ parivrajet ||
tṛtīyaṃ bhāgam iti yāvatā kālena tapaḥsiddhiḥ viṣayābhilāṣaś ca nivartate tāvad vivakṣitaḥ, na hi mukhyas tṛtīyaḥ kālo na yāvati ca vayasi madāveśaḥ tadā tadā saṃvedyate tadā parivrajed ity arthaḥ |
āśramād āśramaṃ gatvā hutahomo jitendriyaḥ |
bhikṣābalipariśrāntaḥ pravrajet pretya vardhate ||
samuccayapakṣāśrayam etat, yadā gṛhasthāśramavānaprasthāśramau kṛtvobhaytrāvaśyakānuṣṭhānena jitendriyaḥ tadā pravrajan vardhata iti pūrvāśramadharmānuvādaḥ |
mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇe |
anutpādya sutān devān asaṃtarpya pitṝṃs tathā |

guruṇānumataḥ snātvā sadāro vai dijottamaḥ |

brahmavaivartte |

ṛṇāni trīṇy apākṛtya mano mokṣe niveśayet |

mokṣaikaphalatvāt jñānam eva cātra mokṣaśabdenocyate, ata eva mokṣaṃ sevamāna ity uktiḥ |
adhītya vidhivad vedān putrāṃś cotpādya dharmataḥ |
iṣṭvā tu śaktito yajñair mano mokṣe niveśayet ||
anadhītya dvijo vedam anutpādya tathātmajān |
aniṣṭvā caiva yajñeṣu mokṣam icchan vrajaty adhaḥ ||
samuccayapakṣam āśrityetarapakṣanindāvacanaṃ na punaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ uditānuditahomavat, anyathā "yadi vetarathā brahmacaryād eva pravrajed" iti pratyakṣajābālaśrutivirodhaḥ syāt | "jāyamāno vai brāhmaṇas tribhir ṛṇavān jāyate brahmacaryeṇa ṛṣibhyo yajñena devebhyaḥ prajayā pitṛbhyaḥ [809] eṣa vā anṛṇo yaḥ putrī yajñī brahmacārī vāsīti" etat taittirīyaśrutivacanam api samuccayapakṣāśrayam eva |
śaṅkhalikhatau |

kūrmapurāṇe |

ārādhya tapasā devaṃ yoginaṃ parameśvaram |

āturāṇāṃ viśeṣo ’sti na vidhir na ca satkriyā |
praiṣamātraṃ tu saṃnyāsa āturāṇāṃ vidhīyate ||
utpanne saṅkaṭe ghore coravyāghrādigocare |

yamaḥ |

viśvakarmamate |

'īṣaḥ' āśvinaḥ |

'hariḥ' siṃhaḥ |

[824]        svaropajīvināṃ caiva veśyādīnāṃ sadaiva hi ||

'dvaidhaṃ' dvandvayuddham iti yāvat |
