nityaiśvaryayutā loke citrāyāṃ ca hitapradā ||
svātau tu varadā saumyā lokānugrahakāriṇī |
aindrāgne kartṛnāśāya maitre mitravivṛddhaye ||
jyeṣṭhāyāṃ tejasā yuktā dhanadhānyavatī bhavet |
tathāvidhā tathā mūle kiṃ tu bhūtasamāśrayā ||
ādye kledam avāpnoti vaiśvadeve sukhapradā |
śravaṇe dhanadhānyāḍhyā vāsave vasusaṃyutā ||
vāruṇe śīghranāśāya tathāpye manujottama |
ahirbudhne dṛḍhā phītā kartuḥ saukhyapradāyinī ||
dhanadhānyayutā pauṣṇe āśvine yoganāśinī |
yāmye maraṇadā kartur ātmanāśakarī tathā ||
sārke syāc chokajananī sasaure mṛtyudāyinī |
sabhaume vaknibhayadā satamaske sthirā na tu ||
ketunā dhūmite ṛkṣe vahnidāham avāpnuyāt |
ketūdaye bhaved yena tena durbhikṣam āpnuyāt ||
bhaumodaye bhaved yena tena dahyeta vahninā |
saurodaye bhaved yena tena kartā vinaśyati ||
[838]        nakṣatre saparīveṣe paracakrabhayaṃ bhavet |
ulkāhate vināśāya sabhūkampabhayapradā ||
ulkāpāto bhaved yatra tatra vyādhikarī bhavet |
trividhotpātayukte bhe na śubhā parikīrttitā
divyakīrtivināśāya bhaume cātmavināśinī |
antarīkṣe ca vijñeyā lokanāśakarī tathā ||
savaidhṛtavyatīpātam ṛkṣamekaṃ vivarjayet |
śeṣair doṣais tathāyuktā yāvad āgamanād raveḥ ||
janmanakṣatravihitā kartuḥ śreyaskarī bhavet |
sampatkarī dvitīye syāt tṛtīye ’ribhayapradā ||
kṣemyā caturthe bhavati pañcame vyādhivarddhinī |
kāryavṛddhikarī ṣaṣṭhe saptame nidhanapradā ||
aṣṭame varadā saumyā navame śrīvivarddhinī |
karmaṇāṃ sādhikā proktā janmāhe daśame śubhā ||
ekādaśe śubhakarī dvādaśe ’ribhayapradā |
jñeyā trayodaśe kṣemyā rogadā ca caturdaśe ||
buddhidā pañcadaśake ṣoḍaśe nidhanapradā |
saptadaśe bhūtikarī nandā cāṣṭādaśe bhavet ||
ekonaviṃśatitame kartur maraṇadāyinī |
tathā dvitīye dhanadā tṛtīye ’ribhayapradā ||
caturthe kṣemajananī pañcame rogavarddhinī |
[839]        ṣaṣṭhe lakṣmīkarī jñeyā dhanadhānyavivarddhinī ||
dvitīye ca caturthe ca pañcame ca tathāṣṭame |
dvādaśe navame candre kartur doṣavatī bhavet ||
jamasthaś ca tṛtīyaś ca ṣaṣṭhaś caikādaśas tathā |
daśamaḥ saptamaś caiva yadā viddho bhaved grahaiḥ ||
pañcamair navamaiś caiva dvādaśair vā tathāṣṭamaiḥ |
caturthe vā tṛtīye vā kramāt pāpāt phalaṃ labhet ||
viparyayeṇa vedhaś cet pāpo ’pi śubhakṛt smṛtaḥ |
candrād dvādaśake sūrye dvitīye vā bhayapradā ||
dvādaśe vā dvitīye vā bhaume dāham avāpnuyāt |
dvādaśe vā dvitīye vā saure maraṇadā bhavet ||
pāpamadhyagate candre dhruvaṃ maraṇadā bhavet |
ekasmiṃs tu yadā kendre candramāsaṃ vyavasthitaḥ ||
kendratrayam athānyat syād yuktaṃ sūryārasūryajaiḥ |
tadā kartur vināśāya pratiṣṭhā syān narādhipa |
candre sārke vināśāya bhaume dāham avāpnuyāt |
sasaure mṛtyudā jñeyā sarādau nidhanapradā ||
nayane soparāge tu kartur maraṇadāyinī |
parityaṣṭe (?) tathā candre tathā jyeṣṭhāntapādage |
pauṣṇāntyapādage caiva kartur nidhakāriyī ||
[840]
lakṣaṇasamuccaye |
śasto jīvo navadcīṣu saptasthāneṣu sarvadā |
budhaḥ ṣaṣṭhāṣṭaturyeṣu dikṣaptanavarāśitaḥ ||
saptatriṣaṣṭhadaśamaḥ śaśī śubhaphalapradaḥ |
ravir daśatriṣaṭsaṃstho rāhus tridaśasaṅgataḥ ||
triṣaṭsthānagatāḥ śastā mandāṅgārakaketavaḥ |
śubhāḥ krūrāḥ sapāpāś ca sarva ekādaśās tathā ||
eṣāṃ dṛṣṭir munau pūrṇā vārddhikī grahabhūtayoḥ |
pādikī rāmadiksthāne vasvabdhyoḥ pādavarjitā ||
dvitīyā sāpadākhyā tu caturthī kṣemasaṃjñakā |
ṣaṣṭī ca sādhikā tārā aṣṭamī śatrusāśikā |
navamī cātimitrā syād etāḥ pañca phalapradāḥ ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
janmarāśyudaye kartuḥ kṣipraṃ nāśakarī bhavet |
dvitīye dhananāśāya tṛtīye kartṛvṛddhidā ||
caturthe gṛhanāśāya pañcame vyādhidā bhavet |
ṣaṣṭhe śatruvināśāya saptame dhananāśinī ||
aṣṭame mṛtyudā jñeyā navame dharmanāśinī |
daśame karmaṇāṃ vṛddhyai lābhe lābhakarī bhavet ||
dvādaśe tu vyayāya syāt pratiṣṭhā tu tathā kṛtā |
jamalagnodaye śreṣṭhā dhanadhānyavatī bhavet ||
janmarāśiphalaṃ śeṣaṃ sarvasthāneṣu nirdiśet |
[841]        meṣodaye kṛtā kṣipraṃ nāśam āpnoti pārthiva |
vṛṣodaye sthirā proktā dhanadhānyavatī bhavet |
lokakāntā ca mithune bahukalyāṇakāriṇī ||
kulīre kṣipraṃ nāśaḥ syāt siṃhe ca sudṛḍhā bhavet |
kanyāyāṃ sokakāntā syāt tulāyāṃ bhavati sthirā ||
vṛścike tu sthirā proktā kalyāṇāya dhanurdhare |
makare kṣipraṃ nāśaḥ syāt kumbhe lagne dṛḍhā bhavet ||
mīne guṇavahā kartuḥ kalye śūnyā tathā bhavet |
ugrā syāt sūryadābhāyāṃ saumyā saumyasya kīrttitā |
pāpagrahasya kendreṇa kartur nāśāya kīrttitā |
saumyā paṭasya suśubhaṃ kartur bhavati vṛddhidā |
phalaṃ yad eva lagneṣu navāṃśeṣu tad eva tu |
dvādaśāṃśeṣu vijñeyaṃ tad eva manujottama ||
kartur nāśāya vijñeyā triṃśāṃśe somasūryayoḥ |
śataṃ jīvet prapautrāṇāṃ kartuḥ kalyāṇadā bhavet ||
śubham aṃśaṃ mahārāja lagnaṃ pāpaphale śubham |
lagne śubhatare prāpte pāpam aṃśam aśodhanam ||
lagnasthe śokadā kartuḥ kṛtā bhavati bhāskare |
[842]        dvitīye ’rthasya hāniḥ syāt tṛtīye dhanasaṃyutā |
āyuḥkṣayaś caturthe syāt pañcame sutanāśanam |
ṣaṣṭhe śatruvighātas tu dāridryaṃ saptame bhavet ||
marapaṃ cāṣṭame bhānau navame dharmapīḍanam |
daśame sutavṛddhiś ca lābhe lābhayutā bhavet ||
dvādaśe vyayasaṃyuktā nirdhanā tu tathā bhavet |
candre lagnagate jñeyā sudṛḍhā manujottama ||
dhanānvitā dvitīye tu tṛtīye lābhasaṃyutā |
caturthe bāndhavahitā pañcame sutavṛddhidā ||
ṣaṣṭhe ripuvināśāya saptame ca dhanāvahā |
aṣṭame maraṇāyoktā navame dharmapīḍanam ||
daśame dharmadā proktā lābhe lābhapradā bhavet |
vyaye vyayavatī rājaṃs tathā dhanavivarjitā ||
ardhabimbādhike candre śubhapakṣaphalaṃ bhavet |
ardhabimbādhike kṣīṇe kramād atha nibodha me ||
candre lagnagate jñeyā kṣipraṃ nāśo mahībhujām |
dvitīye ca daridrā syāt tṛtīye dhanasaṃyutā ||
bahudhānyaṃ caturthe syāt putranāśāya pañcame |
ṣaṣṭhe ripuvināśāya bhāryānāśāya saptame ||
aṣṭame maraṇāyoktā navame dharmaghātinī |
dhanānvitā syād daśame lābhe lābhavatī bhavet ||
vyaye vyavavatī nityaṃ daridrā ca tathā bhavet |
[843]        lagne mṛtyukarā bhaume tathā dāridryadā dhane ||
kīrttiṃ tribhuvane śubhrāṃ tṛtīyasthaḥ karoty asau |
caturthe bandhunāśaḥ syāt sutanāśas tathā sute ||
arināśas tathā ṣaṣṭhe saptame ’gnau vinaśyati |
aṣṭame kartṛmaraṇaṃ navame daśanacyutiḥ ||
daśame karmasiddhiḥ syāt lābhe lābhavatī bhavet |
jāyātmajaprabhṛtayo vyaye syur vyayadāḥ sadā ||
budhalagne dhanayutā dvitīye ca tathā bhavet |
tṛtīye varadā proktā caturthe dhanasaṃyutā ||
kīrttiś ca pañcame jñeyā ṣaṣṭhe ripuvināśinī |
sukhadā saptame jñeyā harṣadā ca tathāṣṭame ||
saukhyadā navame rājan daśame karmavṛddhidā |
sthiralābhagate jñeyā vyayage dhanasaṃyutā ||
jīve dhanāḍhyā lagnasthe dvitīthe ca tathā bhavet |
dṛḍhāspadā tṛtīye syāt caturthe dhanasaṃyutā ||
pañcame sutadā proktā ṣaṣṭhe śatruvināśinī |
saptame rājyadā kartur aṣṭame ca samṛddhidā ||
kīrttidā navame jñeyā daśame 'nnasamṛddhidā |
lābhasthe lābhadā jñeyā vyaye lābhasamanvitā ||
lagnasthe niścalā śukre sarvakāmapradā bhavet |
dhanage ca dhanaṃ dadyāt tṛtīye bhrātṛvarddhinī |
caturthe subhagā jñeyā pañcame sutavṛddhidā |
[844]        ṣaṣṭhe pūjyā tathā śukre saptane dhanavṛddhidā |
aṣṭame sukhadā proktā navame ca sukhārthadā ||
daśame lokakāntā syād arināśas tathāyage |
tathā vyayasthe vijñeyā sadvyaye sadhanā tathā ||
mṛtyudā lagnage saure daridrā syād dvitīyage |
tṛtīye dhanalābhāya caturthe kartṛmṛtyudā ||
sutage sutanāśaḥ syād arināśas tathārige |
jāyānāśas tu jāyāsthe mṛtyur mṛtyugrahopage ||
dharmage dharmahāniḥ syāt karmahānis tu karmage |
mahālābhas tu lābhasthe vyayage ca vyayo bhavet ||
śūnyaṃ vivarjayet kendre tat tatraiva niyojayet |
evaṃ jñātvā śubhaṃ kālaṃ prayatnena sudaivavit |
kuryāt pratiṣṭhāṃ yajñena gṛhṇīyād avadhānataḥ ||
śubhe 'hni pūrvaṃ yatrasthāṃ tatkālapratimāṃ ca yām |
samātṛpīṭhikāṃ gartte sthāpitāṃ viniveśayet |
tatkālam evaṃ kurvīta nāmāvāsyāṃ samāhitaḥ ||
lakṣaṇasamuccaye |
pādād ūnacaturnāḍībhāgaḥ syān mīnameṣayoḥ |
vṛṣakubhau ca bhuñjānau catasraḥ pādavarjitāḥ ||
makare mithune caiva cāpāliharikarkaṭāḥ |
[845]        pādonāḥ paṭulāḥ kanye ghaṭikāḥ sārdhapañca tu ||
kesarī ca vṛṣaḥ kumbhaḥ sthirāḥ syuḥ siddhidāyakāḥ |
caraṃ dhanus tulāmeṣārdrayugbhaṃ mīnakanyake |
karkaṭe karkaṭāliś ca pravarjyāḥ kāryanāśakāḥ ||
sthiraḥ śubhagrahair dṛṣṭaḥ śasto lagnaḥ śubhāśritaḥ |
guruśukrabudhair yukte lagne dadyād dhanāyuṣī ||
rājyaṃ saukhyaṃ balaṃ puṃsāṃ deśadharmādikaṃ bahu |
prathamaḥ saptamas turyo daśamaḥ kendra ucyate |
guruśukrabudhās tatra sarvasiddhipradāyakāḥ ||
tryekādaśacaturthasthā lagnāt pāpāḥ śubhagrahāḥ |
ato ’nye ’niṣṭakarmārthaṃ yojyās tithyādayo budhaiḥ ||
suyoge śāśvatā dharmāḥ sthirāyāṃ puṣṭijīvitam |
sulagne ca mahābhāgo viṣuve cepsitaṃ phalam ||
ṣaḍaśītimukhe puṇye ayane ca mahātithau |
ṛddhir ārogyam aiśvaryaṃ devasthāpanato bhavet ||
sandhyāgate tu lagne ca pratyastamitadurgrahe |
duṣṭagrahe duṣṭalagne nakṣatre ’śubhasaṃyute ||
durnimitte tathotpāte candrasūryopamardane |
eteṣu sthāpitā devāḥ kṣayadurbhikṣarogadāḥ |
tasmād dinaṃ nirīkṣyādau sarvopaskaram āharet ||
matsyapurāṇe |
grahatārābalaṃ buddhvā grahapūjāṃ vidhāya ca |
[846]        nimittaṃ śakunaṃ labdhvā varjayitvā kṣudhādikam ||
śubhakāle śubhasthāne krūragrahavivarjite |
lagne ṛkṣe ca kurvīta pratiṣṭhādikam uttamam ||
ayane viṣuve tadvat ṣaḍaśītimukhe tathā |
eteṣu sthāpanaṃ kuryād vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā ||
viṣṇudhamottare |
yasmin ṛkṣe yad evoktaṃ phalaṃ bhūpatisattama |
tad eveha phalaṃ proktaṃ tanmuhūrtte ’pi yādava ||
raudraḥ sārpas tathā maitraḥ paitro vāsava eva ca |
ādyo vaiśyas tathā brāhmaḥ keśvaraḥ śakradevataḥ ||
aindrāgneyo nairṛtaś ca vāruṇaś ca mahīpate |
aryamṇaś ca tathā bhāgyo muhūrttās tu divākaraḥ ||
raudro ’japād ahirbudhnaḥ pauṣṇa āśvina eva ca |
yāmyo ’gnidevataś caiva brāhmaḥ saumyas tathaiva ca ||
ādityo jīvadaivatyo (?) vaiṣṇavaḥ sūryadevataḥ |
tvāṣṭraś caivātha yāmyaś ca muhūrttā rātricāriṇaḥ ||
tathā |
dinamadhyaṃgate sūrye muhūrtte 'bhijidaṣṭame |
sarvakāmasamṛddhaḥ syāt sarvopadravavarjitaḥ ||
matsyapurāṇe |
prājāpatye tu śayanaṃ brāhme cotthāpanaṃ bhavet |
muhūrtte sthāpanaṃ kuryāt tena brāhme vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
[847]
viṣṇudharmottare |
gurāv astamayaṃ prāpte nīcasthe kartṛghātinī |
tasmād balasthe jīve tu dhanadhānyakarī bhavet ||
brāhme raudre dṛḍhā jñeyā prājāpatye sukhāvahā |
svargalokapradā svarge cakre cakrapravarttinī ||
vānaspatye tu varadā āntye āntyavivarddhinī |
vāse bhavati vastrāḍhyā kāle mṛtyupradāyinī ||
āgneye dāham āpnoti klīvam abdaivate tathā |
saure bhavati susphītā cāndre ca varadā tathā ||
naśyate sāśvadaivatye godeve vṛddhim āpnuyāt |
caitre ca puṣṭidā proktā tathā bhavati pūjitā ||
kaumāre vṛddhim āpnoti pitrye nāśaṃ tathaiva ca |
vāruṇe rogadā proktā śubhā cānantadaivate ||
capalā vanadevatye yāmye mṛtyupradā bhavet |
vāgdevatye sadā vāgmī śrīge ca śrīyuto bhavet ||
dhanage dhanasaṃyuktaḥ sudṛḍhaḥ śailadaivate ||
pṛthvīdeve dṛḍhā saumyā śubhā syād vedadaivate |
pauruṣe ca tathā roṣe bahudharmavivarddhinī |
kartuḥ sukhāvahā caiva tathā tvāṣṭrayutā bhavet ||
iti sāmānyapratiṣṭhā |
[848]
atha śivapratiṣṭhā |
atha lakṣaṇasamuccaye |
uttarāśāgate bhānau liṅgasthāpanam uttamam |
dakṣiṇe tv ayane pūjyaṃ trivarṣād vai bhayāvaham ||
sagrahaṃ sthāpanaṃ neṣṭaṃ tathā vai dakṣiṇāyane |
sagrahe sthāpite liṅge vyādhinā pīḍyate prajā ||
kumārāḥ saṃprapīḍyante kamyānāśaś ca jāyate |
sumahāśastralopaś ca tadā rājñāṃ prajāyate ||
kartuḥ kṣayaḥ sadā śoko gṛhe bhavati dāruṇaḥ |
tasmān na sthāpayed devaṃ sagrahe dakṣiṇāyane ||
sthāpanaṃ tu prakartavyaṃ śiśirādāv ṛtutraye |
prāvṛṣi sthāpitaṃ siddhyai bhaved varadayogadam ||
hemante jñānadaṃ liṅgaṃ śiśire sarvabhūtidam |
lakṣmīpradaṃ vasante ca grīṣme ca jayaśāntidam |
yatīnāṃ sarvakāle ca liṅgasyāropaṇaṃ matam ||
ratnāvalyām |
māghaphālgunavaiśākhajyaiṣṭhāṣāḍheṣu pañcasu |
māseṣu śuklapakṣeṣu suduṣṭagrahavarjite ||
dvitīyā pañcamī ṣaṣthī saptamī navamī tathā |
dvādaśyekādaśī grāhyā pūrṇimā ca trayodaśī ||
guruḥ śukro budhaḥ somo varayet tu sukhāvaham |
[849]        ārdrā śatabhiṣā svātī rohiṇī śravaṇaṃ vṛṣaḥ ||
pūrvāṣāḍhottarāṣāḍhā jyeṣṭhāśleṣā ca revatī |
citrāhastau dhaniṣṭhā syād anurādhā ca siddhidā ||
lakṣaṇasamuccaye |
nakṣatre yatra tatrāpi sarvakālaṃ dvipakṣayoḥ |
liṅgasya sthāpanaṃ śastaṃ yateḥ kāmārthino dhruvam ||
ratnāvalyām |
saubhāgyaḥ śobhanāyugmān siddhaḥ sādhyaḥ śivaḥ śubhaḥ |
vṛddhiḥ prītir dhṛtiḥ siddhiḥ dhruvaḥ śuklaḥ suśobhanam ||
vavaṃ ca bālavaṃ caiva kaulavaṃ taitilaṃ śubham |
maitraṃ paramamaitraṃ ca sampat kṣemaṃ yathā śubham ||
lagnaś ca vṛścikaḥ siṃho meṣo mithunakarkaṭau |
tathā kanyā tulākumbhau vṛṣabhaś ca praśasyate ||
ravihaste bhavet siddhiḥ some mṛgaśiras tathā |
kṛttikā bhaumavāre syād anurādhā budhe yadā ||
revatī bhṛgusampannā śukravāre punarvasuḥ |
śravaṇaṃ śaśivāre ca siddhiyogāḥ śubhā matāḥ ||
janmabhaprabhṛtayo ’tha ṣaṭsaptaikādaśāḥ śubhāḥ |
bhaumamandau vṛṣasthau ca dvisaptāṅkaśarair guruḥ ||
janmaturyarasāṣṭastho daśasthaś ca śubho budhaḥ |
rasasaptadaśānyasthaḥ śukraś cātha prayatnataḥ ||
kṣetramadhye grahāḥ sarve yamakaṇṭheti niścitāḥ |
[850]        yasmāt te sarvakāryaghnās tasmāt teṣv aniyojayet ||
kṣīṇacandras tathā mandaḥ kujārkau tair yuto budhaḥ |
pāpāḥ pāpāśayā yasmāt tasmāt tāṃś ca vivarjayet ||
kendrasthe ca gurau śukre na lagnendor yadā grahāḥ |
naṣṭacandre tathā sukre gurāv astaṃ gate sati |
pratiṣṭhādiśubhārambhān dūrayātrāṃ vivarjayet ||
anyad guhyataraṃ yat tat jyotiḥśāstraviśāradaḥ |
samālokya niyuñjīta sarvasādhyāny athācaret ||
lakṣaṇasamuccaye |
sudine śuklapakṣe ca ravivārarkṣabhūṣite |
sucandratārakāyoge sulagne karaṇānvite || [broken letters]
dvaite daive pratiṣṭhā syān miśre ca sitapakṣake |
advaite caiva kṛṣṇe 'pi mantramūrttiprabhedataḥ ||
daitā siddhāntakī raudrī śataṃ varṣāṇi tiṣṭhati |
pañcarātrī harer miśrā pañcaśovarṣasaṃsthitiḥ ||
advaitā bhairavī sā tu vāmadakṣiṇamantrajā |
śatārdhārdhaṃ tu yā tiṣṭhet bāṇaliṅgasvayambhuvā ||
iti śivapratiṣṭhā |
[851]
atha viṣṇupratiṣṭhā |
vaikhānasasaṃhitāyām |
ayane cottare kuryād dakṣiṇe vā tvarānvitam |
devīpurāṇe vaikhānasasaṃhitāyām |
mārgaśīrṣakamāghau dvau ninditau brahmaṇā purā |
māseṣu phālgunaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ caitro vaiśākha eva ca |
taiṣe ’trāpy aśvayuṅmāse śrāvaṇe māsi vā bhavet ||'
tatvasārasaṃhitāyām |
pratiṣṭhātrarṣibhiḥ proktā yā kramād vakṣyate 'tha sā |
pratipac ca dvitīyā ca navamī ca trayodaśī |
daśamī dvādaśī pūrṇe śuklapakṣe śubhānvitā ||
mahāpañcarātre |
paurṇamāsyāṃ trayodaśyṃ dvādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣataḥ |
pratipaddvitīyayor vā pañcamyāṃ daśamyām api |
saṃsthitās tithayaś caitā ṛkṣayogaṃ śṛṇuṣva me ||
vaikhānasasaṃhitāyām |
śravaṇe caiva rohiṇyā svātyāṃ haste punarvasau |
triṣūttareṣu revatyāṃ śraviṣṭhe vāruṇe tathā ||
saumyatvāṣṭrānurādhāsu tiṣye caiva viśeṣataḥ |
amyasmin supraśaste vā yathoktaguṇasaṃyute ||
aśvinīrohiṇīyoge punarvasau ca puṣyataḥ |
[852]        bharaṇyāṃ śravaṇe haste revatyām uttarāsu ca |
triṣu nakṣatrayogeṣu krameṇaiṣūttarāyaṇe ||
sāgarasaṃhitāyām |
somo bṛhaspatiś caiva bhārgavo ’tha budhas tathā |
ete saumyā grahāḥ proktāḥ pratiṣṭhāyogakarmaṇi ||
'grahāḥ' vārāḥ | 'saumyāḥ' anukūlāḥ |
mahāpañcarātre |
saumyagrahe śastadine somamārgavavāsare |
grahayoga evaṃ bhavet pratiṣṭhāyajñakarmaṇi ||
vaikhānasasaṃhitāyāṃ nṛsiṃhapurāṇe |
pūrvapakṣe śubhe kāle sthire cordhvamukhe ’pi bhe |
anukūle ca lagne ca hariḥ sthāpyo narais tathā ||
nakṣatre ca tithau yugme praśaste viṣṭivarjite |
guruśukrabudhendūnām ekavārayute śubhe ||
grāmasya yajamānasyāpy anukūle ’pi tatra vai |
cararāśiṃ vivarjyātha sthirarāśiṃ pragṛhya ca |
supraśaste muhūrtte vai pratiṣṭhāṃ kārayed  dhareḥ ||
lakṣaṇasamuccaye |
sudine sitapakṣe ca suravārarkṣabhūṣite |
sucandratārakāyoge sulagne karaṇānvite ||
dvaite daive pratiṣṭhā syān miśre ca sitapakṣake |
advaite caiva kṛṣṇe ca mantramūrttiprabhedataḥ ||
[853]        dvaitā siddhāntikī raudrī śatavarṣāṇi tiṣṭhati |
pañcarātrī harer miśrā pañcaśovarṣasaṃsthitiḥ |
advaitā bhairavī sā tu vāmadakṣiṇamantrajā ||
madhūkakāṣṭhapratimāpratiṣṭhākṛtyaṃ vārāhapurāṇe |
śuklapakṣe tu dvādaśyāṃ nakṣatre raivate tathā |
tatra saṃsthāpanaṃ kuryād bhūmisiddhyarthasādhanam ||
iti viṣṇupratiṣṭhākālanirṇayaḥ |
atha devīpratiṣṭhākālaḥ |
devīpurāṇe |
gurau meṣagate śukre devīṃ cātha pratiṣṭhapet |
ihaiva sa bhaved dhanyo mṛto gacchet paraṃ padam ||
tasmān meṣagate śukre uttamā navamī smṛtā |
tathā māghāśvinau masāv uttamau parikīrttitau ||
devī tatra sadā śukrapāṃśujāpi pratiṣṭhitā |
bhavate phaladā puṃsāṃ karkasthe ca vṛṣasthite ||
་
tathā ca siddhagandharvā nṛpā vā rājyakāṅkṣiṇaḥ |
te yajantu sadā devīṃ sthāpayitvā vidhānataḥ ||
na tithir na ca nakṣatraṃ nopavāso ’tra kāraṇam |
mātṛbhairavavārāhanarasiṃhatrivikramāḥ |
[854]        mahiṣāsurahantryaś ca sthāpyā vai dakṣiṇāyane |
tathā ca catuḥṣaṣṭipratiṣṭhāyām |
brahmovāca |
sthāpanaṃ ca pravakṣyāmi sarvakāmaprasādhakam |
sarvakālaṃ prakarttavyaṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe viśeṣataḥ ||
rātrirūpā yato devī divārūpo maheśvaraḥ |
ataḥ svakālapūjābhiḥ siddhidā parameśvarī ||
iti devīpratiṣṭhākālanirṇayaḥ |
atha vāpīkūpādipratiṣṭhākālaḥ |
vahnipurāṇe |
vāpīkūpataḍāgānāṃ tasmin kāle vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ |
sudine śubhanakṣatre pratiṣṭhā śubhadā smṛtā ||
karkaṭe putralābhas tu saukhyaṃ tu makare bhavet |
mīne yaśo’rthalābhas tu kumbhe ca subahūdakam ||
vṛṣe ca mithune vṛddhir vṛścike lakṣaṇaṃ bhavet |
pitṛtṛptis tu kanyāyāṃ tulāyāṃ śāśvatī gatiḥ |
siṃhe meṣe dhananāśaṃ lakṣmīś ca dvija yacchati ||
bhaviṣyottarapurāṇe |
[855]        tasmin salilasampūrṇe kārttike saviśeṣataḥ |
taḍāgasya vidhiḥ kāryaḥ sthiranakṣatrayogataḥ ||
munayaḥ kecid icchanti vyatīte cottarāyaṇe |
na kālaniyamas tatra salilaṃ taca kāraṇam ||
iti vāpyādipratiṣṭhākālanirṇayaḥ |
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevīyasamastakaraṇādhīśvarasakalavidyā-viśāradaśrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau pariśeṣakhaṇḍe kālanirṇaye pratiṣṭhākālanirṇayo nāma pañcadaśo ’dhyāyaḥ |
[856]
atha ṣoḍaśo 'dhyāyaḥ
atha dīkṣākālaḥ |
tatra nānādevatādīkṣākālaḥ kālottare |
śaradvasantayor yogo dīkṣākarmavidhau varaḥ |
tayor asambhave varṣā nānyatrāpi praśasyate ||
dīkṣāyām abhiṣeke ca tathā mantraparigrahe |
vratagrahaṇamokṣe ca dravyālambhanakarmaṇi |
kārttikyāṃ caiva vaiśākhyāṃ svarbhānor avidarśane ||
tatraiva |
candrasūryoparāgeṣu ṣaḍaśītimukheṣu ca |
grahanakṣatrayogeṣu viṣuvatsudineṣu ca |
ayaneṣu ca sarveṣu yogaḥ sarvārthasiddhidaḥ ||
kāraṇe |
pūrvāṣāḍhe ca māse ca āṣāḍhe mṛgaśīrṣake |
dīkṣāṃ na kārayed dhīmān anyamāseṣu kārayet |
śuklapakṣe śubharkṣe ca suvāratithibhir yute ||
kriyākāṇḍaśekhare I
na vinā parva dīkṣā syād varṣāsu madhupauṣayoḥ |
anyatra tu sadā kāryā viśuddhau guruśiṣyayoḥ ||
[857]        varṣādau tu nimittāni praśastāny upalakṣayet ||
varṣādiṣu niṣiddheṣv api kāleṣu kadācic chubhaśakunādyupalambhe sati dīkṣā kartavyety arthaḥ |
prasiddhās tithayo rāhudarśanaṃ guruparva ca |
pavitrakā tithiś cāpi dīkṣākarmavidhau varā ||
ratnāvalyām |
caturthīṃ navamīṃ ṣaṣṭhīm aṣṭamīṃ ca caturdaśīm |
pūrṇamāsīṃ vinā śeṣā hitā muktau mumukṣuṣu |
ādityaṃ maṅgalaṃ sauriṃ tyaktvā vārās tu bhūtaye ||
suprabhede |
saptamyāṃ ca navamyāṃ vā ekādaśyām athāpi vā |
daśamyāṃ ca trayodaśyāṃ dīkṣākarma praśasyate ||
kvacit tu trayodaśyām amāvāsyām iti pāṭhaḥ |
sitendu-ñagurūṇāṃ tu parīkṣeta guṇāguṇaiḥ |
guṇair yuktās tu saṃgrāhyā guṇahīnāṃs tu varjayet ||
kālottare |
caturthyām atha vāṣṭamyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ tathaiva ca |
pūrṇamāsyāṃ prakartavyaṃ bhūtikāmaiḥ site sahā ||
muktikāmaiḥ kṛṣṇapakṣe yat kiṃcit karma cācaret |
dinacchidrāṇi muktvātha yāś cānyās tithayaḥ smṛtāḥ ||
tattvasāgarasaṃhitāyām |
[858]        tāṃ tāṃ tithiṃ purālocya tad uktāṃ tatra dīkṣayet |
indra uvāca |
kasya kā tithir uddiṣṭā viśeṣaṃ vada nārada |
saṃkṣepeṇaiva dīkṣāyāṃ viśeṣāvasaraṃ tathā ||
nārada uvāca |
brahmaṇaḥ paurṇamāsyuktā dvādaśī cakradhāriṇaḥ |
caturdaśī śivasyoktā vācaḥ proktā trayodaśī ||
dvitīyā tu śriyaḥ proktā pārvatyāś ca tṛtīyakā |
nityamārgeṣu pārvatyā aṣṭamī ca caturdaśī ||
aṣṭamī gaṇanāthasya bhānoḥ proktā tu saptamī |
evaṃmukhās tu saṃkṣepāt tithayaḥ paribhāṣitāḥ |
prapañcena tithīḥ sarvāḥ pavitrāropaṇe smṛtāḥ |
kāraṇe |
pauṣṇaṃ rohiṇy athādityaṃ śravaṇaṃ cāśvinī tathā |
sāvitraṃ tvāṣṭravāyavye nairṛtaṃ maitram eva ca ||
tithyaṃ trir uttarārdrā tu śraviṣṭhā ca trijanmabham |
nakṣatrāṇi praśastāni dīkṣākarmaṇi suvrata ||
ratnāvalyām |
trīṇy uttarāṇi rohiṇyaḥ puṣyakaṃ mṛgaśīrṣakam |
hastaḥ svātir anurādhā maghā mūlaṃ ca revatī ||
abhijicchravaṇaś ceti śivayoge caturdaśī |
yogāś ca prītir āyuṣmān saubhāgyaḥ śobhanaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
[859]        sukarmā ca dhṛtir vṛddhir dhruvaḥ siddhiś ca harṣaṇaḥ |
varīyāṃś ca śivaḥ siddho brahmā aindraś ca ṣoḍaśa ||
nindyāni tāni sarvāṇi praśastāni vimuktaye |
kiṃ tu deśikasekādau śubhāny atrāpi pūrvavat ||
pratipat pūrvāṣāḍhā ca pañcamī kṛttikā tathā |
pūrvā bhādrapadā jyeṣṭhā daśamī rohiṇī tathā ||
dvādaśyā sarpanakṣatram aryamṇā ca trayodaśī |
nakṣatralambā ity ete devānām api nāśadāḥ ||
kāraṇe |
rāśayaś ca carāḥ śreṣṭhā madhyamāś cobhaye smṛtāḥ |
sthiraś ca naidhanasthāne grahāḥ sarve vivarjitāḥ |
ācāryaśiśyayor ānukūlyaṃ śubhapradaṃ bhavet ||
kriyākāṇḍaśekhare |
rāśyādivargasaṃśuddhir lagnacandrārkayor api |
balaṃ gocaraśuddhiś ca yogaśāstre pratīyatām ||
lagnadoṣagrahadoṣāḥ sarve naśyanti te śubhe |
lagnasthe bhārgave prauḍhe kendrasthe ca bṛhaspatau ||
ityādinipuṇaṃ vīkṣya dīkṣāṃ maumukṣavīn prati |
maumukṣavīṃ prati na yatkālādiniyamaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
mantravarṇeṣu siddhān vai susiddhān melayed budhaḥ |
vaivarṇavān udāsīnān gaṇayed daśabhiḥ pṛthak ||
siddharāśau hared bhāgaṃ vasubhir bhānubhiḥ svaraiḥ |
[860]        śuddharāśis tu yaḥ śeṣo yāme saṅkhyoditā hi sā ||
ripurāśigataḥ śeṣo māso ’sau parikīrttitaḥ |
haret pañcadaśaṃ bhāgaṃ tithijñānāya mantragam ||
māsi tasmiṃs tathā yāme kurvīta grahaṇaṃ manoḥ |
jyotiḥśāstrāt sunirṇīte lagne vā dīkṣito bhavet ||
atra dīkṣārthaṃ praśastās tithīḥ pratipādya tattvasāgarasaṃhitāyām uktaṃ hi |
tithiṃ vināpi dīkṣāyā viśiṣṭāvasaraṃ śṛṇu |
durlabhe sadgurūṇāṃ tu sakṛtsaṅga upasthite |
tadanujñā yadā labdhā sa dīkṣāvasaro bhavet ||
grāme vā yadi vāraṇye kṣetre vā divase niśi |
āgacchati gurur daivād yadā dīkṣā tadā bhavet ||
prāptā dīkṣā tadā jñeyā gurau ca samupasthite |
yadaivecchā tadā dīkṣā guror ājñānurūpataḥ ||
iti nānādevadīkṣākālaḥ |
atha viṣṇudīkṣākālaḥ |
kratupañcarātre |
vijñāya nītipravaṇaṃ hi śiṣyam
udaggatau tīkṣṇakarasya kāle |
[861]        somasya vṛddhau śubhalagnayukte
sandīkṣayed vai kṛpayā gurus tu ||
mahāpañcarātre |
dādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣasya sūryasaṃkramaṇe tathā |
dvādaśyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣasya paurṇamāsyāṃ mune ’tha vā ||
amāvāsyāyām atha vā kālam uddiśya deśikaḥ |
tad ekadvitryahaḥpūrvam adhivāsanam ārabhet ||
tattvasāgarasaṃhitāyām |
brahmaṇaḥ paurṇamāsy uktā dvādaśī cakradhāriṇaḥ |
caturdaśī śive protā vācaḥ proktā caturdaśī |
aurvapañcarātre navakadīkṣāviṣaye |
dīkṣāvidhau vā navake ca kāle
syād dvādaśī pañcadaśī tithis tu |
ekādaśī pañcadaśī tithir vā
bhavec caturdaśy atha vāṣṭamī ca |
yātrādike yogavidhau praśastā
syād devatānāṃ navamī caturthī ||
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevīyasamastakaraṇādhīśvara-
sakalavidyāviśāradaśrīhemādriviracite caturvargacintāmaṇau pari-
śeṣakhaṇḍe kālanirṇaye dīkṣākālo nāma ṣoḍaśo ’dhyāyaḥ |
[862]
atha saptadaśo ’dhyāyaḥ |
atha naimittikādidevatāpūjātadaṅgānāṃ kālaḥ |
viṣṇudharmottare |
kālaś ca dvividho jñeyaḥ sthūlasūkṣmopalakṣitaḥ |
sthūlaś ca laukiko jñeyaḥ sūkṣmaś cādhyātmikas tathā ||
sarvaṃ sthūle ca kartavyaṃ sthūlaṃ kālavidhiṃ śṛṇu |
svasthānakākṣinimiṣaturyabhāgas truṭiḥ smṛtaḥ ||
taddvayaṃ tu lavaḥ prokto nimeṣas taddvayaṃ bhavet |
nimeṣāḥ pañcadaśa kāṣṭhāḥ triṃśatkātkāṣṭhāḥ kalā smṛtā ||
triṃśatkalā muhūrttaś ca tad eva ghaṭikādvayam |
sārdhāś ca nāḍikāḥ sapta yāmas tat sandhir ucyate |
sandhayo 'sṭau samākhyātā ahorātraṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ ||
yajanaṃ pratimānaṃ tu uttamaṃ tv atikīrttitam |
udaye caiva madhyāhne pradoṣe cārdhayāmake ||
yajanaṃ madhyamaṃ madhya udaye 'stamanaṃ samam |
parārdham eṣu kāleṣu pūjayet tu viśeṣataḥ ||
dvikālaṃ vā trikālaṃ vā ātmārthaṃ saṃprapūjayet |
pūjārambhāya balyantaṃ sarvaṃ sandhyāvidhiṃ kuru ||
sandhyādikramaṇād doṣāḥ kṛte cet tu na doṣakaḥ |
[863]        pūrvāhne caiva madhyāhne pradoṣe balim āharet ||
anyāsu sarvasandhyāsu nācaret tu balikramam |
ardhayāme baliṃ kuryāt kāmyārthī tu viśeṣataḥ ||
nityotsave ca pūjāyāṃ tathā saṃvatsarotsave |
kārayet tu viśeṣeṇa anyathā cen na kārayet ||
bhāskarodayam ārabhya yāvat tu daśa nāḍikāḥ |
prātaḥkāla iti proktaḥ sthāpanāropaṇādiṣu ||
pūrvāhṇāc ca samārabhya yāvat tu daśa nāḍikāḥ |
madhyāhna iti vijñeyaḥ sthāpanāropaṇādiṣu ||
madhyāhnāt tu samārabhdha yāvat tu daśa nāḍikāḥ |
sāyaṃkāla iti proktaḥ pradoṣam adhunā śṛṇu ||
astamānaṃ samārabhya sārdhāḥ sapta ca nāḍikāḥ |
pradoṣa iti vikhyātas tv ardhayāmam ataḥ śṛṇu ||
pradoṣāntaṃ samārabhya tripādena trināḍikāḥ |
ardhayāma iti proktaś cārdharātram athocyate ||
ardhayāmāntam ārabhya yāvat tu daśa nāḍikāḥ |
ardharātram iti proktaṃ rātrir naktam athocyate ||
bhāskarasyodayāt pūrvaṃ tripādena trināḍikāḥ |
rātrir naktam iti proktaṃ jñātvaivaṃ sarvam ācaret ||
jalasaṃgrahaṇaṃ puṣpasaṃgrahaṃ yajanaṃ tathā |
udayād eva kartavyaṃ rātryante vā jalagrahaḥ |
devatāsthāpanaṃ tīrthaṃ prātaḥkāle samācaret ||
[864]        prātaḥkālāntam ārabhya yāvad vai daśa nāḍikāḥ |
tāvad vāpi prakartavyaṃ tīrthakāryaṃ prajāpate ||
aṅkurārpaṇakārye tu utsavasyādhivāsanam ||
sāyaṃ ca prārabhed dhīmān rakṣāṃ caiva prabandhane ||
sthāpane prokṣaṇe caiva garbhanyāse tathaiva ca |
adhivāsanāni sarvāṇi madhyarātre tu kārayet ||
rātryantake viśeṣeṇa sarvadevakriyārthakam |
kuryāt paraṃ mahāśabdaṃ tadāśubhanivṛttaye ||
iti nityanaimittikādidevatāpūjātaraṅgānāṃ kālaḥ |
atha viṣṇupūjākālaḥ |
tatra viṣṇudhamottare |
ekakālaṃ dvikālaṃ vā trikālaṃ pūjayed dharim |
apūjya bhojanaṃ kurvan narakāṇi vrajen naraḥ ||
nāradīye |
prātar madhyandine sāyaṃ viṣṇupūjāṃ samārabhet |
yathā sandhyā tathā nityā devapūjā smṛtā budhaiḥ ||
aśakto vistareṇaiva prātaḥ saṃpūjya keśavam |
madhyāhne caiva sāmyaṃ ca puṣpāñjatim api kṣipet ||
madhyāhne vā vistareṇa saṃkṣepeṇātha vā harim |
saṃpūjya bhojanaṃ kuryād anyathā narakaṃ vrajet ||
[865]        nimitteṣu ca sarveṣu tatkāle ca viśeṣataḥ |
pūjayed devadeveśaṃ dravyaṃ sampādya yatnataḥ ||
iti viṣṇupūjākālaḥ |
atha devatāviśeṣapūjane tithiviśeṣāḥ |
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe dvādaśīkalpe |
pratipatpāvakī proktā dvitīyā śamanasya tu |
tṛtīyā giriputryās tu caturthī vighnahāriṇaḥ ||
pañcamī nāgarājānāṃ ṣaṣṭhī skāndī tithiḥ smṛtā |
saptamī saptasaptes tu aṣṭamūrttes tathāṣṭamī |
navamī yoginīnāṃ tu yamasya daśamī tathā |
ekādaśī dhaneśasya dvādaśī cakrinas tathā ||
trayodaśī tv anaṅgasya bhūteśasya caturdaśī |
paurṇamāsī prajeśasya pitṝṇāṃ darśa ucyate ||
iti devatāviśeṣapūjane tithiviśeṣāḥ |
atha kāmanāviśeṣāt tithyādiviśeṣe devatāviśeṣapūjā |
bhaviṣvatpurāṇe |
agnim iṣṭvā ca hutvā ca pratipady amṛtaṃ ghṛtam |
haviṣā sarvadhānyāni prāpnuyād amitaṃ dhanam ||
brahmāṇaṃ ca dvitīyāyāṃ saṃpūjya brahmacāriṇaḥ |
[866]        bhojayitvā ca vidyānāṃ sarvāsāṃ pārago bhavet ||
tṛtīyāyāṃ ca vitteśaṃ vitteśo jāyate dhruvam |
krayādivyavahāreṣu lābho bahuguṇo bhavet ||
gaṇeśaḥ pūjitaḥ kuryāt caturthyāṃ sarvakarmasu |
avighnaṃ viduṣāṃ vipra kāryanāśaṃ na karhicit ||
nāgān iṣṭvā ca pañcamyāṃ na viṣair abhibhūyate |
striyaṃ vā labhate putrān parāṃ ca śriyam āpnuyāt ||
saṃpūjya kārttikeyaṃ tu dvijaḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prajāyate |
māyāvī rūpasaṃpanno dīrghāyuḥ kīrttivardhanaḥ ||
saptamyāṃ pūjayet devaṃ citrabhānuṃ divākaram |
aṣṭamyāṃ pūjito devo gocūḍābharaṇo haraḥ |
jñānaṃ dadāti vipulaṃ kāmajān yacchate guṇān ||
mṛtyuhā dhanadaś caiva pāpahā ca prapūjitaḥ |
durgāṃ saṃpūjya durgānāṃ navamyāṃ taraṇecchayā |
saṃgrāme vyavahāre ca sadā vijayam ādiśet ||
daśamyāṃ dharmarājas tu sarvavyādhiharo dhruvam |
narakād apamṛtyoś ca samuddharati mānavam ||
ekādaśyāṃ yathoddiṣṭā viśvedevāḥ prapūjitāḥ |
prajāṃ buddhiṃ ca dhānyaṃ ca prayacchanti mahīṃ tathā ||
dvādaśyāṃ pūjito devaḥ sarvaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ |
bahuputro bahudhanas tathā syān nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
trayodaśyāṃ ca saṃpūjya kāmadevaṃ mahābalam |
[867]        pūjitaḥ parayā bhaktyā dhanaṃ putrāṃś ca dāpayet ||
caturdaśyāṃ mahādeva umākānto jagadguruḥ |
sampūjito mahābhaktyā sarvān kāmān dadāty asau ||
paurṇamāsyāṃ ca yaḥ somaṃ pūjayet bhaktimān naraḥ |
bahvaptyaṃ bhavet tasya iti me niścitā matiḥ ||
amāyāṃ pitaraḥ piṇḍair iṣṭvā kurvanti sarvadā |
pūjāṃ vṛddhiṃ dhanaṃ rakṣām āyuṣyaṃ balam eva ca ||
upavāsaṃ vināpy ete bhavanty uktaphalapradāḥ |
pūjitā japahomaiś ca toṣitā bhaktitaḥ sadā |
mūlamantrās tu saṃjñābhir aṅgamantrāś ca kīrttitāḥ |
pūrvaṃ ca padmapatrasthāḥ kartavāyāś ca tithīśvarāḥ ||
eteṣāṃ ca rūpāṇi devatākāṇḍe ālokanīyāni |
gandhapuṣpopahāraiś ca yathāśakti vidhīyate |
pūjā śādye na kartavyā kṛtāpi na phalapradā ||
ājyadhārāsamidbhiś ca dadhikṣīrānnamākṣikaiḥ |
yathoktaphalado homo japaḥ śāntena cetasā ||
kṛtvā yajñaṃ daśābde ca phalāny etāni bhaktitaḥ |
yathoktāni yathoktāni labhetehādhikāni tu ||
iha janmany athānyasmin nivasec ca sukhī sadā |
teṣāṃ lokeṣu mantrajño yāvatīha tithiḥ smṛtā ||
iha tasmāt paribhraṣṭas tadbhakto jāyate naraḥ ||
[868]        surūpo dhanasaṃpanno nirjitārir mahīpatiḥ |
strīpuṃnapuṃsako vāpi jāyate puruṣottamaḥ ||
kūrmapurāṇe |
devatābhyarcanaṃ nṝṇām aśeṣāghaughanāśanam |
amāvāsyāṃ tithiṃ prāpya yaś cārādhayate bhavam |
brahmāṇaṃ pūjayitvā tu sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ mahādevaṃ tathā kṛṣṇacaturdaśīm |
sampūjya brāhmaṇamukhe sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
trayodaśyāṃ tathā rātrau sopahāras trilocanam |
iṣṭveśaṃ prathame yāme sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
amāvāsyām athāvāpya uddiśyā ca pitāmaham |
brāhmaṇāṃs trīn samabhyarcya mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ ||
ṣaṣṭhyām upoṣito devaṃ śuklapakṣe samāhitaḥ |
saptamyām arcayed bhānuṃ mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ ||
bharaṇyāṃ ca caturthyāṃ ca śanaiścaradine yamam |
pūjayet saptajanmasthair mucyate pātakair naraḥ ||
ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ samabhyarcya janārdanam |
dvādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣasya mahāpāpaiḥ pramucyate ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
kāryaṃ tavāhaṃ vakṣyāmi devatāpūjane pṛthak |
saṃvatsareṇa sarvajña sopavāsaś ca sarvadā |
[869]        brahmāṇaṃ pūjayet devaṃ satataṃ prathame ’hani |
pakṣadvaye mahābhāga pañcadaśyām upoṣitaḥ ||
saṃvatsareṇa dharmajña vidyābahusuvarṇakam |
haṃsayuktena yānena brahmalokaṃ prapadyate ||
caitramāsasya yā śuklā prathamā pratipad bhavet |
tadahni brahmaṇaḥ kṛtvā sopavāsas tu pūjanam |
saṃvatsaram avāpnoti saukhyāni bhṛgunandana ||
kālasyāvayavāḥ sarve tasminn ahani pūjitāḥ |
grharkṣāṇi ca dharmajña saukhyaṃ dadyur anuttamam ||
saṃvatsarādhipaṃ nāgaṃ tasminn ahani pūjayet |
grahāc ca saukhyam āpnoti svāsthyam agryaṃ tathaiva ca ||
tatrāgniṃ brahmaṇā sṛṣṭaṃ trailokye prathamaṃ dvija |
dakṣaṃ prajāpatiṃ nityaṃ dvitīyāyām athārcayet |
phalam āpnoti dharmajña gomedhasya na saṃśayaḥ ||
tathā nāsatyayoḥ kṛtvā tasminn ahani pūjanam |
nityam ārogyam āpnoti tathā rūpaṃ ca bhārgava ||
śuklapakṣe dvitīyāyāṃ bālacandrasya pūjanam |
kṛtvā dattvā ca lavaṇaṃ prāg rātrau subhago bhavet ||
sādhyā dvādaśa ye proktās teṣāṃ kṛtvā tu pūjanam |
tṛtīyāyāṃ mahābhāga dvādaśāhaphalaṃ bhavet ||
tṛtīyāyāṃ tadābhyarcya brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarān |
pṛthak pṛthak mahābhāga trivargaphalabhāg bhavet ||
[870]        trīn lokāṃś ca tadā nāma samyak saṃpūjya yatnataḥ |
aiśvaryaṃ mahad āpnoti gatim agryāṃ ca vindati ||
tṛtīyā śrāvaṇe kṛṣṇā yā syāt śravaṇasaṃyutā |
tasyāṃ saṃpūjya govindaṃ puṣṭimayyām avāpnuyāt ||
vaiśākhe śuklapakṣe tu tṛtīyāyām upoṣitaḥ |
akṣayaṃ phalam āpnoti sarvasya sukṛtasya ca ||
sā tasmāt kṛttikopetā viśeṣeṇa supūjitā |
tatra dattaṃ hutaṃ japtaṃ sarvam akṣayam ucyate ||
akṣayā sā tithis tasmāt tasyāṃ sukṛtam akṣayam |
akṣataiḥ pūjito viṣṇus tena sāpy akṣayā matā ||
akṣatais tu naraḥ snāto viṣṇor dattvā tathākṣatān |
varān susaṃskṛtāṃś caiva hutvā caiva tathākṣatān ||
vipreṣu dattvā tān eva tathā śaktūn susaṃskṛtān |
yavānnaṃ sumahābhāga phalam akṣayam aśnute ||
ekām apy uktavat kṛtvā dvitīyāṃ bhṛgunandana |
etām abdatṛtīyāyāṃ sarvāsāṃ tu phalaṃ labhet ||
proktās tu bhagavo nāma devā dvādaśa ye purā |
caturthyāṃ pūjanaṃ teṣāṃ kṛtvā divam avāpnuyāt ||
yamarājpūjanaṃ kṛtvā caturthyām eva dhārmikaḥ |
nāpnoti nārakaṃ duḥkhaṃ tuṣṭe ravisute naraḥ ||
vināyakam athābhyarcya caturthyāṃ yadunandana |
sarvavighnavinirmuktaḥ kāryasiddhim avāpnuyāt ||
[871]        nidrāṃ ratiṃ tathā śraddhāṃ kīrttiṃ medhāṃ sarasvatīm |
prajñāṃ puṣṭiṃ tathā kāntiṃ tatraivāhani pūjayet ||
tatprasādād avāpnoti yatheṣṭaṃ manujottama |
vidyākāmo viśeṣeṇa pūjayec ca sarasvatīm ||
devānāṃ mātaraḥ sarvās tatra tatrāhni pūjitāḥ |
sarvakāmapradā jñeyāḥ puruṣasya vipaścitaḥ ||
pañcamyāṃ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā tathā ca manasā naraḥ |
saubhāgyaṃ mahad āpnoti yaśaś cāgryaṃ ca vindati ||
pañcamyāṃ pṛthivīṃ devīṃ tathā saṃpūjayan naraḥ |
tām avāpnoti yatnena nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
viśvedevās tu ye proktāḥ pūrvam eva mayā daśa |
teṣāṃ saṃpūjanaṃ kṛtvā pañcamyāṃ divam āpnuyāt ||
iṣṭaṃ gandharvam abhyarcya pañcamyāṃ subhago bhavet |
tathā citrarathaṃ teṣāṃ rājānaṃ tu viśeṣataḥ ||
devabhāryās tathā sarvāḥ saṃpūjya subhago bhavet |
iṣṭvā tv apsarasaṃ caiva tathā rūpam avāpnuyāt ||
iṣṭaṃ nāgaṃ tathābhyarcya śriyam āpnoty anuttamām |
vārrṇe puṣkarasyārcāṃ pañcamyāṃ susamārabhet ||
sarvakāmasamṛddhasya yajñasya suphalaṃ bhavet |
tathā ca pūjayed rājan tathaiva nalakūvaram ||
śriyaḥ saṃpūjanaṃ kṛtvā pañcamyāṃ prayataḥ sadā |
śriyam āpnoti vipulāṃ saṃvatsaram athoditām ||
[872]        sarvasyāṃ nṛpa pañcamyāṃ ratiṃ prītiṃ sarasvatīm |
umāṃ medhāṃ bhadrakālīṃ tathā kātyāyanīm api ||
dhṛtiṃ svāhāṃ svadhām ṛddhiṃ anasūyāṃ tathā kṣamām |
surabhiṃ devasenāṃ ca velāṃ jyotsnāṃ tathā śacīm ||
gaurīṃ varuṇapatnīṃ ca yamapatnīṃ tathaiva ca |
dhūmrākhyāṃ sumahābhāgāṃ mṛtyucchāyāṃ tathaiva ca ||
abhīṣṭadevajananīṃ devaputrīṃ tathaiva ca |
pūjayet kāmam āpnoti tasyāṃ tv ekām asaṃśayam ||
airāvataṃ ca garuḍam ucaiḥśravasam eva ca |
harasya vṛṣabhaṃ caiva śastrāṇy astrāṇi yāni ca |
tathā saṃpūjayed rājan vijayaṃ samupāśnute ||
tathā bhādrapade māsi śuklapakṣasya pañcamī |
nāgasaṃpūjanaṃ kṛtvā dhanabhāgī bhaven naraḥ ||
kumāraś ca tathā skando vibhākhaś ca guhas tathā |
caturāsyavinirdiṣṭo bhagavān krauñcasūdanaḥ ||
tam abhyarcya naraḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ putrān āpnoty abhīpsitān |
bālānāṃ pūjanāt śreyo naraḥ prāpnoty asaṃśayam ||
ṛtūnāṃ pūjanaṃ tatra kṛtvā tu sukham āpnuyāt |
skandapārśvacarān rājan rudrapārśvacarān api |
yamapārśvacarāṃś caiva rogamuktim avāpnuyāt ||
kālapāśāṃs tathābhyarcya sūryapatnīṃ suvarcasam |
īṣṭān kāmān avāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
[873]        evam ekonapañcāśat maruto nāma kīrttitāḥ |
teṣāṃ saṃpūjanaṃ kṛtvā saptamyāṃ divam āpnuyāt ||
iṣṭasya pūjāṃ śailasya tadā kṛtvā sukhī bhavet |
pūjayitvā tathābhīṣṭāṃ saritaṃ puṇyabhāg bhavet ||
vahnisampūjanaṃ kṛtvā vahniṣṭomam avāpnuyāt |
vāyoḥ saṃpūjanaṃ kṛtvā prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim ||
saṃpūjya ca ṛṣīn sapta somayajñās tu ye smṛtāḥ |
sadā prāpnoti tān eva gatim agryāṃ ca vindati ||
saptamyāṃ yaduśārdūla iṣṭam abhyarcayen munim |
svādhyāyaphalam āpnoti tad vāpi phalam aśnute ||
pūjayitvā samudrāṃś ca dvīpamadhye tadā naraḥ |
pātālasthān mahābhāga bhuvam āpnoty abhīpsitām ||
saptalokāṃs tathā tatra pūjayitvā sukhī bhavet |
dhīdāñ caiva tathaivāgryāṃ matim apramitāṃ labhet ||
gaṅgāṃ sataprakārāñ ca tathā devīṃ sarasvatīm |
sapta yajñān avāpnoti naraḥ saṃpūjya vai dhruvam ||
ādityaṃ pūjayitvā vai śīghraṃ rogaiḥ pramucyate |
saptamyāṃ yādavaśreṣṭha matim agryāṃ ca vindati ||
ekānaṃśāṃ (?) tadā devīṃ tathā sampūjayan naraḥ |
sarvakāmasamṛddhasya yajñasya labhate phalam ||
narendrapūjanaṃ kṛtvā matim agryāṃ tathā labhet |
jayantaṃ śakratanayaṃ pūjayitvā sukhī bhavet ||
[874]        aṣṭamyāṃ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā vasūnāṃ dharmavittamaḥ |
nākalokam avāpnoti vahniṃ ca manasepsitam ||
catuṣpatheṣu rathyāsu tathaivodūkhaleṣu ca ||
giriśṛṅgeṣu rathyāsu nadītīreṣu cāpy atha |
guhāsu ca gavāṃ rathyāṃ piśācānāṃ baliṃ haret ||
śakrādīnāṃ ca devānāṃ kṛtvā saṃpūjanaṃ tataḥ |
teṣāṃ baliṃ vinikṣipya kṣemam āpnoti mānavaḥ |
āyudhaṃ pūjayitvā tu tadā vijayam āpnuyāt |
daśamyāṃ pūjayitvā vai vaiśvadevāṃs tathā daśa |
sarvakāmasamṛddhasya yajñasya phālam aśnute ||
tathā saṃpūjayed rājan tathaiva ca diśo daśa |
kriyāsu phalam āpnoti yatra yatrābhijāyate ||
dharmaṃ saṃpūjya deveśaṃ sarvasattvasukhāvaham |
dharmyāṃ gatim avāpnoti dharmyaṃ phalam eva ca ||
ekādaśyāṃ tu saṃpūjya rudrān ekādaśa prabho |
sarvakāmasamṛddhasya yajñasya phālam aśnute ||
tathā sarvagatān rudrān mudā sarvatra pūjayet |
sarvān kāmān avāpnoti sarvagān aparājitān ||
tathā ca dvādaśādityān dvādaśyāṃ pūjayen naraḥ |
[875]        dvādaśyāṃ samavāpnoti gatim agryāṃ ca vindati ||
dvādaśyāṃ devadeveśaṃ pūjayitvā jalādhipam |
puṇḍarīkam avāpnoti varuṇaṃ yādasāṃ patim ||
sarvadeveśvaraṃ śakraṃ pūjayitvā tathā naraḥ |
sarvān kāmān avāpnoti svargalokaṃ ca gacchati ||
viṣṇoḥ saṃpūjanaṃ kṛtvā kāmān āpnoty abhīpsitān |
iṣṭam agryaṃ phalaṃ prāpya gatim agryāṃ ca vindati ||
trayodaśyām athābhyarcya kāmadevaṃ jagatpatim |
saubhāgyaṃ mahad āpnoti gatim agryāṃ ca vindati ||
caitraśuklatrayodaśyāṃ kāmadevam athārcayet |
arcanāt sarvam āpnoti phalaṃ saṃvatsaroditam ||
yakṣāṇāṃ rākṣasānāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ tu pūjanam |
krtvā kṣemam avāpnoti kriyāsāphalyam eva ca ||
pūjayitvā dhanādhyakṣaṃ tadā vaiśravaṇaṃ prabhum |
bahuvittam avāpnoti phalaṃ saṃvatsaroditam ||
śaṅkhapadmau tathābhyarcya nidhāne yakṣapūjite |
maṇibhadraṃ tathābhyarcya dhanaṃ prāpnoty asaṃśayam ||
pūjayitvā mahādevaṃ sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt |
māghamāse caturdaśyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe viśeṣataḥ ||
tathā pitṛgaṇān rājan kṣīṇacandre tu pūjayet |
sarvakāmasamṛddhasya yajñasya phalam aśnute ||
śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā tathā rājan sarvān kāmān avāpnuyāt |
[876]        svarṇam induṃ tathābhyarcya saubhāgyaṃ mahad āpnuyāt ||
duṣṭaṃ graham athābhyarcya nakṣatram atha vā nṛpa |
tasmāt kṣemam avāpnoti kāmaṃ ca yadunandana ||
māsanāma ca nakṣatraṃ karaṇaṃ yogam eva ca |
pūjayitvā tathā rājan saubhāgyaṃ mahad āpnuyāt ||
sopavāvas tu nakṣatraṃ nakṣatreśam athārcayet |
nakṣatravāmabhāge ca tasmāt kāmam avāpnuyāt ||
kārttikeyaṃ mahābhāgaṃ kṛttikāsv arcayen naraḥ |
vahniṣṭomam avāpnoti kulaṃ caiva samuddharet ||
kṛttikāsu tathābhyarcya lagnaṃ vijayam āpnuyāt |
bhoginaṃ nāgam abhyarcya śriyam āpnoty anuttamām ||
kāmadevam athābhyarcya bhāgyaṃ saubhāgyam āpnuyāt |
sāvitre ca tathā haste japtvā sāphalyam āpnuyāt ||
iṣṭagrahārcitaṃ devaṃ tannāgaṃ yakṣam eva ca |
gandharvaṃ vā grahaṃ vāpi tasmāt kāmān avāpnuyāt ||
kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ mahākālam athārcayet |
sarvān kāmān avāpnoti tatheśaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
maheśvaraṃ mātṛgaṇaṃ tathā vahniṃ prapūjayet |
ekāṃ vā mātaraṃ rājan kāmam āpnoty abhīpsitam ||
tathā tumburugandharvapañcakaṃ pūjayen naraḥ |
sarvatra jayam āpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
kṛttikāsu naro ’bhyarcya skandapārśvacarāṃs tathā |
[877]        ārogyaṃ mahad āpnoti sadā vā manasepsitam ||
nṛsiṃhapratimāṃ caiva pūrṇacandraṃ samarcayet |
naro mātṛgaṇān rājan sarvakāmamanoramān ||
ekāṃ vā mātaraṃ rājan kāmān āpnoty abhīpsitān |
vānaspatyam avāpnoti pūjayitvā vanaspatīn ||
devānāṃ mānavānāṃ ca tatpakṣā ye tathāpare |
teṣāṃ saṃpūjanaṃ kṛtvā caturdaśyāṃ sukhī bhavet ||
karaṇe vā muhūrtte vā yathāvad devam arcayet |
tasmāt kāmam avāpnoti gatim agryāṃ ca vindati ||
caitramāsam athārabhya yathokte 'hni naraḥ sadā |
iṣṭadevam athābhyarcya yathoktaṃ phalam aśnute ||
saṃvatsareṇa dharmajña nakṣatre yadi vā tithau |
graheṣu sarvadharmajña sopavāsaḥ samāhitaḥ ||
saṃvatsare vāpy ayane ṛtau māse ca taddale |
naktāśī saṃyataḥ pūjāṃ kṛtvā tatsvāminaḥ sadā |
tāvatkālaṃ mahābhāga tasmāt kāmam avāpnuyāt ||
caitrāt samārabhya mahānubhāva
roceta yas taṃ suram arcayānaḥ |
tasyeha toṣāt paramaṃ sa kāmam
prāpnoti yatnāt yaduvaṃśacandra ||
iti kāmanāviśeṣeṇa tithyādiviśeṣe devatāviśeṣapūjā |
[878]
atha kāmanāviśeṣeṇa nakṣatraviśeṣe devatāviśeṣapūjā |
devīpurāṇe |
brahmovāca |
devatā yatra nakṣatre yadā dṛṣṭisthitā tadā |
ūrustho yajñadevas tu tadā sa phalabhāg bhavet ||
devatāś ca pravakṣyāmi nakṣatrāṇāṃ yathākramam |
nakṣatrāṇi ca sarvāṇi yajñāṃś caiva pṛthak pṛthak ||
aśvinyām aśvināviṣṭvā (-viddhā?) dīrghāyur jāyate naraḥ |
vyādhibhir mucyate kṣipram atyarthaṃ vyādhipīḍitaḥ ||
bharaṇyāṃ yamam abhyarcya kusumair asitaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
tathā gandhādibhiḥ śubhrair apamṛtyor vimucyate ||
analaḥ kṛttikāyāṃ tu ṛddhiṃ saṃpūjitaḥ parām |
raktamālyādibhir dadyāt ghṛtahomena ca dhruvam ||
iṣṭaḥ prajāpatiḥ pūjya iṣṭān dadyāt paśūṃs tathā |
rohiṇyāṃ devaśārdūla dadyāc ca harikuñjarān ||
mṛgaśīrṣe tathā somaṃ jayam ārogyam eva ca |
ārdrāyāṃ tu śivaṃ pūjya paśūn vijayam aśnute ||
sitaiḥ paśvādibhir dravyair devatvaṃ payasā ca vai |
punarvasau cāpy aditiṃ sadā saṃpūjanādibhiḥ ||
caruṇā tarpitā caiva tān eva parirakṣati |
[879]        tiṣye bṛhaspatir vṛddhiṃ dadāti vipulaṃ dhanam ||
pānagandhādibhir nāgā aśleṣāyāṃ prapūjitāḥ |
tarpitas tu pitṛgaṇo bhakṣyādyair madhuraiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
maghāyāṃ vijayaṃ dadyāt pūrvāyāṃ tu bhagas tathā |
bhartaram īpsitaṃ kuryāt kanyāyāḥ puruṣasya ca ||
iha jamaṇi cāyuṣyam uttarasyāṃ tathāryamā |
pūjitaḥ savitā haste viśvatejonidhiḥ sadā ||
śastaiḥ puṣpādibhiḥ sarvair dadāti vipulaṃ dhanam |
rājyaṃ tvaṣṭā ca citrāyāṃ nissapatnaṃ prayacchati ||
svātyāṃ saṃtarpito vāyur dadyād āyur balaṃ param |
indrānī ca viśākhāyāṃ pītaraktaiḥ prapūjayet ||
dhanaṃ rājyaṃ balaṃ snehas tejāṃsi nivaset sadā |
anurādhāṃ samāsādya mitraṃ saṃpūjya bhaktitaḥ ||
priyo bhavati sarveṣāṃ nirmalaṃ cittam āpnuyāt |
jyeṣṭhāyāṃ pūrvavac chakram iṣṭvā puṣṭim avāpnuyāt ||
guṇaiḥ sarvaiś ca saṃpūjya karmaṇa ca dhanena ca |
mūle tu nirṛtaṃ samyak bhaktyā saṃpūjya pūrvavat ||
iti kāmanāviśeṣeṇa nakṣatraviśeṣe devatāviśevapūjā |
[880]
atha nimittanakṣatrādeḥ saṃyogaviśeṣe devatāviśeṣapūjā |
devīpurāṇe |
brahmovāca |
śṛṇu vatsa pravakṣyāmi yathā tvaṃ paripṛcchasi |
alpakleśaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ graharkṣatithiyaugikam ||
śṛṇu kṛṣṇāṣṭamīyogaṃ śivayogeṣu cottamam |
mṛduvargaṃ ca bhāgyaṃ ca umayā bhṛguvāsare ||
daivayogād yadā ṣaṣṭhī puṣyarkṣe ravivāsare |
skandayāgas tadā kāryaḥ sarvakāmaprasādhakaḥ ||
yadā tu sūryavāreṇa saptamī vijayā tu sā |
tadā saṃbhavate bhānor yāgaḥ sarvaguṇāvahaḥ ||
śaśiriktāsamāyoge ārdrarkṣe mātṛpūjanam |
māghādyāḥ kālikādyāś ca yaṣṭavyā vidhinā mune |
saṃpūrṇaṃ phalam āpnoti svasthāne ceśvaro bhavet ||
puṣpair iṣṭvā jalaṃ śvetaiḥ pūrvāṃ caitre ca pūrvavat |
sa pāpāt mucyate kṣipraṃ śārīrāt mānasāt tathā ||
āṣāḍhāsu tathā vidvān uttarāṣāḍhayogataḥ |
viśvān saṃpūjya puṣpādyaiḥ svargam āpnoti cātmanaḥ ||
śrāvaṇe tv asite viṣṇoḥ puṣyair dhūpaiś ca bhaktitaḥ |
saṃtarpya śriyam āpnoti dhanaṃ vijayam eva ca ||
dhaniṣṭhāyāṃ vasūn iṣṭvā na bhayaṃ vindate kvacit |
mahānto ’pi tathā teṣāṃ gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ śubhaiḥ |
[881]        varuṇaṃ tu samabhyarcya vyādhibhir mucyate bhṛśam ||
āturaḥ puṣṭim āpnoti svāsthyam aiśvaryam eva ca |
ajaṃ bhādrapadāyāṃ tu śuddhasphaṭikasaṃnibham |
saṃpūjya muktim āpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
uttarāyām ahirbudhnyaṃ parāṃ gatim avāpnuyāt |
revatyāṃ pūjitaḥ pūṣā dadāti satataṃ paśūn ||
sitaiḥ puṣṭiṃ sthitiṃ caiva dhṛtiṃ vijayam eva ca |
yatra caite samākhyātā yajñāḥ saṃkṣepato mayā ||
nakṣatradevatānāṃ ca sādhakānāṃ hitāya vai |
bhaktyā vittānusāreṇa bhavanti phaladā dhruvam ||
gantuṃ cecched yadā grāmaṃ yātrāyāṃ dhruvam eva ca |
nakṣatradevatāyajñaṃ kṛtvā tat sarvam ācaret |
evaṃ kṛte hi tat sarvaṃ yātrāphalam avāpnuyāt ||
kriyāphalaṃ ca saṃpūrṇam ity uktaṃ bhānunā svayam |
yajñābhāve japaṃ kuryād dhomaṃ kuryād yathepsitam ||
iti tithinakṣatrādisaṃyogaviśeṣe devatāviśeṣapūjā |
atha pavitrāropaṇakālaḥ |
tatra śivapavitrāropaṇakālaḥ |
śivadharma-bhaviṣyatpurāṇayoḥ |
paurṇamāsyāṃ tathā ṣaṣṭhyāṃ śivaṃ saṃpūjya yatnataḥ |
[882]        upavītaṃ śive dadyāc chivabhaktāṃś ca bhojayet ||
punar evaṃ ca kārttikyāṃ pūjya śaṃbhuṃ kṣamāpayet |
yatibhyo dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt sūtravastrādipūrvikām ||
yaḥ kuryāt sakṛd apy evaṃ cāturmāsyaṃ pavitrakam |
kalpakoṭiśataṃ divyaṃ rudraloke mahīyate ||
puṇyakṣayātr paribhraṣṭaś caturvedaś ca jāyate |
ihāgato bhaved rājā gururūpasamanvitaḥ ||
śivarahasye |
pavitrāropaṇaṃ śambhoḥ kuryān nabhasi vā śucau |
caturdaśyām athāṣṭamyām adhivāsya vidhānataḥ ||
śrāvaṇe prauṣṭhapadyāṃ vā pavitrāropaṇaṃ tu yaḥ |
kurute nāpavitraṃ syāt tasya saṃvatsarāntarā |
śambhoḥ pavitram āropya riktaḥ saṃpūrṇatām iyāt ||
pavitrāt tu pavitraṃ tu sāntvayaṃ bhṛgunandana |
apavitraṃ pavitraṃ syād dehakarmākhilaṃ nṛṇām ||
kālottare |
pūjāṃ kṛtvā prakartavyaṃ nityam eva pavitrakam |
atha vā niyamenaiva kuryān māsatrayāntare ||
āṣāḍhānte caturdaśyāṃ nabhasyanabhasos tathā |
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ pakṣayor ubhayoḥ samam |
pavitrāropayaṃ kāryaṃ na tu kālāntare sthitam ||
[883]        evaṃ kāle hy atikrānte prāyaścittaṃ samācaret |
bhautikānāṃ viśeṣeṇa śuklapakṣe hy ayaṃ vidhiḥ ||
'āṣāṣhānte caturdaśyām' iti paurṇamāsyāṃ candramāsavivakṣayā āṣāḍhaśuklacaturdaśyām ity arthaḥ |
tathā ca mohacaurottare |
āṣāḍhasya tathādiṣṭā śrāvaṇasya sitāsitā |
saptamyāṃ ca trayodaśyāṃ tatra gandhapavitrakam ||
trayodaśyāṃ prakartavyaṃ pavitraṃ gandhasaṃjñitam |
pavitram atha bhūtāyām āṣāḍhaniyamaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
evaṃ saty api viṣṇusvāpābhāve na kartavyam, kiṃ tu viṣṇusvāpānantaram eva kartavyam |
uktaṃ ca |
āṣāḍhe ’pi na kartavyam asupte madhusudane |
kālo 'py aniyatas tatra śrūyatāṃ vidhinirṇayaḥ ||
śuklāṣāḍhacaturdaśyāṃ kuryāc chrāvaṇabhādrayoḥ |
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ pakṣayor ubhavor api ||
nanv āṣaḍhacaturdaśyām ity anenaiva viṣṇusvāpānantarakālaḥ svayam eva labhyate, tatra kim iti prasupta eva madhusūna iti |
satyam | kiṃ tu āṣāḍhas tāvad dvividhaś cāndraḥ sauraś ceti | tatra cāndre sarvakālaṃ svapiti punar adhikamāse sauramāsikakarkaṭasaṃkrāntāv eva viṣṇuḥ svapitīty etad uktam iti na doṣaḥ |
[884]
uktaṃ ca jyotiḥśāstre |
mithunastho yadā bhānur amāvāsyādvayaṃ spṛśet |
dvirāṣāḍhaḥ sa vijñeyo viṣṇuḥ svapiti karkaṭe || iti |
tathā |
darśadvayam atikramya yadā saṃkramate raviḥ |
adhimāsaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ sarvakarmabahiṣkṛtaḥ ||
iti vacanāc ca | pūrvāṣāḍhe pavitraṃ na kurvītety abhiprāyaḥ | yadā tu caitrādiṣaṭsu māseṣv anyatamasminn adhikamāse dvirāṣāḍhaḥ syāt tadā śrāvaṇe viṣṇusvāpaḥ |
tacā ca jyotiḥśāstre |
mādhavādiṣu ṣaṭsu ekamāse darśadvayaṃ tadā dvirāṣāḍhas tadāpi syāc caitre śrāvaṇe vyūḍhaḥ, atas tadā śrāvaṇādau pavitrāropaṇaṃ paraṃ kāryam |
uktaṃ ca mohacaurauttare |
dīkṣādisthāpanāntaṃ ca pavitrādi śatakratoḥ |
pavitrādi na kurvīta yadicchec chubham ātmanaḥ ||
darśadvayaṃ bhaved yatra ravisaṃkrāntivarjitam |
adhimāsaḥ sa vijñeyo viṣṇuḥ svapiti karkaṭe ||
tuluamāse ’dhimāse ca kartavyaṃ tu pavitrakam |
supte caiva hṛṣīkeśe doṣabhāg anyathā bhavet ||
nanu kiṃ cāndramāsena saura eva grāhyo bhavet tatrādhikamāsasya śaṅkāsti |
naivam | prāyeṇa pavitrāropaṇe cāndra eva māso ’bhimato na tu sauraḥ, kanyāgate ravau prāyaścittābhidhānāt |
[885]        āṣāḍhādiṣu māseṣu supta eva janārdane |
śuklapakṣe ’tha vā kṛṣṇe praśastā sutrarohaṇe ||
rogābhivṛddhisaṃyuktaḥ pravāsī rājapīḍitaḥ |
uktamāsatraye yas tu na kuryāt sūtrarohaṇam |
asau kanyāgate bhānau yathā dakṣāṇunā yutam ||
'dakṣāṇunā' aghoramantreṇa |
kuryāt pavitrakaṃ śambhos tulāyāṃ na kathaṃcana |
malimlucaṃ parityajya sarvakarmasu garhitam ||
kāraṇe |
āṣāḍhādicaturmāsās tadanyāni vivarjayet |
kartavyaṃ pakṣayoḥ śuklakṛṣṇayor ubhayor api |
caturdaśyām athāṣṭamyāṃ ropayet tu pavitrakam ||
ratnāvalyām |
yadā tv ekadine śambhoḥ pavitrādyaṃ cikīrṣati |
kṛtanityas tadā sandhyāṃ kṛtvā naimittikīṃ sakṛt ||
samyag gandhāḍhyakaṃ kṛtvā pavitraṃ pūjayen naraḥ |
yadā khaṇḍatithis tatra tadā tat tithibhāgayoḥ ||
yadā caturdaśī paurṇamāsyardhasaṃmiśrā tadā kālāntare ’bhihitam |
yadā tatraiva kartavyaṃ yadi vyagratayā tadā |
godohāntaritaṃ kṛtvā sādhivāsaṃ pavitrakam |
caturdaśīkṣaṇe kuryāc cheṣaṃ śeṣatithau caret ||
[886]        saptamyāṃ vā trayodaśyāṃ kṛtvā gandhapavitrakam |
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ kuryāt pavitrakaṃ tathā |
apare ’hani kartavyaṃ supavitram iti sthitiḥ |
atha dvābhyāṃ dinaikena kartavyaṃ cāpare jaguḥ ||
adhimāsatrayodaśyām apare ’hni vidhidvayam |
godohāntaritaṃ kṛtvā yadi syāt vyagramānasaḥ ||
caturdaśīkṣaṇe kuryāt sādhivāsaṃ pavitrakam |
supavitraṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ tithibhede tv ayaṃ vidhiḥ |
aṣṭamyām api boddhavyaḥ kramo ’yaṃ sūtraropaṇe ||
iti śaivapavitrāropaṇakālaḥ |
atha viṣṇupavitrāropaṇakālaḥ |
tatra pavitrāropaṇaṃ kāmyaṃ nityaṃ ca |
tatra viṣṇurahasye |
pavitrāropaṇaṃ viṣṇor bhuktimuktipradāyakam |
strīpuṃkīrttipradaṃ puṇyaṃ sukhasampaddhanāvaham ||
puṇyānāṃ tu tathā puṇyaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ tu vai |
pavitrāropaṇaṃ tasmāt pavitraṃ paramaṃ smṛtam ||
saṃvatsare naro bhaktyā samabhyarcya janārdanam |
yat phalaṃ samavāpnoti pavitrāropaṇena tat ||
na karoti vidhānena pavitrāropaṇaṃ tu yaḥ |
[887]        tasya sāṃvatsarī pūjā niṣphalā munisattama ||
tasmād bhaktisamāyuktair narair viṣṇuparāyaṇaiḥ |
varṣe varṣe prakartavyaṃ pavitrāropaṇaṃ hareḥ ||
mantraprakāśe tu |
pavitrāropaṇaṃ vakṣye sarvapūjāphalapradam |
haranti rākṣasās tasya varṣapūjādikaṃ phalam |
vidhinā śāstradṛṣṭena yo na kuryāt pavitrakam ||
varṣe varṣe tataḥ kāryaṃ vidhidṛṣṭena vartmanā |
bhaktyā paramayā yukto hariprītyai pavitrakam ||
tasmād āvaśyakaṃ pavitrāropaṇakarma āsādya kāmanānusāreṇāyurādīny api phalāni bhavantīti draṣṭayam |
viṣṇurahasye |
śrāvaṇasya site pakṣe karkaṭasthe divākare |
dvādaśyāṃ vāsudevāya pavitrāropaṇaṃ smṛtam ||
siṃhasthe vā ravau kāryaṃ kanyāyāṃ tu gate ’tha vā |
tayām eva tithau samyak tulāsthe na kathaṃcana ||
tathā |
śaradvarṣāsu kurvīta pavitrāropaṇaṃ śubham |
dvādaśyāṃ śravaṇe cāpi pañcamyām atha vā dvija |
anuktaiś caiva kartavyaṃ caturdaśyām athāpi vā ||
mantratantraprakāśe |
karkoṭakagate sūrye tathā siṃhagate ’pi vā |
[888]        dvādayāṃ śuklapakṣasya harer dadyāt pavitrakam ||
atha ced vighnayogena mukhyakālo na labhyate |
kanyāṃ cāpi prakurvīta yāvan nottiṣṭhate hariḥ ||
sātvatasaṃhitāyām |
tasya māsacatuṣkasya madhye kuryāc chubhe dine |
āṣāḍhīpañcadaśyās tu yāvad vai kārttikasya ca ||
saṃpūrṇacandradivasaṃ iti |
ā karkoṭakasaṃkrāntes tulābhogakṣayāvadhi |
kālāntam asya pakṣasya sauraṃ madhyamasaṃjñitam ||
ekādaśyāsta tadanto yaś cāturmāsyopalakṣitam |
kālāntaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ viddhi uttamaṃ sarvasiddhidam ||
aprāpter asya kālasya tv antarāyeṇa kenacit |
nirvāhaṇīyo hy aparaḥ kālaś cāndramasādinā |
saṃpādayec caturmadhye vidhivad yogapūrvakam ||
iti viṣṇupavitrāropaṇakālaḥ |
atha nānādevatāpavitrāropaṇakālaḥ |
tatra māsā vaiṣṇavoktā eva tithiṣu viśeṣaḥ |
tattvasāgarasaṃhitāyām |
pratipad dhanadasyoktā dvitīyā ca śriyā matā |
tṛtīyā pārvatīdevyāś caturthī vighnahāriṇaḥ ||
[889]        pañcamī śaśinaḥ proktā ṣaṣṭhī proktā guhasya tu |
saptamī bhāskarasyoktā durgāyāś cāṣṭamī matā ||
mātṝṇāṃ navamī proktā vāsave dhaśamī smṛtā |
ekādaśī munīnāṃ ca dvādaśī cakrapāṇinaḥ |
trayodaśī tv anaṅgasya śivasyoktā caturdaśī |
paurṇamāsī suraśreṣṭha pitur me kathitā tithiḥ ||
devyās tripurabhairavyāḥ kathitā tu caturthikā |
anyāsām api nityānām aṣṭamī navamī smṛtā |
tithayas te samākhyātāḥ pavitrāropaṇe śubhāḥ |
paśun vājibahūn indra nityatvena samarcayet ||
pavitrāropaṇaṃ tasya pṛthaṅ mukhyatayeritam |
bhavet dravyasya sampattyai deśasyāpi tathā bhavet ||
yaś ca mukhyatayā deva proktaṃ tattattithau bhavet |
iti kālaḥ samākhyātaḥ śṛṇu sūtraṃ surādhipa |
viṣṇurahasye |
tithayaḥ sūtravikhyātāḥ pṛthag uktās tapodhanāḥ |
pratipad dhanadasyoktā pavitrāropaṇe tithiḥ ||
śriyā devyā dvitīyā tu tithīnām uttamā tithiḥ |
tṛtīyā tu bhavānyāś ca caturthī tatsutasya tu ||
pañcamī somarājasya ṣaṣṭhī proktā guhasya tu |
saptamī bhāskare proktā durgāyāś cāṣṭamī smṛtā ||
[890]        mātṝṇāṃ navamī proktā daśamī vāsukeḥ smṛtā |
ekādaśī ṛṣīṇāṃ tu dvādaśī cakrapāṇinaḥ ||
trayodaśī tv anaṅgasya śivasyoktā caturdaśī |
amā deva muniśreṣṭha paurṇamāsī tithiḥ smṛtā ||
yathoktāḥ śuklapakṣe tu tithayaḥ śrāvaṇasya tu |
sarveṣām eva devānāṃ kāryaṃ tāsu yathāvidhi ||
tathā ca kālottare |
viśeṣeṇocyate vatsa pratipatprabhṛtikramāt |
vahnes tu brahmaṇo gauryā gaṇeśādiṣu pañcamī |
ṣaṇmukhasya tu sūryasya śivasyāpy aṣñamī hitā |
ambikāyāḥ kṛtāntasya rudrāyāś cakrapāṇinaḥ ||
kāmasya ca trayodaśyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ śivasya ca |
pitṝṇāṃ caiva pūrṇāyāṃ guruyogaṃ ca kārayet ||
caturdaśyām athāṣṭamyāṃ parva sādhāraṇaṃ hitam ||
devīpurāṇe devīm adhikṛtya |
atha vāṣāḍhamāse tu śrāvaṇe vāpi kārayet |
saptamyāṃ vā trayodaśyām adhivāsaṃ surādhipa |
iti nānādevatāpavitrāropaṇakālaḥ |
atha damanakāropaṇakālaḥ |
devīpurāṇe |
brahmovāca |
caitrādau kārayet pūjāṃ mama vatsa yathāvidhi |
[891]        gandhadhūpārcanādānair mālābhir damanodbhavaiḥ ||
sahomaṃ pūjayed devaṃ sarvakāmān avāpnuyāt |
sarvatīrthābhiṣekasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ||
umā śivaṃ hutāśaś ca dvitīyāyāṃ tu pūjayet |
haviṣyam annaṃ naivedyaṃ deyaṃ gandhārcanaṃ punaḥ |
phalam āpnoti viprendra umayā yat prabhāṣitam ||
pañcamyāṃ pūjayen nāgān anantādyān mahoragān |
kṣīraṃ sarpiś ca naiveyaṃ deyaṃ sarvaviṣāpaham ||
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ skandasya kartavyā pūjā sarvopahārikīm |
ihaiva sukhasaubhāgyam ante skandapadaṃ vrajet ||
daśamyāṃ dharmarājasya pūjā kāryātigandhikī |
vigatārir nirātaṅka iha cānte paraṃ padam ||
ekādaśyām ṛṣeḥ pūjā kāryā sarvopahārikī |
dhanavān putravān kānta ṛṣiloke mahīyate ||
kāmadevas trayodaśyāṃ pūjanīyo yathāvidhi |
ratiprītisamāyuktam aśokamaṇibhūṣitam ||
kumbhe vā sitavastre vā lekhyapātre halādibhiḥ ||
paurṇamāsyāṃ tathā kāryā sarvakāmasamṛddhaye ||
indrāya sahaśiṣyāya kāyikaṃ labhate phalam |
khaṇḍam iṣṭaṃ prayacched yaḥ saubhāgyam atulaṃ labhet ||
iti damanakāropaṇakālaḥ |
[892]
atha māsaviśeṣeṇa puṇyaviśeṣāḥ |
āṣāḍhe bilvakalhārair īpsitaṃ labhate phalam |
navamallikayā pūjā nabhomāsi mahāphalā ||
kadambaiś campakair evaṃ nabhasye sarvakāmadā |
āśvine paṅkajair śambhor mālatyā pūjanaṃ śubham ||
īpsitaṃ labhate sarvaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam |
māghaphāgunayoḥ puṇyaiḥ pūjanaṃ kundamudgaraiḥ |
caitre damanakaiś cāpi pūjanaṃ śatapatrakaiḥ ||
candanaiḥ kusumair vāpi pūrvanāc ca jagadguroḥ |
pūrṇe saṃvatsare martyas tridaśaiḥ samatāṃ vrajet ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
pūjā campakamālatyā iṣe 'bhyudayadāyanī |
'iṣe' āśvine |
śatapatrikayā pūjā kārttike sārvakāmikī |
mārge nīlotpalaiḥ pūjā puṣpaiḥ syāt kubjakaiḥ śubhā ||
māghe ’tha kundakusumair uvalkena phālgune |
śatapatrais tathā caitre yaḥ kuryāt surasattama |
labhate sarvayajñānāṃ sarvadānaphalaṃ tathā ||
iti māsaviśeṣeṇa puṣpaviśeṣāḥ |
atha rātryādibhedena puṣpabhedāḥ |
kanakāṇi kadambāni rātrau deyāni śaṅkare |
[893]        divāśeṣāṇi deyāṇi divārātrau ca mallikāḥ |
praharaṃ tiṣṭhate jātī karavīram aharniśam ||
praharam aharniśaṃ vā pūjāyāṃ sthāpanānantaram uttāraṇīyam ity arthaḥ |
kāmikā-kāraṇayoḥ |
nandyāvartaṃ śriyāvartaṃ śvetārkaṃ śvetapuṣpakam |
punnāgaṃ paṭṭikaṃ ṣoḍhaṃ mālatīm udaye dadet ||
paṅkajaṃ vṛhatīṃ vyāghrīṃ vyāghātaṃ karavīrakam |
utpalaṃ pāṭalīṃ droṇaṃ madhyāhne tu pradāpayet ||
campakaṃ vedakaṃ bhadrāṃ dhūstūraṃ varakarṇikām |
mālatīṃ mallikāṃ caiva dāpayet tu pradoṣake ||
jātīṃ nīlotpalaṃ caiva puṣpaṃ kundaṃ kadambakam |
dvivarṇaṃ caiva bhadraṃ ca ardhayāme pradāpayet ||
nīlotpalasamaṃ puṣpaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati |
kadambaṃ janakaṃ jātī deyaṃ svāc cārdharātrake |
anyapuṣpāṇi sarvāṇi anyasandhyāsu dāpayet ||
iti rātryādibhedena puṣyabhedāḥ |
atha sārvakālapuṣpāṇi |
bilvapuṣpaṃ śamīpuṣpaṃ karavīraṃ ca mālatī |
unmattakaṃ campakaṃ ca sadyaḥ prītikaraṃ mama ||
campakāśokapunnāgāḥ sakalhārās tathā mama |
[894]        harṣadā dvijaśārdūla ye cānye bahugandhinaḥ |
etair hi pūjito nityaṃ prītiṃ śīghraṃ vrajāmy aham ||
yaiḥ kair vāpīha kusumair jalasthalaruhaiḥ śivam |
saṃpūjya proṣito bhaktyā śivaloke mahīyate ||
iti kālaviśeṣeṇa śivapuṣpaṃviśeṣapūjanam |
atha puṣpādīnām abhāve patrādibhiḥ pūjā kārye’ti nirūpyate |
skandapurāṇe |
abhāve puṣpapatrāṇām annādyenāpi pūjayet |
śālitaṇḍulagodhūmair yavair vāpi samarcayet |
gāṇapatyam avāpnoti rudraloke vasec ciram ||
bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
abhāvena hi puṣpāṇāṃ patrāṇy api nivedayet |
patrāṇām apy abhāve tu phalāny api nivedayet ||
phalānām apy abhāve tu tṛṇagulmauṣadhīs tadā |
auṣadhīnām abhāve tu bhaktyā bhavati pūjitaḥ ||
iti puṣpādyabhāve patrādīnāṃ pūjāsādhanatvaṃ nirūpitam |
[895]
atha sāmānyataḥ kṣudrakarmakālaḥ |
nārāyaṇīye |
kulikaḥ sthaviro yogas tārā vaināśikaḥ kujaḥ |
aṣṭamo rāśir ityādyāḥ kālāḥ syuḥ kṣudrakarmaṇīi || iti |
kulikas tāvat śanaiścarādyādayaḥ aṣṭau dinādhipamukhyodayino divā sāyaṃ vā parārdham uditaṃ kulikodayākhyam | prapañcitaś cāyaṃ viṣaharaprakaraṇe |
sthaviro nāma -
gurur avyaṃśake kṣetre tayor eva dinaṃ yadi |
taddine svāṃśake rikte rogarṇādipratikriyā ||
tārāś ca -
tisraś ca pūrvā bharaṇau maghā ca
pañcogravīryāṇi vadanti tajjñāḥ |
raudrendra mūloragadevatāni
krūrāṇi teṣūgraparigrahaḥ syāt ||
vaināśikaṃ trayoviṃśaṃ varāhamihiroditam |
dvāviṃśakaṃ tu mandādyair aṣṭāśīty ekaśandinam ||
'kujaḥ' aṅgārakadinam, 'aṣṭamorāśiḥ' utpattikāle yasmin rāśau candro varttate tasyaivāṣṭamo rāśikālaḥ | ādiśabdena kalātithivelāgrahaṇam | tatra kalā nāma śuklapakṣe candrakalā vardhante kṣīyante ca kṛṣṇapace tatrāpi kṣayakāle ’ṣṭamīm ārabhyāmāvāsyāparyantaṃ [896] kuryāt | 'tithayaḥ' caturthyādayaḥ, candrodayam ārambhya pañcadaśaghaṭikāparyantaṃ samudrasya kṣobho bhavati sā candravelā nāma tadā stambhādikarma na kuryāt | tadārabhya punaḥ pañcadaśaghaṭikāparyantaṃ velā nāsti, tadā stambaṃ kuryāt |
iti sāmānyataḥ kṣudrakarmakālaḥ |
atha vaśyādikarmaviśeṣeṇa kālaviśeṣaḥ kathyate |
mantratantraprakāśe |
śiśirādiṛtujñānaṃ karmāṅgaṃ tac ca kathyate |
ācāryaiḥ kathitaṃ pūrvaiḥ karmaṇāṃ siddhikāraṇam ||
dinādiyāminīprānte ṛtavaḥ ṣaḍ yavasthitāḥ |
śiśirādyāḥ samārabhya nāḍīr daśa daśa kramāt ||
āraktadhavalo bāṇaḥ śiśiro vaśyakarmaṇi |
uccāṭane ’tha vijñeyo vasanto lohito yuvā ||
grīṣmo dhūmraśarīraś ca māraṇe sa niyujyate |
prāvṛḍ dhūmraśarīrā tu stambhane vā niyojitā ||
śarat kṛṣṇā matākṛṣṭau mantrajñair gurupūjakaiḥ |
hemanto dhavalo vṛddhaḥ śāntivaśyādikarmakṛt ||
mantratantre |
śrīkāmas tu japet kāle mantraṃ pūrvāhṇike ’tha vā |
brahmasārasvatajapaṃ kāle pūrvāhṇike ’tha vā ||
tathā kāle ca pūrvāhṇe vaśyārthī prajapen manum |
ākarṣaṇe niśi proktaṃ yāmāt pūrvaṃ tu tat dvijaiḥ ||
[897]        mantratantraprakāśe 1
pūrvāhṇe śubhadaṃ karma brāhme vāpi nigadyate |
lakṣmīsārasvataṃ nāma ākṛṣṭiḥ śāntikaṃ tathā |
āyuṣo vardhanaṃ ceti ṣaṭ śubhāni pracakṣate ||
mantratantre |
pradoṣo buddhināśāya stambhanaṃ cāparāhṇikam |
vidveṣāya japen mantraṃ madhyāhne tu jvarāya ca ||
uccāṭanārthāya japen madhyāhnāt parato manum |
māraṇaṃ tu prakartavyaṃ yāmād ūrdhvaṃ tṛtīyakāt ||
iti vaśyāvaśyādikarmaviśeṣeṇa kālaviśeṣaḥ |
atha viṣṇuśayanādikālanirṇayaḥ |
tatra bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
ābhākāsitaprakṣeṣu maitraśravaṇarevatī |
ādimadhyāvasāneṣu prasvāpāvartanotsavaḥ ||
nāradīye |
maitrādyapāde svapitīha viṣṇuḥ
śruteś ca madhye parivarttam eti |
pauṣṇāvasānena surādihantā
prabudhyate māsacatuṣṭayena ||
alpakādyeṣu māseṣu mathure mādhavasya ca |
[898]        dvādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣe ca prasvāpāvarttanotsavaḥ ||
pauṣṇapauṣe yadā nāhni maitrādyam api noniśi |
dvādaśyām api no kuryāt utthānaṃ śayanaṃ hareḥ ||
dvādaśyāṃ tathā kuryād iti paṭhitvā |
niśi svāpo divotthānaṃ sandhyāyāṃ parivartanam |
anyatra pādayoge ’pi dvādaśyām eva kārayet ||
viṣṇudharmottare |
viṣṇur divā na svapiti na ca rātrau vibudhyate |
dvādaśyām ṛkṣasaṃyoge pādayogo na kāraṇam ||
purāṇāt |
utthāne śayane caiva tathā pārśvavivarttane |
dvādaśyām rkṣasaṃyoge pādayogo na kāraṇam ||
vārāhapurāṇe |
na pādaniyamas tatra svāpe vā parivarttane |
pādayogo vadā tasya ṛkṣeṇāpi tadā bhavet ||
matsyapurāṇe |
revatīṛkṣaparyantaṃ meṣacandrāvalokite |
uttiṣṭhantaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ yoganidrā vimuñcati ||
revatyanto yadā rātrau dvādaśyā ca samanvitaḥ |
tadā vibudhyate viṣṇur dinānte prāpya revatīm ||
revatyādirathānto vā dvādaśyāṃ ca vinā bhavet |
ubhayor apy abhāve tu sandhyāyāṃ tu mahotsavaḥ ||
[899]        purāṇāt |
revatyanto yadā rātrau prāpte nārāyaṇotsave |
pādayogam anādṛtya ṛkṣa eva pravarttate ||
revatyanto yadā rātrau gataḥ pādāntare ’pi ca |
aparāhṇe tadā viṣṇur yoganidrāṃ vyapohati ||
revatyanto yadā rātrau dvādaśyā ca vinā bhavet |
ubhayor apy abhāvaḥ syāt sandhyāyāṃ tu mahotsavaḥ ||
vārāhapurāṇe |
dvādaśyāṃ sandhisamaye nakṣatrāṇām asaṃbhave |
ābhākāsitapakṣeṣu śayanāvarttanādikam ||
ayam arthaḥ |
hariśayanādau śuklā dvādaśī āṣāḍhabhādrapadakārttikānām anurādhāśravaṇarevatīnām ādimadhyāntapādayuktā rātrisandhyā divākṣaṇayuktā ca praśastā, yadā tu yathopadarśitakāle pādayogo na prāpyate tadā dvādaśīnakṣatrayoga ādaraṇīyāt | pādayor ubhayor utsavena cāyaṃ viśeṣaḥ | divā revatīdvādaśīyoge rātrigāmini nakṣatre śeṣadinānte viṣṇor utthānaṃ yadā tu revatyā vinā dvādaśī tadā dvādaśīsandhyāyām utthānādikaṃ bhavati |
tad ukam |
dvādaśyāṃ sandhisamaye nakṣatrāṇām asaṃbhave |
ābhākāsitapakṣeṣu śayanāvarttanādikam || iti ||
[900]
atra kecid āhuḥ | yadi maitrādīni nakṣatrāṇi dvādaśīṃ vihāya trayodaśyāṃ bhavanti tadā caturdaśyāṃ tadanantarāṇi jyeṣṭhādīni tataḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ tadanantarāṇi mūlādīni, tathā sati āṣāḍha iti virudhyeta tatra nakṣatrayuktā paurṇamāsī sandhijyeṣṭhādiśakteḥ bhādrapadamāsasya yathā kathaṃcit prāpyate,
ādyopāntau tribhau jñeyau phālgunaś ca tribho mataḥ |
śeṣā māsā dvibhā jñeyāḥ ||
iti vacanāt | na dhaniṣṭhā jyeṣṭhādau hariśayanādi bhaviṣyati |
yad uktaṃ viṣṇudharmottare |
niśi svāpo divotthānaṃ sandhyāyāṃ parivarttanam |
pādayogād antyatithau dvādaśyām ṛṇayogatḥ ||
iti, ācārasāre tu "dvādaśyām ṛkṣasaṅgamād" iti paṭhitam | tenānyatithigatamaitrādau pādasambandhe kaṭadvādaśyāṃ sandhisamaye śayanādikriyā |
atra śrīkaraḥ prāha: yadā gatakāle amāvasyādvayaṃ bhavati tadā mithunād itareṣv āṣāḍhībhāvāt suptacandrasūrye grahavāraśayanarevatyādayo yadi vā caturdaśyāṃ bhavanti tadāpi saṅkarayoḥ sahotthānavilokaprasiddhes tatra (?) durlaṅghanam | tadā vṛścike nakṣatraprāptāv utsave kriyamāṇe pañcamamāsaprāptau "prabudhyate māsacatuṣṭayenety" asyānupapatteḥ pādayogād anyathāvyatyaya eva kalpyatvād anādaraṇīyaḥ | dvādaśyāṃ sandhiyamaya iti tu māthurakalpāśrayaṇenoktam | divā hi vaiṣṇavānām [901] anuṣṭhānaṃ kalpaḥ māthuraś ca taditarataś ca tat | māthuro dvādaśīpuraskāreṇa nakṣatrasambandhaprekṣaṇena ca iti tu nakṣatrapādayogapuraskāreṇa dvādaśyapekṣāvaśena ca tithinakṣatramelanaṃ ca pakṣadvaye praśataṃ tena vaidikaśākhāvikalpanyāyenopapattiḥ | tadāyaṃ tithinakṣatravaśenānuṣṭhānavikalpaḥ | kathaṃ tarhi hariśaṅkarayoḥ mahotthānety asya nānyā tithir asti tasmāt sarvam anākulam iti | atra paṇḍitaparitoṣakṛtā dūṣaṇam abhihitaṃ anupapannam etat, tathā hi pādayogād anyatithau dvādaśyām ṛkṣayoga ity asya ko ’rtha, dvādaśyā anyā ekādaśī trayodaśī ekādaśīdvādaśītulyau ca na tasyā nakṣactrasaṃyogapādayogādaraḥ |
tad uktaṃ viṣṇudharmottare |
ekādaśyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ ca nityaṃ saṃnihito hariḥ |
tatra nakṣatrasaṃyoge pādayogo na kāraṇam || iti ||
atha trayodaśyām iti vaktavyaṃ tathā saty ābhākā iti virudhyate | na ca kārttikaśabdo māsacatuṣṭayaprabodhanānurodhena prāyikaḥ "ābhākā" ity akṣare bahvāyāsaprasiddhasya niyatatvān māsacatuṣṭayenety asyaiva prāyikānuvādatvaṃ yujyate | tathā ca kārttikīdvayaprāptāv uttaramāsāśrayaṇena kārttika eva viṣṇuprabodhe saty api mithunāditye svapane adhimāse sati paurṇamāsīdvayasya sambhavāt | pañcabhir api (?) māsair utthānaṃ na virudhyate | ṣaṣṭhyāpi divasair māsa iti catuḥsaṃkhyopapattiḥ, dvirāṣāḍhe vivecakaṃ darśayiṣyāmaḥ | na ca hariśaṅkarayoḥ sahotthānam iti lokaprasiddhir niyāmikā, tasyāḥ śāstraprasiddhito daurbalyāt | kiṃ caivaṃvādinā śayane kiṃ vācyaṃ yadānurodhāt kālapramāṇaṃ vṛṣāditye bhavati [902] tadā kiṃ tatraiva hariśayanaṃ utāṣāḍha apekṣaṇīyaḥ | tathāpi caturdaśyāṃ nakṣatraprāptau hariśaṅkarayoḥ sahotthānam iti lokaprasiddhir niyāmikā, tasyāḥ śāstraṃ kiṃ loko na jalpati, mithunāditye vā caturdaśyām anurādhāprāptau tatrāṣāḍhaśuklapaurṇamāsīlakṣitamāsāpekṣita-
tathotthāne kayā yuktyāpi kṛtā tasmāc chayanādāv āṣāḍhapratiniyamāt jyeṣṭhādau nakṣatralābhe ’pi śayanādinimittakaraṇaṃ tadādhimāsapātāvaśyaṃbhāvāt dvirāṣāḍhakalpanam āśritya tadanuṣṭhānānantaravyatirekeṇa tathāvidhanakṣatraprādhānyānupapatteḥ athāpi bhavati tathāpi ābhākā ity asyāvaśyādaraṇīyatvam | kiṃ caivaṃvādinā āśvine ’pi lokaprasiddhiṃ puraskṛtya devotthāpanam abhidadhatā svayaṃ likhitam api prasmṛtaṃ ṣaṣṭhyāpi divasair māso bhavatīti tasmād anyathā varṇanīyam |
tatra yad uktam,
niśi svāpo divotthānaṃ sandhyāyāṃ parivartanam |
pādayogād anyatithau dvādaśyām ṛkṣayogataḥ ||
iti, tasyāyam arthaḥ | pādayogād anyasyāṃ trayodaśyām api pādayoge sandhyāyāṃ parivartanam | dvādaśyāṃ nakṣatrayoge sati niśi svāpo divotthānaṃ bhavati | na punar utsavādikam apy anyatithau nakṣatrapādayogād evaṃ sati ābhākā iti māsacatuṣṭayeneti ca dvayam upapadyate, evaṃ caikādaśyām api nakṣatrayoge vacanāntarabalena śayanādy ācaraṇīyam | yat tu "dvādaśyām eva tat kuryād" iti, tan māthurakalpāśrayaṇena, yadi dvādaśīṃ vihāya ekādaśyāṃ nakṣatralābhaḥ tathāpi dvādaśīsandhisamaya eva śayanādikam anuṣṭheyam | [903] yady ekādaśyāṃ nakṣatrayogo yadi vā trayodaśyāṃ sarvatrābhākāprāptau dvādaśyāṃ sandhikṣaṇe śayanādikaṃ sandhyāyāś ca rātridivasobhayātmakatvāt "niśi svāpo divotthānam" ity api nātyantaṃ virudhyata iti sa eva mathuramādhavakalpena nakṣatraphalam astu ekādaśyāṃ vā nakṣatraprāptau praśastatamatvenānyatarānuṣṭhānaṃ trayodaśyāṃ vāpi kārttikāvirodhenety uktam iti |
tad etad ayukaṃ, “niśi svāpo divotthānam" iti vākye bhavaduktārthasvīkāre vyavahitasambandhaprasaṅgāt asyārthasya vacanād apratīteḥ tanmāsānām antarādhimāsanipāte tulāvṛścikayor vikalpena divotthāpanavidhāyakavacanasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt | tadabhiprāyeṇāsya vacanasyārjavenopapatter na bhavaduktārthasvīkāre kāraṇam asti | tena śrīkarāṇāṃ matam eva sādhu | kārttikaśabdaś ca mukhya evāvikalpābhiprāyeṇopapadyate | yac ca kārttikasyādhimāsatve śuddhakārttika eva viṣṇuprabodha ity uktaṃ tad api vikalpasya vakṣyamāṇatvād ayuktam | tasmād yathoktam eva sādhīyaḥ |
bhaviṣyottare |
prāpte bhādrapade māsi ekādaśyāṃ śubhe dine |
kaṭadānaṃ bhaved viṣṇor mahāpātakanāśanam ||
'kaṭadānaṃ' śayānasya viṣṇor aṅgaparivṛttikaraṇam |
tathā |
kārttike śuklapakṣasya ekādaśyāṃ samāhitaḥ |
mantreṇa caiva rājendra devam utthāpayed dvijaḥ ||
vārāhapurāṇe |
iyaṃ tu dvādaśī deva prabodhārthaṃ tu nirmitā |
[904]        tvayaiṣā sarvalokānāṃ hitārthaṃ śeṣaśāyinā ||
evam apy eṣām api devānāṃ svīyasvīyatithivaśena nakṣatravaśena ca śayanādy ācaraṇīyam iti |
tad uktaṃ matsyapurāṇe |
yasa yasya tu devasya yan nakṣatraṃ tithiś ca yā |
tasya devasya tasmiṃs tu śayanāvarttanādikam || iti ||
kecit tithivaśena kecin nakṣatravaśena sarveṣāṃ śayanādikam ācaranti | pratipadādipañcadaśatithayo dhanadādīnāṃ devānāṃ, tatraikaiva tithir anekadevatākā yathā pratipad agner brahmaṇaś ca dhanadasya ca | tatrānuṣṭhānavikalpa evānyāyyaḥ saptaviṃśatinakṣatrāṇy api tat sadaiva vyāpīnīti gāṇapatyādīnāṃ nakṣatravaśena ca śayanādikam ācaraṇīyam | nakṣatratithimelanaṃ rudrādīnāṃ śayanādāv āṣāḍhādau notsavaḥ, na hi kadācic caturdaśyām āṣāḍhyāṃ raudram ārdrānakṣatraṃ saṃbhavati | evam anyatrāpi draṣṭavyam | tasmāt tithivaśenaiva teṣāṃ śayanādikaṃ videśe tu nakṣatravaśenāpīti |
pūrvedyur upavāsaḥ syāt pūrvāhṇe svāpabodhayoḥ |
aparāhṇe yadā tau tu tadahar niyamaṃ viduḥ ||
pūrvāhṇam ārabhya rātriviśeṣa eva pūrvāhṇa evety ucyate divāsvāpasya niṣedhāt | evam eva ca rātrāv udayamāne tu garuḍadhvaje pūrvedyur upavāsaḥ syād aparedyur dharmam ācaret iti boddhavyam |
kāśyapapañcarātre |
madutthāne ca śayane matpārśvaparivarttane |
atha yo dīkṣitaḥ kaścid vaiṣṇavo bhaktitatparaḥ ||
[905]        annaṃ vā yadi bhuñjīta phalamūlam athāpi vā |
aparādham ahaṃ tasya na kṣamāmi kadācana |
kṣipāmi narake ghore dṛnbhūḥ saṃjāyate samāḥ ||
naiva yāvad bhagavato vāsudevasya śayanādikālo ’vadhāritaḥ | adhimāsanipāte tu karkaṭe vṛścike ca puṇyādikam ācaraṇīyam iti | tadvidheḥ saṃkṣepādikaṃ vidhīyate |
āha jyotiḥparāśaraḥ |
atīte ca dvaye sārdhaṃ pañcapakṣe dinadvaye |
divasasyāṣṭame bhāge pataty eko ’dhimāsakaḥ ||
divasasya haraty arkaḥ ṣaṣṭibhājasv ṛtau tataḥ |
karoty ekamahacchedaṃ tathaivaikaṃ ca candramāḥ ||
evaṃ sūryācandramasau uttarāyaṇānantaraṃ kālaṃ dakṣiṇāyanāt prāg vaiśākhādau gativiśeṣavaśenādhimāsaṃ janayataḥ | dakṣiṇāyanāt paraḥ kvacit |
āha marīciḥ |
adhimāso bhaved yasmin dvirāṣāḍho bhavet tadā |
amāvāsyādvayaṃ dṛṣṭvā dvirāṣāḍhaṃ prakalpayet ||
āha atriḥ |
mithunastho yadā bhānur amāvāsyādvayaṃ spṛśet |
dvirāṣāḍhaḥ sa vijñeyo viṣṇuḥ svapiti karkaṭe ||
[906]        kṛṣṇapakṣe daśamyādau meṣaṃ gacched divākaraḥ |
dvirāṣāḍhaḥ sa vijñeyo viṣṇuḥ svapiti karkaṭe ||
daśamyādau navamyām iti |
tathā |
mādhavādyeṣu māseṣu ṣaṭsu darśadvayaṃ yadā |
dvirāṣāḍhaḥ sa vijñeyo viṣṇuḥ svapiti karkaṭe ||
viṣṇuḥ |
amāvāsyām atikramya yadā saṃkramate raviḥ |
dvirāṣāḍhaḥ sa vijñeyo viṣṇuḥ svapiti karkaṭe ||
pañcamyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe ca meṣaṃ gacched divākaraḥ |
dvirāṣāḍhaḥ sa vijñeyo viṣṇuḥ svapiti karkaṭe ||
atrāyaṃ saṃkṣepārthaḥ | adhimāso yadā dakṣiṇāyanāt prāk meṣāditrike patati tadā dvirāṣāḍhaḥ prathamavarṣe eva sampadyate, tadā dakṣiṇāyanānantaraṃ viṣṇuḥ svapiti yadā karkaṭāditrike adhimāsaḥ patati tadā āgāmivarṣe śeṣakarkaṭāditye avaśyam āṣāḍhīpaurṇamāsī bhavati tasyā vā āṣāḍhatvāt tatraiva viṣṇuḥ svapiti, dvividhasyāpi ca māsapātasya nāmāvāsyādvayādi smṛtaṃ, tathā ca sati yadā karkaṭāditrike amāvāsyādvayaṃ bhavati tadā śuklapratipadi dvitīyāyāṃ vā kanyātulāsaṃkrāntir bhavati āgāmivarṣe meṣasaṃkrāntir api tathaiva, pratimāsaṃ saṃkramaṇe ca dinadvayavṛddhyā pañcamyāṃ ṣaḍaśītimithunasaṃkrāntir bhavati tadā dvirāṣāḍhaṃ prakalpya karkaṭe [907] ’hani śayanaṃ na tu paramārthato dvirāṣāḍhaḥ | tathā ca gaṇitakuśalānāṃ mithunāditye bhoge atīte ’pi gaṇyamāne bhāskare mithunabhāga evādityasya gaṇite āṣāḍheti na tattvato gaṇitāmāvāsyādinābhyāṃ dvirāṣāḍo gamyate |
tad āha satyaḥ |
vṛṣaṃ tyaktvā caturthyante ṣaḍaśītiḥ site yadā |
tadā daivavidā cintyaṃ dvirāṣāḍhasya kalpanam ||
tathā ca jyotiḥśāstre |
śuklacaturthīm atikramya yadā saṃkramate raviḥ |
dvirāṣāḍhaṃ prakalpyaiva karkaṭādau svaped dhariḥ ||
prathame sa dvitīye vā śukle meṣam iyād raviḥ |
dvirāṣāḍhakriyā tāvad yāvad viṣṇuprabodhanam ||
viṣṇuḥ parakarkaṭake svapet | śeṣaṃ śakrotsavādi yathākālam eva kāryam |
tathā hi |
dvirāṣāḍhavikalpo ’yaṃ vaikuṣṭhaśayanaṃ prati |
dhvajas tu śatayajñas tu siṃha evaṃ vidhīyate ||
baudhāyanaś ca |
dvirāṣāḍakriyā tāvad yāvad viṣṇoḥ prabodhanam |
viśuddhe tu harau kāryā sūryagatyaiva sā kriyā ||
yadā tu prathame varṣe dvirāṣāḍhe karkaṭe hariśayanaṃ tadā kanyāyāṃ [908] parivarttanaṃ śakrodyāpanaṃ ca, tulāyāṃ durgotsavaḥ, vṛścike vāsudevotthāpanam |
yad āha viriñcyaḥ |
dakṣiṇāśāmukhe bhānau svaped yadi haris tadā |
kanyāvṛścikayor eva vivarttanavibodhane ||
tathā |
karkaṭake harau supte śakradhvajakriyāśvine |
tulāyāṃ bodhayed devīṃ vṛścike tu janārdanam || iti |
yadā tu prakalpyate dvirāṣāḍhaḥ, yadā ca svarūpatas tadā śuklapakṣe śravaṇadvaye sati |
yathā kartavyam āha satyaḥ |
dvirāṣāḍhe tu saṃprāpte yadi siṃhe hariḥ svapet |
paratra sthāpayec chakraṃ kanyāyāṃ tu visarjayet ||
atha kanyāyām eva śravaṇadvayaṃ bhavati tadā nāmādiśravaṇe śakrotthāpanaṃ, aparasmin durgotthāpanam | tad āha |
siṃhakanye ’tha pakṣe ca śukrādeḥ pakṣasaṃyute |
siṃhe pare śakram ahaḥ kanyāyāṃ siṃhadurgayoḥ ||
śuklapakṣadvaye pūjā kalpo ’yam aparaḥ smṛtaḥ |
dvirāṣāḍhasya vidvadbhiḥ svasamāptiś ca tāvatā ||
kuta ity apekṣāyām āha |
śakradhvajotthāpanaṃ ca viṣṇoś ca parivarttanam |
māsadvayena nirdiṣṭaṃ śayanādi na kovidaiḥ ||
[909]        durgāyāc ca tribhir māsair adhomāsaṃ vinaiva tat |
adhimāsanipāte tu kramād indrādikān harīn |
kanyātulāvṛścikeṣu rūpaṃ cotthāpayed dhruvam ||
adhimāsanipāta ity asyāyam aparo ’rthaḥ yadā karkaṭādiṣu paurṇamāsīdvayaṃ bhavati
adhimāsanipāte tu kramād indrādikān harīn | iti |
tathā hi |
āṣāḍhadvayasaṃyuktaṃ paurṇamāsadvayaṃ yadā |
dvirāṣāḍhaḥ sa vijñeyo viṣṇuḥ svapiti karkaṭe || iti |
tathā coktam |
vaiśākhāditulānte tu yadi pūrṇādvayaṃ bhavet |
dvirāṣāḍhaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ śayanāvarttanādiṣu ||
vaiśākhādīty upalakṣaṇaṃ phālgunadvayasyāpi māsasya trinakṣatratayā saṃbhavāt tatra phālgunādāv adhimāsapāte karkaṭe hariśayane sati māsacatuṣṭayenotthānaṃ bhavati karkaṭādicatuṣṭaye tv adhimāsapātān mithuna evāśāḍhād vā hariśayane vṛtte śrāvaṇyādīnām anyatra dvaividhye vṛścika eva kārttikamāso varttate tena pañcabhir api māsais tatraivotthānaṃ ābhākāsitapakṣeṣv ity asya bahusaṃmatatvenādhikatvāt “prabudhyate māsacatuṣṭayenety asya prāyikābhiprāyikānuvādatvāt eka evāsau māsaḥ |
yad āha bādarāyaṇaḥ |
ekamāsasthite sūrye yadi syād adhimāsakaḥ |
[910]        eka eva hi māso 'yau ṣaṣṭhibhir divasair mataḥ || iti |
evaṃ dvirāṣāḍhaphale prāpte dvirāṣāḍha ucyate na tu svarūpato dvirāṣāḍjaḥ evaṃ parivartanadurgotsavayor api boddhavyam | tad yathā śrāvaṇīdvayaṃ bhādrapadīdvayaṃ bhavati tadā devaśayanām māsatrayeṇa kanyāyāṃ śakrotthāpanam parataḥ tasmāc ca māsena durgotthāpanaṃ māsadvayena viṣṇoḥ | yadā tv āśvinīdvayaṃ bhavati tadā siṃha eva śakrotthāpanaṃ parivarttate tasmān māsadvayena durgāyās trayeṇa ca trayeṇa ca viṣṇor utthāpanaṃ, yadā tu kārttikīdvayaṃ bhavati tadāpi dvirāṣāḍhena dvirāṣāḍhakalpanaṃ karkaṭe hariśayanaṃ śakrotsavādi tu yathākālam ity ukaṃ | bhaviṣyottare adhimāsanipāte ’pi tulāyām eva kṛṣṇotthāpanam abhihitam |
mithunasthe sahasrāṃśau sthāpayen madhusūdanam |
tulāyāṃ ca mahārāja punar utthāpayet tu tam ||
adhimāse prapatite eṣa eva vidhikramaḥ |
nānyathā sthāpayet kṛṣṇaṃ nānyathotthāpayet tathā ||
ity alam ativistareṇa |
brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
dvādaśyāṃ tu site pakṣe māse prauṣṭhapade tathā |
śakram utthāpayed rājā viśvaśravaṇavāsave ||
''viśvaṃ' uttarāṣāḍhā, 'vāsavaṃ' dhaniṣṭhā, śravaṇanakṣatrasyādyapāde dvādaśyā yogaḥ supraśastatamaḥ |
tad uktuam |
[911]        vaiṣṇavādigate candre śakram utthāpayen nṛpa |
bharaṇyām antapāde ca niśi supte visarjayet ||
śravaṇasyādyapāde ca bharaṇyāṃ samasaptake |
śakraṃ prasādayed devaṃ yathā rājā na paśyati ||
saurabhaumādhipe vāre sūtake mṛtake 'pi vā |
bhūmikampādikotpāte śakraṃ naiva praśaṃsayet ||
nimittaviśeṣopanipāte tu bharaṇyantapādān ārabhyety anusandheyam |
āha vṛddhavaśiṣṭhaḥ |
candragṛhagate bhānau yadā svapiti keśavaḥ |
śaśiputragṛhe bhānau na cotthāpyaḥ purandaraḥ |
'candragṛhaṃ' karkaṭakaḥ, 'śaśiputragṛhaṃ' kanyeti |
athavāha |
dvirāṣāḍhe ca kanyāyāṃ śakraṃ notthāpayed yadi |
rājño rājyaṃ vinaśyeta prajā caiva nipīḍyate ||
kāle tu sthāpite śakre ciraṃ jīvati pārthivaḥ |
prajānāṃ tūtsavād evaṃ bhaved ṛkṣavatī kṣitiḥ || iti |
śeṣaṃ dvirāṣāḍhavivekadarśitam anusandheyam iti |
devīpurāṇe |
prauṣṭhapadena cāṣṭamyāṃ śuklāyāṃ śobhanarkṣake |
āśvine vātha śuklāyāṃ śrāvaṇe vā samucchrayet ||
gargaḥ |
siṃhaṃ gate dinakare sitacārupakṣe
haryādyapādam upagacchati vai śaśāṅke |
uttiṣṭhate vividhamandiravṛndabandho
yāmyāṃ tato niśi niṣīdati vajrapāṇiḥ || iti |
atha ca hariśabdena haridaivatyaṃ śravaṇanakṣatram upalabhyate |
bhaviṣyottare |
rājñānyenāpi karttavyo varṣe varṣe mahotsavaḥ |
indradhvajasamutthānaṃ mahādānakṛtaṃ yadi |
tatas tu dvādaśe varṣe karttavyaṃ nāntarā punaḥ ||
devīpurāṇe sūryarathayātrāyāḥ kathaṃcid akaraṇe dvādaśābde śakradhvajaṃ karttavya ity abhidhāyoktam |
indradhvajasya cāpy evam ucchrāyo na kṛto yadi |
tato dvādaśame varṣe karttavyo nāntarā punaḥ ||
śakrotsavo nabhasye tu kāryaḥ siṃhagate ravau |
dvādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣe tu nakṣatre viṣṇudaivate ||
tatpātaś ca bharaṇyāṃ syān navamyām āśvinasya tu |
arcayitvā bhagavatīṃ tataḥ sadyo visarjayet ||
bhāgavate |
kanyāyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe tu pūjayitvā svaped divā |
navamyāṃ bodhayed devīṃ gītavāditranisvanaiḥ ||
śuklapakṣe caturthyāṃ ca devīkeśavimocanam |
prātar eva tu pañcamyāṃ snāpayet tu śubhair jalaiḥ ||
saptamyām ambikāpūjā aṣṭamyāṃ supoṣaṇam |
[913]        vratāya jāgaraiś caiva navamyāṃ vidhivad baliḥ ||
saṃprekṣaṇaṃ daśamyāṃ tu krīḍākautukamaṅgalaiḥ |
nīrājanaṃ daśamyāṃ ca balavṛddhikaraṃ mahat ||
vārāhe |
ārdrayāṃ bodhayed devīṃ mūlena pratipūjayat |
uttareṇārcanaṃ kṛtvā śravaṇena visarjayet |
mūlena sakalāṃ bilvaśākhām āhṛtya pūjayet ||
antyapādo niśābhāge śravaṇasya yadā bhavet |
tadā devyāḥ samutthānaṃ navamyāṃ dinabhāgataḥ |
daśamyāṃ balavṛddhyarthaṃ kuryān nīrājanaṃ nṛpa ||
svātyādityatṛtīyādau saptāhaṃ cāśvine sati |
rakṣāṃ kṛtvā daśamyāṃ tu śaktyā nīrājayet tadā ||
nīrājanasaṃjñitāṃ śāntiṃ kuryād ity arthaḥ |
āha vyāsaḥ |
ārdrāyāṃ bodhayed devīṃ mūlena pratipūjayet |
tadā devyāḥ samutthānaṃ navamyāṃ na pumar divā ||
antyapādo divābhāge śravaṇasya yadā bhavet |
tadā saṃprekṣaṇaṃ devyā daśamyāṃ sādhanotsavaiḥ ||
ṛkṣatraye tu mūlādau navamyām āśvine site |
caṇḍikām upahāraiś ca pūjayed rāṣṭravṛddhaye ||
pūrvāṣāḍhe tu kanyāyām utthānaṃ navayoṣitaḥ |
kurvato hīyate rāṣṭraṃ prajā ca vikalā bhavet || iti |
[914]        brahmāṇḍapurāṇe |
tulāyāṃ tilatailena sāyaṃsandhyāsamāgame |
ākāśadīpaṃ yo dadyān māsam ekaṃ nirantaram |
saśrīkāya śrīpataye sa śriyā na vimucyate ||
dāmodarāya nabhasi tulāyāṃ lolayā saha |
pradīpante prayacchāmi namo ’nantāya vedhase ||
iti dīpadānamantraḥ |
amāvāsyāṃ tulāditye lakṣmīr nidrāṃ vimuñcati |
sukharātrisvarūpā sā pradīpojvalanāya vai ||
kusumbhakusumair gandhair dīpair gorocanāphalaiḥ |
vasurvadhūnavavadhūś (?) ca pṛcchet kuśalayā girā ||
pūjayec ca sadā lakṣmīm alakṣmīṃ malanāśinīm |
kṣaye pañcapatākānāṃ dhvajam ekaṃ gṛhe nyaset ||
vārāhe |
amāvāsyāṃ tulāditye lakṣmīr nidrāṃ vimuñcati |
tasmin śukle tadā viṣṇus tulāyām atha vṛścike ||
lakṣmīprabodhaḥ dīyāliketi yasya loke prasiddhiḥ |
kaumudī yakṣarātriś ca kausamī phālgunī tathā |
vāsantir iti vijñeyā deśasya mahimāśraye ||
āśvine paurṇamāsyāṃ ca niśādeḥ krīḍanaṃ smṛtam |
kaumudī yā samākhyātā kāryā lokavibhūtaye ||
[615]        kārttike sitapakṣādau tithau tu kusumāṃśakaiḥ |
yakṣārcā yakṣarātriḥ syāt kāryā ceṣṭasukhāya sā ||
māghaśuklacaturdaśyāṃ tu varam ārādhya ca śriyaḥ |
pañcamyāṃ kundakusumaiḥ pūjā sā kausumī smṛtā ||
phālgune paurṇamāsyāṃ tu yadā vāsavilāsakaḥ |
jñeyā sā phālgunī loke kāryā lokasamṛddhaye (?) ||
caitrāṣṭamyāsaśokais tu trayodaśyāṃ smarārcanam |
tac ca kāryam aśokārtha śeṣā vāsantiketi sā ||
atha jyotiḥśāstre |
amāvāsyāṃ tulāditye lakṣmīr nidrāṃ vimuñcati |
tasmin śukle yadā viṣṇus tulāyām adhigacchati |
uttiṣṭhaty agrato viṣṇuḥ paścāt kṛṣṇacaturdaśīm ||
atha bhaviṣyatpurāṇe |
snānaṃ dānaṃ śataguṇaṃ kārttike yā tithir bhavet |
pratipadbrahmaṇaś cāpi guḍamiśraiḥ sadīpakaiḥ |
vāsobhir ahataiś cādyair gacchet tad brahmaṇaḥ padam ||
puṣpair gandhair navair vastair ātmānaṃ pūjayed budhaḥ |
tasyāṃ pratipadāyāṃ ca sa gacched brahmaṇaḥ padam ||
iti śrīmahārājādhirājaśrīmahādevīyasamastakaraṇādhīśvara-
sakalavidyāviśāradaśrīhemādriviracite caturvargacitāmaṇau
pariśeṣakhaṇḍe kālanirṇaye viṣṇuśayanādikālanirṇayo nāma
saptadaśo ’dhyāyaḥ |
