athāṣṭādaśo ’dhyāyaḥ |
atha viṣṇunāmakīrttane kālaviśeṣaḥ |
viṣṇudharmottare |
vajra uvāca |
kasmin kāle tu devasya kiṃ kiṃ nāma prakīrtayet |
etan me saṃśayaṃ chindhi tvaṃ hi sarvavid ucyase ||
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
puruṣaṃ vāmadevaṃ ca vyāsaṃ saṅkarṣaṇaṃ prabhum |
pradyumnam aniruddhaṃ ca kramād eṣu prakītayet |
balabhadraṃ tathā kṛṣṇaṃ kīrtayeta dinadvaye ||
mādhavaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ tathā vai bhogaśāyinam |
padmanābhaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ tathā devaṃ trivikramam ||
krameṇa rājaśārdūla vasantādiṣu kīrtayet |
viṣṇuṃ ca madhuhantāraṃ tathā devaṃ trivikramam ||
vāmanaṃ śrīdharaṃ caiva hṛṣīkeśaṃ tathaiva ca |
dāmodaraṃ padmanābhaṃ keśavaṃ ca yadūttamam ||
nārāyaṇaṃ mādhavaṃ ca govindaṃ ca tathā kramāt |
caitrādiṣu ca māseṣu devadevam anusmaret |
prayujamnṃ aniruddhaṃ ca paṣayoḥ śuklakṛṣṇayoḥ ||
śarvaḥ sarvaḥ śivaḥ sthānur bhūtādir nidhir avyayaḥ |
cādityādiṣu vāreṣu kramād evam anusmaret ||
[917]        viśvaṃ viṣṇur vaṣaṭkāro bhūtabhavyabhavatprabhuḥ |
bhūtakṛd bhūtabhṛd bhāvo bhūtātmā bhūtabhāvanaḥ ||
avyaktaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣo viśvakarmā śuciśravāḥ |
saṃbhavo bhāvano bhartā prabhavaḥ prabhur īśvaraḥ ||
aprameyo ṛṣīkeśaḥ padmanābho ’maraprabhuḥ |
agrāhyaḥ śāśvato dhātā kṛṣṇaś caitān anusmaran |
devadevasya nāmāni kathitāni ca yādava ||
brahmāṇaṃ śrīpatiṃ viṣṇuṃ kapilaṃ śrīpatiṃ prabhum |
dāmodaraṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ govindaṃ madhusūdanam ||
bhūdharaṃ gadinaṃ devaṃ śaṅkhinaṃ padminaṃ tathā |
cakriṇaṃ ca mahārāja prathamādiṣu saṃsmaret |
sarvadā sarvadevānāṃ devadevasya yādava ||
nāmāni sarvāṇi janārdanasya
kālaś ca sarvaḥ puruṣapravīra |
tasmāt sadā sarvagatasya nāma
grāhyaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ varadasya rājan ||
vajra uvāca |
kāryārambhe kathaṃ kasmin kiṃ nāma parikīrtayet |
etan me saṃśayaṃ chindhi tvaṃ hi sarvavid ucyase ||
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca |
cakriṇaṃ halinaṃ caiva śārṅgiṇaṃ khaḍginaṃ tathā |
mokṣārtho pravasan rājan dikṣu prācyādiṣu smaret ||
[918]        acyutaṃ cādhikaṃ caiva sarvaṃ sarveśvaraṃ pṛthum |
saṃsmaret puruṣaṃ bhaktyā vyavahāreṣu sarvadā ||
kūrmaṃ vārāhaṃ matsyaṃ vā jalaprataraṇe smaret |
bhrājiṣṇum agnijanane japen nāma tv atandritaḥ ||
saṃgrāmābhimukho gacchan saṃsmaret tv aparājitam |
keśavaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ puṣkarākṣaṃ tathā japet ||
netrabādhāsu sarvāsu hṛṣīkeśaṃ tathaiva ca |
acyutaṃ cāmṛtaṃ caiva japed auṣadhakarmaṇi ||
garuḍadhvajānusmraṇād āpado mucyate naraḥ |
jvaraduṣṭaśirorogaviṣavīryaṃ praśāmyati ||
grahanakṣatrapīḍāsu devabādhāṭavīṣu ca |
dasyuvairanirodheṣu vyāghrasiṃhādisaṅkaṭe |
andhakāre tathā tīvre narasiṃheti kīrtayet ||
nārāyaṇaṃ śārṅgadharaṃ śrīdharaṃ gajamokṣaṇam |
vāmanaṃ khaḍginaś caiva duḥsvapneṣu tu saṃsmaret ||
agnidāhe samutpanne saṃsmarej jalaśāyinam |
balabhadraṃ tu yuddhārthī kṛṣyārambhe halāyudham |
uttaraṇe vaṇijyārthī śrīśam abhyudaye nṛpa ||
jagato maṅgalaṃ viṣṇuṃ māṅgalyeṣu kīrtayet |
agnighāteṣv aśeṣeṣu viśokeṣu tathā japet ||
uttiṣṭhan kīrtayed viṣṇuṃ prasvāpe mādhavaṃ naraḥ |
[919]        bhojane caiva govindaṃ sarvatra madhusūdanam ||
nārāyaṇaṃ sarvakālaṃ kṣatapraskhalitādiṣu |
snāne devārcane home praṇipāte pradakṣiṇe ||
kīrtayed vāsudevaṃ ca anukteṣv api yādavam |
kāryārambhe tathā rājan yatheṣṭaṃ nāma kīrtayet ||
sarvāṇi nāmāni hi tasya rājan
sarvārthasiddhau tu bhavanti puṃsaḥ |
tasmād yatheṣṭaṃ khalu devanāma
sarveṣu kāryeṣu japeta bhaktyā ||
iti viṣṇunāmakīrttane kālaviśeṣaḥ |
atha mukhyakālātikrame kālāḥ |
te ca gauṇā vācanikāś ceti dviprakārāḥ | tad evaṃ vicāryate mukhyakālāsambhave gauṇakālagrahaṇaṃ kāryaṃ na veti | nanu ko mukhyaḥ ko vā gauṇaḥ | yo vihitaḥ sa mukhyaḥ, yathā vṛddhiśrāddhādau prātarādiḥ | yaś cāvihitaḥ tatsamīpavartī teṣv evāṅgabhāvaṃ nīyamānaḥ saṅgavādiḥ sa gauṇaḥ | tad āha trikāṇḍamaṇḍanaḥ |
svakālād uttaro gauṇaḥ kālaḥ sarvasya karmaṇaḥ |
yad vāgāmikriyāmukhyakālasthāpy antarālavat |
gauṇakālatvam icchanti kecit prāktanakarmaṇi || iti |
asthārthaḥ pūrvottarayoḥ pūrvasya karmaṇo yaḥ svakālas tasmād uparitanaḥ uparitanakarmakālāc ca pūrvabhāvī pūrvāparayor antarālakāla iti yāvat
sa pūrvasmin karmaṇi gauṇaḥ | yad vā yathoktāntarālavad āgāmikriyā-[920]-mukhyakālasyāpi pūrvasmin karmaṇi gauṇakālatāṃ manyanta iti | kathaṃ punar uttarakarmakālasya pūrvakarmānuṣṭhānāya grahaṇam āśaṅkyate yataḥ svakālāt pracyutaṃ pūrvaṃ karma tāvad vinaṣṭaprāyaṃ uttaraṃ ca svakālād apracyutatvād avinaṣṭarūpaṃ tatra yady uttarakarmakāle pūrvaṃ karma kriyate tadā vinaṣṭasamādhānārthaṃ avinaṣṭavināśanaṃ prasajyate | tan mṛtajīvanāya jīvanmaraṇam iva syāt |
atra brūmaḥ | uttare karmakāle dayor avakāśe satīdam ucyate na punar asaty api tasmitnn iti |
nanu mukhyakālasamīpavartinaḥ kālasyābhidhayāvinābhūtapravṛttilabhyatvāl lākṣaṇikatvam evocitam |
satyam evaṃ, tathāpi tatkālopalakṣaṇībhūtāt apamārdavādiguṇopanītayā laukikyā prātarādiśabdapravṛttyā tasya gauṇatvam apy asty eveti gauṇatvoktir na virudhyate |
nanu tadanupadeśāt kathaṃ grāhyatvam āśaṅkyate |
pratinidhinyāyeneti brūmaḥ |
nanv evaṃ tarhi yathā kathaṃcit sādṛśyān madhyāhnādāv api kadācit prātarādikṛtyāni prasajyeran, kim atrāniṣṭaṃ kriyate evaṃ hi kadācid atyantasādṛśyavataḥ pracuragauṇaprayogasaṅginaḥ saṅgavāder alābhāt, tad evam asmin saṃśaye kaścit pūrvāhṇe daivikaṃ śrāddham ityādikālasaṃyuteṣu vākyeṣu kālaṃ prati karmaṇo guṇabhāvena vidhānaṃ matvā pradhānabhūtavihitakālātikrameṇa guṇabhūtakarmānugrahāya kālāntarānuṣṭhānaṃ na kāryam iti pūrvapakṣam abhipretya siddhāntitavān, kāle hi karma codyate na karmaṇi
kālaḥ ataḥ karmaṇām eva prādhānyaṃ kālam anūdya karmaṇo vidhānāt | tataḥ karma prati guṇabhūtavihitakālātikrame pradhānabhūtakarmānugrahārthaṃ gauṇakāle ’py anuṣṭhānaṃ kāryam, kālahāne karmaṇo ’pi tyāgasyānyāyyatvāt | na hy ekavyañjanaṃ vinā śeṣabhojanam eva tyavyate |
tad ayuktam | na tāvat karma-[921]guṇībhāvenātra pūrvapakṣo ghaṭate karmaṇaḥ phalasambandhāt | phalavatsaṃnidhāv aphalaṃ tadaṅgam iti nyāyena kālasyaivāṅgavāt | na ca karmaṇaḥ kālārthatayā parārthatvāt phalaśrutir arthavāda iti vācyam | kālasya phalavatkarmārthatvāvagamāt, nāpi kāmaguṇībhāvoktaḥ siddhānto ghaṭate, siddhahetvābhāsopanyāsāt, na hy atra kālānuvādena karma vidhīyate, kālasthānyataḥ prāptivirahāt |
nanu kālasya vākyāntareva prāptyabhāve 'py amāvāsyādirūpeṇa lokavyavahārād eva jñātasyānuvādo bhaviṣyati |
maivam | lokasiddhakālasvarūpānuvādena karmavidhāv asya svayam aphalatvena phalavatkarmāṅgatvābhāvena ca vidher ānarthakyaprasaṅgāt | kiṃ cāsmin karmaṇy upadeśyasya kālasya na karmāntarasambandho ghaṭate tasyaitatkarmānuṣṭhāne ’nantaram evānuṣṭhitatvāt |
nanv evaṃ tarhi yajeta svargakāma ity atrāpi lokād evāvagataṃ svargakāminam anūdya yāgavidher avadhāraṇāt kathaṃ na vidhyānarthakyaṃ |
ucyate, yady api svargakāmasyoddeśyatayā vākye ’nvayaḥ pratīyate tathāpi bhāvanāyāḥ prathamaṃ bhāvyasyāpekṣaṇāt puruṣasya ca siddharūpatayā tadanarhatvāt svargakāmapadena kāmanāviṣayabhūtaḥ svarga eva sādhyatvena samarpyate svargakāmas tu pūrvasiddha evānūdyate, yathā lohitoṣṇīṣā ṛtvijaḥ pracarantītyādau viśeṣyāṇām ṛtvijāṃ prāptatvād aprāptaviśeṣaṇamātraparatvaṃ vācyaṃ evam ihāpi | tad utkaṃ maṇḍanamiśraiḥ |
apekṣitatvāt bhāvyasya kāmaśabdā hi tatparāḥ |
viśeṣaṇapradhānatvaṃ daṇḍītyādiṣu darśitam || iti |
ataḥ kālānuvādena tatra karmavidhir ity ayuktam | tad evaṃ yathoktau pūrvottarapakṣāv ayuktau kau ca tarhi tau yuktau |
ucyate | tatra tāvat pūrvapakṣaḥ nityaṃ naimittikaṃ āvaśyakatvena prāpte tādṛgvidhasvarūpanirvāhārthaṃ yathā śaknuyād ity upabandhe vihitāsaṃpattau tatsadṛśapratinidhigrahaṇaṃ [922] kartavyam iti sthite svakālāsampattau gauṇakālagrahaṇaṃ kāryam |
tad āha trikālaṇḍamaṇḍanaḥ |
mukhyakāle yadāvaśyaṃ karma kartuṃ na śakyate |
gauṇakāle ’pi kartavyaṃ gauṇo ’py atredṛśo bhavet || iti ||
'īdṛśaḥ' mukhyakālasadṛśaḥ, anenāsya pratinidhitvena yogyatā darśitā | mṛtatithāv api gauṇakālagrahaṇaṃ darśayanti |
yathā kathaṃcit kartavyaṃ nityaṃ karma vijānatā |
na prāptasya vilopo ’sti paitṛkasya viśeṣataḥ || iti |
tathā |
divoditāni karmāṇi pramādād akṛtāni vai |
yāminyāḥ praharaṃ yāvat tāvat sarvāṇi kārayet |
sandhau rātrau na kartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ khalu viṣayayeḥ ||
atyādi |
sandhyādikālaviśeṣaniṣedhaś ca gauṇatvena tatkālagrahaṇaprāptau satyām evāvakalpyate | nityanaimittikeṣu ca yathā śaknuyāt tathā kuryād ity upabandhasāmarthyān nityavad atas tato ’nyāny apy aṅgāny anityāni bhavanti |
tathā ca paiṭhīnasiḥ |
pradhānasacivāny aṅgāni bhavanti na bhavanti ceti |
nanu yadi mukhyakālātikrame gauṇakālagrahaṇaṃ na viruddham tarhi darśapūrṇamāsapārvaṇaśrāddhādīnām amāvāsyādivihitakālābhāve pañcamyādiṣu kartavyatvaṃ prasajyeta | kā nāmaiṣā prasaktir abhimatam eva hi gauṇakālasvīkāravādinas tadā tadanuṣṭhānam | etac ca gauṇakālagrahaṇaṃ na kāmyeṣu | tatra hi sarvāṅgopasaṃhāraśaktasyaivādhikāra-pratipādanāt | gaukālagrahaṇe tu karmānuṣṭhāne kaścid viśeṣas trikāṇḍamaṇḍanoktaprasaṅgād ucyate |
[923]        gauṇeṣv eteṣu kāleṣu karma coditam ācaret |
prāyaścittaprakaraṇaproktāṃ niṣkṛtim ācaret ||
kālāntaroditaṃ karma eteṣu pūrvoktalakṣaṇeṣu gauṇakāleṣv ācaret |
pakṣāntaram api tenaivoktam |
prāyaścittam akṛtvā vā gauṇakāle samācaret |
atrākṛtvety atra pūrvakālatāpratītir avivakṣitā | tad evaṃ gauṇakālagrahaṇe prāpte ’bhidhīyate sarvatra saptamyantanirdiṣṭasya kāmasyānupādeyatve uddeśyaikasvabhāvasya nimittatvenābhidhānād adhikāriviśeṣaṇatve vihitakālam antareṇādhikārābhāvāt kālāntare kṛtam akṛtam eva syād iti gauṇakālagrahaṇaṃ na kāryaṃ vihitakālābhāve ’dhikārābhāvaḥ sāntapanīyādhikaraṇe prāpaṇāc ca nimittasyety atra sūtre pratipāditaḥ |
ata eva laugākṣiḥ |
gaṇitāj jñāyate kālaḥ kāle tiṣṭhanti devatāḥ |
varatv ekāhutiḥ kāle nākāle lakṣakoṭiśaḥ ||
yat tu trikāṇḍamaṇḍaṇena gauṇakālagrahaṇam uktaṃ tat pūrvapakṣanyāyasaiva siddhāntatām abhimanyamānenoktam ity upekṣaṇīyam | yat tu yathā kathaṃcid ityādismaraṇaṃ na tatra gauṇakālagrahaṇaṃ pratipādyate kiṃ tv agrahaṇam eva | yatas tasyāyam artho ’vagamyate svakālaprātasya karmaṇo mukhyadravyādyasampattivaśād vilopo ’nanuṣṭhānaṃ na kāryam, kiṃ tu svakāla eva yathā kathaṃcin mukhyadravyasadṛśopādānena kiṃcid vikalam api kartavyam iti | yad api "divoditāni karmāṇi" ityādivacanaṃ na tena sarveṣv api karmasu sarveṣāṃ ca gauṇakālānāṃ gauṇakālayuktyā grahaṇam ucyate kiṃ tu keṣucid eva karmasu kiṃcid eva kālāntaram anukalpatvena mukhyakālavan nyāyād aprāptam eva vidhīyate | ato naitadvacanabalena saṃvatsarartumāsatithyā-[924]dikālaviśeṣavihitāni karmāṇi tattatkālātikrame kālāntare ’pi kartuṃ yujyante | yat tu sandhyārātryoḥ śrāddhaniṣedhaḥ so ’pi rāgataḥ prāptasya bhakṣaṇāder iva nyāyābhāvotpāditamohaprāptasyopapadyate | atha vā |
"drayaṃ brāhmaṇasampattiḥ śrāddhaṃ prati rucis tathā |
akāle yadi vā kāle tīrthaśrāddhaṃ sadā naraiḥ ||
prāpter eva hi karttavyam” ityādibhir aparāhṇādivyatiriktakālaprāptasya śrāddhasya sandhyādikāleṣv ayaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ | yat tu mukhyakālātikrame nityamaimittikānāṃ gauṇakāle ’nuṣṭhānaṃ dṛṣyate tat kvacit śiṣṭagarhāparihāramanaḥparitoṣādyarthaṃ, kvacic cānukalpatvena kalāntaravidhir ity anavadyam | upadiṣṭakālātikrame cādhikārābhāvād eva mukhyadravyalobhān mukhyakālātikramo na kāryaḥ, etad eva ca sandehapūrvakam upanyasya trikāṇḍamaṇḍanena nirṇītam |
mukhyakāle hi mukhyaṃ cet sādhanaṃ naiva labhyate |
tatkāladravyayoḥ kasya mukhyatvaṃ gauṇatāpi vā ||
mukhyakālam upāśritya gauṇaṃ mukhyasya sādhanam |
na mukhyadravyalobhena gauṇakālapratīkṣaṇam ||
tad evam etat siddhaṃ vacanam antareṇa gauṇakālagrahaṇaṃ na kāryaṃ sati tu vacane gauṇasya, tasmāt parasyāpi grahaṇaṃ kāryam iti |
iti śrīmadrājādhirājaśrīmahādevīyasamastakaraṇādhīśvara-sakalavidyāviśāradaśrīhemādriviracite caturvargacitāmaṇau
pariśeṣakhaṇḍe kālanirṇayaḥ samāptaḥ |
śivam astu |
